text.body: <1> śrīḥ alaṃkāramaṇihāre dvitīyabhāgaprārambhaḥ atha parikarālaṃkārasaraḥ sābhiprāye parikāro'laṃkārassyādviśeṣaṇe | atrālaṃkāra ityuktiḥ doṣābhāvenaiva caritārthyamiti śaṅkānirāsāya | taccāgre darśayiṣyate | sābhiprāye prakṛtārthopapādakārthaviṣayakābhiprāyapūrvake tathābhūtārthavyañjake iti yāvat | tathāca prakṛtārthopapādakārthavyañjakaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ lakṣaṇamiti dhyeyam | dhvanāvatiprasaṅganirāsāya prakṛtārthopapādaketi | hetvalaṃkāravāraṇāya bodhakatvamapahāya vyañjakatvaniveśaḥ | vakṣyamāṇaparikarāṅkurālaṃkāravāraṇāya viśeṣaṇeti | tatra tu viśeṣyaṃ tatheti nātiprasaṅgaḥ || yathā dhutamapi tava caraṇarucā natatāśrayaṇādrame mahārajanam| etya mahārajatatvaṃ vidyudvarṇe tavaiti sāvarṇyam || 803 || vidyudvarṇe! he rame! mahārajanaṃ kusumbhaḥ ‘syānmahārajanaṃ klībaṃ kusumbhaḥ' ityamaraḥ | tava caraṇarucā dhutamapi natatāśrayaṇāt namratāvalambanāt sārāsāraṃ balaṃ vīryamātmano dviṣataśca yaḥ | jānan vicarati prājño na sa yāti parābhavam || evameva yadā vidvānmanyate'tibalaṃ ripum | saṃśrayedvaitasīṃ vṛttimetat prajñānalakṣaṇam || iti bhāratādyuktarītyā vaitasavṛttyāśrayaṇāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe mahārajanāmitipadaṃ natatāśrayaṇāt nakārasya takāratvāśrayaṇāt nakāramapanīya tatra takārapaṭhanāditi bhāvaḥ| mahārajatatvaṃ suvarṇatvaṃ ‘mahārajatakāñcane' ityamaraḥ | mahārajataśabdatvamiti ca | etya tava sāvarṇyaṃ eti | atra vidyudvarṇe iti viśeṣaṇaṃ mahārajanasya upapāditaprakāreṇa mahārajatatāvāptipūrvakasāvarṇyalābhārhatābhiprāyagarbham || yathāvā ākālikasukhadāyāstokānekārtivartanīkāya| lokāya varākāya śrīkānta brahmaṇo'pi naṃ spṛhaye || ākālikaṃ āśuvināśi yat sukhaṃ taddadātīti tathoktāya samānakālāvādyantau yasyeti vigrahaḥ ‘ākālikaḍādyantavacane' ityāśuvināśinyarthe samānakālaśabdāṭhṭhak | samānakālaśabdasyākālādeśaḥ 'ākālāṭhṭhaṃśca' iti ṭhanvā | astokāḥ anekā ārtivartanyaḥ pīḍāmārgāḥ yasmiṃstathoktāya | anyatsugamam | atrānekāni lokasya viśeṣaṇānyatiheyatābhiprāyagarbhāṇi || yathāvā arivargalulitahṛdayaṃ duritacchuritaṃ durantavipadudayam | karivarada kṛpāsindho tvaritaṃ māmuddhareśa natabandho || 805 || atrānekānyahamarthaviśeṣaṇānyatidīnatvena dayanīyatvābhiprāyagarbhitāni | anekāni ca bhagavadviśeṣaṇāni bhaktavatsalatayā taduddharaṇāvaśyakatābhiprāyagarbhitāni || yathāvā nācakathaṃ rāmakathāṃ nāraracaṃ bhārataṃ ca bhūritaram | nācakalaṃ bhāgavataṃ nātha kathaṃ tāvakastavasyeśe || 806 || katharacakalāstrayo dhātavaścurādyantargaṇe kathādāvadanteṣu paṭhitāḥ | tebhyassvārthaṇijantebhyaḥ kartari luṅi 'ṇiśridrusrusyaḥ kartari caṅ' iti cleścaṅi ṇeraglopitatvāt ‘sanvallaghuni caṅpare'naglope' ityatrānaglope iti paryudāsātsanvadbhāvābhāvena abhyāsasya ‘sanyataḥ' iti vihita ikāraḥ 'dīrgho laghoḥ' iti dīrghaśca na | īśe iti īśadhātorlaḍuttamaikavacanam | stavasyetyatra ‘adhogarthadayeśām' iti karmaṇaśśeṣatvavivakṣayā ṣaṣṭhī | atra nācakathamityādīni viśeṣaṇāni svāsmin prācetasapārāśaryasūtāsādhāraṇakāryaniṣedhamukhena nāhaṃ prācetasa ityādyākūtagarbhitāni || yathāvā nodāyiṣi jvalanato nodāhārṣīśca matkṛte gītām | ko'sāviti mama dayase vyāsānnājaniṣi cāhamabjākṣa || 807 || atra jvalanato nodāyiṣītyādīni viśeṣaṇāni svasmin draupadīdhanañjayaśukāsādhāraṇakāryaniṣedhamukhena nāhaṃ draupadītyādyābhiprāyagarbhāṇi | atrādye udāharaṇe ekaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ, samanantarodāharaṇayoḥ pratyekaṃ bahūni viśeṣaṇāni padārtharūpāṇi ekābhiprāyagarbhāṇi antimodāharaṇayoḥ vākyārtharūpāṇi bhinnābhiprāyagarbhāṇi ceti bhidā | eteṣu vyaṅgyārthasadbhāve'pi na dhvanivyapadeśaḥ | suvarṇasya ramāsāvarṇyaprāptau caturmukhalokasyāspṛhaṇīyatāyāṃ bhagavattadbhaktayoravaśyoddhartṛtoddharaṇīyatvayoḥ svasmin dayākaraṇakāraṇābhāve ca vācya evopaskārakatvāt | ataeva vyaṅgyārthasya vācyaparikaratvāt parikara iti nāma asyālaṃkārasya || nanu niṣprayojanaviśeṣaṇopādāne apuṣṭārthadoṣasya sarvasaṃpratipannatayā saprayojanaviśeṣaṇaṃ doṣābhāvamātraṃ kaṣṭatvādyabhāvavadbhavitumarhati na tvalaṃkāra iti | atra prāñcaḥ ekadharminiṣṭhatayā bahūnāṃ sābhiprāyaviśeṣaṇānāmupādāne vicchittiviśeṣo'nubhavārūḍhatayā durapalapa ityalaṃkāramadhye parigaṇita iti || atra dīkṣitāḥ anekaviśeṣaṇopanyāsa eva parikara iti na niyamaḥ | śleṣayamakādāvapuṣṭārthasya doṣatvābhāvāttatraikasya viśeṣaṇasya sābhiprāyatve'pyalaṃkāratā durnivārā | evaṃca ‘sudhāṃ śukalitottaṃsaḥ' ityatrāpi tasyātmalābho na nirudhyate | apicaikapadārthahetukaṃ kāvyaliṅgamalaṃkāra iti sarvasammataṃ, tadvadekasyāpi viśeṣaṇasya sābhiprāyasyālaṃkāratvaṃ yuktamevetyāhuḥ || anye tu śleṣādyatiriktasthale sābhiprāyaviśeṣaṇopādānena vicchittiviśeṣasvīkāre tasyālaṃkāratvaṃ durvāraṃ, anyathā ca śleṣādisthale'pi vicchittiviśeṣo nāstītyapi kaktuṃ śakyam | yadi ca tatrānubhavaḥ pramāṇamityucyate tadā'nyatrāpi tattulyamiti na pṛthagalaṃkārateti dīkṣitamataṃ dūṣayitvā sundaratve satyupaskārakatvamalaṃkāratvaṃ, camatkārāpakarṣakābhāvamātratvaṃ doṣābhāvatvaṃ, tayośca kvacidekatra samāveśe'pi naikenaikasyānyathāsiddhiḥ upadheyasaṃkare'pyupādherasaṃkarāt | yathā brāhmaṇasya mūrkhatvaṃ doṣaḥ vidyā tu doṣābhāvo bhavati guṇaśca, tadvadihāpyupapattiḥ | na ca doṣābhāvatayā prāptasyāpi parikarasya kimityalaṃkāreṣu gaṇanāgauravamiti vācyam | ubhayātmakatvena doṣāntaravailakṣaṇyajñāpanārthatayā tadupapatteḥ | yathā guṇībhūtavyaṅgyabhedatayā saṃgṛhītā'pi samāsoktiralaṃkāragaṇanāyāṃ punargaṇyate, yathā vā prāsādavāsiṣu gaṇito'pyubhayavāsī bhūvāsigaṇanāyāṃ punargaṇyate tathehāpīti na kaściddoṣaḥ | anyathā kāvyaliṅgamapyalaṃkāro na syāt | nirheturūpadoṣābhāvātmakatvāditi prāhuḥ || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre parikarālaṃkārasaraḥ ṣaḍviṃśaḥ <2> atha parikarāṅkurasaraḥ viśeṣyaṃ yadi sākūtaṃ bhavetparikarāṅkuraḥ | viśeṣyasya sābhiprāyatve parikarāṅkurālaṃkāraḥ || yathā dhanuṣi trinayanakarajuṣi patrībhūya trivikrama purā tvam | trīṇi purāṇyasurāṇāṃ sudurādharṣāṇi bhasmasādakṛthāḥ || 808 || trinayanaśabdaḥ kṣubhnādigaṇe paṭhitaḥ | ‘kṣubhnādiṣu ca' iti niṣedhāt ‘pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmagaḥ' iti ṇatvaṃ na | atra trayo vikramā yasyeti vyutpattyā yogabalāttripurābhibhavapaṭayistvamabhivyañjayantrivikrameti viśeṣyaṃ vācyopaskārakatāṃ pratipadyate || yathavā balisutabāhādaśaśatavidalanakṛtko vinā sahasrāram| jalaruhakuladaladaśaśatavidalanakṛtko'ntarā sahasrāṃśum || 809 || atra pradhānavākyārtho dṛṣṭāntālaṃkārarūpaḥ | tatra bimbapratibimbarūpayorvākyārthayorviśeṣyabhūtau sahasrārasahasrāṃśuśabdau bāhādalasahasravidalanadhurīṇatāṃ vyañjayantau vācyopaskārakau || yathāvā eṣa navanītacoro mūṣati netraṃ mama svahṛnmadhye'mum | sinuyāṃ bandhaṃ kathamiva dhunuyāddāmodaro'yamīkṣeyāham || 810 || eṣa navanītacoraḥ nandanandanaḥ mama netraṃ nayanaṃ mūṣati ‘rūpaudāryaguṇaiḥ puṃsāṃ dṛṣṭicittāpahāriṇam' ityuktarītyā'paharati | ‘mūṣa steye' bhauvādikaḥ | aṃśukamapaharatītyapi gamyate | ‘netraṃ vastre'kṣṇi' iti ratnamālā | amuṃ evaṃ netraharaṃ svahṛnmadhye svamano'ntare sinuyāṃ dhyāyeyamiti yāvat | pakṣe svahṛtāṃ parasvāpahāriṇāṃ madhye sinuyāṃ asyāpi coratvāditi bhāvaḥ | ayaṃ evaṃ bandhanaṃ prāpitaḥ dāmodaraḥ bandhaṃ mama bhavabandhaṃ kathamiva dhunuyāt ahaṃ īkṣeya māmakabhavabandhavimocanakramamamuṣya kīdṛgiti parīkṣeyeti bhāvaḥ | athavā svayameva baddhaḥ kathaṃ mama bandhamapanayet ‘baddhassvayaṃ kimu vimocayitā batānyam' ityukteriti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe matkṛtasvahṛnmadhyabandhaviślathanasyāyaṃ neśīteti bhāvaḥ | atra navanītacora iti viśeṣyaṃ cauryaniṣṇātatākūtagarbhaṃ sannetramūṣaṇarūpavācyārthopaskārakam | dāmodara iti viśeṣyaṃ bandhaviślathanānaśitābhiprāyagarbhaṃ satkathaṃkāraṃ bandhaṃ dhunuyāditi vācyopaskārakatāmaśnute | atra viśeṣyadvayaṃ bhinnābhiprāyakam || kvacittu yogamanapekṣya prasiddhibalādeva vyañjakaṃ bhavati viśeṣyam | yathoktamekāvalyāṃ 'kvacitpunaḥ prasiddhatvādviśeṣyamatathābhūtaṃ prayuktamapi tathābhūtamabhiprāyamabhivyanakti' iti || yathā na trātuṃ sutrāmā satrārirvidhirapīśvaraḥ khalumām | bhavagahanaguhāśayitaṃ niyataṃ mucukundavarada eveṣṭe || 811 || atra mucukundavarada iti viśeṣyaṃ guhāntaranidrāṇajanatrāṇadhurīṇatāmabhivyañjayati || yathāvā dūrīkṛtasaddarśanamūrīkutamalinimā'hiśikharīndo | daharaguhāghanatama iha na harasi kimimāṃ praviśya cakradhara || 812 || he cakradhara! dūrīkṛtaṃ satāṃ brahmavidāṃ darśanaṃ yena tattathoktam | pakṣe satāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ darśanaṃ yena tat guhāntargatasya ghanatamaso nakṣatranirvarṇanāsaṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ | ūrīkṛtaḥ malinimā pāpmā nailyaṃ ca yena tattathoktaṃ, daharaguhāyāḥ ghanatamaḥ tatra vidyamānassāndrastamoguṇa eva gāḍhatamisraṃ meghāvṛtiprayuktaṃ timiraṃ vā | imāṃ daharaguhāṃ praviśya kiṃ na harasi, na harasi kimiti vā yojanā | kena hetunā na harasi vā na jānīma iti prāthamikayojanāyāmabhiprāyaḥ, harasyeveti dvitīyayojanāyāma | atra cakradhareti viśeṣyaṃ cakrasya bhāskarakoṭibhāsvaratayā taddhāriṇo bhagavataḥ hṛdayaguhāntargataghanatamonibarhaṇasaukaryamabhipraiti || yathā vā dūrotsāritadussahadurantadurvāsanaṃ vidhāyaiva | vanamālinnāmodaya nanu mānasamānatasya mama || 813 atra vanamālinniti viśeṣyaṃ dūrvāsanādūrotsāraṇapūrvakāmodanopapattirūpamabhiprāyamabhivyañjayadvācyasyopaskurute || yathā vā rāma iti nāma yattava tāmarasekṣaṇa sahasranāmasadṛkṣam | ko mahimānaṃ gadituṃ nāmāsya paṭustamantareṇānantam || 814 || asya mahimānaṃ gadituṃ ko nāma paṭuriti yojanā | ‘paryāptivacaneṣvalamartheṣu' iti tumun | atrānantamiti viśeṣyaṃ sahasraśīrṣatvamabhiprayatsat ‘sahasranāmatattulyaṃ rāmanāma' iti śrīviṣṇusahasranāmasamānavaibhavarāmanāmamahimavarṇanapaṭutārūpavacyārthaunmukhyamupaiti || yathā vā tava nāmasahasrasya stavanāya rame sa eka evālam | bhuvanādhīśvari puruṣaḥ pavanāśanapariṣadagraṇīrathavā || sa puruṣaḥ ‘sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ' iti prathitaḥ paramaḥ pumān eka eva tava stavanāya alaṃ samarthaḥ | athavā pavanāśanapariṣadagraṇīḥ bhujagakuladhaureyaśśeṣaḥ alamiti yojanā | atra puruṣaḥ pavanāśanapariṣadagraṇīriti viśeṣyadvayaṃ sahasraśīrṣatvābhiprāyagarbhitaṃ sat lakṣmīsahasranāmastavanasamarthatārūpavācyārthaparikaratāṃ pratipadyate | pūrveṣūdāharaṇeṣu caturṣu ekameva viśeṣyaṃ sābhiprāyaṃ, iha tu viśeṣyadvayaṃ tadapyekābhiprāyakam || yathā vā na hi tādṛśyabhimanyau vihitā bhavatā''rtibhāji śatamanyau | dvirade yādṛkkaruṇā varadeha vadāmi kiṃ bhavantamaham || 816 || atra abhimanyau śatamanyau iti viśeṣyadvayaṃ bhāgineyatvena bhrātṛtvena tatrāpi yogamahimnā ativeladainyavattvena cāvaśyādaraṇīyatvaṃ, dvirade iti viśeṣyaṃ vanyatvenānanubandhitayā upekṣaṇīyatvaṃ, varadeti viśeṣyaṃ tu avivecitasvaparavaradānena mugdhatamatvaṃ cābhivyañjayatīti catvāri viśeṣyāṇi bhinnābhiprāyagarbhāṇīti pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥ | anubandhyapekṣayā ananubandhinyeva tvayā paripūrṇā kṛpā vyadhīyateti iha vadāmi kiṃ bhavantamahamiti vākyenopālambho dyotitaḥ || atredaṃ boddhavyaṃ parikarāṅkuro nālaṃkārāntaraṃ bhavitumarhati sābhiprāyapadavinyāsaḥ parikara iti taṃ lakṣayitvā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyapadatvābhyāṃ tasya dvaividhyābhivarṇane'sya tadavāntarabhedatvasaṃbhavāt | vicchittivailakṣaṇyādhīnaṃ hyalaṃkāravailakṣaṇyaṃ, na hyekavākyagatapadasābhiprāyatvanibandhane tadastīti | ayaṃ cālaṃkāra ekāvalīkārādibhirlakṣitaḥ | prāñcastu prakāśakārādayo nālakṣayannamum || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre parikarāṅkurasarassaptaviṃśaḥ <3> atha śleṣasaraḥ varṇyāvarṇyobhayālambī śleṣo'nekārthasaṃśrayaḥ| anekārthaśabdavinyāsaśśleṣaḥ| sa ca trividhaḥ prakṛtaviṣayaḥ, aprakṛtaviṣayaḥ, prakṛtāprakṛtaviṣayaśceti | trividhopyayaṃ sabhaṅgābhaṅgabhedena punastrividha iti ṣaḍvidhaḥ | tatrādyaḥ prakāro yathā ahigiripatihṛdayaṅgamavṛttirudanvatsutādhibhūrjagatām | śubhakṛdalaṃ naḥ kurutāṃ paritāntānāṃ śriyaṃ bhave caratām || 817 || ahigiripatiḥ śeṣanāmādrivaraḥ tasmit hṛdayaṃgamā hṛdyā vṛttiḥ sthitiryasya sa tathokta iti bhagavatpakṣe | śrīpakṣe tu ahigiripateḥ veṃkaṭādrinetuḥ śrīnivāsasya hṛdayaṃgamā vakṣo'dhigatā vṛttiḥ vartanaṃ yasyāsseti | jagatāṃ śubhakṛt | udanvatsutāyāḥ śriyaḥ adhibhūḥ nāyakaḥ, idaṃ bhagavatpakṣe viśeṣyam | anyatra śubhakṛt kalyāṇakarī | jagatāṃ adhibhūriti yojanā | bhuvanānāmadhīśvarītyarthaḥ | udanvatsutā sindhunandinī śrīḥ, idaṃ viśeṣyam | anyatsugamam || yathāvā madīye rāmeśvaravijaye raṅkharājavilāse ca campūprabandhe hṛdayehirājabhāsuramañcamudāraṃ sadā girāṃ prāptyai | kalayehitaṃ dadānaṃ dhāma purāṇaṃ turaṅgarājākhyam || 818 || ahirāja eva bhāsuramañco yasya taṃ udāraṃ vadānyaṃ hitaṃ śreyaḥ dadānaṃ, udāramityetat hitaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā, niśśreyasamiti tadarthaḥ| raṅgarājākhyaṃ purāṇaṃ dhāma tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe ‘syurevaṃ tu punarveai vetyavadhāraṇavācakāḥ' ityamaraḥ | dhāmaivetyarthaḥ | sadā girāṃ prāptyai hṛdaye citte kalaye dhyāyāmi | anyatra hṛdaye ityatra hṛt aye iti cchedaḥ | hīti bhinnaṃ padaṃ prasiddhyarthakam | aye hṛt! he hṛdaya! rājabhāsuraṃ candrabimbe prakāśamānaṃ candravadviśadamiti vā | añca mudā araṃ iti chedaḥ | kalayā alpakālenaiva īhitaṃ īpsitaṃ dadānaṃ turaṅgarājākhyaṃ purāṇaṃ dhāma śrīhayagrīvamityarthaḥ | sadā girāṃ prāptyai mudā añca iti yojanā | ārādhayetyarthaḥ | añcerloṇmadhyamaikavacanam | anayorudāharaṇayosstavyatvena prakṛtayośśrīśrīnivāsayoḥ śrīraṅgarājahayagrīvayośca śleṣaḥ | sa ca prathame udāharaṇe abhaṅgaḥ dvitīye sabhaṅga iti dhyeyam | evaṃ vakṣyamāṇodāharaṇeṣu yathāsaṃbhavaṃ draṣṭavyam | vaktavyāntaraṃ tūpariṣṭādvakṣyate || yathāvā prathimahitaṃ prodyaddhanamitradyotaṃ mahāyudhaṃ hṛdaye | sārasanābhaṃ kalaye sudarśanaṃ sādhucakrarājaṃ tam || 819 || atra bhagavataḥ sudarśanasya ca prakṛtayoreva śleṣaḥ | tathāhi, bhagavatpakṣe prathimne pṛthutvāya āśritaprakhyāpanāyeti yāvat | hitaṃ ‘caturthī tadartha' ityādinā samāsaḥ | prathimnā prakhyātatvena hitamiti vā | sudarśanapakṣe prathiḥ nemiḥ tena mahitaṃ ‘nemisstrī syātprathiḥ pumān' ityamaraḥ | prodyan prāvṛḍārambhe vijṛmbhamāṇaḥ ghanaḥ meghaḥ tasya mitraṃ suhṛt dyotaḥ prakāśo yasya taṃ prāvṛṣeṇyaghanāghanaśyāmalamityarthaḥ | pakṣe prodyan udayamānaḥ ghanassāndraḥ avikalaprakāśa iti yāvat | yaḥ mitraḥ bhānuḥ tasya dyota iva dyoto yasya taṃ udyadbhānunibhaprabhamityarthaḥ | ‘sudarśanaṃ bhāskarakoṭitulyam' ityukteḥ | mahāyudhaṃ mahānti āyudhāni cakrādīni yasya tam | pakṣe mahatī yut yuddhe yasya taṃ ‘samityājisamidyudhaḥ' ityamaraḥ | yadvā bhagatpakṣa eva mahatī yut yasyeti | sudarśanapakṣe tu mahānti āyudhāni śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ sacāpaṃ paraśumasimiṣuṃ śūlapāśāṅkuśāgnīn bibhrāṇaṃ vajrakheṭaṃ halamusalagadākuntam' ityuktarītyā bahvāyudhadhāriṇamityarthaḥ | sārasaṃ padmaṃ nābhau yasya tam | gaḍvāderākṛtigaṇatvātsaptamyāḥ paranipātaḥ| bhagavatpakṣe idaṃ viśeṣyam | pakṣe araiḥ parito'rpitābhiśśalākābhissaha vartata iti sāraḥ ‘sphuratsahasrāraśikhātitīvram' ityādyukteḥ ‘araṃ śīghre ca cakrāṅge' iti medinī | nābhyā madhyarandhreṇa saha vartata iti sanābhaḥ ‘acpratyanvava' ityatra ajiti yogavibhāgādac | ubhayatra sahapūrvapadabahuvrīhiḥ| sāraścāsau sanābhaśceti viśeṣaṇobhayapadakarmadhārayaḥ | taṃ tathoktam | sudarśanaṃ kalyāṇālokanam | sādhūnāṃ satāṃ cakrasya bṛndasya rājā taṃ tathoktaṃ sārasanābhaṃ kalaye iti bhagavatpakṣe yojanā | sudarśanapakṣe tu cakrarājaṃ cakrāṇāṃ rājānaṃ sudarśanaṃ tannāmānaṃ bhagaddivyāyudhaṃ, idameva viśeṣyam | sādhu yathā syāttathā kalaye iti yojanā | sudarśanaśabdaḥ puṃsyapyanuśiṣṭaḥ ‘sudarśano'striyāṃ cakre' iti nāmanidhāne | ‘sudarśano hareścakre merujambūdrume pumān, atha sudarśanaḥ | viṣṇoścakre' iti medinyabhidhānacintāmaṇyostu puṃsyeva | tena 'nāmaliṅgānuśāsane ‘cakraṃ sudarśanam' iti klībatayā pāṭhasadbhāve'pi na virodhaḥ | vastutastu tatrāpi puṃliṅgapāṭha evādṛto'marasudhādau | prayuktaśca māghena ‘bandhureṣa jagatāṃ sudarśanaḥ' iti | yadyapyatra prathimahitamityādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya sudarśanamityasya dvitīyaikavacanāntatayā tatra puṃnapuṃsakayoraikarūpyānna puṃliṅgatopapattirapekṣitā | tathā'pi mahāyudhamiti viśeṣaṇe mahatī yut yasyeti vigrahe tayoḥ rūpabhedo'vaśyaṃbhāvītyapekṣitaiva sā pradarśiteti vibhāvanīyam || yathāvā harimukhamarudabhisaṃstavabhavaninadadhvastadanutanujadarpaḥ | pañcajanādhāro'vyādbhagavān rājanmahādaraḥ ko'pi || 820 || atra bhagatpāñcajanyayoḥ prastutayoreva śleṣaḥ| tathāhi harimukhā indrādyāḥ ye marutaḥ devāḥ ‘marutau pavanāmarau' itya maraḥ | teṣāṃ abhitaḥ saṃstavāt samīcīnastuteḥ bhavaḥ jātaḥ yo ninadaḥ tena dhvastaḥ danutanujadarpaḥ dānavagarvaḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | pakṣe hareḥ bhagavataḥ mukhamarutaḥ vadanānilasya abhisaṃstavaḥ abhitaḥ paricayaḥ ‘saṃstavassyātparicayaḥ' ityanuśāsanāt | tadbhavena ninadena dhvastadanutanujadarpaḥ | ūkto'rthaḥ | anena viṣṇormukhotthānilapūritasya yasya dhvanirdānavadarpahantā' ityetatpratyabhijñāpyate | pañcajanānāṃ manujānāṃ ‘syuḥ pumāṃsaḥ pañcajanāḥ' ityamaraḥ | pañcabhirbhūtairjanyanta iti pañcajanāḥ ‘janī prādurbhāve' ghañ | ‘janivadhyośca' iti na vṛddhiḥ | ādhāraḥ āśrayaḥ | yadvā pañcajanānāṃ indriyāṇāṃ ādhāraḥ āśrayaḥ ‘yasmin pañca pañcajanā ākāśaśca pratiṣṭhitaḥ iti śruteḥ | pakṣe pañcajano nāma daityaḥ sa ādhāro yasya saḥ tadadhāratvādevāsya pāñcajanyaśabdavācyatā | yathoktaṃ śrīmati bhāgavate nāhārṣaṃ tamahaṃ deva daityaḥ pañcajano mahān | antarjalacaraḥ kṛṣṇa śaṅkharūpadharo'suraḥ || ityupakramya, tadaṅgaprabhavaṃ śaṅkhamādāya rathamāviśat | iti | ata eva hi ‘gambhīrāññyaḥ' iti sūtrasthāt ‘bahirdevapañcajanebhyaśceti vaktavyam' iti vārtikāt bhavārthe ñyena niṣpāditaḥ pāñcajanyaśabdo bhāṣyakṛtā | rājan prakāśamānaḥ mahān ādaro yasya saḥ | ko'pi ‘yato vāco nivartante' iti śrutamahāmahimā | bhagavān avyāt | pakṣe bhagavāniti viśeṣaṇam | ko'pi lokavilakṣaṇaḥ rājat mahaḥ tejaḥ yasya sa rājanmahāḥ daraḥ śaṅkhaḥ avyāt iti || yathā vā rucirāṅgadāṃ bhujaṅgamapuṅgavagiripatikaragrahollasitām | vidhutālasadanujātāṃ sādhuśriyamāśraye śaraṇam || 821 || atra stotavyatvena prastutayorlakṣmīgadayoḥ śleṣaḥ | tathāhi bhujaṅgamapuṅgavagiripateḥ śrīnivāsasya karagraheṇa pāṇigraheṇa pariṇayenetyarthaḥ | pakṣe hastādānena ullasitāṃ ullāsaśālinīṃ bhāsamānāṃ ca | vidhorbhāvaḥ vidhutā tayā candratayā lasan anujātaḥ anujanmā yasyāstāṃ candrasodarāmityarthaḥ | pakṣe vidhutāḥ nirdhūtāḥ ata eva alasāḥ mandāḥ danujātāḥ dānavāḥ yayā tāṃ tathoktām | rucire aṅgade keyūre yasyāstāṃ śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ sādhu puṣkalāṅgaṃ yathā syāttathā śaraṇaṃ upāyaṃ upāye gṛharakṣitrośśabdaśśaraṇamityayam | vartate sāṃprataṃ caiṣa upāyārthaikavācakaḥ || ityahirbudhnyasaṃhitokteḥ | āśraye bhagavaccaraṇāravindaśaraṇavaraṇapuruṣakāratvena prapanno'smītyarthaḥ | pakṣe sādhuśriyamityetatsamastaṃ gadāviśeṣaṇam | sādhvī śrīryasyāstāṃ rucirāmiti vyastaṃ padam | ramaṇīyāṃ gadāṃ kaumodakīṃ, asmin pakṣe ‘vā padāntasya' ityanusvārasya vaikalpikaḥ parasavarṇaḥ | śaraṇaṃ śraye iti || yathā vā sannandakamasitojjvalamojaśśśrīmattsarūpadheyāṅgam | dhyāyāmo balidaityadhvaṃsanadakṣiṇamahāśayākalitam || 822 || atra bhagavannandakayoḥ prakṛtayośśleṣaḥ | bhagavatpakṣe sannandakaṃ asitojjvalaṃ ojaḥ śrīmat sarūpadheyāṅgaṃ iti pañcapadāni | śrīmat lakṣmīnityayogavat | rūpameva rūpadheyaṃ ‘bhāgarūpanāmabhyo dheyaḥ' iti svārthiko dheyapratyayaḥ | tena saha vartata iti sarūpadheyaṃ divyarūpamityarthaḥ | tādṛśaṃ aṅgaṃ vigrahaḥ yasya tattathoktam | baleḥ tannāmnaḥ daityasya dhvaṃsane aindrapadādbhraṃśane dakṣiṇā dakṣā ‘dakṣiṇastu paracchandānuvartini | dakṣe'pasavye sarale' ityabhidhānacintāmaṇiḥ | mahatī āśā tṛṣṇā tayā kalitam | asitaṃ ca tat ujjvalaṃ ca asitojjvalam | satāṃ nandakaṃ sannandakaṃ ānandadamityarthaḥ | ojaḥ idaṃ viśeṣyaṃ ‘taṃ devā jyotiṣāṃ jyotiḥ' iti śrutaṃ paraṃ brahmetyarthaḥ | dhyāyāma iti | nandakapakṣe tu sannandakaṃ asitojjvalaṃ ojaśśrīmat tsarūpadheyāṅgaṃ iti padacatuṣṭayam | ojasaḥ śrīḥ saṃpat asyāstītyojaśśrīmat | tsarau muṣṭau upadheyaṃ nidheyaṃ aṅgaṃ yasya taṃ tathoktam | prāthamikapakṣe śrīmattsaru ityatra takārasya ‘anaci ca' iti dvitvam | ‘tsaruḥ khaṅgādimuṣṭau syāt' ityamaraḥ | khaḍgasya tsarvādhārakatvāttathoktiḥ | balināṃ daityānāṃ dhvaṃsanaḥ dhvaṃsakaḥ bhagavān tasya dakṣiṇaḥ vāmetaraḥ yo mahān śayaḥ pāṇiḥ tena ākalitaṃ daityādidakṣiṇapāṇiparigṛhītamityarthaḥ || aserbhāvaḥ asitā tayā ujjvalam | saṃścāsau nandakaśca sannandakaḥ taṃ, idaṃ viśeṣyam | nandakākhyaṃ khaḍgaṃ dhyāyāma iti || yathā vā samupanateṣu pravaṇaṃ vidhūnitajyānighṛṣṭaparakoṭi | vastu mahāśārṅgaṃ ciramastu mama śreyase kimapi || atra śārṅgiśārṅgayoḥ prakṛtayoreva śleṣaḥ | tathāhi samupanateṣu śaraṇāgateṣu pravaṇaṃ adhīnamiti yāvat | vidhūnitā nirastā jyāniḥ glāniḥ yena tat iti vyastaṃ padam | praśamitanikhilalokamlānītyarthaḥ | ghṛṣṭāḥ piṣṭāḥ pareṣāṃ arīṇāṃ koṭayo yena tat dhvaṃsitānantavipakṣamityarthaḥ | mahat śārṅgaṃ yasya tat iti bhagavatpakṣe | śārṅgapakṣe tu samupanatāḥ saṃhitāḥ iṣavaḥ sāyakāḥ yasmiṃstat | tatra hetuḥ pravaṇamiti | namramityarthaḥ | tatrāpi hetumāha vidhūniteti | vidhūnitā kammitā yā jyā maurvī tayā nighṛṣṭhā ghaṭiteti yāvat | parā tadāśrayakoṭyapekṣayā anyā koṭiḥ agraṃ yasya tat | mahacca tat śārṅgaṃ ca | kimapi vastu bhagavadrūpaṃ taccāparūpaṃ ca vastu ciraṃ mama śreyase astu | iyaṃ 'prathimahitam' ityādipañcaślokī mamaiva śliṣṭapañcāyudhīyastutau nibaddhā || yathā vā adhirūḍhasuguṇakoṭikṣiptamahāpattribhuvanavikhyātam | acyutaśubhakaradhāmapreṅkhacchārṅgaṃ mahāmaho jayatāt || 824 || atrāpi śārṅgiśārṅagayoreva prakṛtayośśleṣaḥ | tathāhi adhikaṃ rūḍhāḥ prādurbhūtāḥ prakāśamānā ityarthaḥ | suguṇānāṃ kalyāṇaguṇānāṃ koṭayo yasya tattathoktam | pakṣe adhirūḍhaḥ ārūḍhaḥ suguṇaḥ śobhanā maurvī yasyāṃ sā tathoktā koṭiḥ aṭaniḥ yasya taditi bahuvrīhigarbhabahuvrīhiḥ| adhijyāṭanītyarthaḥ | kṣiptāḥ nirastāḥ mahatyaḥ āpadaḥ jagadvipadaḥ yena tat kṣiptamahāpat | tribhuvane vikhyātam | pakṣe kṣiptāḥ preritāḥ mahāntaḥ patriṇo bāṇāḥ yena tat kṣiptamahāpattri | bhuvaneṣu vikhyātam | acyutaṃ śubhakaraṃ ca dhāma tejaḥ prabhāvo vā yasya tattathoktam | preṅkhat proccalat śārṅgaṃ yasya tattathoktam | mahāmahaḥ divyaṃ tejaḥ ‘atha yadataḥ paro divo jyotiḥ' | iti śrutaṃ paraṃ brahma | idaṃ viśeṣyam | pakṣe acyutasya bhagavataḥ śubhaḥ kalyāṇaḥ yaḥ karaḥ hastaḥ sa eva dhāma sthānaṃ tasmin preṅkhat mahat maho yasya tattathoktaṃ śārṅgaṃ, idaṃ kartṛ, jayatāt || yathāvā sa jayatu sarasijanayanassanātanīṃ gāṃ surāriṇā'pahṛtām | uddhartumāvirāsīnmahāvarāhastvarānvito yaḥ prāk || 825 || atra stavyatvena prastutayormahāvarāhaśrīhayagrīvayoḥ śleṣaḥ | tathāhi surāriṇā hiraṇyākṣeṇa | pakṣe madhunāmnā kaiṭabhādvitīyena daityena apahṛtāṃ sanātanīṃ gāṃ bhuvaṃ śrutirūpāṃ vācaṃ ca | uddhartuṃ yaḥ prāk tvarānvitaḥ sasaṃbhramaḥ mahāvarāhassan | pakṣe mahāvarāhaḥ tu arānvita iti chedaḥ | tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe | uddhartumityatrānvetavyaḥ| uddhartumevetyarthaḥ | arānvitaḥ rephānanvitaḥ mahāvarāhaḥ mahāvāhaḥ hayagrīvassannityarthaḥ | mahāvarāhaśabde repharūpavyañjanamātrotsāraṇe avaśiṣṭasya ākārasya vakārottarākārasya ca savarṇadīrghe mahāvāha iti niṣpatteriti bhāvaḥ | āvirāsīt | saḥ sarasijanayanaḥ jayatu | sarasijanayana ityanena 'mahāvarāhasphuṭapadmalocanaḥ' ityetatpratyabhijñāpyate || yathāvā varamanaghataramadhīśaḥ purādade hanta yassadāmo darataḥ | hṛdayedvitīyavarṇo guhāśayo vasatu me sa mucukundo'yam || 826 || atra prastutayormucukundamukundayośśleṣaḥ | saḥ māndhātṛtanayatayā saināpatyena devaparitrātṛtayā ca prathitaḥ yaḥ adhīśaḥ adhirājaḥ sārvabhaumā mucukunda ityarthaḥ | purā kālayavanavidrāvaṇāvasare | dāmodarataḥ ādyāditvātpañcamyāstasiḥ | bhagavataḥ śrīkṛṣṇāt anaghataraṃ varaṃ ādade svīkṛtavān | guhāśayaḥ girigahvaraśāyī dvitīyo varṇo yasya saḥ dvitīyavarṇaḥ kṣatravarṇajanmā so'yaṃ mucukundaḥ | pakṣe sadāmodarata iti samastaṃ padaṃ prathamaikavacanāntam | satāṃ āmode praharṣaṇe rataḥ āsaktaḥ yaḥ bhagavān | purā adhīśaḥ | adhīṭśabdo'yaṃ ṣaṣṭhyekavacanāntaḥ | adhirājasya tasyaiva mucukundasyetyarthaḥ | saṃbandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī | anaghataraṃ varaṃ dade iti chedaḥ | dattavān | guhāśayaḥ sakalacetanahṛdayaguhāniviṣṭaḥ ‘guhāhitaṃ gahvareṣṭhaṃ' ityādiśruteḥ | advitīyavarṇa iti chedaḥ | so'yaṃ advitīyavarṇaḥ dvitīyavarṇaradditaḥ mucukundaḥ mukunda ityarthaḥ | śabdārthayostādātmyāt | me mama hṛdaye vasatu dhyānapathādhvanīno bhavatvityarthaḥ | mucukundasyāprakṛtatvābhisandhau tvidaṃ prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣasyodāharaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatītyanusandheyam || yathāvā prāgbhavapāvakaviddhaṃ jahato brahmāṇamapyabhadramamī | govinda nandanandanajayantyupāttavratāḥ priyatamāste || 827 || atrāmbarīṣādivadbhagavadekaniṣṭhānāṃ śrījayantīvratānuṣṭhātṝṇāṃ ca prastutānāmeva śleṣaḥ| tathāhi he nandanaṃdana! govinda! idaṃ vakṣyamāṇārthopaskārāya | bhavapāvakena saṃsārānalena viddhaṃ bādhitaṃ ata eva abhadraṃ amaṅgalaṃ brahyāṇaṃ caturmukhamapi prāk purastāt jahataḥ dhyānānupakārakatvāttyajantaḥ | caturmukhasyaivādau tyāge tato'pyavaradaivatatyāgaḥ kiṃpurnyāyasiddhaḥ | yadvā prākchabdo bhavaśabdaviśeṣaṇatayā samastaḥ | prāgbhavaḥ anādisaṃsāraḥ pāvaka iva tena viddhaṃ, anyattulyam | atra ābrahmastambaparyantā jagadantarvyavasthitāḥ | prāṇinaḥ karmajanitasaṃsāravaśavartinaḥ || avidyāntargatāssarve te hi saṃsāragocarāḥ | yatastato na te dhyāne dhyānināmupakārakāḥ || iti, ‘āviriñcādamaṅgalam' ityādipramāṇāni cānusaṃhitāni | amī upāttavratāḥ upāttaṃ brataṃ sa tvaṃ prahara vā mā vā mayi vajraṃ purandara | nāhamutsṛjya govindamanyamārādhayāmi bhoḥ || ityādikamambarīṣoktaprakārakaṃ brataṃ yaiste ‘niyamo bratamastrī taccopavāsādipuṇyakam' ityamaraḥ | udāhṛtapramāṇābhisaṃdhinaiva mūle govindeti saṃbodhanam | idameva pītāmbarasāgarāmbarādivadviśeṣyam | sūtritaṃ hi vāmanena 'viśeṣaṇaprayogo viśeṣyapratipattau' iti | te tava priyatamāssanto jayanti | priyatamā ityanena 'yamevaiṣa vṛṇute' iti śrutyuktaparamātmavaraṇīyatāhotūktiḥ 'priyatama eva hi varaṇīyo bhavati yasyāyaṃ niratiśayīprayassa evāsya priyatamo bhavati' iti hi laghusiddhānte prakṛtaśrutibhāṣyam | anyatra brahmāṇaṃ rohiṇīnakṣatraṃ ‘rohiṇīnakṣatraṃ prajāpatirdevatā' iti rohiṇyāḥ prajāpatidevatākatvaśravaṇāt, 'vidhātā rohiṇīśvaraḥ' iti smaraṇācca | abhadramapi bhadrā saptamī ‘nandā bhadrā jayā riktā pūrṇā syustithayaḥ kramāt' iti pratipadādīnāṃ pañcapañcānāṃ tithīnāṃ krameṇa saṃjñāvidhānāt | avidyamānā bhadrā yasya taṃ saptamyaviddhamapītyarthaḥ | idamaparityāgakāraṇam | prāgbhavapāvakaviddhaṃ prāgbhavena pūrvasthitena pāvakena kṛttikā nakṣatreṇa ‘kṛttikānakṣatramagnirdevatā' iti tasyāgnidevatākatvaśravaṇāt | ‘āgneyī kṛttikā proktā' ityukteśca | viddhaṃ vedhaṃ prāpitaṃ, idamagrāhyatāhetuḥ| jahataḥ tyajantaḥ | jayantī dvividhā proktā śuddhā viddheti saṃjñitā | śuddhā tu dvividhā proktā viddhā caiva caturvidhā || tasmātsarvaprayatnena saptamīṃ kṛttikāmapi | kalāmātrāmapi tyaktvā parato vratamācaret || ityādivacanaiḥ saptamyā aṣṭamīrohiṇyoḥ kṛttikāyā aṣṭamīrohiṇyoścetyevaṃrūpacaturvidhavedhasya tyajyatāyā ākareṣu nirṇītatvāt | amī jayantyupāttavratā iti samastaṃ padam | jayantyām śrāvaṇasya tu māsasya kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ narādhipa | rohiṇī yadi labhyeta sā jayantīti kīrtitā || prājāpatyaṃ muhūrtārdhaṃ navamyāṃ yadi vā na vā | mṛgeṇa kevalenāpi sā jayantīti kīrtitā || ityādyuktalakṣaṇāyāṃ tithau upāttaṃ gṛhītaṃ vrataṃ upavāsādiniyamo yaiste tathoktāḥ janāḥ ta priyatamāḥ upapāditacaturvidhavedhabidhurajayantīvratavidhātārastavātivelapriyā bhavantītyarthaḥ | atra śuddhāṣṭamīṃ vinā vā'pi śuddhamṛkṣamathāpi vā | mṛgeṇa ca navamyāṃ vā daśamyāṃ vā'pi vaiṣṇavaḥ || pūrve tu saptamīyuktā tvapare kṛttikā yutā | dinadvayaṃ parityajya tadanye vāsare caret || ityādivacanasahasramanusandheyam | evaṃ kevalaprakṛtānekaviṣayaḥ śleṣa udāhṛtaḥ || aprakṛtānekaviṣayo yathā sumahābilavilasattamaviśadaguṇā santatottamasphuraṇā | tārāvalī vṛṣācaladhaureyanakhālikṛtatiraskaraṇā || 828 || sumahāḥ śobhanadīptiḥ bileṣu randhreṣu vilasattamaḥ viśadaḥ svacchaḥ guṇaḥ tantuḥ yasyāssā | anyatra suṣṭhu mahābile vyomni "meghadvāraṃ mahābilam' ityamaraśeṣaḥ | vilasattamaḥ atimātraṃ prakāśamānaḥ viśadaguṇaḥ dhāvalyaṃ yasyāssā tathoktā | satataṃ uttamaṃ sphuraṇaṃ cākacakyaṃ yasyāssā tathoktā | itaratra utkṛṣṭaṃ tamasi sphuraṇaṃ prakāśo yasyāssā | tamassphuraṇetyatra tamaśśabdavisargasya ‘kharpare śari vā visargalopaḥ' iti lope pakṣadvaye'pi varṇānupūrvyāssāmyaṃ veditavyam | tārāvalī muktāhāraḥ nakṣatrapaṅktiśca | tārovānarabhinmuktāviśuddhau śuddhamauktike | nānakṣatre'kṣimadhye ca na nārūpye napuṃsakam || ityuubhayatrāpi medinī | anyatsugamam | atra bhagavannakhāvalyā upamānatvenāprakṛtayormuktāhāratārakāvalyośśleṣaḥ || yathā vā diviyuktasthitimujjvalavigrahadhāmnaiva mudiramuccāpam | vyajayata yaḥ kila sa pumānvijayāya mamāstu bhujagirinetā || 829 || divi vyomni yuktasthitiṃ yuktā varṣakaraṇakajagadānandanānurūpā sthitiḥ avasthānaṃ yasya tam | tatra hetumāha ucceti | uccāḥ nirbharāḥ āpaḥ yasya tam | ‘ṛkpūrap' ityādinā samāsānto'pratyayaḥ | prāvṛṣeṇyamiti bhāvaḥ | mudiraṃ jīmūtaṃ ‘ghanajīmūtamudirajalamugdhūmayonayaḥ' ityamaraḥ | ujjvalasya vigrahasya divyavapuṣaḥ dhāmnaiva tejasaiva yaḥ vyajayata | pakṣe uccāpaṃ uddhṛtadhanvānam | diviyuktasthitiṃ dinā divarṇena viyuktā vighaṭitā sthitiḥ yasya taṃ mudiraṃ muramityarthaḥ | mudiraśabde divarṇalope mura iti niṣpatteḥ | śabdārthayostādātmyamiha śaraṇam | vigrahadhāmnā samaraprabhāveṇa vyajayata tiraskurute sma | ihāprakṛtayormudiramurayoḥ śleṣaḥ || yathāvā tvadavekṣaṇatomartyaḥ prasādhitasvasthirassudhānyādaḥ | akhilāmba dānavārātyākhyāto vindate budheḍyatvam || 830 || he akhilāmba! martyaḥ mānavaḥ | amartya iti ca chedaḥ | deva ityarthaḥ | tvadavekṣaṇataḥ tvatkaṭākṣāt prasādhitasvasthiraḥ prasādhite prakarṣeṇa vaśīkṛte svaṃ dhanaṃ sthirā bhūśca yena sa tathoktaḥ | amartyapakṣe prasādhitasvaḥ prasādhitaṃ alaṃkṛtaṃ svaḥ svargo yena sa tathoktaḥ| rephāntāvyayottarapado bahuvrīhiḥ | sthiraḥ cirakālāvasthāyī | śobhanāni ca tāni dhānyani ca sudhānyāni tānyattīti sudhānyādaḥ sumṛṣṭavrīhitaṇḍulādyannabhojīti yāvat | anyatra sudhā amṛtaṃ nyādaḥ āhāraḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ ‘nau ṇa ca' ityādernipūrvakāt ṇapratyayaḥ | ‘jemanaṃ lepa āhāro nighaso nyāda ityapi' ityamaraḥ | dānavārā dānodakena atyākhyātaḥ atiśayena samantātprathitaḥ ata eva budheḍyatvaṃ vindate | mahodārasārvabhaumatayā vidvadabhinandanīyatāṃ labhata iti bhāvaḥ | itaratra dānavārātiḥ vṛtramukhadaityadhvaṃsīti ākhyātaḥ prasiddhyā, ādyāditvāttṛtīyāyāstasiḥ | ākhyāta iti prathamāntaṃ vā padam | budhaiḥ devaiḥ īḍyatvaṃ vindate devādhirājatvaṃ bhajata ityarthaḥ | atra jagajjananīkaṭākṣitayormartyāmartyayoraprakṛtayośśleṣaḥ || yathāvā kalito bhagavan bhavatā mitrāṇāmadhibhuvāñchito vibhavaḥ | dānānvitā viracitā vadānyatā'pi ca pṛdākuśikharimaṇe || 831 || he bhagavan! bhavatā adhibhu bhuvi vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ | mitrāṇāṃ suhṛdāṃ vāñchitaḥ kāṅkṣitaḥ vibhavaḥ kalitaḥ kṛtaḥ | dānena vitaraṇena anvitā vadānyatā valguvacanatā'pi ca ‘vadānyo valguvāgapi' ityamaraḥ | viracitā ‘datvā ca madhuraṃ vadet' iti hi dharmavidaḥ | suhṛdastvayā vibhavavantastadanuguṇadānapriyavacanāśca kṛtā iti nirgalito'rthaḥ | pakṣe amitrāṇāmiti chedaḥ | vairiṇāṃ adhibhuvāṃ prabhūṇāṃ ‘adhibhūrnāyako netā' ityamaraḥ | vibhavaḥ kalitaḥ yuddhena, ādyāditvāttasiḥ | ‘saṃprahārābhisaṃpātakalisaṃsphoṭasaṃyugāḥ' iti yuddhaparyāyeṣvamaraḥ | chitaḥ chinnaḥ chāyate smeticchitaḥ 'cho chedane' iti daivādikāddhātoḥ karmaṇi ktaḥ 'śāccho'nyatarasyām' iti vaikalpikamitvam | ‘kṛttaṃ dātaṃ ditaṃ chitaṃ vṛkṇam' ityamaraḥ | apica dānānvitā dā iti varṇena nānvitā ayuktā virahitetyarthaḥ | naśabdena samāsaḥ | vadānyatā vanyatetyarthaḥ | viracitā | vairiṇo na kevalamapacitavibhavā eva kṛtāḥ, kiṃtu vanyavṛttayo'pītyabhiprāyaḥ | atra bhagavadīyayormitrāmitrayoraprastutayośśleṣaḥ | dvayorapi prastutatvābhisandhau prakṛtānekaviṣayaśleṣasyaivodāharaṇaṃ bhavet | evaṃ pūrvodāharaṇe'pi draṣṭavyam | prastutāprastutayoryathā yo vahati mañjulakṣmācchāyāmasitāṃ ghṛṇipratītātmā | vṛṣabhāgaṃ tuṅgamayannayaṃ hariḥ prathayate śriyaṃ hṛdyām || 832 || atra bhagavaccandramasoḥ prastutāprastutayoḥ śleṣaḥ | tathāhi mañjṛ manoharaṃ lakṣma śrīvatsacihnaṃ asādhāraṇaṃ śaṅkhacakrādicihnaṃ vā yasya sa tathoktaḥ | anena paratvaṃ sūcitam | tamasaḥ paramo dhātā śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ | śrīvatsavakṣā nityaśrīrajayyaśśāśvato dhruvaḥ || ityādyṛkteḥ | asitāṃ śyāmalāṃ chāyāṃ kāntiṃ vahati | ayaṃ hariḥ bhagavan ghṛṇipratītātmā ghṛṇā asyāstīti ghṛṇī dayāvān | vrīhyāditvānmatvarthīya iniḥ | ‘jugupsākaruṇe ghṛṇe' ityamaraḥ | ghaṇīti pratītātmā prakhyātasvabhāvaḥ | ‘ghṛṇī satyaparākramaḥ' ityādyṛkteḥ | ghṛṇiṣu pratītātmeti vā paramakāruṇika ityarthaḥ | ghṛṇīti viśvāsaviṣayasvabhāva iti vā | pratipūrvakasya iṇo viśvāsārthakatvāt | ghṛṇī cāsau pratītātmā cati viśeṣaṇobhayapadakarmadhārayo vā | asmin pakṣe pratīto hṛṣṭa ityarthaḥ | ‘khyāte hṛṣṭe pratītaḥ' ityamaraḥ | mahādayālutayā līlāvibhūtisthānujjīvayituṃ prahṛṣṭamanā iti bhāvaḥ | anena saulabhyahetubhūtakṛpāśālitoktiḥ | ata eva tuṅgaṃ vṛṣabhāgaṃ vṛṣabhādriṃ ayan prāpnuvan anena saulabhyoktiḥ | śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ hṛdyāṃ vakṣassthāṃ prathayate svasya śrīnivāsatvaṃ pradarśayatīti bhāvaḥ | anena saulabhye'pi paratvāprahāṇaṃ darśitam | pakṣe ghṛṇibhiḥ kiraṇaiḥ pratītātmā prakhyātasvarūpaḥ yaḥ asitāṃ nīlāṃ mañjulakṣmācchāyāṃ kṣmāyāḥ bhūmeḥ chāyā mañjulā ca sā kṣmācchāyā ca tāṃ, śaśaśabdābhilapanīyaṃ bhūpratibimbamityarthaḥ | vahati ‘lokacchāyāmayaṃ lakṣma tavāṅge śaśasannibham' iti harivaṃśokteḥ ‘tavāṅke' ityapi pāṭhaḥ | ‘bhūcchāyamaicchanpare' ityarvācīnokteśca | ‘chāyā sūryapriyā kāntiḥ pratibimbamanātapaḥ' ityamaraḥ | ayaṃ hariḥ candramāḥ 'hariryamārkāśvāgnīnduviṣṇvindrāṃśuśukeṣu nā' iti ratnamālā | tuṅgaṃ uccaṃ vṛṣabhāgaṃ vṛṣasya vṛṣabharāśeḥ bhāgaṃ tṛtīyāṃśamiti yāvat | tasyaiva tatparamoccasthānatvāt | yathocyate varāhamihirācāryeṇa ajavṛṣabhamṛgāṅganākulīrā jhaṣavaṇijau ca divākarādituṅgāḥ | daśaśikhimanuyuktithīndriyāṃśaistrinavakaviṃśatibhiśca te'stanīcāḥ || iti | ayan san hṛdyāṃ hṛdayapriyāṃ śriyaṃ dīptiṃ prathayate dīpto bhavatītyarthaḥ | yadvā svalagnajanmanāṃ śubhasaṃpadaṃ vitanotītyarthaḥ | ‘svocce pradīptaḥ' iti, ‘dīptiḥ pūrṇaṃ vidhatte śubham' iti ca mādhavīyokteḥ || yathāvā gauravitāsaśrīranavarataṃ hṛdyāhitā suhṛllekhā | yena sa vṛṣācalāhitadhāmā devādhināyako jayati || atra prakṛtāprakṛtayorbhagavanmaghavatośśleṣaḥ | tathāhi yena bhagavatā hṛdayaṃ likhatīti hṛllekhā śobhanā hṛllekhā suhṛllekhā atimātrahṛdayaṃgametyarthaḥ | ‘hṛdayasya hṛlekha' ityādinā hṛdayaśabdasya hṛdādeśaḥ | ‘hṛdayagrāhi hṛdyaṃ ca hṛllekhaṃ hṛdayapriyam' iti ratnakośaḥ | ata eva anavarataṃ hṛdi vakṣasi āhitā nihitā ata eva gauravitā sajātagauravā | tārakādiṣu gauravaśabdasya pāṭhāt ‘tada,sya saṃjātam' ityarthe itac | yadvā gauravavatī kṛtā, gauravitāṇyantādgauravavacchabdāt niṣṭhāyāṃ ṇāviṣṭhavadbhāvena ‘vinmatoḥ' iti matupo luk | ata eva āsa didīpe | ‘asa dīptau' iti dhātorliṭprathamaikavacanam | pakṣe gauḥ avitā saśrīḥ iti chedaḥ | yena maghavatā saśrīḥ salakṣmīkā hṛdyā hṛdayapriyā hitā pathyā ‘hitaṃ pathye gate dhṛte' iti medinī | suhṛdo lekhāḥ devāḥ yasyāṃ sā ‘lekhā aditinandanāḥ' ityamaraḥ | gauḥ dyauḥ svarga ityarthaḥ | gaussvarge ca balīvarde' iti medinī | anavarataṃ avitā rakṣitā | vṛṣādrau ahitaṃ nyastaṃ dhāma sthānaṃ divyamaṅgalavigraho vā yasya saḥ ‘gṛhadehatviṭprabhāvā dhāmāni' ityamaraḥ | saḥ devādhināyakaḥ bhagavān | pakṣe saḥ vṛṣā acalāhitadhāmeti chedaḥ | acalānāṃ śailānāṃ ahitaṃ dhāma tejaḥ prabhāvo vā yasya saḥ gotrabhidityarthaḥ | devānāṃ adhināyakaḥ saḥ vṛṣā maghavā jayatīti || yathāvā kṛṣṇaghanābhivitīrṇasvātyamalarasaikasamadhigatasattāḥ | muktākhyāssanmaṇayo vilasacchuktyāgatādṛgānandāḥ || 834 || atra prakṛtānāṃ brahmavidāmaprakṛtānāṃ muktāphalānāṃ ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi kṛṣṇena bhagavatā ghanaṃ sāndraṃ yathā syāttathā abhivitīrṇaḥ pradattaḥ svasmin svaviṣaye yaḥ atyamalaḥ vijātīyarasāsaṃvalitatayā svacchaḥ rasaḥ anurāgaḥ snehāparaparyāyaḥ tatpūrvakānudhyānaṃ bhaktiriti yāvat ‘snehapūrvamanudhyānaṃ bhaktirityabhidhīyate' iti hyucyate | tenaiva samadhigatā samyakprāptā sattā svarūpadhāraṇaṃ yeṣāṃ te rasaikasamādhagatasattāḥ 'dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te' ityuktaprakriyayā bhagavaddattenoktavidhānudhyānenaiva svadehadhāraṇādikaṃ kurvanta iti bhāvaḥ | sanmaṇayaḥ brahmavidagresarāḥ muktāḥ prakṛtibandhaviyuktāḥ ityākhyā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāssantaḥ vilasan śucaḥ śokasya tyāgo yeṣāṃ te vilasacchuktyāgāḥ ‘apahatapāpmā' iti prajāpativākye ‘viśokaḥ' iti śravaṇāt | tādṛk 'yato vāco nivartante | aprāpya manasā saha' iti vāṅmanasāparicchedyatayā śrutaḥ ānando yeṣāṃ te tādṛgānandāḥ vilasacchuktyāgāśca te tādṛgānandāśceti viśeṣaṇobhayapadakarmadhārayaḥ | śokopalakṣitaheyaguṇadavīyāṃsaḥ paripūrṇabrahmānubhavānandaṃ vindanta ityarthaḥ || anyatra kṛṣṇaghanena nīlāmbudena abhivitīrṇaḥ yaḥ svātyamalarasaḥ svātīravisaṃcārakālikanirmalasalilabinduḥ nadyāṃ tatra svātige'rke śuktisthā vṛṣṭibindavaḥ | ṣaḍbhirmāsairghanībhūtā jāyante śuddhamauktikāḥ || ityukteḥ | tenaiva samadhigatā sattā svarūpasthitiḥ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | ata eva muktākhyāḥ muktābhidhānāḥ sanmaṇayaḥ praśastaratnāni | vilasantī yā śuktiḥ muktāsphoṭaḥ tasyāḥ āgatāḥ tato jātā ityarthaḥ | dṛgānandāḥ dṛśāṃ īkṣitṛjanalocanānāṃ ānandāḥ harṣahetavo bhavantīti || yathāvā mukhyavibhusahajasaṅgāvudagrabhūmāśritau ca sumahāntau | hanta vihaṅgabhujaṅgau na kvāpyarthe virodhamupayātau || 835 || atra garutmadanantayoḥ prastutayoḥ vihaṅgabhujaṅgaśabdayoraprastutayośca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi sumahāntau vihaṅgabhujaṅgau garuḍānantāvityarthaḥ | mukhyavibhusahajasaṅgau mukhye na tu rājādivadgauṇe vibhau svāmini śrīnivāse sahajaḥ svābhāvikaḥ saṅgaḥ śeṣaśeṣibhāvarūpassaṃbandhaḥ yayostau tathoktau | ata eva udagreṇa ucchritena bhūmnā mahimnā āśritau ca | yadvā udagrā śreyasī bhūḥ bhūdevī yasyāssā tathoktā yā mā śrīḥ tāṃ śritau 'dvitīyā śrita' ityādinā samāsaḥ ‘viṣṇupatnīṃ mahīm' ityādiśrutau 'lakṣmīpriyasakhīm' iti bhūdevyā lakṣmīpriyasakhītvokteriha tadvaiśiṣṭyamabhihitaṃ śriyaḥ | yadvā udagre bhūśca mā cetyete bhagavaddivyamahiṣyau śritāvityarthaḥ | na kevalametau bhagavataśśeṣabhūtāveva apitu tatprasādanatatparayostaddivyamahiṣyorapīti bhāvaḥ | kvāpyarthe kaiṃkaryādirūpe kasmiṃścidapi prayojane virodhaṃ nopayātau | kasyacit bhagavannityecchāvyavasthiteṣu tattatkaiṃkaryādiṣvanyasyānuṣṭhānābhisandheranudayāt nityanirdoṣabhagavadāśrayaṇaprabhāvācceti bhāvaḥ || pakṣe mukhyau yathāsaṃkhyaṃ ādyau viśca bhuśca vibhū ityākārakau varṇau yayostau mukhyavibhū haśca jaśca hajau varṇau tābhyāṃ saha vartete iti sahajau ca ‘vopasarjanasya' iti sahaśabdasya sabhāvaḥ | ṅgena ṅakāragakārasaṃyogena saha vartete iti saṅgau ca | eteṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ viśeṣaṇānāṃ rkamadhārayaḥ | mukhyavibhusahajasaṅgau | udagrabhūmāśritau ut utkṛṣṭaṃ yathā syāttathā agre bhavatītyagrabhūḥ avasāne vidyamānaḥ yaḥ maḥ makāraḥ tenāśritau | yadvā agrādudgatā udagrā bhūḥ paryavasānamityarthaḥ | tasyāṃ māśritau makārāśritāvityarthaḥ | īdṛśau vihaṅgabhujaṅgau vihaṅgabhujaṅgaśabdau kvāpi kvacidapi loke vede veti bhāvaḥ| arthe abhidheye virodhaṃ anyārthatvaṃ nopayātau vihaṅgabhujaṅgaśabdābhyāṃ yāvānartho'bhidhīyate vihaṅgamabhujaṅgamaśabdābhyāāmapi tāvata evārthasyābhidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | asminpakṣe sumahāntāvityasya sumahāśabdānte vidyamānāvityartho'pyupaskāryaḥ | sumahāvihaṅgaḥ sumahābhujaṅgaḥ iti śabdāvityartho niṣpadyate | vihāyasi gacchatīti vigrahe ‘gamessupi vācyaḥ' iti khaci ‘vihāyaso viha iti vācyam' iti vihādeśe ‘khacca ḍidvā vācyaḥ' iti khaco vaikalpike ḍittve ḍittvasāmarthyāṭṭilope ‘arurdviṣat' iti mumāgame vihaṅgaḥ vihaṅgamaḥ iti rūpadvayamabhinnārthakam | evaṃ bhujairgacchatīti vigrahe gameḥ khaco vaikalpike ḍittve ṭilope mumāgame ca bhujaṅgaḥ bhujaṅgama iti rūpadvayaṃ ca || yathāvā sāmānādhikaraṇyāduttarapadatāṃ gatena nanu viṣṇo | mahatastvayā samāse satyākāre'stameti tāntatvam || 836 || atra mahanīyasya brahmavido mahacchabdasvarūpasya ca prakṛtāprakṛtayoḥ śleṣaḥ | tathāhi nanu viṣṇo! uttaraṃ sarvottamaṃ padaṃ 'tadviṣṇoḥ' iti śrutaṃ sthānaṃ yasya sa uttarapadaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ tattā tāṃ gatena paramapade nivasatetyarthaḥ | tvayā sāmānādhikaraṇyāt ekādhikaraṇakatvāt, lyablope karmaṇi pañcamī | ekādhikaraṇyaṃ prāpyetyarthaḥ | samāse samyagavasthāne sati saṃpūrvakādāserghañ | mahataḥ mahanīyasya kasyacidbrahmavidaḥ satyākāre satyaḥ anāropitaḥ svābhāvika ityarthaḥ | sa cāsāvākāraḥ apahatapāpmatvādirūpaḥ tasmin sati prādurbhavatīti yāvat | tāntatvaṃ aśanāyāpipāsādiglāniḥ astaṃ adarśanaṃ eti prāpnoti | tadatītatvaśravaṇāttasya | tvadanugraheṇa parame vyomni tvayā saha vasataḥ prādurbhūtaguṇāṣṭakasya cetanasyāśanāyādiglānirna kadā'pyunmiṣediti bhāvaḥ | anyatra he viṣṇo! iti viṣṇuśabdasyaiva saṃbodhanam | sāmānādhikaraṇyāt pravṛttinimittabhedenaikārthavṛttitvarūpāt | yadāhuḥ bhinnapravṛttinimittānāṃ śabdānāmekasminnarthe vṛttissāmānādhikaraṇyam' iti | uttarapadatāṃ samāsacaramāvayavatāṃ samānādhikaraṇottarapadatāmityarthaḥ | gatena prāptena tvayā viṣṇuśabdena samāse sati mahataḥ mahacchabdasya alo'ntyaparibhāṣayā antyasya takārasyetyarthaḥ | ākāre ātve sati bhavati satītyarthaḥ | satyākāre ityatra sati ākāre iti chedaḥ | tāntatvaṃ takārāntatvaṃ astameti na dṛśyate | ākārādeśenāpahṛtatvāt mahāviṣṇurityeva niṣpadyate rūpaṃ na tu mahadviṣṇuriti bhāvaḥ | atra ‘ānmahatassamānādhikaraṇa' iti sūtrārtho'nusandheyaḥ || yathāvā tvāṃ viditavān sadāsaṃbuddhau viṣṇo maharṣivihitaguṇam | tvayi supratyayalopādvisarjanīyo hi bhavati dūresaḥ || 837 || atra bhagavato viṣṇoḥ viṣṇuśabdasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi he viṣṇo! mahāṃścāsau ṛṣirvedaḥ parāśarādirmuniśca 'ṛṣirvede vasiṣṭhādau dīdhitau ca pumānayam' iti medinī | tena vihitāḥ anuśiṣṭāḥ guṇāḥ sarvakāraṇatvasarvajñatvasarvottamatvādayo yasya taṃ tathoktam| "sa kāraṇaṃ karaṇādhipādhipaḥ | yassarvajñassarvavit | viṣṇuḥ paramaḥ, viṣṇossakāśādudbhūtaṃ jagattatraiva ca sthitam | tejobalaiśvaryamahāvabodhasuvīryaśaktyādiguṇaikarāśiḥ | paraḥ parāṇāṃ sakalā na yatra kleśādayassanti parāvareśe || samastakalyāṇaguṇātmako'sau..................... ......||" ityādiśrutismṛtiprakhyāpitakalyāṇaguṇamityarthaḥ | sadā buddhau manasi viditavān jñātavān āsaṃ sadbhāvabhāgabhavam | ‘asti brahmeti cedveda santamenaṃ tato viduḥ' iti śruteḥ | anevaṃbhūtastu asattvāddūratastyājya ityāha tvayīti | dūresa ityatra dūre asa iti chedaḥ | sa na bhavatītyasaḥ atathāvidhaḥ uktavidhaṃ tvāmaviditavānityarthaḥ | ata eva tvayi viṣaye supratyayasya śobhanasya jñānasya mahāviśvāsasya vā lopāt dūre visarjanīyaḥ tyājyo bhavati | hīti prasiddhau | īdṛśassatāṃ bahiṣkārya eveti prasiddhameveti bhāvaḥ | anyatra he viṣṇo! viṣṇuśabda! tvāṃ, asminpakṣe sadā saṃbuddhau iti chedaḥ | saṃbuddhau ‘ekavacanaṃ saṃbuddhiḥ' iti saṃketite saṃbodhanaprathamaikavacane parata iti śeṣaḥ | maharṣiṇā pāṇininā vihitaḥ guṇaḥ yasya taṃ 'hrasvasya guṇaḥ' iti sūtreṇa saṃbuddhau parato guṇavidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | sadā viditavān āsam | tvayi viṣṇo ityatreti bhāvaḥ | supratyayasya su ityākārakapratyayasya lopāt 'eṅ hrasvātsambuddheḥ' iti sūtreṇa saṃbuddhihalo lopādityarthaḥ | saḥ suppratyayasakārasya sa iti ṣaṣṭhyekavacanam | visarjanīyaḥ 'sasajuṣoruḥ' iti rutvānantarabhāvī ‘kharavasānayorvisarjanīyaḥ' iti vihito visargaḥ dūre bhavati hi | paramasthāninassakārasyaiva lope kānāma tatsthānikarutvāvalambinī visargakatheti bhāvaḥ || yathāvā iha viṣvagdevo'ñcatiparo'drimagryaṃ śrito mahādeśam | apratyayo'pi dhātustadagaścāyaṃ samantatodṛśyaḥ || 838 || atra śrīnivāsasya prakṛtasya viṣvagdevaśabdayoraprakṛtayośca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi paro devaḥ vāsudevaḥ dhātuḥ brahmaṇaḥ apratyayopi anadhīnopi | pratyayaḥ prathitatveSpi sanādijñānayorapi | ācāre śapathe randhre viśvāsādhīnahetuṣu || iti medinī | brahmaṇā dhyātumaśakyopītyarthaḥ | dhāturapyapratyaya iti vā yojanā | agryaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ adriṃ śeṣācalaṃ tasyaiva prakṛtatvāt 'eṣa śeṣācalo nāma girīṇāmuttamo giriḥ' ityukteśca | mahādeśaṃ pūjyapradeśaṃ śeṣācalaṃ nāma divyadeśamityarthaḥ | śritassan iha asminnadrau viṣvak samantataḥ añcati saṃcarati viharatīti yāvat | tat tasmāt bhagavadviharaṇāddhetoḥ ayaṃ bhagavadvihārasthānabhūtaḥ agaśca girirapi samantataḥ paritaḥ dṛśyaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ, janairiti śeṣaḥ | na kevalaṃ bhagavāneva darśanīyaḥ apitu sarvatopi bhagavatsaṃcaraṇātpāvanatamo'yaṃ girirapi sarvessarvato darśanīya evetyarthaḥ || pakṣe viṣvak viṣvagityākārakaḥ devaḥ deva ityākārakaśca śabdaḥ añcatiḥ añcudhātuḥ paro yasya saḥ añcatiparassan | añcatīti śtipā nirdeśaḥ | agryaṃ agre ṭisthāne bhavaṃ adriṃ adrītyākārakaṃ mahāntaṃ anekāltvādbṛhantaṃ ādeśaṃ śrita prāptaḥ bhavati | nanu añcatiparo viṣvak devaśca yadyadyādeśaṃ prāpnuyāttarhi viṣvagañcanaṃ devāñcanamityatrāpi viṣvagdevayoradryādeśassyādityata āha apratyayopi dhāturiti | asminpakṣe ihetyetadatrānveti | iha añcatipara ityatra vidyamānaḥ dhāturapi añcudhātuśca apratyayaḥ avidyamānaḥ pratyayo yasmādityapratyayaḥ kvibanta ityarthaḥ | kvipassarvasyāpi lopādavidyamānatvam | yadvā avidyamānaḥ pratyayaḥ apratyaya iti tatpuruṣa eva | tasya dhātuviśeṣaṇatvena tadantalābhaḥ avidyamānapratyayāntaḥ kvibanta ityarthaḥ| anyathā viṣvagañcanamityādāvivādryādeśānāpatteriti bhāvaḥ | tat tasmāt viṣvagdevayoṣṭisthāne adryādeśāddhetoḥ samantataḥ samyagante vidyamānaḥ ayaṃ prakṛte viṣvakchabde devaśabde ca sthitaḥ aga ityatra ak aḥ iti chedaḥ | ‘jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' iti kakārasya jaśtvena gakāraḥ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ viṣvakchabdasthaḥ ak ityākārakavarṇasamudāyaḥ aśca devaśabdasthaḥ akāraścetyarthaḥ | adṛśya iti chedaḥ | adyādeśenāpahṛtatvānna dṛśyata ityarthaḥ | atra 'viṣvagdevayośca ṭeradryañcatāvapratyaye' iti sūtrārtha upapāditaprakāreṇānusandheyaśabdavidyāniṣṇātairityalam | yadvā samaṃ tataḥ adṛśya iti tridhā chedaḥ | tataḥ adryādeśādanantaraṃ tat tasmāt adryādeśādeva hetoḥ ayaṃ prakṛtaviṣvagdevaśabdayorvidyamānaḥ ak aśca ukta evārthaḥ| samaṃ tulyaṃ yathā syāttathā adṛśyaḥ | dvayorapyanayośśabdayoṣṭeradryādeśena akaḥ asya cāpahārādadarśanamanayostulyameveti bhāvaḥ | athavā tat uktādeva hetoḥ tataḥ sārvavibhaktikassaptamyāstasiḥ | tayoḥ viṣvagdevaśabdayorityarthaḥ | ayaṃ buddhisthaḥ ak aśca samaṃ tulyaṃ adṛśya iti || yathāvā lakṣmyāssakhyuḥ patyuryuktaṃ prathateghitāguṇābhāvaḥ | idamapi yuktaṃ vidmo yadbhavitāpratyayasya nābhāvaḥ || 839 || atra prastutasya bhagavataḥ aprastutānāṃ lakṣmīsakhipatiśabdānāṃ ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi lakṣmyāḥ sakhyuḥ suhṛdbhūtasya anenānurāgaparipūrṇatā dyotitā | patyuḥ bhartuḥ śrīnivāsasya ayaṃ ca śrīpatitvena nirdeśaḥ anupadavivakṣitāyā ubhayaliṅgatāyāstadekāśrayatvaṃ vyañjayitum | ata eva hi ‘śriyaḥpatirnikhilaheyapratyanīkakalyāṇaikatānaḥ' ityabhāṣi bhagavadbhāṣyakāraiḥ| aghamasyāstītyaghī tasya bhāvaḥ aghitā | sā cāsau guṇaśva āghitāguṇaḥ, tasyābhāvaḥ prathate prasiddhyatīti yuktam | 'sa eṣa sarvebhyaḥ pāpmabhya uditaḥ | eṣa sarvabhūtāntarātmā'pahatapāpmā divyo deva ekā nārāyaṇaḥ' ityādiśravaṇāt | pratyayasya jñānasya upalakṣaṇamidaṃ śaktibalaiśvaryādīnāmapi | na abhāvaḥ iti chedaḥ | abhāvaḥ na bhavitā sattaiva bhaviteti yat, nañdvayena saṃbhāvyabhāvaniṣedho vyāvartitaḥ | idamapi yuktaṃ vidma 'parā'sya śaktirvividhaiva śrūyate svābhāvikī jñānabalakriyā ca' ityādiśruteḥ| jñānopalakṣitakalyāṇayuṇavaidhuryamasya na kadā'pi bhavediti bhāvaḥ | ābhyāṃ pūrvottarārthābhyāṃ ‘apahatapāpmā vijaro vimṛtyurviśoko vijighatso'pipāsaḥ' iti śrutā akhilaheyapratyanīkatā ‘satyakāmassatyasaṃkalpaḥ' iti śrutā anantakalyāṇaguṇākaratā ca krameṇa darśitā || anyatra lakṣmyāḥ lakṣmīśabdasya | arthagatasya strītvasya śabde āropaḥ | sakhyuḥ sakhiśabdasya patyuḥ patiśabdasya ca | ghitāguṇābhāvaḥ ghitā ghisaṃjñakatvam | tena yo guṇaḥ ‘gherṅiti' iti vihito guṇaḥ tasya abhāvaḥ prathata iti yuktam | lakṣmīśabdasya nadīsaṃjñakadīrghevarṇāntatvena ‘śeṣo ghyasakhi' ityanadīsaṃjñakahrasvevarṇovarṇāntatvanibandhanaghisaṃjñāyāstatrāpravṛtteḥ | tatraiva ghisaṃjñāvidhāyake sūtre asakhīti sakhiśabdasya paryudastatvā | sakhiśabdasya ‘patissamāsa eva' iti samāsa eva patiśabdasya ghisaṃjñāyā niyamitatvenāsamastapatiśabdasya ca tadabhāvāt ghisaṃjñāprayuktaguṇābhāvaḥ prasiddha iti yuktam | bhavitāpratyayasyetyatra bhavitā āpratyayasyeti chedaḥ | āpratyayasya āṅsaṃjñasya ṭāpratyayasya nābhāvaḥ 'āṅo nāstriyām' iti vihitasya nādeśasyābhāvaḥ bhaviteti yat idamapi yuktaṃ vidmaḥ| lakṣmīsakhi patiśabdānāmuktarītyā ghisaṃjñāyā evābhāvānna tatkāryanābhāva iti bhāvaḥ | yadvā apiśabdo garhāyāṃ, apīdaṃ yuktaṃ vidma iti yojanā | asmin pakṣe āpratyayasya āṅaḥ nābhāvaḥ nātvaṃ bhaviteti yat tat yuktaṃ vidmaḥ kiṃ ? teṣāṃ śabdānāṃ ghisaṃjñāyā evābhāvena āṅo nādeśo bhaviteti na yuktaṃ vidma ityarthaḥ || yathāvā tvadbhogīnassvāmin viśvajanīnastathā''tmanīnaśca | bhāti hitārthasukhenaprathito'thātmā prakṛtyā ca || 840 || atra bhagavadupāsakasya prakṛtasya tvadbhogīnādiśabdasyāprakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi he svāmin ! tvadbhogīnaḥ tavaiva bhogāya hitaḥ na tu svasya, tvadbhogasaṃpādanaikatānaḥ tvaccheṣataikarasa iti yāvat | ‘paragatātiśayādhānecchayā upādeyatvameva yasya svarūpaṃ sa śeṣaḥ' iti hi śeṣalakṣaṇam | ata eva viśvajanīnaḥ sarvajanāya hitaḥ ātmanīnaḥ ātmane hitaśca svaparahitācaraṇaikavṛttirityarthaḥ | uktaṃ ca 'svaparahitaparaṃ deśikam' iti | īdṛśaḥ ātmā cetanaḥ hitārthasukhena hitaṃ bhagavatprāptyupāyaḥ arthaḥ paramapuruṣārthaḥ hitārthaśabdau tadjñānaparau | idaṃ tattvajñānasyāpyupalakṣakam | tābhyāṃ yatsukhaṃ ānandaḥ tena prathitassan bhāti | atha śarīrāvasāne prakṛtyā ca āvirbhūtaguṇāṣṭakādiviśiṣṭatvarūpeṇa svasvabhāvena ca bhātītyanuṣajyate dīpyate | tvaccheṣataikaraso viśvajanāya svacchātrabhūtāyātmane ca hitakṛccetanastattvahitapuruṣārthajñānaprayuktānandavattayeha pratītaśśarīrāvasāne cāvirbhūtasvābhāvikāpahatapāpmatvādibrāhmaguṇo nityāsaṃkucitajñānatayā prakāśate mukto bhavatīti bhāvaḥ || anyatra tvadbhogīna iti śabdaḥ viśvajanīna iti śabdaḥ ātmanīna iti śabdaśca hitārthasukhenaprathita iti samastaṃ padam | hitārthe hitarūpe'rthe ‘tasmai hitam' iti sūtreṇa vihite śobhanaścāsau khaśva sukhaḥ ‘ātmanviśvajanabhogottarapadātkhaḥ' iti vihito yaḥ khapratyayaḥ tasya yaḥ īnaḥ 'āyaneyīnīyiyaḥ' ityādinā vihita īnādeśaḥ tena prathitassan bhātīti pratyekaṃ tvadbhogīna ityādibhissaṃbadhyate | tvadbhogīnādiśabdatrayasyoktaprakriyāniṣpannatvāttathoktiḥ | athātmanīnaśabde viśeṣaṃ ca darśayaty athetyādinā | atheti viśeṣadyotakam | ātmā ātmaśabdaḥ prakṛtyā ca bhāti ‘ātmādhvānau khe' iti sūtravihitaṃ prakṛtibhāvamāpannaḥ prakāśate | yathāvasthitasvarūpa eva bhavati, na tu ‘nastaddhite' iti ṭilopaṃ prāpnoti | khapratyayaśśabdatraye'pyaviśiṣṭa eva, ātmaśabde tu prakṛtibhāvo viśeṣa iti bhāvaḥ || yathāvā sakto bhajati dadhāti spaṣṭaṃ hitatāṃ phaṇīśagiribhavanaḥ | svaujasi pareśatā'sminnanumāgamatoviśeṣabhāgbhavati || 841 || atra prastutasya bhagavataḥ aprastutasya dhāñdhātoḥ bhajadhātośca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi phaṇīśagiriḥ bhavanaṃ yasya saḥ śrīnivāsaḥ bhajati bhakte jane saktaḥ prītimān ‘priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ' iti gānāt | ata eva hitatāṃ tasmai bhaktimate upāyopeyabhāvena hitakāritāṃ dadhāti bibharti spaṣṭaṃ nātra viśayaleśo'pīti bhāvaḥ | svaujasi svā ojasīticchedaḥ ojasi ‘paraṃ jyotirupasaṃpadya' iti śrute divyatejorūpe | yadvā svā aujasīticchedaḥ | ā samantāt ojaḥ prakāśo yasya tasmin sarvavyāpiniratiśayatejasi asmin parabrahmāṇi śrīnivāse vidyamānā | svā svatassiddhā paraścāsāvīśaśca pareśaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ pareśatā pāramaiśvaryaṃ 'īśassarvasya jagataḥ, eṣa sarveśvaraḥ' ityādiśruteḥ | nanu māgamata iticchedaḥ | māyāḥ śriyaḥ āgamataḥ saṃbandhāt viśeṣabhāgbhavati nanu | bhagavataśśrīnivāsasya svābhāvikamaiśvaryaṃ parimalādiva hemāravindaṃ śrīsaṃbandhādāmreḍitavaibhavaṃ bhavatyevetyarthaḥ | nanuravadhāraṇe | uttarārdhena paratvaṃ pūrvārdhena saulabhyaṃ ca darśitam | yadvā uttarārdhasyaivamarthaḥ svaṃ ojaḥ yasya tasmin svaujasi svaprakāśasvarūpe asmin śrīnivāse vidyamānā īśatā aiśvaryam | anumāgamata iti samastaṃ padam | anumā anumānaṃ smṛtiḥ āgamaḥ śrutiḥ tayoḥ anumāgamataḥ 'ādyādibhyaḥ' iti sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ | parā dūrā ‘yato vāco nivartante' ityādiśruteḥ tadaviṣaya ityarthaḥ | ‘paraṃ dūrānyamukhyeṣu paro'riparamātmanoḥ' iti vaijayantī | yadvā anumāgamataḥ śrutismṛtibhyāṃ uktetyadhyāhāraḥ pareśatā pāramaiśvaryaṃ aviśeṣabhāgiticchedaḥ | aviḥ śailaḥ ‘avayaśśailameṣārkāḥ' ityamaraḥ | sa cāsau śeṣaśca aviśeṣaḥ śailākārabhāk śeṣaḥ śeṣādrirityarthaḥ | taṃ bhajatīti tathoktā bhavati | parasmin brahmaṇi vidyamānaṃ pāramaiśvaryaṃ sarvamapi śeṣādrāveva cakāsti tasyātrāvirbhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | asmin pakṣe uttarārdhenaiva krameṇa paratvasaulabhyoktiḥ | yadvā svaujasi svamahimapratiṣṭhite ‘ojo bale prabhāve ca' ityamaraḥ | bhūmavidyāyāṃ ‘sabhagavaḥ kasmin pratiṣṭhitaḥ' iti praśne ‘sve mahimni ' ityuttaraśravaṇāt rudraṃ samāśritā devā rudro brahmāṇamāśritaḥ | brahmā māmāśrito rājannāhaṃ kaṃ cidupāśritaḥ || mamāśrayo na kaścittu sarveṣāmāśrayo hyaham || iti smṛteśca | asmin bhagavati anumāgamataḥ śrutismṛtibhyāṃ pratipāditetyarthaḥ | pareśatā uktorthaḥ | śeṣāḥ dāsabhūtāścetanāḥ tān bhajatīti śeṣabhāk viśiṣya śeṣabhāk viśeṣabhāk sā na bhavatītyaviśeṣabhāk bhavati | parasmin brahmaṇi tasmin śrutismṛtibhyāmudghoṣitaṃ sarvaśeṣitvaṃ taccheṣabhūteṣu brahmarudrādiṣu nityasiddheṣvanantagaruḍādiṣu vā na saṃbhavatīti bhāvaḥ | yadvā na nu mā āgamataḥ iticchedaḥ| parā śreṣṭhā īśatā aiśvaryaṃ yasyāssā pareśatā | mā śrīḥ | svaujasi ukto'rthaḥ | asmin bhagavati āgamataḥ pañcarātrāgamoktarītyā nityasaṃbandhādvā viśeṣabhāk bhedabhāk na bhavati nu kiṃtu tādātmyāpannaiva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | 'viśeṣo'vayave vyaktau tilake'tyantabhedake' iti ratnamālā | nanvityekameva padaṃ vā | aviśeṣabhāgbhavatītyevacchedaḥ | tādātmyāpannaiva bhavatītyarthaḥ|| anyonyenāvinābhāvādanyonyena samanvayāt | tādātmyaṃ viddhi saṃbandhaṃ mama nāthasya cobhayoḥ | iti lakṣmītantrokteḥ, tadantarbhāvāttvāṃ na pṛthagabhidhatte śrutirapi | ityabhiyuktokteśca | athavā pareśatā mā svaujasi | asmin ukta evārthaḥ | āgamataḥ 'hrīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyau, sumajjānaye'| ityādiśrutyuktarītyā viśeṣabhāk viśeṣo viśeṣaṇatvaṃ vyāvartakatvaṃ, vipūrvakāt śiṣerbhāve ghañ | taṃ bhajatīti tathoktā bhavati nanu | svarūpanirūpakatayā bhagavati viśeṣaṇatvamupeyuṣī jagatkāraṇatvena śaṅkitebhyaścaturānanādibhyastasya vyāvṛttiṃ saṃpādayatīti bhāvaḥ | yadvā svaujasi asmin sati pareṣāṃ caturmukhādīnāṃ īśatā āgamataḥ śāstrāt viśeṣabhāk utkarṣabhāk mā bhavati nanu | jāgarūke bhagavataḥ pāramaiśvarye anyeṣāmaiśvaryaṃ śāstradṛṣṭyā kathamutkarṣamāpnuyāditi bhāvaḥ | māśabdo niṣedhārthakaḥ | ‘mā'vyayaṃ pratiṣedhe syāt, mā niṣedhe'vyayaṃ matam' iti ratnamālāviśvau || dhātupakṣe phaṇīśagiri patañjalivāci mahābhāṣye bhavanaḥ sattāṃ labhamānaḥ bhavaternandyāditvātkartari lyuḥ, bāhulakālluḍvā kartari | vyākaraṇe paṭhita iti yāvat | dadhātispaṣṭamityatra dadhātiriti chedaḥ | 'śarpare khari vā visargalopaḥ' iti pākṣiko visargalopaḥ | dadhātiḥ dhāñdhātuḥ śtipā nirdeśo'yam | ktena ktapratyayena saha vartata iti saktassan spaṣṭaṃ hitatāṃ hitaṃ iti rūpaṃ bhajati prāpnoti | dhāñaḥ ktapratyaye ‘dadhāterhiḥ' iti hyādeśavidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | asmin dhāñdhātāveva śatā laṭo vihitaśśatrādeśaḥ svaujasi suśca auśca jaścatyeteṣāṃ samāhāraḥ svaujas tasmin pare parato vidyamāne sati | na numāgamata iti chedaḥ | numāgamataḥ ‘ugidacāṃ sarvanāmasthāne'dhātoḥ' iti vihitānnumāgamāt viśeṣabhāk nakārasāhityena vailakṣaṇyabhāk na bhavati | ‘nābhyastācchatuḥ' iti tasya numniṣedhāditi bhāvaḥ | yadvā phaṇīśagiribhaveti saṃbuddhyantaṃ padam | na iti pṛthakpadam | phaṇīśagiri pātañjalabhāṣye viṣaye jāta! ‘goṣu prasūta' ityādau gā evānubhavituṃ jātetivat mahābhāṣyamevādhyetuṃ prasūteti kaṃcicchātraṃ prati kenacicchābdikenācāryeṇa kṛtaṃ saṃbodhanam | bhajati bhajacchabde saktaḥ saṃbaddhaḥ śatā śatrādeśaḥ svaujasi pare sati naḥ numāgamasaṃbandhinakārasya hitatāṃ anukūlatāṃ dadhāti dhatte ‘ugidacām' ityādinā numāgamavidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | uttarārdhe na num āgamata iti padatrayam | asmin pūrvokte śatari num numāgamaḥ āgamataḥ ā ityākārakavarṇasya āgamataḥ gamato vā | yathāsaṃbhavaṃ supratyaye pare 'atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' iti vihitadīrghasaṃbandhādityarthaḥ | viśeṣabhāk vailakṣaṇyabhāk na bhavati | śatrantasya adantatayā atvantatvābhāvāduktadīrghāprāpteriti bhāvaḥ | ata eva hi bhavannityatra ‘śatrantasya tu atvantatvābhāvānna dīrghaḥ' iti kaumudīgranthaḥ | yadvā na nu māgamata iti chedaḥ| asmin prakṛte bhajacchabde vidyamānaḥ śatetyanuṣajyate | śatā śatṛpratyayaḥ māgamataḥ mugāgamasaṃbandhimakārāgamataḥ viśeṣabhāk na bhavati nu | śānaci vihitasya ‘āne muk' iti mugāgamasya śataryaprasaktestatprayuktaṃ vailakṣaṇyaṃ na bhajatītyarthaḥ | nanvityavacchede vā | māgamataḥ viśeṣabhāk bhavati nanu | nanviti praśne vā | na bhavatyeveti bhāvaḥ | ito'pi prāthamikī vyākhyaiva svārasikīti sāvadhānairidamanusandheyam || yathāvā hantāto'nupasarge ko bhavati pratyayo'tha sukhadaśca | jāgratyadhipe tasminnatrātaścopasarga iti kassyāt || 842 || atra prakṛtasya bhagavataḥ aprakṛtasya vakṣyamāṇasūtradvayasya ca śleṣa | hanteti vakṣamāṇārthaparyālocanajamitaharṣe | vākyārambhe vā | anupasarge jagatāmupadravanivartane viṣaye iti yāvat | 'upasarga upadrave | prādau ca rogabhede ca' iti hemacandraḥ | pratyayaḥ hetuḥ 'pratyayo'dhīnaśapathajñānaviśvāsahetuṣu' ityamaraḥ | sukhadaśca saṃpatprayuktasaukhyadāyakaśca | ataḥ akāravācyādbhagavataḥ, prastutādasmādvā ko bhavitā jagatāṃ vipadapākaraṇe sukhavitaraṇe ca bhagavato'smādanyaḥ ko heturbhavedityarthaḥ | tasmin adhipe ‘eṣa bhūtādhipatireṣa bhūtapālaḥ' iti śrute sarvajagannetari sarvajagadavitari bhagavati jāgrati sati upasarge vipadi atrātaḥ arakṣita iti ca kaḥ syāt sati bhagavati rakṣitari apināma kaścidarakṣita iti ca vidyeteti bhāvaḥ | atra na saṃpadāṃ samāhāre vipadāṃ vinivartane | samartho dṛśyate kaścittaṃ vinā puruṣottamam || ityādipramāṇārtho'nusaṃhitaḥ || pakṣe 'āto'nupasarge kaḥ, ātaścopasarge' iti sūtradvayārthassodāharaṇo draṣṭavyaḥ | tathāhi ātaḥ ākārāntāddhātoḥ anupasarge anupasargāditi pañcamyantatayā vipariṇāmaḥ karmaṇītyanuvartate | karmaṇyupapade kaḥ pratyayaḥ bhavatīti sūtrārthaḥ| udāharaṇamāha atheti | atha sukhadaśca bhavati | sukhaṃ dadātīti sukhada iti sukhaśabde karmaṇyupapade anupasṛṣṭāddādhātoḥ kapratyayena niṣpannatvāttasyeti bhāvaḥ | kiṃca tasmin prasiddhe atra asmin buddhisthe jāgrati prakāśamāne adhipe adhipaśabde ‘ātaścopasarge' iti kassyāt | ātaḥ ākārāntāddhātoḥ upasarge adhītyākārakopasarge upapade kapratyayassyāditi tadarthaḥ | atra padye ‘āto'nupasarge kaḥ, ātaścopasarge' iti sūtrānupūrvyeva ghaṭiteti dhyeyam || yathāvā eṣa tvaccaraṇalihaśśeṣamahīdhroguṇottaro bhāti | kenāsya guṇaniṣiddhiśrīnātha kṛtā śrutā dṛṣṭā || atra bhagavaccaraṇalihasya śeṣamahīdhrasya prakṛtasya tadvācakaśabdayoraprakṛtayośca śleṣaḥ| tathāhi he śrīnātha! eṣaḥ śeṣamahīdhraḥ tvaccaraṇau leḍhīti tvaccaraṇalihaḥ tvatpādapadmasparśīti yāvat | ata eva guṇaiḥ pāvanatvaramyatvādibhiḥ uttaraḥ śreṣṭhassan bhāti dīpyate | asya evaṃ vidhasya śeṣādreḥ guṇaniṣiddhiḥ pūrvoktaguṇaniṣedhaḥ | nipūrvakātsedhateḥ ktin | kena puṃsā kṛtā klṛptā, kena śrutā, kena dṛṣṭā vā | asya pāvanatvādiguṇaniṣedho na kenacitkṛtaśśruto dṛṣṭo vetyarthaḥ || anyatra tvaccaraṇalihaśabdaḥ śeṣamahīdhraśabdaśca, aguṇottara iticchedaḥ | aguṇaṃ guṇarahitaṃ uttaraṃ lihaḥ dhra ityākārakamuttarapadaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ bhavati | nanu anayośśabdayoḥ krameṇa kuto laghūpadhalakṣaṇaḥ ārdhadhātukalakṣaṇaśca guṇo na pravartata ityata āha kenati | asya lihaśabdasya dhraśabdasya ca kṛtā kṛtsaṃjñakena kena 'igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ, kaprakaraṇe mūlabibhujādibhya upasaṃkhyānam' iti ca vihitena kapratyayena hetubhūtena guṇaniṣiddhiḥ ‘kṅiti ca' iti vihito guṇaniṣedha iti bhāvaḥ | śrutā śāstreṣu niśamitā | dṛṣṭā prayogeṣu dṛṣṭā ca | lihadhraśabdayorubhayorapi uktarītyā kapratyayāntatayā, kitvaprayuktaguṇaniṣedhaḥ śruto dṛṣṭaścetyarthaḥ | yadvātvaccaraṇalihaḥ śeṣamahīdhraśca aguṇottaro bhātīti kenacidukte kenāsya guṇaniṣiddhiḥ kṛtā śrutā dṛṣṭā ceti praśnābhinnamuttaramidamiti vakṣyamāṇacitrālaṅkāraścetyayaṃ viśeṣo'sminnarthe || yathāvā kaścittvayi lumpati cellumpatu supratyayaṃ parabrahman | tava nanu yadākadāvā bhavitā kaścittato nalopo vā || 844 || atra parabrahmaṇaśśrīnivāsasya parabrahmaśabdasya ca prakṛtāprakṛtayoḥ śleṣaḥ | tathāhi he parabrahman ! kaścit asthirahṛdaya iti bhāvaḥ | tvayi viṣaye supratyayaṃ vijātīyapratyayānantaritatayā śobhanaṃ anavaratabhāvanātmakaṃ jñānaṃ upāsanamityarthaḥ | lumpati cet vicchinatti cet kāmaṃ lumpatu vicchinattu antarayatvityarthaḥ | tataḥ pratyayalopāt nanu bhagavan! tava yadākadāvā | nalopovetyatra vidyamāno vāśabdo bhinnakramaḥ kaścidityatrānveti | kaścidvā lopaḥ hāniḥ na bhavitā | yadi yaḥkaścit tvaddhyānavicchedaṃ kuryāttatastavākhilaheyapratyanīkānantakalyāṇaguṇaikatānasya tatkṛtā na kācidapi hānissaṃbhavet pratyuta tasyaiva | ‘yadā hyevaiṣa etasminnudaramantaraṃ kurute | atha tasya bhayaṃ bhavati | tattveva bhayaṃ viduṣo'manvānasya' yanmuhūrtaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vā'pi vāsudevo na cintyate | sā hānistanmahacchidraṃ sā bhrāntissā ca vikriyā || iti śrutismṛtidarśitaṃ bhayaṃ bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ || pakṣe he parabrahmanniti śabdasyaiva saṃbodhanam | kaścit śabdaviditi bhāvaḥ | tvayi parabrahmaśabde tvayi supratyayaṃ parabrahmanniti saṃbodhanavaśātsasaṃbuddhisupratyayamityarthaḥ | lumpati cet 'svamornapuṃsakāt' iti sūtreṇeti bhāvaḥ | lumpatu kāmaṃ lupyāt | tataḥ lopāt yadākadāvā yasminkasminnapivā kāle nalopaḥ nakāralopaḥ vā bhavitā vikalpenaiva bhavitā | na tu rājannityādau nāntapulliṅgaśabda iva sarvathā na bhavitaiveti bhāvaḥ | ‘saṃbuddhau napuṃsakānāṃ nalopo vā vaktavyaḥ' iti nāntanapuṃsakaliṅgaśabdasaṃbuddhau vikalpena nakāralopānuśāsanāt | ayaṃ vakṣyamāṇāvajñālaṅkāragarbhita iti dhyeyam || yathāvā saṃjñā'nusaṃhitā tava saṃtanute'bhīpsitaṃ yathoddeśam | ucitārthādhyāhārādūrīkṛtakāryakālapakṣā ca || 845 || atra bhagavannāmnaśśabdaśāstrīyasaṃjñāyāśca prakṛtāprakṛtayā śleṣaḥ | tathāhi he bhagavanniti prakaraṇāllabhyate | ucitaḥ samañjasaḥ arthādhyāhāraḥ puruṣārthapradānaṃ yasyāssā ucitādhyāhārā abhīpsitasakalapuruṣārthadāyinītyarthaḥ | ‘dharmārthī prāpnuyāddharmamarthārthī cārthamāpnuyāt' ityādinā nāmasaṃkīrtanaphalokteḥ | ‘ucitaṃ syānmite yogye jñāte'bhyaste samañjase' iti ratnamālā | tava saṃjñā nāmadheyaṃ ‘saṃjñā syāccetanā nāma' ityamaraḥ | anusaṃhitā kīrtitā satī yathoddeśaṃ uddeśamanatikramya saṃkīrtayitṝṇāmabhisandhyanurodhenetyarthaḥ | abhīpsitaṃ abhilaṣitamarthaṃ saṃtanute udāhṛtapramāṇānusārāditi bhāvaḥ | na kevalamiṣṭaprāpaṇameva saṃtanute apitvaniṣṭanivāraṇamapītyāha dūrīti | dūrīkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ duṣkṛtino yātanāprāpaṇarūpakriyā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ kālasya kṛtāntasya pakṣāḥ sahāyāḥ bhaṭā iti yāvat, yayā sā tathoktā ca bhavati | 'pakṣo māsārdhake pārśve' ityārabhya 'bale sakhisahāyayoḥ' iti medinī | bhagavannāmābhilapanamātreṇaiva tatkartṝṇāṃ sarvāśubhanivṛttau tatra yamasya tadbhaṭānāṃ vā prābhavamakiñcitkaramiti bhāvaḥ | yathocyate vaiṣṇave kamalanayana vāsudeva viṣṇo dharaṇidharācyuta śaṅkhacakrapāṇe | bhava śaraṇamitīrayanti ye vai tyaja bhaṭa dūratareṇa tānapāpān || iti, kiṃkarāḥ pāśadaṇḍāśca na yamo na ca yātanāḥ | samarthāstasya yasyātmā keśavālambanassadā || ityādikamapyatraivānukūlam || pakṣe anusaṃhitā śabdaśāstreṇoditā saṃjñā abhyāsādisaṃjñā yathoddeśaṃ svapradeśamanatikramya sthitā satī ucitasya arthasya adhyāhārāt ūhāt ‘adhyāhārastarka ūhaḥ' ityamaraḥ | ‘adhyāhāro nāma nyūnapūraṇārthādhikapadapadārthānyataropādānam' ityāhuḥ | abhīpsitaṃ vākyārthabodhanarūpamabhīṣṭaṃ saṃtanute | yathoddeśapakṣe saṃjñāyā arthādhyāhāreṇa vākyaikavākyatayā kāryakāritvasya śābdikaissiddhāntitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | kiṃcorīkṛtaḥ kāryakālapakṣo yayā sā ūrīkṛtakāryakālapakṣā ca | abhīpsitaṃ saṃtanute | saṃjñāyāḥ kāryakālatvena padaikavākyatayā'pi vākyārthabodhanasya siddhāntitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | yathā paribhāṣyate yathoddaśaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣaṃ, kāryakālaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam' iti ca | ‘yathoddeśaṃ uddeśamanatikramya yathoddeśaṃ, uddeśa upadeśadeśaḥ adhikaraṇasādhanaścāyaṃ, yatra deśe ḍapadiśyate taddeśa eva vākyārthabodhena gṛhītaśaktyā gṛhītaparibhāṣārthena ca sarvatra śāstre vyavahāraḥ' iti prathamaparibhāṣārthaḥ | deśaścoccāraṇakāla evātra śāstre vyavahriyata iti saṃkṣepaḥ | dvitīyaparibhāṣārthastu ‘kāryeṇa kālyate svasaṃnidhiṃ prāpyata iti kāryakālaṃ svasaṃskārāya svavṛttiliṅgacihnitaparibhāṣāṇāmākṣepa iti yāvat' iti | yathoddeśapakṣe saṃjñāyāssvadeśīyatvaṃ, kāryakālapakṣe vidhideśīyatvamiti vivekaḥ || yathāvā yobrahmāyaścaśivaḥ pareṇabhavatā'khileśvarasaho ktau | ye'nyetadādimāste'pyante bhavadekaśeṣatāṃ dadhate || 846 || atra prakṛtasya brahmādipadārthasya caturmukhādeḥ aprakṛtasya brahmādiśabdarūpārthasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi he akhileśvara! pareṇa sarvottareṇa bhavatā tvayā saha uktau 'sthityādayo hariviriñcihareti līlāḥ' ityādau tulyatābhramāspadatayā sahapaṭhitau | yo brahmā caturmukhaḥ yaśca śivaḥ śambhurityetau ‘hiraṇyagarbhassamavartatāgre, na sanna cāsacchiva eva kevalaḥ' iti śravaṇātkāraṇatvaśaṅkāviṣayabhūtau yāvityarthaḥ | tāvevādimau yeṣāṃ te tadādimāḥ | ya anye devāḥ ‘nakirindra tvaduttaro na jyāyānasti vṛtrahan' ityādinā kāraṇatvaśaṅkāgocaratayoktā indrādayaḥ | te'pi ante vākyārthanirṇayāvasare ‘anto'strī niścaye nāśe svarūpe'gre'ntike'ntare' iti ratnamālā | svarūpe vā | bhavadekaśeṣatāṃ bhavata eva śeṣatāṃ mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāso'svapadavigraha iti lakṣmīsahasraratnaprakāśikāyāṃ nirūpitamasmābhiḥ | samyagvimarśe brahmādayassarve'pi bhavadekaśeṣasvarūpā eveti niścīyeran natu kadā'pi tvāmeva sarvaśeṣiṇa itīti bhāvaḥ | yadvā ante pralaye bhavāneva śeṣo yeṣāṃ te bhavadekaśeṣāḥ tattāṃ dadhate || brahmādiṣu pralīneṣu naṣṭe loke carācare | ābhūtasaṃplave prāpte pralīne prakṛtau mahān | ekastiṣṭhati viśvātmā sa tu nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || naṣṭe loke dviparārdhāvasāne mahābhūteṣvādibhūtaṃ gateṣu | vyakte'vyaktaṃ kālavegena yāte bhavānekaśśiṣyate śeṣasaṃjñaḥ || ityādyuktarītyā bhavadekaśeṣatvaṃ dadhate tvayi pralīyanta ityarthaḥ | akhileśvaretisaṃbodhanamīdṛśaviśeṣamabhisaṃdhāyaiveti dhyeyam || aprakṛtapakṣe tu yo brahmā brahmaśabdaḥ yaśca śivaḥ śivaśabdaḥ pareṇa utkṛṣṭena bhavatā bhavacchabdena | utkarṣaścāsya vakṣyamāṇarītyāsarvaissahoktau svaikaśeṣatvakṛta iti dhyeyam | sahoktau ikārāntasaptamyekavacanamidam | sahavacane satītyarthaḥ | ante vigrahāvasāne bhavadekaśeṣatāṃ bhavacchabdaikaśeṣatāṃ dadhate dhatte | ‘dadha dhāraṇe' bhauvādikādasmāllaṭprathamaikavacanam | brahmaśivaśabdābhyāṃ pratyekamanveti | ‘tyadādīni sarvairnityam' ityanuśāsanāt | brahmā bhavāṃśceti śivo bhavāṃśceti ca vigrahe bhavacchabdasyaiva śiṣyamāṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ | ye anye tadādimāḥ tad yad etad ityādayaḥ te'pi śabdāḥ pareṇa tyadādigaṇe sarvebhyaḥ paratra paṭhitena bhavatā sahoktau ante vigrahāvasāne bhavadekaśeṣatāṃ bhavacchabdamātraśeṣatāṃ dadhate bibhrati | ‘ḍu dhāñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' iti jauhotyādikāddhātorlaṭprathamabahuvacanam | 'tyadādīnāṃ mithassahoktau yatparaṃ tacchiṣyate' iti | sa ca yaśca eṣa ca bhavāṃśceti vigrahe bhavanta iti parabhūtabhavacchabdasyaiva śeṣaṇāditi bhāvaḥ | yathāvā upasargaviralabhāvo bhvādau janitāsadāvalīḍāgamavān | tāntaḥ palāyitassyāddhāturbhavatohitoya evānanta || 847 || atra bhagavataśśrīnivāsasya prakṛtasya patañjaleraprakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ | he! ananta! bhagavan! dhātuḥ dhārayituḥ poṣṭuśca "eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca" ityukteḥ | dhāñaśśatā | bhavataḥ tava bhvādau bhūlokādiloke janitā utpannaḥ | janestṛc | yaḥ cetanaḥ asadāvalīḍāgamavān asatāṃ khalānāṃ āvalī paṅktiḥ tasyāḥ īśaḥ pradhānabhūtāḥ | īṭchabdo'yam | teṣāṃ āgamassaṃsargaḥ tadvān asatsaṃsargadūṣita ityarthaḥ | yadvā asadāvaleḥ iḍāḥ vācaḥ "bhūgovācastviḍā ilāḥ" ityamaraḥ | tadāgamavān nityamasadālāpaśālītyarthaḥ | nityayoge matup | athavā asadāvaleḥ iḍāḥ vācaḥ tābhiḥ āgamavān śāstravān | tā evāgamaśśāstraṃ tadvānvā | asadvāca evāsyānuṣṭhānavidhāyinya iti bhāvaḥ | ata eva ahita eva syā | durantaduṣkarmavaśaṃvadatvanibaṃdhanāsatsaṃsargadūṣitavivekitayā tvayi vidveṣavāneva bhavedityarthaḥ | bhvādau janitaḥ yaḥ asadāvalīḍāgamavān san dhāturbhavataḥ ahita eveti yojanā | arthastu tulya eva | ya ityasyottaravākyagatatayā na pūrvavākye tadvṛttopādānāvaśyaṃbhāvaḥ | saḥ cetanaḥ upasargaviralabhāvaḥ upasargaiḥ upaplavaiḥ ‘upasarga upadrave | prādau ca rogabhede ca' iti hemacandraḥ | viralaḥ pelavaḥ atimātralaghurityarthaḥ, bhāvaḥ sattā svabhāvaḥ abhiprāyaḥ ceṣṭā janma vā yasya sa tathoktassan | "pelavaṃ viralaṃ tanu | bhāvassattāsvabhāvābhiprāyaceṣṭātmajanmasvi" iti cāmaraḥ | ata eva tāntaḥ glānaḥ palāyitaśca syāt | dīnaḥ kvāpyavasthitimalabhamāno yatra kvāpi dhāvedityarthaḥ | bhagavadvidveṣiṇaḥ kva nu śreyassaṃpadyeteti bhāvaḥ| pakṣe he! ananteti patañjalitvenāvatīrṇasya śeṣasya saṃbodhanaṃ | bhavatā ūhitaḥ aya iti cchedaḥ | bhavatā, tvayā ūhitaḥ vicāritaḥ | bhavataḥ hitaḥ aya iti vā chedaḥ | bhavataḥ hitaḥ jñātaḥ pathya iti vā | 'hi gatau' karmaṇi ktaḥ | ye gatyarthāste jñānārthāḥ| ‘hitaṃ pathye gate dhṛte' iti medinī | bhavata iti śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī ‘na loka' iti niṣedhastu kārakaṣaṣṭhīviṣayaḥ | yadvā ‘matibuddhi' iti sūtravihitaḥ ktaḥ | ‘ktasya ca vartamāne' iti ‘na loka' iti niṣedhāpavādabhūtā ṣaṣṭhī | bhvādau bhvādigaṇe janitā prādurbhūtaḥ | sthita iti yāvat | ayaḥ ayadhātuḥ | śapā nirdeśo'yam | upasarge svasaṃbandhini vivakṣite paretyākārakopasarge, palāyita iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | viralabhāvaḥ vigamito raḥ rephaḥ yenasaḥ viraḥ labhāvaḥ lavarṇasthitiḥ viraḥ labhāvo yasya sa tathoktaḥ | yadvā rasya rephasya labhāvo latvaṃ viśiṣṭo ralabhāvo yasya sa tathoktaḥ | vītyanena labhāvasya nityatvaṃ dyotitam | sarvathā'pi rephasthānikalakāravānityarthaḥ | tāntaḥ tetyutsṛṣṭānubandhasya ktasya grahaṇam | ktapratyayānta ityarthaḥ | sadāvalīḍāgamavānityatra sadā vali iḍāgamavāniti padatrayamasamastam | vali ārdhadhātukaktapratyayasaṃbandhitakārarūpe valpratyāhāraghaṭakavarṇe sadā nityaṃ iḍāgamavān san palāyitassyāt ‘ayapaya' ityādinā bhvādau paṭhitasya paropasṛṣṭasyāyateḥ ktapratyaye ‘upasargasyāyatau' iti rephasya nityaṃ latve ‘ārdhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ' iti niyamiḍāgame ca palāyita iti rūpaṃ niṣpadyata iti nirgalito'rthaḥ || yathāvā īśaḥ parovaraścinnāsyeḍayameva hīśvaro bhavati | vikṛtimiyānnaivāsāvupadhālaghutāguṇo'pi dūre'sya || atra bhagavataḥ īśvaraśabdasya ca śleṣaḥ | paraḥ anyaḥ caturmukhādiḥ avaraḥ nihīnaḥ cit cetatīti cit cetanaḥ asya īśaḥ īśvarasya bhagavataḥ | ‘īśā vāsyam' ityatreva īṭchabdo'yaṃ | īṭ svāmī na bhavati | bhagavadapekṣayā nihīnatvāttasyeśvaro na bhavatītyarthaḥ | yadvā paraḥ anyaḥ cit cetanaḥ | īśa iti pañcamī ‘anaupādhikanirdeśe hyasaṃkoco manīṣibhiḥ | siddhe śabdārthasaṃbandhe' iti nyāyena śabdaśakterasaṃkocātsarveśvarādasmādityarthaḥ | avaraḥ nyūna eveti vākyāntaram | yadvā asyetyetatpūrvatrāpyapakṛṣya asya iśaḥ avara iti yojanā asmānyūna ityevārthaḥ | asmispakṣe īśa iti śeṣaṣaṣṭhī | ata eva asya bhagavataḥ paraḥ itaraḥ caturmukhādiḥ neṭ īśvaro na bhavatītyarthaḥ | 'na tasyeśe kaścana' ityādiśruteḥ | ayameva eṣa śrīnivāsa eva īśvaraḥ sarveṣāmīśvaraḥ bhavati hi | hi śabdaḥ ‘eṣa sarveśvaraḥ | īśāno bhūtabhavyasya | sarreśvareśvaraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ' ityādiśrutipurāṇādiprasiddhaṃ dyotayati | yadvā hirhetau | asyaiva sarveśvaratvāditi bhāvaḥ | hetvantaraṃ cāha vikṛtimiti | asau bhagavān vikṛtiṃ ‘jāyate asti vardhate' ityādyuktān ṣaḍbhāvavikārān naiva iyāt | ‘jarāṃ mṛtyumatyeti | apakṣayavināśābhyām' ityādipramāṇebhya iti bhāvaḥ | kiṃcāsya bhagavataḥ upadhā kaitavaṃ, yena parā atisaṃdhīyeran tādṛśaścittavikāraviśeṣaḥ ‘kapaṭo'strī vyājadambhopadhayaśchadmakaitave' ityamaraḥ, ‘amātyānupadhātītān' itiprayogaśca | laghutāguṇo'pi rāgadveṣādikṛtacittalāghavarūpaguṇo'pi | athavā upadhayā yā laghutā tādṛśaḥ aguṇaḥ apraśastaguṇaḥ heyaguṇa ityarthaḥ | nañatrāprāśastye | 'aprāśastyaṃ virodhaśca' iti nañartheṣu parigaṇanāt | idaṃ heyaguṇasāmānyasyopalakṣakam | so'pi dūre amuṃ na spṛśatītyarthaḥ | apūrṇatvādanyeṣāmīdṛśaheyaguṇasaṃbandhassyāt | asya tu niravadhikaiśvaryanityapūrṇatvādakhila heyapratyanīkatvācca tatsaṃbandhagandho'pi na saṃbhavatītyayameva sarveśvara iti bhāvaḥ | atra upadhādūratvoktyā asyāśriteṣu karaṇatrayavṛttyaikarūpyeṇa kauṭilyavidhuratayā ārjavaṃ pradarśitam | yathā cāyamevāha dyauḥ patet pṛthivī śīryeddhimavānvicaledapi | śuṣyettoyanidhiḥ kṛṣṇe na me moghaṃ vaco bhavet' || iti | laghutāguṇadūratvoktyā āśritāparādhaiḥ tatpradarśakairvā'pyakṣobhyatvarūpaṃ sthairyaṃ darśitam | yathā''ha svayameva sugrīvādīnprati mitrabhāvena saṃprāptaṃ na tyajeyaṃ kathaṃcana | doṣo yadyapi tasya syāt satāmetadagarhitam || iti | pakṣe īśaḥ 'īśa aiśvarye' iti dhātoḥ ‘kṣiyo dīrghāt' ityādāviva dhātoranukaraṇam | cit cakāreetkaḥ paraḥ ‘stheśabhāsapisakaso varac' iti vihito varacpratyaya ityarthaḥ | paraḥ 'pratyayaḥ, paraśca' ityadhikārātparatra vidyamāna ityarthaḥ | asya varacaḥ iṭ iḍāgamaḥ na na bhavati | ‘neḍvaśikṛti' iti niṣedhādityarthaḥ | ayameva evaṃ varajviśiṣṭa īśadhātureva īśvaro bhavati īśvaraśabdo niṣpadyate | asau evaṃ niṣpanna īśvaraśabdaḥ vikṛtiṃ naiva iyāt iḍabhāvādvikāraṃ na prāpnuyādeva | dhātupratyayayoryathāvasthitayoreva śravaṇāditi bhāvaḥ | yadīḍāgamo'bhaviṣyattadā'sya vikārassamabhaviṣyat | asya īśvaraśabdasya upadhālaghutāguṇaḥ upadhāyāḥ 'alo'ntyātpūrva upadhā' ityuktalakṣaṇasya upāntyavarṇasya laghutayā ‘hrasvaṃ laghu' ityuktalakṣaṇahrasvatvena yo guṇaḥ ‘pugantalaghūpadhasya' iti vihito guṇaḥ so'pi dūre | asya dīrghopadhatvena tadaprāpteḥ | iḍāgamaprayuktavikāravirahe'pi yadi guṇo vā'bhaviṣyattadā vikāramalapsyatāpi | so'pi neti bhāvaḥ || yathāvā vātāśagirāvāptaḥ padaṃ budhavrajamahodayaśasādau | prathitodantaśślāghyassādhīyāṃste hare lasati pādaḥ || 849 || atra bhagavaccaraṇasya prastutasya pādaśabdasyāprastutasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi budhavrajamahoda! budhavrajasya devanivahasya mahaḥ tejaḥ dadātīti tathoktaḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ, he hare! bhagavan! ādau trivikramāvatārasamaye ityarthaḥ | prathitaḥ prakhyātaḥ udanto vṛttānto yasya sa tathoktaḥ "idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā nidadhe padam" ityādiśrutiprasiddhasakalalokākramaprabhāva iti bhāvaḥ | ata eva yaśasā ślāghyaḥ sādhīyān atiśayena bāḍhaḥ atimātrapraśasta ityarthaḥ | bāḍhaśabdādīyasuni "antibāḍhayornedasādhau " iti sādhādeśaḥ | te bhavataḥ pādaḥ caraṇaḥ vātāśagirau śeṣādrau padaṃ sthānaṃ āptassan lasati | tatra nyastatvāttathoktiḥ || anyatra budhānāṃ śābdikānāṃ mahodayaḥ mahābhyudayahetuḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ he hare! patañjalitvenāvatīrṇa he śeṣetyarthaḥ | "vyālaḥ kumbhīnaso hariḥ" ityamaraḥ | viśeṣaṇamahimnā sāmānyasyāpi hariśabdasya viśeṣaparatvamavadheyam | ślāghyaḥ adantaḥ | hrasvākārāntaḥ prathitaḥ adantatayā kośādau prasiddhaḥ pādaḥ pādaśabdaḥ śasādau śasiti dvitīyābahuvacanasya saṃjñā | tadādau pratyaye pare satīti yāvat | vātāśaḥ ṛṣiḥ pāṇinirityarthaḥ | tasya girā "padannomās" ityādisūtrarūpayetyarthaḥ | padaṃ padityākārakamādeśamiti yāvat | avāptaḥ prāptaḥ | prathitodantaślāghya ityānupūrvīmāvartya prathitaḥ dantaślāghya iti chidyate; dantaḥ d ityākārakavarṇaḥ ante yasya sa tathoktaḥ | padādeśe tathātvasiddheḥ, danta iti ślāghyaḥ dantaślāghyaḥ te śabdānuśāsanabhāṣyakṛtastava | saṃbandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī | sādhīyān sādhuśabdādayisun | atiśayena sādhuriti prathitassan lasati | sūtrakṛtā ādeśamātravidhānena sādhuḥ kṛtaḥ | bhāṣyakṛtā tvayā tu tadanuguṇasthānino'pi pradarśanena sādhīyānkṛta iti bhāvaḥ | yathāvā arhaḥ paraṃśamāptuṃ gaṇyo dhāturapi vedavidaniṭ syāt | dāntatvamīyuṣo'niśamātmā'sya sakṛdvibhāto hi || 850 || atra brahmavidaḥ prakṛtasya vidadhātoraprakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ| tathāhi paraṃ niratiśayaṃ śaṃ sukhaṃ parabrahmānubhavānandamityarthaḥ | āptuṃ arhaḥ ata eva dhātuḥ brahmaṇo'pi gaṇyaḥ ślāghyaḥ vedavit brahmavettā aniṭ niṭ niśā tatsadṛśamajñānamiti yāvat sā na vidyate yasya sa tathoktaḥ syāt | tatra hetuḥ dāntatvamityādi | hi yasmāt aniśaṃ dāntatvaṃ ‘śānto dānta uparataḥ' ityādyuktaṃ guṇaviśeṣaṃ īyuṣaḥ asya brahmavidaḥ ātmā antaryāmī sakṛdvibhātaḥ sarvadā anāvṛtatayā pradīptaḥ | tasmādasya brahmavidaḥ ajñānagandho'pi nāstītyarthaḥ | atra ‘tasmādvā eta setuṃtīrtvā api naktamaharevābhiniṣpadyate sakṛdvibhāto hyeṣa brahmalokaḥ' iti daharavidyāgataśrutyarthassaṃgṛhītaḥ | asyāśśruterarthaścopaniṣadbhāṣyakārairevaṃ varṇitaḥ ‘paramātmānaṃ prāptasya naktaṃ tamisrā rātrirapi divaiva | tasyājñānaprasakterabhāvāt ahassadṛśī rātriḥ ahorātrayorna viśeṣaḥ | tatra hetuḥ sakṛdvibhātaḥ sadābrahmasvarūpaprakāśasyānāvṛtatayā bhāsamānatvāt' iti || pakṣe paraṃ svasmātparaṃ śaṃ 'tudādibhyaśśaḥ' iti vihitaṃ śapratyayaṃ āptuṃ arhaḥ| vedetibhinnaṃ padam | vid 'vidl lābhe' iti tudādau paṭhitaḥ dhāturapi aniṭ avidyamānaḥ iḍāgamo yasya sa tathoktaḥ | gaṇyaḥ aniṭsu gaṇanīyaḥ syāditi veda vedmi | ‘vindatiścāndradaurgāderiṣṭo bhāṣye'pi dṛśyate' ityaniṭkārikāsūktadhātorapi pāṭhāt ‘ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt' iti iṇniṣedhāditi bhāvaḥ | vid dhāturapītyapiśabdena śyan śnam vikaraṇapaṭhitayossattāvicāraṇārthakayorvidadhātvorivāsyāpīṇniṣedhoniṣpratyūha iti dhvanitam | tāvapi hi dhātū ‘vidyatirvinad' ityaniṭkārikāsu paṭhyete | asya videranudāttatvaṃ draḍhayati dāntatvamityādinā | hi yasmāt aniśaṃ dāntatvaṃ da iti varṇo'nte yasya tattvaṃ īyuṣaḥ detyatra akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | asya vidadhātoḥ ātmā svarūpaṃ sakṛt ekavārameva vibhātaḥ vi ityākārakavarṇena bhātaḥ prakāśitaḥ viderevaṃvidhasvarūpatvenaikāctvādukta iṇniṣedho yukta eveti bhāvaḥ || yathāvā ye kuśalā api santo na taddhitapratyayādayo dṛṣṭāḥ | ita ete lupyante na taddhitapratyayādayastvete || 851 || atra prakṛtānāṃ bhagavadabhaktabhaktānāṃ 'laśakvataddhite, tasya lopaḥ' iti sūtrārthasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi ye janāḥ kuśalāḥ kṛtinassanto'pi | yadvā ye santaḥ manīṣiṇaḥ kuśalā apīti yojanā | ṛgvedādyaparavidyāniṣṇātā apītyarthaḥ | taddhitapratyayādayaḥ tasmai prakṛtāya bhagavate hitāḥ prītyādhāyakāḥ pratyayo jñānaṃ ādiryeṣāṃ te pratyayādayaḥ ādiśabdena bhaktivairāgyādīnāṃ grahaṇam | taddhitāḥ pratyayādayo yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ bhagavadabhimatajñānabhaktivairāgyādiguṇavantaḥ na dṛṣṭāḥ, te janāḥ itaḥ asmāttaddhitajñānādimattvādarśanādeva hetoḥ lupyante svayameva naśyanti adhaḥpatantīti yāvat | bhagavadabhimatajñānādivirahe akhilakalākauśalyamapyakiṃcitkaramiti bhāvaḥ | taddhitapratyayādayastu bhagavatprītyādhāyakajñānabhaktyādimantastu ete santo janāḥ na lupyante 'na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati' iti gānāditi bhāvaḥ || pakṣe santo'pi sūtroccāraṇāvasare śrūyamāṇā api ye kuśalāḥ kavargaśakāralakārāḥ atra ‘laśaku' iti vakṣyamāṇasūtroktavaiparītyena kuśalā ityuktirvivakṣitaśleṣalābhāya | nataddhitapratyayādayaḥ taddhitabhinnapratyayādyavayavabhūtāssantaḥ dṛṣṭāḥ jñātāḥ nataddhitetyatra naśabdena samāsaḥ | ete ime itaḥ itsaṃjñakāḥ ‘laśakvataddhite' iti taddhitavarjapratyayādibhūtānāṃ laśakavargāṇāmitsaṃjñāvidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | ata eva lupyante luptā bhavanti | ‘tasya lopaḥ' itītsaṃjñakasya varṇasya lopavidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | lopaścādarśanaṃ ‘adarśanaṃ lopaḥ' ityanuśāsanāt | ataddhiteti paryudāsaphalitamāha netyādinā | taddhitapratyayādayastu taddhitasaṃjñakapratyayādyavayavabhūtāstu ete kavargaśakāralakārāḥ ‘ākarṣādibhyaḥ kan, lomādibhyaśśaḥ, prāṇisthādāto lajanyatarasyām' ityāditaddhitādhikārīyasūtravihitakādipratyayādyavayavabhūtā ityarthaḥ | na lupyante | ‘āto'nupasarge kaḥ, ejeḥ khaś, puṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ prāyeṇa, laṭaśśatṛśānacau, lyuṭca' ityādivihitātaddhitapratyayādibhūtāḥ kādaya iva na lopaṃ prāpnuvanti | kiṃtu ākarṣakaḥ lomaśaḥ jaṅghāla ityādiṣu śrūyamāṇā eva bhavantīti bhāvaḥ || yathāvā siddhyati maha eva mahatparādatipratyayādbudhendrāṇām | yatraiva sarvanāmasthāne siddhonumāgamo'pi pare || 852 || atra bhagavato mahadhātośca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi budhendrāṇāṃ brahmavidagresarāṇāṃ parāt vijātīyapratyayāvyatikīrṇatayā śreṣṭhāt atipratyayāṃt avicchinnāt smṛtisantatirūpāt jñānādeva mahat pūjyaṃ mahaḥ ‘taṃ devā jyotiṣāṃ jyotiḥ, paramaṃ yo mahattejaḥ' ityādyuktaṃ svaprakāśarūpaṃ paraṃ brahma siddhyati prāptaṃ bhavati | tadeva maho viśinaṣṭi yatreti | sarvanāmasthāne sarveṣāṃ nāmnāṃ paryavasānabhūmau sarvaśabdavācye ityarthaḥ | devādināmarūpavyākaraṇanidānabhūte iti vā | yatra yasmin pare brahmaṇyeva māgamaḥ māyāḥ śriyaḥ gamaḥ saṃgamaḥ saṃbandho'pi siddhaḥ niṣpannaḥ maṅgalakara iti vā ‘ṣidhū śāstre māṅgalye ca' asmātkartari ktaḥ | apītyanena nisargata eva maṅgalasyāsya maṅgaladdevatāyāśśriyassaṃbandho'pyatiśayādhāyaka iti dyotitam | nu iticchātrānunaye ‘nu vitarkāpamānayoḥ | vikalpe'nunanaye'tīte' iti medinī | śrīnivāsabhūtaṃ paraṃ mahaḥ brahmavedibhirupāsanena prāptaṃ bhavatīti pariniṣpanno'rthaḥ || pakṣe budhendrāṇāṃ vaiyākaraṇānāṃ mahaḥ ‘maha pūjāyām' ityukto mahadhātuḥ parāt svasmātparatra vidyamānāt atipratyayāt mahat siddhyati mahaditi niṣpadyata ityarthaḥ | yatraiva yasminmahacchabda eva sarvanāmasthāne ‘śi sarvanāmasthānam, suḍanapuṃsakasya' iti ca sūtravihitasarvanāmasthānasaṃjñake pratyaye pare sati | numāgama ityatra num āgama iticchedaḥ | num ‘vartamāne pṛṣanmahadbṛhajjagacchatṛvacca' ityatipratyayāntatayā nipātitasya śatṛvadbhāvātideśena ugitvāt ‘ugidacāṃ sarvanāmasthāne'dhātoḥ' iti vihito numāgamaḥ āgamaḥ ā ityākārakavarṇasya gamaḥ saṃbandhaḥ ‘sāntamahataḥ' ityanena vihito nakāropadhādīrgha iti yāvat | so'pi siddha iti || yathāvā iha bṛṃhati parabhūmani nodbhavati prakṛtisaṅgato numataḥ | brahmaṇi narastathātvenossyānnāpyatra vaśikṛtīḍitatā || 853 || atra prakṛtasya brahmavidaḥ aprakṛtasya brahmaśabdasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi iha bṛṃhati parabhūmani na udbhavati prakṛtisaṃgataḥ nu mataḥ brahmaṇi naraḥ tathātve no syāt na api atra vaśīkṛtīḍitatā iti padacchedaḥ | naraḥ cetanaḥ parabhūmani niratiśayamahimani ‘yatra nānyatpaśyati nānyacchṛṇoti nānyadvijānāti sa bhūmā' ityuktarītyā niratiśayavaipulyaviśiṣṭe ityarthaḥ | ata eva bṛṃhati vardhamāne 'nainamūrthvaṃ na tiryañcaṃ na madhye parijagrabhat' ityādyuktarītyā sarvavyāpinītyarthaḥ | brahmaṇi viṣaye mataḥ mantā 'matibuddhi' ityādinā kartari ktaḥ | parabrahmasvarūpamananaśīla ityarthaḥ | prakṛtisaṅgataḥ prakṛtisaṃsargāt iha asyāṃ bhūmau asmin loke iti vā | nodbhavati nu bhūyo na jāyata ityarthaḥ | arcirādipathena parabrahma pratipadya punarnāvartate | māmupetya punarjanma duḥkhālayamaśāśvatam | nāpnuvanti mahātmānassaṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ || iti gānāditi bhāvaḥ | tathātve evamanāvṛttatve sati | atra asmin brahmavidi nare vaśikṛtīḍitatā vaśī sarveśvaraḥ svāyattasakalaloka ityarthaḥ | vaśo'syāstīti vaśī ‘vaśa āyattatāyāṃ syādvaśa icchāprabhutvayoḥ' iti viśvaḥ | ‘sarvasya vaśī sarvasyeśānaḥ' iti śruteḥ | ‘jagadvaśe vartatedaṃ kṛṣṇasya sacarācaram' iti smṛteśca | kṛtamasyāstīti kṛtī ‘na me pārthāsti kartavyam' ityuktarītyā svārthakartavyaśeṣarahita ityarthaḥ | yadvā āśritarakṣaṇena kṛtakṛtyaḥ ‘abhiṣicya ca' ityārabhya ‘kṛtakṛtyastadā rāmaḥ' ityukteḥ | athavā kṛtamupakāro'syāstīti kṛtī bhūmni matvarthīyaḥ | yatkiñcidupakṛtamapi baṃhīyo jānātītyarthaḥ | yathoktaṃ 'kathañcidupakāreṇa kṛtenaikena tuṣyati' iti | kṛtenetyatra ‘ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ, kartumupakrāntena' iti vyākhyātāraḥ | govindeti yadākrandat kṛṣṇā māṃ dūravāsinam | ṛṇaṃ pravṛddhamiva me hṛdayānnāpasarpati || iti ca | atra ‘vaśī vadānyaḥ' iti
