padye śrīyāmunamunibhiranugṛhītāni vaśitvakṛtitvakṛtajñatvānyanusaṃhitāni | vaśī cāsau kṛtī ceti viśeṣaṇobhayapadakarmadhārayaḥ | sa cāsāvīṭ ca | īṭ iśvaro bhagavān tena itaḥ prāptaḥ | vaśikṛtīṭ itaḥ prāpto yeneti vā | tasya bhāvaḥ vaśikṛtīḍitatā parabrahmānubhava ityarthaḥ | sā'pi nossyāditi na kiṃ tvavaśyaṃ bhāvinyeveti bhāvaḥ saṃbhāvyaniṣedhanivartakaśabdadvayena īdṛśasya viduṣaḥ parabrahmānanubhavasaṃbhāvanā dūrato nirasyate | yathā sūtritaṃ vāmanena 'saṃbhāvyaniṣedhanivartane dvau pratiṣedhau' iti | nossyādityatra sakārasya ‘anaci ca' iti vaikalpikaṃ dvitvamarthāntarānuguṇyāyāvaśyameṣṭavyam | yadvā vaśibhiḥ svāyattendriyaiḥ kṛtibhiḥ vidvadbhiḥ īḍitatā mahāprabhāvo'yaṃ brahmaviditi stutatā nossyāditi na kiṃtu stutataiva syāditi bhāvaḥ | anyatra iha bṛṃhatiparabhūmani naḥ at bhavati prakṛtisaṅgataḥ numataḥ brahmaṇi na raḥ tathā atvena uḥ syāt na api atra vaśi kṛti iḍitatā iti padacchedaḥ | bṛṃhatiparabhūmani bṛṃhatiḥ bṛhidhātuḥ ‘bṛhi vṛddhau" iti bhvādau paṭhitaḥ | śtipā nirdeśo'yam | tasmāt parabhūḥ paratra vidyamānaḥ man mannityākārakapratyayo yasya tasmin bṛṃhatermaninpratyayena niṣpanne ityarthaḥ | brahmaṇi brahmaśabde prakṛtisaṃgataḥ prakṛtau manpratyayaprakṛtibhūte bṛṃheti dhātau saṃgataḥ saṃbaddhaḥ numataḥ atatītyataḥ atatessātatyagamanārthakādbhauvādikāt ecādyac | numaḥ ataḥ numataḥ bṛhidhātoriditvāt 'idito num dhātoḥ' iti vihitanumāgamātprāpta ityarthaḥ | naḥ nakāraḥ at bhavati | bṛhidhātornumo nakāraḥ ‘taparastatkālasya' iti śābdikasaṃketito hrasvo'kāro bhavatītyarthaḥ | 'sarvadhātubhyo man' ityato mannityasyānuvṛttau ‘bṛṃherno'cca' ityauṇādikasūtreṇa numo nakārasya attvavidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | tathā evameva | attvena numo nakārasyākārādeśena | uḥ bakārottaravartiṛkārasya | ṛśabdāt ṅasi ‘ṛta ut' ityekādeśe utve raparatve ‘rātsasya' iti salope rephasya visargaḥ | raḥ rephaḥ na syāditi na iti yojanā | syādevetyarthaḥ | bṛ a iti sthite ‘iko yaṇaci' iti ṛkārasya yaṇādeśavidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | atra evaṃ niṣpanne brahmanśabde vaśi vaśpratyāhāraghaṭakamavarṇādau kṛti kṛtpratyaye iḍitatā'pi iḍāgamayuktatā'pi na syāditi padadvayamevāvartyate | na syāt na bhavedityarthaḥ | ‘neḍvaśikṛti' itīṇniṣedhāt | evaṃ suduṣkaratamasyāsya padyasyārtho brahmamīmāṃsāśabdanayanipuṇatamaissahṛdayairvipaścitsamudayaissadayaissāvadhānaṃ sūkṣmayā dṛśā vibhāvanīyaḥ || yathāvā pradadāti nirupasargassvajuṣe viśa ātmane padaṃ devaḥ | sa ca tatra niviśamāno bhavati parasmai padāya yo'bhyarhet || 854 || atra prakṛtasya brahmajuṣo manujasya aprakṛtasya viśadhātośca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi yaḥ pumān parasmai padāya paramaṃ sthānaṃ prāptuṃ 'kriyārtha' ityādinā caturthī | abhyarhet yogyo bhavet | tasmai svajuṣe ātmānaṃ sevamānāya viśe manujaśarīrakāya ātmane cetanāya | śarīravācakānāṃ śabdānāṃ śarīriparyantatāyā ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyasiddhatayā viśe ātmane ityanayossāmānādhikaraṇyam | 'dvau viśau vaiśyamanujau' ityamaraḥ | devaḥ bhagavān nirupasargaḥ iyatpadametasmai kathaṃ deyamityudvegaṃ dūrataḥ pariharanniti bhāvaḥ | padaṃ tadarhaṃ divyaṃ sthānaṃ pradadāti | sa ca sa pumānapi tatra parasmin pade niviśamāno bhavati | bhagavadanugṛhītaniravadhikaniśśreyasasāmrājyastatraiva tatkaiṃkaryaikaratirvasatīti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe yaḥ ‘viśa praveśane' iti paṭhito dhātuḥ parasmaipadāya ‘laḥ parasmaipadam' iti vihitāya parasmaipadasaṃjñakāya lādeśāya abhyarhet yogyassyāt viśadhātoḥ parasmaipadiṣu paṭhitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | tasmai svajuṣe svasamabhivyāhārabhāje viśe viśadhātave devaḥ devayati dhātvarthaṃ dyotayatīti devaḥ dīvyaterṇijantātpacādyac upasargāṇāṃ dyotakatvāddeva ityuktiḥ | niḥ nītyākārakaḥ upasargaḥ ‘upasargāḥ kriyāyoge' ityanuśiṣṭo nipātaviśeṣaḥ | ātmanepadaṃ ‘taṅānāvātmanepadam' iti vihitaṃ śānajākhyamātmanepadasaṃjñakaṃ pratyayaṃ pradadāti ‘nerviśaḥ' ityanena nītyupasargātparībhūtasya viśaterātmanepadānuśāsanāttasya taddattatvopacāraḥ | sa ca nītyupasargaviśiṣṭo viśadhāturapi | tatra tasminnātmanepade pare satīti śeṣaḥ | niviśamāno bhavati tathā niṣpadyate | nisargataḥ parasmaipadī viśadhāturnītyupasargātparatve uktaprakāreṇātmanepaditāṃ prapadya niviśamāna iti niṣpadyata iti nirgalito'rthaḥ | asminpakṣe ātmanepadaṃ parasmaipadāyetyatra ‘vaiyākaraṇākhyāyāṃ caturthyāḥ' iti ‘parasya ca' iti sūtrābhyāṃ caturthyā alugiti dhyeyam || yathāvā nāthapadadvayasevī nirsagatassvairamadhidharaṇirājaḥ | paramānamataṃ dhatte caṭulassthāne tathā sadādeśam || atra bhagavaccaraṇasevino rājādhirājasya rājṛdhātośca prakṛtāprakṛtayośśleṣaḥ | tathāhi nisargataḥ na tu parapreraṇayā | svairaṃ svacchandaṃ yathā syāttathā na tu saṃkucitaṃ nāthasya veṅkaṭanāthasya padadvayasevī caraṇayugaṃ sevamānaḥ adhidharaṇirājaḥ adhiko dharaṇirājaḥ rājādhirāja ityarthaḥ | caṭulaḥ caṭavaḥ stutayaḥ asya santīti caṭulaḥ | sidhmādiṣu caṭuśabdapāṭhāt ‘sidhmādiṣu ca' iti matvarthīyo lacpratyayaḥ | caṭūn lāti ādatta iti vā 'āto'nupasarge' iti kapratyayaḥ | ‘caṭuścāṭuśca rājādistutau paśupicaṇḍake' iti vaijayantī | ślāghyassannityarthaḥ | yadvā acaṭula iticchedaḥ | acapalassannityarthaḥ | ‘madena kiṃciccaṭulālasānām' ityatra ‘caṭulāścapalāḥ' iti mallināthena vyākhyātatvāt | sthāne rājye ityarthaḥ | sthitassannityadhyāhāraḥ | deśaṃ janapadaṃ paramānamataṃ pareṇa utkṛṣṭena mānena gauraveṇa mataṃ saṃmataṃ yathā syāttathā sadā satataṃ tathā anirvacanīyaṃ yathā syāttathetyarthaḥ | dhatte puṣṇāti | yadvā sadādeśamiti samastaṃ padam | paramānamataṃ paraiśśatrubhirapi mānena gauraveṇa mataṃ abhimataṃ santaṃ yathāvidhi prayuktatayā praśastaṃ ādeśaṃ śāsanaṃ dhatte puṣṇāti | athavā satāṃ ādeśaṃ ājñāṃ paramānamataṃ mahatā pūjanena viditaṃ yathā syāttathā dhatte sajjanādiṣṭena pathā sabahumānamādhirājyaṃ puṣṇātīti bhāvaḥ | yadvā sthāne iti yuktārthakamedantamavyayaṃ pṛthakpadamante yojyam | sadādeśaṃ dhatte sthāne | bhagavaccaraṇayugalasevinaḥ idaṃ yuktamityabhiprāyaḥ | anyatsamānameva || pakṣe he nātheti saṃbuddhiḥ | adhidharaṇīti pṛthakpadam | vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ, bhuvītyarthaḥ | rājaḥ ‘rājṛ dīptau' ityukto dhātuḥ śapā nirdeśo'yam | nisargata eva na tu yagādisamabhivyāhārāt svairaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ padadvayasevī ubhayapadītyarthaḥ | svaritettvānuśāsanena kriyāphalasya kartṛgāmitvavivakṣāyāmātmanepadaṃ paragāmitvavivakṣāyāṃ parasmaipadaṃ ca bhajamāna iti bhāvaḥ | ata eva caṭu ślāghyaṃ yathā syāttathā paraṃ svasmātparato vidyamānaṃ lasthāne laṭassthāne | ānaṃ ataṃ iticchedaḥ| ānaṃ atamiti muktānubandhayośśānacśatrorgrahaṇam | ānaṃ ātmanepaditve śānacaṃ ataṃ parasmaipaditve śatari ca ‘laṭaśśatṛśānacau' iti tayoranuśāsanāditi bhāvaḥ | sadādeśaṃ satsaṃjñakamādeśaṃ ‘tau sat' iti lādeśayośśatṛśānacossatsaṃjñāvidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | dhatte dadhāti | rājṛdhātussvaritatvenobhayapaditayā svabhāvasiddhayā yathepsitaṃ lasthānikaṃ śānacaṃ śatāraṃ ca satsaṃjñakamādeśaṃ labhata iti saṃpiṇḍito'rthaḥ || yathavā itaretarayogojjvalamubhayapadārthapradhānatāmadhuram | bhagavadrūpaṃ dvaṃdvaṃ bhajāmahe'nantagirikṛtotkarṣam ||855 atra lakṣmīnārāyaṇarūpadivyamithunasya prakṛtasya dvaṃdvasamāsasyāprakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi itaretarayogojjvalaṃ tulyaśīlavayovṛttāṃ tulyābhijanalakṣaṇām | rāghavo'rhati vaidehīṃ taṃ ceyamasitekṣaṇā || ityādyuktarītyā parasparasaṃbandhena parasparaṃ prāptaparabhāgamityarthaḥ | yadvā anyonyamavinābhāvena labdhasattākamityarthaḥ | yathoktaṃ lakṣmītantre ahantā brāhmaṇastasya sā'hamasmi sanātanī | ātmā sa sarvabhūtānāmahaṃbhūto hariḥ smṛtaḥ | ahaṃtā sarvabhūtānāṃ sā'hamasmi sanātanī || ahaṃtayā samākranto hyahamarthaḥ prasiddhyati || ahamarthasamutthā ca sā'hantā parikīrtitā | anyonyenāvinābhāvādanyonyena samanvayāt || tādātmyaṃ viddhi saṃbandhaṃ mama nāthasya cobhayoḥ || ityādi | pakṣe ‘cārthe dvaṃdvaḥ' ityanuśiṣṭasamuccayānvācayetaretarayogasamāhārarūpacārthacatuṣṭayamadhye itaretarayogalakṣaṇārthaviśeṣe ujjvalaṃ sāmarthyasadbhāvena samastatayā prakāśamānam || idamatrāvadheyam īśvaraṃ guruṃ ca bhajeti samuccaye, bhikṣāmaṭagāṃ cānayetyanvācaye ca na samāsaḥ, ekārthībhāvarūpasāmarthyavirahāt | tathāhi bahuvrīhighaṭakapadānāṃ karmādyantarbhāveṇeva dvaṃdvaghaṭakapadānāṃ cārthāntarbhāveṇaikārthībhāva āvaśyakaḥ, ‘samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ' iti paribhāṣitatvāt ‘cārthe dvaṃndvaḥ' ityukteśca | na cetaretarānvaye parasparanirapekṣāṇāmekārthībhāvassaṃbhavati, yena samuccayānvācayāvekārthībhāvāntarbhūtau syātām | ataśca itaretarayoge samāhāre ca parasparasāhityasattvātsamāso bhavati na tu samuccayānvācayayoḥ| paraṃ tvitaretarayoge sāhityaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ dravyaṃ viśeṣyaṃ, samāhāre tu sāhityaṃ pradhānaṃ dravyaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti vivektavyam | anayorapi sāhityapradhānakasamāhārāpekṣayā vakṣyamāṇarītyā dravyarūpobhayapadārthapradhānaka itaretarayogo jyāyānityāśayenoktamitaretarayogojjvalamitīti || 'parasparanirapekṣasyānekasyaikasminnanvayassamuccayaḥ | anyatarasyānuṣaṅgikatva anvācayaḥ | militānāmanvaya itaretarayogaḥ | samūhassamāhāraḥ' ityāhuḥ | ubhayapadārthapradhānatāmadhuraṃ ubhau ca tau padārthau lakṣmīnārāyaṇātmakau tayoḥ prādhānyena ubhayavibhūtiśeṣitvavyāpitveśvaratvādau samapradhānatayā ramaṇīyam || asyā mama ca śeṣaṃ hi vibhūtirubhayātmikā | yathā mayā jagadvyāptaṃ svarūpeṇa svabhāvataḥ | tayā vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ niyantrī ca tatheśvarī || ityādīni pramāṇānyatrānusaṃhitāni || pakṣe kriyānvaye vartipadārthayorubhayorapi prādhānyena manoharamityarthaḥ | 'ubhayapadārthapradhāno dvandvaḥ' iti hi prācāṃ pravādaḥ | bhagavatī ca bhagavāṃśca bhagavantau jñānādiṣāḍguṇyapūrṇau bhagavantāviti rūpaṃ yasya tat ubhayorapyuktaguṇaparipūrtestathoktiḥ | dvaṃdvaṃ mithunam | pakṣe samāseṣu pradhānabhūtabhagavadvibhūtitayā parigaṇitaṃ dvaṃdvasamāsamityarthaḥ | 'dvaṃdvassāmāsikasya ca' iti vibhūtivistarādhyāye gānāditi bhāvaḥ | bhagavadvibhūtitvādeva dvaṃdvasyātra bhagavadrūpatoktiḥ | ‘sāmāsikaḥ samāsasamūhaḥ | tasya madhye dvaṃdvasamāso'ham | sa hi pūrvottarānyapadārthapradhānebhyo'vyayībhāvatatpuruṣabahuvrīhibhyo'pyubhayapadārthapradhānatayotkṛṣṭaḥ' iti bhāṣyatātparyacandrikayosspaṣṭam | etadabhiprāyeṇaiva hyatrobhayapadārthapradhānatāmadhuramityuktam | dvaṃdvaṃ punarviśinaṣṭy anantagirikṛtotkarṣamiti | śeṣācale labdhotkarṣamityarthaḥ | pakṣe anantagiri patañjalivāci mahābhāṣye labdhotkarṣam | atra anantasya bhagavato vāsudevasya giri gītārūpāyāṃ vāci kṛtotkarṣaṃ udāhṛtapramāṇānusāreṇotkarṣitaṃ, ata eva bhagavadrūpamityapyartho'nusandheyaḥ | bhajāmahe || yathavā nanu cetastatpuruṣepūrve tvāṃ nyastavān samāse'ham | paśyāmīha na tulyaṃ paratra tulyaṃ pade paramavaimi || 856 || atra kavinā svacetasaḥ ktvāpratyayasya ca śleṣo varṇyate tathāhi nanu ceta! he hṛdaya! ahaṃ tvāṃ pūrve akhilajagatkāraṇe | sa cāsau puruṣastatpuruṣaḥ tasmin sarveśvaratvādinā sakalalokavidite paramapuruṣe nyastavān vinyastātmarakṣābharassanniti yāvat | samāse samyagupaviśāmi nirbharatayā sukhī saṃvṛtto'smītyarthaḥ | saṃpūrvakādāseḥ kartari laḍuttamaikavacanam | ata eva iha asmin loke tulyaṃ mama samaṃ janaṃ kamapi na paśyāmi || satkarmaniratāśśuddhāssāṃkhyayogavidastathā | nārhanti śaraṇasthasya kalāṃ koṭitamīmapi || ityādipramāṇāditi bhāvaḥ | paratra pade parasmin pade tu paraṃ 'brahmavidāpnoti param' iti śrutaṃ paramapuruṣameva tulyaṃ mama sadṛśaṃ avaimi jānāmi 'nirañjanaḥ paramaṃ sāmyamupaiti' iti śrutyā paramasāmyasyāveditatvāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe nanu ca itaḥ iti chedaḥ | itaḥ asmin buddhisthe sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ | apūrve nañpūrve ityarthaḥ | akāreṇa luptanakārasya naño vivakṣā | tatpuruṣe ca tatpuruṣasaṃjñake ca samāse na tu yasminkasmiṃścitsamāse, ahaṃ tvāṃ tvāmityutsṛṣṭānubandhasya ktvāpratyayasya grahaṇam, ‘ānemuk' ityādau śānajāderiveti bhāvaḥ | ktvāpratyayamityarthaḥ | nyastavān san iha asmin ktvāpratyaye tatsthāne ityarthaḥ | na tu lyaṃ iti padatrayam | lyaṃ lyamityutsṛṣṭānubandhasya lyapo nirdeśaḥ 'matau bahvacaḥ' ityādau matuvāderiveti bhāvaḥ | na tu paśyāmi naiva paśyāmi ‘samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyapa' ityanañpūrvasamāsa eva ktvo lyabvidhānāt akṛtvetyādau nañsamāse lyapo'darśanāditi bhāvaḥ | paratra pade nañatiriktaśabdapūrvakasamāsasthale tu lyaṃ avaimi 'alaṃkṛtya namaskṛtya' ityādau lyapo darśanāditi bhāvaḥ | yathāvā kalpāntagatatve'pi hrasvāntatvaṃ śriyo na lakṣmyāssyāt | bhāntyapi vā'nte hrasvā niyataṃ bahvītarapprasaktā sā || 857 || atra lakṣmīgatāyāḥ tatkaṭākṣalabdhāyā vā saṃpadaḥ prakṛtāyāḥ śrīlakṣmyādiśabdānāṃ cāprakṛtānāṃ śleṣaḥ | tathāhi lakṣmyāḥ śrīsaṃbandhinyāḥ, lakṣmīkaṭākṣalabdhāyā vā | asminnarthe lakṣmyā iti pañcamī vā | labdheti śeṣaḥ | śriyaḥ saṃpadaḥ | śriyo lakṣmyā iti vā yojanā | arthastu pūrvavadeva | kalpāntagatatve'pi saṃvartasamayabhāktve'pi | hrasvaḥ antaḥ svarūpaṃ yasya tattathoktaṃ, sāmānye napuṃsakaṃ, tasya bhāvaḥ hrasvāntatvaṃ naśvaratvamiti yāvat | ‘antassvarūpe nikaṭe prānte niścalanāśayoḥ' iti hemacandraḥ | ‘anto'strī niścaye nāśe svarūpe'gre'ntike'ntare' iti ratramālā ca | na syāt | lakṣmīsaṃbandhinī tatkaṭākṣalabdhā vā saṃpattiḥ kalpānte'pi na naśvarī syādityabhiprāyaḥ | itarapprasaktā itarāsu devatāsu sthitā itarābhyo devatābhyo labdhā vā ‘sarvanāmno vṛttimātre' itītarāśabdasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ itarapprasaktetyatra pakārasya 'anaci ca' iti dvitvamarthāntare śabdāvairūpyāyāvaśyakam | yadvākalpati kalpapa iva tareti tarapa utsṛṣṭānubandhasya grahaṇe arthāntare'pi pakārasya na dvitvāvaśyakateti bodhyam | sā śrīrityarthaḥ | bahvī bhāntyapivā avimarśāvasare aparicchinnatayā bhāsamānā'pi vā ante nirṇayāvasare hrasvā āśuvināśinīti yāvat | bhavati niyataṃ nūnaṃ bhagavallakṣmyatiriktadevatāsaṃbandhinī tatprasādāsāditā vā saṃpat avimarśadaśāyāmanantatayā bhāsamānā'pi tattvaniṣkarṣasamaye parimitaiva jñāyata iti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe kalpāntagatatve kalpaḥ kalpappratyayaḥ tasya antagatatve svasmātparatrāvasthāne sati | idamupalakṣaṇaṃ tarabādiparakatvasya | apiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ śriya ityatra saṃbadhyate | lakṣmyā lakṣmīśabdasya, arthagatasya strītvasya śabde āropa ityasakṛdavocāma | evamagre'pi | śriyo'pi śrīśabdasya ca | hrasvāntatvaṃ na syāt | yato gharūpakalpabādiparakatve 'nadyāśśeṣasyānyatarasyām' ityaṅyantanadyā ṅyantaikācaśca vihito hrasvavikalpaḥ 'kṛnnadyā na' iti niṣidhyate | lakṣmīśabdaśca kṛnnadyantaḥ ‘lakṣermuṭca' ityauṇādikasūtreṇa lakṣadhātorīpratyayavidhānāt | tasya ca ‘yūstryākhyau nadī' iti nadīsaṃjñakatvāt | śrīśabdastu ‘neyaṅuvaṅsthānāvastrī' iti niṣedhenānadyantatvāttadaviṣaya eva | evaṃca lakṣmīkalpā śrīkalpeti dīrghaghaṭitameva rūpaṃ bhavati, na tu lakṣmikalpā śrikalpeti hrasvaghaṭitam | viśeṣāntaramapyāha bhāntītyādinā | apītyasya apicettharthaḥ | bhāntī bhāntīśabdaḥ tarapprasaktā | tarap tarappratyayaḥ prasakto yasyāṃ sā tathoktā, tarappratyayānteti yāvat | kalpāntagatatve ca ukta evārthaḥ | ante vāhrasvā vikalpena hrasvā syāt hrasvaśabdāt matvarthīyaḥ, arśa ādyac | hrasvāntā bhavedityarthaḥ | ‘ugitaśca' iti gharūpakalpādiparakatve hrasvasya vikalpena vidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | ugidantaścāyaṃ bhāntīśabdaḥ | kiṃca sā bhāṣitapuṃskatvena ṅyantatvenānekāctvena ca prasiddheti bhāvaḥ | bahvī bahvīśabdaḥ taraprasaktā satī kalpāntagatatve vā ante niyataṃ hrasvā syāt nityaṃ hrasvāntā syādityarthaḥ | ‘gharūpakalpacalaḍbruvagotramatahateṣu ṅyonekāco hasvaḥ' ityanena sūtreṇa nityaṃ hrasvavidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | 'bhāṣitapuṃskātparo yo ṅīp tadantasyānekāco'ṅgasya hrasvassyāt gharūpakalpapratyayeṣu pareṣu celaḍādiṣūttarapadeṣu ca' iti sūtrārthaḥ | gheti taraptamapossaṃjñā ‘taraptamapau ghaḥ' iti saṃjñāvidhānāt | evaṃca bhāntīśabdottarapkalpapoḥ parayoḥ hrasvavikalpādbhāntitarā bhāntikalpeti rūpaṃ, hṛsvābhāvapakṣe ‘tasilādiṣu' iti puṃvadbhāvebhāttarā bhātkalpetyevarūpaṃ na tu bhāntītaretyādi | bahvīśabdāttayoḥ parayornityaṃ hrasve bahvitarā bahvikalpeti rūpamityavahitahṛdayaissahṛdayaiśśabdavidagraṇībhirvibhāvanīyam || yathāvā kadaśanabhugasūpagataḥ prāktvatpadavidatha bhavati yo rājā | annantasyāsya punarnasūpaluptaṃ sadā'pi bhavati hare || 858 || he hare! prāk tvaccaraṇaśaraṇāgateḥ pūrvaṃ yaḥ pumān kadaśanaṃ kutsitānnaṃ bhuṅkta iti kadaśanabhuk san asūpagataḥ asubhiḥ prāṇaiḥ upagataḥ asavaḥ upagatāḥ yeneti vā | kadannābhyavahāreṇaiva prāṇān dhārayiteti bhāvaḥ | yadvāsūpagataḥ kadaśanabhugiti yojanā | sūpaṃ gatassūpagataḥ ‘dvitīyā śrita' ityādinā samāsaḥ | sa na bhavatītyamupagataḥ kadaśanabhuk kadannabhoktā bhavati vyañjanādidaviṣṭhayāvanālādigarhyānnabhojī bhavatītyarthaḥ | atha tvatpadavit tava pade caraṇe vindati prāpnotīti tathoktaḥ | tvaccaraṇaprapannassannityarthaḥ | rājā bhavati | tasyāsya ādau kadaśanabhoktuḥ tato bhagavadanugrahādhigatarājabhāvasyetyarthaḥ | annaṃ punaḥ odanaṃ tu sadā'pi na sūpaluptaṃ luptasūpaṃ na bhavati | sūpetyupalakṣaṇamupasecanāntarasyāpi | mṛṣṭānnabhoktṛtvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | annantasyetyatrānusvārasya ‘vā padāntasya' iti vaikalpikaḥ parasavarṇaḥ arthāntare śabdaikarūpyāyeti dhyeyam || pakṣe yaḥ kadaśanabhukchabdaḥ prākchabda tvatpadavicchabdaśca sunā supratyayena upagato na bhavatītyasūpagataḥ bhavatīti pratyekaṃ yojyaṃ ‘halṅyābhyo dīrghātsutisyapṛktaṃ hal' ityanena luptasupratyayo bhavatītyarthaḥ | atha atha ca kiṃcetyarthaḥ | ‘atha samuccaye | maṅgale saṃśayārambhādhikārānantareṣu ca | anvādeśe pratijñāyāṃ paścātsākalyayorapi' iti hemacandraḥ | yo rājā bhavati rājetiśabdā vidyate | annantasya anniti varṇasamudayo'nte yasya tathoktasya asya punaḥ rājanśabdasya tu sadā'pi nityamapi nasūpaluptaṃ na su ityanayorvarṇayoḥ upaluptaṃ lopa ityarthaḥ | lumpaterbhāve ktaḥ | bhavati ‘halṅyābhyaḥ' iti sulopaḥ 'nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' iti nalopaśca bhavatītyarthaḥ | yadvā athetyetannasūpaluptamityatrānveti | sākalyena supratyayanakārayorlopo bhavatītyarthaḥ | asya punarityanena kadaśanabhugādiśabdāpekṣayā vailakṣaṇyaṃ sūcitam | teṣāṃ supratyayamātralopaḥ asya tu nakārasyāpi lopa iti vailakṣaṇyaṃ bodhyam | atra bhagavaccaraṇāravindaprapannasya prakṛtasya kadaśanabhugādiśabdasyāprakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ || yathāvā appratyayo bhavati cetsvayaṃ bhuvi rameśa bhavati bhava eva | kathamaghavato'sya bhāvo vṛddhiṃ prāpto bhavetsādhvīm || 859 || atra bhagavadapratyayitasya puṃsaḥ prakṛtasya appratyayāntasya bhūdhātoraprakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi he rameśa! svayaṃbhuvi kāraṇāntararahite sarvakāraṇabhūte ityarthaḥ | 'prabhurmanīṣī paribhūḥ svayaṃbhūḥ' iti śruteḥ | bhavati tvayi appratyayaḥ aviśvāsaścet bhava eva bhavati | tvayi mahāviśvāsopalakṣitamātmarakṣābharamanarpayitussaṃsāro dustyaja iti bhāvaḥ | yadvā svayaṃbhuvi bhavati apratyayaḥ nañatra virodhe viruddhajñānaṃ nānātvadhīriti yāvat | bhavati cet | bhavatītyuttaravākyādapakṛṣyate | tasya bhava eva saṃsāra eva bhavati | yadeveha tadamutra yadamutra tadanviha | mṛtyossa mṛtyumāpnoti ya iha nāneva paśyati || iti śrutyuktarītyā paramātmani bhedadraṣṭurmṛtyuśabditasaṃsāraprāptireva bhavatītyarthaḥ | "yadeva paramātmatattvamatra loke'hamityanusaṃdhīyamānatayā''tmabhūtaṃ tadeva lokāntarasthānāmapyātmabhūtaṃ, tataścātmabhedo nāstītyarthaḥ | iha paramātmani bhedamiva yaḥ paśyati saḥ saṃsārātsaṃsāraṃ prāpnoti" iti śrutyartho varṇita upaniṣadbhāṣye | aghavataḥ evaṃ viruddhajñānamūlabhūtapāpmavataḥ asya janasya bhāvaḥ sthitiḥ svabhāvaḥ abhiprāyo vā ‘bhāvassattāsvabhāvābhiprāyaceṣṭātmajanmasu' ityamaraḥ | sādhvīṃ parabrahmadhyānaikatānatayā śreyasīṃ vṛddhiṃ prāptaḥ kathaṃ bhavet | yadvā asya sādhvīṃ vṛddhiṃ prāpto bhāvaḥ kathaṃ bhavediti yojanā | sādhvīṃ vṛddhiṃ prāptaḥ aparicchinna iti yāvat | bhāvaḥ vibhūtiḥ nityavibhūtirityarthaḥ | 'bhāvo budhe vibhūtau ca' iti śeṣaḥ | idṛśasyoktavidhaṃ bhāgyaṃ durlabhamiti bhāvaḥ || pakṣe bhuvi bhūdhātau appratyayaḥ ‘ṝdorap' iti vihitaḥ ap ityākārakaḥ pratyayaḥ bhavati cet bhavaḥ svayameva bhavāta bhava iti hetvantaranirapekṣameva niṣpadyata ityarthaḥ | asya bhūdhātoḥ aghavataḥ ghetyutsṛṣṭānubandhasya ghaño grahaṇam | avihitaghañpratyayasya sata ityarthaḥ | sādhvīṃ vṛddhiṃ ‘aco ñṇiti' iti śāstravihitāṃ ñinnimittāṃ vṛddhiṃ prāptaḥ bhāva iti kathaṃ bhavet | ghañabhāve kathamevaṃ rūpaṃ niṣpadyetetyarthaḥ || yathāvā prāyassatvaṃ citte para iha yadyekadāsthito'vasitau | kṛṣṇa tadeva samastaṃ prāyaścittaṃ bhavenna saṃdehaḥ || 860 || atra prastutabhagavaddhyānarūpaprāyaścittasya aprastutaprāyaścittaśabdasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi para ihetyatra paraḥ iha iti chedaḥ | he kṛṣṇa! paraḥ ‘akṣarātparataḥ paraḥ' ityādyuktarītyā sakalacetanavilakṣaṇassarvottaraḥ saḥ || sakṛtsmṛto'pi govindo nṛṇāṃ varṣaśataiścitam | pāparāśiṃ dahatyāśu tūlarāśimivānalaḥ || ityādyuktarītyā sakalalokakaluṣavidhvaṃsanapaṭīyastayā prasiddhaḥ tvaṃ iha asmin loke citte cetasi avasitau | śarīrāvasāne ekadā jātucidapi vā na tu sarvadeti bhāvaḥ | prāyaḥ sāntamavyayaṃ bhūmni ‘prāyo bhūmni' ityavyayeṣvamaraḥ | bahuśa ityarthaḥ | yadi sthitaḥ smṛtaścedityarthaḥ | tadeva tadavasthānameva samastaṃ sarvaṃ prāyaścittaṃ niṣkṛtiḥ bhavet | prāyaścittaśabdaśca rūḍhyā yogena ca pāpanivartanakṣamaṃ dharmamācaṣṭe | prāyaścittaśabdaḥ pāpakṣayārthe naimittikakarmaviśeṣe rūḍha ityāhussāṃpradāyikā nibandhanakṛtaḥ | yogastvaṅgirasā darśitaḥ prāyo nāma tapaḥ proktaṃ cittaṃ niścaya ucyate | tapo niścayasaṃyuktaṃ prāyaścittamihocyate || iti | anuṣṭhitena dvādaśavārṣikādinā avaśyaṃ pāpaṃ nivartata iti viśvāsayuktaṃ vratānuṣṭhānalakṣaṇaṃ tapaḥ prāyaścittamiti tadarthaḥ | smṛtyantareṇa cāyaṃ niruktaḥ prāyaḥ pāpamiti proktaṃ cittaṃ tasya viśodhanam | iti | na saṃdehaḥ nātra saṃśayaḥ | pāpe gurūṇi guruṇi svalpānyalpe ca tadvidaḥ | prāyaścittāni maitreya jagussvāyaṃbhuvādayaḥ || prāyaścittānyaśeṣāṇi tapaḥkarmātmakāni vai | yāni teṣāmaśeṣāṇāṃ kṛṣṇānusmaraṇaṃ param || ityuktaprakriyayā idamevākhilaprāyaścittaṃ bhavedityatra na saṃdegdhavyamiti bhāvaḥ | etatpramāṇapratyabhijñāpanāyaiva atra mūlaśloke kṛṣṇeti saṃbodhanaṃ kṛtamityavagantavyam || pakṣe ekadā samāsavivakṣāyāmityarthaḥ | prāyaḥ prāyaśabdaḥ | adanto'yam | asmin pakṣe para ihetyatra pare iheti chedaḥ | citte cittaśabde pare paratra vidyamāne sati | avasitau avasāne virāme ante ityarthaḥ | ekadā āsthita iti chedaḥ | satvaṃ āsthito yadi samastaṃ samāsaṃ prāptaṃ tadeva prāyaḥ cittamiti padadvayameva prāyaścittaṃ bhavet prāyaścittamiti niṣpadyetetyarthaḥ | ‘prāyasya citticittayoḥ' iti prāyaśabdātparasya cittaśabdasya suḍāgamavidhānāt | yadyapi suḍāgamaścittaśabdādyavayavabhūta eva, 'ādyantau ṭakitau' iti paribhāṣaṇāt | tathā'pi tasya prāyaśabdānte' śravaṇāt prāyaśabdo'vasāne satvamāsthita ityuktam | āgamasakārasya ścutvena śatvam | vastutastu bhāṣye 'prāyasya citticittayossuḍaskāro vā' iti paṭhitatvātprāyaśabdāntyāvayavabhūtasyākārasya askāre prāyaśabda evāvasāne satvamāsthito bhavatīti na pūrvoktakleśo'nusartavyaḥ | askāra iti pratīkamādāya ‘asya sthāne askāraḥ askāraḥ śakandhvāditvātpararūpam' iti kaiyaṭena vivṛtam | asya prāyaśabdāntyasya hrasvākārasya askāraḥ asitikaraṇaṃ sa eva askāraḥ | a askāra ityatra savarṇadīrghamāśaṅkya śakandhvāditvātpararūpamityuktamiti kaiyaṭagranthābhiprāyaḥ || yathāvā cittaṃ paraṃ prapadya prāyaścittī bubhūṣati tarāṃ yaḥ | prāyeṇānte sayujā pūrvaṃ svantena tena bhavitavyam || atra bhagavatprapitsucetanasya prakṛtasya cittaśabdasyāprakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ | cit taṃ iticchedaḥ | yaḥ cit cetanaḥ taṃ 'ahaṃ tvā sarvapāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi' ityādinā śaraṇāgata janasakalakaluṣanirdhūnanakṛtapratijñatayā prasiddham | paraṃ brahmavidāpnoti param' iti brahmavitprāpyatayā śrutaṃ paramātmānaṃ prapadya śaraṇamupetya prāyaścittī bubhūṣati tarāṃ atiśayena prāyaścittavānbhavitumicchati | ‘anādernissīmno duritajaladheryannirupamaṃ viduḥ prāyaścittaṃ raghuyadudhurīṇāśayavidaḥ' iti prapadanasya nirupamaprāyaścittatvokteriti bhāvaḥ | pūrvaṃ ādau svantena śobhanaḥ anto niścayo yasya tathoktena dṛḍhaniścayenetyarthaḥ | bṛhaspatipramukhairapyakampanīyamahāviśvāsaśālineti bhāvaḥ | 'anto'strī niścaya nāśe svarūpe'gre'ntike'ntare' iti ratnamālā | tena cetanena ante dehāvasāne sayujā śaraṇyasamānāpahatapāpmatvādiguṇakenetyarthaḥ | ‘yujyata iti yukchabdo guṇaparaḥ | dharmiṇi hi guṇassaṃbadhyate | samānaguṇakassayuk' iti mahāsiddhānte vyāsāryāḥ | yadvā ekasmin saprakārakabrahmarūpabhogye bhoktṛtvena brahmaṇā saha yujyata iti sayuk tena tathoktena prāyeṇa bhavitavyam | nātra sandegdhavyamiti bhāvaḥ 'so'śnute sarvānkāmānsaha | brahmaṇā vipaścitā' iti śrutyartho'trānusandheyaḥ || nanvevaṃ sāyujyaśabdasya sārṣṭitāśabdasya ca ‘etāsāmeva devatānā m̐ sāyujya m̐ sārṣṭitām' ityādiśrutiṣu sahaprayogo'nucitassyāt ārṣṭirhyaśanaṃ bhoga iti samānārthakatvādubhayoriti ceducyate | sāyujyaṃ nāma ubhayorbhoktavye viśeṣābhāvaḥ | sārṣṭistu bhogasya taratamabhāvābhāvaḥ | yathā'nugṛhītaṃ paripūrṇabrahmānubhavādhikāre śrīmadācāryaiḥ sāyujyamubhayoratra bhoktavyasyāviśiṣṭatā | sārṣṭitā tatra bhogasya tāratamyavihīnatā || iti | anyatra yaḥ prāyaśabdaḥ paraṃ paratra vidyamānaṃ cittaṃ cittaśabdaṃ prapadya prāpya prāyaścittī bubhūṣati tarāṃ samastatayā prāyaścittaśabdo bhavitumicchati tarām | pūrvaṃ svantena suśabdassubupalakṣakaḥ vigrahadaśāyāṃ śrūyamāṇasubanteneti yāvat | tena prāyeṇa prāyaśabdena ante sayujā savarṇayuktena bhavitavyaṃ na tu prāya ityavyayena, tasya 'avyayādāpsupaḥ' iti sublopavidhānena sarvadā'pyaśrūyamāṇasubvibhaktikatvāt, svata eva sāntatayā ante sayujeti vidhānasyānāvaśyakatvācca | ‘prāyasya citticittayoḥ' iti prāyaśabdasyaiva hyaskāro vidhīyate | svatassiddhe'pi prāyaśabdasya subantatve svanteneti viśeṣaṇamuktaviśeṣārthadyotanāyaiveti dhyeyam | anyatsarvamavyavahitapūrvodāharaṇe nirūpitam || yathāvā jñeyassa satpadavidāmādeśo bhavati pūrvaparayoryaḥ| eko yenāśrutamapi sarvaṃ spaṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ bhavati || atra sarvapraśāsituḥ paramātmanaḥ prakṛtasya śabdaśāstrīyaikādeśasyāprakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi saḥ vakṣyamāṇaḥ aśrutaśrutatvakāraṇabhūta ādeśaḥ satpadavidāṃ ‘sadeva somyedam' iti śrutasadvastuvetṝṇāṃ 'padaṃ vyavasitatrāṇasthānalakṣmāṅghrivastuṣu' ityamaraḥ | jñeyaḥ jñātuṃ śakyaḥ | ādeśasacchabdayorekārthakatvāditi bhāvaḥ | jñeya iti jñādhātuprayogeṇa sadvidyopasaṃhāragataṃ ‘taddhāsya vijijñau' ityetatpratyabhijñāpyate | sadvidyāgatārthapratipādakatvādasya padyasya | yadvā satpadavidāṃ satāṃ brahmavidāṃ padaṃ sthānaṃ pādaṃ vā vindanti prāpnuvantīti tathoktāḥ teṣāṃ, vindateḥ kvip | brahmavidācāryopasadanaśālināmevetyarthaḥ | ‘sarvaṃ vākyaṃ sāvadhāraṇam' iti nyāyāt | saḥ pūrvoktaprakāra ādeśaḥ jñeyaḥ na tu kevalāparavidyāvidāmanūcānamānināṃ stabdhānāmiti bhāvaḥ | idaṃ ca śvetaketurnāmoddālakasya putro dvādaśavarṣāṇi gurukule vasannadhigatasāṅgavedo mahāmanā anūcānamānī stabdho'bhyetya brahmavidagresarasyoddālakasya nijapitussaṃnidhiṃ tena ca ‘yannu somyedaṃ mahāmanā anūcānamānī stabdho'syuta tamādeśamaprākṣyo yenāśrutaṃ śrutaṃ bhavati' iti pṛṣṭastadaparijñānena vigalitacittasamunnatistadupasadanenaiva tādṛśamādeśaṃ jñātavānnatvanyathetyetadabhisaṃdhāyoktamityavagantavyam | ādeśameva viśinaṣṭi bhavatītyādinā | yaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ pūrvasya caturmukhādeḥ parasya arvācīnasyāsmadādeśca ekaḥ advitīyaḥ ādeśaḥ ādiśyate'nenetyādeśaḥ ādeṣṭā praśāstā bhavati | ‘etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane gārgi sūryācandramasau vidhṛtau tiṣṭhataḥ | antaḥ praviṣṭaśśāstā janānā m̐ sarvātmā | ekaśśāstā na dvitīyo'sti śāstā | śāstā viṣṇuraśeṣasya | praśāsitāraṃ sarveṣām' ityādipramāṇāt | āṅpūrvakāddiśeḥ karaṇe ghañ, 'akartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām' ityanuśāsanāt | na ca vivakṣitādeśakartṛtvarūpārthavirodhaśśaṅkyaḥ ‘vivakṣātaḥ kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiḥ' itiśābdikoktanayātkartaryeva karaṇāntaranairapekṣyeṇa sādhakatamatvavivakṣayā tathā prayogopapatteḥ | ādeśameva viśinaṣṭi yeneti | yena śruteneti yāvat | aśrutamapi sarvaṃ spaṣṭaṃ yathā syāttathā śrutaṃ bhavati | idamupalakṣaṇaṃ śrutena matena vijñātena aśrutamamatamavijñātaṃ śrutaṃ mataṃ vijñātaṃ bhavatītyasya | atra ‘uta tamādeśamaprākṣyo yenāśrutaṃ śrutam' iti sadvidyāvākyārthassarvo'pi pratyabhijñāpitaḥ | atra ‘yenāśrutaṃ śrutaṃ bhavati' ityatra ‘kasminnu bhagavo vijñāte sarvamidaṃ vijñātaṃ bhavati, ātmani khalvare dṛṣṭe śrute mate vijñāte idaṃ sarvaṃ viditaṃ bhavati' iti muṇḍakabṛhadāraṇyakavākyānurodhena yena śrutenetyādyartho varṇitaḥ | yenāśrutaṃ śrutamityanena upādānatvaṃ praśāsitṛtvārthakādeśaśabdena cātmasvarūpamuktam | tathācātmabhūtamupādānaṃ sadvidyāvedyamiti niṣpannorthaḥ | anyatsarvaṃ sugamaṃ brahmamīmāṃsāvidāmityalaṃ prapañcena || pakṣe satpadavidāṃ sādhuśabdaśāstravetṝṇāṃ saḥ jñeyaḥ | yaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ ekaḥ ādeśaḥ bhavati ‘ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ' ityadhikāravihitaḥ 'ādguṇaḥ' | vṛddhireci | akassavarṇe dīrghaḥ' iti guṇavṛddhisavarṇadīrghādirekādeśo vidyate | yena uktavidhenādeśena aśrutamapi asaṃhitāvasthāyāṃ ādeśātpūrvaṃ aprāptaśravaṇamapi okāraukārākārādi spaṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ bhavati saṃhitāyāṃ vivakṣitāyāṃ prāptaśravaṇaṃ bhavati | yathā upendra iti sthite guṇādeśavidhānātprāgaśruta ekāraḥ tadādeśavidhānānantaraṃ śrūyate | yathāca kṛṣṇa ekatvamiti sthite aśrūyamāṇa aikāro vṛddhyādeśavidhānānantaraṃ śrūyate | yathā cātraiva padye yena aśrutamityavasthāyāmaśruta ākāraḥ ādeśavidhānānantaraṃ śrūyata ityādi draṣṭavyam || yathāvā iha tatpuruṣe'jādāvuttarapada eva sati sadā'dhipatau | anuśāsanena bhāyātkadadhipatiḥ koḥ kadā deśe || 863 || atra paramapuruṣasya śrīnivāsasya prakṛtasya kadadhipatirūpatatpuruṣasya cāprakṛtasya śleṣaḥ | tathāhi ajādau ajasya sraṣṭṛtayā prakhyātasya brahmaṇo'pyādau kāraṇabhūte adhipatau ‘eṣa bhūtādhipatiḥ' ityādiśrute nirupādhikasarvalokeśvare | yadvā ajādau adhipatau caturmukhāderīśvare 'svāmīśvarādhipati' ityādinā adhipatiśabdayogena ajādāvityatra saptamī | sa cāsau puruṣaśca tatpuruṣaḥ | tasmin ‘yo'syādhyakṣaḥ parame vyoman' iti śrutaparamavyomanilayatayā prasiddhe ‘puruṣa eveda m̐ sarvam' iti sarvajagaccharīrakatayā śrute śrīnivāse iha asmin śeṣācalarūpe uttarapade uttame sthāne sadā na tu yadākadācit satyeva vidyamāna eva koḥ bhuvaḥ ‘gotrā kuḥ pṛthivī' ityamaraḥ | deśe pradeśe kadadhipatiḥ kutsito'dhipatiḥ ākālikāpekṣikaiśvaryavattayā kutsanaviṣaya īśvaraṃmanyo'nya iti bhāvaḥ | anuśāsanena praśāsitṛtvena kadā bhāyāt | sarveśvareśvare sarvapraśāsitari śrīnivāse śeṣādrau dedīpyamānavaibhave sati bhuvi mitaṃpacaiśvaryaḥ ko'pi praśāstṛtayā na kadā'pi bhāyāditi bhāvaḥ || anyatra tatpuruṣe, evetyetadihānveti | tatpuruṣasamāse vivakṣita eva na tu bahuvrīhāviti bhāvaḥ | tena kūṣṭro rājetyādau vakṣyamāṇaḥ kadādeśo na bhavatīti dhyeyam | ajādau ajvarṇādau adhipatau adhipatiśabde | ajādāviti viśeṣaṇaṃ vastusvarūpakathanamātraparaṃ adhipatiśabdasyājāditāyāḥ sphuṭatvāt | uttarapade sati anuśāsanena koḥ kadityādipadaiḥ pratyabhijñāpitena ‘koḥ kattatpuruṣe'ci' iti sūtreṇa | koḥ kuśabdasya uttarapadena pūrvapadasyākṣepātpūrvapadabhūtasyetyarthaḥ | kadādeśe kadityādeśe sati sadā nityatayetyarthaḥ | kadadhipatiḥ bhāyāt | kadadhipatiriti niṣpadyetetyarthaḥ | uktasūtreṇa kadādeśasya nityatayā vidhānāditi bhāvaḥ || yathāvā eko gotre niyamādāpatyapratyayaḥ kutaśśaurau | notpadyeta tadānīmanyapratyayaparamparā'niṣṭā || 864 atra bhagavadviṣayadhyānasya prakṛtasya gotrāpatyapratyayasyāprakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi gāḥ trāyata iti gotraḥ gopālaḥ 'āto'nupasarge' iti kaḥ | tasmin śaurau bhagavati vāsudeve āpatya ādṛtyeti yāvat | yadeti śeṣaḥ | āṅpūrvakātpateḥ ktvo lyap | niyamāt ekaḥ pratyayaḥ avicchinnasmṛtisaṃtatiḥ kṛtaḥ | tadānīṃ aniṣṭā bhayahetutayā hānipradā anyapratyayaparamparā vijātīyapratyayadhārā notpadyeta | vijātīyapratyayānantaritatvameva hi smṛtisaṃtateravicchedaḥ | aniṣṭetyanena 'yadā hyevaiṣa etasminnudaramantaraṃ kurute | atha tasya bhayaṃ bhavati | tattveva bhayaṃ viduṣo'manvānasya' iti śrutyarthassūcyate | tathāhi tadarthaḥ eṣa upāsakaḥ etasmin paramātmani dhyānasya antaraṃ vicchedaṃ araṃ alpamapi yaḥ kurute tasya bhayamudbhavati, viduṣo brahmopāsananiṣṭhasya tadatiriktaviṣayaspṛhayā nirantaraṃ mananamakurvataḥ tadeva amananaṃ bhayaṃ, na hi tadapekṣayā'nyadbhayamasti | uktaṃ ca maharṣibhiḥ yanmuhūrtaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vā'pi vāsudevo na cintyate | sā hānistanmahacchidraṃ sā bhrāntissā ca vikriyā || ityādīti | ‘hāniḥ iṣṭahāniḥ, chidraṃ aniṣṭaprāptirandhraṃ, bhrāntiḥ tatkṛtacittaskhalanaṃ, vikriyā tenāṅgānāmavaśādayathāyathavyāpāraḥ' iti vyāsāryāḥ | pakṣe gotre ‘apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram' ityukte apatyatvena vivakṣite pautrādigotrarūpārthe niyamāt ‘eko gotre' iti sūtreṇa kṛtāt gotre eka eva pratyayassyāditi niyamāt ekaḥ āpatyapratyayaḥ apatyārthe vihitaḥ pratyayaḥ yadotyadhyāhāraḥ | yadi kṛtaḥ kṛtaścet tadānīṃ śaurau śauriśabde, idamupalaṇamaupagavādīnāṃ śabdānām | aniṣṭā anyapratyayaparaṃparā notpadyeta | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ śūrasya gotrāpatyamityarthe śūraśabdāt ‘bāhvādibhyaśca' ityanena ‘ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇikurubhyaśca' iti vihitāṇapavādake iñi kṛte punaḥ ‘tasyāpatyam' ityaṇ, tataḥ punastasyāpatyamiti iñ, ityādyaniṣṭapratyayaparaṃparā notpadyate | evaṃ upagorgotrāpatye aṇi aupagavaḥ tataḥ ‘ata iñ' iti iñ aupagaviḥ, tataḥ ‘yañiñośca' iti phak aupagavāyana ityādyaniṣṭapratyayaparaṃparā notpadyeta ‘eko gotre' iti niyamāditi | atra gotre svaikonasaṃkhyānāṃ pratyayānāṃ paraṃparā | yadvā svadvyūnasaṃkhyebhyo'niṣṭotpattiḥ prasajyate || apatyaṃ pitureva syāttataḥ prācāmapīti ca | matabhedena taddhānyai sūtrametattathottaram || iti kārikā'rthonusaṃdheyaḥ | iti viśramyate vistarabhayāt || yathāvā yo devejyāśīlassaṃmārṣṭyakhilaṃ grahaṃ pavitreṇa | svakaradhṛtenāsāviha vivakṣitānugrahaikatāno hi || atra apāmārjanoktavarāhanṛsiṃhādibhagavanmantraniṣṭhasya pusaḥ prastutasya yāyajūkasyāprakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi iha asmin loke yaḥ pumān devejyāśīlaḥ devasya bhagavataḥ ijyā japastutyādirūpamārādhanaṃ ‘vāgyajñenārcito devaḥ' iti vāgbhiḥ praśastābhirgamiṣyanpūjitastayā | yadbhaktyā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ stavairarcennarassadā || ityādibhirjapastutyāderārādhanarūpatābhidhānāt | devejyā śīlaṃ svabhāvo yasya sa tathoktaḥ | ‘ijyā strī yāgadānārcāsaṃgeṣu' iti ratnamālā | asau svakaradhṛtena pavitreṇa kuśena jātyekavacanaṃ, 'mārjayetsarvagātrāṇi kuśāgrairdālbhyaśāntikṛt' ityukteḥ | yadvā‘aśeṣatīrthopahṛtāḥ kamaṇḍalornidhāya pāṇāvṛṣiṇā'bhyudīritāḥ ityuktarītyā svahastavinyastena mantrapūtenāmbhasā | dadhikalaśagomayāmbuṣu kuśatāmrabrahmasūtramantreṣu | hemnyarthe ca pavitraṃ triṣu pūte puṃsi śaṃbhupāvakayoḥ || iti ratnamālā | akhilaṃ sakalaṃ grahaṃ ḍākinīpūtanādibhūtaviśeṣaṃ graho'nugrahanirbandhagrahaṇeṣu raṇodyame | sūryādau pūtanādau ca saiṃhikeyoparāgayoḥ || iti medinī | saṃmārṣṭi nirasyatīti yāvat || sadā karālavadano nārasiṃho mahāravaḥ | grahānaśeṣānniśśeṣān karotu jagato hitaḥ || śāntirastu śivaṃ cāstu praṇaṃśyatvasukhaṃ ca yat | vāsudevaśarīrotthaiḥ kuśaissaṃmārjito mayā || ityādyapāmārjanādhyāyoktakrameṇa vārāhanārasiṃhādimahāmantrābhimantritakuśādakamārjanenākhilān grahān praṇudatīti bhāvaḥ | tatra hetumāha vivakṣiteti | hi yasmāt asāvityetadatrāpyanuṣajyate | asau devejyāśīlaḥ pumān vivakṣitānugrahaikatānaḥ vivakṣiteṣu vaktumiṣṭeṣu ādeśakāriṣu vidheyeṣvityarthaḥ | ‘vidheyo vinayagrāhī vacanesthita āśravaḥ' iti hi vidheyaparyāyāḥ paṭhyante | na hi vaktumaniṣṭeṣu janeṣu vivakṣā kasyacidapi bhavati | yo'nugrahaḥ tasmin ekatānaḥ ekāgraḥ 'ekatāno'nanyavṛttirekāgraikāyanāvapi' ityamaraḥ | vidheyajanānugraha evoktarītyā tadīyagrahādisarvāniṣṭanivāraṇe heturiti bhāvaḥ | anena anārādhitagovindā ye narā duḥkhabhāginaḥ | teṣāṃ duḥkhābhitaptānāṃ yatkartavyaṃ dayālubhiḥ|| ityapāmārjanoktapraśne yaddayālutvamapāmārjanaśāntikaraṇahetutayoktaṃ tatsaṃgṛhītam | pakṣe he deva! yaḥ pumān ijyāśīlaḥ yāyajūkaḥ asau svakaradhṛtena pavitreṇa daśāpavitreṇa akhilaṃ grahaṃ homasādhanapātraviśeṣaṃ sarvāngrahānityarthaḥ | saṃmārṣṭi saṃmārjanena saṃskaroti | nanu ‘grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi' iti saṃmārjanakarmaṇo grahasyaikatve śrūyamāṇe'pi kathaṃ sarvān grahān saṃmārṣṭītyuktamityata āha ihetyādi | vivakṣitā nu grahaikatā no hi iticchedaḥ | hi yasmāt iha 'grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi' iti vākye grahaikatā grahasyaikatvaṃ grahagataikatvarūpā saṃkhyā no vivakṣitā | na vivakṣitetyarthaḥ | nu ityetadanunaye 'nu syātpraśne vikalpārthe'pyatītānunayārthayoḥ' iti viśvaḥ | ekatvasyāvivakṣitatvātsarvān grahān saṃmārṣṭīti saṃmārgādhikaraṇokto'rtho'trānusaṃdheyaḥ | ayaṃ ca saṃmārganyāyaḥ jaiminīyadarśane tṛtīyādhyāye mīmāṃsitaḥ | tathāhi jyotiṣṭome ‘daśāpavitreṇa grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi iti śrūyate | tatra saṃśayaḥ kimekasya saṃmārgaḥ kiṃ vā sarveṣāmiti | tadarthaṃ cintā kimatroddeśyagatā saṃkhyā vivakṣitā utāvivakṣiteti | yathā 'paśunā yajeta' ityatra ekatvaśrutibalāduddeśyagatā'pi saṃkhyā vivakṣitā, evamatrāpyuddeśyagatā saṃkhyā vivakṣitā bhavitumarhati | tasmādekasyaiva grahasya saṃmārga iti pūrvapakṣaṃ prāpayya paśoranenaiva vacanena yāgasaṃbandhāvagamādyāgaṃ prati paśorguṇabhūtatvādyāvadguṇaṃ pradhānāvṛttyabhāvātkiyatā paśuneti paricchedakākāṅkṣāyāṃ tatparicchedakatvenaikatvasaṃkhyā saṃbadhyata ityupādeyagatāyāssaṃkhyāyā vivakṣitatvaṃ yuktam | grahāṇāṃ tu vākyāntareṇa yāgasaṃbandhāvagamāt saṃmārgavākye, dvitīyāśrutyā saṃmārgaṃ prati grahasya prādhānyāvagamāt yāvatpratipradhānaṃ guṇasya saṃmārgasyāvartanīyatvāt kiyanto grahāssaṃmārjanīyā ityākāṅkṣāyā anudayāduddeśyagrahagatā saṃkhyā na vivakṣitā | tasmātsarve grahāssaṃmārjanīyā iti siddhāntitam || yathāvā yadi nanu niṣṭhātono yadupatimahilebhavatprapadi bhavati | agrebhavadaśca tadā bhavetprapanno'yamatra ko viśayaḥ || 866 || atra lakṣmīpadāravindaprapannasya prapannaśabdasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi nanu yadupatimahile ! ‘māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja' ityādi vadato bhagavato vallabhe! anena tasyā api tāddharmyaṃ dyotitam | 'nityaṃ taddharmadharmiṇīm' iti hyucyate | bhavatprapadi bhavatyāḥ pādāgre ‘sarvanāmno vṛttimātre' iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ | ‘pādāgraṃ prapadam' ityamaraḥ | niṣṭātaḥ, sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ | tadekatatparatayā taccharaṇavaraṇaikavratatayā vā ‘niṣṭhā tu nāśe niṣpattāvante tātparyayācñayoḥ' iti ratnamālā | ‘niṣṭhotkarṣavyavasthayoḥ | kleśe niṣpattau nāśe'nte nirvāhe yācane vrate' iti hemacandraḥ| anitītyanaḥ prāṇitā ‘ana prāṇane' pacādyac | 'prapannaścātako yadvat, dharmaṃ dhāraya cātakasya kuśalindhārādharaikāntinaḥ' ityādyuktarītyā tvaccaraṇaśaraṇavaraṇaikāntikataikadhāraka ityarthaḥ | yadvā niṣṭhātaḥ prārthanayā | kośastūktaḥ | prārthanāpalakṣitānukūlyamukhāṅgapañcakena anaḥ ujjīvitetyarthaḥ | yadi bhavati tadā ayaṃ prapannaḥ svatantraprapattiniṣṭhaḥ pumān agre prapattyuttaraṃ bhavaṃ janma garbhaprāptiṃ vā dyati avakhaṇḍayatīti bhavadaḥ 'do avakhaṇḍane' asmāt ‘ādeca upadeśe'śiti' iti kṛtātvāt 'āto'nupasarge' iti kaḥ | yadvā agre bhavaṃ dāyatīti bhavadaḥ ‘daipu śodhane' śodhanārthakādasmāddhātoḥ pūrvoktarītyaiva kaḥ punarjanma śodhayati tatsaṃbandhaṃ nirmārṣṭītyarthaḥ | śodhayateḥ 'sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā' ityādau kṣālanārthe prayogadarśanāt | ta ccharīrāvasāna evāsya niśśreyasāvāpternirargalatayā punarbhavaprasakteranavakāśāditi bhāvaḥ | agre bhavadaśceti caśabdena svatantraprapadananiṣṭho'yaṃ ‘prārabdhaṃ paribhujya karmaśakalam' ityuktarītyā'bhyupagataprārabdhaṃ taccharīrāvadhikamevānubhūya ‘prakṣīṇakamāntaraḥ' ityuktaprakriyayā anabhyupagataprārabdhakhaṇḍaphalabhogadaśarīrāntarasaṃbandhaṃ dhunoti | ‘nyāsena kṣapayannanabhyupagataprārabdhakhaṇḍaṃ ca naḥ' ityukteḥ, na tvaṅgaprapadananiṣṭha iva saṃpūrṇaprārabdhakarmaphalabhogārthavidyārambhottarakālikaśarīrāntarāṇyapyanubhavatīti sūcitam | agre bhavada ityasya agre prapattyuttarakṣaṇameva bhavada ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ prapanno'sāvārtaḥ, prāthamikārthapakṣe dṛpta iti vailakṣaṇya bodhyam || pakṣe yadupatimahile'bhavatprapadītyatra abhavaditicchedaḥ | bhavatīti saṃbuddhyantaṃ padam | nanu bhavati! pūjye! yadupatimahile! prapadi prapūrvakapadadhātau niṣṭhātaḥ niṣṭhā ktapratyayaḥ 'ktaktavatū niṣṭhā' ityanuśāsanāt | tasyāḥ yaḥ t ktapratyayasaṃbandhitakāraḥ tasya | halanto'yaṃ śabdaḥ | agrebhavadaśca ktapratyayāpekṣayā pūrvasya dhātvavayavasya dakārasya ca | ayamapi halanta eva | naḥ nādeśo yadyabhavat, tadā ayaṃ śabdaḥ prapannaḥ bhavet prapanna iti niṣpadyeta ‘radābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ pūrvasya ca daḥ' iti rephadakārābhyāṃ parasya niṣṭhātakārasya tatpūrvasyadakārasya ca natvānuśāsanāditi bhāvaḥ | atra ukte'rthe ko viśayaḥ na ko'pi saṃdeha ityarthaḥ || yathāvā upadiśatu hariṃ stautviti na tulopo dṛśyate kadā'pyasmin | nindeti yadi pravadedatohilopaḥ purā bhavatyeva || 867 || atra bhagavadviṣayakastutinindābhyanujñānayossadasatphalakayoḥ prakṛtayoḥ stautu ninda iti tiṅantaśabdayoḥ tulopābhāvahilopavatoraprakṛtayośca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi hariṃ stautu ityupadiśatu janānāmiti śeṣaḥ | asmin upadeṣṭari puruṣe kadā'pi lopaḥ śreyohāniḥ na tu dṛśyate naiva dṛśyate mūḍhān bhagavannutau pravartayiturna kadā'pi kācidapi hānirbhavati | pratyuta śreyo'tiśaya eva ajñānāya tu yo jñānaṃ dadyāddharmopadeśanam | kṛtsnāṃ vā pṛthivīṃ dadyāttena tulyaṃ na tatphalam || ityādyukteḥ | ninda he janeti śeṣaḥ | tvaṃ bhagavantaṃ ninda nindaterloṇmadhyamaikavacanam | iti pravadedyadi ataḥ asmādeva nindāpravartanavacanāt lopaḥ hāniḥ purā bhavedeva nikaṭāgāmyeva avyavahitottaralakṣaṇāgāmyeva bhavati | ‘nikaṭāgāmike purā' ityamaraḥ | asminnarthe ‘śīghraṃ gaccha purā devo varṣati' iti prayogaśca | bhagavannindanapravartayitussadya eva sarvaśreyohāniḥ saṃpadyate iti bhāvaḥ || yo nindetkamalākāntaṃ nindayedvā pṛthagjanaiḥ | na vidmastaṃ mahārāja yastasya nirayo bhavet || ityukteḥ || pakṣe hariṃ stautu ityupadiśatu | asmin stautu iti pade tulopaḥ tuvarṇalopaḥ na dṛśyate | lopavidhāyakaśāstrābhāvāt śrūyata evetyarthaḥ | nindeti pravadedyadi asmin nindetiśabde atohilopaḥ ‘ato heḥ' iti sūtravihito hilopaḥ purā bhavatyeva abhavadevetyarthaḥ | ‘puri luṅcāsme' iti purāśabdayoge bhūte laṭ | loṇmadhyamaikavacanasya sipaḥ ‘serhyapicca' iti hyādeśe ‘ato heḥ' iti ataḥ parasya herluganuśāsanāt | hilopānantarameva hi nindeti rūpaṃ śrūyata iti bhāvaḥ | yathāvā raghuvaradivyakathāmṛtaliḍabhūdyadi bhuvi tadā babhūvaivāyam | ekaḥ puruṣaḥ prathamastathottamo bhavati madhyamo naiveha || 868 || atra bhagavatkathāmṛtāsvādinaḥ puṃsaḥ prakṛtasya bhūdhātorvihitasya liṭo'prakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi bhuvi bhūmau raghuvaradivyakathāmṛtaṃ leḍhīti raghuvaradivyakathāmṛtaliṭ, lihateḥ kvip | abhūdyadi ayaṃ pumān babhūvaiva sattāmalabhataiva ‘bhū sattāyām' iti hi dhātuḥ ‘bhṛśānurakto medhāvī na bhaviṣyati lakṣmaṇaḥ' ityādau sattārthakatā ca prasiddhyati | sattā cātmalābhaḥ | bhagavaddivyakathāmṛtāsvādenaivāsya sattālābho nānyatheti bhāvaḥ | adyatve īdṛśo durlabha iti dyotanāya parokṣabhūtanirdeśaḥ | tameva viśinaṣṭy eka iti | ayamityanuṣajyate | ayamekaḥ puruṣaḥ eka eva pumān ‘sarvaṃ vākyaṃ sāvadhāraṇam' iti nyāyāt iha asmin loke tathā uttamaḥ anirvacanīyatayā uttamaḥ | tathāśabdo'nirvacanīyavācī ‘tathā gatāṃ tām' ityādau tathā darśanāt | ata eva prathamaḥ sarveṣāmagraṇīḥ bhavati madhyamo naiva bhavati kathamīdṛśo madhyamassyāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe divyaṃ kathāmṛtaṃ yasya tasya saṃbuddhiḥ he raghuvara! bhuvi bhūdhātau liṭ 'parokṣe liṭ' iti vihito liṭ abhūdyadi parokṣavṛtterbhūdhātorliḍyadā'bhūt tadā ayaṃ bhūdhātuḥ babhūvaiva | abhūdityanuṣajyate | babhūvetyeva niṣpanno'bhūdityarthaḥ | uktarūpaniṣpatternissaṃdigdhatvadyotanāya bhūtanirdeśaḥ | kimakhilaliṭyapi babhūvetyeva rūpaṃ syādityata ahaika ityādinā | iha asmin bhūdhātau | ayamityanuṣajyate | ayaṃ liṭ ekaḥ ekatvasaṃkhyābodhakaḥ prathamaḥ puruṣaḥ prathamapuruṣaikavacanamiti bhāvaḥ | bhūdhātorliṭastipaḥ 'parasmaipadānāṃ ṇal' ityādinā ṇalādeśe babhūveti niṣpatteḥ | liṭprathamapuruṣaikavacanasyaivedaṃ rūpamiti bhāvaḥ | na kevalametāvadeva | tathā uttamaḥ tadvadeva ekatvabodhaka uttamapuruṣaśca bhavati | mipo ṇalyapi babhūvetyeva rūpaniṣpatteḥ | naiva madhyamo bhavati madhyamapuruṣaikavacanaṃ tu na bhavati | tatra babhūvithetyeva hi rūpaṃ na tu babhūveti || yathāvā sarveṣāṃ varṇānāṃ pratilomānāmutānulomānām | tulyārthado'khilātman sannyāso bhavati hi svaniṣṭhānam || 869 || atra prakṛtasya bhagavati bharanyāsasya aprakṛtasya sannyāsaśabdasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi he akhilātman ! bhagavan ! bhavati tvayi sannyāsaḥ prapadanaṃ, nikṣepāparaparyāyo nyāsaḥ pañcāṅgasaṃyutaḥ | sannyāsastyāga ityuktaśśaraṇāgatirityapi || iti sannyāsaśabdasya prapattiparyāyatokteḥ | svaniṣṭhānāṃ svaśabdassannyāsaparaḥ svasminniṣṭhā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ teṣāṃ prapadanaikāntyabhājāmityarthaḥ | sarveṣāṃ varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇādivarṇacatuṣṭayajānāmiti yāvat | anulomānāṃ anulomajānāṃ uta pratilomānāṃ pratilomajānāṃ vā ‘acpratyanvavapūrvātsāmalomnaḥ' ityubhayatrāpi samāsānto'c | ‘nastaddhite' iti ṭilopaḥ | utkṛṣṭavarṇajātpuṃso'pakṛṣṭavarṇajastriyāṃ jātāḥ anulomajāḥ | apakṛṣṭavarṇajātpuruṣādutkṛṣṭavarṇajastriyāṃ jātāḥ pratilomajāḥ | tathā ca smaryate yājñavalkyena viprānmūrdhāvasikto hi kṣatriyāyāṃ viśasstriyām | ambaṣṭhaśśūdryāṃ niṣādo jātaḥ pāraśavo'pi vā || vaiśyāśūdryostu rājanyānmāhiṣyograu sutau smṛtau | śūdrāyāṃ karaṇo vaiśyādvinnāsveṣa vidhissmṛtaḥ || brāhmaṇyāṃ kṣatriyātsūto vaiśyādvaidehakassmṛtaḥ | śūdrājjātastu caṇḍālassarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ || kṣatriyā māgadhaṃ vaiśyācchūdrātkṣattārameva ca | śūdrādāyogavaṃ vaiśyā janayāmāsa vai sutam || māhiṣyeṇa karaṇyāṃ tu rathakāraḥ prajāyate | asatsantastu vijñeyāḥ pratilomānulomajāḥ || iti | asantaḥ pratilomajāḥ santastvanulomajā iti vijñeyā ityarthaḥ | tulyārthadaḥ samānapuruṣārthadāyī varṇāśramādikakṣyāvibhāgena vinaiva tattadabhīpsitasarvavidhapuruṣārthaprada ityarthaḥ || ananyopāyaśaktasya prāpyecchoradhikāritā | prapattau sarvavarṇānāṃ sātvikatvādiyoginaḥ | sā hi sarvatra sarveṣāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradā | iti bhagavatprapadanasya sarvādhikārikatvasarvapuruṣārthapradatvokteḥ | etadabhiprāyeṇaiva hi mūle bhagavato'khilātmanniti saṃbodhanam || pakṣe sannyāsaḥ sannyāsa iti śabdaḥ | ayaṃ ca samomakārasyānusvāre 'vā padāntasya' iti vaikalpikaparasavarṇe sannyāsa iti dvinakāraka eva grāhyaḥ | anyathā vivakṣitasyānulomapratilomapāṭhayorānupūrvītaulyasya durlabhatvāt | svaniṣṭhānāṃ svasminvidyamānānāṃ sarveṣāṃ varṇānāṃ akṣarāṇāṃ anulomānāṃ pratilomānāṃ vā satāṃ tulyārthadaḥ samānābhidheyabodhako bhavati | bhavatītyetadasminpakṣe tiṅantam | svaniṣṭhavarṇā ānulomyena vā paṭhyantāṃ prātilomyena vā | ubhayathā'pi tulyānupūrvīkatāyā eva darśanādānulomyaprātilomyānādareṇāyaṃ sannyāsa iti śabdastulyārthabodhaka eva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | yathāvā yadivā'krūrasahāyo balavāniha lokapālakendragataḥ | saumyonugraha eko bhavitā'riṣṭasya bhaṅgadassadyaḥ || 870 || atra bhagavadanugrahasya prakṛtasya saumyagrahasyāprakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi akrūrasya akrūrākhyasya sahāyaḥ trāteti yāvat | balavān āśritojjīvanaupayikasāmarthyavān saumyaḥ anugraḥ | anena sukhaniṣevaṇīyatvaṃ dyotitam | lokapālakādīnāṃ indrādīnāmapi indraḥ īśvaraḥ bhagavān ‘eṣa bhūtādhipatireṣa lokapālaḥ' ityanaupādhikalokapālatvaśravaṇāt | taṃ gataḥ prāptaḥ tadīya ityarthaḥ | ekaḥ sahāyāntaranairapekṣyeṇaiva svakartavyasarvakāryanirvoḍhā anugrahaḥ kṛpā iha yadivā bhavitā akrūra iva mayyapi syāccediti bhāvaḥ | ariṣṭasya madīyānādikālapravṛttākṛtyakaraṇakṛtyākaraṇādisarvavidhāśubhasya bhaṅgadaḥ nirmūlayitā sadya eva bhavitā na tu vilambena || tāvadārtistathā vāñchā tāvanmohastathā'sukham | yāvannāyāti śaraṇaṃ tvāmaśeṣāghanāśanam || ityuktanyāyena tvadanugrahāvadhika eva mamāśubhasparśa iti bhāvaḥ || pakṣe budhabhārgavajīvānāmekatamaḥ kendramāgato balavān | krūrasahāyo yadyapi sadyo'riṣṭasya bhaṅgāya || iti bālāriṣṭabhaṅgavādipadyārtho'nusandheyaḥ | tathāhi he lokapāleti bhagavatassaṃbodhanam | saumyaḥ nu grahaḥ iticchedaḥ| saumyaḥ eko grahaḥ budhabhārgavajīvānāmanyatama iti bhāvaḥ | balavān sthānadikkālaceṣṭādibalāḍhyaḥ kendragataḥ lagnacaturthasaptamadaśamānyatamasthānasthitaḥ krūrasahāyaḥ krūrāḥ kujādiduṣṭagrahāḥ sahāyā yasya sa tathoktaḥ yadi vā syāt krūragrahayuto'pi vā sadyaḥ ariṣṭasya bālāriṣṭasya bhaṅgadaḥ bhavitā | kimu tadayukta iti bhāvaḥ | yathavā bhagavanvidho tavaitaissaumyairastāriparibhavasthitibhiḥ | adhiyoge jyotirbhirjātāsseneśasacivabhūpāssyuḥ || 871 || atra bhagavaccandramasoḥ prakṛtāprakṛtayośśleṣaḥ | tathāhi bhagavan! pūrṇaṣāḍguṇya! he vidho! he viṣṇo! ‘vidhurviṣṇau candramasi' ityamaraḥ | saumyaiḥ śubhaiḥ astāriparibhavasthitibhiḥ astā nirastā ariparibhavasya vairikartṛkaparābhavasya sthitiḥ yaistathoktaiḥ nirastāriparibhavā sthitiryeṣāṃ taistathoktairiti vā | parihṛtabāhyāntaravairivargairityarthaḥ | etaiḥ tava jyotirbhiḥ dṛṣṭibhiḥ kaṭākṣairityarthaḥ | ‘jyotirbhadyautadṛṣṭiṣu' ityamaraḥ | ‘jyotiragnau divākare | pumānnapuṃsakaṃ dṛṣṭau syānnakṣatraprakāśayoḥ' iti medinī ca | adhiyoge adhikasaṃbandhe sati jātāḥ janmavanto janāḥ seneśasacivabhūpāḥ camūpatimantrirājānaḥ yathāyogaṃ syuḥ bhagavatkaṭākṣagocarāṇāṃ kiṃ durlabhamiti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe he bhagavan ! he śrīman ! he vidho ! he indo ! tava yatrakvavā rāśau sthitasya taveti bhāvaḥ | astāriparibhavasthitibhiḥ astaṃ saptamo rāśiḥ ariḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ paribhavo'ṣṭamaḥ | 'ṣaṣṭhaṃ kṣatāryāhvayaṃ jāmitrāstakalatramanmathamadadyūnābhidhaṃ saptamam | randhrāyurmaraṇaṃ parābhavamṛtisthānaṃ vadantyaṣṭamam' iti mādhavīyokteḥ | teṣu sthāneṣu sthitiryeṣāṃ taiḥ tathoktaiḥ saumyaiḥ śubhaiḥ budhaguruśukraiḥ jyotirbhiḥ tārāgraheḥ | kośastūktaḥ | adhiyoge sarvaiśśubhagrahairyatrakvavā sthitāccandrāt ṣaṣṭhasaptamāṣṭamarāśivartibhiḥ adhiyogo nāma rājayogaḥ kriyate | tasmin rājayoge jātāḥ janmavantaḥ seneśasacivabhūpāḥ kramātsyuḥ || saumyaissamarārinidhaneṣvadhiyoga indoḥ | tasmiṃścamūpasacivakṣitipālajanma || iti varāhamihirokteriti bhāvaḥ || yathāvā pāmaramapi padalagnaṃ laghu kṛtvā nirmamantatastamapi | paramātmā kavivaryo darśayati janaissudurgamaṃ pāram || 872 || atra bhagavān prastutaḥ kavivaryastvaprastutaḥ | tayoḥ śleṣaḥ | tathāhi kavivaryaḥ kavibhirvidvadbhirvaraṇīyaḥ | yadvā kavīnāṃ vareṇyaḥ, pañcarātragītādipraṇetṛtvāt | ‘kavirmanīṣī' iti śruteḥ | paramātmā 'tasyāśśikhāyā madhye paramātmā' iti śrutassarvāntarātmā nārāyaṇaḥ padalagnaṃ svacaraṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataṃ pāmaramapi prākṛtamapi janaṃ laghu kṣiprameva nirmamaṃ 'mameti dvyakṣaro mṛtyuḥ' ityuktadehādimamatārahitaṃ, mameti vibhaktipratirūpakamavyayaṃ, nirgataṃ mama yasyeti vigrahaḥ | kṛtvā tataḥ nirmamatāhetoḥ tamapi evaṃ kṛtaṃ janamapi | nirmamantata ityatra ‘vā padāntasya' iti parasavarṇaḥ | janaiḥ pāmaraiḥ 'jano loke maharlokātparaloke'pi pāmare' iti medinī | sudurgamaṃ ativeladurlabhaṃ pāraṃ 'tamasaḥ pāraṃ darśayati bhagavān' iti śrutaṃ saṃsārasaṃtamasacaṇḍabhānūyamānopāsanāgācaramātmānaṃ darśayati ‘dṛśeśva' iti dvikarmakatā | niśśreyasabhājaṃ vidadhātīti bhāvaḥ || pakṣe paramaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ ātmā buddhiryasya sa tathoktaḥ | kavivaryaḥ kāvyakṛdagraṇīḥ | padalagnaṃ padeṣu suptiṅantātmakeṣu vyavahriyamāṇeṣu śabdeṣu lagnaṃ anyatamatvena saṃbaddhaṃ pāmaraṃ pāmaraśabdamapi laghu yathātathā, nirmaṃ antata iticchedaḥ | antataḥ madhye ‘anto'strī niścaye nāśe svarūpe'gre'ntike'ntare' iti ratnamālā | nirmaṃ nirgatamakāraṃ kṛtvā pāmaraśabde madhyasthamakāramutsāryetyarthaḥ | janaiḥ sudurgaḥ gantumaśakyaḥ durvijñāna ityarthaḥ | tādṛśo maḥ makāro yasya taṃ tathoktam | makārotsāraṇe punarmakāraśravaṇaṃ kvatyamiti bhāvaḥ | pāraṃ pāraśabdaṃ darśayati, pāmaraśabdamutsāritamakāraṃ pāraṃ santaṃ darśayatītyarthaḥ || yathāvā deveśādhīśassyādvidito jagadīśavallabheyamaveḥ | kimuta sa deśādhīśo dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭaṃ ca vayamihābrūma || atra bhagavatyā śriyā'bhirakṣitasya puṃsaḥ deveśādhīśaśavdasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi he jagadīśavallabhe ! tvaṃ yaṃ aveḥ rakṣeḥ | avaterliṅmadhyamaikavacanam | sa pumān deveśānāṃ lokapālānāmapyadhīśaḥ viditaḥ prasiddhaḥ syāt | deśādhīśaḥ deśānāṃ aihalaukikānāṃ viṣayāṇāṃ 'deśaviṣayau' ityamaraḥ | adhīśaḥ rājā syāditi kimuta kimu vaktavyam | naitadāścaryamiti bhāvaḥ | iha asmiṃstvadrakṣite puṃsi viṣaye dṛṣṭaṃ aihikaṃ phalaṃ deśādhīśatāvāptirūpaṃ adṛṣṭaṃ deveśādhīśatāvāptirūpamāmuṣmikaṃ phalaṃ ceti vaiparītyena yojyam | vayaṃ tvatprabhāvābhijñā iti bhāvaḥ | abrūma avocāma | pakṣe jagadīśavallabhe'yamityatra ayamiti chedaḥ| deveśādhīśaḥ deveśādhīśaśabdaḥ viditassyāt tvayā jñāta eva bhavet | so'yaṃ ukto deveśādhīśaśabda eva aveḥ vekārarahitassan seḥ sayau sayaḥ itivadaveśśabda edantaḥ | deśādhīśassyāt deśādhīśa iti niṣpadyeta | iha anayoḥ deveśādhīśadeśādhīśaśabdayoḥ vayaṃ ve iti varṇaṃ ve iti prātipadikādami ayādeśe sayamitivaddvitīyaikavacanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ deveśādhīśaśabde śrutaṃ adṛṣṭaṃ deśādhīśaśabde aśrutaṃ ca yathākramaṃ abrūmeti | kāvyārthāpattisaṃkīrṇo'yam | evaṃ prāgupadarśite'ṣūdāharaṇeṣu yathāsaṃbhavamalaṃkārāntarasaṃkīrṇatvaṃ pratibhāśālibhirunneyam || yathāvā śrīramyā saikāvalyabhikhyayā bhātyalaṃkṛtiśślāghyā | sādhukṛtārthaśreṇīgṛhītamuktākṛtiryasyāḥ || atra prastutāyāḥ śriyaḥ aprastutayoḥ muktāvalyekāvalyalaṃkārayoścetyarthatrayasya śleṣa iti viśeṣaḥ | tathāhi, śrīpakṣe śrīḥ ramyā sā ekā valyabhikhyayā bhāti alaṃ kṛtiślāghyā sādhu kṛtārthaśreṇī gṛhītamuktākṛtiḥ yasyāḥ iti chedaḥ | valyabhikhyayā valīnāṃ trivalīnāṃ abhikhyayā śobhayā ramyā | ekā apratidvaṃdvā sā śrīḥ alaṃ paryāptaṃ yathā syāttathā kṛtibhiḥ vidvadbhiḥ ślāghyā bhāti | tameva viśinaṣṭi sādhviti | yasyā iti pañcamī | yasyāḥ śriyassakāśāt tadanugrahāditi yāvat | kṛtārthānāṃ anuṣṭhitopāyatayā kṛtakṛtyānāṃ śreṇī paṅktiḥ sādhu yathā syāttathā gṛhītamuktākṛtiḥ upāttamuktasvarūpā bhavatīti || muktāvalīpakṣe tu śrīramyā sā ekāvalyabhikhyayā bhāti alaṃkṛtiḥ ślāghyā sādhu kṛtā arthaśreṇīgṛhītamuktā ākṛtiḥ yasyāḥ itichedaḥ | śriyā lāvaṇyalakṣmyā ramyā ramaṇīyā ślāghyā sā alaṃkṛtiḥ ābharaṇaṃ ekāvalyabhikhyayā ekāvalīnāmnā ‘ekāvalyekayaṣṭikā' ityamaraḥ | bhāti, yasyāḥ ekāvalyākhyālaṃkṛteḥ ākṛtiḥ svarūpaṃ arthaśreṇyā analpena dhanenetyarthaḥ | gṛhītāḥ krītāḥ muktāḥ mauktikāni yasyāssā tathoktā | sādhu yathā syāttathā kṛtā niṣpāditeti || ekāvalyalaṃkārapakṣe tu pūrvārdhe pūrvavadeva chedaḥ | uttarārdhe tu sādhu kṛtā arthaśreṇī gṛhītamuktākṛtiḥ iti viśeṣaḥ | śriyā kāvyalakṣmyā ramyā sā alaṃkṛtiḥ alaṃkāraḥ ekāvalyabhikhyayā tannāmnā ślāghyā satī bhāti | yasyāḥ alaṃkṛteḥ arthānāṃ abhidheyānāṃ śreṇī paṅktiḥ gṛhītamuktā ākṛtiḥ yasyāssā tathoktā | sādhu kṛtā racitā ‘gṛhītamuktarītyā'rthaśreṇirekāvalī matā' iti tallakṣaṇāditi || yathāvā devottamasvarūpāsitabhābhāyātsadātmanibiḍaujāḥ | dyumaṇirnalinadalekṣaṇa iha sutarāṃ śūravikhyātaḥ || 875 || atra prakṛto bhagavān aprakṛtāvindrādityau trayāṇāmeṣāṃ śleṣaḥ | tathāhi, bhagavatpakṣe svarūpāsitabhāḥ svarūpeṇa svabhāvena asitā śyāmalā bhāḥ dīptiryasya sa tathoktaḥ ‘nīlatoyadamadhyasthā, śyāmācchabalaṃ prapadye' ityādiśravaṇāt | sadātmanibiḍaujāḥ satāṃ brahmavidāṃ ātmani manasi | saṃścāsāvātmā ceti karmadhārayo vā | ubhayathā'pi viśuddhe manasītyarthaḥ | nibiḍaujāḥ aviralaprakāśaḥ 'manomayaḥ prāṇaśarīro bhārūpa' iti śāṇḍilyavidyāyāṃ viśuddhamanogrāhyatvabhāsvararūpatvayośśravaṇāt atra na cakṣuṣā gṛhyate nāpi vācā nānyairdevaistapasā karmaṇā vā | jñānaprasādena viśuddhasattvastatastu taṃ paśyate niṣkalaṃ dhyāyamānaḥ || antaśśarīre jyotirmayo hi śubhro yaṃ paśyanti yatayaḥ kṣīṇadoṣāḥ || ityādiśrutayopyanusandheyāḥ | ‘ātmā yatno dhṛtirbuddhissvabhāvo brahma varṣma ca' ityamaraḥ | dyumaṇiḥ divi parame vyomni maṇiriva vidyotamānaḥ ‘atha yadataḥ paro divo jyotirdīpyate' iti śruteḥ | śūra iti vikhyātaḥ ‘śūraśśauriḥ' iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt | yadvā śūraśabdo yaduśabdavattadapatyeṣu lākṣaṇikaḥ | śūreṣu yaduviśeṣeṣu vikhyātaḥ yena sa śaurirityabhidhīyate | dyumaṇiśabdena paratvaṃ śūravikhyātaśabdena saulabhyaṃ ca darśitam | devottamaḥ caturmukhādīnāmapyuttamaḥ ‘yatra devānāmadhideva āste' ityādiśruteḥ | nalinadalekṣaṇaḥ puṇḍarīkapalāśalocanaḥ bhagavān iha asmin loke sutarāṃ bhāyāt || indrapakṣe svarūpāsitabhāḥ svaruṇā vajreṇa ‘śatakoṭissvaruḥ' ityamaraḥ | upāsitā svasminnupaveśitā tena sevitā vā ‘āsa upaveśane' asmāṇṇijantātkarmaṇi ktaḥ | bhāḥ prabhāvo yasya sa tathoktaḥ vajrāyudhonmiṣitaprabhāva ityarthaḥ | ‘bhāḥ prabhāve mayūkhe'strī' iti medinī | dyumaṇiḥ svarlokābharaṇabhūtaḥ 'dyauḥ strī svarge ca gagane' iti medinī | nalinasya sahasrapatrasya dalānīva īkṣaṇāni yasya sa tathoktaḥ sahasrākṣa iti bhāvaḥ | śūraḥ vikrāntaḥ sa cāsau vikhyātaśca vṛtrādimahāsuravadhaprakhyātaśaurya iti bhāvaḥ | devottamaḥ nirjareṣu śreṣṭhaḥ | sadā ātmani biḍaujāḥ iti chedaḥ | biḍaujāḥ indraḥ sutarāṃ ātmani buddhau sadā bhāyāt iti || ādityapakṣe tu svarūpe svākāre āsitā upaveśitā | yadvā svarūpeṇa svabhāvenaiva ā samantāt sitā baddhā bhāḥ dīptiḥ yasmin sa tathoktaḥ | ‘ṣiñ bandhane' karmaṇi ktaḥ| 'mudditaṃ saṃditaṃ sitam' ityamaraḥ | svabhāvato niścaladīptirityarthaḥ | athavā āsitaṃ sthitiḥ āserbhāve ktaḥ svarūpasyāsitaṃ tena bhāsata iti svarūpāsitabhāḥ, bhāsateḥ kvip, svarūpasthityaiva bhāsamāna ityarthaḥ | sadātmanibiḍaujāḥ san svasminvidyamānaḥ ‘satye sādhau vidyamāne praśaste'bhyarhite ca sat' ityamaraḥ | yaḥ ātmā paramapuruṣaḥ 'ya eṣontarāditye hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣaḥ' iti śruteḥ | tena nibiḍaujāḥ ‘na tatra sūryo bhati' ityārabhya ‘tasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ vibhāti' ityādityāditejasāṃ tadupajīvyatvaśravaṇāt | nalinadalekṣaṇaḥ dalayatīti dalaṃ 'dala viśaraṇe' asmāddhātorṇijantātpacādyac | ‘ṇeraniṭi' iti ṇilopaḥ | dalerghaṭādiṣu bhojena paṭhitatayā ‘ghaṭādayo mitaḥ' iti mittvāt ṇicprayuktavṛddhyapavādako ‘mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' iti hṛsvaḥ | nalinānāṃ dalaṃ nalinadalaṃ īkṣaṇaṃ darśanaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ kamalavikāsakadarśana ityarthaḥ | sutarāṃśuḥ ravikhyātaḥ iti chedaḥ | ‘rori' iti rephalope ‘ḍhralope' iti pūrvasyāṇo dīrghassaṃhitāyām | sutarāḥ śobhanatarāḥ aṃśavaḥ kiraṇāḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | suśabdo'tra dravyavācī | atastasmādvihitasya tarapo nāmupratyayaḥ, ‘kimettiṅavyayaghādāmvadravyaprakarṣe' iti pratiṣedhāt | raviriti khyātaḥ ravikhyātaḥ | devottamaḥ 'surottamo dhāmanidhiḥ' iti sūryaparyāyeṣu pāṭhāt | dyumaṇiḥ ādityaḥ iha bhāyāditi | atrārthatrayaśleṣaḥ pūrvavadeva, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavyatyāsastu viśeṣa iti dhyeyam || yathāvā kamalapadāyāvāṇyāvaśago gauryāssadā'pi sādhurateḥ | sumanobhavahāryaja iha nijapadalagnāṃstanoti satkāmān || 876 || atra bhagavān prastutaḥ brahmeśānasmarā aprastutāḥ caturṇāmeṣāṃ śleṣaḥ | tathāhi, bhagavatpakṣe ajaḥ na jāyate smetyajaḥ | bhagavān viṣṇuḥ ‘ajāyamānaḥ' iti śruteḥ | ‘ajaśchāge haribrahmavidhusmaranṛpe hare' iti medinī | gauryāḥ hiraṇyavatpiśaṅgavarṇāyāḥ 'hiraṇyavarṇāṃ, piṅgalāṃ hemamālinīm' ityādiśruteḥ | ‘gauro'ruṇe site pīte' ityamaraḥ | anena lāvaṇyasamṛddhirdyotitā | 'ṣidgaurādibhyaśca' iti ṅīṣ | sadā'pi sādhvī praśastā ratiḥ bhartṛviṣayakānurāgo yasyāssā tasyāḥ, anena prītyatiśaya uktaḥ | ābhyāṃ viśeṣaṇābhyāmanatilaṅghanīyavacanatvaṃ sūcitam | kamalaṃ padaṃ nivāsasthānaṃ yasyāssā kamalapadā tasyāḥ padmālayāyāḥ śriyaḥ | anena saukumāryātiśayo vyajyate | tena ca tatprārthanākaraṇe mlāniśaṅkayā'vaśyopādeyatvaṃ tadvacaso dhvanyate | vāṇyāḥ ‘kimevaṃ nirdoṣaḥ ka iha jagati' ityādyuktaprakārāyāḥ vācaḥ vaśagaḥ vaśyaḥ | ata eva sumanasāṃ viduṣāṃ bhavaṃ saṃsāraṃ haratīti sumanobhavahārī san nije svakīye pade caraṇe sthāne vā lagnān tāneva sumanasa iti bhāvaḥ | satkāmān satyakāmān āvirbhūtakalyāṇaguṇānityarthaḥ | tanoti | anatikramaṇīyaśrīvacanavibhavavivaśo bhagavānniśśeṣāvidyānivartanapūrvakaṃ svāśritānāvirbhūtaguṇāṣṭakānvidadhātīti nirgalito'rthaḥ || caturmukhapakṣe kamalapadāyāḥ nalinamṛdulacaraṇāyāḥ gauryāḥ 'yā kundendutuṣārahāradhavalā' ityuktarītyā viśadavarṇāyāḥ sadā'pi sādhurateḥ sādhuṣu sabhyeṣu vidvatsu ratiḥ prītiḥ yasyāḥ tathoktāyāḥ vāgdevatātvāditi bhāvaḥ | ‘sādhustriṣūcite cārau sabhye vārdhuṣike tu nā' iti ratnamālā | vāṇyāḥ sarasvatyāḥ vaśagaḥ | sumanasi bisaprasūne padme bhavena janmanā 'janmaharau bhavau' ityamaraḥ | hārī manoharaḥ bhagavannābhinalinajanmetyarthaḥ | ajaḥ caturmukhaḥ | nijapadalagnān satyalokagatān satkāmān ramaṇīyabhogyavastuśālinaḥ tanotīti || īśānapakṣe kamalapadāyāḥ padyata iti padā padyateḥ pacādyac | kamalasya kuraṅgasya padā, kamalaḥ kuraṅgaḥ padaṃ cihnaṃ yasyāsseti vā tasyāḥ ubhayathā'pi kuraṅgapāṇerityarthaḥ | ‘syātkuraṅge'pi kamalaḥ, padaṃ vyavasitatrāṇasthānalakṣmāṅghrivastuṣu' iti cāmaraḥ | yadyapi kuraṅgapāṇitvamīśānasyaiva prasiddhyati | tathā'pyumāyāstadardhāṅgatayā taduktiriti dhyeyam | ata eva ‘dīpakamṛgāyamāṇanijahariṇaśāvakānudhāvyamānapārṣṇibhāgau' iti hariṇasyobhayasādhāraṇyoktissaṃgacchate | yadvā kamalāni uttamamahilātvasūcakarekhākārapadmāni pade yasyāsseti | sādhurateḥ ramaṇiyavallabhaprīteḥ | gauryāḥ pārvatyāḥ vāṇyāḥ vācaḥ vaśagaḥ | manobhavaṃ manmathaṃ haratīti manobhavahārī | suṣṭhu manobhavahārī sumanobhavahārī kandarpavairītyarthaḥ | ajaḥ īśānaḥ nijapadalagnān svacaraṇasaktān satkāmān vidyamānamadanān tanotīti virodhaḥ, phalitamanorathāṃstanotīti parihāraḥ || smarapakṣe tu kamalapadāyāḥ aruṇāmbujacaraṇāyā gauryāḥ aruṇavarṇāyāḥ pātivratyena viśuddhāyā vā | ‘gauraḥ pīte'ruṇe śvete viśuddhe cābhidheyavat' iti medinī | rateḥ ratidevyāḥ vāṇyāḥ vācaḥ sādhu yathā syāttathā vaśagaḥ | tadājñāvaśaṃvada ityarthaḥ | suṣṭha manasi citte bhavena janmanā hārī ramyaḥ manasija ityarthaḥ | ajaḥ smaraḥ | kośastūdāhṛta eva | nijapadeṣu svakīyavastuṣu ālambanaguṇādyuddīpanavibhāveṣvityarthaḥ | lagnān abhiṣaktān janān satkāmān ūrjitapreyasīsaṃbhogābhilāṣān tanotīti || yathāvā puṣkalasacchrīlakṣaṇahṛdyo yo bahuvirocanābhikhyaḥ | vidyudbhājayatu harissa vṛtrasaṃhananabhiduravarahetiḥ || 877 || atra bhagavān prastutaḥ indrassūryaścandro vidyutprakāśaścāprastutāḥ | eteṣāṃ pañcānāṃ śleṣa iti pūrvodāharaṇādviśeṣaḥ | tathāhi, bhagavatpakṣe yaḥ hariḥ puṣkale atiśobhane satī ca sacca satī ‘napuṃsakamanapuṃsakenaikavaccāsyānyatarasyām' iti napuṃsakaikaśeṣaḥ | satī abhyarhite ca | śrīśca lakṣaṇaṃ ca śrīlakṣaṇe lakṣmīśrīvatsau hṛdye urassthite yasya saḥ 'śrīmān śreṣṭhaḥ puṣkalassyātsattamaścātiśobhane' ityamaraḥ | ‘satsādhau dhīraśastayoḥ | mānye satye vidyamāne triṣu sādhvyumayoḥ striyām' iti medinī | yadvā puṣkalāni pūrṇāni ‘pūrṇaśreṣṭhau tu puṣkalau' iti ratnamālā | santi praśastāni lakṣaṇāni sāmudrikoktamahāpuruṣatvajñāpakāṅgacihnānvitaiḥ hṛdyaḥ manojñaḥ | yathocyate śrīrāmāyaṇādau tristhirastripralambaśca trisamastriṣu connataḥ | ityādinā | yadvā puṣkalā śrīmatī satī sādhvī ca yā śrīḥ lakṣmīḥ tasyāḥ lakṣaṇaṃ nāmaiva hṛdyaḥ tasyāḥ jagato vā vaśīkāramantro yasya sa tathoktaḥ, hṛdayasya bandhano hṛdya iti vigrahaḥ| ‘bandhane carṣau' iti hṛdayaśabdāt ṣaṣṭhyantādbandhane yatpratyayo vede'bhidheye | hṛdyo vaśīkaraṇamantra ityāhuḥ | ‘nārāyaṇasya kila nityajapastvadīyaṃ nāma pragalbhatamam' ityuktarītyā bhagavato lakṣmīnāma nityajapārhamiti bhāvaḥ | lakṣaṇaṃ kārṣike cihne nāmni mudrāṅgasaṃpadoḥ | hṛdyo vaśikriyāmantre hṛdyaṃ dhadhnyanulepane || hṛtpriye hṛddhite hṛjje.........|| iti ca vaijayantī | athavā puṣkarā satī śrīreva lakṣaṇaṃ jagadīśvaratvajñāpakamudrā hṛdyaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | bahu adhikaṃ virocanaṃ prakāśo yasyāstathoktā abhikhyā kīrtiryasya saḥ bahuvirocanābhikhyaḥ 'tasya nāma mahadyaśaḥ' iti śruteḥ | 'abhikhyā tviḍyaśonāmasu' iti ratnamālā | vṛtrasaṃhananabhiduravarahetiḥ vṛtrāśśatravaḥ teṣāṃ saṃhananāni vapūṃṣi ‘gātraṃ vapussaṃhananam' ityamaraḥ | bhindantīti bhidurāḥ 'vidibhidicchideḥ kurac' iti kurac | vṛtrasaṃhananānāṃ bhidurāḥ ripuvapurbhedinya ityarthaḥ | varāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ hetayaḥ sudarśanādīnyāyudhāni yasya saḥ | 'dhvāntāridānavā vṛtrāḥ| vṛtro meghe ripau dhvānte dānave vāsave girau' ityamarahemacandrau | ‘hetirjvālāṃ'śurāyudham' iti vaijayantī | vidyudbhāḥ vidyuttulyaprakāśaḥ ‘sarve nimeṣā jajñire vidyutaḥ puruṣādadhi' iti śruteḥ | yadvā vit jñānaṃ 'vyavahāravide' ityādāviva videssaṃpadāditvādbhāve kvip | vidā yautīti vidyut | yudhātormiśraṇārthakātkartari kvip | ‘hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk' iti tugāgamaḥ | vidyut bhāḥ tejo yasya saḥ vidyudbhāḥ | jñānānvitatejassaṃpanna ityarthaḥ | atra jñānaśaktibalaiśvaryavīryatejāṃsyaśeṣataḥ || ityukteṣu guṇeṣu pratyāhāranyāyenādyantayorgrahaṇaṃ madhyasthānāṃ śaktyādīnāṃ caturṇāmapi guṇānāmupalakṣakam | tena pūrṇaṣāḍguṇyavattvaṃ darśitam | saḥ hariḥ jayatviti || indrapakṣe yaḥ puṣkale puṣkare ralayorabhedāśrayaṇāt gagane sīdantīti puṣkarasadaḥ dyusadaḥ, sadeḥ kvip | teṣāṃ devānāṃ śrīlakṣaṇāni sāmrājyajñāpakacchatracāmarādicihnāni taiḥ hṛdyaḥ hṛdayapriyaḥ bahūni sahasrasaṃkhyākāni virocanāni vilocanāni ralayorabhedāśrayaṇāt yasya saḥ bahuvilocana ityabhikhyā prasiddhiḥ yasya sa tathokta iti bahuvrīhigarbho bahuvrīhiḥ | vṛtrasya asuraviśeṣasya saṃhananaṃ hananasādhanaṃ hanteḥ karaṇe lyuṭ | yat bhiduraṃ kuliśaṃ 'bhiduraṃ paviḥ' ityamaraḥ | tadeva varahetiḥ uttamaśastraṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | vidyudbhāḥ vit vyākaraṇaviṣayakaṃ jñānaṃ ‘vāgvai parācyavyākṛtā'vadattāmindro madhyato'vakramya vyākarot' iti śruteḥ | brahmaviṣayakaṃ jñānaṃ vā ‘sa hovāca māmeva vijānīhyetadevāhaṃ manuṣyāya hitatamaṃ manye' ityādinā pratardanāya svātmaśarīrakabrahmopadeṣṭṛtvaśravaṇāt | yut paulomādiyuddhaṃ tābhyāṃ bhāsata iti vidyudbhāḥ ‘samityājisamidyudhaḥ' ityamaraḥ | yadvā vidi udbhāḥ iticchedaḥ| vidi pūrvoktajñāne viṣaye udbhāḥ udañcaddīptiḥ apratihatajñāna ityarthaḥ | saḥ hariḥ indraḥ jayatviti || sūryapakṣe yaḥ puṣkarāṇāṃ kamalānāṃ satī yā śrīḥ saṃpat śobhā vā tasyāḥ lakṣaṇaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ ralayorabhedāt | hṛdyaṃ hṛdayahitaṃ yasya saḥ | bahu iti bhinnaṃ padamagre'nveti | virocanābhikhyaḥ virocananāmā 'candrāgnyarkā virocanāḥ' ityamaraḥ | yadvā rocanānāṃ raktakahlārāṇāṃ abhikhyā śobhā | viśiṣṭā rocanābhikhyā yasmātsaḥ | raktakahlārasuṣamāvaha ityarthaḥ | ‘rocanā raktakahlāre gavāṃ pitte varastriyām' iti ratnamālāvaijayantyau | bahu yathā syāttathā | idaṃ bhedanakriyāviśeṣaṇam | vṛtrāṇāṃ parjanyānāṃ saṃhananaṃ saṃghaḥ 'aṅge saṃghe saṃhananam' iti śeṣaḥ | teṣu bhidurāḥ vṛṣṭyarthaṃ militāḥ varāḥ hetayaḥ kiraṇāḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ ‘yābhirādityastapati raśmibhistābhiḥ parjanyo varṣati' iti śruteḥ | vidyudbhāḥ vidyudvarṇaḥ saḥ hariḥ sūryaḥ jayatviti || candrapakṣe puṣkalaṃ pūrṇaṃ satāṃ rohiṇyādinakṣatrāṇāṃ ‘satklībamṛkṣe' iti ratnamālā | śriyaḥ saṃpadaḥ rakṣaṇaṃ hṛdyaṃ hṛdayapriyaṃ yasya saḥ | tārādhīśatvāttasyeti bhāvaḥ | yadvā bahu yathā tathā puṣkareṣu padmeṣu satī yā śrīḥ śobhā tasyāḥ lakṣaṇaṃ cihnaṃ nāma vā haratīti puṣkarasacchrīlakṣaṇahṛt, harateḥ kvip | padmaśobhāyāścihnaṃ nāmāpi vā niśśeṣayitetyarthaḥ | asminpakṣe yaḥ puṣkarasacchrīlakṣaṇahṛt yaḥ virocanābhikhya iti yatpadadvayasya yojanā | virocanābhikhyaḥ cirocanāparanāmā | vṛtrāṇāṃ dhvāntānāṃ saṃhananasya saṃghasya bhidurāḥ bhedayitryaḥ varāḥ hetayaḥ aṃśavo yasya saḥ| vidyut viśeṣeṇa dyotamānā bhāḥ prabhāvo yasya saḥ | hariḥ candramāḥ jayatviti || vidyutprakāśapakṣe tu liṅgavipariṇāmena viśeṣaṇāni yojyāni | puṣkaraṃ nakṣatraṃ tadiva satī ramaṇīyā | yadvā puṣkaraṃ ahiviśeṣaḥ jaladhārā vā tadiva satī vidyamānā vakratanudīrghojjvalarūpā || puṣkaramambuni khe bhe yudhi vādyamukhe'mare'pi dhārāyām | dvīpe bheṣajabhede sārasatīrthāhikarikarāgreṣu || iti ratnamalā | śrīrasyāstīti śrīlā | sidhmāditvānmarthīyo lac | ‘lakṣmīvān lakṣmaṇaśśrīlaḥ' ityamaraḥ | kṣaṇahṛdyā alpakālaramaṇīyā acirarucitvāt | trayāṇāmeṣāṃ karmadhārayaḥ | hariḥ kapilavarṇā | ata eva virocanābhikhyā | rocanā gorocanā tasyāḥ abhikhyevābhikhyā yasyāssā viśeṣeṇa rocanābhikhyā virocanābhikhyā | athavā rocanāḥ varavarṇinyaḥ tāsāṃ ābhikhyevābhikhyā yasyāssā uttamalalanāmaṇitulyaśobhetyarthaḥ | ata eva pratīpālaṃkāraḥ | bahu yathā tathā vṛtrāṇāṃ jīmūtānāṃ saṃhananaṃ saṃghaḥ tasya bhidurāḥ varāḥ hetayaḥ jvālāḥ yasyāssā ambudakadambasambhedanenonmīlitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | vidyudbhāḥ taṭitprakāśaḥ jayatviti || yamānilendracandrārkaviṣṇusiṃhāṃśuvājiṣu | śukāhikapibhekeṣu harirnā kapile triṣu || ityamaraḥ || yathāvā rājā sa lokapālo jiṣṇussamavartitāpprathi tanāmā | varṣati tarāṃ pracetāśśrīdo nanu sarvatomukhaṃ kāmam || 878 || atrāpi bhagavāneva prastutaḥ | indrayamavaruṇakuberacandrā aprastutāḥ | ṣaṇṇāmeṣāṃ śleṣaḥ | bhagavatpakṣe jiṣṇuḥ jayaśīlaḥ | samavartitāprathitanāmā | mayā śriyā saha vartate yasminkarmaṇi tadyathā syāttathā samaṃ samaṃ vartata iti samavartī śrīmattayaiva vidyamāna ityarthaḥ | yadvā 'samo'haṃ sarvabhūteṣu' ityuktarītyā sarvasamaṃ vartata iti tathoktaḥ | athavā sameṣu sarveṣu cetanācetanarūpavastuṣu vartate antaḥ praviśya niyantṛtayā vidyata iti samavartī ‘sarvasādhusamāneṣu samaṃ syādabhidheyavat' iti medinī | tasya bhāvaḥ samavartitā | tayā prathitanāmā prakhyātābhikhyaḥ prakṛṣṭaṃ ceto yasya sa tathoktaḥ mahāśaya ityarthaḥ | mahodāra iti yāvat | mahodāratā ca pātralāghavaṃ pradeyagauravaṃ cānādṛtya dāyabhāganyāyena pratyupakāranirapekṣaṃ vitaraṇarasikatvaṃ prājyaṃ datvā'pyatṛptatvaṃ ca | ata eva śrīdaḥ āśritebhyo'khilasaṃpatpradaḥ rājo ‘eka idrājā jagataḥ' | eṣa brahmalokassamrāṭ! rājādhirājassarveṣāṃ viṣṇurbahmamayo mahān' ityādyuktarītyā sakalalokādhirājaḥ saḥ evaṃ prasiddhaprabhāvaḥ lokapālaḥ sarvajagadrakṣako bhagavān 'eṣa lokapālaḥ' iti śruteḥ | sarvatomukhaṃ apratihataṃ kāmaṃ manorathaṃ asmākamiti śeṣaḥ | varṣatitarāṃ nanu atiśayena dadātyeva | nanuravadhāraṇe | yadvā na nu iti padadvayam | nuḥ pṛcchāyāṃ na varṣatitarāṃ nu | varṣatyeveti bhāvaḥ || indrapakṣe samavartitāprathitaṃ svarūpocitavṛttitayā prasiddhaṃ nāma yasya sa tathoktaḥ | pracetāḥ mahāmanāḥ śrīdaḥ āśritalakṣmīpradaḥ | rājā, ‘indro rājā jagataḥ | indrāya rājñe' ityādiśravaṇādrājatayā prasiddhaḥ | lokapālaḥ jiṣṇuḥ indraḥ ‘jiṣṇurlekharṣabhaḥ' ityamaraḥ | sarvatomukhaṃ salilaṃ ‘puṣkaraṃ sarvatomukham' ityamaraḥ | kāmaṃ paryāptaṃ yathā syāttathā varṣatitarāṃ parjanyavāhanatayā varṣasya tadadhīnatvāditi || yamapakṣe jiṣṇuḥ jayaśīlaḥ pracetāḥ śrīdaḥ ukta evārthaḥ | rājā 'yamo rājā pramṛṇābhiḥ' iti śruterasya rājatvam | samavartitāprathitanāmā samavartīti prasiddhābhidhānaḥ | lokapālaḥ sarvatomukhaṃ niravadhikaṃ kāmaṃ abhilāṣaṃ varṣatitarām | svāśritānāṃ pradadātītyarthaḥ | 'ye ye kāmā durlabhā martyaloke sarvān kāmāṃśchandataḥ prārthayasva' iti naciketasaṃ prati svenaivoktatvāditi bhāvaḥ || varuṇapakṣe pracetā iti viśeṣyam | samaṃ vartata iti samavartitā vartatestṛc | arthaḥ pūrvavadeva | apprathitanāmeti bhinnaṃ padam | adbhiḥ prathitaṃ vyapadiṣṭaṃ nāma yasya saḥ ‘varuṇo'pāmadhipatiḥ' ityādiśrutestannāmno'dbhiḥ prathitatvam | rājā ‘rājā tvā varuṇo nayatu | yāsāṃ rājā varuṇaḥ' ityādiśruterasyāpi rājatvam | anyāni viśeṣaṇāni yathoktārthānyeva | sarvatomukhaṃ jalaṃ kāmaṃ varṣatitarāṃ salilādhipatitvāttasya parjanyadvārā varṣaṇamiti dhyeyam || kuberapakṣe śrīda ityetadviśeṣyam | anyāni viśeṣaṇāni yathoditārthānyeva | rājā ‘kuberāya vaiśravaṇāya mahārājāya namaḥ' iti śrutiprasiddherasyāpi rājatvam | evaṃ cāṣṭānāmapi digadhīśānāṃ lokapālatvāviśeṣe'pīndrayamavaruṇakuberāṇāmeva mahādigadhīśatayā rājatvaṃ śrutyā khyāpitam | na tu vidigadhīśānāmagniniṛtimarudīśānānāṃ teṣāṃ rājatvāśravaṇādityavadheyam | śrīdaḥ kuberaḥ sarvatomukhaṃ kāmaṃ varṣati tarāṃ ‘sa me kāmān kāmakāmāya mahyaṃ, kāmeśvaro vaiśravaṇo dadātu' iti śruteḥ || candrapakṣe tu lokapālaḥ indrānilayamārkāṇāmagneśca varuṇasya ca | candravitteśayoścaiva mātrā nirhṛtya śāśvatīḥ|| ityupakramya ‘aṣṭābhirlokapālānāṃ mātrābhirnirmito nṛpaḥ' ityukteścandrasyāpi lokapālatvam | anyāni viśeṣaṇāni pūrvoktārthānyeva | rājā idaṃ viśeṣyaṃ candra ityarthaḥ | ‘soma eva no rājetyāhurbrāhmaṇīḥ prajāḥ' iti śravaṇādasya rājatvam | sarvatomukhaṃ niraṅkuśaṃ yathā tathā kāmaṃ varṣatitarāṃ manmathamuddīpayatīti yāvat || nanvatropapāditeṣu sarveṣvapyartheṣu viśeṣaṇānāṃ viśeṣyāṇāṃ cāniyamātkathamasya śleṣodāharaṇatā ‘sarvadomādhavaḥ pāyāt' ityādau tanniyamasyaiva darśanāditi cet ubhayeṣāmapi śliṣṭatvaniyamānatikramādityavadhehi | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyobhayaśliṣṭatvameva hi śleṣalakṣaṇam | na hi viśeṣaṇairviśeṣyairvā sarveṣvapyartheṣvaikarūpyeṇaiva bhāvyamityāgrahaḥ | teṣāṃ śliṣṭatāniyamamātrasyaivāpekṣitatvāditi dik | evaṃ sarvatrāpi draṣṭavyam || yathāvā govisaropāttaśrīrudārasattvā'dhidevatāmahatī | vasumattāvidyotā samupāśrayate parāṃ kāṣṭhām || atrāpi śriyaḥpatireva prakṛtaḥ, bṛhaspatidivaspatipaśupatigrahapativasumatīnarapatayo'prakṛtāḥ | saptānāmeteṣāṃ śleṣaḥ tathāhi, śrīpatipakṣe govisaropāttaśrīḥ gavāṃ apāṃ visarassamūhaḥ vārāśiḥ tasmāt upāttā śrīḥ lakṣmīḥ yayā sā tathoktā gau kratau vṛṣabhe candre vāgbhūdigdhenuṣu striyām | dvayostu raśmidṛgbāṇasvargavajrāmbulomasu || iti ratnamālā | ‘visaraḥ prasare vraje | śrīrveṣaracanāśobhābhāratīsaraladrume | lakṣmyāṃ trivargasaṃpattividhopakaraṇādiṣu | vibhūtau ca gatau ca strī' iti ca medinī | udāraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sattvaṃ svasattābhāsakaṃ sattvaṃ guṇasattvādvilakṣaṇam' ityukto guṇaviśeṣaḥ yasyāssā ‘yatsattvaṃ sa harirdevaḥ' ityādyukteśśaśuddhasattvamayāprākṛtadivyamaṅgalavigrahetyarthaḥ | 'udāro dakṣiṇe khyāte dānaśauṇḍe mahatyapi' iti, ‘sattvaṃ guṇe piśācādau vyavasāyasvabhāvayoḥ | guṇaprāṇabalasvāntasattāsvastrī tu jantuṣu' iti ca ratnamālā | vasumattāvidyotā vasavaḥ devaviśeṣāḥ prasiddhāḥ mattāḥ tṛptāḥ yasmātsaḥ vasumattaḥ | aviḥ ādityaḥ tasmin dyotata iti dyotā ‘asau vā ādityo devamadhu' ityupakramya 'tadyatprathamamamṛtaṃ tadvasava upajīvantyagninā mukhena na vai devā aśnanti na pibantyetadevāmṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā tṛpyanti' iti madhuvidyoktaprakriyayā vasutṛptihetāvāditye ‘yaścāsāvāditye' ityādyuktarītyā vidyotamānetyarthaḥ || vasurnā devabhedeṣu yoktrāgnidhanadāṃśuṣu | madhure tu triṣu klībe salile dhanaratnayoḥ || iti ratnamālā | ‘hṛṣṭo mattastṛptaḥ' ityamaraḥ | avirnā parvate sūrye meṣe mūṣakakambale | prākāre bhavane bhāsi strī tu puṣpavatībhuvoḥ || iti ratnamālā | mahatī devatā ‘mahate daivatāyājyaṃ, daivatānāṃ ca daivatam' ityukto bhagavān vāsudevaḥ parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ sthitiṃ śrayate | saiva paramaprāpyetyarthaḥ | ‘sā kāṣṭhā sā parā gatiḥ' iti hi śrutiḥ |‘kāṣṭhotkarṣe sthitau diśi' ityamaraḥ | kāṣṭhaṃ dāruṇi kāṣṭhā tu prakarṣe sthānamātrake | diśi dāruharidrāyāṃ kālamānaprabhidyapi || iti hemacandraḥ || bṛhaspatipakṣe govisareṇa vākprasareṇa upāttā śrīḥ devācāryakavibhūtiryayā sā tathoktā | udāraṃ khyātaṃ sato bhāvassattvaṃ vaiduṣyaṃ yasyāssā ‘san sudhīḥ kovido budhaḥ' itya maraḥ | vasumattā tejasvitā brahmavarcasamiti yāvat | sā ca vidyā ṛgvedādividyā ca vasumattāvidye pūrvanipātaprakaraṇasya ‘lakṣaṇahetvoḥ' ityādisūtranirdeśenānityatāyā jñāpitatvānnehālpāctarasya vidyāśabdasya paranipātavirodhaḥ | vasumattāvidyābhyāṃ ūtā saṃtateti yāvat |‘ūtaṃ syūtam' ityamaraḥ | veṅaḥ karmaṇi kte saṃprasāraṇam | mahatī devapūjyā devatā bṛhaspatināmeti bhāvaḥ | parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ utkarṣaṃ samupāśrayate || divaspatipakṣe govisareṇa nayananivahena locanasahasreṇetyarthaḥ | upāttā śrīśśobhā yayā sā tathoktā | udārasattvāmahāvyavasāyā | vasavo devaviśeṣāḥ te'sya santīti vasumat tasya bhāvaḥ vasumattā ‘śaradaḥ kṛtārthatā' ityādāviva sāmānye napuṃsakam | tayā āvidyotā samantātprakāśamānā | akhiladevādhīśatvātsatatamapi vasusāhityena bhāsamānetyarthaḥ | mahatī devatā ‘yo vṛtramavadhīttanmahendrasya mahendratvam' iti śrutyuktarītyā prāptamahattvā | devatā indrarūpā devatā | aparāṃ parā paścimā sā na bhavatītyaparā pūrvetyarthaḥ | tāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ diśaṃ samupāśriteti || paśupatipakṣe gauḥ vṛṣabhaḥ visaratīti visarā, pacādyac | gavā visarā govisarā | bhinnaṃ padam | vṛṣabhacāriṇītyarthaḥ | upāttā pītā śrīḥ viṣaṃ yayā sā tathoktā śrīrveṣaracanāśobhāsaṃpatsaralaśākhiṣu | vāṇīlakṣmīlavaṅgeṣu viṣe bilve'pi........ || iti ratnamālā | ata evāyaṃ śrīkaṇṭha ityucyate | udārāṇi mahānti sattvāni bhūtapiśācādīni yasyāssā tathoktā | bhūteśatvāditi bhāvaḥ | vasuragniḥ so'syāstīti vasumān tasya bhāvaḥ vasumattā phālalocanāgnimattetyarthaḥ | tayā yaḥ aviḥ bhāḥ | udāhṛtaḥ kośo na vismartavyaḥ | tena dyotā dyutimatī | yadvā vasuḥ dhanadaḥ vasumattā tadvatā tayā avau śaile kailāsanāmni | yadvā vasurdhanadaḥ mattaḥ hṛṣṭo yasmin tasmit avau kailāsagirau dyotata iti tathoktā dvayorapi tayoḥ kailāsanilayatvāditi bhāvaḥ | mahatī devatā mahādevatvena prasiddhā devatā parāṃ ‘dikṣvaiśānī diguttamā' iti praśastatayā smṛtipratipāditāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ diśaṃ samupāśrayate || grahapatipakṣe gavāṃ diśāṃ visareṇa nivahena upāttā śrīḥ prakāśo yasyāssā sarvadikprakāśiketyarthaḥ | arāṇyasya santītyari cakraṃ matvarthīya iniḥ | tannāmakatvātkokā atra vivakṣitāḥ ‘kokaścakraścakravāko rathāṅgāhvayanāmakaḥ' ityamaraḥ | ariṇāṃ samūhaḥ āram | sāmūhikaṃ ‘prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ' ārasya sattvamantaḥkaraṇaṃ ārasattvaṃ tadullāsitaṃ yayetyudārasattvā prādibhyo dhātujasya' iti bahuvrīhau lāsitaśabdalopaḥ | vasavaḥ kiraṇāḥ asya santīti vasumān bhūmni atiśāyane vā matup | tasya bhāvaḥ vasumattā tayā avidyotā avirmeṣarāśiḥ tasmin dyotata iti tathoktā meṣarāśestaduccasthānatvāttatra dyotata ityuktam | yathocyate kārtāntikaiḥ ‘svocce pradīptaḥ' iti | mahatī sarvaistrisandhyamabhivandyamānā devatā sūryābhidhānetyarthaḥ | parāṃ 'diśāṃ prācī' ityuktarītyā mukhyāṃ pūrvāṃ parāṃ paścimāṃ ca kāṣṭhāṃ diśaṃ samupāśrayate udayāstamayārthamiti bhāvaḥ || vasumatīpakṣe gāvo dhenavaḥ avayaḥ meṣāḥ sarāṃsi kāsārāḥ āpaḥ anyāni nadyādijalāni | sarasāṃ āpaḥ saro'pā iti vā | eteṣāṃ samāhāraḥ go'visaro'paṃ ‘ṛkpūrap' ityādinā samāsānto'pratyayaḥ | tena āttā śrīśśobhā yayā tathoktā | udārāḥ mahāntaḥ sattvāḥ jantavaḥ yasyāṃ sā | yadvā āraḥ aṅgārakaḥ ‘ārā carmaprabhedinyāṃ puṃsi bhaume śanaiścare' iti medinī | sa eva sattvaṃ garbho yasyāssā utkarṣeṇa ārasattvā udārasattvā | sattvaśabdo garbhavācī | ata eva āpannasattveti garbhiṇīparyāyaśabdaśśrūyate | aṅgārako hi vasudhāgarbhoditaḥ | sa hi ‘rohitāṅgo mahīsutaḥ' ityabhidhīyate | vasumattā ratnavattā nidhirūpadhanavattā vā yata iyaṃ vastumatītyākhyāyate avayaḥ girayaḥ | vasumattā ca avayaśca vasumattāvayaḥ taiḥ dyotata iti tathoktā | yadvā vigato dyoto yasyāssā na bhavatītyavidyotā | vasumattayā avidyotā ratnagarbhatayā nityaprakāśetyarthaḥ | mahatī vipulā devatā bhūrūpā ‘hantāhamimāstisro devatāḥ' ityannaśabdābhilapanīyāyā bhuvo devatātvaśravaṇāt | parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ śrayate sarvā diśo vyāpnotītyarthaḥ | narapatipakṣe govisarāt tattaddeśabhūnivahāt dṛṣṭiprasaraṇāt bāṇaprayogādvā upāttā sāmantavargādupāhṛtā śrīḥ vibhūtiḥ yayā sā tathoktā udāraṃ sattvaṃ balaṃ prāṇo vā yasyāssā vadānyacittā vā | vasubhiḥ dhanaiḥ mattā tṛptā | avibhiḥ prākāraiḥ bhavanaiḥ bhābhirvā sarvairvā dyotata iti tathoktā | udāhṛtaḥ kośo na vismaraṇīyaḥ | mahatī devatā bhūpatirūpā ‘mahatī devatā hyeṣā nararūpeṇa tiṣṭhati' iti smaraṇāt | parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ utkṛṣṭāṃ sthitiṃ ādhirājyapadamiti yāvat | samupāśriteti || evamaṣṭānāṃ navānāṃ daśānāṃ tatopyadhikānāṃ vā'rthānāṃ śleṣaśśakyaḥ kartuṃ, athā'pi bhagavatyā bhāratyā bhūyān syātkleśa iti bhiyā viśramyate || evaṃ prakṛtāprakṛtatadubhayagocaratayā śleṣatraividhyaṃ prapañcitam | tatra sabhaṅgābhaṅgarūpavailakṣaṇyaṃ ca sāmānyataḥ pradarśitam | idānīṃ viśiṣya tadbhedaḥ prapañcyate | atra kaustubhakāraḥ "śleṣassabhaṅgo'bhaṅgaśca | vibhinnānupūrvīkaśabdapratisandhānabodhyārthāntarakatvaṃ sabhaṅgatvam | samānānupūrvīkaśabdapratisandhānabodhyārthāntarakatvamabhaṅgatvam| dvividhopyayaṃ śleṣo'rthālaṅkāra eva | arthāntarasya vākyārthānanvaye nānārthakapadasadbhāve'pi śleṣavyavahāravirahāt | ādyaścāṣṭadhā varṇapadaliṅgabhāṣāvibhaktiprakṛtipratyayavacanabhedāt" ityabhāṇīt | tathāhi ādyo'ṣṭadhā varṇapadaliṅgabhāṣāvibhaktibhiḥ | prakṛtipratyayābhyāṃ ca vacanaiśśleṣa īritaḥ ||77 tatra ca varṇaśleṣaḥ vibhaktyādivaśādyatra nānāvarṇaikarūpatā | śrūyate sa hi vidvadbhirvarṇaśleṣa itīryate || 78 || yatrānekeṣāṃ varṇānāṃ vibhaktyādibalādaikarūpyaṃ śrūyate sa varṇaśleṣa ityabhidhīyate || yathā śreyohetau śubhakarabhūṣaṇaveṇau samullasajjānau | tvayi bhagavati viniviśatāṃ cittaṃ deveśvare mama dayālau || 881 || atra lakṣmīśrīnivāsayośśleṣaḥ| tatra lakṣmīviṣaye he deveśvare | devānāmīśvarā īśānā tasyāssaṃbuddhiḥ | ‘stheśabhāsa' ityādinā varajantatvānna ṅīp | he bhagavati! śreyasāṃ hetau kāraṇe 'śreyo na hyaravindalocanamanaḥkāntāprasādādṛte saṃsṛtyakṣaravaiṣṇavādhvasu nṛṇāṃ saṃbhāvyate karhicit' ityukteḥ | śubhakarāṇi bhūṣaṇāni yasyāṃ sā tathoktā veṇiḥ praveṇī yasyāssā tathoktā tasyām | idanto'yaṃ veṇiśabdaḥ | ‘veṇṛ niśāmanavāditrādānagamanajñānacintāsu' iti bhauvādikāddhātorauṇādika in pratyayaḥ | ‘veṇipraveṇī' ityamaraḥ | ‘karaṇaśroṇiveṇayaḥ' iti strīkāṇḍe nigamaḥ ‘devassa tvāmasūta dviṣadupamṛditasvarvadhūveṇibandhā' iti murārimiśraprayogaśca | samullasantī ratnamukurākāratayā dīpyamāne jānunī yasyāḥ tasyāṃ tathoktāyām | dayā ālissakhī yasyāḥ tasyāṃ tathoktāyāṃ dayāparavaśāyāmiti yāvat | tvayi mama cittaṃ viniviśatām | vinipūrvakādviśaterloṭ ‘nerviśaḥ' ityātmanepadam || śrīnivāsapakṣe tu deveśvare ityatra deveti cchedaḥ | he deva! śreyasyaḥ praśasyatarāḥ hetayaḥ divyāyudhāni yasya tasmiṃstathokte | śubhaḥ karayoḥ hastayoḥ bhūṣaṇaṃ alaṃkārabhūtaḥ veṇuḥ yasya tasmin gānakṛte pāṇigṛhītaveṇāvityarthaḥ | samullasantī kalyāṇadivyavigrahavattayā prakāśamānā jāyā yasya tasmin samullasajjānau ‘jāyāyā niṅ' iti bahuvrīhau samāsānto niṅ ‘lopo vyorvali' iti yalopaḥ | ‘sumajjānaye viṣṇave' iti śrutiratra pratyabhijñāpyate | dayālau kṛpāśālini 'spṛhi gṛhi pati dayi' ityādinā kartaryāluc | īśvare anaupādhikanirdeśādasaṃkucitaiśvaryavati bhagavati tvayi cittaṃ niviśatām | atra hetau veṇau jānau dayālau ityatra heti hetu veṇi veṇu jāni jānu dayāli dayālu padānāṃ saptamīvibhaktāvikārokārāvekoccāraṇaviṣayatayā śliṣṭāviti varṇaśleṣo'yam | īśvare bhagavatītyatra saṃbuddhisaptamīvibhaktyorvakṣyamāṇarītyā śleṣaścābhyuccīyate || yathāvā hṛdayaṃ sadā''śarārau durgativārāśitaraṇadivyatarau | kalaśodadhibhavane mama kasmiṃściddevate ciraṃ lagatāt || 882 || atrāpi śrīśrīnivāsayoreva śleṣaḥ | aśarārau ahiṃsre anugrahamayatvenājñātanigrahe ityarthaḥ | pakṣe āśarārāviticchedaḥ | āśarāṇāṃ rakṣasāṃ arau virodhini ‘kravyādo'srapa āśaraḥ' ityamaraḥ | durgatirdāridryaṃ vārāśiriva durgativārāśiḥ tasya taraṇe divyatarau kalpaśākhini ‘dāridryārṇavatāriṇīm' ityādyukteḥ | 'durgatirnarake naisvye' iti medinī | pakṣe durgatiḥ narakaḥ sa eva vārāśiḥ tasya taraṇe divyā adbhutā tariḥ nauḥ tasyāṃ divyatarau | kalaśodadhau dugdhajaladhau bhavanaṃ janma nivāsaśca yasya tasmiṃstathokte kasmiṃściddaivate śrīrūpe śrīnivāsarūpe ca mama hṛdayaṃ sadā lagatāt | atra sadā''śarārau divyatarau ityatra aśarāru āśarāri divyataru divyataripadānāṃ saptamīvibhaktāvukārekāyorvarṇayośśleṣaḥ || yathāvā svātmani codayamānaṃ tvāṃ sudhiyo'bjā kṣa sarvadātaraṇau | ekaṃ hanta vidanto muktā vindantyamandamānandam || 883 || sarvasya dātā sarvadātā tasya saṃbuddhiḥ sarvadātaḥ! 'ya ātmadā baladāḥ' | ‘sakalaphalaprado hi viṣṇuḥ' ityuktarītyā ātmaparyantasarvasvadānaśīletyarthaḥ | he abjākṣa ! anena "tasya yathā kapyāsaṃ puṇḍarīkamevamakṣiṇi" iti vivakṣitaśrutyarthassmāritaḥ | aṇau aṇuparimāṇe ‘eṣo'ṇurātmā' iti śruteḥ | svātmani ‘svatvamātmāni sañjātaṃ svāmitvaṃ brahmaṇi sthitam' ityuktarītyā svāminassvasya svabhūte ātmani pratyagātmani sudhiyaḥ suptāni jñānendriyāṇi codayamānaṃ prerayantamityarthaḥ | anena ‘dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt' iti śrutiḥ pratyabhijñāpyate | yadvā 'ya ātmani tiṣṭhannātmano'ntaraḥ' ityuktarītyā'ntaryāmitayā sthitvā ‘sa no devaśśubhayā smṛtyā saṃyunaktu' ityuktaprakāreṇa svaprāptyaupayikīrdhiyaḥ prerayantamityarthaḥ | atra ‘dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te' ityetat smartavyam | naitāvadeva, svātmani svaśarīrabhūte
