‘yasyādityaśśarīram' iti śruteḥ | 'ātmā yatno dhṛtirbuddhissvabhāvo brahma varṣma ca' ityamaraḥ | sarvadā taraṇau ca udayamānaṃ iti chedaḥ | taraṇau cetyanvayaḥ, āditye ca sarvadā udayamānaṃ prakāśamānaṃ tvāṃ anena ca sandarbheṇa 'sa yaścāyaṃ puruṣe | yaścāsāvāditye' iti śrutikhaṇḍaḥ pratyabhijñāpyate | ekaṃ ubhayatra vidyamānamabhinnam | anena udāhṛtaśrutiśeṣasthaṃ 'sa ekaḥ' ityetatpratyabhijñāpyate | vidantaḥ jānantaḥ | anena 'sa ya evaṃ vit' ityetat | sudhiyaḥ vipaścitaḥ muktāssantaḥ, anena ‘asmāllokātpretya' ityuktārcirādimārgagamanapūrvakavitamaḥpadaprāptiruktā | amandamānandaṃ vindanti | anena 'etamānandamayamātmānamupasaṅkrāmati' iti śrutyarthassamagṛhyata | udāhṛtaśrutyartho vyāsāryairitthamabhivarṇitaḥ 'sarvospi vidvānasmāllokātpretyānnamayādisamaṣṭivyaṣṭivibhūtikaṃ niratiśayānandaṃ paramātmānaṃ bhogyabhūtaṃ bhoktā sannanubhavati' iti | hantetīdṛśārthaparicintanajanitaharṣe | atra taraṇyaṇuśabdayossaptamīvibhaktau ikārokārayorvarṇayośśleṣaḥ pūrvavadeva | sarvadātaḥ aṇau sarvadā taraṇau iticchedādvakṣyamāṇapadaśleṣaśca | eṣu śreyohetāvityādiṣu triṣūdāharaṇeṣu hetau veṇau ityādau hetuhetiveṇuveṇītyādivibhinnānupūrvīkaśabdayorekoccāraṇagocaratayā pratisandhānenārthadvayasya bodhitatvātsabhaṅgaśleṣasāmānyalakṣaṇānugatiḥ | hetau ityādau ‘acca gheḥ ityadādeśottaramānupūrvībhedābhāve'pyādeśini bhedadarśanādvibhinnānuupūrvīkatvaṃ draṣṭavyam | evamanyatrāpyūhyam || padaśleṣaḥ padaśleṣassa yaśśleṣaḥ padabhedanibandhanaḥ || 79 || yathā vā samupanatavatsalakṣmāsnigdhamanāssatsuhṛdyanityaśrīḥ | kalikalmaṣahṛtpadmā kalyāṇaguṇāmbudhissvabhūravyāt || 884 || atra śrīśrīśayoḥ śleṣaḥ | śrīpakṣe samupanateṣu śaraṇāgateṣu vatsalā vātsalyaśālinī yā kṣmā bhūrdevī tasyāṃ snigdhaṃ snehaśāli mano yasyāssā | bhuvaḥ ‘lakṣmīpriyasakhīṃ devīm' iti viśeṣitatvaśravaṇāt | satsuhṛdyanityaśrīḥ satī sādhvī 'satye sādhau vidyamāne praśaste'bhyarhite ca sat' ityamaraḥ | suhṛdyā atimātrahṛdayapriyā satāṃ suhṛdyā vā nityā anaśvarī śrīḥ śobhā saṃpattirvā yasyāssā tathoktā | kalikalmaṣahṛt kalikaluṣahāriṇī | kalyāṇāḥ guṇāḥ yasyāssā | svena bhavatīti svabhūḥ, svecchāyattajanmā na tu karmakṛtajaniḥ ambudhau svabhūḥ ambudhisvabhūḥ | padmā śrīḥ avyāt pāyāt | iti || śrīśapakṣe tu vaṃtse vakṣasi ‘uro vatsaṃ ca' ityamaraḥ | lakṣma śrīvatsākhyaṃ cihnaṃ tat samupanataṃ prāptaṃ yena saḥ samupanatavatsalakṣmā | satsu brahmavitsu snigdhamanāḥ 'sa ca mama priyaḥ' iti gānāt | hṛdyā vakṣassthā nityā ‘nityaivaiṣā jaganmātā' ityukteḥ śrīḥ lakṣmīḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | kalikalmaṣahṛtpat mā iti cchedaḥ| kalikalmaṣaṃ harata iti tathoktau padau caraṇau yasya sa tathoktaḥ ‘padaṅghriścaraṇo'striyām' ityamaraḥ || yāvatsa pādapadmābhyāṃ pasparśemāṃ vasundharām | tāvatpṛthvīpariṣvaṅge samartho nābhavatkaliḥ || ityetadatrānusaṃhitam | kalyāṇaguṇāmbudhiḥ svabhūḥ bhagavan ‘keśavo mādhavassvabhūḥ' ityamaraḥ | mā māṃ avyāditi yojanā ananvādeśe'pi vaikalpiko mādeśo bhavatyeva ‘ete vāṃnāvādaya ādeśā ananvādeśe vā vaktavyāḥ' ityukteḥ | padmā ityatra saṃhitāyāmanunāsikanakārādeśābhāvaḥ, ‘yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā' iti tasya vaikalpikatvānuśāsanāt | atra 'samupanatavatsalakṣmā' ityādau padabhedanibandhanaḥ śleṣaḥ | ayameva sabhaṅgaśleṣa iti kāvyadarpaṇakṛt || liṅgaśleṣaḥ liṅgaśleṣassa vijñeyo hrasvadīrghasamāsataḥ | strīpuṃnapuṃsakānāṃ cecchabdānāṃ tulyarūpatā || hrasvairdīrghairvā varṇaiḥ laghordīrghatvena dīrghasya laghutvena vā samāsairvā strīpuṃnapuṃsakaliṅgānāṃ sārūpyaṃ varṇyate cetsa liṅgaśleṣa ityarthaḥ || yathā kimapi mahassvānasmān śreyo nayatā dadhatkarāgre'bjam | mātṛtvabhāktrijagatāṃ nitarāṃ jāgrannatepsitavidhāne || 885 || atrāpi śrīśrīśayoreva śleṣaḥ | trijagatāṃ mātṛtvaṃ jananītvaṃ padatrayeṇa mitikartṛtvaṃ ca bhajatīti mātṛtvabhāk | bhajaterṇviḥ | nitarāṃ natānāṃ īpsitavidhāne jāgrat jāgarūkaṃ jāgarūkaśca | pakṣe 'nābhyastācchatuḥ' iti numabhāvaḥ| karāgre abjaṃ padmaṃ śaṅkhaṃ ca dadhat dadhānaṃ dadhānaśca | kimapi mahaḥ tejastvenādhyavasitaṃ vastu viśeṣaṇamahimnā śrīrūpamiti lakṣyate | svān svakīyān asmān śreyaḥ kalyāṇaṃ nayatām || pakṣe mahassvānityekaṃ padam | mahassvān tejasvī viśeṣaṇamahimnā bhagavāniti labhyate | asmān kimapi śreyo nayatāmiti yojanā | mahasvānityatra ‘tasau matvarthe' iti bhasaṃjñāyāṃ na padakāryarutvādi | asminpakṣe sakārasya 'anaci ca' iti dvitvaṃ bodhyam || yathāvā padmānurāgiśubhadṛkchukavāgamṛtābdhijātatayaśobhāk | pāyādeva mahojjvalabhāmāmaṇihārihṛtsatatamasmān || 886 || atrāpi śrīśrīśayoreva śleṣaḥ | śrīpakṣe prathamaikavacanāntāni viśeṣaṇāni | śrīśapakṣe saṃbuddhyantānīti draṣṭavyam | padmeṣu anurāgiṇī śubhā dṛk yasyāssā kamalasuhṛnnayanetyarthaḥ | śukasya kīrasya vāgiva vāk yasyāssā śukavāk | amṛtābdhijā dugdhāmbudhijanitā | tataṃ vistṛtaṃ yaśo bhajata iti tatayaśobhāk | mahojjvalā atyujjvalā bhāḥ yasyāssā | mā maṇihārihṛt iti chedaḥ | maṇihāro'sminnastīti tathoktaṃ hṛt vakṣo yasyāssā | mā lakṣmīḥ satataṃ asmān pāyādeva rakṣyādeva nātra saṃdeha iti bhāvaḥ || bhagavatpakṣe padmāyāṃ lakṣmyāṃ anurāgiṇī śubhā dṛk yasya saḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | śukasya śukamaharṣeḥ vāk śrībhāgavatarūpā saiva amṛtābdhiḥ tasmājjātamiti śukavāgamṛtābdhijaṃ ātataṃ ca yadyaśaḥ tadbhajatīti tathoktaḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ śrībhāgavataprakhyātavipulakīrte ! ityarthaḥ | mahojjvalabhāmāmaṇihārihṛdityekaṃ padaṃ samastam | jvalatīti jvalā pacādyac | mahasā jvalā mahojvalā 'anaci ca' iti jakārasya dvitvam | yā bhāmāmaṇiḥ lakṣmīḥ tayā hāri manoharaṃ hṛt vakṣaḥ yasya tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | pāyāḥ deveticchedaḥ | he deva ! bhagavan ! satataṃ asmān pāyāḥ avyāḥ, pādhātorāśīrliṅi madhyamaikavacanam | pūrvatra prathamaikavacanam | anayoḥ padyayoḥ dadhat ityādīnāṃ puṃnapuṃsakaliṅgānāmekoccāraṇagocaratvālliṅgaśleṣaḥ | īdṛśaṃ ca liṅgaśleṣodāharaṇamalaṅkārakaustubhakṛdudāharaṇānurodhena | vastutastu tanmatena nedamudāharaṇaṃ, tena hi varṇādyaṣṭavidhaśleṣāṇāṃ sabhaṅgatvaṃ pratijñāya ‘vibhinnānupūrvīkaśabdapratisandhānabodhyārthāntarakatvaṃ sabhaṅgatvam' iti sabhaṅgatāṃ pariṣkṛtya unnidrābjapariṣkṛtapravaradoḥ prahvībhavaddaivataḥ śreṇīmaulitaṭāvaghaṭṭitamaṇijyotsnāsamullāsitāt | unmīladdhanasārasantatisadṛkphullāravindābhadṛ grūpaṃ kaiṭabhabhedino madanajidvā candrikā vā'vatu || ityudāhṛtya ‘atra dorityādīnāṃ rūpaṃ klībapuṃstrīliṅgeṣu samānam' ityuktam | evaṃ ca tadudāharaṇe liṅgatrayasya dadhadityādyasmadudāharaṇe puṃnapuṃsakaliṅgayoścānupūrvyā ekākāratayā vibhinnānupūrvikatāyāḥ kathamapyadarśanānna bhavatīdaṃ sabhaṅgaviśeṣaliṅgaśleṣodāharaṇaṃ, apitu haryādiśabdavadabhaṅgaśleṣodāharaṇameva || nanu haryādiśabdeṣu liṅgabhedābhāvādānupūrvyā avibhinnatvamastu pravaradorityādau dadhadityādau ca tatsadbhāvādvibhinnatvamānupūrvyā iti cenna, liṅgabhedasya tadaprayojakatvāt | śabdeṣvānupūrvī nāma avyavahitottaratvasaṃbandhena pūrvapūrvavarṇaviśiṣṭacaramavarṇatvarūpā | sā ca pradarśitasthale avibhinnaiva dṛśyata iti kvāsti vibhinnānupūrvīkatā | na ca puṃnapuṃsakādirūpārthabhedāttadbhedanirvāhaḥ, arthabhedasyāpi tadaprayojakatvāt | liṅgasya śabdavṛttitābhyupagame'pi na liṅgamānupūrvīghaṭakaṃ bhaviṣyati | liṅgaṃ hi nāma strītvapuṃstvādirūpa udāttatvānudāttatvādivatkaścana śabdavṛttidharmaḥ pṛthagevānupūrvyāḥ | ata eva ‘taṭādiśabdeṣu samānānupūrvīkeṣu liṅgatrayam' iti vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇoktaṃ saṃgacchate | liṅgasyāpyānupūrvyantaḥpātitvābhyupagame ‘abjena tvanmukhaṃ tulyaṃ kamalānāṃ tvadīkṣaṇe' ityādāvapyabjakamalapadayorliṅgabhedaprayuktānupūrvībhedena sabhaṅgaśleṣatvāpattiḥ | iṣṭāpattau ca tatrābhaṅgaśleṣa iti sakalālaṅkārikābhimativirodhaprasaṅgaḥ | tasmānna liṅgamānupūrvībhavitumarhatīti vibhinnānupūrvīkatāyā upadarśitodāharaṇagatapravaradorityādiśabdeṣvasambhavātteṣāṃ sabhaṅgāvāntaraliṅgaśleṣodāharaṇatvaṃ na yujyate 'bibhrannīlotpalaruciṃ hariravyāttadakṣi vā' iti kāvyadarpaṇakṛto liṅgaśleṣodāharaṇaṃ tu tanmate samyageva | tasyā bhaṅgatāyāmapyavirodhāt | tena hyaṣṭavidhaśleṣāntaḥpātipadaśleṣamudāhṛtyāyameva sabhaṅgaśleṣa ityuktam | na tu bhedāntarasyābhaṅgatvaṃ sabhaṅgatvaṃ vā kaṇṭhataḥ | tasmāt padaśleṣātiriktānāṃ varṇādiśleṣāṇāṃ yathāyathaṃ sabhaṅge abhaṅge vā śleṣe antarbhāva iti tadāśaya unnīyate | sāhityadarpaṇakārastu "śliṣṭaiḥ padairanekārthābhidhāne śleṣa iṣyate | varṇapratyayaliṅgānāṃ prakṛtyoḥ padayorapi | śleṣādvibhaktivacanabhāṣāṇāmaṣṭadhā ca saḥ | ityādinā aṣṭavidhān śleṣānnirūpya, punastredhā sabhaṅgothābhaṅgastadubhayātmakaḥ || iti punastridhā vibhajya ‘etadbhedatrayaṃ coktabhedāṣṭake yathāsambhavaṃ jñeyam" ityabhāṇīt | evaṃca kāvyadarpaṇādimate ‘bibhrannīlotpalarucim' ityādeḥ dadhadityādeścābhaṅgaśleṣatve'pi liṅgaśleṣodāharaṇatvaṃ nirargalameva | alaṅkārakaustubhamate tūpapāditaprakāreṇa tadīyalakṣaṇāsaṅgateḥ ‘pravaradoḥ' ityāditadīyaliṅgaśleṣodāharaṇamasamīcīnameva | idaṃ tu tanmate'pyudāharaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati yathā tvamakhilajagadānandī tvamaśubhahārī tvameva śabhakārī | nyasya paramātmanīne manorame tvayi hare'tra paramenaḥ || 887 || atrāpi śrīśrīśayoreva śleṣaḥ | bhṛśaṃ ātmane paramātmane hitā ātmanīnā | tasyāssaṃbuddhiḥ he ātmanīne! ‘ātmanviśvajana' ityādinā hitārthe khapratyayaḥ | ‘ātmādhvānau khe' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ | he rame ! tvaṃ akhilajagat ānandayatītyakhilajagadānandī tvaṃ aśubhaṃ haratītyaśubhahārī lvameva śubhaṃ karotīti śubhakārī ca | sarvatra karmaṇyaṇi 'ṭiḍhḍhāṇañ' iti ṅīp | atra tvayi asyāṃ tvayi mano nyasya paraṃ bharanyāsottarakālikaṃ enaḥ aghaṃ ‘kaluṣaṃ vṛjinaino'gham' ityamaraḥ | hare harāmi | purvāghasya vinaṣṭatvāduttarāghasyāśleṣāditi bhāvaḥ | hṛñastaṅi laṭyuttamaikavacanam || bhagavatpakṣe ātmani ine manorame parame naḥ iti chedaḥ | he hare ! tvaṃ bhṛśaṃ ‘akhilajagat ānandayatīti tathoktaḥ tvaṃ aśubhahārī | tvameva śubhakārī ca | ābhyāṃ viśeṣaṇābhyāṃ aśubhāni nirācaṣṭe tanoti śubhasaṃtatim | smṛtimātreṇa yatpuṃsāṃ brahma tanmaṃgalaṃ param || iti pramāṇārthassaṃgṛhītaḥ | sarvatra 'supyajātau' iti ṇinimanorame saindaryasauśīlyādikalyaṇaguṇaiścittāpahāriṇi ine saḥ vaiśvaraṃ parame ātmani sarvāntarātmani atra asmin tvayi naḥ asmān nyasya nyasyāḥ | tvayi nyastabharān kuryā ityarthaḥ | nipurvakādasyatairdaivādikālloṇmadhyamaikavacanam | atra jagadānandītyādiviśeṣaṇatraye strīpulliṅgayośśleṣaḥ, tayoraikarūpyeṇa śravaṇāt | ānandatyādeḥ ṅyantatvaṇinyantatvakṛtā vibhannānupūrvīkateti tādṛśaśabdapratisandhānabodhyatvādarthadvayasya sāmānyalakṣaṇasaṃgatiḥ | nyasya hare ityatra suptiṅpratyayayośśleṣaḥ | ātmanīne manorame paramenaḥ ityatra padaśleṣaścetyapi vibhāvanīyam || yathāvā sādhujanapakṣapātā sakalaparityaktavāyasatrātā | surarāḍbahumānetā sumahāśśrīssphuratu mama jaganmātā || 888 || atrāpi bhagavato lakṣmyāśca śleṣaḥ | sādhujanapakṣasya pātā rakṣitā | sādhujane pakṣapāto yasyāssā tathoktā ca | sakalaparityaktasya ‘sa pitrā ca parityaktaḥ' ityuktarītyā sakalalokopekṣitasya vāyasasya indrātmajasya kākasya trātā pālayitā | uktavidho vāyasastrāto yayā sā ca | idaṃ ca pādmottare prasidhyati | jagatāṃ mātā padatrayeṇa mitikartā jananī ca | surarāṭ devānāmadhīśaḥ | bahu iti bhinnaṃ padmumuttarānvayi | mānetā śrīnāyakaḥ | pakṣe surarāḍityādi samastaṃ padaṃ, surarāja indrasya bahumānena atiśayitena pūjanena itā yuktā | iṇaḥ ktaḥ | tatpūjitetyarthaḥ | prasidhyatīdaṃ vaiṣṇave purāṇe | sumahatī atipūjyā śrīḥ lakṣmīḥ saṃpattirvā yasya sa tathoktaḥ | idaṃ mānetetyasyaiva viśeṣaṇam | pakṣe sumahāḥ śobhanatejāḥ | sumahetyādantatayā vā chedaḥ | śobhanotsavetyarthaḥ | śrīḥ lakṣmīḥ mama sphuratu prakāśatām | atra puṃstrīliṅgayorekoccāraṇaviṣayatayā liṅgaśleṣaḥ | sādhujanapakṣapātṛtvasādhujanapakṣapātātvādirūpavibhinnānupūrvīkaśabdapratisaṃdhānenārthadvayabodhātsabhaṅgatvamiti dhyeyam || bhāṣāśleṣaḥ bhāṣāśleṣastu bhinnārthanānābhāṣaikyato bhavet || 81 bhinnārthakānāṃ nānābhāṣāṇāṃ śleṣaṇe bhāṣāśleṣaḥ || yathā bāhāsamaṃ sahajasaṃpariṇāhidayārasaṃ saralabhāsam | sugalantamohamīḍe kamalāvāsaṃtamahiharesantam || 889 || atra sāṃskṛtī bhāṣā bhagavatparā, prākṛtī tu lakṣmīparā | tathā hi, bhagavatpakṣe bāhāsamaṃ bāhābhiḥ bhujābhiḥ asamaṃ asadṛśaṃ sakalabhuvanarakṣaṇavicakṣaṇalokottaracaturbāhumityarthaḥ | sahajasaṃpariṇāhidayārasaṃ sahajaḥ nisargasiddhaḥ saṃpariṇāhī ativipulaḥ dayārasaḥ yasya taṃ tathoktam | saralabhāsaṃ saralā udārā bhāḥ yasya taṃ tathoktam | sugalaṃ śobhanaḥ rekhātrayalakṣaṇavattayā kalyāṇaḥ galaḥ kaṇṭho yasya taṃ tamohaṃ tamaḥ ajñānaṃ hantīti tathoktam ‘anyeṣvapi dṛśyate' iti hanterḍaḥ, sugalaśabdāntyānusvārasya 'vā padāntasya' iti vaikalpikaḥ parasavarṇaḥ | harati saṃharatīti haraḥ ahīnāṃ haraḥ ahiharaḥ nāgāntakaḥ tasmin santaṃ sthitaṃ tārkṣyavāhanamityarthaḥ | kamalāvāsaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ īḍe staumi || lakṣmīpakṣe bāhāsamaṃ bādhāśamāṃ, śamayatīti śamā, pacādyac | bādhāyāḥ jagatpīḍāyāḥ śamā tāṃ tathoktām | "khaghadhathabhāṃ haḥ' iti sūtreṇa bādhāśabdadhakārasya hakāraḥ | ‘śossal' ityanena śamaśabdaśakārasya sakāraḥ ‘svarasya bindvami' iti samāśabdākārasya hrasvaḥ | evamuttaratrāpi | sahajasaṃ sahayaśasaṃ yaśasā sahitāṃ ‘tena saheti' | ityādinā samāse 'vopasarjanasya' ityasya vaikalpikatvātsabhāvābhāvaḥ | ‘āderjaḥ' iti yaśaśśabdayakārasya jaḥ | ‘antyahalo'śradudī" ityantyasakāralopaḥ | ‘snamadāmaśironabhonari' iti yaśaśśabdasya puṃstve'pi bahuvrīhau strītvam | hrasvaḥ pūrvavat | pariṇāhidayārasaṃ vipulakaruṇārasām | prāyo lukkagacajatadapayavām' ityatra prāyograhaṇāddayāśabdayakārasya naluk | ‘samāse vākyavibhaktyapekṣayā bhinnapadatvamapīṣyate' ityuktatvāt sudoha ityādāviva dayāśaśabdadakārasya na luk | saralabhāsaṃ saralabhāṣāṃ udāragiramityarthaḥ | ‘śossal' iti ṣakārasya sakāraḥ | bhāsamityasya samāse pūrvavadbhinnapadatvena bhakārasyāditayā ‘khaghathadhabhāṃ haḥ' iti na hakārādeśaḥ, ‘akhoḥ' ityanuvṛtteḥ | aikapadyavivakṣāyāmapi prāyograhaṇānuvṛtteḥ ‘paṭṭaṇabhavo' ityādāviva na hakāraḥ hrasvaḥ prāgvadeva | sugalntamohamiti samastaṃ padam | sugalanmohāṃ sugalantetyatra ‘śatṛśānacoḥ' iti sūtreṇa ntādeśaḥ | tato mohaśabdena suṣṭhu galanto moho yasyā iti pañcamībahuvrīhiḥ | sarvavaicityanivārayitrīmityarthaḥ | hrasvaḥ ahihare ahidhare śeṣādrau sthitāmityadhyāhāraḥ | samāsassyaikapadatvavivakṣayā dhakārasyānāditvalābhāt 'khaghathadha' ityādinā hādeśaḥ | santaṃ śāntāṃ prasannāmiti yāvat | taṃ tāṃ kamalāvāsaṃ padmāvāsāṃ | īḍe | uḍvāderākṛtigaṇatvānneha latvam | atra saṃskṛtaprākṛtabhāṣayorekoccāraṇaviṣayatayā bhāṣāśleṣaḥ| evaṃ śaurasenyādibhāṣāśleṣo'pyūhyaḥ || vibhaktiśleṣaḥ supāṃ tiṅāṃ ca śleṣaścedvibhaktiśleṣa īritaḥ || kevalasupāṃ kevalatiṅāṃ militānāṃ vā suptiṅāṃ śleṣaścetsa vibhaktiśleṣa ityucyate || yathā urugāyānyatha ca sadānandāni mahāmahāṃsi bhūyāṃsi | phaṇiśikhariśikharasīmani vilaganti jaganti cāvanti || 890 || atrāpi bhagavato lakṣmyāśca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi uruḥ vipulaḥ gāyaḥ kīrtiḥ yeṣāṃ tāni | atha ca san ānando yeṣāṃ tāni | bhūyāṃsi atibahūni | bahutvaṃ cātra vaipulyaṃ na tu saṅkhyāviśeṣaḥ | bahuśabdasya ‘bahuṣu bahuvacanam' ityādau saṅkhyāyāmiva ‘alpaṃ vā bahu vā yasya' ityādāvalpatvapratiyogivaipulye'pi prayogadarśanāt ‘bahu syātryādisaṅkhyāsu vipule'pyabhidheyavat' iti medinī | vaipulyaṃ cātra guṇatassvarūpataśca | tathācānantakalyāṇaguṇāni sarvavyāpīni cetyarthaḥ | mahāmahāṃsi tathātvenādhyasto bhagavānityarthaḥ | phaṇiśikhariśikharasīmani vilaganti avatiṣṭhante | tatra hetumabhiprayannāha jaganti lokān avanti rakṣanti ca | lagateravateśca laṭprathamabahuvacanam || pakṣe phaṇiśikhariśikharasīmani vilaganti vidyamānāni jaganti avanti trāyamāṇāni | bhūyāṃsi ukto'rthaḥ | mahāmahāṃsi dvitīyābahuvacanam | tattvenādhyavasitāṃ śriyamityarthaḥ | uru adhikaṃ yathā syāttathā gāyāni gāyeyaṃ tadyaśaḥkīrtanaṃ karavāṇītyarthaḥ | athaca gānānantaraṃ ca sadā sarvadā nandāni nandeyaṃ pramodeyetyarthaḥ | ubhayatra prārthanāyāṃ loḍuttamaikavacanam | atra vilagantītyādau suptiḍavibhaktyoḥ śleṣaḥ || yathāvā caraṇāmbujaśaraṇagataṃ kaṃcidapi tvaṃ purā'pi na nirāsthaḥ | adyatve'cyuta madavanaviṣaye'pi tathaiva ko viśayaḥ || 891 || he acyuta! āśritarakṣaṇavratānnacyavatītyacyuta iti niruktiḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | idaṃ ca prakṛtavivakṣitārthopaskārakaṃ, caraṇāmbujaśaraṇagataṃ kaṃcidapi jātivṛttādinihīnamapīti bhāvaḥ | purā'pi pūrvamapi na nirāsthaḥ na nirākārṣīḥ | niḥpūrvakādasyaterluṅi sipi cleraṅi ‘asyatesthuka' iti thuk | adyatve madavanaviṣaye madrakṣaṇaviṣaye'pi tathaiva na nirāstha eva nirapekṣo na kiṃtu sāpekṣa eveti bhāvaḥ | nirgatā āsthā yasya nirāsthaḥ na nirāsthaḥ nanirāsthaḥ | ‘āsthā tvālambanāsthānayatnāpekṣāsu yoṣiti' iti medinī | atra tiṅsubvibhaktyoḥ śleṣaḥ || yathāvā sumanohṛtsarasīruhanivāsabhāgabjalocanā'narghaśrīḥ | śiśirakṛpāsārassyādbhūyānmayi sarvadā ca bhavatastapte || 892 || atra śrīśrīpativiṣayakaḥ prathamāsaṃbuddhivibhaktyoḥ śleṣaḥ | śrīpakṣe sumanohṛditi vyastaṃ padaṃ, atimanohāriṇītyarthaḥ | samastaṃ sarasīruhaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā | sarasīruhe nivāsabhāk | anarghaśrīḥ divyaśobhā | sarvaṃ dadātīti sarvadā ca | akhilābhīṣṭadātrītyarthaḥ | evaṃvidhā abjalocanā śrīrityarthaḥ ‘padmadalāyatākṣi' ityetadatra smartavyam | śiśirakṛpāsārassyāt | lyablope pañcamī | śītaladayāsarasatāṃ prāpyetyarthaḥ | dvitīyasakārasya ‘anaci ca' iti dvitvamarthāntarānurodhāt | bhavataḥ saṃsāreṇa | sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ| tapte mayi bhūyāt sannidhattāmityarthaḥ || śrīpatipakṣe tu sumanasāṃ viduṣāṃ hṛtsarasīruhe nivāsabhāk sadbhirdhyeyetyarthaḥ | saṃbuddhyantamidamabjalocanetyasya viśeṣaṇam | evamagre'pi | anarghā śrīḥ lakṣmīryasya tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | he abjalocana ! bhagavan ! puṇḍarīkākṣa ! bhavataḥ tava bhūyāniti chedaḥ atibahuḥ śiśiraḥ kṛpāsāraḥ tapte ādhyātmikāditāpagraste mayi sarvadā sadā syāt prasaratāditi yāvat | atra padaśleṣo'pi draṣṭavyaḥ | yathavā bhaktārthadayā satataṃ sureṣu dattābhayā'lamudadhijayā | nanu sarvabhūtadhātryādaratastatre'khilaṃ bhuvanametat || 893 || atra bhūśrīviṣayakaḥ prathamātṛtīyayoḥ śleṣaḥ | bhaktānāṃ arthaṃ abhīṣṭaṃ puruṣārthaṃ dadātīti bhaktārthadā tathoktayā | pakṣe bhaktebhya iyaṃ bhaktārthā 'arthena nityasamāso viśeṣyaliṅgatā ceti vaktavyam' iti samāso viśeṣyaliṅgatā ca | tādṛśī dayā kṛpā yasyāssā tathoktā satataṃ sureṣu devebhya ityarthaḥ | ‘samamabrāhmaṇe dānam' ityādāviva saṃpradānasyaivādhikaraṇatvavivakṣayā saptamī | alaṃ dattā ābhā dīptiḥ yayā sā tathoktā tayā | pakṣe sureṣu viṣaye dattaṃ abhayaṃ yayā sā tathoktā | udadheḥ kṣīrodājjātā udadhijā | tayā tathoktayā | pakṣe ut utkṛṣṭaḥ adhi adhikaḥ jayaḥ yasyāssā tathoktā | sarvabhūtānāṃ dhātryā savitryā lokamātrā | śriyetyarthaḥ | akhilaṃ etadbhuvanaṃ darataḥ saṃsārabhayāt tatre trātam | karmaṇi liṭ | 'bhītrārthānām' iti pañcamī | pakṣe sarvabhūtadhātrī ādarata iti chedaḥ | sarvabhūtadhātrī bhūḥ ‘bhūtadhātryabdhimekhalā' ityamaraḥ | ādarataḥ ādarāt akhilaṃ etadbhunaṃ tatre trāyate sma | trāyateḥ kartari liṭ | atra sarvabhūtadhātryādarata ityatra padaśleṣo'pi veditavyaḥ || yathāvā kṣemakṛto dāmabhṛtassthemapuṣassakaladuritanāmamuṣaḥ | sarasīruhavāsinyāssadṛśā dadatāṃ śriyaṃ mamāpāṅgāḥ || 894 || atra sarasīruhavāsinyāssadṛśā iti tadapāṅgānāṃ viśeṣitatvāt kṣemakṛta ityādīni padāni tasyāsteṣāṃ cāvipariṇāmenaiva viśeṣaṇānīti bodhyam | ata eva ṣaṣṭhīprathamayorvibhaktyoḥ ekavacanabahuvacanayośca śleṣa ityavadheyam || yathāvā namadavanāsvapnatarāvamlānau sarvasaṃpadāmavanau | hṛdayamanuviharatāṃ phaṇigiridhāmaniviṣṭapādau naḥ || atra bhagavatpakṣe saptamyāḥ tatpādapakṣe prathamāyāśca vibhakteḥ śleṣaḥ | tathāhi namatāṃ nantṝṇāṃ aghane prīṇane viṣaye asvapnatarussuradrumaḥ tasmiṃstathābhūte sarvepsitadātarīti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe namadavane atiśayenāsvapnau asvapnatarau atijāgarūkāvityarthaḥ | prathamādvivacanam | evamagre'pi | amlānau avidyamānā mlāniḥ harṣakṣayo yasya tathokte | pakṣe na mlānau amlānau glānivihīnāvityarthaḥ | sarvasaṃpadāṃ avanau bhūmau ādhārabhūta ityarthaḥ | pakṣe rakṣakāvityarthaḥ | phaṇigiriḥ dhāma sthānaṃ yasya tasmin phaṇigiridhāmani | viṣṭapānāṃ lokānāmādau prathame jagatkāraṇabhūte parasmin brahmaṇi naḥ asmākaṃ hṛdayaṃ cittaṃ anuviharatām | lagnaṃ bhavatvityarthaḥ | anupūrvakāt hṛñastaṅi loṭprathamapuruṣaikavacanam | pakṣe phaṇigiridhāmaniviṣṭapādau iti samastaṃ padam | phaṇigiririti yaddhāma sthānaṃ tasmin niviṣṭaḥ sthitaḥ śrīnivāsa ityarthaḥ | tasya pādau caraṇau | naḥ hṛdayaṃ cittaṃ anu 'anurlakṣaṇe' iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyāṃ ‘karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā' iti hṛdayaśabdāddvitīyā | viharatāṃ krīḍatām | hṛñaḥ parasmaipadino loṭprathamapuruṣadvivacanam | ‘tasthasthamipāṃ tāṃtaṃtāmaḥ' iti tasastāmādeśaḥ | atraikavacanadvivacanayoḥ ikārokārayoḥ ikārākārayorvarṇayoyośca śleṣaḥ || yathāvā drāghīyovikhyātāvatipraśastau nitāntaparipuṣṭau | cetoharau sadā''stāṃ doṣaudāsyaṃ vitanvato'sya mama || 896 || drāghīyasī vikhyātiryasya tasmin tathokte iti bhagavatpakṣe | drāghīyo yathā syāttathā vikhyātau drāghīyāṃsāviti vikhyātāviti vā tadbhujapakṣe | evamagre'pi | atiśayitā praśastiryasya saḥ atipraśastiḥ tasmin | pakṣe atiśayena praśastau | nitāntā paripuṣṭiryasya tathokte | pakṣe nitāntaṃ paripuṣṭau puṣṭimantau | harau uktavidhe bhagavati doṣaudāsyaṃ doṣeṣu audāsyaṃ udāsīnatāṃ vitanvataḥ asya mama cetaḥ kartṛ sadā āstāṃ upaviśatāt ‘āsa upaveśane' loṭprathamapuruṣaikavacanam | pakṣe cetoharāviti samastaṃ padam | sadā stāṃ doṣau dāsyaṃ iti chedaḥ | asya prastutasya bhagavataḥ doṣau bāhū 'bhujabāhū praveṣṭo doḥ' ityamaraḥ | dāsyaṃ śeṣatvaṃ vitanvataḥ vistārayataḥ mama sadā cetoharau cittahāriṇau stāṃ bhavatām | asterloṭprathamapuruṣadvivacanaṃ, ‘śnasorallopaḥ' ityakāralopaḥ | atra saptamīprathamayorvibhaktyoḥ tadekavacanadvivacanayośca śleṣaḥ | sadāstāmityatra padaśleṣaḥ | tiṅvibhaktivacanaśleṣaśca || yathāvā ādṛtasumanasseve śubhaguṇamahite sadā'pi lakṣmipade | ghanarucibhūmni yaśasvini nanu medhāvati manohare bhavati || 897 || atra śrīśrīnivāsayorviṣaye krameṇa saṃbuddhisaptamyorvibhaktyośśleṣaḥ | tathāhi, śrīpakṣe ādṛtasumanaḥ seve śubhaguṇamahi te sadā api lakṣmi pade nanu medhāvati manohare bhavati iti chedaḥ | ādṛtāḥ sumanaso budhāḥ yayā sā ādṛtasumanāḥ tasyāssaṃbuddhiḥ he ādṛtasumanaḥ ! śubhaguṇānāṃ mahi ! nivāsabhūme ! ghanaḥ sāndraḥ rucibhūmā yasyāssā tasyāssaṃbuddhiḥ he ghanarucibhūmni ! 'ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām' iti vaikalpiko ṅīp | yaśasvini ! pūrvavatsaṃbuddhiḥ | medhā asyā astīti medhāvatī tasyāssaṃbuddhiḥ | manohare ! manojñe ! he bhavati ! pūjye mātariti vā | he lakṣmi ! sadā'pi te tava pade caraṇe seve bhaje iti || bhagavatpakṣe tu ādṛtasumanasseve śubhaguṇamahite sadā api lakṣmipade nanu me dhāvati manaḥ hare bhavati iticchedaḥ | nanu hare ! he bhagavan ! ādṛtā sumanasāṃ vibudhānāṃ sevā yena tasmiṃstathokte | śubhaguṇaiḥ mahitaḥ tasmin | lakṣmyāḥ padaṃ sthānaṃ lakṣmipadaṃ tasmiṃstathokte śrīnivāse ityarthaḥ | lakṣmīśabdasyāṅyantatayā samāse ‘iko hṛsvo'ṅyo gālavasya' iti vaikalpiko hṛsvaḥ ‘lakṣmaṇo lakṣmisaṃpannaḥ' itivat | ghanasyāmbudasya rucibhūmeva rucibhūmā yasya tasmin | yaśasvini 'tasya nāma mahadyaśaḥ' ityuktarītyā kīrtimati | bhūmni praśaṃsāyāṃ vā matvarthīya iniḥ | bhavati tvayi me manaḥ cittaṃ dhāvati pravartate | atra padaśleṣādikamapi draṣṭavyam || yathāvā svāmini jagatāṃ lakṣmīkāmini varade vibhāvatimanojñe | bhavatānmanastvayi śubhe bhavarahite padmajātahṛnmahite || 898 || atrāpi pūrvavadeva saṃbuddhisaptamyoḥ śleṣaḥ | tathāhi, lakṣmīpakṣe varadevi bhāvati manojñe bhavatāt manaḥ tvayi śubhe bhavarahite iti chedaḥ | he svāmini ! aiśvaryaśālini ! jagatāṃ lakṣmīṃ kāmayate iti lakṣmīkāminī | tasyāssaṃbuddhiḥ| jagatāmaiśvaryadānābhilāṣiṇītyarthaḥ | bhāḥ asyā astīti bhāvatī tasyāssaṃbuddhiḥ | tejasvinītyarthaḥ | manojñe manohāriṇi | śubhe kalyāṇi | bhavarahite karmakṛtajanmavidhure | padmānāṃ jātaṃ bṛndaṃ ‘jātaṃ janasamūhayoḥ' iti viśvaḥ | tasya hṛdi madhyadeśe karṇikāyāmityarthaḥ | mahite pūjite 'padme sthitāṃ, tāṃ padmanemim' iti ca śruteḥ | he varadevi! varā ca sā devī ca varadevī tasyāssaṃbuddhiḥ devadivyamahiṣītyarthaḥ| 'devo kṛtābhiṣekāyām' ityamaraḥ | tvayi manaḥ kartṛ, mameti śeṣaḥ | bhavatāt vartatām | bhavaterloṭprathamaikavacanam | ‘tuhyostātaṅāśiṣyanyatarasyām' ityāśīrarthe tostātaṅ | tvayyeva lagnaṃ bhavatvityarthaḥ | bhagavatpakṣe varade vibhau atimanojñe bhavatāt manaḥ tu ayi śubhebhavarahite iti chedaḥ | jagatāṃ svāmī īśvaraḥ tasmin varade abhīṣṭaprade | vibhau sarvavyāpini | atimanojñe | śubhaḥ ‘maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam' ityukteḥ | sa cāsau ibhavarāya gajendrāya hitaḥ śubhebhavarahitaḥ gajendrahitakārītyarthaḥ | tathokte | yadvā śubhaḥ niśśreyasarūpakalyāṇakaraḥ ibhasya gajasya varaḥ varadānamiti yāvat | tasmai hitaḥ tasmin | padmajāto brahmā tasya hṛdā manasā mahitaḥ pūjitaḥ tasmin lakṣmīkāmini śriyaḥpatyau | ayi manaḥ ! he hṛdaya ! bhavatāt bhūyāḥ | tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe | bhagavatyeva saktaṃ bhūyā ityarthaḥ | bhavatereva loṇmadhyamaikavacane heḥ āśiṣi tātaṅ | atra strīpuṃsaliṅgayośśleṣaḥ | varadevibhāvatimanojñe ityādau padaśleṣaḥ | bhavatādityatra puruṣaśleṣaśceti bodhyam || yathāvā kuvalayadalāsitimnaśśriya ākāṅkṣāmyapāṅgarucibhūmnaḥ | bhagavata uccamahimnaḥ paguṇatamaiśvaryadānanissīmnaḥ || 899 || atra lakṣmīkaṭākṣaviṣaye dvitīyāyāḥ bhagavadviṣaye pañcamyāśca vibhakteḥ śleṣaḥ | tadbahuvacanaikavacanayośca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi kuvalayadalasya asitimevāsitimā yeṣāṃ tān kuvalayadalāsitimnaḥ | bhagavataḥ śrīnivāsādapi uccamahimnaḥ atiśayitavaibhavān | ata eva praguṇatamaṃ atimātraṛju yadaiśvaryaṃ tasya dāne nissīmnaḥ udvelānityarthaḥ | ‘ṛjāvajihmapraguṇau' ityamaraḥ | śriyaḥ lakṣmyāḥ apāṅgānāṃ kaṭākṣānāṃ rucibhūmnaḥ prakāśātiśayān ākāṃkṣāmi | lakṣmīkaṭākṣarucayo mayi prasarantvityāśāsa iti bhāvaḥ || pakṣe kuvalayadalāsitimna ityādīni bhagavata ityasya viśeṣaṇāni pañcamyekavacanāntāni | nīlotpaladalaśyāmalādityarthaḥ | apāṅgasya anaṅgasya rucibhūmeva rucibhūmā yasya tasmāt kandarpatulyasaundaryādityarthaḥ | uccamahimnaḥ niratiśayabhūmnaḥ praguṇatamaiśvaryadānanissīmnaḥ ukta evārthaḥ | bhagavataḥ uktavidhāt śrīnivāsāt śriyaḥ muktaiśvaryaparyantāssaṃpadaḥ ākāṃkṣāmi abhilaṣyāmīti | atra bhagavata ityatra pañcamīṣaṣṭhyekavacanayoḥ śriya ityatra ṣaṣṭhyekavacanadvitīyābahuvacanayośca śleṣaḥ || yathāvā ghanakaruṇānuttānāṃ bhajeyaśobhābhṛtāṃ subahudānām | sarasīruhadhāmadhṛtāṃ paraṃparāṃ mādṛśāṃ śriyamavitrīm || 900 || atra śrīviṣaye tatkaṭākṣaviṣaye ca dvitīyāṣaṣṭhyorvibhaktayoḥ śleṣaḥ | tathāhi ghanayā karuṇayā anuttānā na uttānā gambhīrā tāṃ tathoktām | ‘nimnaṃ gabhīraṃ gambhīramuttānaṃ tadviparyaye' ityamaraḥ | ‘triṣvāgādhāt' ityukterbhedyaliṅgatā | pakṣe ghanakaruṇayā nuttānāṃ preritānāmiti ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanam | evamagre'pi | 'nuttanunnāstaniṣṭhyūtaviddhakṣipteritāssamāḥ' ityamaraḥ| nuderniṣṭhāyāṃ ‘nudavidondītrāghrāhībhyo'nyatarasyām' iti natvavikalpānuśāsanāt niṣṭhātasya pūrvasya dasya ca na natvaṃ, kiṃtu cartvam | bhaje yaśobhābhṛtām iti chedaḥ | yaśaśca bhā ca yaśobhe tābhyāṃ bhṛtāṃ pūrṇām | atra bhāśabdasya dvandve alpāctaratvanimittakapūrvanipātābhāvo na doṣāya | ‘samudrābhrāddhaḥ, lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ' ityādiniveśena tasya prakaraṇasyānityatājñāpanāt | yadvā yaśaso bhā prakāśaḥ tayā bhṛtāmiti vigrahaḥ | pakṣe bhajeyeti chedaḥ | śobhāṃ bibhratīti śobhābhṛtaḥ tāsām | subahu dānaṃ vitaraṇaṃ yasyāstām | pakṣe subahu dadatīti subahudāḥ tāsāṃ 'āto'nupasarge' iti kaḥ | sarasīruhameva dhāma sthānaṃ tena dhṛtāṃ kamalālayāmityarthaḥ | pakṣe sarasīruhāṇāṃ dhāma tviṣaṃ dharantīti tathoktānām | dhṛñaḥ kvip | paraṃ atimātraṃ parāṃ uttamāṃ mādṛśāṃ madvidhānāṃ avitrīṃ pālayitrīṃ śriyaṃ lasmīṃ bhaje seve | laṭ | pakṣe śriyaṃ saṃpadaṃ avitrīṃ avatestṛn | ‘na loka' iti ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhātkarmaṇi dvitīyā | māyāḥ śriyaḥ dṛśaḥ kaṭākṣāḥ tāsāṃ mādṛśāṃ paraṃparāṃ rekhāṃ bhajeya seveya, liṅ | atroktayorvibhaktyorekavacanabahuvacanayośca śleṣaḥ | bhajeyaśobhetyatra paraṃparāmityādau ca padaśleṣaścānusandheyaḥ || yathāvā duritabhide sarvavide natanivaheṣṭārthakalpabhūmiru he | kamalāprakhyātibhṛte namostu mama daivate sadā'bjadhṛte || 901 || atra bhagavadviṣaye caturthyāḥ śrīviṣaye saptamyāśca vibhakteḥ śleṣaḥ | tathāhi duritāni bhinattīti duritabhit tasmai duritabhide | ‘satsūdviṣa' ityādinā kvip | pakṣe bhinattīti bhidaṃ 'igupadhajñā' ityādinā kaḥ | tasmin | evamagre'pi | sarvavide sarvaṃ vetti vindati vā sarvavit tasmai 'yassarvavit' iti śruteḥ | pakṣe sarvajñe iti, natanivaheṣṭārthānāṃ kalpabhūruṭ kalpataruḥ tasmai | abhīpsitārthapradāyetyarthaḥ | pakṣe kalpabhūmiruhaḥ tasmin | kamalayā śriyā yā prakhyātiḥ tāṃ bibhartīti kamalāprakhyātibhṛt tasmai śrīnirūpitasvarūpāyetyarthaḥ| ‘hrīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyau, sumajjānaye viṣṇave' | yadapāṅgāśritaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam | yasya vakṣasi sā devī prabhā'gneriva tiṣṭhati || sa vai sarveśvaraśśrīmān kalyāṇaguṇasāgaraḥ | ityādiśrutipurāṇavacanānyatrānusandheyāni | pakṣe kamaleti prakhyātyā bhṛtaṃ pūrṇaṃ tasmin | abjaṃ śaṅkhaṃ dharatītyabjadhṛt tasmai | pakṣe padmena dhṛte ityarthaḥ | ‘padme sthitām' ityādiśruteḥ | mama daivate mahālakṣmīrūpe daivate | sadā namaḥ astu | pakṣe daiva te iti padadvayam | he mama daiva ! madbhāgadheyarūpa ! bhagavan ! te tubhyaṃ namaḥ astu | ‘namassvasti' ityādinā caturthī | atra padaśleṣo'pi draṣṭavyaḥ || yathāvā prabhave'khilabhuvanānāṃ vibhave tattādṛśe svamātmānam | surarājaśrījīvanadayālave nanu samarpaye mahite || 902 || atrāpi pūrvavadeva śleṣaḥ| he surarāja! devadhīśa! he śrījīvana! śriyo lakṣmyā jīvanabhūta! śrīrjīvanaṃ yasya tasya saṃbuddhirvā he śrīnivāsetyarthaḥ | akhilabhuvanānāṃ prabhave adhīśvarāya | vibhave vyāpakāya ca | tattādṛśe avāṅmanasagocarasvarūpasvabhāvavibhavāyeti bhāvaḥ | tattādṛkchabdastādṛkchabdasamānārthakaḥ | yathā tattulyaśabdastulyaśabdasamānārthakaḥ | saḥ tādṛk yasya sa tathokta iti vā | asadṛśāyeti tadarthaḥ | dayālave kṛpāśāline ‘spṛhigṛhi' ityādinā kartaryālucpratyayaḥ | te tubhyaṃ svaṃ ‘svatvamātmani sañjātaṃ svāmitvaṃ brahmaṇi sthitam' ityuktaprakāreṇa svabhūtaṃ ātmānaṃ samarpayemahi | saṃpūrvakādarpayaterliṅuttamabahuvacanam || pakṣe akhilabhuvanānāṃ prabhavo jagatkāraṇabhūta ityarthaḥ | tasmiṃstathokte | surarājaśrījīvanadayālave iti samastamekaṃ padam | surarājaśriya indraiśvaryasya jīvanaḥ jīvayitā dayāyā lavo leśaḥ yasya tasmin, prasiddhyatīdaṃ vaiṣṇave purāṇe | mahite pūjye tattādṛśe vibhave vibhūtau bhagavatyāṃ śrīmahālakṣmyāmityarthaḥ | śrībhāgavate ‘vakṣonivāsamakarotparamaṃ vibhūteḥ' iti lakṣmīrvibhūtitvena hi vyapadiśyate | nanuravadhāraṇe | lakṣmyāmevetyarthaḥ | svaṃ ātmānaṃ samarpaye | saṃpūrvakādarpayaterlaḍuttamaikavacanam | atra śeṣidaṃpatyorātmanikṣepa uktaḥ || yathāvā bhavamayapāśalavitre bhajamānānāṃ viśālaśubhanetre| nikhilacarācaradhātryā nijamātmānaṃ nivedayepatye || 903 || atrāpi pūrvavadeva śleṣaḥ | bhagavatpakṣe bhajamānānāṃ bhaktānāṃ bhavamayassaṃsārarūpaḥ yaḥ pāśaḥ tasya lāvitā chettā tasmai tathoktāya, lūñastṛc | viśālaṃ vipulaṃ śubhaṃ niśśreyasarūpaṃ kalyāṇaṃ tasya netā prāpayitā tasmai, ṇīñastṛc | nikhilacarācaradhātryāḥ sakalalokajananyāḥ śriyaḥ patye bhartre nijaṃ ātmānaṃ nivedaye arpaye sarvalokaśaraṇyāya rāghavāya mahātmane | nivedayata māṃ kṣipraṃ vibhīṣaṇamupasthitam || ityatreva ‘kriyayā yamabhipraiti so'pi saṃpradānam' ityuktarītyā saṃpradānasaṃjñāyāṃ patiśabdasya caturthī | śrīpakṣe bhajamānānāṃ bhavamayapāśasya lavitraṃ dātraṃ tasmin | ‘artilūdhūsūkhanasahacara itraḥ' iti lūnāteritrac ‘dātraṃ lavitram' ityamaraḥ | chettarītyarthaḥ | viśāle śubhe netre yasya tasmin | nikhilacarācaradhātryāḥ sakalaṃbhūtadhātryāḥ bhuvaḥ | yadvā nikhilāḥ pūrṇāḥ carācarāḥ jaṅgamasthāvarāḥ yasyāṃ sā tathāvidhāyāḥ dhātryāḥ bhuvaḥ ‘vipulā gahvarī dhātrī' ityamaraḥ | nivedaye'patye ityatra apatye iti chedaḥ | apatye duhitari | ‘sutaḥ putraḥ striyāṃ tvamī | āhurduhitaraṃ sarve'patyaṃ tokaṃ tayossame, ityamaraḥ | bhagavatyāṃ janakanandinyāmityarthaḥ | nijaṃ ātmānaṃ nivedaye | ‘nivedayīta svātmānaṃ viṣṇāvamalatejasi' ityatreva saṃpradānasyādhāratvavivakṣayā apatyaśabdātsaptamī | atra padaliṅgaśleṣāvapi draṣṭavyau || yathāvā sundaryagraṇyāṃ paradaivatavāmabhruvāmudāradhiyām | añjalayo nipatantassañjanayantyakhilasaṃpadaṃ tāsām || 904 || atra ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyorvibhaktyoḥ śleṣaḥ, tadbahuvacanaikavacanayorapi | sundarīṇāṃ agraṇyāṃ agragaṇyāyām | udāradhiyāṃ mahāprajñāyāṃ vadānyamanīṣāyāṃ vā | paradaivatasya bhagavataḥ vāmabhruvāṃ lalanāyāṃ lakṣmyām | sarvatra 'ṅerāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ' iti ṅerāmādeśaḥ | nipatantaḥ śrīviṣaye ahamahamikayā samudayanta ityarthaḥ | tāsāṃ sundaryagraṇyāmityādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭānāmityarthaḥ | tāsāmityuktyā pradarśitānāṃ saptamyekavacanāntānāṃ padānāṃ ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanāntatvaṃ jñāpitam | tathāhi sundarīṇāṃ agraṇyāṃ agragaṇyānāṃ, anadyantatvādāmo na nuṭ | udāradhiyāṃ mahāmatīnām | parāṇi ca tāni daivatāni caturmukhādayo devāḥ teṣāṃ yāḥ vāmabhruvaḥ mahilāḥ parāśca tāḥ daivatavāmabhruvaścaiti vā tāsāṃ ‘bṛndārakā daivatāni' ityamaraḥ | vāṇīrudrāṇīndrāṇīprabhṛtīnāṃ surasudatīnāmityarthaḥ | ubhayatra 'vā'mi' iti nadīsaṃjñāyā vikalpitatvena tadabhāvādāmo na nuṭ | akhilasampadaṃ janayantīti yojanā || prakṛtiśleṣaḥ aśliṣṭapratyayakṛtā prakṛtyoścetsarūpatā | sa eṣa prakṛtiśleṣo dvidhā suptiṅapekṣayā | nānārūpayoḥ prakṛtyoḥ aśliṣṭapratyayakṛtaṃ cetsārūpyaṃ sa prakṛtiśleṣaḥ | dvivacanaṃ bahūnāmapyupalakṣakam | sa ca supratyayāpekṣastiṅpratyayāpekṣaśceti dviprakārakaḥ | aśliṣṭeti pratyayaviśeṣaṇaṃ pratyayaśleṣe atiprasaṅgavāraṇāya | pratyayaśliṣṭatāyāṃ sa eva hi bhaviṣyati || tatrādyo yathā citraṃ harikṛpayā yaḥ kupayā yo devatāntarasyāpi | vṛddhiṃ bhajeta sa pumān sukṛtīśastomahāvyasanarutsyāt || 905 || yaḥ harikṛpayā vṛddhiṃ bhajeta sa pumān sukṛtī puṇyavān śastaḥ samastalokastutaḥ mahānti vyasanāni vipadaḥ ruṇaddhīti mahāvyasanarut | rudheḥ kvipi jaśtvacartve | vipallepavidhurassyāt | vibhīṣaṇādivaditi bhāvaḥ | yo'pi devatāntarasya kṛpayā vṛddhiṃ bhajeta so'pi pumān uktavidha eva bhavediti citram | vastutastu sukṛtīśastomaheticchinnaṃ samastamidaṃ padam | sukṛtīśāḥ puṇyavadagragaṇyāḥ teṣāṃ stomaṃ vyūhaṃ hantīti sukṛtīśastomahā ‘anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' iti hantervic | na tu kvip ‘brahmabhruṇavṛtreṣu kvip' ityatra caturvidhaniyamāśrayaṇāt | etena ‘mātṛhā vai tvamasi pitṛhā vai, viśrutātmā surārihā, pumān bhavābdhiṃ na taretsa ātmahā' ityādiprayogā vyākhyātāḥ | vyasanaiḥ ‘mṛgayā'kṣā divāsvapna' ityādyuktaiḥ kāmajairdaśābhiḥ, ‘paiśunyaṃ sāhasaṃ drohaḥ' ityādyuktairaṣṭabhiḥ krodhajaiśca doṣaiḥ roditi aśru vimuñcatīti tathoktaḥ | ruderaśruvimocanārthakātkvip, cartvam | uktavidhavyasanavargakṣubhitahṛdayo bhavet | rāvaṇādivaditi bhāvaḥ | 'vyasanaṃ vipadi bhraṃśe doṣe kāmajakopaje' ityamaraḥ | atra rudhirudyoḥ kvicnimittakaṃ sārūpyamiti prakṛtiśleṣaḥ | sukṛtītyādau padaśleṣo'pi | yathāvā sādhusamityagresarayudyo bahuśāstravijjayati śatrūn | sa hi viracitaśubharakṣovairiyaśastudbhavenmahādhīraḥ || 906 || atra bhagavadbhakto vidvān prastutaḥ aprastutastu śūraḥ tayoḥ śleṣaḥ | yaḥ pumān sādhūnāṃ viduṣāṃ samitau sabhāyāṃ ye agresarāḥ tairyautītyagresarayut | ‘yu miśraṇe' ityasmādādādikāddhātoḥ kvipi tuk | satsaṅgaśālītyarthaḥ | anyatra sādhu yathā syāttathā samitau yuddhe ‘samitissāṃparāye syātsabhāyāṃ saṅgame'pi ca' iti medinī | ye agresarāḥ taiḥ yuddhyata iti tathā | yuddhyateḥ kvip | jaśtvacartve | bahūni śāstrāṇi vettīti tathā | videḥ ‘satsūdviṣa' ityādinā kvip | cartvam | pakṣe śastrāṇāṃ mamūhaśśāstraṃ bahu yacchāstraṃ tena vidhyatīti tathā | vidhyateḥ kvipi jaśtvacartve | śatrūn kāmādinityavairiṇaḥ, pakṣe arātīn jayati abhibhavati | saḥ mahādhīraḥ mahāvidvān atidhairyavāṃśca pumān | ‘dhīrassyāttriṣu paṇḍite | svacchande dhairyayukte ca' iti medinī | viracitaṃ śubhaṃ maṅgalaṃ yena tattathoktaṃ yat rakṣovairiyaśaḥ daityārikīrtiḥ tat stautīti tathoktaḥ jaganmaṅgalabhagavaddivyayaśoviṣayakaprabandhapraṇetā | parāśaravyāsādivaditi bhāvaḥ | stauteḥ kvipi tuk | pakṣe viracitā śubhānāṃ kalyāṇānāṃ rakṣā śubhā vā rakṣā yena sa tathoktaḥ | viśiṣya jagatkṣemaṅkara ityarthaḥ | bhinnaṃ padam | vairiṇāṃ yaśaḥ tudatīti tathoktaḥ | tudateḥ kvip | bhavet | atra yautiyudhyatoḥ vettividhyatyoḥ yaśaśśabdopapadakastautitudatyośca kvipi sārūpyamitīdṛśaprakṛtyossupprakṛtyapekṣayoḥ śleṣaḥ | uttarārdhe padaśleṣo'pi || yathāvā tvadabhimukho bhavamuksyāttvadvimukhaścāpi pannaganagendo | ubhayorapi mahatī rukprabhavatyanayoritīdamāścaryam || 907 || tvadabhimukhaḥ tvadvimukhaścāpi bhavamuk bhavaṃ saṃsāraṃ muñcatīti tathoktaḥ | muceḥ kvip 'coḥ kuḥ' iti kutvam | pakṣe bhave saṃsāre bhavena vā muhyatīti tathoktaḥ | muheḥ kvipi 'vā druhamuhaṣṇuhaṣṇihām' iti hasya vaikalpikaṃ ghatvaṃ, jaśtvacartve | anayorubhayorapi mahatī ruk ruci dīptiḥ 'syuḥ prabhārugruciḥ' ityamaraḥ | rucerdīptyarthakātkvip | pakṣe ruk rogaḥ "strī rugrujā ca' ityamaraḥ | rujeḥ kvip | ubhayatra jaśtvacartve | atra bhavaśabdopapadakayormuñcatimuhyatyoḥ kevalayo rucirujyośca kvipi sārūpyamiti prakṛtiśleṣaḥ || yathāvā bhavapāśabandhamuḍiti tvāṃ tvatto'nyaṃ ca nātha nigadāmaḥ | jānātyanekadhātuprakṛtijño'nte budhastadākūtam || 908 || he nātha! tvāṃ tvadanyaṃ caturmukhādikaṃ ca bhavapāśabandhamuḍiti nigadāmaḥ | vividhaśleṣavaktāro vayamiti bhāvaḥ | tadākūtaṃ ubhayatra tādṛśaśabdaprayogābhiprāyaṃ tu ante nirṇayāvasare anekadhā bahuprakāreṇa nissandigdhamiti bhāvaḥ | prakṛtiṃ jagatkāraṇabhūtaṃ paraṃ brahma bhavabandhanidānabhūtāṃ mūlaprakṛtiṃ ca jānātīti prakṛtijñaḥ ‘prakṛtirguṇasāmye syādamātyādisvabhāvayoḥ | yonau liṅge pauravarge' iti medinī | yoniḥ kāraṇam | liṅgaṃ cihnaṃ 'prakṛtiryā mayā''khyātā' ityādau mūlaprakṛtāviva ‘vāsudevaḥ parā prakṛtiḥ, prakṛtiśva pratijñādṛṣṭāntānuparodhāt' ityādau prakṛtiśabdo hi jagatkāraṇe'pi prayuktaḥ | yadvā prakṛtiṃ tava tvadanyasya ca svabhāvaṃ jānātīti tathoktaḥ | bhavapāśacchettṛtvaṃ tava svabhāvaḥ | bhavapāśamugdhatvaṃ tvadanyasyeti jānanniti bhāvaḥ | athavā aneke bahavaḥ ye dhātavaḥ dhātāraḥ tattadaṇḍāntarvartinaścaturmukhāḥ teṣāṃ prakṛtiḥ kāraṇaṃ ‘yo brahmāṇaṃ vidadhāti pūrvam' ityādiśrutibhyaḥ | dhātuśabdo dhāñdhātoḥ ‘sitanigamimasisicyavidhāñkruśibhyastun' ityauṇādikatunpratyayena niṣpannatayā udantaḥ 'dhātuprasādānmahimānamātmanaḥ' ityatra vyāsāryairevameva niṣpāditaḥ || pakṣe ante bhavapāśabandhamuḍityatrāvasāne vidyamānāḥ aneke ye dhātavaḥ ‘muṭa ākṣepapramardanayoḥ, muṣa steye, muha vaicitye' iti dhātavaḥ krameṇa tudādau kryādau divādau ca paṭhitāḥ | tadrūpāḥ prakṛtīḥ kvippratyayaprakṛtīḥ jānātīti tathā | budhaḥ parāvaratattvavit śābdikaśca jānāti | bhavapāśabandhaṃ muṭatīti vā muṣṇātīti vā vigrahe kvipi ayaṃ śabdo bhagavadviṣayaḥ bhavapāśabandhena muhyatīti vigrahe kvipi niṣpanno bhagavadanyaviṣayaḥ tayoratra śleṣa iti tadabhiprāyaṃ vettītyarthaḥ | atra muṭamuṣamuhīnāṃ kvippratyaye sārūpyam | muṭimuṣyorjaśtvacartve | muhestu ‘vā drahamuha' iti vaikalpikaghatvābhāve ‘ho ḍhaḥ' iti ḍhatve jaśtvacartve iti bodhyam || yathāvā tvaṃ vimṛḍasi svato'cyuta bhaktataterāgasā tathā'ghānām | yogakṣemāṇāmapi bahudhātuviśeṣavittvidaṃ vidyāt || 909 || he acyuta! tvaṃ svataḥ svabhāvādeva vimṛṭ viśeṣeṇa mṛḍati sukhyatīti tathoktaḥ | aparicchinnasukhasvarūpa ityarthaḥ | 'prāṇo brahma kaṃ brahma khaṃ brahma yadvāva kaṃ tadeva khaṃ yadeva khaṃ tadeva kam' ityādau tathā śravaṇāt | tathā bhaktatateḥ tatsaṃbandhināṃ idamuttaratrāpyanveti | āgasāṃ aparādhānāṃ vimṛṭ viśeṣeṇa mṛṣyati kṣamata iti vimṛṭ | mahāparādhasahiṣṇurityarthaḥ | kiṃcāghānāṃ tadīyānāṃ duḥkhānāṃ vimṛṭ | viśeṣeṇa mārṣṭi śodhayatīti tathā | sakalavyasananiśśeṣayitetyarthaḥ| apica yogāḥ alabhyalābhāḥ kṣemāḥ labdhaparipālanāni teṣāṃ vimṛṭ vimṛśatīti vimṛṭ vicārayitetyarthaḥ | ananyāścintayanto māṃ ye janāḥ paryupāsate | teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ yogakṣemaṃ vahāmyaham || iti gānāt | idaṃ tu uktaṃ bhagavato guṇajātaṃ sarvamapi bahudhā 'bahubhyaśśrotavyaṃ bahudhā śrotavyam' | aṇubhyaśca mahadbhyaśca śāstrebhyo matimānnaraḥ | sarvatassāramādadyātpuṣpebhya iva ṣaṭpadaḥ || ityuktaprakriyayā bahuprakāreṇa | viśeṣavittu turavadhāraṇe | śāstrārthatattvavettaiva vidyāt jānīyāt | nānyaḥ yasya nāsti svayaṃ prajñā kevalaṃ tu bahuśrutaḥ | na sa jānāti śāstrārthaṃ darvī sūparasāniva | ityuktaprakāraḥ sthūlamatiriti bhāvaḥ | bahavo ye dhātuviśeṣāḥ tadvideva amumarthaṃ jānīyāt | nānyaḥ aśābdika ityarthopyupaskāryaḥ | atra krameṇa ‘mṛḍa sukhane' taudādika, ‘mṛṣa titikṣāyām' daivādikaḥ, 'mṛjū śuddhau' ādādikaḥ, ‘mṛśa āmarśane | taudādikaḥ | eṣāṃ caturṇāṃ dhātūnāṃ vipūrvakāṇāṃ kvipyaikarūpyam | pūrvodāharaṇe trayāṇāmaikarūpyamiti dhyeyam | atra vipūrvakāt mṛḍeḥ kvipi cartve mṛṣeḥ jaśtvena ḍatve cartve ca mṛjimṛśibhyāṃ tu ‘vraśca' ityādinā ṣatve jaśtvena ḍatve cartve vimṛḍiti tulyaṃ rūpam || evamādyassuppratyayāpekṣaḥ prakṛtiśleṣo nirūpitaḥ | tiñpratyayāpekṣo dvitīyaḥ prakāro yathā avaśādyastvāṃ nāmnā juhāva yaścādhvareṣu niyamātte | phalamubhayorapyanayorjalajākṣa niraṅkuśo bata dadāsi || 910 || yaḥ ajāmilādiḥ avaśāt haṭhāt tvāṃ nāmnā nārāyaṇādyabhidhānena juhāva āhūtavān ‘hveñ spardhāyāṃ śabde ca' iti bhauvādikāddhātorliṭ | ‘abhyastasya ca' ityabhyastībhaviṣyato hveñassaṃprasāraṇaṃ, tato dvitvam | yaśca yajamānaḥ uparicaravasuprabhṛtiḥ niyamāt ye tu vākaniṣanniṣṭhāstattatsaṃskārasaṃskṛtāḥ | te vai bhāgavatāśśuddhā vāsudevaikayājinaḥ | ityuktaprakriyayā śuddhayājitvarūpapāramaikāntyādityarthaḥ | adhvareṣu te tubhyaṃ juhāveti yojanā | hutavān tvāmuddiśya havirdattavānityarthaḥ | ‘hu dānādanayoḥ' asmājjauhotyādikāddhātorliṭ | dānaṃ ceha prakṣepaḥ | sa ca vaidhe ādhāre haviṣaśceti svabhāvāllabhyata ityāhuḥ | atra liṭi hvayatijuhotyoḥ prakṛteraikarūpyamiti tiñpratyayāpekṣaprakṛtiśleṣo'yam || yathāvā tasyāḥ kiyadiva bhāgyaṃ yā tvāṃ garbhe jagannivāsādhāt | yasyāśca śiśuriva bhavān stanyaṃ śaure jagatsavitā || 911 || he jagannivāsa! idaṃ ca saṃbodhanaṃ vivakṣitagarbhadhāraṇārhatvasyāścaryāvahatvaṃ dyotayitum | yā devakīti bhāvaḥ | tvāṃ garbhe adhāt dadhāra dadhāterluṅ | tasyāḥ bhāgyaṃ kiyat aparicchinnamityarthaḥ | ivaśabdo vākyālaṃkāre | jagatāṃ savitā janakaḥ idamapi vivakṣitastanyapānādbhutatvavyañjanāya | śiśuriva prākṛtastanaṃdhaya iva yasyāḥ yaśodāyā iti bhāvaḥ | stanyaṃ adhāt papā tasyāśca bhāgyaṃ kiyadiveti yojanā | ‘dheṭ pāne' luñ ‘vibhāṣā ghrādheṭśācchāsaḥ' iti vaikalpikassico luk | atra dhāñdheṭoḥ prakṛteraikarūpyam || yathāvā varayati vinatānakhilānuragadharādharakṛpā yaśaścaiṣām | kṣodayati ripūneṣāṃ tadīyasenāśca yadiha niśśeṣam || 912 || uragadharādharakṛpā kartrī akhilān vinatān varān śreṣṭhān karoti varayati | varaśabdāṇṇic | eṣāṃ vinatānāṃ yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ ca uruṃ vipulaṃ karoti varayati | uruśabdāṇṇāviṣṭhavadbhāve ‘priyasthira' ityādinā varādeśaḥ | tatra hetumāha kṣodayatītyādinā | yat yasmāt eṣā bhagavatkṛpā eṣāṃ vinatānāṃ ripūn kṣudrān kṛpaṇān karoti kṣodayati | kṣudraśabdāṇṇāviṣṭhavadbhāve ‘sthūladūra' ityādinā tasya yaṇādiparalopaḥ pūrvasya guṇaśca | tadīyāḥ vinataripusambandhinīḥ senāśca niśśeṣaṃ yathā syāt tathā kṣodaṃ karoti kṣodayati | kṣodaśabdāṇṇic | cūrṇayatītyarthaḥ | ‘cūrṇe kṣodaḥ' ityamaraḥ | atra varoruśabdayoḥ kṣudrakṣodaśabdayośca ṇijantayostipyaikarūpyātprakṛtiśleṣaḥ || yathāvā kalayati viṣayaṃ tava yaṃ karuṇārasameduraḥ kaṭākṣalavaḥ | lokeśvaradayite taṃ loke bṛndayati tasya vibhavāṃśca || 913 || he lokeśvaradayite ! karuṇārasameduraḥ tava kaṭākṣalavaḥ yaṃ pumāṃsaṃ viṣayaṃ kalayati gocarayati taṃ pumāṃsaṃ loke sarvasmin jane bṛndayati bṛndārakaṃ mukhyaṃ karoti | bṛndārakaśabdāṇṇāviṣṭhavadbhāve ‘priyasthira' ityādinā tasya bṛndādeśaḥ sarvopajīvyaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| 'bṛndārakau rūpimukhyau' ityamaraḥ | tasya vibhavāṃśca bṛndayati bṛndāni karoti saṃpuñjayati | tasminneva samāhārayatītyarthaḥ | bṛndaśabdāt ‘tatkaroti' iti ṇic | atra bṛndārakabṛndaśabdayorṇijantayostipyaikarūpyam | ādyayorudāharaṇayośśuddhadhāturūpaprakṛtyoraikarūpyam | anantarayostu ṇyantanāmadhātulakṣaṇaprakṛtyoriti vailakṣaṇyaṃ bodhyam || yathāvā tvadbhuktaśeṣamanaghaṃ bhaktyā'cyuta yena bhakṣyate puṃsā | sa hyātivāhikairapi hutavahamukhyairitīdamāścaryam || 914 || he acyuta ! anaghaṃ tvadbhuktaśeṣaṃ yena bhakṣyate adyate sa pumāt arcirādikairātivāhikairapi bhakṣyate hi ityetadāścaryam || seviṣyata iti tu tattvam | bhagavanniveditaśeṣaprasādāsvādanamahimnā arcirādikairātivāhikairapi mānyate pumān kimutānyairiti bhāvaḥ | niveditahaviśśeṣaṃ bhuktvā bhagavato'nagham | vyapohya sarvapāpāni mokṣamṛcchatyasaṃśayam || iti bhagavacchāstrīyapramāṇārtha ihānusandheyaḥ | atrādye'rthe bhakṣadhātoḥ karmaṇi yaki laṭ, dvitīye bhajadhātorlṛṭi syapratyaye 'coḥ kuḥ' iti kutve 'iṇkoḥ' iti syāvayavasasya ṣatvam | atra bhakṣerbhajeśca yaksyapratyayakṛtaṃ sārupyam | yadyapi pratyayavidhāvuddheśyatvaṃ prakṛtitvamiti bhakṣibhajyostiṅnirūpitaprakṛtitvāttayornaikarūpyaṃ, tathā'pi pratyayaniyatapūrvavṛttitvaṃ tadityabhyupagamena bhakṣyetyanayostiṅpūrvavṛttitayā prakṛtibhūtayoraikarūpyamiti nirvoḍhavyam | yadvā prakṛtiśleṣa ityasyāṅgaśleṣa ityarthaḥ | tathā satīdṛśodāharaṇasyāpi saṃgraho nirargala eva, vakṣyetyanayostiṅnirūpitāṅgatvena tayoścaikarūpyāt | 'yasmātpratyayavidhistadādipratyaye'ṅgam' iti hyaṅgalakṣaṇam || uktasyobhayavidhaprakṛtiśleṣasya saṅkaro'pi saṃbhavati |yathā dṛśye yogivaraistvayi nihitātmā'haṃ tvayā dayārdradṛśā | tvannāma vahannāsye narakārāte purā narake || 915 || yogivaraiḥ sukṣmadarśibhiḥ dṛśye 'dṛśyate tvagryayā buddhyā sūkṣmayā sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ' ityuktaprakāreṇa draṣṭuṃ yogye dṛśeḥ ‘ṝdupadhāt' iti kyap | tvayi nihitātmā vinyastātmā ahaṃ tvayā kartrā dayārdradṛśā karaṇena | yadvā dayārdradṛśeti bahuvrīhiḥ tvayetyasyaiva viśeṣaṇam | dṛśye iti āvṛttyā yojanā | iṣṭo bhavāmītyarthaḥ | dṛśeḥ karmaṇi yaki laḍuttamaikavacanam | āsye mukhe tvannāma vahan tvannāmoccārayanniti yāvat | narake niraye pakṣe vahannāsye ityatra na āsye iti chedaḥ | pureti niścayadyotako nipātaḥ | purā nāsye iti yojanā | niścayena kṣipto na bhaviṣyāmītyarthaḥ | kṣepaṇārthakādasyaterāṅpūrvakātkarmaṇi laḍuttamaikavacanam | ayaṃ ca laṭ ṣurāśabdayogādbhaviṣyadarthe | ‘yāvatpurānipātayorlaṭ' iti smaraṇāt | atra ṅi iṭ iti suptiṅpratyayaprakṛtyoḥ krameṇa kyabyagantayoḥ ṇyadyagantayoḥ ddaśyetyanayoḥ āsyetyanayośca prakṛtyoḥ śleṣa iti tayossaṅkīrṇatā | ubhayatra dhātvaikye'pi pratyayabhedakṛtaṃ bhedamādāya prakṛtiśleṣanirvāhaḥ | 'asyante varṇāḥ yena asyate grāso vā'sminnityāsyam |‘asu kṣepaṇe' ‘kṛtyalyuṭo bahulamiti ṇyat' ityamarasudhāyām | āsyandate āmlādinā prasravatītyāsyam | ‘syandū prasravaṇe' 'anyebhyopi dṛśyata iti ḍaḥ' ityapi tatraiva vyutpāditam | asminpakṣe tu āsye ityatra dhātubhedātprakṛtibhedaḥ spaṣṭa evetyalam | na kevalamatra prakṛtimātraśleṣaḥ, kintu pratyayaśleṣo'pīti vicchittiviśeṣo jñeyaḥ || na kevalaṃ suptiṅpratyayāpekṣa eva prakṛtiśleṣaḥ, kintu taddhitaprakṛtyapekṣo'pi saṃbhavati || yathā tvāmāśritaḥ prathīyāṃstadvibhavaścāpi nātha tava ghṛṇayā | tvatpratikūlastu bhavetsādhīyāṃstadvipattinivahaśca || 916 || he nātha ! tvāmāśritaḥ pumān tava ghṛṇayā kṛpayā prathīyān prathā nāma guṇavattāprakhyātiḥ sā'syāstīti prathāvān atiśayena prathāvān prathīyān bhavet | prathāśabdānmatubantādīyasuni ‘vinmatoḥ' iti matupo luk | tadvibhavaḥ bhagavadāśritasya vibhavo'pi prathīyān atiśayena pṛthuḥ ativipula ityarthaḥ | pṛthuśabdādīyasuni ‘ra ṛto halāderlaghoḥ' iti ṛkārasya rephādeśaḥ | tvatpratikūlastu tava ghṛṇayetyetadatrāpi saṃbadhyate | ghṛṇayā jugupsayā ‘jugupsākaruṇe ghṛṇe' ityamaraḥ | anarho'yamiti tvatkartṛkajugupsayetyarthaḥ | sādhīyān ādhinā saha vartata iti sādhiḥ | atiśayena sādhiḥ sādhīyān niratiśayamanovyatha ityarthaḥ | bhavet | tasya tvatpratikūlasya vipattinivaho'pi sādhīyān atiśayena bāḍhaḥ atimātradṛḍha ityarthaḥ | bāḍhaśabdādīyasuni ‘antikabāḍhayornedasādhau' iti sādhādeśa | 'gāḍhabāḍhadṛḍhāni ca' ityamaraḥ | atra prathāvatpṛthuśabdayoḥ sādhibāḍhaśabdayośca prakṛtestaddhitapratyaye pare aikarūpyam || tiṅtaddhitaprakṛtipratyayobhayaśleṣo'pi saṃbhavati | yathā asulabhamāśāsai kathamamṛtaṃ śrīśāradaghī mahānandāt | ityaṅga mā trapiṣṭhā iha katikati tena nāmṛtaṃ gamitāḥ || 917 || aghamasyāstītyaghī | nityayoge matvarthīya iniḥ | nityaduḥkhītyarthaḥ | ‘aṃhoduḥkhavyasaneṣvagham' ityamaraḥ | mahānandāt 'sa eko brahmaṇa ānandaḥ' ityuktaniravadhikānandāt | idamubhayoratimātrānānurūpyaṃ dyotayitum | śrīśāt bhagavataḥ asulabhaṃ durlabhaṃ amṛtaṃ niśśreyasaṃ kathaṃ āśāsai apekṣiṣīya | śveva devabhogyaṃ puroḍāśamiti bhāvaḥ | ‘eta ai' iti loḍuttamasya ekārasya aiādeśaḥ | iti evaṃ aṅga ! idaṃ kasyacidvā svasya vā saṃbodhanam | mā trapiṣṭhāḥ mā lajjiṣṭhāḥ ‘trapūṣ lajjāyām' asmālluṅi ūditvādvaikalpika iṭ | māṅyogādaḍabhāvaḥ | īdṛśo'haṃ tādṛśāśāsane kathaṃ na trapeyetyatrāha ihetyādinā | iha asmin loke tena śrīśena katikati trapiṣṭhā iti yojanā | atiśayena tṛprāḥ trapiṣṭhā janāḥ | tṛpraṃ duḥkhamiti mādhavaḥ | ayaṃ cātra tadvati vartate | tvattopyatiśayita duḥkhā ityarthaḥ | tṛpraśabdādatiśāyane'rthe iṣṭhani ‘priyasthira' ityādinā trapītyādeśaḥ | amṛtaṃ na gamitāḥ bhūyāṃsa eva niśśreyasaṃ nītāḥ | tvaṃ kutastadāśāsanāya lajjasa iti bhāvaḥ | atra trapadhātoḥ tṛpraśabdasya ca prakṛteḥ krameṇa iḍāśliṣṭathāsi tiṅi iṣṭhani taddhite caikarūpyam | evaṃ pratyayayorapyaikarūpyamiti dhyeyam || atha pratyayaśleṣaḥ prakṛtipratyayaughasyānekasya pratyayairyadi | śliṣṭaissarūpatā so'yaṃ pratyayaśleṣa ucyate || yatrānekeṣāṃ prakṛtipratyayasamudāyānāṃ tadghaṭakapratyayaśleṣanimittakaṃ sārūpyaṃ dṛśyate so'yaṃ pratyayaśleṣaḥ | ime ca prakṛtipratyayaśleṣalakṣaṇe rudraṭānurodhena varṇite | vastutastu sa eṣa prakṛtiśleṣaḥ prakṛtyoḥ śliṣṭatā yadi | śliṣṭatāyāṃ pratyayayoḥ pratyayaśleṣa iṣyate || ityetāvatī eva lakṣaṇe alaṃ, kāvyaprakāśādyanurodhitvāt | 'vibhaktervaicitryasya viśeṣahatutayā pṛthagupādānātpratyayapadaṃ tadatiriktaparam' iti kāvyapradīpakāraḥ || yathā kamitā śriyo madāgaḥ kṣamitā yatrāvabhāsate vitatā | amitā mamatāpāliśśamitānenāpsyate tathā'bhimatā || 918 || śriyaḥ kamitā bhagavān | anena puruṣakārasānnidhyamuktam | madāgaḥ mamāparādhaṃ kṣamitā soḍhā kṣamaterluṭ | ūdittvādvaikalpika iṭ | tatra hetumāha yatreti | yatra yasmin śrīvallabhe vitatā vistṛtā kṣamiteti yojanā | kṣamata iti kṣamī | kṣameḥ ‘śamityaṣṭābhyo ghinuṇ' iti ghinuṇ pratyayaḥ | ‘nodāttopadeśasya' iti vṛddhiniṣedhaḥ | tasya bhāvaḥ kṣamitā mahāparādhasahiṣṇutā avabhāsate | atha tatkāryamāha amitā mama tāpāliḥ ādhyātmikāditāpaparaṃparā śamitā śamiṣyati | śāmyaterluṭ | bhagavatā madāgasi kṣānte mama tāpatrayavyathā naṅkṣyatyevetyarthaḥ | na kevalametāvadeva, tathā anena mayetyarthaḥ | abhimatā śāstrasammatā śamitā śāmyatīti śamī pūrvavadeva ghinuṇ, vṛddhyabhāvaśca | tasya bhāvaḥ śamitā ‘śānto dāntaḥ' iti śrutā śāntatā bhagavadupāsanaupayikīti bhāvaḥ | āpsyate lapsyate | atra kṣamitā śamiteti prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasya tāstalpratyayaśleṣanimittakaṃ sārūpyamiti pratyayaśleṣaḥ || yathā agrāhi hṛdā bhagavān durviṣayasyendriyaṃ ca nikhilaṃ me | dhanyenābhāvi mayā mama bhavakāntāracāraduḥkhamapi || 919 || bhagavān hṛdā manasā mayeti śeṣaḥ | agrāhi agṛhyata dhyāta ityarthaḥ | graheḥ karmaṇi luṅi ciṇ | me mama nikhilaṃ indriyaṃ cakṣurādikaṃ ca idaṃ kartṛ, durviṣayasya karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | agrāhi agrāhakaṃ bhavatīti śeṣaḥ | graheḥ kartari 'nandigrahi' iti ṇiniḥ | ata eva mayā dhanyena kṛtārthena abhāvi | bhavaterbhāve luṅi ciṇ abhūyata | mama bhavakāntāracāraduḥkhamapi abhāvi na bhāvi abhāvi | itaḥparaṃ punarna bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ | 'bhaviṣyatigamyādayaḥ' iti bhaviṣyatyarthe ‘bhuvaśca' ityauṇādika iniḥ | sa ca ṇit | 'āṅiṇit' ityato ṇidityanuvṛtteḥ | tato nañsamāsaḥ | atra agrāhi abhāvītyubhayatrāpi ciṇṇinyoḥ pratyayayoraikarūpyam || yathāvā jagatāmādirabhūstvaṃ tava mahimā tvanidamādivacaso'pi | abhavastvaṃ phaṇiśaile tvāmāśrityāhamapi bhavāni hare || 920 || he hare! tvaṃ jagatāṃ ādiḥ 'yato vā imāni' ityuktarītyā kāraṇaṃ abhūḥ āsīḥ | bhavaterluṅ madhyamaikavacanam | tava mahimā tu anidamādivacaso'pi abhūḥ aviṣayaḥ 'yato vāco nivartante' iti śruteḥ | naño bhūśabdena samāsaḥ | tvaṃ evaṃjagatkāraṇabhūta iti bhāvaḥ | phaṇiśaile abhavaḥ jagadavanārthamarcātmanā prādurāsīrityarthaḥ | bhūdhātorlaṅmadhyamaikavacanam | tvāṃ āśritya ahamapi viṣayamarumarīcikāhariṇāyamānahṛdayo'pīti bhāvaḥ | abhavaḥ punarjanmavidhuraḥ bhavāni prārthanāyāṃ loṭ | bhavitumāśāse ityarthaḥ | atra abhūḥ abhavaḥ ityubhayatre'pi sipsupratyayayoraikarūpyam || yathāvā ācāryāṇāmabhimukhamatanormāṃ dūrato'sya bādhā me | tvaritaṃ harermamākhiladuritaṃ tasyāmba māṃ priyaṃ tanuyāḥ || 921 || he amba ! māṃ ācāryāṇāmabhimukhaṃ atanoḥ akaroḥ | tanoterlaṅi madhyamaikavacanam | asya atanorityāvartyate | atanoḥ kāmasya bādhā me mama dūrato bhavati | ācāryābhimukhyena kāmādayo māṃ na spṛśantīti bhāvaḥ | mama akhilaṃ duritaṃ pūrvamuttaraṃ cāghaṃ hareḥ apanudeḥ | hṛñassaṃbhāvanāyāṃ liṅmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanam | māṃ tasya harerityetadatrāvartyate | hareḥ bhagavataḥ priyaṃ 'saca mama priyaḥ' ityuktarītyā prītiviṣayaṃ tanuyāḥ kuryāśca | tanotessaṃbhāvanāyāṃ liṅ | ācāryābhimukhyadātrī tvaṃ uttarapūrvāghalopavināśapūrvakaṃ parame vyomni bhagavannityakiṃkaraṃ kuryā eveti sambhāvaye || yo me garbhagatasyāpi vṛttiṃ kalpitavān prabhuḥ | śeṣavṛttividhānāya sa kiṃ supto'thavāgataḥ || iti nyāyāditi bhāvaḥ | atra atanoḥ hareḥ ityatra sipṅasoraikarūpyam || yathāvā tvāmāśritasya pāto na kiṃtu so'pi tvayā dayājaladhe | tvaccaraṇau māmevaṃ kimanyadavaśiṣyate'rthanīyaṃ me || 922 || he dayājaladhe ! tvāṃ āśritasya pātaḥ adhogatiḥ pataterbhāve ghañ | na bhavati | kiṃtu, tvayā so'pi pātaḥ rakṣitaḥ pāteḥ karmaṇi ktaḥ | anenāniṣṭanivāraṇamiṣṭaprāptiścocyate | ‘pātastu rakṣite | patane ca' iti ratnamālā | āśritasyaivaṃvidhātiśayalābhe tava kimāyātamityatrāha tvaditi | tvaccaraṇau māṃ, ahamapi na kiṃ tavāśrita iti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ pātaḥ rakṣataḥ | pāterlaṭ prathamapuruṣadvivacanam | evamiti sābhinayanirdeśaḥ | āśritāntaraṃ tvameka eva rakṣasi | māṃ tu tvaccaraṇau dvau rakṣata iti tadapekṣayā mamaivātiśayalābha iti bhāvaḥ | anyat aniṣṭanivāraṇeṣṭaprāpaṇarūyarakṣaṇādanyat kiṃ mamāśāsyaṃ sarvasyāpi prārthanīyasyātraivāntargatatvāditi bhāvaḥ | atra dvitīyatṛtīyayorarthayossubantakṛtpratyayasya ktasya tiṅantataspratyayasya caikarūpyamiti pratyayaśleṣaḥ prāthamikapadaśleṣeṇa saṃkīrṇa iti pūrvebhyo viśeṣaḥ || atha vacanaśleṣaḥ sa bhavedvacanaśleṣaḥ śliṣyanti vacanāni cet || subvibhaktīnāṃ tiṇvibhaktīnāṃ vā vacanāni śliṣṭāni cedvacanaśleṣa ityarthaḥ | yathā khelantī harihṛdaye tudatī vipadaḥ prapuṣṇatī vibhavān | lakṣmīstaccaraṇe vā rundhāṃ mama cāpalāni dīvyantī || 123 || atra khelantī dīvyantī ityanayoḥ ‘śapchyanornityam' iti śīnadyoḥ parayornityaṃ num | tudatī ityatra tu na num | ‘ācchīnadyornum' iti vikalpena vihitatvāttasya | rundhā niruddhāni karotu kurutāmiti cārthaḥ | 'rudhir āvaraṇe' asmādātmanepadino loṭi prathamapuruṣaikavacanam | pakṣe tasmādeva dhātoḥ parasmaipadino loṭprathamapuruṣadvivacanam | atra khelantī ityādisubanteṣu rundhāmiti tiṅante caikavacanadvivacanayoḥ śleṣaḥ | liṅgaśleṣo'pyatra draṣṭavyaḥ || yathāvā sumahāmahāssvayaṃbhūkṛtabahudhāmāna ūrjitārcāvibhayaḥ | suśrīkamanāssatataṃ sarvātmānaḥ paraśriyaṃ sandadhatām || 924 || atra śrīparavāsudevasya śrīveṃkaṭācalādidivyadeśasthārcāvatārāṇāṃ ca śleṣaḥ | prathamapakṣe sumahat mahaḥ tejo yasya sa tathoktaḥ | svayaṃbhuvā vedhasā kṛtaḥ bahudhā bahuprakāraḥ mānaḥ pūjā yasya saḥ | ūrjitau arcā śrīveṅkaṭācalādigato'rcāvatāraḥ, vibhavaḥ rāmakṛṣṇādyavatāraśca yasya yena vā sa tathoktaḥ | satataṃ śobhanā śrīḥ lakṣmīḥ yasmiṃstat suśrīkaṃ mano yasya saḥ suśrīkamanāḥ| 'asyā devyā manastasmiṃstasya cāsyāṃ pratiṣṭhitam' ityuktarītyā'navaratamapi lakṣmīlālasamānasa ityarthaḥ | sarveṣāmātmā antaḥ praviśya niyantā paraḥ paravāsudevaḥ naḥ asmākaṃ śriyaṃ sarvaprakārasamṛddhiṃ saṃdadhatāṃ saṃdhattām | ‘dadha dhāraṇe' asmādbhauvādikālloṭprathamapuruṣaikavacanam | dvitīyapakṣe tu imāni viśeṣaṇāni bahuvacanāntāni, vibhava iti viśeṣyānurodhāt | sumahān mahaḥ utsavaḥ nityotsavapakṣotsavādiḥ yeṣāṃ te | ‘maha uddhava utsavaḥ' ityamaraḥ | adanto'yaṃ mahaśabdaḥ | svayaṃ ātmanā anitarapreraṇamityarthaḥ | bhuvi kṛtāni āśritāni bahūni dhāmāni veṃkaṭācalādisthānāni yaiste tathoktāḥ | ūrjitāḥ ūrjasvalāḥ arcāḥ pūjāḥ pratikṛtayo vā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | ‘arcā pūjāpratimayoḥ' iti medinī | śriyā lakṣmyāḥ kamanāḥ kāmayitāraḥ suṣṭhu śrīkamanāḥ suśrīkamanāḥ | suṣṭhu lakṣmyāḥ abhirūpā vā ‘kamanaḥ kāmuke kāme'bhirūpe'śokapādape' iti medinī | sarveṣāṃ cetanācetanānāṃ ātmānaḥ vibhavaḥ prabhavaḥ jagadīśvarā ityarthaḥ | tattaddivyadeśārcābahutvaprayuktaṃ bahuvacanam | satataṃ paraśriyaṃ śreṣṭhāṃ saṃpadaṃ saṃdadhatām | dadhāterjauhotyādikālloṭprathamabahuvacanam | atra sumahāmahā ityatra subante saṃdadhatāmityatra tiṅante ca prathamaikavacanabahuvacanayoḥ śleṣaḥ | svayaṃbhūkṛtetyādau tu padaśleṣa iti veditavyam | paraśriyamityatra samastatāyāṃ śakārasya 'anaci ca' iti vaikalpikaṃ dvitvam || yathāvā sakṛdapi vāmitratayā raghunandana yastvayā pura skriyate'lam | bhoktācaturaśrāṇāṃ rasābhṛtāṃ prāṇadaṃ saviṣayaṃ vā'yam || 926 || he raghunandana ! yaḥ pumān mitratayā suhṛttvena pakṣe amitratayā asuhṛttvena tvayā sakṛdapi vā puraskriyate pūjyate ādriyata iti yāvat | pakṣe abhiyujyata ityarthaḥ | ‘puraskṛtaḥ pūjite'rātyabhiyukte'grataḥ kṛte' ityamaraḥ | saḥ ayaṃ uktavidha eṣa pumān | catasraḥ aśraya koṭayo yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ tathoktānāṃ 'striyaḥ pālyaśrikoṭayaḥ' ityamaraḥ | ‘suprātasuśva' ityādinā bahuvrīhāvajantatayā nipātito'yam | caturdigantavidyamānānāmiti yāvat | rasābhṛtāṃ bhūpālānāṃ prāṇadaṃ śaktipradaṃ viṣayaṃ deśaṃ 'deśaviṣayau' ityamaraḥ | vāśabdo bhinnakramaḥ | alaṃ bhoktā vā bhokṣyatyeva pālayiṣyatyevetyarthaḥ | ‘bhuja pālanābhyavahārayoḥ' 'asmālluṭ | ‘vā syādvikalpopamayorevārthe ca tadavyayam' iti viśvaḥ || anyatra saḥ amitratayā abhiyuktaḥ pumān bhoktā acaturaḥ śrāṇāṃ iti chedaḥ | alaṃ acaturaḥ akuśalaḥ | nabhṛtā abhṛtā rasena abhṛtā rasābhṛtā tāṃ nīrasāmityarthaḥ | śrāṇāṃ yavāgūṃ 'yavāgūruṣṇikā śrāṇā' ityamaraḥ | bhoktā abhyavahartā pātetyarthaḥ | bhujestṛn | ata eva ‘na loka' iti niṣedhāt śrāṇetyatra na karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī kiṃtu dvitīyaiva | prāṇaṃ dyatīti prāṇadaṃ asūcchedakam | dehāntarānile prāṇo jīvātmaparamātmanoḥ | āyurindriyasattveṣu praṇave kāvyamarmaṇi || iti ratnamālā | ayaṃ avidyamānayakāraṃ viṣayaṃ viṣamityarthaḥ | śabdārthayostādātmyaṃ na prasmartavyam | tadvā bhoktā | tvadabhiyukto durgato yatra kvā kadannābhyavahāreṇa jīvati | tathā jīvitumanicchurgaralaṃ vā pibati | na tu tvadagrataḥ parākramata iti bhāvaḥ | atra caturaśrāṇāṃ rasābhṛtāmityatra ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanadvitīyaikavacanayośśleṣaḥ padaśleṣasaṃkīrṇaḥ | bhoktetyatra subantakṛttiṅoḥ śleṣaḥ | ayamityatra padaśleṣasaṃkīrṇaḥ prathamādvitīyayorvibhaktyośśleṣaśca || yathāvā sarvavido bhajatānnaścetassuguṇādimānyaduvarīyān | apratihataprabhāvānmahāsvabhāvān durantaduritanudaḥ || 927 || atra bhagavato bhāgavatānāṃ ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi vettīti vidaḥ, igupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ | sarvasya vidaḥ sarvavidaḥ sarvavit 'yassarvajñassarvavit' iti śruteḥ | suguṇādimān suguṇāḥ satyakāmatvādayaḥ kalyāṇaguṇāḥ ādayo yeṣāṃ te suguṇādayaḥ ādiśabdena svarūparūpādīnāṃ grahaṇam | te'sya santīti tathoktaḥ | nityayoge atiśāyane vā matup | apratihatā ca sā prabhā ca tadvān | 'na tatra sūryo bhāti' ityādyuktasūryādyabhibhāvukadivyaprabhāśālī | tatra hetuḥ mahatī ca sā svabhā ca tadvān mahāsvabhāvān lokottarasvayaṃprakāśasvarūpaḥ na hyasya prakāśassūryāderivānyādhīnaḥ | yadvā bhāḥ prabhāvaḥ ‘bhāḥ prabhāve ca dīptau ca' iti medinī | mahāprabhāvaśālītyarthaḥ | nudatīti nudaḥ, igupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ | durantaṃ yadduritaṃ tasya nudaḥ pūrvottarāghanirdhūnana ityarthaḥ | atiśayena uruḥ varīyān uruśabdādīyasuni ‘priyasthira' ityādinā varādeśaḥ | yaduṣu varīyān yaduvarīyān yadukulottaṃso bhagavān naḥ cetaḥ bhajatāt hṛdi saṃ nidhattāmityarthaḥ || pakṣe bhaja tān naḥ iti chedaḥ | naḥ asmākaṃ cetaḥ ! he manaḥ! sarvaṃ vidantīti sarvavidaḥ tān videḥ kvip | sarvajñānityarthaḥ | śobhanāḥ guṇāḥ ‘aṣṭāvātmaguṇā dayā sarvabhūteṣu kṣāntiranasūyā śaucamanāyāso maṅgalamakārpaṇyamaspṛhā' ityādigautamādyuktā mahāguṇāḥ yeṣāṃ te suguṇāḥ teṣu ādimāḥ agrimāḥ tāṃstathoktān ādiśabdādbhavārthe 'agrādipaścāḍḍimuc' iti ḍimac | apratihataprabhāvān akuṇṭhitamahimaśālinaḥ | mahān svabhāvo yeṣāṃ te tathoktān uttamaśīlān durantaṃ duritaṃ nudantīti tathoktān, nudeḥ kvip | tān prasiddhān yaduvarasya ime yaduvarīyāḥ tān | gahāderākṛtigaṇatvācchaḥ | bhāgavatānityarthaḥ | bhaja sevasva | bhajateḥ parasmaipadinaḥ loṇmadhyamaikavacanam | pūrvatra loṭprathamaikavacanam | atra suguṇādimānityādau padaśleṣasaṅkīrṇa ekavacanabahuvacanayoḥ śleṣaḥ| evaṃ prathamādvitīyayorvibhaktyorapi | yaduvarīyānityādau tu vacanavibhaktiśleṣaḥ pūrvavadeva | iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ īyasuncharūpataddhitapratyayāntaprakṛtyoḥ tatrāpi uruvaraśabdarūpaparamaprakṛtyośca śleṣa iti || yathāvā vrajajanatānāṃ nyaruṇastvaṃ varṣīyānupaplavān śaure | apica garīyān doṣān kālindyāḥ kāliyoddhṛtervyudhunoḥ || 928 || he śaure! varṣīyān jyāyān purāṇapuruṣa iti bhāvaḥ | atiśayena vṛddha iti vigrahaḥ | vṛddhaśabdādīyasuni ‘priyasthira' ityādinā varṣādeśaḥ | tvaṃ vrajajanatānāṃ nandavrajajanasamūhānāṃ varṣīyān ativṛṣṭisaṃbandhinaḥ govardhanayāgāvasarakruddhavṛddhaśravaḥkalitāniti bhāvaḥ | upaplavān upadravān nyaruṇaḥ nyagṛhṇāḥ | apica garīyān atiśayena guruḥ gurūṇāmapi guruḥ prathamācārya ityarthaḥ | ‘tvamasya pūjyaśca gururgarīyān' ityukteḥ | ‘gururgurutamaḥ' iti nāmasahasrapāṭhācca | kālīyasya tannāmna āśīviṣasya uddhṛteḥ utsāraṇāt kālindyāḥ yamunāyāḥ garīyān garaḥ garalaṃ tatsaṃbandhinaḥ | gahāditvācchaḥ | evaṃ varṣīyānityatrāpi doṣān vyadhunoḥ nirākārṣīḥ | atra prathamaikavacanadvitīyābahuvacanayoḥ śleṣaḥ | anyatsarvaṃ yaduvarīyānityatreva bodhyam || yathāvā gāte tavabjatulanāṃ grīvā nayane nakhāni ca murāre | vyatipāte jagadakhilaṃ kṛpā tava dṛśau bhujāśca catvāraḥ || 929 || he mukunda! tava grīvā abjatulanāṃ śaṅkhataulyaṃ gāte gacchati prāpnotītyarthaḥ | nayane ābjatulanāṃ padmasāmyaṃ gāte gacchataḥ | nakhāni ca abjatulanāṃ candrasādharmyaṃ gāte gacchanti | 'gāṅ gatau' asmādbhauvādikāt krameṇa laṭprathamapuruṣaikavacanadvivacanabahuvacanāni | bahuvacane ‘ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' iti jhasya at | tava kṛpā akhilaṃ jagat vyatipāte karmavyatihāreṇa rakṣati | karmavyatihāro nāma kriyāvinimayaḥ | dṛgbhujayogyaṃ pālanaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | tava dṛśau akhilaṃ jagat vyatipāte kṛpābhujayogyaṃ pālanaṃ kurvāte | catvāro bhujāśca vyatipāte kṛpādṛgyogyaṃ pālanaṃ kurvantītyarthaḥ | vyatipūrvakātpāteḥ ‘kartari karmavyatihāre' ityātmanepade krameṇa laṭprathamapuruṣaikadvibahuvacanāni | atra gāte vyatipāte iti ca vacanatraye'pi tulyarūpamiti vacanaśleṣaḥ | ayaṃ śuddhaḥ na tu pūrvavatsaṅkīrṇaḥ iti viśeṣaḥ || amīṣāmaṣṭānāṃ śleṣāṇāṃ madhye yasya yasminnantarbhāvaḥ pratibhāti tatra tadbhinnatvaṃ vivakṣaṇīyam' ityalaṅkārakaustubhakāraḥ | ete śleṣabhedāḥ prāgupadarśiteṣu prakṛtāprakṛtādiśleṣodāharaṇeṣvapi yathāyathaṃ saṃbhavantīti dhyeyam | evaṃ aṣṭavidhassabhaṅgaśleṣo nirūpitaḥ | abhaṅgaśleṣo yathā, madīya eva nṛsiṃhavilāse amṛtaśriyaṃ prayacchan satāṃ pravardhitahiraṇyagarbho yaḥ | mugdhendubimbadhāmā mukhe harisstānmude mahān sa pumān || 930 || atra śrīhayagrīvanṛsiṃhayorubhayorapi stavyatvena prastutayoreva śleṣaḥ | yaḥ satāṃ amṛtaśriyaṃ trayīmityarthaḥ | 'ṛcassāmāni yajūgm̐ṣi | sā hi śrīramṛtā satām' iti śruteḥ | prayacchan pradānena hetunā ‘lakṣaṇahetvoḥ' iti śatā | pravardhitaḥ samedhitaḥ hiraṇyagarbhaḥ brahmā yena saḥ madhukaiṭabhāpahṛtavedāharaṇatatpradānojjīvitacaturmukha ityarthaḥ | ‘yo brahmāṇaṃ vidadhāti pūrvaṃ yo vai vedāṃśca prahiṇoti tasmai' iti śruteḥ | atra mokṣadharmagatahayaśiraupākhyānamanusandheyam | pakṣe satāṃ brahmavidāṃ amṛtaśriyaṃ muktisaṃpadaṃ prayacchan pravardhitaḥ prakarṣeṇa chinnaḥ hiraṇyasya hiraṇyakaśipoḥ garbhaḥ kukṣiḥ yena sa tathā | mugdhendubivaṃ dhāma sthānaṃ yasya, pakṣe mugdhendubimbasya dhāmeva dhāma tejaḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | nṛsiṃhadivyavigrahasya ‘indudhavalaṃ lakṣmīnṛsiṃhaṃ bhaje' iti pāṇḍuratvokteḥ | mukhe hariḥ turaṅgaḥ siṃhaśca sa mahān mude astu | atrānyonyavilakṣaṇaṃ padabhaṅgamanapekṣya samānānupūrvīkaśabdapratisandhānabodhyānekārthakroḍīkaraṇādabhaṅgaśleṣaḥ || atra kecid anayossabhaṅgābhaṅgaśleṣayoḥ ‘sarvadomādhavaḥ' ityādau sarvadaḥ sarvadeti padadvayasya jatukāṣṭhanyāyena saṃbandhātsabhaṅgaśleṣaśśabdālaṅkāraḥ, śabdavṛttitvāt | abhaṅgaśleṣastu abjakamalādiśabdeṣu padabhedābhāvena padadvayasaṃbandhābhāvācchabdavṛttitānupapatterekasmin śabde arthadvayasya vācyatayā saṃbaddhatvādayamekavṛntagataphaladvayanyāyenārthālaṅkāra ityāhuḥ || anye tu sabhaṅgābhaṅgaśleṣau dvāvapi śabdālaṅkārāveva, śabdānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvāt | na tu sabhaṅgaśleṣasya śabdāśritatvācchabdaśleṣatvaṃ abhaṅgaśleṣasyārthāśritatvādarthaśleṣatvaṃ yuktaṃ, kaṣṭatvādidoṣagāḍhatvādiguṇānuprāsādyalaṅkāravadatrāpyanvayavyatirekābhyāmeva vyavasthopapattāvatiriktaniyāmakāntarakalpane gauravāt | na caivamabhaṅgaśleṣasyāpi śabdānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitayā śabdaśleṣatve arthaśleṣo nirviṣayassyāditi vācyaṃ, stokenonnatimāyāti stokenāyātyadhogatim | aho susadṛśī rītistulākoṭeḥ khalasya ca || ityādau yatra svalpenonnatimāyātītyādinā śabdaparivartane'pi na śleṣatvabhaṅgaḥ | tatraivārthaśleṣapadavīsāmrājyādityavādiṣuḥ || kuvalayānandakṛtastu ubhayamapyarthālaṅkāra iti | ayaṃ hi teṣāmāśayaḥ sabhaṅgābhaṅgabhedena dvividho'pyayaṃ śleṣo'rthālaṅkāra eva, anekārthapratipādanātmanastasyārthālaṅkāratvasyaivocitatvāt | āśrayāśrayibhāvasyaiva laukikālaṅkāravattattadalaṅkāraprayojakatvam | laukikālaṅkāro hi kaṅkaṇamañjīrādiḥ pāṇipādādiniṣṭhaḥ pāṇipādādyalaṅkāratayaiva vyavahriyate | iyameva rītiḥ kāvyagatālaṅkāreṣvapi | na ca śabdānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvādasya śabdālaṅakāratvamiti vācyam | tathā sati sarveṣāmapyalaṅkārāṇāṃ tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvena śabdālaṅkāratāprasaṅgāt | na cābhaṅgaśleṣasya ekavṛntagataphaladvayanyāyena ekapadāśritārthadvayaniṣṭhatayā'rthālaṅkāratvaṃ, sabhaṅgasya tu jatukāṣṭhanyāyena śabdadvayasaṃśleṣarūpatvācchabdālaṅkāratvamiti sarvasvakārādyaktaṃ yuktaṃ, 'arthabhedena śabdabhedaḥ' iti mate ‘anyāyyaṃ cānekārthatvam' ityupapattikabalite abhaṅgaśleṣe'pi sabhaṅga iva śabdabhedasya durnivāratayā śabdayoreva śleṣasya suvacatvāt | ata ubhayaṃ śabdālaṅkāra iti vā sabhaṅgasya śabdālaṅkāratvamabhaṅgasyārthālaṅkāratvamiti vā matadvayamapyayuktam | tasmāt dvayorapyarthālaṅkāratvameva yuktamiti | anye tu camatkāre arthamukhaprekṣitvādubhayorapyarthālaṃkāratvaṃ, anuprāsayamakādestu na camatkāre'rthamukhaprekṣitvamiti na teṣāmarthālaṃkāratvaṃ apitu śabdavaicitryācchabdālaṃkāratvamevetyapyāhuḥ || kāvyaprakāśānuyāyī jagannāthastu " śrutyaikayā'nekārthapratipādanaṃ śleṣaḥ | tacca dvedhānekadharmapuraskāreṇa ekadharmapuraskāreṇa ca | ādyaṃ dvedhānekaśabdapratibhānadvārā ekaśabdapratibhānadvārā ceti trividhaśśleṣaḥ | tatrādyassabhaṅgaḥ dvitīyo'bhaṅga iti vadanti | tṛtīyastu śuddhaḥ | evaṃ trividho'pyayaṃ prakṛtamātrāprakṛtamātraprakṛtāprakṛtobhayāśritatvena punastrividhaḥ | tatrādye bhede dvitīye ca viśeṣyasya śliṣṭatāyāṃ kāmacāraḥ | tṛtīyabhede tu viśeṣaṇavācakasyaiva śliṣṭatvaṃ na viśeṣyavācakasya tathātve śabdaśaktimūladhvaneruccheda eva syāt | viśeṣaṇamātraśliṣṭatāyāmapi prakṛtāprakṛtadharmiṇorupādāna eva śleṣaḥ | prakṛtadharmimātrasyopādāne tu samāsoktereva viṣayaḥ | taditthaṃ prakṛtamātraviśeṣyakānekārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ yatra sa ekaḥ | evamaprakṛtetyādi dvitīyaḥ | pṛthagupāttaprakṛtāprakṛtobhayaviśeṣyakanānārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ tṛtīyaḥ | etadanyatamatvaṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ paryavasitam" ityabhāṇīt | tanmatānusāreṇa diṅmātramudāhriyate tatrādyaḥ prakṛtamātraviṣayassabhaṅgaḥ śleṣo yathā jagadavati yasya pāṇissubhavyabhāvetrasattayā dīvyan | śeṣāhāryādaraṇo viṣvaksenassa śamayatādvighnān || 931 || yasya bhagavataḥ pāṇiḥ trasato bhāvaḥ trasattā na trasattā atrasattā tayā anudvignatayā subhavyasya jagatkṣemasya bhāve prāptau viṣaye ‘bhū prāptāvātmanepadī' ityādhṛṣīyādbhavaterghañ | dīvyan jagat avati | pakṣe yasya bhagavatsenādhināthasya viṣvaksenasya subhavyā atiramaṇīyā bhāḥ dīptiryasya saḥ pāṇiḥ vetrasya sattayā sthityā prāśastyena vā dīvyan jagadavati ‘yadvetraśikharaspande viśvametadvyavasthitam' ityukteḥ | śeṣāhārye śeṣādrau ādaraṇaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | pakṣe śeṣe anante ahāryaṃ itarairanapanodyaṃ ādaraṇaṃ yasya sa tathā | svasyeva tasyāpi nityasiddhatayā tasminnavicchinnaprītiriti bhāvaḥ | saḥ viṣvakseno bhagavān 'viṣvaksenaścaturbhujaḥ' ityamaraḥ | pakṣe bhagavatsenānīḥ vighnān vidyāniṣpattivirodhino'ntarāyān aihikaśreyontarāyāṃśca śamayatāt | ‘śuklāmbaradharaṃ, yasya dvirada' iti padyābhyāmubhayorapi vighnopaśamanārthamupāsyatvābhidhānāt | atra bhagavadviṣvaksenayorubhayorapi prakṛtatvāt prakṛtamātrāśrito'yamekayā śrutyā padadvayapratibhānadvārā bhinnadharmapuraskāreṇānekārthapratipādanātsabhaṅgaḥ || viśeṣyayoraśliṣṭatve'pyayaṃ saṃbhavati, yathā bahudhāmaravidrāvaṇaparāsuhṛdbāṇabhujavitatilavitā | bhṛgunetā raghunetā yadunetā vā mamāvitā bhavitā || 932 || drāvayatīti drāvaṇaḥ raveḥ drāvaṇaḥ ravidrāvaṇaḥ | bahunā dhāmnā tejasā ravidrāvaṇaḥ vahnineva svarṇapiṇḍaṃ svatejasā vilāpayatītyarthaḥ | mahāpratāpaśālīti bhāvaḥ | yathocyate mātsyādiṣu purāṇeṣu yo'sau bāhusahasreṇa jyāghātakaṭhinatvacā | bhāti raśmisahasreṇa śāradeneva bhāskaraḥ || iti, sahasrakaramatyeti so'yaṃ karasahasravān | tejasā mahatā śrīmān kārtavīryorjuno nṛpaḥ || iti ca | evaṃvidho yaḥ paraḥ virodhī 'paro'riparamātmanoḥ' iti viśvaḥ | arthātkārtavīrya ityarthaḥ | tasya asuhṛtaḥ ripuprāṇāpahāriṇaḥ bāṇāḥ yeṣu te asuhṛdbāṇāḥ | idaṃ ca viśeṣaṇaṃ ‘utsasarjaikavegena pañcabāṇaśatāni yaḥ' ityetadabhisaṃdhāyoktam | asuhṛdāṃ ripūṇāṃ bāṇaprāyā iti vā | ye bhujāḥ sahasrasaṃkhyākāḥ teṣāṃ vitateḥ samūhasya lavitā chettā | bhṛgunetā bhārgavo rāmaḥ | pakṣe bahudhā amarānvidhyatītyamaravit , vidhyateḥ kvip | yo rāvaṇaḥ tasya pareṣāṃ ripūṇāṃ asuhṛtaḥ prāṇāpahāriṇo bāṇāḥ yeṣu te tathoktāḥ bhujāḥ viṃśatisaṃkhyākāḥ teṣāṃ vitateḥ lavitā raghunetā bhagavān rāghavaḥ | anyatra bahudhā amarāṇāṃ devānāṃ vidrāvaṇe dūrotsāraṇe paraḥ āsaktaḥ asuhṛt dveṣī yo bāṇaḥ balisutaḥ tasya bhujānāṃ vitateḥ lavitā yadunetā bhagavānvāsudevo vā mama avitā rakṣitā bhavitā iti | atra trayāṇāṃ bhagavadavatārāṇāmapi prastutatvātprakṛtaśleṣassabhaṅgaḥ aśliṣṭaviśeṣyakaḥ || ayamevābhaṅgātmako dvitīyo yathā dīvyatu purāṇaratnaṃ divyaṃ manvantaraprathitavibhavam | vaṃśyānucaritagītaṃ sargapratisargaracananiṣṇātam || 933 || manvantareṣu prathitāḥ vibhavāḥ vibhavāvatārāḥ ‘manvantarāvatārāśca viṣṇorhayaśirādayaḥ' iti śrībhāgavatādyuktāḥ yasya tat | anyatra manvantarānuvarṇanena khyātavaibhavam | vaṃśe veṇau bhavaṃ vaṃśyaṃ digāditvādyat | vaṃśanālamityarthaḥ | tena ācaritaṃ gītaṃ gānaṃ yena tattathoktaṃ veṇugānarasikamityarthaḥ | pakṣe vaṃśyānāṃ sūryādivaṃśajānāṃ rājādīnāṃ anucaritaṃ caritraṃ gītaṃ udīritaṃ yasmiṃstat āhitāgnyāderākṛtigaṇatvānniṣṭhāyāḥ paranipātaḥ | sargaḥ avyākṛtaguṇakṣobhānmahatastrividhāhamaḥ | bhūtasūkṣmendriyārthānāṃ saṃbhavassarga ucyate || iti śrībhāgavatoktalakṣaṇā samaṣṭisṛṣṭiḥ| pratisargaḥ puruṣānugṛhītānāmeteṣāṃ vāsanāmayaḥ | visargo'yaṃ samāhāro bījādvījaṃ carācaram || ityuktalakṣaṇo mahadādisamāhārarūpacarācarādivyaṣṭisṛṣṭirvisargāparaparyāyā | tayoḥ racane karaṇe niṣṇātaṃ kuśalam | pakṣe sargapratisargavarṇane kuśalaṃ divyaṃ aprākṛtaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ ca purāṇaṃ sanātanaṃ ratnaṃ tattvenādhyavasitaṃ paraṃ brahma | itaratra sargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśamanvantarāṇi ca | vaṃśyānucaritaṃ ceti lakṣaṇānāṃ tu pañcakam || ityuktapañcalakṣaṇaṃ purāṇaśreṣṭhaṃ śrīmadvaiṣṇavaṃ purāṇaṃ tasyaiva 'niramimīta purāṇaratnam' iti purāṇaratnatvokteḥ | dīvyatu dīpyatām | atra manvantaretyādāvekaśabdapratibhānadvārā'nekadharmapuraskāreṇānekārthapratipādanādabhaṅgaśleṣaḥ śliṣṭaviśeṣyakaḥ || viśeṣyayoraśliṣṭatve abhaṅgo yathā kamalāñcitakarayugalaṃ kalaśapayorāśisaṃbhavasthānam | tanutāṃ śriyamamitāṃ nastatparamaṃ brahma tatkalatraṃ vā || 934 || kamalaiḥ añcitaṃ pūjitaṃ tato'pi ślāghyaṃ, kamalābhyāṃ añcitaṃ yuktaṃ ca karayugalaṃ yasya tattathā | kalaśapayorāśisaṃbhavaṃ tatra vidyamānaṃ sthānaṃ nivāso yasya kalaśapayorāśiḥ saṃbhavasthānaṃ janmagṛhaṃ yasya ca tattathoktam | atra viśeṣyayoraśliṣṭatā || tṛtīyaśśuddhaḥ prakṛtamātraviṣayo yathā bhāratavikhyātayaśāssmerataraprāvṛṣeṇyavāridabhāḥ | prekṣāmanaghāṃ vitaratu sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ purāṇamuniḥ || 935 || bhagavatkṛṣṇadvaipāyanobhayaviṣayako'yamekadharmapuraskāreṇānekārthapratipādanācchuddhaḥ | ayamevārthaśleṣa iti vadanti | mahābhāratākhyaprabandhavikhyātayaśastvaṃ prāvṛṣeṇyajaladanīlatvaṃ sakṣānnārāyaṇatvamityetānyubhayatrāpyekarūpāṇyeva dharmāṇi | ‘kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ vyāsaṃ viddhi nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum' iti pramāṇārtho'trānusaṃhitaḥ | ayaṃ śliṣṭaviśeṣyakaśśuddhaḥ || ayameva aśliṣṭaviśeṣyako viśeṣaṇamātraśliṣṭo yathā kalaśodadhirājodarakalitodayamaryamātiśāyiruci | harihṛdayahāri ratnaṃ tacca vadhūratnamavatu māṃ pratnam || 936 || aryamātiśāyirucīti lakṣmīviśeṣaṇaṃ tu ‘ādityavarṇe tapaso'dhijātaḥ' iti śruteḥ || evamete trayo'pi bhedāḥ prakṛtamātraviṣayāḥ pradarśitāḥ || aprakṛtaviṣayā yathā niradhāvi citrabhānurniraṅkuśoṣmāhavisphuraddhetiḥ | jagadullāsiśrīkṛddhvāntadhvaṃsī tavaujasā bhagavan || 937 || he bhagavan ! niraṅkuśaṃ yathā syāttathā ūṣmaṇaḥ ahaḥ ūṣmāhaṃ grīṣmartudinaṃ ‘rājāhaḥ' ityādinā ṭac | tasmin visphurantyaḥ prakāśamānāḥ hetayaḥ kiraṇāḥ yena yasya vā sa tathoktaḥ | ‘sphurati sphulatyornirnivibhyaḥ' iti ṣatvasya vikalpena vidhānāt iha vītyupasargātparasya sphuratessasya na ṣatvam | 'grīṣmoṣmabāṣpā ūṣmāṇaḥ', 'hetirjvālāyudhāṃśuṣu' iti ca ratnamālā | anyatra niraṅkuśoṣmeti bhinnaṃ padaṃ, apratihatauṣṇya ityarthaḥ| haviṣā ājyena 'ghṛtamājyaṃ haviḥ' ityamaraḥ | sphurantyaḥ hetayo jvālāḥ yasya saḥ | jagat ullāsayati prakāśayati praharṣayati ceti jagadullāsinī yā śrīḥ dyutiḥ saṃpacca tāṃ karotīti tathoktaḥ | bhānorjagatprakāśakatvaṃ pratyakṣasiddham | vahnessaṃpatpradatvaṃ ca 'candrāṃ hiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ jātavedo mamāvaha, śriyamiccheddhutāśanāt' iti śrutismṛtiprasiddham | dhvāntadhvaṃsī idamubhayatra tulyārthakam | citrabhānuḥ bhāskaraḥ vahniśca ‘sūryavahnī citrabhānū' ityamaraḥ | tava ojasā niradhāvi nirdhūtaḥ | niḥpūrvakāddhāvateḥ karmaṇi luṅi ciṇ | atra pūrvārdhe sabhaṅgaḥ tṛtīyapāde abhaṅgaḥ dhvāntadhvaṃsītyatra śuddhaśca śliṣṭaviśeṣyako'prakṛtamātraviṣayakaḥ śleṣaḥ || yathāvā saṃpūrṇabhāsvadambholyujjvalamūrtirmarunmahāsphūrtiḥ | jagadāpyāyanavṛṣṭistava śriyā paryabhāvi parjanyaḥ || 938 || he bhagavan ! saṃpūrṇā anūnā bhāḥ chaviḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ svaḥ svakīyaḥ yo dambholiḥ vajrāyudhaṃ tena ujjvalamūrtiḥ | pakṣe saṃpūrṇaṃ pūritaṃ bhāsvat bhāsuraṃ yat ambhaḥ payaḥ tena aliḥ bhramara iva ujjvalamūrtiḥ tadvacchayāmala ityarthaḥ | yadvā saṃpūrṇaṃ yathātathā bhāsvat ambho yasya sa tathā | ata eva alyujjvalabhāḥ ukto'rthaḥ | viśeṣaṇobhayapadakarmadhārayaḥ| marutsu deveṣu mahāsphūrtiḥ atiprakāśaḥ, pakṣe marutā vāyunā mahāsphūrtiḥ atisphuraṇaḥ ativelacalana ityarthaḥ | ‘sphura saṃcalane' asmādbhāve ktin | jagadāpyāyanavṛṣṭiḥ idaṃ pakṣadvaye'pi tulyārthakam | ‘nikāme nikāme naḥ parjanyo varṣatu, yadindro varṣate' iti dvayorapi varṣapradatvokteḥ | parjanya indraḥ dhvanadambudaśca ‘parjanyau rasadabdendrau' ityamaraḥ | idamapi tasya pūrvaviśeṣaṇavat prāvṛṣeṇyatvasūcanāya | tava śriyā saṃpadā tviṣā ca | paryabhāvi paribhūtaḥ | atra viśeṣaṇatraye krameṇa sabhaṅgo'bhaṅgaśśuddhaśca śleṣaḥ kevalāprakṛtaviṣayaḥ śliṣṭaviśeṣyakaḥ || aprakṛtayorviśeṣyayoraśliṣṭatve yathā hrādinyantarvilasatsāraṅgollāsadāyirasadamalam | paribhūtaṃ haribhāsā kuvalayambhodavalayamapi nīlam || 939 || hrādinyāḥ nadyāḥ, pakṣe hrādinyā taṭitā | antaḥ vilasan 'taṭinī hrādinī dhunī, hrādinyau vajrataṭitau' iti cāmaraḥ | alaṃ sāraṅgāṇāṃ bhṛṅgāṇāṃ ullāsadāyī yo rasaḥ makarandaḥ taṃ dadātīti sāraṅgollāsadāyirasadam | pakṣe sāraṅgāṇāṃ cātakānāṃ 'sāraṅgaścātake bhṛṅge' iti śeṣaḥ | ullāsadāyi idaṃ bhinnaṃ padam | rasat amalamiti chedaḥ | rasat garjat amalaṃ akaluṣaṃ atisnigdhamityarthaḥ | nīlaṃ kuvalayaṃ indīvaraṃ ambhodavalayaṃ ca haribhāsā paribhūtam | atra prathame pāde abhaṅgaḥ dvitīye sabhaṅgaḥ nīlamityatra śuddhaśca śleṣaḥ aśliṣṭaviśeṣyakaḥ || prakṛtāprakṛtobhayaviṣayo yathā hṛdyamahāpadmaśrīrnīlaruciḥ kundasahajavaraśaṅkhaḥ | dhanada iva kanati śaurirviyaddhunīvimalavṛṣagirīśāptaḥ || 940 || hṛdyā vakṣassthā mahāpadmā mahatī pūjye padme karadhṛte yasyāssā tathoktā śrīḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | pakṣe hṛdyā hṛdayapriyā mahāpadmaśrīḥ mahāpadmākhyanidhisaṃpat yasya sa tathā | nīlā ruciryasya nīle nīlanāmni nidhau ruciḥ abhilāṣo yasyeti ca | kundasahajaḥ kundakusumasadṛśaḥ tadvaddhavalaḥ varaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ śaṅkhaḥ pāñcajanyo yasya sa tathoktaḥ, pakṣe kundanidhessahajau tatsahāvasthāyinau varaśaṅkhau tannāmānau nidhī yasya sa tathā | viyaddhunyā ākāśagaṅgayā vimalaḥ vigamitajagatkaluṣo yo vṛṣa iti girīśaḥ adrivaraḥ tena āptaḥ prāptaḥ saḥ āpto yeneti vā | pakṣe viyaddhunī gaṅgeva vimalo viśadaḥ vṛṣaḥ vṛṣabho yasya sa tathoktaḥ | girīśo rudraḥ āptaḥ pratyayito yasya saḥ tasyāpta iti vā ‘āptapratyayitau samau' ityamaraḥ | tryambakasakha ityarthaḥ | bhagavān śrīnivāsaḥ dhanadaḥ kubera iva kanati dīpyate | atra prakṛtāprakṛtayoḥ bhagavaddhanadayoraśliṣṭatvādviśeṣaṇānāṃ ca śliṣṭatvādbhavati tṛtīyo bhedaḥ | paraṃ tvayamupamayā saṃkīrṇaḥ | yadi ca bhagavān dhanado vilasatīti paṭhitvā aprakṛtāṃśamapi śleṣagrastaṃ vidhāya rūpakaṃ kriyate tadā'pi prakṛtaviśeṣyasya śaureraśliṣṭatvādakhaṇḍita eva śleṣaḥ | na cātra samāsoktiriti bhramitavyaṃ, aprakṛtadharmiṇo'pi śabdavācyatvāt | yatra tvaprakṛtavyavahāra eva śabdaśaktiṃ sahetāpi na tvaprakṛtadharmī tatra samasokteriṣṭeḥ || atra vicāryate’yaṃ cālaṃkāraḥ prāyeṇālaṃkārāntarasya viṣayamabhiniviśate | tatra kimasya bādhakatvaṃ syāt āhosvitsaṃkīrṇatvaṃ utāho bādhyatvamiti | atrāhurudbhaṭādayaḥ "yena nāprāpte ya ārabhyate sa tasya bādhakaḥ" iti nyāyenālaṃkārāntaraviṣaya evāyamārabhyamāṇo'laṃkārāntaraṃ bādhate na cāsya viviktaḥ kaścidasti viṣayaḥ | yatra labdhāvakāśo netaraṃ bādheta | tathāhi aprakṛtamātrayoḥ prakṛtamātrayorvā tāvattulyayogitaiva jāgarti prakṛtāprakṛtayostu dīpakam | tadanumoditā upamādayaśca | na ca deva tvameva pātā'lamāśānāṃ tvaṃ nibandhanam | tvaṃ cāmaramarudbhūmirato lokatrayātmakaḥ || ityādikāvyaprakāśoktau vivakto viṣaya iti vācyaṃ, rūpakasyaivātra sphuṭatvāt | śleṣopasthāpitapātālādyarthasyābhedāropamantareṇa lokatrayātmakatvasya durupapādatvāt | kathaṃ tarhi ‘nadīnāṃ saṃpadaṃ bibhradrājā'yaṃ sāgaro yathā' ityādāvupamāyāḥ pratyayaḥ | kathaṃ vā tatraiva yathāśabdasthāne kimuśabdadāne utprekṣāyāḥ | apara iti kṛte ca rūpakasyeti cenna | atra hi upamādīnāṃ pratibhānamātraṃ, na tu vāstavī sthitiḥ | na hi śvaityena śuktau rajatatvaṃ pratīyamānamapi vastuto'sti | tasmādupamādipratibhotpattihetuśśleṣa eva svaviṣaye sarvatrālaṃkāra iti || etaccāpare na kṣamante, tathāhi yattāvaducyate yenanāprāpte ityādi tatra ‘sarvadomādhavaḥ pāyātsa yo'gaṅgāmadīdharat' ityādiparakīyapadye, gauravitā''sacchrīriha nityaṃ hṛdyāhitāsuhṛllekhā | yena sa vṛṣācalāhitadhāmā devādhināyako jayati || iti prāgudāhṛte'smadīyapadye ca śleṣātiriktaḥ ko'laṃkāraḥ ? na tāvattulyayogitā, viśeṣyayoḥ pṛthaganupādānāt aupamyasya ca gamyatvābhāvāt | sā hi dvayorapi prakṛtayoraprakṛtayorvā viśeṣyayāḥ pṛthagupādāne sādṛśyapratyayaniyame ca labdhapadā bhavati | na hīha hariharayorbhagavadindrayorvā sādṛśyaṃ pratipipādayiṣitam | nāpi cātraikaśrutyā'rthadvayopādānamantareṇānyatkiṃciccamatkāramunmeṣayati | yenālaṃkārāntaramabhyupagacchema | ekaśrutyā'rthadvayopādānaṃ tu śleṣa eva | evaṃca sāvakāśatvācchleṣasya nālaṃkārāntarāpavādakatvaṃ yuktam | ata eva upamādīnāṃ pratibhānamātramiti yaduktaṃ tadapi na saṃgataṃ guṇakriyāderiva śabdamātrasyāpi samānadharmatvenopamāyāṃ tāvadbādhakābhāvāt | ata eva 'sakalakalaṃ purametajjātaṃ saṃprati sudhāṃśubimbamiva' ityatra śabdamātrasāmye'pyupameti sāṃpradāyikāḥ | taduktaṃ rudraṭena sphuṭamarthālaṃkārāvetāvupamāsamuccayau kiṃtu | āśritya śabdamātraṃ sāmānyamihāpi saṃbhavataḥ || iti | evamevālaṃkārāntarasyāpi śleṣaviṣaye pāramārthikyeva sattā na prātibhāsikī | pratyuta śleṣasyaiva pratibhānamātramiti vaktuṃ yuktaṃ pūrṇopamāyā viṣayasya sarvasyāpi trividhaśleṣeṇākrāntatvānniravakāśatayā'sya sāvakāśasya svaviṣaye bādhaucityāt | ‘samarārcito'pyamarārcitaḥ' ityādau śleṣasya taimirikacandradvayavatpratibhānamātrameva | na tvalaṃkāratvaṃ tajjīvātordvitīyārthasyāpratiṣṭhānāt | virodhasya tvābhāsarūpasyāpyalaṃkāratvaṃ na tu śleṣasyeti sphuṭameva | tasmādevamādau śleṣapratibhayotpādyo virodha evālaṃkāraḥ | na tu virodhapratibhayotpadyaśśleṣaḥ | evaṃ sadvaṃśamauktikamaṇe vidvanmānasasārasa | nālpaḥ kavirivāsvacchaśloko deva mahān bhavān || ityatra pūrvārdhe śleṣapratibhayotpādyaṃ rūpakameva, na tu rūpakapratibhayotpādyaśśleṣaḥ | uttarārdhe vyatireko'pyevam | kiṃca pratyekaṃ tattadrūpapuraskāreṇa kasyāpyalaṃkārasya nāsti śleṣaviṣaye nāprāptatvam | alaṃkārāntaratvapuraskāreṇeti cet evaṃ tarhi bādhyasāmānyacintayā svaviṣaye prāptasya sarvasya bādhāpattau śliṣṭaparaṃparitarūpakasya śliṣṭasamāsokteścoccheda eva syāt | tasmāt śleṣasya nāpavādakatvaṃ saṃkīrṇatvaṃ tu syāditi || anye tu alaṃkārā hi prādhānyena camatkārādhāyakāḥ svāṃsvāmākhyāṃ labhante | ta eva paropakārakatayā vartamānāstāṃ tyajanti | yathā ‘rarāja bhūmau vadanaṃ mṛgākṣyā nabhovibhāge hariṇāṅkabimbam' ityatra prakṛtāprakṛtātmanāmekadharmasaṃbandho dīpakākhyāṃ labhate | tyajati ca ‘rājate vadanaṃ tanvyā nabhasīva niśākaraḥ' ityatra | ata evocyate ‘prādhānyena vyapadeśā bhavanti' iti | evaṃcālaṃkārāntaropaskārakatayā sthitaśleṣaḥ kathaṃkāraṃ svagṛhastha iva śleṣālaṃkāravyapadeśaṃ voḍhumīṣṭāmiti bādhyaprāya evetyapyāhuḥ || ayaṃ copameva mvatantro'pi tatratatra sarvālaṃkārānugrāhakatayā sthitassarasvatyā navaṃnavaṃ saubhāgyamāvahannānāvidheṣu lakṣyeṣu sahṛdayairvibhāvanīyaḥ || idaṃ cāvadheyaṃ yatra prakṛtāprakṛtayorviśeṣyayorapi śliṣṭapadopāttatvaṃ sa tu dhvanerviṣaya iti prāñcaḥ | tathāhi prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣodāharaṇe ‘asāvudayamārūḍhaḥ' ityādau na śleṣo'laṃkāraḥ, arthadvayasyābhidhāvyāpāreṇa tulyavṛttikatva eva tasyonmeṣāt | ata eva prakṛtaśleṣe aprakṛtaśleṣe ca prakaraṇādīnāmabhidhāniyāmakānāmabhāvādarthadvaye'pi śabdasya tulyavṛttitvāt śleṣālaṃkāraḥ | iha tu prakṛtārthe prakaraṇādinā niyantritāyāstasyā aprākaraṇike'rthe kuṇṭhitaprasaratayā śabdo vyañjanayā vṛttyā tamarthamavagamayatīti śabdaśaktimūlānuraṇanatulyavyaṅgyadhvaniḥ || bhadrātmano duradhirohatanorviśālavaṃśonnateḥ kṛtaśilīmukhasaṃgrahasya | yasyānuplutagateḥ paravāraṇasya dānāmbusekasubhagassatataṃ karo'bhūt || atra nṛpe kasmiṃścidvarṇyamāne bhadrātmana ityādiviśeṣaṇairmaṅgalātmakasya viśālakulodbhavasyānekaśarasaṃgrahaśālinaḥ pratyarthinivārakasya rājñaḥ pāṇirabhūditi prakṛtavākyārthe prakaraṇasanāthenābhidhāvyāpāreṇa śabdataḥ pratīte paścādbhadrādipadasāmarthyamahimnā bhadrajātīyasya viśālapṛṣṭhāsthisamunnaterbhramaraparītasyotkṛṣṭagajasya kara
