ityaprakṛtagajādyarthasya pratītistāvadanubhavasiddhā | sā ca nābhidhāvyāpāreṇa, prakaraṇādinā tasya niyantraṇāt | ato vyañjakavyāpāreṇa tatpratītirityaprākaraṇikārthasya vyaṅgyatayā śabdaśaktimūlānuraṇanopamāvyaṅgyadhvaniriti mammaṭopādhyāyādayaḥ || dīkṣitāstu prakaraṇādinā prakṛtārthābhidhānaparyavasāne aprakṛtābhidhāne vākyasyāsaṃbaddhārthakatvaṃ mā prasāṃkṣīditi tena prakṛtārthasyopamā vyajyate iti śabdaśaktimūlānuraṇanavyaṅgyā seti teṣāmāśaya ityabhiprayantaḥ "yadatra prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣodāharaṇe śabdaśaktimūladhvanimicchanti prāñcaḥ tatprakṛtāprakṛtābhidhānamūlakasyopamāderalaṃkārasya vyaṅgyatvābhiprāyā, na tvaprakṛtārthasyaiva vyaṅgyatvābhiprāyā, aprakṛtārthasyāpi śabdaśaktyā pratipādyasyābhidheyatvāvaśyaṃbhāvena vyaktyanapekṣaṇāt | yadyapi prakṛtārthe prakaraṇabalājjhaḍiti buddhisthe satyeva paścānnṛpatitadgrāhyadhanādivācināṃ rājakarādipadānāmanyonyasannidhānabalāttattadviṣayaśaktyantaronmeṣapūrvakamaprakṛtārthassphuret | naitāvatā tasya vyaṅgyatvam | śaktyā pratipādyamāne sarvadhaiva vyaktyanapekṣaṇāt paryavasite prakṛtārthābhidhāne paścāt sphuratīti cet kāmaṃ gūḍhaśleṣo bhavatu | asti cānyatrāpi gūḍhaśleṣaḥ" ityuktvā ‘ayamatijaraṭhāḥ' ityādikaṃ gūḍhaśleṣatayodāhārṣuḥ || ayaṃ hi teṣāmāśayaḥ prakaraṇena prakṛtārthatātparyagraheṇa tadgocaraśabdabodhe janite paścādaprakṛtārthasya bodhodayātkuto na vyaṅgyatvamiti na śaṅkanīyam | paścāttattadarthagocaraśaktyantaronmīlanenāprakṛtārthasya sphuraṇe'pi na vyaṅgyatvam | paścātpratītyā hi gūḍhaśleṣa iti bhaṇyata iti || pare tu ‘prakaraṇāderaprakṛtagocarābhidhāsāmarthyapratibandhakatve dvitīyasminnarthe yatra nābhidhā saṃkrāmati tatrāpi yadi saṃkrāmakaśabdasamabhivyāhārassyāt tadā prakaraṇādestena kuṇṭhanaśaktau pratihatāyāṃ pūrvaṃ bādhitā'pyabhidhāśaktiḥ pratiprasūyata iti tayā aprakṛtārthasphūrtiriti nāsau dhvanerviṣayaḥ | yathā iha padminī suhasitā kāmayate svapriyaṃ ramāvāsam | iti niśamayannupaśrutimicchuḥ padmāvatīṃ harirmumude || 941 || idaṃ hi pratyūṣe praphullāṃ kamalinīṃ vilokya kenacitkaṃcitprati kathitaṃ padminyākhyāyāmākāśarājaputryāmanuraktasya tatsamāgamaḥ kathaṃ syāditi cintayato bhagavataśrīnivāsasyopaśrutirūpaṃ sadānandāvahamāsīdityetadarthapratipādakaṃ vacanam | atra suhasitā samyagvikāsitā padminī kamalinīlatā svasya ātmanaḥ priyaṃ abhīṣṭaṃ ramāyāḥ śriyaḥ vāsaṃ sthitiṃ kāmayate abhilaṣyatītyarthe prakaraṇādinā yadyapyete niyamitābhidhāśśabdāḥ, tathā'pi sā dvitīyasminnarthe vivariṣyamāṇe niruddhā satī upaśrutimityanena śabdena pratyujjīvitā | iha suhasitā samandasmitā padminī ākāśarājatanayā padmāvatyaparanāmā padminī ramāvāsaṃ bhagavantaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ svapriyaṃ svavallabhaṃ kāmayate svavallabho bhūyādityabhilaṣyatīti dvitīyo'rthaḥ prakaraṇādinā niruddhābhidhāśaktikaśabdapratipādyamāno dhvanipathagamanāya prasthita upaśrutiśabdena sūcitatayā tato galahastito'bhidhāvyāpāramāsādya vācyatāmāpannaśśleṣālaṃkāraviṣayaḥ | anyatra tu tāddaśābhidhāpratyujjīvanābhāve arthāntaradhvanipaddhatimadhyāste' iti vadanti || ayamalaṃkārāntarāsaṃkīrṇatayā śleṣasya vivikto viṣayo'pi bhavati | na cātrāprastutapraśaṃsāśaṅkā, kasyacidvacane kamalinīvṛttāntasya prakṛtatvenāprastutena prastutasya gamyatvābhāvāt | na ca tarhi prastutenāprastutasya gamyatvātsamāsoktirastviti vācyaṃ, padminīti viśeṣyasyāpi śliṣṭatvena tadanavatārāt | nāpi prakṛtāprakṛtayorekadharmasaṃbandhāddīpakamastviti vācyam, udāsīnasya kasyacidvaktuḥ prakṛtāprakṛtayordharmaikyasya vivakṣāvaidhuryāt | prakṛtāprakṛtayorviśeṣyayoḥ pṛthaganupādānācca | tattu tayoḥ pṛthagupādāna evonmiṣati | nāpi gūḍhoktiḥ, anyoddeśenānyaṃ prati kathanasyātrāvivakṣaṇāt | tasmādayaṃ śleṣasyaiva vivikto viṣaya iti dik | vistarastu prācāṃ nibandheṣu draṣṭavyaḥ || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre śleṣālaṃkārasaro'ṣṭāviṃśaḥ <4> athāprastutapraśaṃsāsaraḥ prastutaviśeṣaṇasāmyamāśritya samāsoktirnirūpitā | tatprasaktyā viśeṣaṇāśrayaparikarādikaṃ nirūpitam | adhunā punastadvaiparītyenāprastutapraśaṃsocyate syātprastutasya gamakaṃ yatrāprastutavarṇanam | aprastutapraśaṃsākhyā saiṣā'laṃkṛtirucyate || 85 || yatrāprastutavṛttāntavarṇanaṃ prastutavṛttāntamavagamayati saiṣā aprastutapraśaṃsocyate | samāsoktau tu prastutenāprastutapratītiriti viśeṣaḥ | praśaṃsanaṃ cātra varṇanamātraṃ na tu stutiḥ ‘antaśchidrāṇi bhūyāṃsi kaṇṭakā bahavo bahiḥ' ityādāvavyāptyāpatteḥ || kārye hetau tathā vyāpye vyāpake prastute'nyagīḥ | same samasya cetyevaṃ saiṣā bhavati pañcadhā || 86 || aprastutavṛttāntavarṇanena prastutāvagatiśca saṃbandhe sati bhavati | saṃbandhaśca kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvaḥ sārūpyaṃ vā saṃbhavati | saptamyanteṣu padeṣu prastute ityetadanveti | anyagīḥ tadanyoktiḥ | tathāca kārye prastute kāraṇasya, kāraṇe prastute kāryasya, vyāpyavyāpakaśabdau viśeṣasāmānyapaṇeṃ | viśeṣe prastute sāmānyasya, sāmānye prastute viśeṣasyoktiriti catvāro bhedāḥ | same prakṛte samasyeti pañcamaḥ | yadāhuḥ kārye nimitte sāmānye viśeṣe prastute sati | tadanyasya vacastulye tulyasyeti ca pañcadhā || iti | tatra kārye prastute kāraṇasyoktiryathā hṛtasarvasvā sarasijarājī muravairimukhakṛte vidhinā | tāmarasatāṃ dadhānāṃ tadāhurenāmudārataradhiṣaṇāḥ || 942 || tat tasmāt tāmenāṃ sarasijarājīm | arasatāṃ nīrasatāṃ nissāratāmiti yāvat | pakṣe tāmarasatāṃ tāmarasatvaṃ dadhānāṃ āhuḥ| sphuṭamanyat | atra kamalarājīgatatayā saṃbhāvyamānena śrīnivāsadivyavadanāravindanirmāṇārthaṃ sārāṃśaharaṇena tatkāraṇena tatkāryarūpo varṇanīyatayā prastutaśśrīnivāsadivyavadanāravindagato lokottarasaundaryasaugandhyasaukumāryādiviśeṣaḥ pratīyata iti kāraṇanibandhanāprastutapraśaṃseyam | śleṣātiśayoktisaṃkīrṇā || yathāvā sāraharaṇāya khātā vātāśanagiricikīrṣuṇā vidhinā | devena nikhilaśailāstannūnamanantadevakhātabilāḥ || 943 || atrāprastutanikhilaśailaniṣṭhatayā saṃbhāvyamānena śeṣādrisarjanārthasārāṃśaharaṇena prastutaśśeṣādriniṣṭhaḥ ko'pi nikhilakulācalātiśāyimahimātiśayaḥ pratīyate | anantāni aparicchinnāni devena devaiśca khātāni bilāni yeṣāṃ te ‘devakhātabile guhā' ityamaraḥ | devakhātabilaśabdau vyastau guhāvācināviti kecit | samasta evāyaṃ devakhātabilaśabdastadvācītyanye || yathāvā dyutisarvasvaṃ taṭitāmādaya vidhistavāmba tanumatanot | kṣaṇarucayo vidyuta iti tā etā jagadire tataḥ kavibhiḥ || 944 || kṣaṇarucayaḥ atyalparociṣaḥ anupadameva vigatā dyut dyutiryāsāṃ tāstathoktāḥ viśeṣeṇa dyotamānā iti vastusthitiḥ || evam tava divyavapussraṣṭuṃ hṛtasāro vedhasā'hiśailamaṇe | nūnaṃ harimaṇirakhilo viditā sutarāmasāratā'sya tataḥ || 945 || ityatrāpi kāraṇanibandhanā'prastutapraśaṃsā draṣṭavyā | sutarāṃ asāratā nissāratā | sutarā atiśobhanā masāratā masāranāmateti vastusthitiḥ | ‘masāra indranīle syāt' ityavocāma prāgeva || kāraṇe prastute kāryābhidhānaṃ yathā ādau sumukhā vibudhairānītā tatpurassaratvamapi | paścādbhītaudāryāttavasurabhiragādvisargamevānte || he bhagavan! surabhiḥ kāmagavī ādau tvanmahaudāryaniśamanātpūrvaṃ sumukhā pṛthagjanavarṇyamānanijavādānyakotkarṣaniśamanajanitaharṣamūlakasaumukhyaśālinī | pakṣe surabhiśabde svavācake ādau suḥ suvarṇaḥ mukhaṃ pradhānaṃ yasyāssā ‘mukhaṃ pradhāne prārambhe vaktre nissaraṇe'pi ca' iti ratnamālā | tat sumukhātvādeva hetoḥ vibudhaiḥ guṇajñaiḥ devaiḥ purassaratvaṃ vadānyāgresaratvaṃ puraskāraṃ vā ānītā prāpitā | anyatra tatpura iti samastaṃ padam | tasya suvarṇasya puraḥ agrataḥ anantaramityarthaḥ | saratvaṃ rephasāhityaṃ ānītā | paścāt tava śrīnivāsasya bhavataḥ audāryāt | 'ya ātmadā baladā' ityādiśrutibhiḥ ‘tadanyaḥ ko mahodāraḥ' ityādipurāṇavacanaiśca jegīyamānāditi bhāvaḥ | bhītā nijaudāryaprathākuṇṭhanasaṃbhāvanāttrastā | pakṣe paścāt rephānantaraṃ audāryāt nirargalatvāditi yāvat | bhītā bhivarṇena itā yuktā | ata eva ante bhayadarśanādanantaraṃ visargaṃ evaṃ trastā nāsmābhissaṃbhāvanīyeti vibudhakṛtaṃ visarjanaṃ agāt tyaktā'bhūdityarthaḥ | pakṣe ante svavācakaśabdānte visargaṃ visarjanīyaṃ agāt | surabhiriti śabdasya tathātvādevamuktam | atrāprastutena aucityātsaṃbhāvyamānena surabhibhayādikāryeṇa tatkāraṇabhūtaḥ śrīnivāsamahaudāryasyānitarasādhāraṇo mahimā pratyāyyata itīyaṃ kāryanibandhanāprastutapraśaṃsā śleṣātiśayoktisaṃkīrṇā || yathāvā viharantyā divi bhavataḥ kīrtimarālyā prasūtamavadātam | peśīnivahaṃ manye tārāsamudayamimaṃ murārāte || 947 || peśīnivahaṃ aṇḍanikaraṃ ‘peśīkośo dvihīne'ṇḍam' ityamaraḥ | atrāprastutasya tārāsamudayasya bhagavatkīrtihaṃsīprasūtapeśīnivahatvotprekṣaṇena tatkāraṇībhūtaprastutabhagavatkīrtidhāvalyātiśayo lokottara iti pratīyate || yathāvā antarvatnyā phaṇigiriśiromaṇe rociṣāṃ praroheṇa | ete dyavā prasūtāḥ potāssphītā ghanāghanavrātāḥ || 948 || bhagavato rociṣāṃ tejasāṃ praroheṇa aṅkureṇa antarvatnyā garbhiṇyā dyavā divā 'dyodivau dve striyāmabhram' ityamaraḥ | spaṣṭamanyat | atrāpyaprastutānāṃ ghanāghanavrātānāṃ bhagavattanūruciprarohagarbhitadyoprasūtārbhakatvena saṃbhāvanāttatkārāṇībhūtabhagavattanuruciprarohe'tyuttamaśyāmalimabhūmā pratyāyyate | samāsoktisaṃkīrṇeyam | pūrvā tu rūpakasaṃkīrṇā || yathāvā abdhau samudbhavantyā śriyaḥ prasṛmarāḥ padābjarucikaṇikāḥ | anyonyataraṅgāhatipuñjībhūtāḥ pravālatāṃ yātāḥ || 949 || atrāvatārasamaye jaladhau prasṛtānāṃ śrīmahālakṣmīcaraṇāravindarucikaṇikānāmanyonyataraṅgāsphālanavaśena sūkṣmatamasikatāphenalavādivatpuñjībhūtānāṃ pariṇāmatayā saṃbhāvyamānābhiḥ pravālalatābhiḥ kāryabhūtābhistatkāraṇabhūtaśrīcaraṇāravindarucessarvātiśāyyaruṇimabhūmā pratīyate || yathāvā śaure bhavatpratāpātkṣodiṣṭhau dvau sphuliṅgakau sphuṭitau | viyati ravistatraikaḥ payasi payodheḥ parastu baḍabāgniḥ || 950 || atrāprastutayo ravibaḍabānalayorbhagavatpratāpakāryabhūtasphuliṅgakatvotprekṣayā prastute tadupādānakāraṇabhūte bhagavatpratāpe anantakoṭisahasrāṃśubaḍabānalātiśāyyaujjvalyaṃ gamyate | atra pratāpasya mahāgnitvaṃ gamyate || yathāvā brahmāṇḍabhāṇḍapūrṇe bhagavanbhavadīyaśubhayaśaḥpayasi | vilasanti budbudā iva tārā rārāṣṭi phenavajjyotsnā || 951 || atrāprastutānāṃ tārājyotsnānāṃ bhagavadyaśodugdhakāryabhūtabudbadaphenatvasaṃbhāvanena prastutasya bhagavadyaśodugdhasya niratiśayo vaiśadyaviśeṣaḥ pratīyate || yathāvā cyāvitavaravarṇastvadyaśasā kathamapyadhaśśirā nipatan | vindati vṛṣaśailendo vibhāvarīśaśśarīrabhāvitvam || 952 || he vṛṣaśailondo! anena prasiddhendvapekṣayā'sya vailakṣaṇyaṃ gamyate | vibhāvarīśaḥ candramāḥ tvadyaśasā cyāvitaḥ cyutiṃ prāpitaḥ varaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ varṇaḥ dhavalimā yasya sa tathoktaḥ vaivarṇyaṃ prāpita ityarthaḥ | yaśasā cyāvitavarṇatvakathanena klībaparābhūtatādyotakenātimātradussahaduḥkhatvaṃ dyotyate | ata eva adhaśśirāḥ nipatan san candramaso'stācalābhimukhyāvasare viparyastatayā dṛśyamānatvādadhaśśironipatanoktiḥ | kathamapi dūragamanādiyatnagauraveṇetyarthaḥ | 'kathamādi tathā'pyantaṃ yatnagauravabāḍhayoḥ' ityutpalamālā | śarīrabhāvitvaṃ śarīrasattāṃ vindati | ‘satāṃ māne mlāne' ityuktarītyā śarīratyāgāvaśyaṃbhāve'pi tamakṛtvā ‘athavā dūragamanam' iti dvitīyapakṣāvalambanena śarīramadhārṣīdityarthaḥ | pakṣe vibhāvarīśaśabdaḥ ardhaśśirāḥ nipatan pratilomatāṃ prapadyamāna iti yāvat | cyāvitaḥ cyutiṃ prāpitaḥ vaḥ vakāraḥ yena sa tathoktaḥ ravarṇaḥ rephaḥ yasmiṃstathokta iti bahuvrīhigarbho bahuvrīhiḥ | vakāramutsārya tatraiva rephaḥ prāpita ityarthaḥ | śarīrabhāvitvaṃ śarīrabhāvītyānupūrvīmattvaṃ vindati | vibhāvarīśaśabdasyopapāditarītyā tathā niṣpatteriti dhyeyam | śabdārthayostādātmyaṃ tu na vismartavyam | iha vibhāvarīśasyopamānabhūtasyāprastutatvam | bhagavadyaśasaścopameyabhūtasya prastutatvam | tathāca vibhāvarīśagatena cyāvitavaravarṇatvādisaṃbhāvanāvaśonmiṣitenāprastutenātimātranistejaskatārūpakāryeṇa kimapi lokottaraṃ yaśogatamavadātatvaṃ prastutameva pratīyate | atra kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ prayojyaprayojakarūpaḥ | evamuttaratrāpyasmin prakaraṇe yathāyogaṃ draṣṭavyaḥ || yathāvā phaṇadharadharādhareśvarakanadadhararucā prapadya mukhabhaṅgam | vidrumanivaho jaladhau vinā mukhenaiva līyate satatam || 953 || mukhabhaṅgaṃ parābhavam | mukhena vinaiveti lokoktiḥ | mukhaṃ darśayitumakṣama eveti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe vinā vi ityākārakavarṇena mukhena mukhyabhūtena upalakṣitaḥ vidrumanivahaḥ | vācyavācakayostādātmyam | atra bhagavadadhararuciprāptamukhabhaṅgaprayojyatayā saṃbhāvyamānamaprastutaṃ vidrumanivahasya jaladhinilayanarūpaṃ kāryaṃ tatkāraṇabhūtaprastutaśrīnivāsādharamaṇiśoṇimātiśayapratyāyakamitīyamapi kāryanibandhanā'prastutapraśaṃsaiva || yathāvā prathamaṃ madhurimabhūmnā prathitā madhumathanavidhumukhi madhūlī | tvadadharasudhāvidhūtā dhūlyabhavatprathamabhūmavidhuratayā || 954 || he madhumathanavidhumukhi! bhagavadvallabhe! idaṃ ca madhūlīvidhūnanapāṭavamadasīyādharasudhāyā abhivyanakti | prathamaṃ adharasudhākartṛkavidhūnanātpūrvaṃ madhurimabhūmnā mādhuryātiśayena prathitā madhūlī makarandaḥ tvadadharasudhāvidhūtā satī prathamaḥ ādau sthitaḥ yo bhūmā mādhuryotkarṣaḥ tena vidhuratayā viśliṣṭatayā dhūlī pāṃsubhūtā abhavat nissārā'bhūditi yāvat | pakṣe prathamaṃ bhavatīti prathamabhūḥ ādau vidyamānaḥ yo maḥ mavarṇaḥ tena vidhuratayā dhūlīti niṣpannā madhūlīśabdo makārotsāraṇe tathā niṣpadyata ityarthaḥ | atra saṃbhāvyamānāprastutamadhūlīdhūlībhavanarūpakāryeṇa tatkāraṇabhūtaprastutajagajjananyadharasudhāmadhurimotkarṣalokottaratvāvagatiḥ| atrāpi kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ prayojyaprayojakabhāvarūpa eva | śleṣasaṃkīrṇatvaṃ pūrvavadeva || yathāvā tvadgatilīlā'vamatassevitvā'laṃ viṣaṃ jagajjanani | kṣībo'pi rājahaṃsaḥ klībatvaṃ prathayati sma sādhveva || 955 || he jagajjanani! rājahaṃsaḥ kṣībaḥ matto'pi tvadbhatilīlā'vamānanātprāgiti bhāvaḥ | tvadbhatilīlayā avamataḥ | anena strīparājitatvadyotakenātimātradūnatvaṃ vyajyate | ata eva viṣaṃ garalaṃ jalaṃ ca alaṃ paryāptaṃ yathā syāttathā sevitvā pītvā, pakṣe vigalitaṣakāraṃ yathātathā sevitvālamityatra laṃ iti cchedaḥ | laṃ lakāraṃ sevitvā prāpya sādhveva na tu yathākathaṃcit klībatvaṃ ṣaṇḍatvaṃ prathayati sma | yaḥ kaścidvā puruṣamānī paraiḥ parāstaścedāśvasya punaḥ pratikartuṃ parākramata eva | na tu klībatayā viṣīdati | ayaṃ tu strīparājito viṣaṃ pītavānkathaṃ na klībatāṃ prathayeteti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe kṣībaśabdaṣṣakārāpagamanena tatraiva lakārasaṃśleṣaṇe klībatayā svarūpaṃ prakāśayatītyarthaḥ | atrāprastutena rājahaṃsasya śrīgatilīlā'vamatatvādinā saṃbhāvyamānena kāryeṇa tatkāraṇabhūtaprastutaśrīgatilīlārāmaṇīyakātiśayapratītiḥ || yathāvā tāvakanayanaśrīlavacauryāccakitā jagajjanani śakulāḥ | vyatyāsitamukhavarṇāḥ kuśalā bhūtvaiva jīvanamavindan || 956 || he jagajjanani! śakulāḥ mīnāḥ tāvakanayanaśrīlavasya cauryāt cauryaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ | cakitāḥ bhītāḥ ata eva vyatyāsitaḥ viparyāsitaḥ mukhasya vadanasya varṇo yaiste tathābhūtāḥ iṅgālacūrṇabhasmādilepanena parairajñātayathāpūrvamukhavarṇā iti bhāvaḥ | ata eva kuśalā bhūttvaiva na tu pramattāḥ | āpadi īdṛśopāyakaraṇādapi kimanyadasti kauśalyamiti bhāvaḥ | jīvanaṃ prāṇadhāraṇaṃ avindan | anyatra vyatyāsitau viparyayeṇa paṭhitau mukhavarṇau śa ku iti varṇau yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | arthagatabahutvasya śabde āropaḥ | kuśalā bhūtvā | śakulā iti śabdaḥ ādyayorvarṇayorvaiparītye kuśalā iti niṣpanna ityarthaḥ | jīvanaṃ jalaṃ avindan | tatra magnā iti yāvat | atrāprastutaśakulagatacauryādikāryeṇa tatkāraṇaprastutalakṣmīnayanalāvaṇyādisamṛddhiḥ pratīyate || yathāvā tvannayanaparābhūto vātāyurjanani dṛśyatāpagamāt | vāyusakho bhūtvā''nītkiṃ nu sa vāyusthitirna cejjīvet || 957 || he janani! vātāyuḥ hariṇaḥ vātāyuśabdaśca tvannayanaparābhūtassan ata eva dṛśyatāpagamāt darśanīyatāpāyāddhetoḥ vāyusakho bhūtvā vāyuvadadṛśyo bhūtveti bhāvaḥ | yadvā dṛśyatāpagagamāt adṛśyatāṃ prāpya lyablope pañcamī | vāyusakhaḥ bhūtvā vāyutulyavegaḥ palāyito bhūtveti yāvat | athavā dṛśyaḥ pratyakṣaḥ yastāpaḥ tasya gamāt prāpteḥ vāyusakhaḥ agniḥ bhūtvā agnivattāpamayo bhūtvetyarthaḥ | śabdapakṣe dṛśyaḥ yaḥ tā iti varṇaḥ tasya apagamāt vāyusakhaḥ | vāyu ityākārakavarṇābhyāmeva yukta ityarthaḥ | bhūtvā ānīt prāṇīt | anyatra sattāmalabhatetyarthaḥ | saḥ vā āyussthitiriti chedaḥ| saḥ vātāyuḥ vāśabda evaśabdārthakaḥ | ‘syurevaṃtupunarvaivetyavadhāraṇavācakāḥ' ityamaraḥ | āyussthitirvā āyuśśeṣa eva na cet jīvetkiṃnu na jīvedeva | āyussthiterdurapanayatvādevedṛśaṃ parābhavaṃ prāpto'pyajīvadityarthaḥ | śabdapakṣe tu saḥ vātāyuśabdaḥ vāyusthitiḥ vā yuḥ ityākārakavarṇasthitirna cet kiṃ nu jīvet | tākāravat vāyuḥ ityākārakavarṇasamudāyasyāpi lope śabdasvarūpasthitireva durlabheti bhāvaḥ | atrāprastutena vātāyuparājayādikāryeṇa saṃbhāvyamānena tatkāraṇabhūtaprastutajagajjananīnayanasuṣamādyatiśayaḥ pratīyate || yathāvā ādāya cauryatastava vādānyakasaṃpadaṃ sthito'pi divi | nirjarapāpassamajanyapi nirjarapādapo hare'dāntaḥ || 958 || he hare! nirjarapādapaḥ devataruḥ divi svarge sthito'pi svatassiddhasvarlokāvasthāno'pi tava vadānyakasaṃpadaṃ cauryataḥ steyena ādāya tvadvādānyakasaṃpaccauryādvinā asya iyadapi vā audāryaṃ kuto bhavediti bhāvaḥ | adāntaḥ kenāpi rājñā aparādhānuguṇamadaṇḍitaḥ ‘vā dānta' ityādinā dameḥ ktāntatayā nipātaḥ | ‘dāntastu damite, sāhasaṃ tu damo daṇḍaḥ' iti cāmaraḥ | nirjaraṃ durjaraṃ pāpaṃ yasya sa tathābhūtaḥ samajani bhuvi kvāpi jāta ityarthaḥ | rājadaṇḍitattve rājabhirdhṛtadaṇḍāstu kṛtvā pāpāni mānavāḥ | nirmalāssvargamāyānti santassukṛtino yathā || iti smaraṇācchodhitapāpatvaṃ syāt | atathābhūtatayā nirjarapāpaḥ kvāpi jāta iti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe nirjarapādapaśabdaḥ daḥ dakāraḥ ante madhye yasya saḥ dāntaḥ sa na bhavatītyadāntaḥ | madhye dakāravidhurassan nirjarapāpa iti niṣpanna ityarthaḥ | atrāprastute nirjarapādapasya cauryaprayuktanirjarapāpatāvāptikāryeṇa saṃbhāvyamānena tatkāraṇabhūtabhagavadvādānyakamahimātiśayaḥ prastuta evāvagamyate || yathāvā tvadvādānyakaniśamanaviśamitamānā vimuñcamānā śam | bhūtvā'tha vivarṇamukhā śabalā kamalālaye'bhavadvibalā || 959 || he kamalālaye ! śabalā kāmagavī śabalāśabdaśca | tvadvādānyakasya niśamanena viśamitaḥ mānaḥ ahaṃ mahāvadānyeti cittasamunnatiḥ yasyāssā tathoktā | ata eva śaṃ svotkarṣajñānajanyaṃ sukhaṃ, pakṣe śakāraṃ vimuñcamānā tyajantī | muñcatissvaritet | ata eva vivarṇaṃ nistejaskaṃ mukhaṃ, pakṣe vi ityākārakavarṇaṃ eva mukhaṃ ādiryasyāssā tathoktā satī vibalā durbalā abhavat | bhagnotsāhatayā niśśaktirabhūdityarthaḥ | na hyutsāhādanyadbalamasti | yathocyate ‘nāstyutsāhātparaṃ balam' iti | pakṣe śabalāśabdaḥ śakārotsāraṇena tatraiva vikāranyasanena ca vibaleti nirapadyatetyarthaḥ | atra bhagavatyāśśriyo mahaudārye varṇanīyatvena prastute suparvadhenugarvaśāntyādikamaprastutamaucityātsaṃbhāvyamānaṃ kāryaṃ varṇitam | idaṃ ca ‘ādau sumukhāvibudhaiḥ, viharantyā divi bhavataḥ' ityādipūrvodāharaṇeṣviva na vastukāryaṃ, kintu ‘tatkeśapāśaṃ prasamīkṣya kuryurvālapriyatvaṃ śithilaṃ camaryaḥ' ityatra tannirīkṣaṇakāryavadaudāryaniśamanakāryam || yathāvā dugdharaso dugdharaso mocā mocā sudhā sudhā bhavati | dvirasanagiripatiramaṇī sarasavacassyādyadi śravaṇapathagam || 960 || dugdharasaḥ kṣīrarasaḥ dugdhaḥ prapūrito recitaḥ rasaḥ svādimā yasya sa tathoktaḥ | mocā kadalīphalam | mocā śālmalīphalaṃ tadvannīraseti bhāvaḥ | ubhayatra ‘phale luk' iti vaikārikāṇo luk | mocāyāḥ phalaṃ moceti vigrahaḥ | ‘kadalyāṃ śālmalau mocā' iti ratnamālā | sudhā amṛtaṃ sudhā lepacūrṇaḥ snuhīkṣīraṃ vā tadvatkaṭuriti bhāvaḥ | ‘sudhā lepo'mṛtaṃ snuhī' ityamaraḥ | spaṣṭamanyat | atra dugdharasādīnāṃ tiraskārarūpakāryeṇa tatkāraṇabhūtajagadīśvarīvacasassvādimotkarṣo gamyate | kāryakāraṇabhāvaśceha jñānayoḥ | tena nīrasatvāderdugdharasādigatatvena jñāyamānasya svarūpatastadvacanarasājanyatve'pi na kṣatiḥ | arthasya kāryatva iva buddheḥ kāryatve'pi kāryanibandhanatvaṃ na hīyata itīdṛśānyapi kāryanibandhanāprastutapraśaṃsāyāmudāhṛtāni cirantanairityasmābhirapyudāhāryanta | vastutastu tadatireke'pi na doṣaḥ | na hyaprastutapraśaṃsāyāṃ prastutāprastutayoḥ pañcavidha eva saṃbandha iti niyantuṃ śakyate | saṃbandhāntareṣvapi taddarśanāditi dīkṣitāḥ || yathā tvaddivyakīrtimuktāphalasya bilaśayakuleśaśailendo | vipulau śuktikapālau dyāvābhūmī vibhāvayāmi param || 961 || atra hyaprastutayorādhārabhūtayordyāvābhūmyorbhagavatkīrtimuktāphalakapālatvotprekṣaṇena tadādheyasya prastutasya bhagavatkīrtimuktāphalasya mahīyastvādikaṃ pratīyate | na ca śuktimuktāphalayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvādisaṃbandho'sti, kiṃtvādhārādheyabhāva eva || evaṃ sahāvasthānādikamapi saṃbandhāntaramāśrayaṇīyameva | yathā harihṛcchāṇollekhoṭṭaṅkitakaustubhakalaṅkareṇukaṇāḥ | nabhasi kvacana samūḍhā nabhasvatā bhāsvadākhyayā bhānti || 962 || kaustubhasya kalaṅkaḥ jaladhijananasamayalagnapaṅkaśaivalādirūpaḥ | samūḍhāḥ samūhīkṛtāḥ | atra kalaṅkareṇūnāṃ kaustubhasya ca sahāvasthitissaṃbandhaḥ | atra bhāsvati bhāsvattvamapahnutya tatra nabhasvatsaṃpuñjitakalaṅkareṇukaṇatvāropeṇāprastutena tatsahāvasthitasya prastutasya kaustubharatnasyānantabhāskarabhāsuratvaṃ pratyāyyate || yathāvā bhūtalasapadisamudgatasītātanulagnareṇukaṇanikarāḥ | abhiṣekajalairjaladhiṃ nītāssphītāśca ratnatāṃ yātāḥ || 963 || atra pūrvārdhena utthitā medinīṃ bhitvā kṣetre halamukhakṣate | padmareṇunibhaiḥ kīrṇā śubhaiḥ kedārapāṃsubhiḥ || ityukto'rthaḥ pratyabhijñāpyate | abhiṣekajalaiḥ avatārakālikamaṅgalābhiṣekasalilaiḥ | jaladhiṃ nītāḥ gaṅgādinadīdvāreti bhāvaḥ | sphītāḥ jale nihitāścaṇakādaya ivocchūnā iti bhāvaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat | atrāpi pūrvodāharaṇavatsahāvasthitireva sītātanubhūreṇūnāṃ saṃbandhaḥ bhūreṇukaṇānāṃ ratnatvena saṃbhāvanāttatsahāvasthitasītādivyamaṅgalavigrahalāvaṇyaprakarṣasya niravadhikatvaṃ pratīyate | asyaiva padyasya ‘laṅkāgatabhūmisutātanulagnakṣoṇireṇukaṇanikarāḥ' iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tadā ‘bhūmiśayyā vivarṇāṅgī' ityuktarītyā laṅkāvasthānāvasare bhagavatyāssītāyā divyamaṅgalavigrahasya bhūreṇusaṃbandhaḥ | abhiṣekajalairityanena ‘tatassītāṃ śirassnātām' iti rāvaṇavadhānantarabhāvimaṅgalasnānaṃ ca vivakṣitam | anyattu tulyaṃ pūrveṇa || yathāvā ambudhisute sitadyutiramba tvadvadanaśeṣabhūto'sau | yatsarvadāsyalakṣmīṃ saṃpūrṇatayaiva vahati netarathā || 964 || ambudhisute! he amba! sitadyutiḥ induḥ tvadvadanasya śeṣabhūtaḥ ‘śeṣaḥ parārthatvāt' ityuktalakṣaṇaśeṣabhāvamāpannaḥ | yat yasmāt asau sitadyutiḥ asyeti śeṣaḥ | sarvadāsyalakṣmīṃ sarvaṃ 'ahaṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyāmi' ityuktaprakāraṃ sarvadeśakālāvasthocitaṃ dāsyaṃ kaiṅkaryaṃ tasya lakṣmīṃ saṃpadaṃ saṃpūrṇatayaiva avaikalyenaiva vahati | netarathā na tu vaikalyena | pakṣe yat yasmāt sarvadā asya tvadvadanasya lakṣmīṃ śobhāṃ āsyalakṣmīṃ mukhaśriyamiti vā saṃpūrṇatayaiva vahati, itarathā tu na | pūrṇasyaivendostatsāmyaṃ na tu vikalasyeti bhāvaḥ | atrāprastutena sitadyutessaṃbhāvyamānena śeṣatvena taccheṣiṇaḥ prastutasya śrīvadanasya rāmaṇīyakasāmrājyotkarṣaḥ pratīyate | atra śrīvadanacandramasorna kāryakāraṇabhāvādisaṃbandhaḥ, kiṃtu śeṣaśeṣibhāvaḥ || evamupamānopameyāvavalambya tatra kavikalpitakāryakāraṇabhāvanibandhane aprastutapraśaṃse darśite | tato'nyatrāpi dṛśyate yathā tvatpadavinyastabharassaduttamo nāntareṇa bhavadūnaḥ | atha tādṛśo bhavannapi sattama eveti varṇyate bhagavan || 165 || he bhagavan! tvatpadavinyastabharaḥ saduttamaḥ prapannāgresaraḥ pumān antareṇa upāyānuṣṭhānaphalopalambhayormadhye bhavena saṃsāreṇa dūnaḥ paritaptaḥ na bhavati | tasyārtyatiśayātprārabdhadehadhāraṇasyāpyaniṣṭatvāt ‘yastu prārabdhadehe'pi śocatyārtassa ucyate' iti hi tallakṣaṇam | atha dṛptaprapannamabhiprayannāha atheti | atha athavā tādṛśaḥ prapanno bhūtvā antareṇābhyupagataprārabdhakhaṇḍatayā bhavadūno bhavannapi sattama eva prapannāgragaṇya eveti varṇyate | prājñairiti śeṣaḥ | na tvaprapanna ityavadhīryate 'yasya dehāntarakṛte śoko dṛptassa ucyate' iti hi dṛptaprapannalakṣaṇam | yadvā tvatpadavinyastabharaḥ saduttamaḥ nā pumān antareṇa tādarthyena 'antaramavakāśāvadhiparidhānāntardhibhedatādarthye' ityamaramedinyau | 'odanāntarastaṇḍulaḥ' ityādau tādarthye'ntaraśabdo dṛśyata iti ṭīkāsarvasvakārādayaḥ | bhavataḥ tvattaḥ ūnaḥ bhavati ‘śeṣaḥ parārthatvāt' ityuktapārārthyalakṣaṇaśeṣatāsvābhāvyāccheṣiṇaḥ paramātmanastvatto nyūno bhavatītyarthaḥ | athaśabdassamuccaye 'athātho saṃśaye syātām' ityukramya ‘kārtsnyārambhasamuccaye' iti medinī | tādṛśaḥ uktarītyā bhavadapakṛṣṭo bhavannapi sattama eveti varṇyate na tvapakṛṣṭa iti | svojjīvanecchā yadi te svasattāyāṃ yadi spṛhā | ātmadāsyaṃ haressyāmyaṃ svabhāvaṃ ca sadā smara || iti pratyagātmaparamātmanośśeṣaśeṣibhāvajñānasyaiva sattāhetutokteriti bhāvaḥ || pakṣe saduttamaśabdaḥ antareṇa madhye bhavaḥ vidyamānaḥ supsupeti samāsaḥ | yaḥ duḥ duvarṇaḥ tena ūnaḥ nyūnaḥ na bhavati | tasmin śabde duvarṇaśravaṇāt | atha yadākadāciditi bhāvaḥ | tādṛśaḥ duvarṇena ūno bhavannapi sattama eva sattamaśabda eveti varṇyate | saduttamaśabde duvarṇotsāraṇe tathā niṣpatteḥ | atrāprastutena prapannajanasaṃsāraduḥkhavidhuratādivarṇanena tatkāraṇasya bhagavaccaraṇāravindaprapadanasya mahimotkarṣaḥ pratyāyyate | nātropamānopameyāvalambī kavikalpitaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ, kiṃtu svābhāvikaḥ || yathāvā lakṣmīkṣaṇabhedavaśāddīneśo'pi ca dineśa iva bhāyāt | atha ca dineśo bhajate dīneśatvaṃ kimatra viśayena || 966 || lakṣmyāḥ īkṣaṇabhedavaśāt kaṭākṣānvayavaśāt dīneśaḥ pūrvaṃ daridrasārvabhaumo'pi dineśa iva sahasrabhānuriva bhāyāt | athaca kiṃca dineśaḥ bhāsvānapi lakṣmyāḥ īkṣaṇabhedavaśāt kaṭākṣavyatirekavaśāt dīneśatvaṃ bhajate | atra viśayena saṃśayena kim | pakṣe he lakṣmi! dīneśo'pi dīneśaśabdo'pi īkṣaṇabhedavaśāt īvarṇasya ivarṇatvena darśanavaśāt dineśa iva bhāyāt | dineśaśabdatayā prakāśeta | ivaśabdo vākyālaṃkāre | ivarṇasya īvarṇatvenekṣaṇe tu dineśaśabdo dīneśaśabdatāṃ bhajata ityarthaḥ | atra dīneśadineśayordineśatvadīneśatvaprāptirūpakāryeṇāprastutena tatkāraṇabhūtayorlakṣmīkaṭākṣānvayavyatirekayoḥ prabhāvo niraṅkuśaḥ prastuta evāvagamyate | atrāpi pūrvodāharaṇavadeva kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ || yathāvā gopālako bhavannapyapākṛtaścettvayā jagajjanani| golaka eva sa bhavitā cāturvarṇyojjhito'tra ko viśayaḥ || 967 || he jagajjanani! gopālakaḥ tridivarakṣaka indraḥ anyo dikpālo bhūpālo vākpatirvā bhavannapi pumān tvayā apākṛtaḥ tiraskṛtaścet cāturvarṇyena brāhmaṇādivarṇacatuṣṭayena, svārthe ṣyañ | ujjhitaḥ bahiṣkṛtaḥ golakaḥ ‘mṛte bhartari golakaḥ' ityuktalakṣaṇo vaidhaveyaḥ bhavitā utpatsyate | atra ko viśayassaṃdehaḥ na ko'pītyarthaḥ| pakṣe gopālakaśabda apākṛtaḥ pāvarṇarahitaḥ kṛtaścet catvāro varṇāḥ yasya saḥ caturvarṇaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ cāturvarṇyaṃ tena ujjhitaḥ golaka eva bhavitā | gopālakaśabdo varṇacatuṣṭayātmakaḥ pāvarṇotsāraṇe trivarṇa eva bhavitertyaḥ | atrāprastutagopālakaduravasthāprāptirūpakāryātsaṃbhāvanāviṣayāttatkāraṇabhūtajagajjananīnigrahaniraṅkuśaprabhāvaḥ prastutaḥ pratīyate || yathāvā kāñcanalakṣmīmañcantyakiñcanānāṃ ghanāni bhavanāni | kimidaṃ syātphaṇiśailaṃ yātā ete didṛkṣamāṇāstam || 968 || atra phaṇiśailaṃ prati gatānāmakiñcanānāṃ bhavaneṣu kucelabhavaneṣviva śrīnivāsakaṭākṣeṇonmiṣitāṃ niravadhikāṃ saṃpadaṃ vīkṣya tannimitte kenacidanuyukte bhagavatprasādarūpaṃ tannimittamanabhidhāya didṛkṣamāṇāḥ phaṇiśailaṃ yātā iti tatkāraṇamabhihitamitīyamapi kāraṇanibandhanā'prastutapraśaṃsaivetyalaṃ dūradhāvanena | prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ || sāmānye prastute viśeṣavacanaṃ yathā chāyāphalamasṛṇastarurāyāsaṃ lokatassamāyāti | śākoṭakaṃ tu loke kākolūkādiko'pi nākāṅkṣet || 969 || atra śrīnivāsaṃ prati tvādṛśo mahaudāryādiguṇanidhireva svābhīpsitaphalaprepsubhirāyāsyate | guṇaleśavandhyastu dūrīkriyata eva sarvairiti sāmānye kathanīye tatpratyāyanāyāprastuto viśeṣo'bhihita itīyaṃ viśeṣanibandhanā || yathāvā kalpataruṃ śrayatāṃ na hyalpatarā'pīpsitānavāptissyāt | iti jānanmatimāṃścetkṣitijānanyānkimarthamāśrayatām || 970 || atrāpi śrīnivāsatulyaṃ mahāvadānyamāśrayatāṃ na kadācidapyabhīṣṭārthānavāptiriti jānāno buddhimāṃścetkimarthamanyānmitaṃpacānāśrayatāmiti sāmānye vaktavye tadavagamanārthamaprastuto viśeṣo'bhihitaḥ | kṣitijān tarūn bhūmiṣṭhān manujāṃścetyarthaḥ || yathāvā svārājyaiśvaryamadānnahuṣaḥ sthitavānajāgaro bhūtvā | jāto'hrasvākāro'jagaro jagadamba tava kṛpāmāndye || 971 || he jagadamba! tava kṛpāmāndye sati nahuṣaḥ svarājyaiśvaryamadāt tridivādhirājyavaibhavaprayuktāccittavikārāt avidyamānā jāgarā jāgaryā yasya tathāvidho bhūtvā bhaviṣyadanarthaparihāre ajāgarūko bhūtvetyarthaḥ | sthitavān ata eva ahrasvaḥ analpaḥ ākāraḥ ākṛtiḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | mahāśarīra ityarthaḥ| 'triṣu hrasvo'lpakharvayoḥ' iti ratnamālā | ajagaraḥ vyālaviśeṣaḥ jātaḥ muniśāpāditi bhāvaḥ | jātaḥ sthitavāniti vā yojanā | atra bhāratīyaṃ nāhuṣamupākhyānamanusaṃdheyam | pakṣe ajāgaraśabdaḥ jātaḥ jakārasaṃbandhinyākāre | sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ | hṛsvaḥ akāro yasya sa tathoktaḥ | ākārasthāne akāraṃ prāpitaḥ ajagaraḥ sthitavān ajagara iti niṣpanna ityartho'pi camatkārī | atra śriyaṃ prati tvatkṛpāprasaramāndye mahato'pi duravasthāprāptirbhavatīti sāmānye'bhidheye viśeṣo'bhihitaḥ || yathāvā inatanayastava rāghava rājyamadānnākariṣyadājñāṃ cet | sanayo'pi nanaya eva hyabhaviṣyaditastato'pi vibhraṣṭaḥ || 972 || he rāghava! inatanayaḥ sugrīvaḥ rājyamadāt rājyalābhaprayuktacittasamunnateḥ tava ājñāṃ yathāpratiśrutaṃ sītānveṣaṇādiviṣayaṃ śāsanaṃ nākariṣyadyadi sanayopi nītimānamapi itaḥ rāghavāt tatsauhārdāditi yāvat | tataḥ rājyādapi vibhraṣṭassan nanayaḥ nītividhura eva abhaviṣyat | naśabdena samāsaḥ | anītimānityeva prāsaitsyaditi bhāvaḥ | yadvā itastataḥ asmādamuṣmācca lokāt vibhraṣṭa ityarthaḥ | ‘kṛtaṃ hyapratikurvaṃstu bhraśyellokadvayādapi' iti smaraṇāt | athavā arthadharmābhyāṃ vibhraṣṭa iyarthaḥ | 'dharmalopo mahāṃstāta kṛte hyapratikurvataḥ | athalopaśca mitrasya' iti śrīrāmāyaṇokteḥ | yadvā itastato vibhraṣṭa iti lokoktiḥ| ayuktāpraśastapradeśeṣu patita ityarthaḥ | abhaviṣyat | hītyavadhāraṇe | apirbhinnakramaḥ garhāyām | pakṣe sanayaḥ nakārābhyāṃ yakāreṇa ca yuktaḥ inatanayaḥ inatanayaśabdaḥ itaḥ ivarṇāt tataḥ tavarṇācca vibhraṣṭaḥ viśliṣṭaścet nanaya iti niṣpadyetetyarthaḥ | atra mahākulīno'pi yadi bhagavacchāsanamativarteta tadā lokadvayādapi bhraśyediti sāmānye kathanīye viśeṣaḥ kathitaḥ | pradarśiteṣūdāharaṇeṣu prāyeṇa śleṣasaṃkīrṇatā'styeva | alaṃkārāntarasaṃkīrṇatā tu tatratatra yathāsaṃbhavaṃ buddhimadbhirūhanīyā || yathāvā prāpya niyantāraṃ tvāmatidyupatirarjunaḥ kururaṇāgre | aparājita evābhūdatidyutiścāpi kaṃsavidhvaṃsin || 973 || he kaṃsavidhvaṃsin! arjunaḥ tvāṃ niyantāraṃ sārathiṃ netāraṃ ca prāpya dyupatimindramatikrānto'tidyupatiḥ kururaṇāgre aparājitaḥ parairanabhibhūta eva bhavan ata eva atidyutiḥ atitejasvī cāpyabhūt | pakṣe atidyupatiśabdaḥ pena pakāreṇa rājitaḥ na bhavatītyaparājita eva san atidyutiriti niṣpanna ityarthaḥ | atra bhagavantaṃ niyantāraṃ prāpto janassarvatra vijayī dyutimāṃśca bhavatīti sāmānye prastute'bhidheye aprastutaviśeṣābhidhānam || yathāvā śarakulakamalataraṇe bhūritare pārijātaharaṇaraṇe | balariputulitaṃ bhavatā kuliśaṃ cālitamatāni kuśameva || 974 || śūro nāma yaduvaṃśyo rājā tasya kulameva kamalaṃ tasya taraṇiḥ dyumaṇiḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ he bhagavan! idaṃ ca saṃbodhanaṃ mahātejasvitādyotanāya | bhūritare pārijātaharaṇaraṇe | balaripuṇā maghavatā tulitaṃ uddhṛtaṃ kuliśaṃ vajraṃ cālitaṃ ayathāvasthitaṃ kṛtaṃ nirvīryaṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ | 'kampane cali' iti niyamāt śīlaṃ cālayatītyādāviva mittvābhāvāttannimittakahrasvābhāvaḥ | kuśameva atāni tṛṇaprāyameva vyadhāyītyarthaḥ | pakṣe ca alitaṃ iticchedaḥ | avidyamāno liḥ livarṇaḥ yasmiṃstat ali ali kṛtaṃ alitaṃ aliśabdāttatkarotīti ṇyantātkarmaṇi ktaḥ | ‘niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi' iti ṇilopaḥ | yadvā liḥ saṃjāto'sya litaṃ na litaṃ alitaṃ livarṇavidhuramityarthaḥ | itaci 'yasyeti ca' itīkāralopaḥ | kuśameva atāni | kuliśapadaṃ livarṇāpasāraṇena kuśamiti niṣpāditamityarthaḥ | atra bhagavatā akhilapratyanīkasasaṃrambhodyatāni mahāntyapyastrāṇi tṛṇavannissārīkriyanta iti sāmānye'bhidheye indrodyatadambholidambhonnatisaṃbhedanarūpaviśeṣo'bhihitaḥ || yathāvā sāraghamamba bhavatyā vacanātsvamavaramavetya sāghamabhūt | neyādyadi tu tathā'ghaṃ sāraṃ syādeva ko'tra saṃdigdhām || 975 || he amba! saraghābhiḥ kṛtaṃ sāraghaṃ madhu kartṛ | tena kṛte ityarthe 'saṃjñāyām' ityaṇ ‘saraghā madhumakṣikā' ityamaraḥ | svaṃ ātmānaṃ bhavatyāḥ vacanāt avaraṃ nihīnaṃ, pakṣe avadhūtaḥ raḥ repho yasmāttattathābhūtaṃ rephavihīnamityarthaḥ | ‘prādibhyo dhātujasya' iti dhūtaśabdalopaḥ | avetya jñātvā aghena duḥkhena saha vartata iti sāghaṃ abhūt | śrīvacanāpekṣayā svasya nihīnatāṃ vijñāya duḥkhitamabhavadityarthaḥ | 'aṃhoduḥkhavyasaneṣvagham' ityamaraḥ | pakṣe sāraghamiti padaṃ rephāvadhūnanena sāghamiti niṣpannamityarthaḥ | yadi tu tathā uktaprakāreṇa ayaṃ neyāt na prapnuyāt tarhi sāraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rasavadityarthaḥ | syādeva | na nīrasaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe ghaṃ iticchedaḥ | tathā evaṃ ghaṃ ghavarṇaṃ neyādyadi sārameva syāt sāraghapadaṃ ghavarṇāpanayane sāramityeva niṣpadyeteti bhāvaḥ | atra sarvātiśāyi śrīvacanamādhuryamiti sāmānye vaktavye madhunīrasatvarūpaviśeṣavacanam || viśeṣe prastute sāmānyavacanaṃ yathā karmajñānopāsanamarmajñā ye svayaṃ kṛtārthāste | ākiṃcanyaikadhanā vinā kṛpāṃ te kathaṃ bhavanti janāḥ || 976 || kathaṃ kṛtārthā bhavantīti yojanā | atra akiṃcano'hamupāyāntarasthāne sthitena tvayaivojjīvayitavya iti viśeṣe prastute ākiñcanyaikadhanā ityādinā sāmānyamabhihitamiti sāmānyanibandhanā'prastutapraśaṃsā || yathāvā śreyo'rthināmupeyo bhūyo nṝṇāṃ mahāpuruṣa eva | kiṃcidapi vāñchitaṃ syādakiṃcanairvañcanāparairna paraiḥ || atra sakalapuruṣārthaprepsubhirapi janaiśśrīnivāsa eva sevanīyo na mitaṃpacāni devatāntarāṇīti viśeṣe vaktavye tatpratyāyanāyāprastutaṃ sāmānyamuktamiti dhyeyam || yathāvā katikati phaṇābhṛdadhipatigiripatiśekhara bhavatpadanakhendum | santaśśekharayantassarvajñāśceśvarāśśivā nāsan || 978 || atra bhagavantaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ prati tvatpadanakhenduśirodhāraṇena mama sārvajñyādhikaṃ setsyatīti viśeṣe vaktavye sāmānyābhidhānam || yathāvā śaśikaradattatrapayā kṛpayā bhagavan suśītalastvamasi | ata eva suśīlo'pi śritāvane'śīta eva sutalaśca|| 979 || he bhagavan! tvaṃ śaśikarāṇāṃ dattā trapā yayā sā tayā tato'pi śiśirayetyarthaḥ | kṛpayā svārthanirapekṣaparaduḥkhanirācikīrṣālakṣaṇayā dayayā suśītalaḥ atimātraśiśiraḥ asi | ata eva asmādeva hetoḥ suśīlo'pi | śobhanaṃ śīlaṃ yasya tathokto'pi | apissamuccaye sauśīlyavāṃścetyarthaḥ | asi | sauśīlyaṃ nāma mahato mandaissaha nīrandhrasaṃśleṣasvabhāvatvam | etacca rāmakṛṣṇādyavatāreṣu guhaśabarīgopālādivṛttānteṣu prasiddhyati | dayāśiśiratāvaidhurye sauśīlyasya kva samunmeṣo bhavediti tayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvakathanam | ata eva śritānāṃ avane rakṣaṇe viṣaṣe aśītaḥ analasa eva ‘śītaṃ himaguṇe klībaṃ śītalālasayostriṣu' iti medinī | yadvā apirvirodhe | evaṃ dayāśiśiratayā suśīlo'pi śritāvane aśītaḥ aśiśiraḥ uṣṇa iti virodhaḥ parihārastvanalasa ityeva | sutalaśca suṣṭhu talati pratiṣṭhata iti sutalaḥ ‘tala pratiṣṭhāyām' iti dhātoḥ pacādyac | āśritarakṣaṇe jāgarūka eva pratiṣṭhita ityarthaḥ | yadvā śobhanaṃ talaṃ yasya saḥ sutalaḥ | kalyāṇasvarūpaśca asi | āśritaparitrāṇajāgarūkatayaiva kalyāṇasvabhāvo bhavasīti bhāvaḥ | ‘adhassvarūpayorastrī talam' ityamaraḥ | pakṣe suśītala iti śabdaḥ ata eva avidyamānatakāramātrassan suśīla iti niṣpadyate | sa eva aśītaḥ śī iti varṇena itaḥ śītaḥ na śītaḥ aśīta eva avidyamāna śīvarṇamātraḥ sutala iti niṣpadyata ityarthaḥ | atra madrakṣaṇa eva jāgarūkatayā pratiṣṭhitastvamiti viśeṣe vaktavye sāmānyakathanam || tulye prastute tulyābhidhānaṃ yathā vahamāne pavamāne ghanāghane cābhimukhyavalamāne | cātakapotakadavabhavatāpāṭopo na te ciraṃ sthātā || 980 || atra cātakapotakavṛttāntakīrtanaṃ tatsarūpe sānugrahamabhimukhe sadācarye tadadhīne ca bhagavatyābhimukhyamupeyuṣi bhavatāpastava na ciraṃ sthāsyatīti prapannāśvāsanavṛttānte paryavasyatīti sārūpyanibandhanā'prastutapraśaṃseyam || yathāvā maṇināmabhṛtaḥ katikati phaṇināthagirīśa diśidiśi na santi | cintāratnatvaṃ te kiṃ tāvadamī kadā'pi vindante || 981 || atra cintāratnetararatnanindā nindanīyatvena prastutānāṃ mitaṃpacaphalavitarītṝṇāṃ bhagavaditaradevatābhedānāṃ nindāyāṃ paryavasyatītīyamapi sārūpyanibandhanaiva || śliṣṭaviśeṣaṇā'pīyaṃ dṛśyate | yathā anuviddhaḥ patrigaṇairucchritamāno'tibhīmasattvāḍhyaḥ | saṃkhyāgrasaraśśūrassuprathanaśśrīnivāsatāmayate || 982 || atra śliṣṭairviśeṣaṇairaprastutaśūrapuruṣastutiḥ stavyatvena prastutasya tatsarūpasya śeṣādreḥ stave paryavasyati | śūra iti viśeṣyamatrāśliṣṭam | patriṇāṃ śarāṇāṃ khagānāṃ ca gaṇairanuviddhaḥ tāḍitaḥ anubaddhaśca | ucchritaḥ mānaḥ cittasamunnatiḥ anyatra mānaḥ pramāṇaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ ‘mānaścittonnatau grahe | klībaṃ pramāṇe prasthādau' iti medinī | bhīmaṃ bhīmasenaṃ rudraṃ vā atikrāntaṃ atibhīmaṃ yat sattvaṃ balaṃ yasya saḥ | pakṣe atibhīmāḥ atighorāḥ sattvāḥ vyāghrādijantavaḥ yasmin sa tathoktaḥ | saṃkhye yuddhe agrasaraḥ | pakṣe saṃkhyāyāṃ mahāgirigaṇanāyāṃ agrasaraḥ agraṇīḥ | śūraḥ vīraḥ śobhanaṃ ca tat prathanaṃ ca suprathanaṃ ślāghyaṃ yuddhaṃ tasya śriyaḥ jayalakṣmyāḥ nivāsatāṃ sthānatām | pakṣe śobhanaṃ prathanaṃ prakhyātiḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | śrīnivāsaḥ bhagavān yasmin tasya bhāvaṃ ayate ityarthaḥ || yathāvā padma kṛtī tvaṃ nūnaṃ hariprasādātsadā mukhavikāsam | abhyeṣi rasaṃ labdhvā''modamanantaṃ ca vindase yasmāt || 983 || he padma! ‘vā puṃsi padmam' ityanuśāsanātpulliṅgatā | tvaṃ kṛtī dhanyaḥ | yasmāt hareḥ bhānoḥ bhagavataśca prasādāt prakāśāt anugrahācca sadā mukhavikāsaṃ abhyeṣi | rasaṃ marandaṃ labdhvā anantaṃ amitaṃ āmodaṃ saurabhaṃ vindase | anyatra ‘raso vai rasaḥ, rasm̐ hyevāyaṃ labdhvā''nandī bhavati' iti śrutyuktarītyā ānandarūpaṃ paraṃ brahma prāpya śataguṇitottarakrameṇābhyasyamānamānandaṃ vindasa ityarthaḥ | atrāpi śliṣṭairviśeṣaṇaiḥ padmasyāprakṛtasya stavaḥ prakṛte brahmavidi tatsarūpe paryavasyati | padmeti viśeṣyamaśliṣṭam || yathāvā mākanda tvaṃ dhanyo mādhavasaktyaiṣi sumata āmodabharam | atirāgiṇamapi pallavamacirādracayasi ca sādhu haritattvavidam || 984 || he mākanda! rasālataro! tvaṃ dhanyaḥ | dhanyatāmevāha mādhaveti | mādhavasya vasantasya saktyā sumataḥ sumaiḥ sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ | pakṣe mādhave bhagavati saktyā śobhanaṃ mataṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ trayyantaniṣṇātasiddhāntānuyāyītyarthaḥ | yadvā sumata āmodamityatra sumate iti chedaḥ | he sumate! mahāprājñeti mākandaviśeṣaṇam | āmodabharaṃ ānandātiśayaṃ eṣi prāpnoṣi | atirāgiṇamapi atiraktimaśālinamapi pallavaṃ kisalayaṃ acirāt haritasya bhāvaḥ haritatvaṃ haridvarṇatvaṃ vindatīti tathoktaṃ vindateḥ kvip | racayasi ca | kisalayāvasthāyāṃ lohitatvaṃ patrāvasthāyāṃ haridvarṇatvaṃ ca dalasya prasiddham | navadalaṃ kisalayaṃ yuvadalaṃ patramiti vibhāgaḥ | anyatra na kevalaṃ svayaṃ dhanyaḥ | kiṃtvāśritānaviraktānapyujjīvayasītyāha atirāgiṇamiti | atirāgiṇaṃ viraktiśūnyaṃ pallavaṃ ṣidgamapi hareḥ tattvaṃ yāthātmyaṃ harirūpaṃ tattvaṃ prāmāṇikaṃ vastu vā | harisaṃjñakaṃ tattvaṃ paramātmānaṃ vā vettīti tathoktam | videḥ kvip | ‘tattvaṃ svarūpe paramātmani' iti medinī | brahmavidamityarthaḥ | racayasi ca | atrāprastutamākandatarupraśaṃsā prastutasvāśritojjīvayitṛbrahmavitpraśaṃsāyāṃ paryavasyati | atra viśeṣyabhūto mākandaśabdo'śliṣṭaḥ || evaṃjātīyakeṣu padyeṣu śliṣṭaviśeṣaṇā'pyaprastutapraśaṃsaiva | na tu samāsoktestadanugrāhakatvaṃ, tasyā etadalaṃkārapratyanīkākāratayā'nugrāhakatvāyogāt | yattu kāvyaprakāśe samāsokteretadanugrāhakatvamabhihitaṃ tanna, pratīyamānavṛttāntasya prastutatve anugrāhikāyāssamāsokterevānunmeṣāt | prastutasya vācyatāyāmeva tadabhyupagamāt | aprastutatve tvanugrāhyāyā aprastutapraśaṃsāyā evābhāvāt | aprastutavṛttāntasya vācyatāyāmeva tadaṅgīkārāt | tasmāt śliṣṭaviśeṣaṇopakṣiptadvitīyārthamātraṃ samāsoktirityabhiprāyeṇa yathākathaṃcittaduktissaṃgamanīyā | iyaṃ ca sādṛśyamūlā'prastutapraśaṃsocyate | asyāṃ ca vācyārthaḥ kvacitpratīyamānārthatāṭasthyenaivāvatiṣṭhate | kvacicca svagataviśeṣaṇānvayayogyatāmāsādayituṃ pratīyamānabhedamapekṣate | kvacicca pratīyamānamapi kvacidaṃśe vācyatādātmyam | vācyaṃ ca kvacidaṃśe pratīyamānatādātmyamapekṣate || tatrādyā yathā ucchritabhūdharaśikharaṃ kṛcchrādāḍhaukito'pi mārjāraḥ | samudagravyāghratulāmāghrātuṃ vā kadā'pi kiṃ prabhavet || 985 || atra prastuto mārjāravṛttāntaḥ svalpaprajñaiḥ prājñaṃmanyairidameva trayīśirassu jagatkāraṇatayā pratipāditaṃ paraṃ brahmeti haṭhājjalpitamapi devatāntaraṃ sarvakāraṇatvanirupādhikasarveśvaratvādinā trayīśirassahasrasantatajoghuṣyamāṇamahāmahimonnateḥ śrīpateḥ parasya brahmaṇassāmyagandhasyāpi daviṣṭhameveti prastute'rthe paryavasyati | atra vācyabhūtānāmarthānāṃ mārjāre saṃbhavādupapāditapratīyamānārthānadhyāropeṇaiva vācyapratītiḥ || dvitīyā yathā bhramara kṣamasva katicana nimiṣānbisakusumakośabandhamimam | jalaruhadalavidalayitā raviriha harihariti kirati kiraṇagaṇam || 986 || atrāprastutena kamalakośāntarniruddhabhramarāśvāsanavṛttāntena tatsarūpaḥ svalpameva kālaṃ saṃsārabandhamimaṃ sahasva bhagavatkaṭākṣāstvayi pratyāsannaprasarā iti prastuto bhagavaccaraṇāravindaprapannāśvāsanavṛttāntaḥ pratīyate || yathāvā ravitāpaśoṣitāpaṃ palvalamabhyetya khalvalaṃ tapasi | mīna tvaṃ dīnatvaṃ vimuñca purato'bhyudañcati ghanālī || 987 || atrāprastutamīnasamāśvāsanavṛttāntenātimātradurgatidūṣitakuṭumbamadhyanivāsaparitaptaṃ dīnaṃ prati mā śucaḥ pratyāsannā tava śrīriti samāśvāsanarūpo'rtho'vagamyate || yathāvā markaṭaka vayasi satataṃ tantubhirahamapi ca tantuvāya iti | devārhāṃśukavātuḥ kā vā hānistataḥ kuvindasya || 988 || markaṭakaḥ ūrṇānābho nāma krimiḥ ‘lūtā strī tantuvāyorṇānābhamarkaṭakāssamāḥ' ityamaraḥ | vayasi vastraṃ karoṣi ‘veñ tantusantāne' iti hi dhātuḥ | devārhāṃśukasya vātā vayanakartā tasya, veñastṛc | śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāssamāsaḥ | atrāprastutasyorṇānābhernindanaṃ kuvindasya praśaṃsanaṃ ca nindanīyatvena prastute tattulye akṣodakṣamāsaṃbaddhadurviṣayakatipayapadyaghaṭayitari kukavau praśaṃsanīyatvena prastute bhagavatkalyāṇaguṇaramaṇīyabhavyakāvyanirmāṇālaṃkarmīṇe kavikulasārvabhaume ca paryavasyati | iyaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇāvajñālaṅkārasaṃkīrṇeti vicchittiviśeṣaḥ || yathāvā na viśuṣyasi tapanakarairna ca hṛṣyasi himakarāṃśubhirapi tvam | dustarakāṭhinyo'si prastara tava caritavistareṇālam || 989 || atrāprastutena prastaravṛttāntena tatsarūpasya nindanīyatayā prastutasya bhūyobhirapi bhavatāpairanabhitaptasyāsakṛdbhagavatkathāmṛtaśravaṇādibhiradravaccittasya mūrkhamūrdhanyasya vṛttāntaḥ pratyāyyate || yathāvā puṣkalakasīmagandhā yūyaṃ yatrakvavā'pi jāyedhvam | puṣkalasaurabhyānvaḥ puṣyati hṛdaye sa puṣkarākṣo'pi || 990 || puṣkalakasya sīmā puṣkalakasīmā | puṣkalako gandhamṛgaviśeṣaḥ | yaṃ gandhamārjāra ityāhuḥ | sīmā aṇḍakośaḥ ‘atha puṣkalako gandhamṛge' iti 'sīmā ghaṭasthitikṣetreṣvaṇḍakośe'pica striyām' iti ca medinī | ‘manaḥ' iti niṣedhānna nāntalakṣaṇo ṅīp | tasyāḥ gandhāḥ tatra bhavo gandhadravyaviśeṣaḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | arthasyaikatve'pyayaṃ śabdo dārāḥ gṛhā itivannityabahuvacanāntaḥ, 'gandho gandhaka āmode leśe saṃbandhagarvayoḥ | sa eva dravyavacano bahutve puṃsi ca smṛtaḥ' ityanuśāsanāt | atra puṣkalakasīmagandhavṛttāntenāprastutena nihīnakulajanmāno'pi tattvajñānaviraktibhaktyādiśubhaguṇasamṛddhimantaścetanāḥ śrī śrīnivāsasya bhagavataḥ kṛpābhājanatayā maṇivaravannityahṛdyā bhavantīti tattulyaḥ prastutavṛttāntaḥ pratyāyyate || yathāvā mākandamukhāstaravaḥ stokaṃ dadate phalaṃ kimetairnaḥ | mandāra mahodāra tvaṃ dātā nūnamīpsitādadhikam || 991 || atrāprastutānāṃ mākandāditarūṇāmanādaraḥ mandārasya praśaṃsā ca anādaraṇīyatayā prastuteṣu devatāntareṣu praśaṃsanīyatayā prastute tatsarūpe bhagavati śrīnivāse ca paryavasyati | atrādyeṣu triṣūdāharaṇeṣu bhramaramīnatantuvāyakrimīṇāṃ tiraścāṃ anantareṣu triṣūdāharaṇeṣu prastaragandhadravyamandārāṇāmacetanānāṃ ca saṃbodhanānarhatayā pratīyamānādhyāropeṇaiva vācyārthapratītestattādātmyamapekṣyate || yathāvā madhukara śṛṇu mama vacanaṃ mā gāḥ khedaṃ tvamaśucivarṇa iti | śrīśrīnivāsapadmāśrayaṇenojjīvito yato'si kṛtī || 992 || aśucivarṇaḥ nīlavarṇaḥ aśuddhavarṇaśśūdraśca | śrīśriyaḥ śrīmahālakṣmyāḥ nivāsabhūtaṃ yatpadaṃ kamalaṃ tasyāśrayaṇena śrīyuktaḥ yaḥ śrīnivāsaḥ bhagavān padmā lakṣmīśca tayoḥ āśrayaṇena ca | atra madhukarasya khedanivāraṇakāraṇatayā viśeṣaṇamupāttaṃ tacca na saṃbhavati na hi madhukare nīlavarṇatvaṃ doṣaḥ aravindāśrayaṇenojjīvitatvaṃ guṇaḥ yena tatpraśaṃsākhedanirāsāya kalpeta | tasmādvācyārthasya pratīyamānatādātmyaṃ viśeṣyāṃśe viśeṣaṇāṃśe cāpekṣaṇīyam | pūrvatra aṃśe iha tu sākalyeneti viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā nanu cātaka sumahāṃstvaṃ stokaka iti mā sma gāḥ kvaciddainyam | amṛtārthī harimeva śrayase tvatto'dhiko dvijaḥ ko'nyaḥ || 993 || stokakaḥ atyalpaḥ stokaśabdādalpārthe kan | pakṣe stokaṃ kāyati rautīti stokakaḥ cātakaḥ ‘stokakaścātakassamau' ityamaraḥ| amṛtārthī salilārthī tṛṣita ityarthaḥ | pakṣe niśśreyasārthī hariṃ maghavantaṃ bhagavantaṃ ca tvatto'dhikaḥ dvijaḥ khagaḥ vipraśca | kaḥ adhikaḥ na ko'pi | atra cātakasya dainyanivāraṇakāraṇatayopāttaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ na saṃbhavati | na hi cātake stokakatvaṃ dainyahetuḥ na vā prathamodabindukāṅkṣitayā maghavadāśrayaṇamutkarṣahetuḥ | yena tatpraśaṃsayā vāryeta dainyaṃ, ato vācyārthasyoktarītyā pratīyamānatādātmyaṃ viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇāṃśayorubhayorapyapekṣyate || yathāvā nityaṃ marāla śucirasi nipuṇatarastvaṃ viṣāmṛtaviveke | dakṣiṇavāmau pakṣau dvau śrayase'dhaḥkṛtosi tadvidhinā || 994 || he marāla! haṃsa! nityaṃ śuciḥ śubhraḥ | pakṣe' yo'rthe śucirhi sa śuciḥ' ityuktarītyā parasvāpahārādyabhisandhividhura ityarthaḥ | asi | viṣāmṛtayoḥ nīrakṣīrayoḥ ‘viṣaṃ tu garale toye' iti, ‘amṛtaṃ yajñaśeṣe syātpīyūṣe salile dhṛte' iti ca medinī | viveke pṛthakkaraṇe | pakṣe viṣāmṛtaśabdau gauṇyā vṛttyā asadarthasadarthaparau | tayoḥ viveke samyagvimarśe nipuṇataraḥ | dakṣiṇavāmau apasavyasavyau saralapratikūlau ca ‘dakṣiṇo dakṣiṇodbhūtasaralacchandavartiṣu' iti medinī | ‘vāmā vadhvāṃ savyaramyapratīpeṣveṣu vācyavat" iti ratnamālā | pakṣau garutau siddhāntau ca saṃśrayase tat tasmāt vidhinā brahmaṇā daivena ca adhaḥkṛtaḥ vāhanatayā'dharīkṛtaḥ | pakṣe sarvairnyakkṛtaḥ narake patito vā asi | atrāprastutamarālavṛttāntena bhagavattadanyaparasiddhāntadvayasyāpi tulyatayā svīkartuḥ kasyacidbahuśākhamateḥ kovidaṃmanyasya guṇaprakhyāpanapūrvakamupālambho dyotyaḥ | tatrāprastute marāle śucitvādinā praśaṃsāyā vā dakṣiṇavāmapakṣāśrayaṇādinā nindāyā vā asaṃbhavādupadarśitaprakāreṇa vācyārthasya dyotyārthatādātmyaṃ viśeṣyāṃśe viśeṣaṇāṃśe cāpekṣaṇīyam || yathāvā api śākhino jaṭālā vaṭā ime nīrase phale raktāḥ| tatphalakāmaireva stomaiḥ patatāṃ ca bata niṣevyante || 995 || ime vaṭāḥ nyagrodhataravaḥ vakṣyamāṇarītyā phalakāmina iti ca vyajyate | śākhinaḥ śākhāśālinaḥ jaṭālā api śiphānvitāśca santaḥ nīrase rasavidhure phale svakīyaphale raktāśśoṇavarṇā bhavanti | prasiddhyati hi tādvidhyaṃ tatphalānām | pakṣe śākhinaḥ vedabhāgādhyetāraḥ jaṭālāḥ jaṭānvitāstāpasā apītyarthaḥ | ‘śākhāpakṣāntare bāhau vedabhāgadrubhāgayoḥ' iti, ‘jaṭālagnakace mūle' iti ca medinī | nīrase tucchānande phale paśuputrasvargādiprayojane raktāḥ āsaktāḥ bhavanti | tatphalakāmaiḥ tathāvidhanīrasaphalakāmaireva patatāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ, adhaḥpātināṃ janānāṃ ca stomaiḥ vrajaiḥ niṣevyante ca | bateti tadanaucityacintanajanitakhede | atra nyagrodhānāṃ ślāghanapūrvakanindanahetutayopāttaṃ viśeṣaṇamasaṃbhavi | na hi śākhitvaṃ jaṭālatvaṃ ca ślāghanahetuḥ, nāpi śoṇavarṇanīrasaphalatvaṃ tādṛśaphalasaktavihaganiṣevyatvaṃ ca nindanahetuḥ, yena tādṛgguṇaślāghanapūrvakaṃ te nindyeran | ato vācyārthasya upapāditarītyā vyajyamānatādātmyaṃ viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇāṃśayorapekṣyate pūrvavat || tṛtīyā yathā anukūlabhūridāśānatibalabhāvārimuhuruditabhaṅgān | matsyāḥ kathamagabhīrāṃstucchānāśrayatha hanta kāsārān || 996 || kūle anukūlaṃ tīre bhūrayaḥ bahulāḥ dāśāḥ kaivartāḥ yeṣāṃ tān | pakṣe anukūlānāṃ svāśritānāṃ bhūri bahulaṃ vastu suvarṇaṃ vā dāśantīti bhūridāśāḥ tān ‘dāśṛ dāne' karmaṇyaṇ | atibalasya samīraṇasya bhāsā prabhāvena 'prakampanaścātibalaḥ' ityamaraḥ | ‘bhāḥ prabhāve mayūkhe strī' iti medinī | vāriṇi salile muhuḥ śāśvat uditāḥ utsṛtvarāḥ bhaṅgāḥ taraṅgāḥ yeṣāṃ tān | anyatra balasya sāmarthyasya bhāvaḥ sattā atiśayitaḥ balabhāvo yeṣāṃ te atibalabhāvāḥ ye arayaḥ vairiṇaḥ daityādayaḥ taiḥ muhuḥ asakṛt uditaḥ bhaṅgaḥ parābhavo yeṣāṃ tān | spaṣṭamanyat | atrāprastutatucchakāsāratadāśritamatsyopālambhena prastutabhagavaditarakṣudradevatadupāsakopalambhaḥ pratyāyyaḥ | tatra yathā agabhīratvaṃ tucchatvaṃ ca vācyapratīyamānayorubhayorapyāśrayaṇānaucitye nimittaṃ, na tathā anukūlabhūridāśatvātibalabhāvārimuhuruditabhaṅgatve; yato'nukūlabhūridātṛtvaṃ pratīyamānakṣudradevarūpārthe na doṣaḥ pratyuta guṇa eveti tadaṃśe vācyabhūtakāsāratādātmyamapekṣyate | kāsāreṣu ca atibalabhāvārimuhurudi bhaṅgatvāṃśe pratīyamānakṣudradevatādātmyaṃ, mārutaprabhāvahetukajalajanitataraṅgatvasya kāsāratyāgānanuguṇatvāt pratyuta tadāśrayaṇānuguṇatvāt || yathāvā vātāśanānuyātāmetāṃ sūnaśriyā'tivikhyātām | bhramara kimarthaṃ bhajase bhramannaraṇyeṣu ketakīṃ bhrātaḥ || 997 || vātāśanaiḥ vyālaiḥ munibhiśca anuyātāṃ upāśritāṃ sūnānāṃ prasūnānāṃ śriyā samṛddhyā sūnayā sutarāṃ ūnayā hīnayā śriyā saṃpadā ativikhyātāṃ paradevatāpekṣayā atyalpavaibhaveti jagadviditāmityarthaḥ | atra kasyacitpuruṣasya paradevatetarakṣudradevatābhajanaṃ tava niṣphalamiti dyotyam | tatra vācyapratīyamānayoḥ ketakīkṣudradevatayorubhayorapi bhajanānaucitye hetutayopāttaṃ viśeṣaṇamasaṃbhavi | yasmāt sūnaśriyā'tivikhyātatvaṃ ketakyāmadoṣaḥ | yāvatā guṇa eva, kusumasamṛddhimattāyā bhajanānuguṇatvāt | tadaṃśe kṣudradevatātādātmyamapekṣyaṃ, kṣudradevatāyāṃ ca ketakītādātmyaṃ, tāpasāśritatvasya tattyāgānanuguṇatvāt | yāvatā tadbhajanānuguṇatvāt | evamanyonyatādātmyāvalambanena vākyārthassiddhyatīti dhyeyam || ayaṃ tṛtīyaḥ prakārassādṛśyamūlāprastutapraśaṃsāyā rasagaṅgādharānurodhena darśitaḥ | kāvyapradīpādau tu iyaṃ sārupyanibandhanāprastutapraśaṃsā tridhā | kvacidvācyārthe pratīyamānārthānadhyāropamātreṇa | kvacitpratīyamānādhyāropeṇa | kvacittu aṃśabhedena tadadhyāropānadhyāropābhyāmiti traividhyamabhihitam | tatrādye prakāradvaye na vailakṣaṇyaṃ, tṛtīye tu prakāre kiṃcidasti vailakṣaṇyam | tatredamudāharaṇam || prathamamanidrā svapade sā drākṣā kṣāntimattvamupayātā | prāptā'tha kṛṣṇarūpaṃ phale rasaghanā ca kiyadidaṃ bhāgyam || 998 || sā prasiddhā drākṣā mṛdvīkā prathamaṃ ādau svapade svavācakaśabde anidrā nirgato drā iti varṇo yasyāssā na bhavatītyanidrā ‘nivātapadmastimitena' ityādāviva niśabdena samāsaḥ | ādau drāvarṇasahitetyarthaḥ | arthagatasya strītvasya śabde āropaḥ | kṣā ityākārakavarṇaḥ antimo yasya taditi sāmānye napuṃsakam | tasya bhāvaḥ kṣāntimattvaṃ 'anaci ca' iti takārasya dvitvam | upayātā kṣākārānvitapaścārdhetyarthaḥ | phale atha kārtsnyena kṛṣṇarūpaṃ asitavarṇatāṃ prāptā phalapariṇāmadaśāyāṃ tathāvidhatvāttasyāḥ | rasaghanā rasasāndrā ca bhavati | pakṣe svapade svatrāṇe svavyavasaye ca ‘padaṃ vyavasitatrāṇasthānalakṣmāṅghrivastuṣu' ityamaraḥ | svojjīvane tadarthamupāyānuṣṭhāne ceti bhāvaḥ | anidrā apramattā ata eva kṣāntimato bhāvaḥ kṣāntimattvaṃ ‘śānto dānta uparatastitikṣuḥ' ityuktarītyā titikṣutvam | idamupalakṣaṇaṃ samāhitatvādeḥ | anenopāyānuṣṭhānapūrtiruktā | atha phale phaladaśāyāṃ kṛṣṇarūpaṃ bhagavatsārūpyaṃ prāptā upāyānuṣṭhānānurūpaṃ phalaṃ prāptavatītyarthaḥ | rasaghanā paripūrṇabrahmānubhavānandamedurā ca bhavati | asyāḥ bhāgyaṃ idaṃ bhāgyaṃ kiyat vacasāmagocaramiti bhāvaḥ | atra drākṣāyāṃ prathamaṃ svapade anidrātvaṃ kṣāntimattvaṃ ca praśaṃsāhetutvena vācye | na ca te taddhetubhūte tadaṃśe pratīyamānabrahmavidvyaktyadhyāropāpekṣā | phale kṛṣṇarūpāvāptiḥ rasaghanātvaṃ ca praśaṃsāhetureveti tadaṃśe nādhyāropaḥ || yathāvā āpātamadhuranīrasadurgrahakarkaśaphalena tālena | udvijamānena manāksparśanataḥ kīra kimiva sādhayase || 999 || kīra! he śuka! āpātataḥ āmukhataḥ madhurāṇi antato nīrasāni athāpi durgrahāṇi asulabhāni gṛhītatve'pi karkaśāni kaṭhorāṇi anubhavadaśāyāṃ kleśāpādakāni ca phalāni yasmin tena sparśanataḥ mārutāt manāk īṣadeva udvijamānena calatā karkaśapatratvāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe manāksparśanataḥ atyalpavitaraṇādapi udvijamānena bibhyatā atimātralubdhenetyarthaḥ | ‘o vijī bhayacalanayoḥ' iti taudādikāddhātośśānac | prāyeṇāyaṃ dhāturutpūrvaḥ | tālena tālataruṇā kiṃnu sādhayase na kimapyanena tava prayojanaṃ siddhyediti bhāvaḥ | atrāprastutaśśukaṃ prati hitopadeśo bhagavadanādareṇa kṣudradevānāṃ lubdhanṛpālānāṃ vā sevanāya pravartamāne kasmiṃścitpuruṣe viṣaye paryavasyati | tatra tālatarorāpātamadhuratvādiviśiṣṭaphaladātṛtvamupālambhahetureveti tadaṃśe dyotyamānakṣudradevatālubdhanṛpālādhyāropo nāvaśyakaḥ | manāksparśanodvijamānatve tu tadadhyāropa āvaśyakaḥ | mārutādyatkiñciccalanasyopālambhāhetutvādityaṃśe adhyāropaḥ aṃśe tadabhāvaśca || yathāvā ativṛtto'pi sarandhropyagrasaro yadasi paraguṇagrathane | śrīnāyakabhāktadasāvasi maṇigaṇa hṛdya eva sudṛśāṃ tvam || 1000 || he maṇigaṇa! tvaṃ ativṛtto'pi ativartulo'pi sarandhro'pi suṣiro'pi yat yasmāt śrīyukto nāyakaḥ śrīnāyakaḥ hāramadhyamaṇiḥ taṃ bhajatīti tathoktaḥ | ‘nāyako netari śreṣṭhe hāraḥ madhyamaṇāvapi' iti medinī | paraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ yo guṇaḥ tantusvarṇamaya iti bhāvaḥ | tasya grathane saṃdarbhe tatsyūtatve satītyarthaḥ | agraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ saraḥ hāraḥ bhavasi | tat tasmādeva asau tvaṃ sudṛśāṃ lalanānāṃ hṛdyaḥ vakṣassthaḥ hṛdayaśabdādbhavārthe ‘śarīrāvayavācca' iti yat | asi | vartulatve'pi suṣiratve'pi nāyakamaṇighaṭita uttamatantusyūta eva hāratāmāpanno mṛgākṣīṇāṃ hṛdayamadhivasasi nānyatheti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe atikrānto vṛttaṃ ativṛtto'pi durācāro'pi ata eva sarandhro'pi sa doṣo'pi ‘randhraṃ tu dūṣaṇe śvabhre' iti medinī | yat yasmāt śrīnāyakaḥ śrīnivāsaḥ taṃ bhajatīti tathoktaḥ tadbhaktimānityarthaḥ | parasya tasyaiva paramātmanaḥ guṇānāṃ sārvajñyasatyasaṃkalpatvasauśīlyādīnāṃ kalyāṇaguṇānāṃ grathane tadviṣayakagrantharacane agrasaraḥ prāthamikaḥ bhavasi | tattasmāt asau tvaṃ sudṛśāṃ viduṣāṃ hṛdyaḥ hṛdayapriya eva asi ‘hṛdayasya priyaḥ' iti yat | atra prathamena padena ‘apicetsudurācāraḥ' ityasya, dvitīyena tṛtīyena ca ‘bhajate māmananyabhāk ' ityasya, caturthapādakhaṇḍena 'sādhureva sa mantavyassamyagvyavasito hi saḥ' ityasya ca gītāvacanasya samagrasyārtho'nusaṃhitaḥ | atrātivṛttatvasarandhratve maṇigaṇasya na doṣaḥ pratyuta ? ativartulatvasya randhravaiśiṣṭyasya ca hāraghaṭanānuguṇatvāt | tasmāttadaṃśe pratīyamānapuruṣaviśeṣādhyāropo'pekṣyaḥ | śrīnāyakabhāktvaparaguṇagrahaṇāgrasaratvasudṛgjanahṛdyatveṣu na tadadhyāropa iti dhyeyam || evaṃ kāvyaprakāśādyanurodhenāprastutapraśaṃsā nirūpitā | rasagaṅgādharakārastu 'aprastutena vyavahāreṇa sādṛśyādivakṣyamāṇaprakārānyatamaprakāreṇa prastutavyavahāro yatra praśasyate sā'prastutapraśaṃsā' ityaprastutapraśaṃsāṃ lakṣayitvā 'iyaṃ pañcadhā, aprastutena svasadṛśaṃ prastutaṃ gamyate yasyāmityekā' ityādinā tasyāḥ pañca prakārān pradarśya tadudāharaṇāni ca prapañcya "evaṃ pañcaprakāreyamaprastutapraśaṃsā prācāmanusāreṇa nirūpitā | vastutastu prathamasyāprastutapraśaṃsāprakārasya nānāvidhatvaṃ saṃbhavati | yatrātyantamaprastutena vācyena prastutaṃ gamyate sa prakāro gaditaḥ | evaṃ yatra sthalaviśeṣe vṛttāntadvayamapi prastutaṃ so'pyekaḥ | yathā jalakrīḍāprakaraṇe bhramarakamalinyādiṣu purassthiteṣu nāyake ca svanāyikāyāmanurakte pārśvavartini nāyikāsakhyāḥ kasyāściduktau maline'pi rāgapūrṇāṃ vikasitavadanāmanalpajalpe'pi | tvayi capale'pi ca sarasāṃ bhramara kathaṃ vā sarojinīṃ tyajasi || iti padye athātra kathamaprastutapraśaṃsā ? vācyārthasya prastutatvena tallakṣaṇānālīḍhatvāditi cenna, aprastutaśabdena hi mukhyatātparyaviṣayībhūtārthātiriktārthe vivakṣitaḥ | sa ca kvacidatyantāprastutaḥ kvacitprastutaśceti na ko'pi doṣaḥ | na ca dhvanimātrasyāprastutapraśaṃsātvāpattiriti vācyam | ata eva lakṣaṇe sādṛśyādyanyatamaprakāreṇeti viśeṣaṇamupāttamiti vibhāvanīyam | etena dvayoḥ prastutatve prastutāṅkuranāmā'nyo'laṃkāra iti kuvalayānandādyuktamupekṣaṇīyam | kiṃcidvailakṣaṇyamātreṇaivālaṃkārāntaratākalpane vāgbhaṅgīnāmānantyādalaṃkārānantyaprasaṅga ityasakṛdāveditatvāt || idaṃ tu bodhyam atyantāprastutasya vācyatāyāṃ tasminnaparyavasitayā'bhidhayā pratīyamānārthasya balādākṛṣṭatvena dhvanitvaṃ na nirbādham | dvayoḥ prastutatve tu dhvanitvaṃ nirvivādameva | evaṃ sādṛśyamūlaprakāre dvaitam | kāryakāraṇabhāvasāmānyaviśeṣabhāvamūlāścatvāraḥ prakārā guṇībhūtavyaṅgyasyaiva bhedāḥ | abhidhādisparśaleśaśūnyasya kevalāgūraṇamātrasya dhvaniprayojakatvāt || atha āpedire'mbarabhuvaṃ paritaḥ pataṅgābhṛṅgā rasālakusumāni samāśrayante | saṃkocamañcati sarastvayi dīnadīno mīno nu hanta katamāṃ gatimabhyupaitu || atra kṣīṇarājāditadekāvalambipuruṣādivṛttānte prastute aprastutapraśaṃsaiveti nirvivādam | yadā tu sarovṛttānto rājavṛttāntaścetyubhayaṃ prastutaṃ tadā'pi prāguktadiśā saiva | yadā tu sarovṛttānta eva prastutastadā guṇībhūtarājavṛttāntarūpavyaṅgye'sminpadye ko'laṃkāraḥ? na tāvadaprastutapraśaṃsā prastutasyaiva praśaṃsanāt | nāpi samāsoktiḥ tajjīvātorviśeṣaṇasāmyasya sakalālaṃkārikasaṃmatasyātrābhāvāt | na ca viśeṣaṇasāmyaprakāra iva śuddhasādṛśyamūle'pi tasyā eva prakāro vācyaḥ | ekadharmālīḍhatvamantareṇaikālaṃkāratve sarveṣāmekālaṃkāratvāpatteḥ | vyavasthāpakaistadbhedatāyā anukteśca | ata evālaṃkārasarvasvakārādibhirviśeṣaṇavāciśabdasāmyaṃ saṃrakṣyaiva samāsāntarāśrayaṇena sādṛśyamūlatvaṃ pradarśitaṃ, na tu tadupekṣyeti ced ucyate | aprastutapraśaṃsaivātrālaṃkāraḥ | aprastutasya praśaṃseti na tadarthaḥ | kiṃtvaprastuteneti | sā cārthātprastutasyaiva | evaṃca vācyena vyaktena vā aprastutena vācyaṃ vyaṅgyaṃ vā prastutaṃ yatra sādṛśyādyanyatamaprakāreṇa praśasyate sā'prastutapraśaṃseti tatrāpyaprastutapraśaṃseti | na tu vācye naiva vyaṅgyameva" ityabhāṇīt | evaṃca ‘purā yatra srotaḥ' ityādāvapyaprastutena vyaktena viparyastadhanasantānādisamṛddhyasamṛddhikuṭumbisamāśrayagrāmanagarādinā'rthena nadīstrotaḥpulinatarughanaviralabhāvaviparyāsavadvanarūpaprastutārthasya praśaṃseti tatrāpyaprastutapraśaṃsaiveti tadāśayaḥ || alaṃkārasarvasvakārastu ‘yadatra sāmānyaviśeṣatvena kāryakāraṇatvena sārūpyeṇa ca yadbhedapañcakamuddiṣṭaṃ tatra dvayossāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ kāryakāraṇayośca yadā vācyatvaṃ bhavati tadā'rthāntaranyāsāvirbhāvaḥ | sārūpyayostu vācyatve dṛṣṭāntaḥ| aprastutasya vācyatve prastutasya gamyatve sarvathā aprastutapraśaṃseti nirṇayaḥ' ityavādīt || etanmate tu 'purā yatra srotaḥ' ityādau prastutasyaiva vācyatvena aprastutasya gamyatvena ca samāsoktirevetyalaṃ pallavitena | kiṃca 'vaidharmyeṇāpīyaṃ dṛśyate' ityuktvā ‘dhanyāḥ khalu vane vātāḥ' ityudāhārṣīt | tadanurodhena idamudāharaṇam te mānyāste dhanyāḥ ye'nanyāḥ pannagādrimūrdhanyān | bhūmnaḥ kāṃścidavanyāṃ taravo'pyarcanti nijasumairdhanyāḥ || 1001 || atra te mānyāste dhanyā ityādyaprastutāt śrīnivāsamanarcanto mānavajanmabhājopi cetanā amānyā adhanyā iti vaidharmyeṇa pratīyate | mammaṭādayastu 'dhanyāḥ khalu vane vātāḥ' ityatra vātastutyā svanindāpratīteḥ vyājastutireva yuktetyāhuḥ | tadā asmadudāhṛtamidamapi padyaṃ vyājastuterevodāharaṇatāmarhatīti dhyeyam || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre aprastutapraśaṃsāsaraḥ ekonatriṃśaḥ <5> atha prastutāṅkurasaraḥ prastutasya prastutena vyañjane prastutāṅkuraḥ || yatra prastutena varṇyamānenābhimatamanyatprastutaṃ dyotyate tatra prastutāṅkuranāmā'laṃkāraḥ | tathāca pradhānabhūtaprastutāntarābhivyañjakaṃ prastutavarṇanaṃ prastutāṅkurālaṃkāra iti siddham | prastutasyābhivyañjakatvādaṅkura ivāṅkura iti vyutpatteranvarthanāmā'yam || yathā ayi giritaṭi samaye'smit ghanamimamudbarhibarhamāśliṣya | na kimapi vetsi tvayyapyaticapalo'yaṃ kiyacciraṃ sthātā || 1002 || iha prāvṛṣi vanavihārāvasare śrīkṛṣṇaparirambhasukhapāravaśyena tṛṇīkṛtānyavanitāṃ kāṃcidgopalalanāṃ prati tena pūrvaṃ vipralabdhāyāḥ kasyāścidgopikāyā vacane giritaṭīṃ saṃbodhya evamāheti vācyārthasya prastutatvam | na cānāmantraṇīyāmantraṇena vācyāsaṃbhavādaprastutameva vācyamiha sadṛśaprastutadyotanāya nirdiṣṭamiti vācyam, ‘karṇikāra tvayā dṛṣṭā, vayaṃ tattvānveṣānmadhukara hatāstvaṃ khalu kṛtī' ityādau cittavikṣepādibhiranāmantraṇīyāmantraṇasyāpi darśanena tasyātimātramasaṃbhāvitatvasya durvacatvāt | evaṃ prastutena giritaṭīkarmakopālambharūpavācyārthena vaktryāstasyāḥ aticapalamamuṃ nandanandanamupagūhya dhanyaṃmanyatayā'nyāḥ kimarthamavamanyase tvayyapi vā'sau kiyantamavadhimanurajyediti tāṃ pratyupālambhaḥ prastuta eva dyotyate | atra pratīyamānārthe ghanamityasya viparītalakṣaṇayā agabhīramityarthaḥ | udbarhibarhamiti vācyārthapakṣe unnītāni vikasitāni barhibarhāṇi yena sa iti | pratīyamānapakṣe uttaṃsitamayūrapiñchamityarthaḥ | na kimapi vetsītyetat vācyagiritaṭīpakṣe ghanacchannatvenaupacārikam | pratīyamānanāyikāpakṣe tu ānandapāravaśyena na kimapi jānāsītyabhiprāyakam | ativelā capalā vidyut yasmanniti vācyapakṣe | vyaṅgye tvaticañcalaprakṛtiriti || yathāvā uccairvibhavasthānaṃ tvatpādasamāśrayo hi śākhigaṇaḥ | sānugatā bhajati śrīstvāmastyahiśaila ko mahāṃstvattaḥ || 1003 || he ahiśaila! tava pādāḥ pratyantagirayaḥ pādau caraṇau ca āśrayo yasya saḥ | śākhināṃ tarūṇāṃ śākhādhyetṝṇāṃ viprāṇāṃ ca gaṇaḥ uccaiḥ vīnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ bhavasthānaṃ janmabhūḥ tatra kṛtanīḍatvāttasyeti bhāvaḥ | unnatasya vibhavasya sthānaṃ ca bhavati | sānūni prasthān gatā prāptā śrīḥ śobhā | anyatra sā jaganmātṛtvādinā prasiddhā śrīḥ lakṣmīḥ anugatā ‘chāyevānugatā tava' ityuktarītyā anuvratā satī bhajati | tvattaḥ evaṃvidhāt bhavato'pi ko mahān pṛthulaḥ | pakṣe mahāvibhūteḥ śriyaḥ patyuranyaḥ ko mahanīya ityarthaḥ | atra prastutenāhiśailavṛttāntena prastutaśrīnivāsavṛttānta eva dyotyate | vācyavyaṅgyayorubhayorapi sevanīyatayā prastutatvam | na cātra prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣaśaṅkā kāryā, viśeṣyasyāpi śliṣṭatva eva tadunmīlanāt atra ca viśeṣyasyāśliṣṭatvāditi || yathāvā sparśana eṣa spṛhayati ghanamācchāditavṛṣādrimapanetum | paśya sakhīti prāvṛṣi patigiramākarṇya namravadanā śrīḥ || 1004 || sparśanaḥ mārutaḥ sparśakartetyapi gamyate | atra prastutena varṣānilakartṛkaghanāpanayanaspṛhāvṛttāntena prastuta eva prāvṛṣi śriyā viharato bhagavatassvapreyasīpayodharakañcukāpasāraṇaspṛhārūpavṛttāntaḥ pratyāyyate | sakhi paśya prāvṛṣīti nirdeśādvācyārthasya prastutatvaṃ sphuṭam | prastutāntaradyotanaṃ ca patigiramākarṇya namravadanetyanena uttarārdhe kavinaivāviṣkṛtam || yathāvā ghanacāpalatāṃ capalāśliṣṭovahase'mbuda sthirā tava dūre | nīradalakṣyāt kṣitiriti nigadantī śauriṇā'bhiparirebhe'lam || 1005 || he ambuda! capalayā taṭitā śliṣṭaḥ ghanāṃ cāpalatāṃ indradhanurlatāṃ vahase | sthirā bhūḥ tava dūre tava vyomnyavasthānāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe capalayā cañcalaśīlayā śriyā''śliṣṭaḥ ‘capalā kamalāvidyutpuṃścalīpippalīṣu ca' iti viśvaḥ | ata eva ghanaṃ cāpalaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | tattāṃ vahase tava evaṃvidhasya bhavataḥ sthirā acañcalaśīlā bhūrdevī ahamiti bhāvaḥ dūrā upekṣaṇīyapakṣe nikṣiptā | capalopagūḍhasya capalaśīlasya tava sthirānurāgaḥ kathamiva saṃbhavediti bhāvaḥ | atra varṣāsu ghanāghanaṃ prati bhūdevyā vacanena prastutena lakṣmyāmeva premabhūmānaṃ vidadhānena tvayā'hamupaikṣiṣīti prastuta eva śrīnivāsaṃ prastutapālambho dyotyate | atrāmbudeti saṃbodhanena vācyārthasya prastutatvaṃ sphuṭameva | prastutāntaradyotanaṃ ca uttarārdhe kavinaiva sphuṭīkṛtam || yathāvā savidhagate'pi ca dayite navanīradameva paśyati mayūrī | iti gadite prāpṛṣi vanabhuvi gopī dṛśamavāñcicatkṛṣṇāt || 1006 || iti gadite kayāciditi śeṣaḥ | gopī gopavadhūḥ kṛṣṇāt dṛśaṃ svāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ avāñcicat avātītarat | avapūrvakāt ṇyantādañcateḥ kartari luṅi caṅ | atra gopānāṃ vanavihārāvasare prāvṛṣi mayūrīṃ nirdiśya kasyāściduktyā prastutagocarayā svadayitamapyanādṛtya nandanandanameva sānurāgaṃ vilokamānāyā gopalalanāyā vṛttāntaḥ prastuta eva dyotyate | prāvṛṣi vanabhuvīti nirdeśo vācyārthasya prastutatāmavagamayati | prastutāntaradyotanaṃ ca dṛśamavāñcicatkṛṣṇāditi kavinaivāviṣkṛtam | atra pūrvodāharaṇadvayāpekṣayā dyotitasya kavinā''viṣkaraṇaṃ sphuṭataram || atrādyodāharaṇayorlocanakāramate anyāpadeśadhvaniḥ | sa hi 'kiṃ bhṛṅga satyāṃ mālatyāṃ ketakyā kaṇṭakeddhayā | anyāsu tāvadupamardasahāsu bhṛṅga lolaṃ vinodaya manassumanolatāsu | bālāmajātarajasaṃ kalikāmakāle vyarthaṃ kadarthayasi kiṃ navamālikāyām' iti prastutāṅkurodāharaṇayoranyāpadeśadhvanimāha | tathāhi ‘aprastutapraśaṃsāyāṃ vācyārtho'prastutatvādavarṇanīya iti tatrābhidhāyāmaparyavasitāyāṃ tena prastutārthavyaktiralaṃkāraḥ | iha tu vācyārthasya prastutatvena tatrābhidhāyāṃ paryavasitāyāmarthasaundaryabalenābhimatārthavyaktirdhvanireva' iti | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ aprastutapraśaṃsāyāṃ vācyārthasyāvarṇanīyatayā kavisaṃrambhāgocaratvātkavisaṃrambhasīmāvadhiḥ prastutavṛttānta eveti tasya vyaṅgyasya pratītāveva tātparyaparyavasāne abhidhāyā aparyavasānānna dhvanisaṃbhava iti | tatrāprastutapraśaṃsālaṃkārasaṃbhave'pi upadarśitodāharaṇayorna tatsaṃbhavaḥ | vācyārthasya prastutatayā kavisaṃrambhasya tatra viśrāntyā abhidhāyāṃstatraiva paryavasitatvena vyaṅgyārthasya viṣayasaundaryabalena labdhaprasarasya vācyakakṣyāmatītya bhāsamānatvāt | ato'trānyāpadeśadhvanireva yukta iti || 'vastutastu ayamalaṃkāra eva na dhvaniriti vyavasthāpitaṃ citramīmāṃsāyām' iti kuvalayānande dīkṣitāḥ | ayamabhiprāyaḥ samāsoktau tāvadvācyasya vṛttāntasya prastutatayā kavisaṃrambhagocaratvenābhidhāyāṃ paryavasitāyāmapi viśeṣaṇasāmyabalenāprastutavṛttāntāvagatāvapi prastutadharmyadhyāropeṇa vācyārthasaundaryāvahatayā yathā na dhvanitvaṃ, yathā vā aprastutapraśaṃsāyāmaprastutasāmānyaviśeṣabhāvādisaṃbandhena pratīyamānasya prastutasya vācyopaskārakatvena na dhvanyantarbhāvaḥ, tathehāpi bhṛṅgopālambhe vācye abhidhāparyavasāne'pi vyaṅgyapriyatamopālambhassārūpyeṇa pratīyamāno'pi kavisaṃrambhagocara evetyubhayostulyatayā prādhānyātsamaprādhānyarūpaguṇībhūtavyaṅgyataiva yuktā | kiṃca vācyasyāprādhānye vyaṅgyasya prādhānyavivakṣāyāmeva dhvaniriti hi siddhāntaḥ | na ceha vyaṅgyasya prādhānyamasti tathātve tasyāvivakṣitatvāpattyā asya vivakṣitānyaparavācyadhvanyantarbhāvoktyayogāditi | ata uktodāharaṇayoranyāpadeśadhvanerayuktatvātprastutāṅkura evocita iti | tṛtīyacaturthapañcamodāharaṇeṣu tu alaṃkāratāyāṃ na kasyāpi vipratipattiḥ | uktaṃ hi dhvanikāreṇa śabdārthaśaktyā''kṣipto'pi vyaṅgyo'rthaḥ kavinā punaḥ | yatrāvikriyate svoktyā sā'nyaivālaṃkṛtirdhvaneḥ || iti | etāni sādṛśyanibandhanānyudāharaṇāni | saṃbandhāntaranibandhanānyapi kathaṃcidvācyavyaṅgyayoḥ prastutatvāvalambanenodāhāryāṇi tatra diṅmātramudāhriyate ekena mukhena tvāṃ stuvīta yaḥ kavirudāradhīrbhagavan | catvāri pañca ṣaḍvā yātvā vadanāni pūjyate sa suraiḥ || 1007 || atra vidhitvaśivatvaskandatvānīva tadavayavatayā udāhṛtavākyavācyāni catvāri pañca ṣaḍānanānyapi śrīśrīnivāsastutimahimaprayuktatayā varṇanīyānīti tanmukhena kṛtsnaṃ vidhitvaṃ śivatvaṃ skandatvaṃ ca gamyata ityavayavāvayavibhāvanibandhano'yaṃ prastutāṅkuraḥ || yathāvā mukhalāvaṇyasudhāmbudhimadhyasamudbuddhabudbudanibhāyāḥ | bhāyāsustā muktā bhagavadvadane lalāṭikāsaktāḥ || 1008 || budbudanibhāḥ yāḥ iticchedaḥ | lalāṭe bhavo'laṃkāro lalāṭikā ‘tatra bhavaḥ' ityadhikāre ‘karṇalalāṭātkanalaṃkāre' iti kan | atra varṇanīyatvena prastutānāṃ bhagavallalāṭikāmuktāphalānāṃ vadanalāvaṇyasudhāmbudhibudbudatayā saṃbhāvanāttatkāraṇībhūtavadanalāvaṇyasamṛddhiranavadhikā pratīyate | sā'pi varṇanīyatvena prastutaiva | atra vadanalāvaṇyasamṛddheḥ tadbudbudatvena saṃbhāvyamānānāṃ mauktikānāṃ ca avayavāvayavibhāvaḥ prakṛtivikṛtibhāvo vā saṃbandhaḥ || yathāvā ativelatayā pravahannabhito haridivyavigrahadvīpam | śrītanulāvaṇyāmbudhiparivāhaḥ pītamambaraṃ nūnam || 1009 || atra varṇanīyatvena prastutasya pītāmbarasya lakṣmīdivyavigrahalāvaṇyāmbudhiparīvāhatvotprekṣaṇena nirbharasaliladurbharataṭākatatparivāhanimittabhūtā taddivyavigrahe amāntī tallāvaṇyasamṛddhirdyotyate | atrāpi lāvaṇyasamṛddheḥ tatparivāhatādātmyāpannapītāmbarasya ca ekadeśyekadeśabhāva eva saṃbandhaḥ || yathāvā mamaiva prapannānandastave vadanarucihradaviharannayanamahāmīnarājaniṣṭhyūtam | nāsāvivaravilagnaṃ nūnaṃ dhyāyāmi mauktikaṃ devyāḥ || 1010 || atra varṇanīyatvena prastutāyā nāsāmauktikamaṇeḥ prasavitṛtvaupayikamīnatādātmyāpannasya śrīdivyanayanasya taducitalāvaṇyādisamṛddhirvyajyate | sā'pi varṇanīyatayā prastutaiva | atra janyajanakabhāvassaṃbandhaḥ | evaṃ nayanamahāmīnarājavihāraupayikatayā hradatādātmyamāpāditāyā vadanarucessamṛddhiranavadhiketi dyotyate | sā'pi prastutaiva | atrādhārādheyabhāvaḥ || yathāvā sarvaṃkaṣā manīṣā kīrtiḥ kūlaṃkaṣā tathā kakubhām | abhraṃkaṣā gṛhālī tvadbhaktānāṃ mṛgendraśailendo || 1011 || atra bhagavato lokottaratvaprakaṭanāya tanmahaudāryavattatkāryāṇi tadbhaktajanasaṃpatsārasvatādīnyapi varṇanīyatvena vivakṣitānīti tanmukhena tanmahaudāryamavagamyata iti kāryakāraṇabhāvasaṃbandhanibandhano'yaṃ prastutāṅkuraḥ || yatra kāryamukhena kāraṇasyāvagatirapi padye nibadhyate na tatrāyamalaṃkāraḥ | kiṃtvanumānameva || yathā kaṇṭhe nṝṇāṃ hārā upakaṇṭhe surucirānanā dārāḥ | sukumārāśca kumārā bruvate lakṣmīdṛśo mahodārāḥ || mahodārā ityetat dvitīyāntasya lakṣmīdṛśa ityasya viśeṣaṇam | idaṃ karma, hārā ityādayastu kartāraḥ | atra muktāhārādisamṛddhirūpakāryeṇa lakṣmīdṛśāṃ kāraṇatvāvagatirvadatītyanenāvivakṣitavācyenopanibaddhetyanumānālaṃkāraḥ || ayamalaṃkāro dīkṣitopajñam | prāñcassarve'pyenamaprastutapraśaṃsāyāṃ sārūpyanibandhanāyāmevāntarabhāvayannityaprastutapraśaṃsāyāmavocāma || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre prastutāṅkurasarastriṃśaḥ atha paryāyoktasaraḥ paryāyoktaṃ tvanyabhaṅgyā kathitaṃ cedvivakṣitam || yena rūpeṇa vivakṣito'rthaḥ tadatiriktaprakāro'nyabhaṅgī bhaṅgyantaramityarthaḥ | rasagaṅgādhare'pi ‘vivakṣitasyārthasya bhaṅgyantareṇa pratipādanaṃ paryāyoktam' ityuktam | kenacidrūpeṇa vyañjanayā labhyasyārthasya tato'pi cārutareṇa rūpeṇa yadabhidhayā pratipādanaṃ tatparyāyoktamiti tadarthaḥ | na caivaṃ dhvanerevāyaṃ viṣayassyāditi vācyaṃ, tatra vācyavyaṅgyayorbhedāt | evaṃca yadvayaṅgyaṃ vastu vyaṅgyatvākārādapi cārutareṇākārāntareṇa śabdenābhidhīyate tatparyāyoktamiti paryavasānāt vācyarūpāpekṣayā vyaṅgyarūpasya cārutvābhāvānna dhvaniviṣayateti dik | paryāyokte vācyasya prādhānyaṃ, aprastutapraśaṃsāyāṃ tu gamyasyeti vivekaḥ | paryāyeṇa bhaṅgyantareṇoktaṃ vyaṅgyaṃ yatreti vyutpatteranvarthanāmadheyamidam || yathā yasya vihārāhāryaḥ pārāśaryasya pāṇineścāpi | sūtrasya bhāṣyamatanotsa vinodī me mano dhinotu pumān || 1013 || <6> atha paryāyoktasaraḥ paryāyoktaṃ tvanyabhaṅgyā kathitaṃ cedvivakṣitam || yena rūpeṇa vivakṣito'rthaḥ tadatiriktaprakāro'nyabhaṅgī bhaṅgyantaramityarthaḥ | rasagaṅgādhare'pi ‘vivakṣitasyārthasya bhaṅgyantareṇa pratipādanaṃ paryāyoktam' ityuktam | kenacidrūpeṇa vyañjanayā labhyasyārthasya tato'pi cārutareṇa rūpeṇa yadabhidhayā pratipādanaṃ tatparyāyoktamiti tadarthaḥ | na caivaṃ dhvanerevāyaṃ viṣayassyāditi vācyaṃ, tatra vācyavyaṅgyayorbhedāt | evaṃca yadvayaṅgyaṃ vastu vyaṅgyatvākārādapi cārutareṇākārāntareṇa śabdenābhidhīyate tatparyāyoktamiti paryavasānāt vācyarūpāpekṣayā vyaṅgyarūpasya cārutvābhāvānna dhvaniviṣayateti dik | paryāyokte vācyasya prādhānyaṃ, aprastutapraśaṃsāyāṃ tu gamyasyeti vivekaḥ | paryāyeṇa bhaṅgyantareṇoktaṃ vyaṅgyaṃ yatreti vyutpatteranvarthanāmadheyamidam || yathā yasya vihārāhāryaḥ pārāśaryasya pāṇineścāpi | sūtrasya bhāṣyamatanotsa vinodī me mano dhinotu pumān || 1013 || pārāśaryo vedavyāsaḥ | tatsūtrasya bhāṣyakāro bhagavān rāmānujācāryaḥ, pāṇinisūtrabhāṣyakāro bhagavānpatañjaliśca śeṣāvatārāvityāgamaḥ | atra śrīnivāsavihārācalasya śeṣatvaṃ vyaṅgyaṃ tadeva bhaṅgyantareṇoktam | śeṣatvaprakāreṇa vyaṅgyatvam | pārāśaryapāṇinisūtrabhāṣyakāratvena vācyatvaṃ bhagavadvihāragireriti vyaṅgyāpekṣayā vācyasyaiva cārutaratvamiti dhyeyam | na ca vyaṅgyasyaivābhidheyatvaṃ viruddhamiti vācyam | na hi vayaṃ yena prakāreṇa śeṣatvākāreṇa vyaṅgyatā tenākāreṇābhidheyatāṃ būmaḥ | kiṃtu pārāśaryapāṇinisūtrabhāṣyakāratvarūpeṇeti na virodhaḥ || yathāvā pavanaṃ yo'śnāti sadā tamapi ca yo'śnāti tāvubhau yasya | śayyāvāhanabhāvaṃ śrayato jagadaśubhamapanayatu sa pumān || 1014 || tamapi ca yo'śnātīti tajjātīyabhujagāśitṛtvamabhisaṃdhāyoktam | atra vyaṅgyādanantagaruḍatvākārādapi pavanaṃ yo'śnātītyādinā cārutareṇa rūpeṇa bhagavataśśayyāvāhanayorabhidhānam | yadvā bhagavan svasādhāraṇākāreṇa gamyaḥ pavanāśanaśayanatvādinā rūpāntareṇa sa evābhihitaḥ || yathāvā vāhanaketanadakṣiṇacakṣussthānānyadhīyamānāni | yasya trīn varṇānapi pavitrayantyeṣa me paritrātā || atra bhagavato vāhanaketanayoryadvainateyarūpatvaṃ dakṣiṇākṣinivāsasthānayoryadādityarūpatvaṃ ca vyaṅgyaṃ tato'pi cārutareṇākāreṇādhīyamānamiti vedarūpatayā bhaṅgyantareṇābhihitam | vāhanādīnāṃ caturṇāmadhīyamānatvaṃ ca ‘suparṇo'sigarutmān, saiṣā trayyeva vidyātapati' ityādyuktarītyā trayīmayatvādaupacārikam | yadvā atrāpi bhagavāneva svāsādhāraṇarūpeṇa gamyaḥ trayīmayavāhanatvādinā bhaṅgyantareṇābhidhīyata iti dhyeyam || yathāvā daśaśatabhujaparirambhakṣobhaṃ vyapanīya balisutavadhūnām | kalyāṇāśāsanapadamāsīttāsāṃ ya eṣa vīro'vyāt || 1016 || atra bāṇāsurabāhāsamudayalavitṛtayā vyaṅgyo bhagavanvāsudevaḥ tato'pi cārutareṇa daśaśatabhujaparirambhaniṣpīḍanāpanayanarūpamahopakāraprītatadvadhūvitīrṇamaṅgalāśāsanagocaratvarūpeṇa bhaṅgyantareṇābhihitaḥ || yathāvā naikaśatabāhuvahanaśramamapanayatisma kārtavīryasya | yatpraharaṇameṣa kṛto yena hṛtaujāssa vijayatāṃ jagati || 1017 || atra kārtavīryārjunabhujasahasracchettṛtvaṃ vivakṣito'rthaḥ na tādrūpyeṇābhihitaḥ | apitu tadbāhubhāravahanaśramāpanetṛtvenākāreṇa | yadvā svāsadhāraṇenākāreṇa gamyo bhagavān dāśarathiḥ kārtavīryabhujabhāraśramāpanetṛparaśudharatejo'pahartṛtvarūpeṇa bhaṅgyantareṇābhihitaḥ | na ca kārtavīryabhujacchettṛparaśudharajetṛtvarūpavyaṅgyamādāyaiva gaditumarhaṃ paryāyoktaṃ na tu viśeṣaṇasāmarthyalabhyadāśarathitvamādāyeti vācyaṃ, uktavidhaparaśudharajetṛtvarūpavyaṅgyasya vācyasiddhyaṅgatvena tenāpi vivakṣitaṃ vyaṅgyaṃ pradhānabhūtaṃ dāśarathitvamiti tadādāyaiva tadvarṇanasya yuktatvāt | asyaiva padyasyānte sa vijayatāṃ jagatītyatra jagatīti padamapanīya rāma iti pāṭhe ‘rāhustrīkucanaiṣphalyakāriṇe haraye namaḥ' ityatra rāhuśiraśchettṛtvamiva kārtavīryabhujacchettṛparaśudharajetṛtvameva vivakṣitaṃ vyaṅgyamiti yuktaṃ tadādāyaiva paryāyoktamiti dhyeyam | ata eva ‘namastasmai kṛtau yena mudhā rāhuvadhūkucau' ityatra 'atra bhagavān vāsudevassvāsādhāraṇarūpeṇa gamyo rāhuvadhūkucavaiyarthyakāritvena rūpāntareṇābhihitaḥ' iti kuvalayānandoktaṃ saṃgacchate | yattu tatra bhagavadrūpeṇāvagamanaṃ viśeṣaṇamaryādālabhyatvenāsundaraṃ paryāyoktasya viṣaya iti, tadavicāritaramaṇīyam | na hi paryāyokte vyaṅgyasaundaryakṛto vicchittiviśeṣaḥ | yenāsundaratā syāt | kiṃtu bhaṅgyantarābhidhānakṛta eva | vyaṅgyaṃ tu bhaṅgyantarābhidhānato'sundarameva prāyeṇa dṛśyate | yathā ihāgantavyamiti vivakṣite vyaṅgye ayaṃ deśo'laṃkaraṇīyaḥ sāphalyaṃ neya ityādau | tasmāttadasundaratvodbhāvanamakiṃcitkaramevetyalaṃ bahunā | evaṃ 'pavanaṃ yo'śnāti' iti prāgupadarśiteṣūdāharaṇeṣvapi draṣṭavyam || yathāvā yasyaikamakṣi bhuvanaṃ divā diviṣṭhaṃ vibhāsayatyakhilam | anyattu naktamadbhutamaniśaṃ mama śaṃ tanotu tattejaḥ || 1018 || atra bhagavatassūryacandralocanatvaṃ gamyaṃ prakārāntareṇa sundaratareṇābhihitam || yathāvā yatra caranti tridaśā divāniśaṃ tacca yau pariṣkurutaḥ | yastau grasati ca parvasu lūnaśirāssopi yena so'vyānnaḥ || 1019 || yatra vyomnīti bhāvaḥ | tridaśāḥ caranti, nabhaścaratvātteṣām | tat vyoma ca | divā ca niśā ca divāniśaṃ atyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā | yau sūryācandramasāviti bhāvaḥ | pariṣkurutaḥ yathākramaṃ bhūṣayataḥ | tau sūryācandramasau ca yaḥ rāhuriti bhāvaḥ | parvasu grasati | so'pi yena lūnaśirāḥ saḥ bhagavān naḥ avyāt | atrāntarikṣādikaṃ vyaṅgyaṃ rūpāntareṇābhihitam | ayaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇaikāvalīsaṃkīrṇaḥ || yathāvā dhatte yā tāmarasaṃ hastena vilomatadabhidhānārtham | hṛdayena yaśca dhatte hṛdaye tau daṃpatī viharatāṃ naḥ || vilomatadabhidhānārthaṃ vyatyastatāmarasanāmavācyaṃ saramatāmityarthaḥ | atra vyaṅgyaṃ lakṣmītvaṃ nārāyaṇatvaṃ ca bhaṅgyantareṇābhihitam || yathāvā jaladasarasāṃ yadīyāṃ dyutimāhurdevatā'vatātsāmām | viparītatadabhidheyaṃ yadrūpaṃ sā'pi devatā'vatu mām || 1021 || yasyāḥ dyutiṃ jaladasarasāṃ toyadaśyāmalāmiti yāvat | āhuḥ śrutyādaya iti śeṣaḥ | sā devatā māṃ avatāt | yasyāḥ rūpaṃ varṇaṃ ‘rūpaṃ svabhāve śuklādau' iti ratnamālā | viparītatadabhidheyaṃ vyatyastena jaladasarasāmitiśabdena vācyaṃ sārasadalajamityarthaḥ | padmadalajanyaṃ tattulyamiti yāvat ‘padmavarṇām' iti śruteḥ | ata eva padārthavṛttinidarśanā | sā devatā ca māṃ avatu | atra bhagavān śrīnivāsaḥ bhagavatī śrīśca vyaṅgyau jaladasarasadīptitvena sārasadalajarūpatvena ca bhaṅgyantareṇābhihitau || yathāvā ādyaṃ bhūtamanantaramapi padbhyāṃ vadanatastṛtīyamabhūt | prāṇātturyaṃ nābhyāḥ pañcamamapi yasya bhūtakṛtso'vyāt || 1022 || atra pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśāni vyaṅgyāni prakārāntareṇābhihitāni | gaṅgā'tra dvitīyabhūtatvena vivakṣitā | atra ‘padbhyāṃ bhūmiḥ | viṣṇupādodbhavā gaṅgā | mukhādindraścāgniśca | prāṇādvāyurajāyata | nābhyā āsīdantarikṣam' | iti pramāṇānyanusandheyāni | idaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇaratnāvalīkāvyaliṅgasaṃkīrṇam || yathāvā dīvyatu ko'pi sa devo bhūṣāṃ yoṣāṃ ca yasya jaladhiradāt | svayameva yatpriyāyāssārasanamabhūtsa eṣa vasanaṃ vā || 1023 || sa eṣaḥ pūrvokto jaladhirityarthaḥ | svayameva yasya devasya priyāyāḥ vallabhāyāḥ bhuva iti bhāvaḥ 'viṣṇupatnīṃ mahīṃ devīṃ mādhavīṃ mādhavapriyām' iti śruteḥ | sārasanaṃ mekhalā | vasanaṃ aṃśukaṃ vā abhūt | 'bhūtadhātryabdhimekhalā | nidhānagarbhāmiva sāgarāmbarām' ityubhayathā'pi prasiddheriti bhāvaḥ | atra kaustubhābharaṇatvaṃ śrīpatitvaṃ bhūvallabhatvaṃ ca vyaṅgyam | idaṃ tulyayogitādisaṃkīrṇam || asmiṃścālaṃkāre vyaṅgyaṃ vācyaparaṃ aprastutapraśaṃsāyāṃ tu vācyaṃ vyaṅgyaparam | tenāyamalaṃkāro vācyasiddhyaṅgaguṇībhūtavyaṅgyabheda iti dhvanikārānuyāyinaḥ | ayaṃ cālaṃkāraḥ kvacitkāraṇena vācyena kāryasya gamyatve kvacitkāraṇena kāryasya kvacidubhayodāsīnena saṃbandhimātreṇa saṃbandhimātrasya ceti trividha iti jagannāthādayaḥ || tatra kāraṇena vācyena kāryasya gamyatve yathā yairarpyante kusumānyasamāni ramāsakha tvadīyapade | tairupyante svapade svairaṃ kalyāṇabījāni || tvadīye tāvake pade caraṇe tvadīyānāṃ bhāgavatānāṃ caraṇe vā | svapade svasthāne svavyavasite'rthe svavastuni vā | atra bījāvāpena kāraṇena abhyudayaḥ kāryarūpo gamyate || kāryeṇa kāraṇasya gamyatve yathā kāmayate yān lokāṃstāmarasavilocana tvadīyajanaḥ | sapadi samuttiṣṭhante saṃkalpādeva deva tasyāmī || 1025 || amī lokāḥ atra ‘sa yadi pitṛlokakāmo bhavati saṃkalpādevāsya pitarassamuttiṣṭhante' iti śruterartho'nusaṃhitaḥ | atra bhagavadbhaktānāṃ yatheṣṭalokasṛṣṭirūpeṇa kāryeṇa tatkāraṇaṃ ‘sa svarāḍbhavati' ityādyuktaṃ muktaiśvaryaṃ gamyate || yathāvā vicaranvipinoddeśe sahasranayanaṃ sahasrakiraṇaṃ ca | śokenānandena ca sāsraṃ yo vyadhita sevya eṣa pumān || 1026 || atra sutrāmṇo'ryamṇaśca sāsrāvarūpakāryeṇa vācyena sutātyayarūpaṃ sutābhyudayarūpaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ gamyate | ayaṃ vakṣyamāṇayathāsaṃkhyasaṃkīrṇa iti pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥ || tadubhayodāsīnena saṃbandhimātreṇa saṃbandhimātrasya gamyatve || yathā utpalamahotpalavrajavikāsinī vāmadakṣiṇe nayane | śiśirāśiśire yasya praśamayatu sa tāpameṣa jaḍatāṃ ca || 1027 || sa eṣaḥ tāpaṃ ādhyātmikādikaṃ saṃjvaraṃ ca | jaḍatāṃ śaityaṃ ajñatāṃ ca praśamayatu | atrotpalamahotpalavikāsakāriśiśirāśiśiravāmadakṣiṇavilocanatvena vācyena na kāryeṇa nāpi kāraṇena kevalaṃ sahacaritena candrasūryavilocanatvaṃ gamyate | atra hi vācyavyaṅgyayoḥ kevalaṃ sahacaritatvaṃ saṃbandhaḥ na tu kāryakāraṇabhāvarūpaḥ evaṃ prāgupadarśiteṣu ‘yasya vihārāhāryaḥ' ityādyudāharaṇeṣvapi yathāyogaṃ saṃbandho draṣṭavyaḥ | idaṃ yathāsaṃkhyaparikarābhyāṃ saṃkīrṇam || kecittu prastutena kāryeṇa prastutasya kāraṇasya gamyatve paryāyoktamāhuḥ | ta ete prastutāṅkurasya na pṛthagalaṃkāratāmabhyupagacchanti | dīkṣitādayastu evaṃvidhe viṣaye prastutāṅkura evetyāhuḥ | spaṣṭaṃ caitatkuvalayānandādau || dvitīyaparyāyoktam vyājena ramaṇīyena yadi svasya parasya vā | sādhyate'bhīpsitaṃ tacca paryāyoktaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || paryāyeṇa vyājarūpeṇoktaṃ yatreti vyutpatteridamapi paryāyoktam | ayaṃ ca prakāro dīkṣitopajñameva | prakāradvayasādhāraṇaṃ tadanyataratvaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamiti dhyeyam || tatrādyaṃ yathā garjati jalado vidyut sphūrjati varjaya bahirgatiṃ bhīru | iti jhaḍiti vārayankila caturaśśliṣyan śriyaṃ jayatu śauriḥ || 1028 || atra jaladagarjitādibhayapradarśanavyājena bhagavatā lakṣmīsamāśleṣarūpasveṣṭasādhanaṃ nibaddham || yathāvā alakāścalitā marutā tilako lulitassamīkariṣyāmi| tadidamiti muditahṛdayo vadanaṃ cumban śriyo harirjayatāt || 1029 || atra lulitālakādisamīkaraṇāpadeśena pītāmbarasyāmbudhisutāvadanāmbujacumbanarūpasveṣṭasādhanameva darśitam || dvitīyaṃ yathā kusumāpacāyalobhādviṣamāṃ kuñjasthalīṃ prayāti ramā | saha yāhi tvaṃ śrāntā'smyahamityahimahibhṛdaśimāha sakhī || 1030 || apacāyetyatra ‘hastādāne cerasteye' iti ghañ | mahiśabdo hṛsvānto'pyasti, ‘vīciḥ paṅkirmahiḥ kelirityādyā hṛsvadīrghayoḥ' iti vācaspatyanuśāsanāt | atra kusumāpacāyavyagratayā kuñjasthalīṃ praviṣṭāyāḥ śriyassāhāyakavidhānapreraṇavyājena bhagavatastatsaṃbhogābhīpsitaṃ śrāntatāvyājena pṛthagavasthitayā sakhyā sādhitamiti pareṣṭasādhanaṃ nibaddham || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre paryāyoktasara ekatriṃśaḥ atha vyājastutisaraḥ stutyābhivyajyate nindā nindayā vā stutiryadi | tatra vyājastutiṃ nāma prājñāḥ prāhuralaṃkṛtim || yatra stutirabhidhīyamānā'pi pramāṇāntareṇa bādhitasvarūpā nindāyāṃ paryavasyati tatrāsatyatvādvyājarūpā stutirityanugamena tāvadekā vyājastutiḥ | yatrāpi nindā śabdena pratipādyamānā pūrvavadbādhitarūpā stutau paryavasyati sā dvitīyā vyājastutiḥ | <7> atha vyājastutisaraḥ stutyābhivyajyate nindā nindayā vā stutiryadi | tatra vyājastutiṃ nāma prājñāḥ prāhuralaṃkṛtim || yatra stutirabhidhīyamānā'pi pramāṇāntareṇa bādhitasvarūpā nindāyāṃ paryavasyati tatrāsatyatvādvyājarūpā stutirityanugamena tāvadekā vyājastutiḥ | yatrāpi nindā śabdena pratipādyamānā pūrvavadbādhitarūpā stutau paryavasyati sā dvitīyā vyājastutiḥ | vyājena nindāmukhena stuteḥ | evaṃ ca karmadhārayatṛtīyātatpuruṣābhyāṃ yogārthadvayena dvayorapi śabdārthatvamiti veditavyam || ādyā yathā sutadāraprīṇanavidhikṛtadākṣyastvaṃ gṛhe vasasi dhanyaḥ | na bhajasi bhujaṅgabhūdharavibhusevāyāsavaiśasaṃ jātu || 1031 || atra kevalasāṃsārikasya kasyacidvyājarūpā tvaṃ dhanya iti stutirbādhitā satī tasya śrīnivāsasevāvaidhuryaprayuktanindāyāṃ paryavasyati || dvitīyā yathā tvattaḥ ko vijugupso mattaḥ ko'nyo rameśa ! nirlajjaḥ | śaśvadaghaṃ kaḥ kṣamatāṃ śaśvatkṣānte'pi tatra kaḥ kurutām || 1032 || tatra tasmin punaḥpunaḥ kṛte aghe kṣānte'pi śaśvat muhurmuhuḥ aghamityanuṣajyate | aghaṃ aparādhaṃ kaḥ kurutām | atastvaṃ vijugupsaḥ ahaṃ nirlajja iti bhāvaḥ | atra ko vijugupsa iti nindā bādhitā satī ramāsakhasya kṣamābhūmā nissamāna iti stutau paryavasyati || atra caika evārthaḥ kenacidākāreṇādau stuternindāyā vā viṣayo bhūtvā prakaraṇādimahimnā prakārāntareṇa nindāyāḥ stutervā viṣayo bhavati,
