tatra yāvānaṃśo bādhitastāvānevānyathātvena paryavasyati | aṃśāntaraṃ tu svabhāvenaivāvatiṣṭhata ityavadheyam || iyaṃ cālaṃkārāntarasaṃkīrṇā yathā hṛdyāyāmapi lakṣmyāmatulāṃ tulasīṃ parāṃ ca vanamālām | āśliṣṭakandharāṃ tvaṃ tanuṣe sarveśvaro'si kiṃ brūmaḥ || 1033 || atulāṃ śīlavayovṛttādibhissvasyānanurūpāṃ nissamāmiti tu vāstavārthaḥ | parāṃ parakīyāṃ utkṛṣṭāṃ ca | sarveśvaro'si ‘pathaśśucerdarśayitāra īśvarā malīmasāmādadate na paddhatim' ityuktarītyā sarveśvarasya tava satpathapravartanamevocitaṃ nāsatpathe svayaṃpravartanamiti bhāvaḥ | vastusthitistu ‘vakṣassthalyāṃ tulasikamalākaustubhairvaijayantī sarvaiśvaryaṃ kathayatitarāṃ raṅgadhāmnastadāstām' ityuktaprakriyayā tulasīvaijayantīlakṣmībhūṣitavakṣassthalatayā akhilajagadadhīśvaro'sīti | atra bhagavatassamāsoktyā pallavikadhurīṇavyavahārāśrayatvapratītiḥ tanmūlā nindā stutaiau paryavasyati || yathāvā sadaraḥ karastavaikassādhvasitā''ḍhyaḥ parastadapi śaure | abhayapradapāṇiṃ tvāmāhussulabhā hi sukṛtināṃ kīrtiḥ || 1034 || sadaraḥ sabhayaḥ saśaṅkhaśca | sādhvasamasyāstīti sādhvasī tasya bhāvaḥ sādhvasitā | tayā āḍhyaḥ | atrārthāntaranyāsaparipoṣitā bhagavato nindā duṣkṛdvināśanaikatānaśaṅkhanandakādidivyāyudhaparikaradhāritayā sakalalokābhayapradānadhaureya iti stutau paryavasyati || yathāvā bhagavanbhārgava kathamiva bhavadāyudhamāhurapratidvaṃdvam | tvayi gṛhṇati yudhi paraśuṃ dviṣatā hyapareṇa paraśunā'bhāvi || 1035 || tvayi yudhi paraśuṃ gṛhṇati sati dviṣatā tvadariṇā jātyekavacanam | hītyavadhāraṇe | dviṣataivetyarthaḥ | apareṇa anyena paraśunā paraśvadhena abhāvi abhūyata | tatkathaṃ bhavadāyudhamapratidvaṃdvamāhuḥ | yatastvadarireva paraḥ paraśvadhassamajanīti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe dviṣatā vairiṇā apareṇa apagatarepheṇa paraśunā paśunetyarthaḥ | abhāvi | tvayi paraśvadhaṃ gṛhṇatyeva tava vairī sarvo'pi paśurbhavati paśuvadviśasanagocaro bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | yadvā apareṇa avidyamānapakārarephobhayavarṇena paraśunā śunā śunakenetyarthaḥ | śunakavatsuprahareṇābhūyateti bhāvaḥ | atra bhagavato bhārgavasya paraśorapratidvaṃdvatādhikṣeparūpanindā sukarasakalaripukulavidalana iti stutau paryavasyati | śleṣottambhiteyam || yathāvā stanyamadātte prītyā dhanyā kācijjighāṃsayā tvanyā | tulyaṃ tayoḥ phalamadāḥ kalyaḥ kaste vivekakathanāya || 1036 || atra bhagavataḥ priyāpriyakakṣyāvibhāgavaidhuryeṇa tulyaphaladānādvivekavidhuro'sīti nindayā bādhitayā sarvabhūtātmake tāta jagannāthe jaganmaye | paramātmani govinde mitrāmitrakathā kutaḥ || samo'haṃ sarvabhūteṣu sarvasya śaraṇaṃ suhṛt || ityuktarītyā sarvasuhṛttvena stutiravagamyate | iyaṃ prāguktahitāhitavṛttitaulyalakṣaṇatulyayogitāviśeṣaparipoṣitā | evaṃ ‘śapatāṃ caidyādīnām' iti tulyayogitāprakaraṇodāhṛtapadye'pīyaṃ vyājastutirdraṣṭavyā || iyaṃ ca vyājastutiryasyaiva vastunaḥ stutininde prathamamupakramyete tasyaiva cennindāstutyoḥ paryavasānaṃ syāttadā bhavati | anyasya stutyā nindayā vā anyanindāstutyoḥ paryavasāne na prasarediti prācāmālaṃkārikāṇāṃ samayaḥ || dīkṣitāstu stutinindayornindāstutibhyāmekaviṣayatayā gamyatve dvau prakārau | bhinnaviṣayatayā gamyatve ca dvau prakārau | anyastutyā'nyastutyabhivyaktau tvekaḥ prakāra ityevaṃ pañcavidhāṃ vyājastutimabhiprayantastathaivodājahrire | ayamabhiprāyaḥ vyaktirvyājastutirnindāstutibhyāṃ stutinindayoḥ' iti lakṣaṇe nindāstutibhyāmityatra stutinindayorityatra ca itaretarayogo na vivakṣitaḥ | tathāca nindayā stuteḥ stutyā nindāyāḥ stutyā stuteśca vyaktirvyājastutirityarthaḥ | prathamo vyājena stutiriti, caramayorvyājarūpā stutariti ca vyutpatteḥ | ata eva vyājastutipadārthānugamābhāvānnindayā nindābhivyaktirvyājanindetyalaṃkārāntaramuktam | evamādye prakāradvaye stutinindayossamānaviṣayatvabhinnaviṣayatvābhyāṃ pratyekaṃ dvaividhyamiti catvāro bhedāḥ | anyastu bhinnaviṣayastutika eka eveti pañca bhedāḥ | lakṣaṇaṃ tu vyājanindābhinnatve sati stutinindānyataraparyavasāyistutinindānyataratvaṃ sarvānugatamiti dhyeyamiti || tanmate evaṃ lakṣaṇaślokaḥ stutyā nindā nindayā vā stutirbhinnaikagocarā | vyaṅgyā vibhinnaviṣayā stutyā vyājastutisstutiḥ || stutyā nindāyāḥ nindayā stutervā bhinnaviṣayāyāssamānaviṣayāyā vā vyaṅgyatāyāṃ catvāraḥ prakārāḥ | bhinnaviṣayāyāḥ stutyā stutervyaṅgyatāyāṃ tvekaḥ prakāra iti pañcadhā vyājastutirityarthaḥ || bhinnaviṣayatve stutyā nindābhivyaktiryathā dhanyāḥ khagā mṛgā api vanyā ete nagāśca nāgāśva | mānyā ye mādhavapadavinyāsapavitrite vasanti girau || 1037 || atra mṛgādhirājanagāvāsināṃ khagādīnāṃ dhanyatāstutyā atadvidhānāmadhanyatārūpanindā vyajyate || iyamevāprastutapraśaṃsā na kāryakāraṇanibandhaneti daṇḍī | yadāha aprastutapraśaṃsā syādaprakāṇḍe tu yā stutiḥ | sukhaṃ jīvanti hariṇā vaneṣvaparasevinaḥ || arthairayatnasulabhaistṛṇadarbhāṅkurādibhiḥ | seyamaprastutaivātra mṛgavṛttiḥ praśasyate || rājānuvartanakleśanirviṇṇena manasvinā || iti | vastutastu 'atra vyājastutirityevayuktaṃ, stutyā nindābhivyaktirityaprastutapraśaṃsāto vaicitryaviśeṣasadbhāvāt | anyathā prasiddhavyājastutyudāharaṇeṣvapyaprastutābhyāṃ nindāstutibhyāṃ prastute stutininde gamyete ityetāvatā vyājastutimātramaprastutapraśaṃsā syāt' iti dīkṣitāḥ || anye tu prasiddhasthale ‘kassvardhuni vivekaste, sādhu dūti punassādhu' ityādau stutinindayorekadharmatvādaprastutapraśaṃsāyāstatrāsaṃbhavena vyājastuterviviktaviṣayatvasāmrājyānna vyājastutimātramaprastutapraśaṃsā bhaviṣyati | prastutadharmike'pyaprastutapraśaṃsā'bhyupagame tu tasminneva viṣaye lalitālaṃkārapārthakyābhyupagamo vyāhatassyādityāhuḥ || bhinnaviṣayatve nindayā stutyabhivyaktiryathā apadatrayamitalokairavāmapādāmbupūtajagatīkaiḥ | alamanyasuravarākairanamṛtadānakṣamairalakṣmīkaiḥ || atra devatāntaranindayā śrīnivāsastutyabhivyaktiḥ || stutyā nindāyāḥ nindayā stutyā vā'bhivyaktau samānaviṣayatāyāṃ prāgevodāharaṇāni prādarśiṣata || anyastutyā'nyastutyabhivyaktiryathā kṣetre kva nu katidivasānvyadhāttapo vā'pi kimabhidhānamayam | yadavirataṃ tvatpadasamamaravindaṃ vindate'cyuta milindaḥ || 1039 || atra milindastutyā bhagavatpādāravindasaundaryasaukumāryabhogyatādisaubhāgyātiśayastutirvyajyate || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre vyājastutisaro dvātriṃśaḥ || <8> atha vyājanindāsaraḥ vyājanindā tu nindāyā nindayā vyaṅgyatā yadi || 91 || yatrānyanindayā anyasya nindāyā abhivyaktissā vyājanindā | itaranindāvyājena nindeti vyutpatteḥ || yathā ghiṅmāṃ jaḍamūrdhanyaṃ vāṅmānasadūravipuladaurjanyam | payasijalocana yo'haṃ tvayi vimukhānāṃ mukhāni paśyāmi || 1040 || atra śrīnivāsavimukhajanamukhāvalokitussvasya nindayā tādṛśasya paramapāpiṣṭhatayā nindā vyajyate || yathā vā āmukhamadhuraṃ pariṇativirasaṃ tiktaṃ ca vitarasi phalaṃ tvam | uccairbhūtapalāśaissevyo'si na mādṛśasya tālataro || 1041 || āmukhamadhuraṃ āpātamadhuraṃ ‘tālaphalarasa ivāpātamadhuraḥ pariṇāmavirasastiktaśca' ityetadanusaṃhitam | uccaiḥ bhūtaiḥ devayoniviśeṣaiḥ palāśaiḥ kravyādaiśca | anyatra uccaiḥ ūrdhvapradeśe bhūtaiḥ jātaiḥ palāśaiḥ patraiḥ sevyaḥ | mādṛśasya divyaphalārthina iti bhāvaḥ | na sevya iti yojanā | atra bhagavatprapannavacane tālatarunindayā'titucchaphalapradadevatāntaranindā vyajyate || ayamapyalaṃkāro dīkṣitopajñameva || nanu kenāpyālaṃkārikeṇānudīritāyā asyāḥ vyājanindāyāḥ kathamalaṃkāratayā'bhyupagamaḥ? ucyate’nyastutyā'nyastutyabhivyaktiriti pañcamaprakāravyājastuteḥ tulyayuktyā pratidvaṃdvisthānīyatvādasyāḥ | tathāca stutivannindāyāmapyaprastutapraśaṃsāto vaicitryaviśeṣāttadanantarbhāve vyājastutau cārthānugamābhāvādanantarbhāve pṛthagalaṃkāratāyā aucityātprācīnairanuktāyā apyabhyupagantumucitatvāditi || nanu yatrānyastutyā'nya stutiranyanindayā'nyanindā ca pratīyate tatra vyājastutivyājanindālaṃkārābhyupagame stutinindārūpāprastutapraśaṃsodāharaṇeṣvaprastutapraśaṃsā na vaktavyā, teṣāmapi vyājastutivyājanindābhyāṃ kroḍīkaraṇasaṃbhavāditi ceducyate yatrāprastutavṛttāntāt stutinindārūpāttatsarūpaḥ prastutavṛttāntaḥ pratīyate ‘antaśchidrāṇi bhūyāṃsi' ityādau tatra labdhāvakāśā sārūpyanibandhanāprastutapraśaṃsā'trāpi pravartamānā na śakyate vārayitum | anyastutyā'nyastutiranyanindayā'nyanindetyevaṃ vyājastutivyājaninde api saṃbhavataścetkāmaṃ te api saṃbhavetāṃ na tvasyāḥ parityāgaḥ | yadyapi ‘āmukhamadhuraṃ pariṇativirasam' ityanupadodāhṛte padye tālatarunindayā nihīnaphaladātṛdevatāntaranindā pratīyata iti tatra sārūpyanibandhanā'prastutapraśaṃsā'pyasti tathā'pi saiva vyājanindāmūleti prathamopāsthitā sā'pi tatra durvārā | evaṃca vyājanindā'nuprāṇiteyamaprastutapraśaṃseti camaktārātiśayaḥ || yathāvā kardama durdamagarvo valga tvaṃ kastavātra doṣo'sti | yastvāṃ kastūrīsamamavaiti nindyassa vai vipinamahiṣaḥ || 1012 || atra vanamahiṣanindayā tanmūlakakardamanindayā ca mūḍhatamasya kasyacit tena ca mahābrahmavittulyatayā jñātasya vidvanmāninaḥ kasyacidvaidheyasya ca nindā pratīyata iti sārūpyanibandhanāprastutapraśaṃsā vyājanindāmūlakavyājanindārūpeyamiti pūrvasmādvicchittiviśeṣaḥ || evameva vyājastutimūlakavyājastutirūpā'pyaprastutapraśaṃsā dṛśyate || yathā nandātmajacūḍārhaṃ barhaṃ yā tava tatāna nanu barhin | sā'mbudamālā stutyā nṛtyānandena kiṃ tava stutyā || 1043 || tatāna vitastāra | stutyā stavārhā | ānandena nṛtya nartanaṃ kuru nṛtyaterloṇmadhyamaikavacanam | tvaṃ svairaṃ nartanaṃ vidhehi asmādṛśāṃ stutyā tava kiṃ prayojanamiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā tava stutyā tvatkarmakastavena asmākaṃ kiṃ prayojanaṃ tavāpyatiśayādhāyikāyāṃ jāgratyāṃ kādambinyāmiti bhāvaḥ | kiṃ tava stutyetyuktirapi harṣātiśayakāriteti stutiparyavasāyinyeva || atrāprastutāmbudamālāstutyā tanmūlakamayūrastutyā ca mahāvadānyacūḍāmaṇermahālakṣmyāstatkaṭākṣādhigatabhagavadarhaṇaupayikavaibhavasya tadbhaktasya ca stutirgamyata itīyaṃ sārūpyanibandhanāprastutapraśaṃsā vyājastutimūlakavyājastutirūpā || yathā vā bahudhā'bhinandanīyassa vidhātā yaścakoraśāba tvām | vidadhe'khiladvijeṣvapi vidhupādasudhārasaikajīvātum || 1044 || atrāprastutā vidhātṛpraśaṃsā tanmūlakacakorastutiśca prastutasya paramakāruṇikasya mahābhāgavatasyācāryasya tatkṛpāsamadhigatabhagavaccaraṇāravindaparicaraṇānubhavarasaikajīvanasyāntevāsinaśca praśaṃsāyāṃ paryavasyati || bukkapattanaveṅkaṭācāryāstu vyājastuteḥ vyājanindāyāśca pratyekaṃ prakāratrayamevāhuḥ || tathāhi tadīye'laṃkārakaustubhe stutyā vā nindayā vā'pi stutiryatra pratīyate | samarthayāmahe tatra vyājastutimalaṃkṛtim || anyastutyā'nyastutiḥ tannindayā tatstutiḥ anyanindayā'nyastutiśceti vyājastutestraividhyam || stutyā vā nindayā vā'pi yatra nindā pratīyate | samarthayāmahe tatra vyājanindāmalaṃkṛtim || stutyā nindā dvividhā | tatstutyā tannindā anyastutyā tannindā | nindayā nindā tvekavidheti vyājanindayāśca traividhyaṃ pradarśya, tathaivodāharaṇāni ca pradāya ‘yadyapi kuvalayānande stutyā nindābhivyaktirapi vyājastutireveti svīkṛtya vyājastuteḥ pañca prakārā ityuktaṃ, tathā'pi nindābhivyaktisthale vyājanindaiva yukteti stutyabhivyaktau vyājastutimaṅgīkṛtya yatraḥ prakārā ityevāśrayituṃ yuktam | samaviṣamādinyāyena parasparapratidvandvinorvibhinnālaṃkāraviṣayatāvaśyakatvādityasmābhiranyathoktam' ityupapāditam || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre vyājanindāsarastrayastriṃśaḥ || <9> athākṣepālaṃkārasaraḥ sa ākṣepo bhavetsvoktaniṣedho yo vimarśataḥ | uktasyārthasya paryālocanapūrvakaḥ pratiṣedha ākṣepālaṃkāraḥ || yathā parirakṣa māṃ prapannaṃ pannaganaganātha bhavapathavipannam | dhanyastvayyahamathavā vinyastabharaḥ kimanyadāśāse || 1045 || atra prārthitasya svarakṣaṇasya bhagavati vinyastasamastātmabharatvena vaiyarthyamālocyāthavetyādinā pratiṣedhassūcitaḥ || yathāvā tvanmukharucidhūtarucerjīvitasaṃdeha eva sannetuḥ | śiśiramarīcerathavā jaivākṛta eṣa kathamapi sa jīvat || 1046 || jaivātṛkaḥ dīrghāyuḥ 'jaivātṛkaḥ pumān some dīrghāyuḥkṛśayostriṣu' iti medinī | atra bhagavanmukhaprabhāvidhūtaruceśśiśiraruceḥ satpatitvāt ‘satāṃ māne mlāne maraṇamathavā dūragamanam' ityuktarītyā jīvitasaṃdehasya saṃbhāvitasya jaivātṛkaśabdagatārthaśleṣamahimnā āyuṣmattāṃ vicārya pratiṣedho varṇitaḥ | śleṣasaṃkīrṇatvaṃ pūrvasmādvicchittiviśeṣaḥ || yathāvā deva kathamudavahastāmudadheḥ piṅgalatayā śrutāṃ kanyām | sā hi niṣiddhā śāstrairathavā svairasya vidhiniṣedhau kva || 1047 || he deva! piṅgalāyāḥ bhāvaḥ piṅgalatā tayā ‘tvatalorguṇavacanasya' iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ | śrutāṃ niśamitāṃ khyātāmiti yāvat | ‘piṅgalāṃ hemamālinīm' iti śrutiprasiddhāmiti hṛdayam | udadheḥ kanyāṃ kathaṃ udavahaḥ paryaṇaiṣīḥ | kuto'sāvākṣepa ityata āha sā hīti | sā piṅgalavarṇā kanyā śāstraiḥ niṣiddhā, nodvahetkapilāṃ kanyāṃ nādhikāṅgīṃ na rogiṇīm | nālomikāṃ nātilomāṃ na vācāṭāṃ na piṅgalām || piśācadevatulyatārūpaviśeṣamākṣipati || yathāvā na vadāmi cāṭu śaure tava dāsānāṃ nṛṇāṃ purandhrigaṇāḥ | maṇisaudhāgragatā vidhulakṣma dṛśorañjanārthamādadate || 1062 || atra stotuḥ kavervacane prathamacaraṇe cāṭuvāditvaniṣedho bādhito mṛṣāvāditvaniṣedhātmanā paryavasyannavaśiṣṭacaraṇatritayagatasyārthasya satyatvarūpaṃ viśeṣaṃ vyanakti | satyatvaṃ cāsya kaviprauḍhoktisiddham | ‘caṭu cāṭu priye vākye' iti tatvabodhinyāmavyayeṣu pāṭhāt cāṭu ityetadavyayam | klībaṃ vā | ‘astrī cāṭuścaṭuḥ' iti kośāt | yathāvā govinda nandanandana sundara na tvāṃ samutsahe draṣṭum | paśyantu svairaṃ tāssvai rantā yā vinodayasi vihṛtaiḥ || 1063 || tāḥ lalanāḥ svāṃ svairaṃ yathepsitaṃ paśyantu | caturthacaraṇe svaiḥ rantā yāḥ iti chedaḥ | rantā vilāsī tvaṃ yāḥ lalanāḥ svaiḥ nijaiḥ vihṛtaiḥ vihāraiḥ bhāve ktaḥ vinodayasi tāḥ paśyantvityanvayaḥ | atra bhagavantaṃ nandanandanaṃ paśyantyāḥ kasyāścidgopamahilāyā uktau ātmani taddharśanotsāhaniṣedho'nupapadyamānassan nāyikāntareṣviva mayyananurakto'si kiṃ vidheyamiti dainyaṃ dyotayati || niṣedhābhāsavadvidhyābhāso'pyākṣepa iṣyate | tulyanyāyatayā asatyena vidhinā niṣedhasyākṣepe aparo'pyākṣepa ityarthaḥ | atra aniṣṭo'rthaḥ tasya vidhiḥ tasyāpyābhāsatvaṃ arthagataviśeṣapratipādanaṃ ceti catuṣṭayamupayujyata ityāhuḥ || yathā daivātsatpathamupagatamevaṃ māṃ cedupekṣase bāḍham | bhūyo'pyapathagamenaṃ śreyasi yojayasi kathamiti bibhemi || 106 4 || idānīṃ yādṛcchikādisukṛtavaśātsanmārgasamīpagataṃ māṃ tvamupakṣase cet bāḍhaṃ tathaivopekṣasvetyarthaḥ |bāḍhamityaṅgīkāre'vyayam | atra ca kasyacidbhagavadbhaktasya paramapuruṣaṃ pratyupekṣāprārthanaṃ vidhīyamānamanupapadyamānaṃ tadvidhyābhāsatayā niṣedhamevāvagamayati | upekṣasveti vidhirvyaktaḥ | mopekṣiṣṭhā iti niṣedhastu bhūyo'pi karmavaśādapathapravṛttamenaṃ māmucite śreyasi pravartayituṃ tava mahān prayāsassyāditi bhayapradarśanena tirohitaḥ | ata eva "ākṣepo'nyo vidhau vyakte pratiṣedhe tirohite" | iti kuvalayānandakārairayaṃ prakāro lakṣitaḥ || ityalaṅkāramaṇihāre ākṣepasaraścatustriṃśaḥ || <10> atha virodhamūlā alaṃkārāḥ tatra virodhālaṃkārasaraḥ sa virodho'virodhe'pi virodhābhāsatā yadi | jātyādīnāṃ svasvaparasaṃbandhāddaśadhā bhavet || paramārthato virodhābhāvepi yatrāpātato virodho bhāsate sa virodhālaṅkāraḥ | virodhaśca prarūḍho'prarūḍhaśceti dvividhaḥ | prarohaśca bādhabuddhyanabhibhṛtatvaṃ, tadvaiparītyamaprarohaḥ | tatrādyo doṣasya viṣayaḥ dvitīyastvalaṅkārasya | ata evemamācakṣate virodhābhāsam | ā īṣat bhāsata ityābhāsaḥ virodhaścāsāvābhāsaśceti | āmukha eva pratīyamāno jhagiti jāyamānāvirodhabuddhitiraskṛta iti yāvat | tatrāpi kāryakāraṇādibuddhyanālīḍho virodhābhāso virodhālaṃkāraḥ | tadālīḍhastu vibhāvanādirvakṣyamāṇaḥ| ayaṃ ca jātiguṇakriyādravyāṇāṃ svena svetareṇa ca saha yogādbhavati | evaṃ ca jāterjātiguṇakriyādravyaiḥ, guṇasya guṇakriyādravyaiḥ, kriyāyāḥ kriyādravyābhyāṃ, dravyasya dravyeṇaiveti daśa bhedāḥ paryavasannāḥ | tathācoktam jātiścaturbhirjātyādyairviruddhā syādguṇastribhiḥ| kriyā dvābhyāmatha dravyaṃ dravyeṇaiveti te daśa || iti | guṇena saha jātervirodhastu pṛthaṅnoktaḥ, jāterguṇavirodha eva tadantarbhāvāt | evamuttaratrāpi bodhyam| kriyā cātra na vaiyākaraṇānāmiva śuddhā bhāvanā, nāpi naiyāyikānāmiva spandarūpā | kiṃ tu tattaddhātuvācyā viśiṣṭavyāpārarūpeti dhyeyam || tatra jāterjātyā virodho yathā ramyāṇi vimānānyatisaumyāni sarāṃsi saṃsadaścatathā | sthānasya tava parātmannūnaṃ narakā bhavanti narakāre || 1065 || atra vimānādijāternarakajātyā virodhaḥ | ayaṃ purassphurannapi jātyorvirodho vakṣyamāṇavacanena bhagavatsthānāpekṣayā'timātraheyatayā narakatulyā bhavantīti vimarśena nivartate | atra ramyāṇi kāmacārīṇi vimānāni sabhāstathā | ākrīḍā vividhā rājan padminyaścāmalodakāḥ || ete vai nirayāstāta sthānasya paramātmanaḥ | iti mahābhāratapramāṇārtho'nusaṃhitaḥ || jāterguṇena yathā ghanasāracandanācalavanasārimarutkiśoraśaśikiraṇāḥ | tvaddhyānaśītalahṛdāṃ tigmakarādapi ca nātha tigmatarāḥ || 1066 || atra ghanasārādijātestigmataratvarūpaguṇena saha virodhaḥ || jāteḥ kriyayā yathā nīrājayamāno ghanasārākhaṇḍapradīpa eṣa tvām | veṅkaṭanātha vilocanapaṅkaruhāṇyāśu śiśirayati nṝṇām || 1067 || atra dīpatvajāterlocanaśiśirīkaraṇakriyayā saha virodhaḥ || jāteḥ dravyeṇa yathā daśarathatanayo dhanvī viśakalayan daśa diśo'pi viṣphāraiḥ | daśamukhapurasadanānāṃ śaśivadanānāmabhūdyugāntāgniḥ || 1068 || atrāgnitvarūpajāterdaśarathatanayalakṣaṇadravyeṇa saha virodhaḥ || ayaṃ śleṣamūlako'pi bhavati | tatra jāterjātiguṇakriyādravyairvirodho yathā śrīśasya pṛthulasattvaḥ krīḍādrirmṛdulatābhirāmatanuḥ | dyāmutpatati mahimnā'nantākhyo'yaṃ mahatkilāścaryam || 1069 || śrīśasya śrīnivāsasya krīḍādrirvihārācalaḥ |atrādritvajāteḥ pṛthulaścāsau sattvaḥ janturiti jātyā virodhaḥ | pṛthulāssattvāḥ prāṇino yasminniti vā, pṛthu lasato bhāvaḥ lasattvaṃ prakāśo yasyeti vā, parihāraḥ | mṛdulatayā mṛdutvena abhirāmatanuriti guṇena virodhaḥ, mṛdavaśca tāḥ latāśca tābhirabhirāmatanuriti parihāraḥ | mahimnā mahattvena gurutvena dyāmutpatatīti kriyayā virodhaḥ, prabhāvena divamapyatiśete iti parihāraḥ | ayamadriḥ anantaṃ antarikṣamityākhyā yasya sa tathoktaḥ | ākāśatvamekavyaktikatvānna jātiriti dravyeṇa tenādritvarūpajātestadanadhikaraṇatvarūpavirodhaḥ | śeṣākhya iti tadabhāvaḥ || yathāvā tava vāhanaṃ pataṅgo'pyāśuga unnidrakuvalayāmodaḥ | uttambhitottamaśśrīrbhavati jagannātha kumudasuhṛdeṣaḥ || 1070 || atra tava vāhanaṃ pataṅgaḥ bhānumānapīti jāteḥ āśugaḥ māruta iti jātyā virodhaḥ vihaṅgaḥ śīghragāmīti samāhitaḥ | unnidraḥ kuvalayānāṃ āmodaḥ parimalaḥ yena sa iti guṇena virodhaḥ prakāśitapṛthvīmaṇḍalapramoda iti samāhitaḥ | uttambhitā unnamitā tamasāṃ śrīryena sa iti tamauttambhanakriyayā virodhaḥ | abhivardhitaśreṣṭhasaṃpaditi parihṛtaḥ | kumudasuhṛt candramāḥ kumudasuhṛttvamekavyaktivṛttitvānna jātiriti dravyaśabdo'yaṃ tena sūryatvajātestatsamavetatvaviraharūpo virodhaḥ | sūryatvasya dvādaśasūryavyaktivṛttitayā jātitvam | kutsitamudāṃ heyaviṣayābhilāṣavatāṃ asuhṛt virodhiti vā, kutsitā pāpinī mut yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ daityadānavādīnāṃ asūn prāṇān haratīti tathokta iti vā samāhitaḥ | atra dvayorapi virodhinoḥ śliṣṭatvaṃ pūrvatraikasyaiveti viśeṣaḥ || evaṃ jāterjātyādibhiścaturbhirvirodha uktaḥ || atha guṇasya guṇena virodho yathā sammārjanavidhuratayā sadhūlayo durvidhālayālindāḥ | tvayi paśyati dānajharairveṅkaṭagirinātha paṅkilā jātāḥ || 1071 || atra sadhūlitvaguṇasya paṅkilatvaguṇena virodhaḥ bhagavatkaṭākṣaprabhāvena tatsaṃbhavātkālabhedena parihṛtaḥ || yathāvā vālidaśānanamukhanirmūlanabāṇaṃ puro raghudhurīṇam | nidhyāyato maghavato mānasamāvilamabhūtprasannaṃ ca || 1072 || nidhyāyataḥ paśyataḥ| atrāvilatvaprasannatvayorguṇayorvirodhaḥ | svatanayavālisvavirodhidaśānanādivadharūpanimittabhedena parihṛtaḥ || guṇasya kriyayā virodho yathā bhavataḥ paritastapatāṃ bhavataścaritāni nātha niśamayatām | udyadamandanandānyapi bata mandībhavanti cetāṃsi || 1073 || atra udyadamandānandatvarūpaguṇasya mandībhavanakriyayā virodhaḥ | vigalitavedyāntarāṇi bhavantīti parihāraḥ || guṇasya dravyeṇa yathā tvayi vinyastasvāntā vijayantāṃ te ciraṃ bhuvi mahāntaḥ | aṇurapi yebhyo datto guṇavadbhyo'bjākṣa bhavati merugiriḥ || 1074 || atrāṇutvarūpaguṇasya merugirirūpadravyeṇa virodhaḥ | alpo'pi padārtho mahāphalaprada iti parihāraḥ || yathāvā tebhyo namo'stu sadbhyaḥ paramaṃ ye hṛdi nidhāya tadbrahma | svaguṇairnispandatamaṃ racayanto dṛḍhatamairaṇumakārṣuḥ || 1075 || atrāṇutvarūpaguṇasya niratiśayabṛhattvayogiparabrahmarūpadravyeṇa saha virodhaḥ ‘jyāyān pṛthivyā jyāyānantarikṣāt' ityādinā sarvasmājjyāyastvena śrutasya parasya brahmaṇa upāsanārthaṃ hṛdayāyatanāvacchedenāvasthāpitatvādidamaṇutvamiti parihāraḥ | tathāca śrūyate 'eṣa ma ātmā'ntarhṛdaye'ṇīyānvrīhervā yavādvā śyāmākādvā śyāmākataṇḍulādvā' iti | pūrvatra guṇasya dravyeṇa virodhaḥ atra tu dravyasya guṇeneti viśeṣaḥ || dṛḍhatamaiḥ guṇaiḥ rajjubhiḥ upāsanaupayikaguṇaiśca nispandaṃ racayantaḥ vadhnantaḥ dṛḍhamavasthāpayantaśca santaḥ tadbrahma aṇumakārṣuriti yojanā || nispandetyatra spaderaṣopadeśatvānna ṣatvam | tathāca vāmanaḥ 'niṣpanda iti ṣatvaṃ cintyaṃ lakṣaṇādarśanāt' iti | etaccāsmābhirvistareṇa nirūpitaṃ haṃsasaṃdeśarasāsvādinyāṃ ‘nyastanispandadṛṣṭiḥ' ityatra || śleṣamūlako guṇasya guṇakriyayā dravyairvirodho yathā mṛdulā'pyadbhutamūrtirmugdhā'pi jagaddhitāni vitanoṣi | 'aticañcalā'pi dhātrī vicitrametadrame tava caritram || 1076 || he rame! tvaṃ mṛdulā komalāvayaveti guṇasya adbhutā mūrtiḥ kāṭhinyaṃ yasyā iti guṇena virodhaḥ, dayāmṛduhṛdayā sāparādhairapi sahasā''śrayituṃ śakyā lokottaradivyavigraheti parihāraḥ | 'mūrtiḥ kāṭhinyakāyayoḥ' ityamaraḥ | mugdhā ajñā'pīti guṇasya jagaddhitāni vitanoṣīti kriyayā virodhaḥ, ajñānāṃ tatkaraṇānīśvaratvāt | mugdhā sundarīti parihāraḥ 'mugdhassundaramūḍhayoḥ' iti viśvaḥ | aticañcalāpīti guṇasya dhātrī bhūmiriti dravyeṇa virodhaḥ | acalātvāttasyāḥ | atikrāntā cañcalāmaticañcalā dīptyatiśayaparāstavidyullatā jagatāṃ māteti parihāraḥ | 'dhātrī jananyāmalakīvasumatyupamātṛṣu' iti medinī || yathāvā pītāṃśuko'pi bhagavaṃścitraṃ haritābhirāma eva tvam | viśadayasi ca nijarucyā jagadakhilaṃ bhavasi cāpi bhūteśaḥ || 1077 || pītāḥ aṃśavaḥ kiraṇāḥ yasya sa pītāṃśuka iti guṇasya haritena haridvarṇena abhirāma iti guṇena saha virodhaḥ | pītāmbara iti harerbhāvo haritā tayā abhirāma iti parihāraḥ | akhila jagat nijayā rucyā dīptyā viśadayasi dhavala sīti kriyayā virodhaḥ | nijarucyā svaviṣayakaprītyā viśadayasi nirmalayasīti parihāraḥ | bhūteśaḥ rudra iti dravyeṇa virodhaḥ | tasya pāṇhuravarṇadravyatayā pītavarṇatvāyogāt | 'eṣa bhūteśvara eṣa bhūtapālaḥ' iti śrutessarvabhūteśvara ityavirodhaḥ | atraikasyaiva pītāṃśukatvaguṇasya guṇakriyādravyairvirodha uktaḥ | pūrvatra tu mṛdulatvādīnāṃ bhinnabhinnānāṃ guṇānāṃ pratyekaṃ guṇādibhirvirodha iti vailakṣaṇyaṃ bodhyam || evaṃ guṇasya guṇādibhistribhirvirodho darśitaḥ || atha kriyāyāḥ kriyayā yathā āpatatāṃ yudhi purato dviṣatāṃ mahatāṃ śirāṃsi cakreṇa | chindannamandameṣāṃ mukunda vidadhāsi paramamānandam || 1078 || atra chedanakriyāyā ānandanakriyayā virodhaḥ | muktau niratiśayasvānandānubhavaṃ vitarasīti tadabhāvaḥ || yathāvā sakalepsitārthadātā duradhigamo bahutaraistapobhirapi | vinatān sukhākaroṣi tvaṃ nanu duḥkhākaroṣi cābjākṣa || 1079 || atra sukhākaraṇaduḥkhākaraṇakriyayorvirodhaḥ | yathāsaṃkhyaṃ pūrvārdhoktāvacchedakadvayasadbhāvena tadabhāvaḥ | sukhākaroṣi duḥkhākaroṣītyubhayatrāpi ‘sukhapriyādānulomye | duḥkhātprātilomye' iti ḍāc || yathāvā sarabhasakarasarasijadhṛtasudarśanaṃ daivataiśca durdarśam | bhṛśamanvaraṅkta bhīṣmo jighāṃsumapi kaṃsahiṃsanaṃ vīkṣya || 1080 || sudarśanamityatra suṣṭhu dṛśyata iti vigrahaḥ | ‘bhāṣāyāṃ śasiyudhidṛśidhṛṣimṛṣibhyo yujvācyaḥ' iti khalo'pavādo yuc | durdarśamityatra tu darśaḥ darśanaṃ dṛśerbhāve ghañ | duṣkaro darśo yasya sa iti vigrahaḥ | na tu duḥkhena dṛśyata iti | tathā sati durdarśana iti syāt udāhṛtavārtikāt | na ca vāsarūpavidhinā khalapavādasya yuco vaikalpikatvānnirvāhaḥ, tanniṣedhasya "ktalyuṃṭtumunkhalartheṣu vāsarūpavidhirnāsti' iti paribhāṣitatvāt | tasmāduktarītyā bahuvrīhiṇaiva nirvāho yuktaḥ | evameva ‘taṃ durdarśaṃ, sudurdarśamidaṃ rūpaṃ, durdarśaṃ śaśikhaṇḍamaṇḍana' ityādiśrutismṛtyarvācīnaprayogā nirvāhyāḥ | atra jighāṃsudarśanānurañjanakriyayorvirodhaḥ anvaraṅktetyatra anupūrvakādrañjerlaṅ || kriyāyā dravyeṇa virodho yathā mārutakukṣiṃbharigiridūratarottuṅgaśṛṅgasaṅgi mahaḥ | vāritakaluṣaṃ dviṣatāṃ bhūritaraṃ malinimānamātanute || 1081 || atra malinimādhānakriyāyāḥ mahastvenādhyavasitabhagavadrūpadravyeṇa saha virodhaḥ || yathāvā raghutanayavaṭutruṭitodbhaṭanaṭacāpasphuṭasvanāṭopaiḥ | phālākṣo'pi cakampe paphāla ca dyauḥ papāta bhuvi ca glauḥ || 1082 || atra kampādikriyāṇāṃ phālākṣādidravyairvirodhaḥ | puraharaśarāsanabhañjanajanitanirghoṣātiśayoktyā parihṛtaḥ || evaṃ kriyāyāḥ kriyādravyābhyāṃ virodho darśitaḥ || dravyasya dravyeṇa virodho yathā vitatāyāṃ tava kīrtyāṃ satataṃ jagadakhilamativiśadayantyām | kanakagiriḥ kailāso vyālādhipaśailaśekhara babhūva || 1083 || atra kanakagirirūpadravyasya kailāsarūpadravyeṇa virodhaḥ | kīrtidhavalimātiśayapraśaṃsayā parihriyate || śleṣeṇa kriyāyāḥ kriyādravyābhyāṃ dravyasya dravyeṇa ca virodho yathā dayamānassakalātmasu viśannapi ghṛṇāṃ vimuñcasi guṇābdhe | kāmaṃ sṛjannapīśaḥ kāmaṃ brahmāsi tadapi bata bhagavan || 1084 || atra dayāpūrvakasarvātmāntaḥpraveśakriyāyāḥ ghṛṇāṃ kṛpāṃ muñcasīti kriyayā virodhaḥ | ghṛṇāṃ vātsalyātiśayātkaṣṭabhūtadehāntaravasthānājjugupsāṃ muñcasi bhogyameva paśyasīti parihāraḥ | kāmaṃ kaṃdarpaṃ sṛjannapīti kriyāyāḥ īśa iti śarvarūpadravyeṇa virodhaḥ | āśritasarvepsitārthadātā bhūtabhavyeśāna iti parihāraḥ | atra aṅguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣo madhya ātmani tiṣṭhati | īśāno bhūtabhavyasya na tato vijugupsate || iti śrutyartho'nusaṃhitaḥ | tadapi evaṃ śarvo'pi brahmā caturmukho'sīti dravyayorvirodhaḥ | brahma svarūpeṇa guṇaiścānavadhikātiśayabṛhat paraṃ brahmeti parihāraḥ || evaṃ prācāmanurodhena virodhabhedāḥ pradarśitāḥ | atra lakṣaṇe jātyādīnāmiti dharmamātraṃ vivakṣitaṃ, upalakṣaṇaparatvāt | tena 'yaḥ kila bālako'pi purāṇapuruṣaḥ viśuddhamūrtirapi nīlāmbudanibhaḥ jagaddhitakṛdapi jagadahitakṛt agoddhārako'pi nāgoddhārakaḥ' ityādau sakhaṇḍopādherabhāvasya ca parigraha ityāhuḥ | vastuto jātyādibhedānāmahṛdyatvāt śuddhatvaśleṣamūlatvābhyāṃ dvividha evāyam | ata eva ‘ābhāsatve virodhasya virodhābhāsa iṣyate, ityetāvadeva sāmānyatā lakṣaṇamabhihitaṃ kuvalayānande | tena pradarśayiṣyamāṇāni padyāni sarvāṇyapi virodhābhāsodāharaṇānyeva bhaviṣyanti || yathā bhuvi kṛtapado'pi divi kṛtapado dramiḍadeśago'pi sakaliṅgaḥ | api śaśadharo vikāsitaśatapatraka eṣa śeṣagirirājaḥ || 1085 || bhuvi bhūmau kṛtapadaḥ klṛptāvasthāno'pi divi nabhasi kṛtapada iti virodhaḥ | divibhiḥ cāṣāparanāmabhirvihagaiḥ kṛtanīḍa iti parihṛtaḥ | dramiḍadeśago'pi sakaliṅgaḥ kaliṅgadeśasahita iti virodhaḥ | dhūmyāṭāparanāmavihagasahita iti parihṛtaḥ | śaśadharaḥ candro'pi vikāsitāni śatapatrāṇi kuśeśayāni yena sa iti virodhaḥ | śaśākhyamṛgaviśeṣāvāsabhūtaḥ ullāsitadārvāghāṭākhyakhagaviśeṣa iti parihṛtaḥ | "atha cāṣaḥ kikī diviḥ | kaliṅgabhṛṅgadhūmyāṭā atha syācchatapatrakaḥ | dārvāghāṭaḥ" ityamaraḥ || yaśśirasi phaṇādibhrāṭpuruṣaṃ dhārayati śeṣagiribhūtaḥ | ayameva kuṃ vicitraṃ mūrdhani dhattehirājisahacaritaḥ || 1086 || śeṣasya patañjalitayā'vatīrṇasya giri vāci mahābhāṣye bhūtaḥ sthitaḥ | yaḥ phaṇādibhrāṭ phaṇādau phaṇadhātuprabhṛtidhātugaṇe vidyamānaḥ bhrāṭ 'ṭu bhrājṛ dīptau' iti dhātuḥ | śirasi antimavarṇe jakāre iti yāvat | puru bhūyiṣṭhaṃ ‘purubhūḥ puru bhūyiṣṭham' ityamaraḥ | anitarabādhitaṃ yathā syāttathā nityameveti yāvat | ṣaṃ "vraścabhrasjasṛjamṛjayajarājabhrājacchaśāṃ ṣaḥ" iti vihitaṃ ṭakāraparamasthānibhūtaṃ ṣavarṇaṃ dhārayati dhatte | rājisahacaritaḥ rājīti ikā nirdeśaḥ rājinā ‘rājṛ dīptau' iti dhātunā sahacaritaḥ asyāpi phaṇādau pāṭhāditi bhāvaḥ | ayameva ‘ṭu bhrājṛ dīptau' ityukto dhātureva | mūrdhani antimavarṇe iti yāvat | kuṃ ‘coḥ kuḥ' iti vihitaṃ kavargādeśam | hiśabdo'vadhāraṇe | tamevetyarthaḥ | dhatte iti vicitram | phaṇāderbhrājeḥ kutvāpavādena ṣatvavidhānāt | ‘ejṛ bhrejṛ bhrājṛ dīptau' ityuktabhrājṛdhātuvatkavargādeśavattvaṃ viruddhamiti bhāvaḥ | yathocyate kaumudīgranthe ‘ṣatvavidhau rājṛsāhacaryāt ‘ṭu bhrājṛ dīptau' iti phaṇādireva gṛhyate | yastu ‘ejṛ bhrejṛ bhrājṛ dīptau' iti tasya kutvameva" iti | parihārastu phaṇāḥ sphaṭāḥ ādiśabdādrasanāśiroratnādīnāṃ grahaṇam | phaṇāḥ ādayo yeṣāṃ te taiḥ bhrājata iti phaṇādibhrāṭ phaṇādiśabdopapadakāt 'ṭu bhrājṛ dīptau' iti dhātoḥ kvip | vraśceti ṣatve jaśtvena ḍaḥ | tasya cartvena ṭaḥ | yaḥ phaṇirāja iti bhāvaḥ | śeṣagiribhūtaḥ śeṣādritāṃ prāptassan mūrdhani svaśikhare puruṣaṃ paramapuruṣaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ dhārayati | ayameva asau phaṇirāja eva ahirājisahacarita iti samastaṃ padam | ahīnāṃ phaṇināṃ rājyā śreṇyā sahacaritaḥ pātāle phaṇiśreṇimilitassan tadadhīśvaratvāttasya | mūrdhani phaṇamaṇḍale kuṃ pṛthivīṃ ‘gotrā kuḥ pṛthivī' ityamaraḥ | dhatte | yaśśeṣācalarūpāvalambī śrīnivāsaṃ svaśirasi dadhāti sa eva phaṇirājassakaladharātalaṃ śirasthale vahatīti nirgalito'rthaḥ || tāvakacaraṇāmbhoruhasevakavargaḥ phaṇīndragiribhāsvan | saṃkhyātigabhadro'pi sphurati caturbhadrabhāgvicitramidam || 1087 || saṃkhyātigāḥ asaṃkhyākāḥ bhadrāḥ gajajātiviśeṣāḥ 'mando bhadrā mṛgaśceti vijñeyāstrividhā gajāḥ' ityanuśāsanāt | yadvā asaṃkhyākamaṅgalo'pītyarthaḥ | caturbhadraḥ catvāra eva bhadrāḥ bhadrāṇi vā yasya sa tathokta ityavadhāraṇagarbho bahuvrīhiḥ ‘abbhakṣaḥ' itivat | sphuratītīdaṃ citram | parihārastu caturbhadraṃ balavaddharmārthakāmamokṣarūpaṃ caturbhadram | yathoktamamarasiṃhena "trivargo dharmakāmārthaiścaturvargassamokṣakaiḥ | sabalaistaiścaturbhadram" iti | catvāri bhadrāṇi śreṣṭhānyasminniti vā | caturṇāṃ bhadrāṇāṃ samāhāra iti vā vigraha ityāhuḥ | anye tu vittaṃ tyāgasametaṃ jñānamagarvaṃ kṣamānvitaṃ śauryam | bhogassaṅgavihīno durlabhametaccaturbhadram || ityāhuḥ | idaṃ ca bhāratīyaṣoḍaśarājakapratyadhyāyaśrūyamāṇasya 'caturbhadratarastvayā' ityasya vyākhyāyāṃ spaṣṭam | tadbhajatīti caturbhadrabhāgiti | ‘bhadraśśive khañjarīṭe vṛṣabhe ca kadambake | karijātiprabhede nā klībaṃ maṅgalamustayoḥ' iti medinī || hanta yadāropayitā cāpaṃ ropaṃ tadaiva cāpayitā | haste'karoḥ purā sadveṣakṣitijaśriyaṃ raghukulendo || 1088 || he raghukulendo! yadā tvaṃ cāpaṃ dhanuḥ ropayitā ropaṃ bāṇaṃ karotīti tathokta iti virodhaḥ | ropaśabdāt ṇyantātttṛc | 'patrī ropa iṣurdvayoḥ' ityamaraḥ | āropayiteti cchedaḥ | adhijyaṃ karteti parihāraḥ | ruherṇici 'ruhaḥ po'nyatarasyām' iti pādeśaḥ tadaiva cāpāropaṇasamaya eva ropaṃ bāṇaṃ cāpayitā cāpaṃ dhanuḥ karotīti tathokta iti virodhaḥ | ca āpayiteti chedaḥ | tadaiva āpayitā dhanuḥ prāpayitā ca bāṇaṃ dhanuṣi saṃdadhatsannityarthaḥ | purā san praśasto veṣo yasyāssā kṣitibhūḥ bhūmijā śrīḥ sītātvenāvatīrṇāṃ lakṣmīḥ tām | pakṣe dveṣeṇa sahitāḥ sadveṣāḥ vairiṇaḥ teṣāṃ kṣitau tatsaṃbandhinyāṃ bhūmau jātā yā śrīḥ saṃpat tāṃ haste'karoḥ paryaṇaiṣīḥ | pakṣe vaśe'kārṣīrityarthaḥ || tvayyabhimukho'nabhimukho hiraṇyabhāksyādaraṇyabhākca śrīḥ | bhedo yadyapyanayorbhavatyathāpi hyabheda iti citram || 1089 || he śrīḥ! tvayi abhimukhaḥ hiraṇyabhāk suvarṇopalakṣitamahāvibhavabhāk syāt | anabhimukhastu araṇyabhāk myāt bhraṣṭaiśvaryo vanaṃ praviśedityarthaḥ | evamanayoḥ bhedaḥ uktarītyā vailakṣaṇyaṃ yadyapi bhavati bhavatyeva ‘yadyapītyavadhāraṇe' iti keśavaḥ | tathā'pi abheda eva bhavati hīti virodhaḥ | hyabheda iti samastaṃ padam | hivarṇāvarṇābhyāmeva bhedo bhavatīti parihāraḥ| hiraṇyabhāk araṇyabhāk iti śabdayoḥ hi a iti varṇābhyāmeva bhidā anyānupūrvyostulyatvāditi bhāvaḥ | śabdārthatādātmyamūlako'yaṃ śleṣeṇa virodhaḥ || dāmodarahitatāṃ yo na vindate nanu mukundacandramukhi | vismāyayati samastāneṣa sadāmodarahitatāṃ vindan || 1090 || nanu mukundacandramukhi! yaḥ dāmodarasya hitatāṃ na vindate saḥ dāmodarahitatāmiti chedaḥ | sa eṣaḥ dāmoharahitatāṃ vindan samastān vismāyayatīti virodhaḥ | parihārastu sadāmodetyādi samastaṃ padam | san praśastaḥ yaḥ āmodaḥ ānandaḥ bhagavatkalyāṇaguṇānubhavajanita iti bhāvaḥ | tena rahitatāṃ vindanniti || asuramahokṣo'tyuccaissvaro'tha mohaśritaḥ paramupetya | miṣatāṃ nṝṇāmāsīdasumokṣo'gre'cyutātsumokṣaśca || 1091 || asuraścāsau mahokṣaśca asuramahokṣaḥ | vṛṣabhāsura ityarthaḥ | mahārājadaśaratha itivadayaṃ nirdeśaḥ | paraṃ atimātraṃ mohaṃ śritaḥ 'dvitīyā śrita' iti samāsaḥ | bhagavannandanandanakarmakajighāṃsā svānarthasyaiva heturityajānāna iti bhāvaḥ | ata eva atha atyuccaiḥ svaro yasya sa tathoktassan upetya nṝṇāṃ miṣatāṃ sarveṣu janeṣu paśyatsveva acyutādbhagavato vāsudevāt svavadhahetubhūtāt asumokṣaḥ śobhanamokṣarahito'pi agre sumokṣaścāsīditi virodhaḥ | asūn prāṇān mokṣayate tyajatītyasumokṣaḥ śobhano mokṣo muktiryasya saḥ sumokṣaścāsīditi parihāraḥ ‘mokṣa avasāne' iti caurādikatvena dhātuvṛttipaṭhitāddhātoḥ karmaṇyaṇ | avasānaṃ kṣepaḥ | ‘mokṣo niśśreyase vṛkṣaviśeṣe mocane mṛtau' iti hemaḥ || pakṣe atyuccaiḥ bahuvarṇasamudāyarūpatvādatimahāniti yāvat | asuramahokṣaḥ asuramahokṣaśabdaḥ svaraḥ suṣṭhu araḥ repharahitaḥ atha anantaraṃ saḥ ahaśrita iti chedaḥ | maḥ iti pañcamyekavacanam | makārāt paraṃ anantaraṃ ahaśritaḥ aho iti svaravyañjanābhyāṃ aśritaḥ rahitassan miṣatāṃ draṣṭṝṇāṃ nṝṇāṃ asumokṣaḥ āsīt asumokṣaśabdatayā dṛśyo'bhūditi bhāvaḥ | agre ādau acyutāt cyutaśabdo bhāve ktāntaḥ avarṇacyuterityarthaḥ | sumokṣaśca sumokṣaśabdaścāsīt tathā dṛśyo'bhūditi bhāvaḥ | asuramahokṣaśabdo repheṇa ah iti svaravyañjanarūpavarṇābhyāṃ ca viśliṣṭaasumokṣa iti niṣpadyamānaḥ anantaraṃ prāthamikena avarṇena vidhurassan sumokṣa iti dṛśyo bhavatīti pariniṣpanno'rthaḥ | prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣasaṃkīrṇo'yam || śvasthitibhāgyaṃ prāptāvavekṣitopekṣitau tvayā manujau | aśvasthitibhāgyajuṣau tathā'pi citraṃ pṛdākuśikharīndo || 1092 || śvaḥ sthitiryasya tat śvasthiti śvo vidyamānaṃ cirakālāvasthāyīti yāvat | bhāgyaṃ śubhakarmaparipākabhūtamaiśvaryaṃ anyatra śunāṃ sthitiḥ maryādā avasthānaṃ vā tadrūpaṃ bhāgyaṃ aśubhakarmaparipākabhūtaṃ dāridryamityarthaḥ | ‘bhāgyaṃ karma śubhāśubham' ityamaraḥ | tat prāptau | tathā'pi aśvasthitibhāgyajuṣau iti virodhaḥ | aśvānāṃ sthitiḥ avasthānaṃ tadrūpaṃ bhāgyaṃ aśvārohaṇaiśvaryaṃ upalakṣaṇamidaṃ gajāntaiśvaryasya | pakṣe śvasthiti na bhavatītyaśvaḥ sthiti atyalpakālikamityarthaḥ | bhāgyaṃ juṣete iti tathoktautvatkaṭākṣitaścirakālānubhāvyaṃ caturaṅgabalaiśvaryaṃ labhate, tvadupekṣitastu śunakādinihīnajantusaṃśrayaṇādirūpadaurbhāgyaṃ tadapyatyalpakālikamevānubhavatīti nirgalito'rthaḥ || prakhyātanīlalohitakapālibhāvādadasphuradudagram | agraṃ phaṇirājagirerugratvamupaityanugratāṃ cāho || 1093 || udagraṃ ucchritaṃ adaḥ idaṃ phaṇirājagireḥ agraṃ nīlalohitaścāsau kapālī ca tasya bhāvaḥ prakhyātaścāsau nalalohitakapālibhāvaśca tasmāddhetoḥ, pakṣe prakhyātāḥ nīlānāṃ indranīlamaṇīnāṃ lohitakānāṃ padmarāgāṇāṃ ca pālayaḥ paṅktayaḥ yasmiṃstat prakhyātanīlalohitakapāli | tasya bhāvāt tattvāt ‘lohitānmaṇau' iti kan | 'śoṇaratnaṃ lohitakaḥ padmarāgaḥ' ityamaraḥ | sphurat iti yojanā | prakāśamānamityarthaḥ | ata eva ugratvaṃ rudratvaṃ tattaulyamiti yāvat | anugratāṃ arudratāṃ ca upaitīti virodhaḥ anugratāṃ araudratāṃ saumyatāmupaitīti parihāraḥ | pakṣe agraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ udagramiti padaṃ adasphuraditi samastaṃ padaṃ dakāreṇāprakāśamānaṃ sat ugratvamupaiti ugraśabdo bhavatītyarthaḥ | athāpi anugratāṃ ugra iti varṇadvayavirahitatāmiti virodhaḥ | ugraśabde uktavarṇasadbhāvāt | anu paścāt graṃ gra iti varṇasamudayo yasya tattathoktaṃ tasya bhāvaṃ tattāmiti parihāraḥ || padalagnaṃ nātha sadāpadalagnaṃ saṃtanoṣi manujaṃ tvam| hanta padānāśritamapi sadāpadāśritamudāraguṇajaladhe || 1094 || padalagnaṃ svacaraṇāśritaṃ apadalagnaṃ svacaraṇānāśritaṃ saṃtanoṣīti virodhaḥ | sadā āpadalagnamiti chedaḥ | vipadanāśritamiti parihāraḥ | kiṃca sadā padānāśritaṃ svacaraṇānāsaktaṃ padāśritaṃ svacaraṇānuraktaṃ saṃtanoṣīti virodhaḥ | sadā āpadāśritaṃ vipadyuktamiti parihāraḥ || śeṣācalādhinetā'pyanaghāśeṣācalādhinetā'si | apica vibhāsurarūpo'pyavibhāsurarūpa eva bhagavaṃstvam || 1095 || śeṣācalādhinetā na bhavasīti virodhaḥ aśeṣāyāḥ acalāyāḥ bhuvaḥ adhineteti vyudastaḥ | avibhāsurarūpaḥ vibhāsurarūpo na bhavasīti virodhaḥ aviḥ bhānuḥ sa iva bhāsurarūpa iti nirastaḥ | anyatsugamam || merunagabhāsuro'pica namerunagabhāsuro mṛgendragiriḥ | atighanajapāvanāḍhyo'pyajapāvana eva citramidam || 1096 || namerunagāḥ chāyātaravaḥ tairbhāsuraḥ | ajasya brahmaṇo'pi pāvana iti ca virodhaparihāraḥ || śiśiro'pyaśītakaśśucirasitaśślakṣṇo'pya sūkṣma evāyam | surabhirapi gandhaśūnyo dvirasanadharaṇīdharendramūrdhanyaḥ || 1097 || śiśiraḥ śītalo'pyaśītakaḥ śītarahita iti virodhaḥ avidyamānaṃ śītaṃ śītaguṇo yasyeti vigrahaḥ ‘śeṣādvibhāṣā' iti kap | dayāśītalaḥ analasa iti parihṛtaḥ ‘śītoṣṇābhyāṃ kāriṇi' iti śītaśabdātkarotītyarthe kan | ‘ālasyaśśītako'laso'nuṣṇaḥ' ityamaraḥ | śucirapi śubhro'pi asitaḥ aśubhra iti virodhaḥ | śuciḥ apahatapāpmā ata eva asitaḥ abaddhaḥ karmabandharahita iti samāhitaḥ | sinoterbandhanāthakātkarmaṇi ktaḥ | ślakṣṇo'pi kṛśo'pi asūkṣmaḥ akṛśa iti virodhaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ asūkṣmaḥ akaitavaḥ mahāniti vā parihṛtaḥ | ‘ślakṣṇaṃ dabhraṃ kṛśaṃ tanu, ślakṣṇaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ' iti cāmaraḥ ‘sūkṣmaṃ syātkaitave'dhyātme puṃsyaṇau triṣu cālpake' iti medinī | surabhissugandhirapi gandhaśūnyaḥ saurabhahīna iti virodhaḥ | manoharaḥ anavalepaśceti samāhitaḥ ‘surabhiścampake' ityārabhya ‘sugandhau ca manojñe ca' iti, ‘gandho gandhaka āmode leśe saṃbandhagarvayoḥ' iti ca viśvaḥ || animiṣarājo'capalaḥ prabalo'pi tvaṃ na bādhase vibalān | citraṃ sudhīvarāṇāṃ lunāsi guṇajālamakhilātman || 1098 || he akhilātman! tvaṃ animiṣarājaḥ matsyarājo'pi acapalaḥ amatsya iti virodhaḥ | devādhirājaḥ acañcalaśīla ityavirodhaḥ 'suramatsyāvanimiṣau' ityamaraḥ | ‘capalaḥ pārade mīne' ityupakramya ‘vācyavattarale cale' iti medinī | prabalo'pi vibalān durbalān śakulārbhakān na bādhase iti virodhaḥ | prabalena durbalasya bādho hi matsyajātessvabhāvaḥ | tadabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | sarveśvaratvena sarvasmātprabalastvaṃ svasmāhurbalān caturmukhādīn na bādhase iti parihāraḥ | śobhanāḥ dhīvarāḥ sudhīvarāḥ teṣāṃ prauḍhānāṃ kaivartānāmityarthaḥ | guṇajālaṃ sūtramayamānāyaṃ lunāsīti virodhaḥ | sudhiyāṃ viduṣāṃ varāḥ teṣāṃ prakṛtibandhaṃ viyojayasīti tadabhāvaḥ || edhayase naidhayase purā virādhaṃ bhujapratāpāgnau | āśayase nāśayase kravyādaḥ kharamukhāṃśca raghuvīra || he raghuvīra! bhujapratāpāgnau virādhaṃ purā edhayase edhaṃ idhmaṃ karoṣi sma naidhayase iti virodhaḥ ‘puri luṅ cāsme' iti bhūte laṭ | virādhaṃ naidhayase na vardhayase 'kiṃtu bhujapratāpāgnau ploṣayasi smeti yojanābhedena parihāraḥ | kharamukhān niśicarān kravyādaḥ māṃsāśinaḥ kaṅkajambukādīn tairityarthaḥ | āśayase puretyetadatrāpyanuṣajyate | abhyavahārayasi sma | nāśayase nābhyavahārayasi smeti virodhaḥ kharapramukhān kharadūṣaṇādīn nāśayase dhvaṃsayasi sma | atha kravyādbhiḥ āśayase smeti parihāraḥ pūrvavat | 'gatibuddhipratyavasāna' ityādinā aśnāteraṇau kartṝṇāṃ kravyādāṃ ṇau karmatvaṃ ‘kravyādrakṣasi puṃsi syānmāṃsādinyanyaliṅgakaḥ' iti medinī | atra śliṣṭābhyāṃ tiṅantaśabdābhyāṃ virodhapradarśanamiti viśeṣaḥ || rakṣasi na rakṣasi tvaṃ dayamānamanā jaganti dāśarathe | sa bhavān kṛtābhiṣeko rarāja nararāja vismayāyaitat || 1100 || he dāśarathe! tvaṃ dayamānamanāssan jaganti rakṣasi pālayasi na rakṣasīti virodhaḥ | parihārastu rakṣasīti jātyabhiprāyakamekavacanam | rākṣasajātau na dayamānamanā iti vyavahitena nañā yojanā ‘kurvantamityatibhareṇa na gānavācaḥ puṣpairvirāmamalināṃ ca na gānavācaḥ' ityatra na virāmamitivat | 'vāyase kṛtavānkrūrāṃ matim' ityuktarītyā krauryaṃ bhajannityarthaḥ | jaganti rakṣasīti | rakṣojātau tava dayamānamanaskatve kathaṃ jagadrakṣaṇaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | sa bhavān evaṃ rākṣasakulakṣapayitā bhavān | kṛtābhiṣekaḥ sākete rājyābhiṣekaṃ prāptassan rarāja didīpe | na rarājeti virodhaḥ | narāṇāṃ rājā nararājaḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ he narendreti parihāraḥ | tiṅantasubantaśabdaśleṣamūlako'yaṃ virodha iti pūrvasmādvailakṣaṇyam || evaṃ śleṣamūlako virodhālaṃkāraḥ prapañcitaḥ || ayameva śuddho yathā ejati tannaijati tattaddūre tadvadantike bhavati | antarbahiśca yugapajjagato'sya tadadbhutaṃ paraṃ brahma || atra tadejati tannaijati | taddūre tadvadantike | tadantarasya sarvasya tadu sarvasyāsya bāhyataḥ || iti śrutyartho'nusaṃhitaḥ | tathāhi tat paraṃ brahma | yugapaditi sarvatrānveti ejati kampate naijati na kampate iti virodhaḥ | javīya iva jñāyate vastuto na kampate iti parihāraḥ | ‘anejadekaṃ manaso javīyaḥ' iti pūrvamantraikārthyāt | tat brahma dūre tadvat antike ca bhavatīti virodhaḥ | āsuradaivaprakṛtipuruṣāpekṣo'yaṃ vibhoreva dūrāntikavartitvavyapadeśa iti parihāraḥ | āha ca bhagavān śaunakaḥ parāṅmukhānāṃ govinde viṣayāsaktacetasām | teṣāṃ tatparamaṃ brahma dūrāddūratare sthitam || tanmayatvena govinde ye narā nvastacetasaḥ | viṣayatyāgināṃ teṣāṃ vijñeyaṃ ca tadantike || iti | tat brahma asya jagataḥ antaḥ bahiśva yugapadbhavatīti virodhaḥ| loke gṛhāntarvartināṃ janānāṃ tadānīmeva bahissthityadarśanāt | parihārastu sarvavyāpakatayā tatsaṃbhavāditi | tathā taittirīyake ca śrūyate 'antarbahiśca tatsarvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ' iti | tadbrahma adbhutaṃ āścaryarūpamityarthaḥ | ayaṃ śleṣagandhaviśliṣṭaśśuddho virodhābhāsaḥ | śrutirevedṛśālaṃkāramārgapradarśayitrīti jñāpayituṃ śrutyuktārtha evātra nibaddhaḥ || idamatra bodhyaṃ yatrāpiśabdo virodhadyotakaḥ tatra virodhaśśābdaḥ | anyatra tvārtha iti tāvatprācīnānāṃ rāddhāntaḥ | tatra yadyapi virodhasya śābdatvaṃ na śabdajanyajñānaviṣayatvaṃ, viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇasaṃsargātiriktasya śābde kvāpyabhānāt | na ca 'trayo'pyatrayaḥ' ityādau nañuttarapadārthayoranvaye pratiyogitvasya sasargatvāttasyaiva virodhapadārthatvātsaṃsargatayaiva tadbhānamiti vācyam 'supto'pi prabuddhaḥ' ityādau tathā'pyagateḥ | na ca tatrāpi lakṣaṇayā suptatvaviruddhaprabuddhatvavadabhinnassupta iti bodha iti vācyam, tathā'nanubhavādityuktavyavasthānupapattiriti | atrāhuḥ supto'pi prabuddhaḥ, trayopyatrayaḥ' ityādiṣu virodhodāharaṇeṣu śabdadvayena śayitatvajāgaritatvādidharmadvayasyādāvupasthitau saṃbandhijñānāt apiśabdasācivyāttadgato virodho'pi smaryate | anantaraṃ ca pratibandhakajñānasāmagryā balavattvādviruddhāvimau dharmāviti mānase vaiyañjanike vā bodhe jāte tena pratirodhācchayitajāgaritayorabhedabuddheranudayāddvitīyaśaktyā prādurbhāvitaṃ dvitīyārthamādāyānvayabodhaḥ, na tu viruddhārtham | virodhadhīśca śithilamūlā nivartamānā'pi kavisaṃrambhagocaratayā camatkārakāraṇamiti prāñcaḥ | navyāstu arthadvayaprādurbhāvaṃ vinā virodhābhāsa eva na saṃbhavati | tatraiko virodhasyollāsakaḥ | dvitīyaścānvayabodhaviṣaya iti | tatsatyam | paraṃtu anvayabodhaviṣaye dvitīyārthe virodhollāsako'pyartho bhede'pi śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyenābhinnatayā bhāsate | evaṃ cāviruddhaṃ dvitīyārthamādāyānvayabodhe satyapi svāspadībhūtasya viruddhārthasya niśśeṣatayā nivṛtterabhāvānmūrchitaśśvasanniva virodho'pi mānasaṃ bodhāntaramāḍhaukate | ata eva camatkārītyucyate | na hi niśśeṣatayā nivṛttaścamatkṛtimīṣṭe janayitum | na cāntareṇa camatkṛtijanakatāmalaṃkāro bhavati | tasmāt virodhadhiyo nātīva śithilamūlatā | nāpicātyantikī nivṛttirityāhuḥ | nanu apiśabdādīnāṃ prayoge śābdo virodho bhāsata iti tathā'pyasaṃgatam | śābdikanaye nipātānāṃ śakteranabhyupagamāditi cet na, nirūḍhalakṣaṇāyā iva nirūḍhadyotanāyā api śaktitulyakakṣatvāditi || atha jātyordravyayośca virodhālaṃkāro neṣṭe bhavitum || devatarustṛṇamāsīddeva tavaudāryavaibhavollāse | bhāti ca bhavatpratāpe kailāsagirirbabhūva kanakagiriḥ || ityādau madīyapadye 'kusumāni śarāścandro bāḍabo duḥkhite hṛdi' ityādau parakīyapadye ca āropamūlasya rūpakasyaivollāsāt | yadi satyapyārope virodha evocyeta tarhi 'mukhaṃ candraḥ' ityatrāpi sa eva kuto nocyatām | na ca rūpakaviṣayasyākhilasyāpi virodhenāskanditatvānnirviṣayatvāpattyā svaviṣaye rūpakaṃ virodhasya guṇādau labdhāvakāśasyāpavāda iti vācyam, 'devatarustṛṇaṃ kailāsagirirmerūgiriḥ kusumāni śarāḥ mṛṇālavalayāni davadahanarāśiḥ candro bāḍabaḥ śaṃkaracūḍhāpagā kālindī' ityādau tvadabhīpsitavirodhasyāsiddhiprasaṅga iti cet satyam | atra hyalaṃkārasamudaye yo yatra sahṛdayacamatkṛtisaraṇimadhyārohati sa eva tatrālaṃkāra ityavipratipannamidam | evaṃ ca rūpake ‘mukhaṃ candraḥ' ityādau yadyapyasti virodhaḥ | tathā'pi na sa tatra pratipipādayiṣitaḥ | apitu candraniṣṭhāhlādakāritādyakhilaguṇānāṃ mukhe pratipattyarthaṃ candrābheda eveti sa eva camatkārī na tu virodhaḥ | pratyuta sannapi virodho vivakṣitārthānanuguṇatvādasatkalpa iti nālaṃkāraḥ | kevalasattāyā akiṃcitkaratvāt | ‘devatarustṛṇaṃ, kusumāni śarāḥ' ityādau bhagavadaudāryādeḥ virahiṇyādīnāmavasthāyāścātyadbhutatāyā vivakṣitatvāt tadānurūpyāyāntargarbhito'pyārtho virodhassamullasatīti sa evālaṃkāraḥ | na caivamapi rūpakasthale virodho'vivakṣitatvānmā nāma bhūdalaṃkāraḥ | virodhasthale ‘devatarustṛṇaṃ kusumāni śarāḥ' ityādau tu virodhonmeṣaṇāyābhedasyāvaśyaṃ vivakṣaṇīyatvādrūpakāpattiriti vācyam | virodhavivakṣānāliṅgitatvasya rūpakalakṣaṇe niveśyatvāt | yadvā abhedasyātra virodhonmeṣaṇārthamupāttasyācamatkāritvādrūpakālaṃkāratvamayuktaṃ, camatkāritvasyaivālaṃkārajīvātutvāditidik | vistarastvanyatra || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre virodhasaraḥ pañcatriṃśaḥ <11> atha vibhāvanālaṃkārasaraḥ kāraṇavyatireke'pi kāryotpattirvibhāvanā || 98 || kāraṇavyatirekasāmānādhikaraṇyena pratipādyamānā kāryotpattirvibhāvanetyarthaḥ | taduktaṃ kriyāyāḥ pratiṣedhe'piphalavyaktirvibhāvanā" | iti | kriyāśabdenātrakāraṇaṃ vivakṣitam | atra kāraṇavyatirekasāmānādhikaraṇyena kāryotpattau nibadhyamānāyāmāpātato virodhaḥ pratibhāsamāno'pi taditarakāraṇakalpanayā nivartate || yathā jālaṃ vinaiva nitarāṃ lolaṃ viṣayeṣu nanu manojālam | nidhyāyatāṃ janānāṃ baddhvā''karṣasi batāhiśailamaṇe || 1103 || atra hi bandhanākarṣaṇayorjālaṃ kāraṇaṃ tadabhāve'pi bandhanākarṣaṇe pratipādyamāne āpātato viruddhe api bhagavaddivyavigrahasaundaryahetukatayā paryavasyataḥ || nanvatra yasya kāryasyotpattiḥ pratipādyate na hi tadīyakāraṇatvenāvagatasya vyatirekaḥ pratīyate | yadīyakāraṇavyatirekaśca pratīyate na hi tasya kāryasyotpattiḥ pratipāditā | bandhanākarṣaṇe ceha niścalāvasthāpanavaśīkaraṇe vivakṣite na tu saṃdānagrahaṇe | jālaṃ ca na bhagavatkartṛkamānasajālaniścalāvasthāpanavaśīkaraṇayoḥ kāraṇaṃ, apitu mīnamṛgādibandhanagrahaṇayoriti cenna | mukhye hi bandhanākarṣaṇe nahanagrahaṇe | gauṇe ca niścalāvasthāpanavaśīkaraṇe | gauṇayormukhyayośca tayossādṛśyamūlenābhedādhyavasāyena niṣpanne sati bhedatirodhāne mīnamṛgādibandhanagrahaṇakāraṇamapi jālaṃ niścalāvasthāpanavaśīkaraṇakāraṇaṃ saṃpadyate | tadabhāve cātra kāryābhinnatayā'dhyavasitayorniścalāvasthāpanavaśīkaraṇayoḥ pratipādanānna doṣaḥ | evaṃ cāsminnalaṃkāre sarvatrāpi kāryāṃśe prāyeṇa abhedādhyavasānarūpātiśayoktiranuprāṇakatayā'vasthitā | tathā ca pāyasādipiṇḍavadekīkṛtasya vastutassadṛśavastudvayasya ekāvayavasaṃbandhikāraṇavyatirekasāmānādhikaraṇyenāparāvayavamādāya paryavasānaṃ bhavati | tatra ca kāryāṃśaḥ kāraṇābhāvarūpavirodhino bādhyatayaiva sthitaḥ, na bādhakatayā, kāryāṃśasya kalpitatvāt | kāraṇābhāvasya ca svabhāvasiddhatvāt | ata eva kāryāṃśo rūpāntareṇa paryavasyati | ata eva ca samabalavirodhidvayaghaṭitādvirodhālaṃkārādasya vailakṣaṇyam | tathācoktam kāraṇasya niṣedhena bādhyamānaḥ phalodayaḥ | vibhāvanāyāmābhāti virodhe'nyonyabādhanam || ityāhuḥ | atraivodāharaṇapadye ‘jālaṃ vinaiva nitarāṃ lolaṃ nanu mānasānimiṣajālam' iti pūrvārdhe paṭhite asminnalaṃkāre rūpakamanuprāṇayitṛtvenāvatiṣṭhate | ata eva ‘vibhāvanāyāmāhāryābhedabuddhimātramevānuprāṇakam | tacca kvacidatiśayoktyā kvaciccarūpakeṇa iti rasagaṅgādharagranthaśca saṃgacchate | ata eva cāsmābhirabhedādhyavasānarūpātiśayokteranuprāṇakatayā'vasthitiḥ prāyeṇetyasminneva prastāve pūrvamuktamiti dhyeyam || iyaṃ ca vibhāvanā uktanimittā anuktanimittā ceti dvidhā | tatrādyā yathā indīvararuciratanuṃ tvāṃ deva sadopagūhamānāyāḥ | amṛgamadalepamāsīdabdhisutāyāḥ payodhare nailyam || atra hi abdhisutāpayodharanīlimni mṛgamadalepo nimittaṃ, tadabhāve'pi nailyamupanibadhyamānamāpātato viruddhamapi bhagavadupagūhanahetukatayā paryavasyati | bhagavadupagūhanaṃ copāttamityupāttanimitteyam || dvitīyā tu jālaṃ vinaivetyudāhṛtaiva | mānasānimiṣajālākarṣaṇahetorbhagavaddivyavigrahasaundaryasyānupāttatvāt | yathāvā santatamanañjanaṃ tvāmañjanagirinetarakṣṇi nidadhānā | kamalā nirañjanā'pi śyāmalakomalavilocanā lasati || 1105 || na añjanaṃ anañjanaṃ añjanabhinnaṃ, karmalepavidhuramitivastusthitiḥ | 'niṣkalaṃ nirañjanam' iti śruteḥ | nirañjanā nayanāñjanavidhurā karmalepavidhureti tu vastusthitiḥ | atrāñjanaṃ vinā'pi śyāmalalocanātve 'taṃ ceyamasitekṣaṇā' iti svābhāvikatvaṃ nimittaṃ, tacca nopāttamityanupāttanimitteyaṃ vibhāvanā || dvitīyā vibhāvanā kāraṇānāmasāmagrye kāryajanma ca sā matā || kāraṇānāṃ hetūnāṃ asāmagrye hetutāvacchedakadharmasya hetutāvacchedakasaṃbandhasya vā vaikalye sati kāryotpattiśca vibhā vanetyarthaḥ || tatra dharmavaikalye yathā kamalekṣaṇa! mama hṛdayaṃ kālāyasagolato'pi kaṭhinataram | kalaśābdherapi śiśiraiḥ kaṭākṣavisarairvilāyayasi citram || 1106 || atra kaṭhinatarahṛdayadravīkaraṇe sādhye kaṭākṣavisarāṇāmasāmagryaṃ niśitatvādidharmavaikalyam || saṃbandhavaikalye yathā tava caraṇanalinareṇuḥ phaṇadharabhūbhṛnmaṇe śirasi vidhṛtaḥ | bhaktānāmamṛśannapi bāṣpāyayate vilocanāni bata |||| 1107 || bāṣpāyayate bāṣpamudvamayati | atra bāṣpodvamanakāraṇasya reṇorasāmagryaṃ sparśanarūpasaṃbandhavaikalyam || daṇḍimate tviyaṃ viśeṣoktiḥ| yataḥ prathamodāharaṇe bhagavatkaṭākṣavisarāṇāṃ dvitīyodāharaṇe tatpādareṇośca mahāmahimarūpo viśeṣaḥ pratyāyyate, tathāca tadīyaṃ lakṣaṇam || guṇajātikriyādīnāṃ yattu vaikalyadarśanam | viśeṣadarśanāyaiva sā viśeṣoktiriṣyate || iti | viśeṣasya prastutasya yaḥ prabhāvādyatiśayaḥ tasya darśanāya pratipattaya eva guṇajātikriyāṇāṃ ādipadena dravyāṇāṃ ca yadvaikalyadarśanaṃ kāryasiddhāvanupayogitvapratipādanaṃ sā viśeṣoktirnāmālaṃkāra iti kārikārthaḥ | dīkṣitānusāribhirasmābhistu niśitatvādivaikalyamapi kāraṇaviśeṣābhāvarūpamiti vibhāvanā pradarśitā || tṛtīyā vibhāvanā tṛtīyā pratibandhe'pi kāryotpattirvibhāvanā || pratibadhyate aneneti pratibandhaḥ pratibandhakaḥ | pratibandhakasadbhāve'pi kāryotpattistṛtīyā vibhāvanā || yathā nāsattvavṛttayo yattvāmuccādiṃ śritāstadanipātāḥ | citraṃ tvavyayalakṣmībhājassanto vibhānti cakradhara! || 1108 || he cakradhara! yat yasmātkāraṇāt uccādiṃ utkṛṣṭaṃ cādiṃ caśabdādikaṃ kaṃcidgaṇaṃ śritāḥ katicana śabdā ityadhyāhāraḥ | asattvavṛttayaḥ adravyavācinaḥ na na bhavanti, kiṃtu dravyavācina eveti bhāvaḥ | tat tasmāt anipātāḥ nipātasaṃjñāvidhurāḥ | ‘cādayo'sattve' ityadravyārthakānāmeva cādīnāṃ nipātasaṃjñāvidhānena dravyavācināṃ tadabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | idaṃ yuktameva | idaṃ tu citraṃ yat avyayalakṣmīḥ avyayaśrīḥ avyayabhāva iti yāvat, tāṃ bhajantīti tathoktāssantaḥ vibhāntīti | avyayatvaprayojakanipātasaṃjñāyā evābhāve avyayatvaṃ bhajanta ityetadadbhutameveti bhāvaḥ | ‘svarādinipātamavyayam' iti hi nipātānāmavyayasaṃjñā vidhīyate sūtrakāraiḥ | parihārastu uccādiṃ ucceṣu unnatapadādhirūḍheṣu caturmukhādiṣu ādiṃ, uccānāmādimiti vā | utkarṣeṇa cakārādimiti ca śabdārthatādātmyavaibhavāllabhyate, cakradhareti saṃbuddhibalāt | tvāṃ śritāḥ santaḥ brahmavidaḥ sattvavṛttayaḥ sātvikāḥ te na bhavantītyasattvavṛttayaḥ tādṛśā na bhavanti kiṃtu sattvavṛttaya eva | pratiṣedhadvayena saṃbhāvyāsattvavṛttitā nivartyate | tadāha vāmanaḥ 'saṃbhāvya niṣedhanivartane dvau pratiṣedhau' iti, mahān prabhurvai puruṣassattvasyaiṣa pravartakaḥ | ityuktarītyā sattvaguṇapravartakaṃ tvāṃ śritāssātvikā eva bhavantītyarthaḥ | ata eva anipātāḥ rājasatāmasavanmadhyādhogatirūpanipātaṃ na prāptaḥ, kiṃtu ‘ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti satvasthāḥ' ityuktaprakāreṇottamagatibhāja eveti bhāvaḥ | ata eva ca avyayalakṣmībhājaḥ śāśvataiśvaryaṃ niśśreyasarūpaṃ bhajantīti tathā | bhānti nityāsaṃkucitajñānatayā dīpyante | atra anipātatvarūpapratibandhakasadbhāve'pi avyayatvarūpakāryotpattirvarṇiteti lakṣaṇasaṃgatiḥ | śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyamūlakātiśayoktyanuprāṇitasamālaṃkāropaskṛteyam || yathāvā phaṇivaravasundharādharadhuraṃdharakṛpābhiṣekadūratarān | candropalasāndrālayajuṣo'pi tāpāḥ parābhavanti narān || 1109 || atra śiśirataracandropalasāndrālayasthitirūpapratibandhakasadbhāve'pi tāpakartṛkābhibhavalakṣaṇakāryotpattiḥ | śleṣasaṃkīrṇeyam || yathāvā vinatānandananāmani vaihāyasarāji carati śirasi nije | unnaddhaśirā vindati pannagabhūmibhṛdaho mahollāsam || 1110 || vinatānandana iti nāma yasya tasmiṃstathokte | pakṣe praṇatajanānandadāyināmadheye vihāyasāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ samūho vaihāyasaṃ ‘prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ' iti sāmūhiko'ñpratyayaḥ | tasya rāṭ tasmin khagarāje garutmatītyartaḥ | anyatra vihāyasi parame vyomni bhavāḥ vaihāyasāḥ anantagaruḍādayo nityamuktāḥ muktāśca teṣāṃ rāṭ tasmin sakaladevādhirāje vā bhagavati śrīnivāse nije śirasi uparibhāge iti yāvat | śikharabhāge ca carati sati pannagabhūmibhṛt śreṣṭhaḥ phaṇītyarthaḥ | śeṣādririti vastusthitiḥ | unnaddhaśirāḥ uttambhitaphaṇa ityarthaḥ | pakṣe unnataśikharaḥ mahollāsaṃ amitamānandaṃ mahaiḥ utsavaiḥ ullāsaṃ prakāśaṃ ca vindati | atra svoparigarutmatsaṃcārarūpapratibandhakasadbhāve'pi phaṇivareṇyasya unnaddhaphaṇatayā mahollāsabhāktvarūpakāryotpattirvarṇitā | śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyaḥ pūrvavat || yathāvā hanta sadāhāritame'pyatimātramudāramaṇyabhiṣvaṅge | bhavadanabhimukhān sumahāśucibhavadāhaḥ parābhavati bhagavan || 1111 || he bhagavan ! bhavadanabhimukhān janān | saḥ dāhāritame iti chedaḥ | sa ityetaduttaratrānveti | dāhasya atiśayena ariḥ aritamaḥ tathokte ativelavirodhini pratibandhake iti yāvat | atimātraṃ atyarthaṃ udāraḥ mahān yo maṇiḥ tasya abhiṣvaṅge'pi saṃbandhe satyapītyarthaḥ | saḥ tīkṣṇatamatvena prasiddhaḥ sumahān yaḥ śucibhavaḥ agnijanyaḥ dāhaḥ parābhavati abhibhavati | hanta | dāhapratibandhakamaṇisaṃbandhasadbhāve'pi dāhotpattirūpakāryodayo vismayāvaha iti bhāvaḥ || parihārastu sadā sarvadā hāritame atimanohāriṇi 'valgu vāmaṃ hāri śāli' ityamaraḥ | atimātramudā ativelaprītyā ramaṇīnāṃ lalanānāṃ abhiṣvaṅge pariṣvaṅge satyapi sumahā'śuciḥ atimātramapavitraḥ yo bhavaḥ saṃsāraḥ tasya dāhaḥ tāpaḥ parābhavatīti | ramaṇīyatamaramaṇīpariṣvaṅgabhājo bhavadanabhimukhān janān saṃsāratāpo'bhibhavatīti bhāvaḥ || yathāvā vanabhūmau phaṇibhūbhṛti dṛgagrabhāge sthite mahābhoge | gahanabhavajantusādhvasamahaha sughoraṃ nṛṇāṃ dravati dūram || 1112 || vanabhūmau mahābhoge bṛhatphaṇaśarīre | pakṣe mahān ābhogaḥ pārapūrṇatā yasya tathokte phaṇibhūbhṛti mahāśīviṣe śeṣādrāviti tu tattvam | dṛgagrabhāge sthite sati samīpavartinyeva dṛṣṭaṃ satītyarthaḥ | nṛṇāṃ śrīnivāsasevārthaṃ sudūrādāgatānāṃ yātrikāṇāmiti bhāvaḥ | sughoraṃ atiraudraṃ gahanabhavajantusādhvasaṃ gahane mahāraṇye bhavānāṃ jātānāṃ jantūnāṃ hiṃsrasattvānāṃ sādhvasaṃ tatkṛtaṃ bhayaṃ dūraṃ dravati palāyate | ahaha mahāśarīre mahāphaṇe ca mahāśīviṣe mahāraṇyabhūmāvagrata eva dṛṣṭe āraṇyahiṃsrasattvabhayaṃ dūrībhavatītyāścaryametaddarśanasyaiva mahābhayahetutvāditi bhāvaḥ | parihārastu gahanaḥ duḥkhakaraḥ yaḥ bhavaḥ saṃsāraḥ tasmāt jātaṃ gahanabhavajaṃ tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe uttarānvayī | sādhvasaṃ bhayaṃ dūraṃ tu dravati | yātrikāṇāṃ nṛṇāṃ śeṣādrinirvarṇanamātrātsaṃsārajanitabhayamapāstameva bhavatīti | ‘gahanaṃ vanaduḥkhayoḥ' iti ratnamālā | bhavajantu ityatra ‘vā padāntasya' iti anusvārasya vaikalpikaḥ parasavarṇo nakāraḥ | atra mahāvyāladarśanarūpapratibandhake satyapi yātrikāṇāmāraṇyakrūrajantubhayadūrībhavanarūpakāryotpattiḥ śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyānuprāṇitā varṇitā || caturthī vibhāvanā vibhāvanā caturthī syātkāryotpattirakāraṇāt || akāraṇāt kāraṇabhinnāt kāryotpattiścaturthī vibhāvanā || rakṣati na veti saṃśayalakṣaṇatimiraṃ nirākariṣyanme | jyotsnāṃ daśanāvalyā sarīsṛpagirīśvarassarīsarṣṭi || 1113 || atra jyotsnākāraṇabhinnāyāḥ yaśanāvalerjyotsnotpattirvarṇitteti lakṣaṇānugatiḥ | daśanakiraṇamasṛṇitaṃ smitaṃ jyotsnātvenādhyavasitamiti parihāraḥ || yathāvā drutamupagūhati bhagavati pidadhānā kaustubhaṃ karatalena | aṅgulibilagalitābhistadvidyudbhirnatānanā'bhūcchrīḥ || 1114 || atra karatalapihitakaustubhamaṇiprabhāḥ anukṣaṇamaṅgulibilaviśakalavigalitatayā kṣaṇaprabhātvenādhyavasitā iti vidyutkāraṇabhinnātkaustubhādvidyujjanma varṇitam || yathāvā kanakāhāryāduditā udārakūṭāssahasraśo'hāryāḥ | tebhyaḥ kharjūranagāste ca variṣṭhaṃ phalantyativicitram || 1115 || kanakāhāryāt hemādreḥ śeṣādreriti ca śeṣādrereva nāmāntaramidamityasakṛdavocāma | sahasraśaḥ udārakūṭāḥ utkṛṣṭaḥ ārakūṭaḥ pittalaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ 'rītiḥ striyāmārakūṭaḥ' ityamaraḥ| ahāryāḥ girayaḥ sahasraśaḥ uditāḥ | pakṣe ahāryāḥ kenāpi hartumaśakyāḥ udārāḥ mahāntaḥ kūṭāḥ śikharāṇi uditāḥ iti | tebhyaḥ ārakūṭāhāryebhyaḥ ahāryebhyaḥ udāraśṛṅgebhyaśca kharjūranagāḥ rajataśailāḥ sahasraśaḥ uditāḥ kharjūravṛkṣā uditā iti ca ‘kharjūraṃ rūpyakhalayoḥ vṛścike nā drume dvayoḥ' iti medinī | 'śailavṛkṣau nagāvagau' ityamaraḥ | te kharjūranagāśva variṣṭhaṃ tāmraṃ phalanti janayantītyarthaḥ | phalatissakarmako'pi bhavati ‘phaladbhiruṣṇāṃśukarāvamarśātkārśānavaṃ dhāma pataṅgakāntaiḥ' ityādiprayogāt | pakṣe atiśayena uru varaṃ vā variṣṭhaṃ yathā syāttathā phalanti phalāni pradarśayantītyarthaḥ | ‘variṣṭhaṃ marice'pi ca | tāmre klībaṃ tittirau nā varorutamayostriṣu' | iti medinī | atra kanakācalapittalācalādibhyaḥ pittalarajatācalādyakāraṇebhyastadutpattirūpakāryaṃ varṇitamitīyamapi vibhāvanā | śleṣasaṃkīrṇatvaṃ vakṣyamāṇamālādīpakasaṃkīrṇatvaṃ mālārūpatvaṃ ca pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥ || yathāvā uccatarānnāgadharādudumbarāgā niraṅkuśamudītāḥ | prāyaśśākhāstebhyo jātā hārītiphalamito'bhyuditam || 1116 || uccatarāt nāgadharāt sīsādreḥ niraṅkuśaṃ yathā syāttathā udumbarāgāḥ tāmravṛkṣāḥ udītā iti virodhaḥ | uragācalāt jantuphalāparanāmānaḥ pādapā jātā iti parihāraḥ | ‘nāgaṃ napuṃsake raṅge sīsake karaṇāntare' ityupakramya ‘nāgaḥ pannagamātaṅgakrūrācāriṣu toyade' iti, ‘udumbarastu dehalyāṃ vṛkṣabhede'pi ṣaṇḍake | kuṣṭhabhede'pi ca pumāṃstāmre tu syānnapuṃsakam' iti ca medinī | tebhyaḥ tāmravṛkṣebhyaḥ ayasaśśākhā ayaśśākhāḥ prakṛṣṭāśca tāḥ ayaśśākhāśca prāyaśśākhāḥ śreṣṭhalohamayaśākhā jātā iti virodhaḥ | prāyaḥ bhūmnā śākhā jātā iti parihāraḥ | itaḥ ābhyaśśākhābhyaḥ rītiphalaṃ pittalaphalaṃ abhyuditam | hā ityāścarye hārīti manoharaprakāraṃ manoharatvena prakāśamānaṃ vā 'valgu vāmaṃ hāri śāli' iti, ‘iti hetuprakaraṇaprakārādisamāptiṣu' iti cāmaraḥ | 'iti hetau prakāśane' iti medinī | phalaṃ abhyuditamiti parihāraḥ | atrāpi pūrvodāharaṇavadeva sarvam | ekāvalīsaṃkīrṇatvaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā idamadbhutamatimātraṃ yadihāruṇanalinavanarucivadānyāt | pāvayituṃ jagadudabhūtpādāddevasya bhāsvato gaṅgā || 1117 || aruṇanalinavanaruceḥ vadānyāt dātuḥ | pakṣe tato'pi mahataḥ bhāsvataḥ bhānoḥ devasya | pakṣe devasya bhagavataḥ bhāsvataḥ tejasvinaḥ pādāt kiraṇāt caraṇācca gaṅgā jātā | atra gaṅgāyā akāraṇādapi bhānupādāttajjanmarūpakāryaṃ varṇitam | vakṣyamāṇahetvalaṃkārasaṃkīrṇatvaṃ pūrvebhyo viśeṣaḥ || pañcamī vibhāvanā kāryotpattirviruddhāccet pañcamī sā vibhāvanā | yathāvā kumbhīnasapatibhūdharakumbhinyullāsabhāramullalayan | nirjarasiṃhaḥ kaścana mārjayati sma dvipasya bata bhītim || 1118 || nirjaraḥ yuvā sa cāsau siṃhaśca | pakṣe devaśreṣṭhaḥ śrīnivāsa ityarthaḥ | kumbhinyāḥ kariṇyāḥ bhūmeśca ‘gaurilā kumbhinī kṣamā' ityamaraḥ| ullāsabhāraṃ prakāśātiśayaṃ harṣātirekaṃ ca | atra kumbhinīdvipollāsanivartakatayā tadviruddhānnirjarasiṃhāttadullāsanatadbhītimārjanarūpakāryotpattirabhihiteti lakṣaṇānugatiḥ || yathāvā nāgāvanībhṛduccairdhinoti kesarikiśorakanikāyam | so'pi kariṇaḥ prabhinnān svagarjitaireva hanta saṃtanute || 1119 || nāgāvanībhṛt gajarājaḥ | śeṣādririti tu vastusthitiḥ | kesarikiśorakanikāyaṃ siṃhaśābakanikaraṃ uccaiḥ dhinoti | so'pi siṃhaśābakanikaro'pi svagarjitaireva kariṇaḥ gajān prabhinnān mattān ‘prabhinno garjito mattaḥ' iti gajaviśeṣaparyāyeṣvamaraḥ | vidāritāniti tu tattvam | atra kesarikiśorakaprīṇanaviruddhāt gajarājāttatprīṇanarūpaṃ kāryaṃ gajamadaśoṣakatayā tanmattatāsaṃpādanaviruddhātkesarikiśorakasamudayāttanmattatāsaṃpādanarūpakāryaṃ ca varṇitamiti vibhāvanādvayaṃ vakṣyamāṇaikāvalīsaṃkīrṇamiti viśeṣaḥ | śleṣanirvyūḍhatvaṃ tu pūrvavadeva || yathāvā antarhitasaralaguṇo ghanataralobhānvito'pyalaṃkāraḥ | muktāhāro'cyuta tava vasuvikiraṇato'tyudāratāmeti || 1120 || antarhitaḥ tirohitaḥ kvacidapyaprakāśa iti bhāvaḥ | tathāvidhaḥ saralaguṇaḥ udāraguṇaḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | pakṣe antaḥ svacchidrāntaḥpradeśe hitaḥ nihitaḥ protaḥ saralaḥ agranthilatayā ṛjuḥ guṇaḥ suvarṇāditantuḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ ‘saralaḥ padmakāṣṭhe nā'thodārāvakrayostriṣu' iti medinī | ghanatareṇa lobhena anvitaḥ | pakṣe ghanaḥ taralaḥ hāramadhyagamaṇiḥ yasya saḥ ghanataralaḥ 'taralo hāramadhyagaḥ' ityamaraḥ | bhānvitaḥ prabhāyutaḥ ata eva muktāhāraḥ tyaktabhojanaḥ atikadaryatayā svodarapūraṇamapyakurvāṇa iti bhāvaḥ | tathāhi smaryate kadaryalakṣaṇam ātmānaṃ dharmakṛtyaṃ ca putradārāṃśca pīḍayet | lobhādyaḥ pitarau bhrātṝn sa kadarya iti smṛtaḥ || iti | pakṣe muktāhāraḥ mauktikagrathitahāra iti prathitaḥ alaṅkāraḥ ābharaṇaṃ lubdhaḥ kaścitpumāniti vyajyate | vasuvikiraṇataḥ vasūnāṃ dhanānāṃ vikiraṇataḥ svairaviśrāṇanāt | pakṣe kiraṇaprasāraṇāt atyudāraḥ mahāvadānyaḥ atipūjyaśca ‘udāro dātṛmahatoḥ' ityamaraḥ | tattāṃ eti | atraudāryaviruddhāllubdhāttatkāryasaṃpattiśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyena varṇitā | samāsoktyupaskṛtatvaṃ pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥ || yathāvā haribhuktaśeṣameva hi yo bhuṅkte so'ṅga maṅgalaṃ bhuṅkte | yo hyanyadeva bhuṅkte citraṃ so'pyaṅgamaṅgalaṃ bhuṅkte || idaṃ padyaṃ kasyacitkaṃcitpratyanuśāsanarūpam || aṅgeti saṃbodhanārthakamavyayam | ‘syuḥ pyāṭ phāḍaṅga he hai bhoḥ' ityanuśāsanāt | aṅga he sādho! yaḥ haribhuktaśeṣameva bhagavanniveditahaviśśiṣṭameva bhuṅkte abhyavaharati sa pumān maṅgalaṃ sarvapāpāpanodanapūrvakaniśśreyasalābhaparyantaṃ kalyāṇaṃ bhuṅkte anubhavati | tatastu bhagavadbhuktaṃ prāśnīyānniyatassvayam | kṣayāya sarvapāpānāṃ mokṣasaṃsiddhaye'pi ca || iti, tvayopabhuktasraggandhavāsolaṅkāracarcitāḥ | ucchiṣṭabhojino dāsāstava māyāṃ taranti te || iti ca śrīmatpārameśvarasaṃhitāśrībhāgavatādyukteriti bhāvaḥ yaḥ pumān anyadeva bhagavadaniveditameva vā bhagavaditaradevaniveditameva vā bhuṅkte so'pi aṅga! he sādho! maṅgalaṃ bhuṅkte uktarītyā kalyāṇabhāgbhavatīti citram 'nāniveditabhogassyāt' iti bhagavadaniveditānnādibhogasya bharadvājasaṃhitādau niṣedhāt | sakṛdeva hi yo'śnāti brāhmaṇo jñānadurlabhaḥ | nirmālyaṃ śaṅkarādīnāṃ sa caṇḍālo bhaveddhruvam | kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi pacyate narakāgninā | nirmālyabhugdvijaśreṣṭho rudrādīnāṃ divaukasām || iti || viṣṇorniveditaṃ śuddhaṃ munibhirbhojyamucyate | anyaniveditaṃ yattadbhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret || iti ca pādmabrāhmādiṣu bhagavadanyadevatāniveditānnādyupayojanasya pratyavāyahetutvasyaiva smaraṇācca tādṛśānnabhojanasya maṅgalaprāpakatvoktirvismayāvahaiveti bhāvaḥ || parihārastu aṅgamaṅgalamiti samastaṃ padam | avidyamānaḥ ṅga ityākārakavarṇasamudayo yasya tattathoktaṃ maṅgalaṃ malaṃ pāpamityarthaḥ | bhuṅkte iti | ‘malo'strī pāpaviṭkiṭṭeṣu' ityamaraḥ | śabdārthayostādātmyaṃ tu na prasmartavyam | bhagavanniveditānnādyupabhoktā yajñaśiṣṭāśinassanto mucyante sarvakilbiṣaiḥ | ityuktaprakriyayā sarvapāpavinirmokapūrvakakalyāṇabhāgbhavati | taditarastu kevalāgho bhavati kevalādī' ‘te tvaghaṃ bhuñjate pāpāḥ ye pacantyātmakāraṇāt' iti śrutismṛtyuktaprakāreṇa kevalapāpabhoktaiva bhavatīti nirgalito'rthaḥ | atra maṅgalabhoktṛtvaviruddhādbhagavadaniveditādyannabhojanāttadbhoktṛtvarūpakāryasaṃpattiruktā | pūrvārdhoktasamālaṅkārapuraskṛteyam | pūrvodāharaṇādvicchittiviśeṣāntaraṃ tu spaṣṭameva || atredamavadheyaṃ lakṣaṇe viruddhādityasya kāryāsahavṛtterityarthaḥ | tathācātra maṅgalabhoktṛtvarūpakāryasya bhavagavadaniveditānnādibhojanarūpakāraṇasya caikasmin puruṣarūpe deśe asahavṛttitvāddeśiko virodha iti | evaṃ ‘kumbhīnasapatibhūdhara' ityādiṣu prāgupadarśiteṣu triṣvapyudāharaṇeṣu daiśika eva virodho draṣṭavyaḥ || yathāvā svakaravyatikaritairhariratiniśitairāśugairmahātejāḥ | atanutarairatanuta bata vimatān jaḍatā'tivepitān sadyaḥ || 1122 || hariḥ raviḥ bhagavāṃśca | svasya karaiḥ kiraṇaiḥ karābhyāṃ ca vyatikaritaiḥ saṃśleṣitaiḥ saṃhitaiśca ata eva niśitaiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ āśugaiḥ mārutaiḥ bāṇaiśca jaḍatayā śaityena apratipattimūḍhamanaskatayā ca ativepitān atikampitān | spaṣṭamanyat || atra jaḍatāprayuktakampaviruddhādbhānostatsaṃpattibhihitā | bhānukarāṇāṃ jaḍatāprayuktakampanasya caikasmin kāle asahavṛtteḥ kāliko virodha iti viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā kuvalayavikāsadaśrīramṛtakaro'pi svatassatāṃ nāthaḥ | āmodayate puṣkarasado mahoṣṇaśriyā bataiṣa divā || 1123 || eṣaḥ satāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ nāthaḥ candramāḥ svataḥ amṛtakaraḥ śiśirāṃśuriti bhāvaḥ | kulavayavikāsadaśrīrapi divā ahni mahoṣṇayā atitigmayā śriyā svabhāsā puṣkarāṇāṃ padyānāṃ sadaḥ sabhāṃ samūhamiti yāvat ‘strīnapuṃsakayossadaḥ' ityamaraḥ | āmodayate surabhīkaroti | bata idaṃ citramityarthaḥ || vastusthitistu svataḥ satāṃ brahmavidāṃ amṛtakaraḥ niśśreyasadātā| kuvalayavikāsadā bhūvalayānandadāyinī śrīḥ lakṣmīḥ śobhā saṃpadvā yasya sa tathoktaḥ | eṣaḥ nāthaḥ jagatāmadhīśvaro bhagavān mahoṣṇā atipaṭuḥ śrīḥ saṃpat yasyāssā atimahoṣṇaśrīḥ tathoktyā divā svargeṇa ‘uṣṇo grīṣme pumān dakṣāśītayoranyaliṅgakaḥ' iti medinī | ‘dakṣe tu caturapeśalapaṭavasūtthāna uṣṇaśca' ityamaraśca | puṣkare sīdantīti puṣkarasadaḥ | sadeḥ kvip | tān dyusadaḥ devān ‘puṣkaraṃ khe'mbupadmayoḥ' iti medinī | āmodayate praharṣayate iti 'āmodo gandhaharṣayoḥ' iti medinī | divaḥ paṭutarasaṃpatsamṛddhimattāmāpādya devānānandayatītyarthaḥ | atra puṣkarapariṣadāmodanivartakatayā tadviruddhāccandramasaḥ puṣkarapariṣadāmodanirvartanarūpakāryasaṃpattirudīritā || candramasaḥ puṣkarāmodasya caikasmim kāle sahānavasthānātkāliko virodhaḥ || kāraṇasyodbhavaḥ kāryādyadi ṣaṣṭhī vibhāvanā || kāryāditi pañcamyartho hetutvaṃ na tvānantaryādiḥ | anyathā kāryakāraṇapaurvāparyaviparyayarūpātiśayoktāvatiprasaṅgassyāt || yathāvā sāgasyapi vinatajane dayāpayodhiṃ śriyāssamudbhūtam | vīkṣyāhīndragirīndorvismayajaladhirvijāyate citram || 1124 || atra kāryabhūtābhyāṃ lakṣmīcandrābhyāṃ kāraṇabhūtajaladhijanirvarṇitetyeṣā vibhāvanā | dayāpayodhiriva vismayo jaladhirivetyupamitasamāsāśrayaṇena mahatī dayā mahāṃśca vismayo jāyata iti virodhaparihāraḥ || yathāvā manaso jāto vidhuriti nanu sā prāhānidaṃprathamavāṇī | śubhavṛṣagirīśamaulervidhoḥ prasannaṃ mano'jani vicitram || 1125 || anidaṃprathamavāṇī śrutiḥ ‘candramā manaso jātaḥ' ityāha | śubhaḥ vṛṣaḥ vṛṣabhaḥ yasya tasya girīśasya śaṅkarasya mauleḥ śekharabhūtāt vidhoḥ candramasaḥ prasannaṃ manaḥ ajanīti virodhaḥ | śubhaścāsau vṛṣagirīśaḥ śeṣagiriḥ tasya mauleḥ vidhorbhagavataḥ hetubhūtāt manaḥ asya mametyādiḥ| prasannaṃ bhagavaddarśanādinā vītakaluṣam | ajanīti yojanābhedena tatparihāraḥ | atrāpi kāryāccandramaso manasaḥ kāraṇasyotpattirvarṇitā śrutiprasiddhakāryakāraṇabhāvavaiparītyavarṇanaṃ pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥ || yathāvā bhānurajāyata bhagavaccakṣuṣa iti vadati pauruṣaṃ sūktam | dhāmanidherajani harerddṛṣṭirviśadā mamaitatadāścaryam || 1126 || pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ ‘cakṣossūryo ajāyata' iti vadati | viśadā prasannā hareḥ bhagavataḥ dṛṣṭiḥ cakṣuḥ dhāmanidheḥ bhānoḥ ajani etat mamāścaryam | iti virodhaḥ | dhāmanidheḥ tejonidheḥ hareḥ bhagavataḥ śrīnivāsāt mama dṛṣṭiḥ jñānaṃ ‘dṛṣṭirjñāne'kṣṇi darśane' ityamaraḥ| viśadā nirmalā ajanīti yojanābhedena parihāraḥ | atrāpi kāryādbhānoḥ kāraṇasya bhagavaccakṣuṣa udayo varṇitaḥ || yathāvā indraścāgniśca mukhādajaniṣṭeti śrutaṃ puruṣasūkte | jiṣṇośśucerbhagavataḥ prādurabhūnmukhamaho mama samakṣam || 1127 || 'mukhādindraścāgniśca' iti puruṣasūkte śrutam | bhagavataḥ mukhaṃ jiṣṇoḥ indrāt śuceḥ agnervā mama samakṣaṃ prādurabhūt ajāyata aho iti virodhaḥ | parihārastu jiṣṇoḥ jayaśīlasya śuceḥ apahatapāpmanaḥ bhagavataḥ mukhaṃ mama samakṣaṃ pratyakṣaṃ prādurabhūt āvirbhūtamabhūt | atrāpi kāryādindrādagneśca kāraṇasya bhagavanmukhasya prādurbhāvo'bhihitaḥ| anyattu pūrvavadeva || yathāvā viṣṇupadādgaṅā'bhūdvimaleti nyaśamayāma śāstrebhyaḥ | citramidaṃ gaṅgāyā viṣṇupadaṃ vimalamāvirabhavaditi || 1128 || nyaśamayāma aśṛṇavāma gaṅgāyāssakāśāt vimalaṃ viṣṇupadaṃ bhagavaccaraṇaṃ āvirabhavat ajāyateti virodhaḥ | gaṅgāyāḥ hetoḥ viṣṇupadaṃ antarikṣaṃ vimalaṃ sat āvirabhavat prakāśamāsīt iti parihāraḥ| kāryātkāraṇajanisspaṣṭaiva || ime ca ṣaṭ prakārāḥ kuvalayānandakārairlakṣitāḥ | prāktanaistu atrādya eva prakāro lakṣitaḥ nānye pañca prakārāḥ ete ca pañcaprakārā dīkṣitopajñānyeveti jñāyante || rasagaṅgādharakṛdādayastu "prathamaprakārātū dvitīyaprakārasya vailakṣaṇyaṃ durupapādameva, kāraṇābhāve'pi kāryotpattirityatra kāraṇatāvacchedakasaṃbandhena kāraṇatāvacchedakāvacchinnapratiyogitākābhāvasya vivakṣitatvāt | prakārāntarasvīkārāpekṣayā tādṛśavivakṣāyā eva laghutvāt | evaṃ pratibandhakamapi kāraṇābhāva eva | pratibandhakābhāvasya kāraṇatvāt | iti tṛtīyo'pi bhedo na vilakṣaṇaḥ| caturthe'pi bhede kāraṇābhāva ārthaḥ | 'śaṅkhādvīṇāninādo'yam' ityukte vīṇāṃ vinaiveti pratyayādavailakṣaṇyam | tasmādādyena prakāreṇa prakārāntarāṇāmālīḍhatvāt ṣaṭprakārā ityanupapannameva | yadi tu yathākathaṃcitkuvalayānandoktissamarthanīyetyāgrahaḥ tadā itthaṃ samarthanīyam | tathāhi vinā'pi kāraṇaṃ kāryajanmeti vibhāvanāyāssāmānyalakṣaṇam | iyaṃ ca tāvat dvividhā | śābdī ārthī ceti | śābdī trividhā | pratibandhakātiriktakāraṇavyaktipratiyogitākābhāvoktipūrvikā satyāmapi kāraṇavyaktau yadavacchinnatvavaikalyaprayuktaḥ kāryābhāvaḥ tadvaikalyoktipūrvikā, sa ca kāraṇatāvacchedakadharmaḥ kvacitkāraṇatāvacchedakasaṃbandhaśca | pratibandhakoktipūrvikā ceti | ārthyapi trividhā | prakṛtakāryasamānajātīyakāryāntarasya kāraṇāt prakṛtaviruddhakāryasya kāraṇāt svakāryādvā | prakṛtakāryasyotpattiriti | etadarthakameva hi ‘akāraṇātkāryajanmetyādi" ityāhuḥ || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre vibhāvanāsaraḥ ṣaṭtriṃśaḥ <12> atha viśeṣoktisaraḥ viśeṣoktiḥ puṣkale'pi hetau kāryaṃ na cedbhavet | satyāmapi kāraṇasāmagryāṃ kāryasyānutpattiviśeṣoktirnāmālaṃkāraḥ | asyāṃ ca virodhaḥ pratibhāsamānaḥ prasiddhakāraṇāntaravaikalyabuddhyā nivartate || yathā snātaṃ tīrthe'dhītaṃ sphītaṃ śāstraṃ kṛtaṃ sukṛtajātam | etanmamāvinītaṃ caitanyaṃ tadapi hanta kiṃ jātam || 1129 || cetanaiva caitanyaṃ buddhirityarthaḥ | hanta kiṃ jātamiti nirvedātiśayakathanam | atra ‘tametaṃ vedānuvacanena brāhmaṇā vividiṣanti yajñena dānena tapasā'nāśakena' ityādyuktarītyā tīrthasnānādīnāṃ brahmavedananidānabhūtacittaśuddhihetūnāṃ bahūnāṃ samavadhāne'pi cittaśuddhirūpakāryānudayavarṇanādviśeṣoktiḥ | tatra īśvarasauhārdayādṛcchikasukṛtaparipākādyabhāvarūpaṃ pratibandhakaṃ pratīyate | iyamanuktanimittā cittaśuddhyanudayanimittasya pratibandhakasyānupāttatvāt || yathāvā subahuśruto'pi kaścittvāṃ nārāyaṇa na vetti paratattvam | avagāḍhapāyaso'pi ca tasya rasaṃ dāruhastaka ivāho || 1130 || atra bahuśrutatvarūpakāraṇasadbhāve'pi ‘tattvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ' iti śrūyamāṇo nārāyaṇa eva paraṃ tattvamiti jñānarūpakāryasyānudayo varṇitaḥ || vidyā rājanna te vidyā mama vidyā na hīyate | vidyāhīnastamo vasto nābhijānāsi keśavam || ityuktarītyā brahmavidyāvidhuratvatamodhvastatvādirūpaṃ pratibandhakaṃ pratīyata itīyamapyanuktanimittā | uktavidhaparatattvājñānanimittasya pratibandhakasyānupādānāt | avagāḍhaṃ viloḍitaṃ pāyasaṃ paramānnaṃ yena sa tathokto'pi dāruhastakaḥ pāyasasūpādiviloḍanapariveṣaṇasādhanabhūto dārunirmito hastākāraḥ kaścidvastuviśeṣaḥ 'syāttaṇḍūrdāruhastakaḥ' ityamaraḥ | atra yasya nāsti nijā prajñā kevalaṃ tu bahuśrutaḥ | na sa jānāti śāstrārthaṃ darvī sūparasāniva || iti śrīmadbhāratavacanārthaḥ pratyabhijñāpyate | upamāsaṃkīrṇatvaṃ tu pūrvodāharaṇādviśeṣaḥ || uktanimittā yathā prāyaścīrṇānyapi vā prāyaścittāni pāpinaṃ manujam | na hi nārāyaṇavimukhaṃ punanti tīrthāni madyabhāṇḍamiva || 1131 || atra nānāvidhaprāyaścittācaraṇalakṣaṇakāraṇasadbhāve'pi pūtatvarūpakāryānudayaḥ | iyamuktanimittā nārāyaṇavimukhamityapūtatānimittasya pratibandhakasyopāttatvāt | anena prāyaścittāni cīrṇāni nārāyaṇaparāṅmukham | na niṣpunanti rājendra surābhāṇḍamivāpagāḥ || iti śrībhāgavataślokārthaḥ pratyabhijñāpyate || yathāvā hanta viśuddhe pūrṇe'pyantargagane vidhau vilasamāne | buddhirmugdhatamānāṃ tamasvinī na vijahāti mālinyam || 1132 || viśuddhe pūrṇe ābhyāṃ viśeṣaṇābhyāṃ ‘eṣa ātmā'pahatapāpmā' ityādidaharavidyodīritamakhilaheyapratyanīkatvamanantakalyāṇaguṇākaratvaṃ ca saṃgṛhītam | antaḥ brahmapurarūpaśarīrāntarvartini hṛdayapuṇḍarīke vidyamāne gagane ‘daharo'sminnantara ākāśaḥ, tatrāpi dahlaṃ gaganam' iti daharavidyāpratipādite parasmin brahmaṇi vidhau viṣṇau nārāyaṇe | anena liṅgabhūyastvādhikaraṇasiddhāntaprakāreṇa nārāyaṇasyaiva sarvaparavidyopāsyatvamityayamarthassūcitaḥ | vilasamāne'pi ‘anena sakṛdvibhāto hyevaiṣa brahmalokaḥ' iti tadvidyoktaṃ brahmasvarūpaprakāśasyānāvṛtatayā bhāsamānatvamuktam | tācchīlyārthakacānaśā tasya prakāśasyānāgantukatvaṃ sūcitam | mugdhatamānāṃ avidyācchāditānāṃ anena ‘tadyathā hiraṇyanidhiṃ nihitamakṣetrajñā uparyupari saṃcaranto na vindeyurevamevemāssarvāḥ prajā ‘aharahargacchantya etaṃ brahmalokaṃ na vindantyanṛtena hi pratyūḍhāḥ' iti tatratyaśrutyartho'nusaṃhitaḥ | pratyūḍhāḥ pratīpaṃ nītāḥ svabhāvāntaraṃ prāpitāḥ ācchāditā iti yāvat iti tadarthaḥ| tamasvinī tāmasī buddhiḥ mālinyaṃ sāṃsārikaduḥkhamalinatāṃ na jahātīti | anyatra viśuddhe vimale pūrṇe samagrakale vidhau candramasi gagane antaḥ antarikṣasya madhye śauṇḍādigaṇe antaśśabdapāṭhādgagane ityavayavina ādhāratvavivakṣāyāṃ saptamī | vistarastu rasāsvādinyāṃ kṛto'smābhiḥ | vilasamāne satyapi tamasvinī tamaḥpracurā buddhiḥ guheti gamyate | mālinyaṃ timiraprayuktamalīmasatvaṃ na vijahātīti | atra vidhuvilasanarūpakāraṇe vidyamāne'pi mālinyaprahāṇarūpakāryānudayo varṇitaḥ | iyamapi pūrvavaduktanimittaiva, tamasvinīti mālinyāprahāṇanimittasya pratibandhakasyopādānāt | pūrvā śuddhā upamopaskṛtā | iyaṃ tu śleṣādisaṃkīrṇeti bhedaḥ || yathāvā api harinakhaparibhūtaḥ kṣāntyādyavibhāsuraḥ kṣapādhyakṣaḥ | svāntetrapādhyalīḍho hyanūnavarṇo babhūva sa khalu jaḍaḥ || 1133 || hareḥ bhagavataḥ nakhaiḥ paribhūto'pi kṣapādhyakṣaḥ candramāḥ | svānte manasi trapā lajjā ādhiḥ vyathā tābhyāṃ ālīḍhaḥ avyāptaḥ nistrapo nirvyathaścetyarthaḥ | ata eva kṣāntyā tādṛśaparibhavasahanena upalakṣitaḥ ata eva avikalavarṇaḥ pūrṇavarṇa eva hiśabdo'vadhāraṇe | dyavi antarikṣe ‘dyodivau dve' ityamaraḥ | bhāsuraḥ babhūva | tatra hetvantaramāha sa iti | saḥ candramāḥ jaḍaḥ khalu mūḍha eva hi | mūḍhāḥ prāyeṇa parebhyaḥ prāpte'pi paribhave na glāyanti kiṃtu vivekavidhurā hṛṣyantyapīti bhāvaḥ || pakṣe kṣapādhyakṣa iti śabdaḥ kṣāntyādyavibhāsura iti samastamekaṃ padam | kṣābhyāṃ kṣakārābhyāṃ antyādyayoḥ caramaprathamabhāgayoḥ vibhāsuraḥ kṣarūpābhyāṃ antyādyavarṇābhyāṃ vibhāsura iti vā | atra asmin svānte svāntare kṣapādhyakṣaśabdamadhye ityarthaḥ | pādhyalīḍhaḥ pādhya iti varṇasamudayalīḍhaḥ avikalavarṇaḥ saṃpūrṇākṣara eva babhūva | ekasyāpi varṇasyānapāyāditi bhāvaḥ | atra harinakhaparibhūtatvarūpakāraṇasattve'pi trapādyanudayo varṇitaḥ | jaḍa iti trapādyanudayanimittasya pratibandhakasyopāttatvāduktanimittaiva | śabdārthatādātmyamūlakaśleṣopaskṛtatvaṃ pūrvasmādvicchittiviśeṣaḥ || yathāvā sārasasarasā dṛkte pratikūloktyā'pi na vikṛtilavaṃ vā | vindati mukundasundari tasyāstādṛgvidhā hi paripāṭī || 1134 || he mukundasundari! sārasasarasā kamalaramaṇīyā tava dṛk pratikūloktyā svavipratīpavacasā'pi vikṛtilavaṃ vā vikāraleśamapi na vindati | mahodāragabhīrahṛdayāyāstava nisarganityaramaṇīyā dṛṣṭiḥ kṣobhahetubhūtakṣodiṣṭhapratikūlagirā na kadā'pi vikṛtimupayāti | kiṃtu yathāvasthitaiva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | tathā'vasthāne hetumāha tasyā iti | hi yasmāt tasyāḥ dṛśaḥ paripāṭī rītiḥ tādṛgvidhā tatsvabhāva eva tādṛk yatkṣobhahetau satyapyavikṛtatayaivāvasthānam | ata eva viśeṣoktiḥ | iyamapyuktaviṣayā | tasyāstādṛgvidhā hi paripāṭīti vikārānudayanimittasya pratibandhakasyopāttatvāt | atra sārasasarasāśabdaḥ pratilomapāṭhe'pi vikāraleśamapi na vindati | tasyāḥ sārasasarasāśabdasya arthagataṃ strītvaṃ śabde āropyate | paripāṭī ānupūrvī tathāvidhāhi | vilomapāṭhe'pyanulomasusadṛśavarṇāvasthānarūpaprakāśaśālinīti camatkārāntarapradarśanaṃ viśeṣaḥ pūrvodāharaṇāt || kecidacintyanimittāṃ tṛtīyāmāmananti | udāharanti ca sa ekastrīṇi jayati jaganti kusumāyudhaḥ | haratā'pi tanuṃ yasya śambhunā na balaṃ hṛtam || iti | anuktanimittāyāṃ nimittaṃ nimittatāvacchedakarūpeṇa cintyamānaṃ pratīyate | iha tu na tathā | kiṃtu bhaviṣyati kiṃcinnimittamityākāreṇetyanuktanimittāto'cintyanimittāyā bheda iti hi teṣāmabhiprāyaḥ | anye tu ‘nānuktanimittāyāṃ cintyatvaṃ nimittaviśeṣaṇaṃ, bhedāntarakalpanāgauravaprasaṅgāt | kiṃtu cintyatvamacintyatvaṃ ceti dviprakārakamapi nimittaṃ yatra noktaṃ sā'nuktanimittā tena acintyanimittā anuktanimittāto na pṛthagbhāvamarhati' ityāhuḥ || cintyanimittā pūrvamudāhṛtaiva || acintyanimittā yathā duṣkṛtiniśśeṣīkṛti kṛtini tvayi jāgrati prabhāvavati | tvadvaibhavavidveṣī khalaḥ kuto'dyāpi śiṣyate bhagavan || 1135 || atra duṣkṛdvināśanapaṭīyastaramahāprabhāvabhagavajjāgarūkatārūpakāraṇasāmagrīsamavadhāne'pi tadvaibhavavidveṣikhalajananiśśeṣīkaraṇarūpakāryānudayavarṇanādviśeṣoktiḥ | tatpariśeṣaṇe nimittaṃ kiṃcidbhaviṣyatītyacintyameva tat, pratītyaviṣayatvāt || yathāvā pannaganagadhaureyaḥ prasannayā'mba tvayā'niśaṃ suhitaḥ | citraṃ namadaskhalito na rāgaduṣṭā'pi dṛṣṭiretasya || 1136 || he amba! tvayā prasannayā surayā svacchayā satuṣṭayā vā satyeti vastusthitiḥ | ‘prasannā syātsurāyāṃ strī svacchasaṃtuṣṭayostriṣu' iti medinī | 'gandhottamā prasannerā' iti surāparyāyeṣvamaraśca | aniśaṃ suhitaḥ tṛptaḥ | pakṣe sutarāṃ hitarakṣaṇena sakalabhuvanahitakṛdityarthaḥ || lakṣmyā saha hṛṣīkeśo devyā kāruṇyarūpayā | rakṣakassarvasiddhānte vedānteṣvapi gīyate || iti śrīsāhityenaiva jagadrakṣaṇokteḥ | madena cittavikāreṇa skhalitaḥ na bhavati | pakṣe namadaskhalita iti samastamekaṃ padam | namatsu śaraṇāgateṣu askhalitaḥ āśritarakṣaṇavrate cyutirahita ityarthaḥ | kiṃca etasya dṛṣṭiḥ rāgeṇa śoṇimnā madakāryeṇa | anyatra mātsaryādidoṣeṇa duṣṭā ca na bhavati | atra aniśaṃ prasannāsuhitatvarūpakāraṇapauṣkalyasadbhāve'pi madaskhālityādikāryānudayavarṇanādviśeṣoktiḥ | tādṛśakāryānudaye nimittaṃ kiṃ bhavedvetyacintyameva tat, pratītyagocaratvāt | iyaṃ śleṣottambhiteti pūrvādāharaṇādvailakṣaṇyam || yathāvā nanu vāsarādhipastava sevāyai vānarādhipo jātaḥ | raghuvīra rūpabhede'pyanayoragrāhi hanta sanabhedaḥ || 1137 || nanu raghuvīra! vāsarādhipaḥ bhānuḥ tava sevāyai kaiṃkaryaṃ kartuṃ vānarādhipo jātaḥ sugrīvatayā''virabhūdityarthaḥ | 'ātmā vai putranāmāsi' iti śruteḥ | anayoḥ vāsarādhipavānarādhipoḥ rūpabhede satyapi saḥ bhedaḥ nāgrāhi | janairiti śeṣaḥ | hantetyāścarye | atra rūpabhedagrahaṇasāmagryāṃ satyāmapi tadagrahaṇavarṇanādviśeṣoktiracintyanimittā | anayoḥ vāsarādhipavānarādhipaśabdayoḥ sanabhedaḥ sakāranakārābhyameva bhedaḥ agrāhi nānyavarṇairiti vastusthitiḥ | ayameva viśeṣaḥ pūrvodāharaṇāt || idamatrāvadheyaṃ yatra kāraṇābhāvakāryābhāvayoḥ pratiyogitāvacchedakaviśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭyena śrutyā pratipādanaṃ tatra vibhāvanāviśeṣoktyośśābdatvaṃ anyatrārthatvamiti || yathā madhuravidhāṃ caritasudhāṃ madhumathana tavāniśaṃ samāpibatām | pratikalamavikalarūpastarṣotkarṣo'bhivardhate citram || 1138 || loke hyasaṃnikarṣastarṣahetuḥ tadabhāve saṃnikarṣe'pi tarṣotkarṣa upanibaddhaḥ | tathā sannikarṣastṛptihetuḥ tatsadbhāve'pi tṛptyabhāvo bodhitaḥ | paraṃtu kāraṇābhāvakāryābhāvayorna prāgupadarśitaprakāreṇa pratiyogitāvacchedakaviśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭyena śrutyā pratipādanamasyārthatvameva vibhāvanāviśeṣoktisaṃkarasya | amumeva cārthaṃ hṛdi nidhāya mammaṭabhaṭṭena "yaḥ kaumāraharaḥ" iti padyamudāhṛtyātra sphuṭo na kaścidalaṃkāra ityabhihitam || vāmanastu ‘ekaguṇahānikalpanāyāṃ sāmyadārḍhyaṃ viśeṣoktiḥ' iti vyavāhārṣīt | udāhārṣīcca ‘dyūtaṃ hi nāma puruṣasyāsiṃhāsanaṃ rājyam' iti | atra hi dyūte rājyaṃ tādātmyenāropyate | tatra siṃhāsanarahitaṃ hi dyūtaṃ siṃhāsanasahitarājyatādātmyaṃ kathamavalambetetyāroponmūlayitṛyuktinirākaraṇāyāropyamāṇe rājye'pi siṃhāsanarāhityaṃ kalpyate | tena dṛḍhāropaṃ rūpakamevedaṃ na viśeṣoktiḥ | evaṃca 'acaturvadano brahmā' ityādipaurāṇikapadye'pi rūpakaviśeṣa eva | tathā guṇādhikyakalpanāyāmapi rūpakaviśeṣa eva | yathā ‘dharmo vapuṣmān bhuvi kārtavīryaḥ' ityādau | evaṃca ‘ekaguṇahānyupacayādikalpanāyāṃ sāmyadārḍhyaṃ viśeṣaḥ' iti viśeṣālaṅkāraṃ lakṣayanto'pi pratyuktāḥ || ityalaṅkāramaṇihāre viśeṣoktisarassaptatriṃśaḥ <13> athāsaṃbhavasaro'ṣṭatriṃśaḥ asaṃbhāvyatvakathanamarthasiddherasaṃbhavaḥ || kasyacitkāryasya niṣpatterasaṃbhāvanīyatvavarṇanamasaṃbhavo nāmālaṃkāraḥ | yathā kurusadasi drupadasutā paribhūtā'bhūdyadā tathā dhūrtaiḥ | tava karuṇā tāṃ bhagavaṃstadā'bhirakṣettatheti ko veda || 1139 || yathāvā caraṇatrayamitadharaṇīvaraṇakṛtārthena vāmanena hare | jagatāṃ tritayaṃ bhavatā''kramyata iti kena nāma vijñātam || 1140 || yathāvā sarvada iti hṛdayaṃ tvayi darvīkaragiripate mayā nyastam | apaharasi tadeva tvaṃ deva tvāmīdṛgiti na vedāham || 1141 || atrodāharaṇatraye pāñcālīrakṣaṇajagattrayākramaṇahṛdayāpaharaṇānāṃ padārthānāṃ niṣpatterasaṃbhāvanīyatvaṃ ko vedetyādibhirāviṣkṛtamiti lakṣaṇānugatiḥ || yathāvā gopakiśorasya vane tāpo mā bhūtpidhehi ghana tapanam | ityāśāse vidyātkā vā dāvāgnimeṣa pibatīti || 1142 || yaśodāyā uktiriyam | ghaneti jaladharasya saṃbodhanam | atra gopakiśorasya dāvāgnipānarūpapadārthaniṣpatterasaṃbhāvyatvaṃ kā vā vidyādityanenāviṣkṛtam || yathāvā śubhabhāvibhavāndadyā iti he ramādhipa samāśritā ete | śubhabhāvibhavānevaṃ hare tvameṣāṃ hareriti na vidmaḥ || 1143 || śubhaṃ kalyāṇaṃ bhāḥ dīptiḥ vibhavaḥ aiśvaryaṃ eteṣāṃ dvaṃdvaḥ śubhabhāvibhavāḥ tān | uttarārdhe virodhaparihāre he śubheti saṃbuddhiḥ | bhāvibhavān bhaviṣyajjanmānītyarthaḥ | atra śubhabhāvibhavaharaṇarūpapadārthaniṣpatterasaṃbhāvanīyatā evaṃ hareriti na vidma ityanena prakāśitā || ramādhipa hare iti saṃpatpradānaharaṇasāmarthyābhiprāyagarbhaviśeṣyanyasanarūpaparikarāṅkuraśleṣaviṣamaviśeṣasaṃkīrṇo'yamiti pūrvebhyo viśeṣaḥ || ayamalaṃkāro dīkṣitopajñameva | prācīnaistu na lakṣitaḥ | taddarśane tu pradarśiteṣu prathametareṣu ‘caraṇatrayamitadharaṇī' ityādiṣu triṣūdāharaṇeṣu yadyapi virodhālaṃkāreṇa bhāvyam | vāmanādīnāṃ dravyāṇāṃ jagattrayākramaṇādikriyābhirvirodhasya sphuṭatvāt | ata eva kuvalayānandīyāsaṃbhavodāharaṇabhūtaṃ ‘ayaṃ vārāmeko nilaya iti ratnākara iti' iti padyamalaṃkārasarvasvakārādayo dravyakriyāvirodhodāharaṇatayopādadire | antime ‘śubhabhāvibhavāndadyāḥ' ityudāharaṇe tu vakṣyamāṇaviṣamaprakārabhedena bhavitavyaṃ, arthāvāptirūpeṣṭārthasamudyamādiṣṭānavāpteraniṣṭapratilambhasya ca varṇitatvāt | tathā'pi prāthamike ‘kurusadasi drupadasutā' iti padye tādṛśavirodhasya vā alaṃkārāntarasya vā asaṃbhavādasaṃbhavālaṃkāra evoktalakṣaṇalakṣito vicchittiviśeṣaśālitayā'vaśyābhyupeya iti
