dvitīyādyudāharaṇeṣvapyarthaniṣpattyasaṃbhāvyatāvarṇanalakṣaṇavicchittiviśeṣasadbhāvasya sahṛdayahṛdayaikasākṣikatayā sa evālaṃkāraḥ pradhānībhūta iti tenaiva vyapadeśo yuktaḥ 'prādhānyena vyapadeśā bhavanti' iti nyāyāt | anyastu tadaṅgatvenāpradhānatayā'vatiṣṭhata iti sudhībhirākalanīyam || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre asaṃbhavasaro'ṣṭatriṃśaḥ <14> athāsaṃgatisaraḥ bhinnādhikaraṇatvaṃ yadviruddhaṃ hetukāryayoḥ | varṇyate tamalaṃkāraṃ prājñāḥ prāhurasaṃgatim || viruddhatvenāpātato bhāsamānaṃ hetukāryayorvaiyadhikaraṇyamasaṃgatirnāmālaṃkāraḥ || yāvatkaṭākṣadhārā bhāvatkī prasaraṇonmukhākārā | tāvattāpā namatāṃ śrīvatsāṅka svayaṃ layamayante || atra kaṭākṣadhārāprasaraṇaunmukhyalakṣaṇahetoḥ tāpalayarūpakāryasya ca vaiyadhikaraṇye atiprasaṅgavāraṇāya viruddhetyādi | iha ca vibhinnadeśasthitasyaiva tasya kāryaprayojakatayā virodhānavakāśaḥ || yathā pavanāśanagirināyaka navajaladastava jahāra rucivibhavam | jagatāṃ nirvarṇayatāṃ bhavatā bata nigalitāni nayanāni || 1145 || atra nigalitānītyatrābhedādhyavasāyalakṣaṇenātiśayena steyarūpāparādhahetukanigalabandhanatayā'vasthite niścalīkaraṇe viṣayyaṃśamupādāya taṃprati samānādhikaraṇatayā pratītasya steyarūpasya hetorvaiyadhikaraṇyajñānātpuraḥprasphuranvirodho viṣayāṃśavimarśottaraṃ taṃ prati ruciharaṇābhivyajyamānasuṣamātiśayasya bhāvanopanītasya hetutāyāḥ pratisaṃdhānānnivartata ityabhedādhyavasāyo'nuprāṇayitā virodhaścotkarṣayitā || iyaṃ śuddhā || yathāvā spītāṃ hareramuṣṇātsvātantryaśriyamakuṇṭhitaprasarām | mandasmitamamba tavāvindata bata mardanaṃ stanadvaṃdvam || 1146 || atra mardanamityatrābhedādhyavasānanibandhanenātiśayena moṣaṇanimittakamardanarūpatayā'vasthite niṣpīḍanarūpe viṣaye viṣayyaṃśamupādāya taṃprati sāmānādhikaraṇyena prasiddhasya kāraṇasya moṣaṇarūpasya vaiyadhikaraṇyajñānātpuratassphūrtimānvirodho viṣayāṃśavicārādanantaraṃ taṃprati svātantryaśrīmoṣaṇābhivyaktasya kāmapāravaśyasya kāraṇatāyāḥ pratisaṃdhānānnivartata ityatrāpyabhedādhyavasāyavirodhayoranuprāṇakatvotkarṣakatve prāgvadeva | iyamapi śuddhā || yathāvā mugdhā mukhasuṣamā tava mukurasya śriyamacūcuratsakalām | śuddhe śaśāṅkabimbe kalaṅkamambeha bata vidhirvidadhe || 1147 || śuddhe ‘yo'rthe śucirhi sa śuciḥ' ityuktarītyā stainyadoṣavidhuratayā niraparādhe | anyatra śubhre | kalaṅkaṃ cauryāpavādaṃ lakṣma ca ‘kalaṅko'ṅkāpavādayoḥ' ityamaraḥ | atra kalaṅkaṃ vidadhe ityatrābhedādhyavasāyalakṣaṇātiśayena cauryahetukāpavādāroparūpatāmāpanne lāñchanavidhāne viṣayyaṃśamupālambya taṃprati sāmānādhikaraṇyena viditasya hetoścauryarūpasya vaiyadhikaraṇyajñānātpuraḥ pratīyamāno virodho viṣayāṃśavimarśottaraṃ taṃprati mukuraśrīcauryābhivyaktalāvaṇyaviśeṣasya hetutāyāḥ pratisaṃdhānānnivartata ityabhedādhyavasāyānuprāṇitatvaṃ virodhotkarṣitatvaṃ ca pūrvavadeva | śleṣopabṛṃhiteyam || yathāvā kamale vilocanaśrīḥ kamalenaiva vyamoṣi tava vimalā | indorbata pratīpā kārā tejovivarddhanī tvajani || 1148 || tuśabdo bhinnakramaḥ | pratīpā pratikūlā | svatejo'sahiṣṇunā kamalena kṛte'parādhe svasya daṇḍaprāpterasaṃbhāvitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | kārā tu aparādhiyogyo bandhanālayavāsastu indoḥ tejovivardhanī tejasaḥ chedayitrī ajani | bateti khede | pakṣe pratīpā pratilomavarṇā kārā rāketyarthaḥ | tejovivardhanī kalābhivṛddhidāyinī ajanītyarthaḥ | rākāyāṃ tasya pūrṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ | atrāpi kāryakāraṇayoḥ kārāvāsamoṣaṇayorvaiyadhikaraṇyam | anyatsarvaṃ pūrvavat || yathāvā viśadayituṃ jagadakhilaṃ diśidiśi jagadīśa vidiśividiśi tathā | yaśasi tava dhāvamāne śaśipādā hanta bhṛśamakhidyanta || 1149 || atrāpi pādakhedadhāvanayoḥ kāryakāraṇayorviruddhaṃ vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ varṇitam | śaśinaḥ pādāḥ caraṇāḥ akhidyanteti virodhaḥ | parihārastu kiraṇāḥ svakaraṇīyasyākhilajagadvaiśadyasya yaśasaiva kṛtatayā svanaiṣphalyacintanena dainyamalabhanteti | iyamapi śleṣopabṛṃhitā prāgvadeva || yathāvā kucarūpamacalayugalaṃ vicacāla hṛdi vrajenduvadanāyāḥ | cittahrado vilulito dattadṛśastatra nandatanayasya || 1150 || atrāpi kāryakāraṇayorviloḍanācalacalanayorviruddhā bhinnādhiraṇakatā draṣṭavyā | rūpakopaskṛtatvaṃ viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā vārāṇasīmadhākṣīnnārāyaṇacakramatiyugāntārkam | āpedire'rilalanāstāpāṭopaṃ diśastu visphoṭam || 1151 || atra dāhasya kāraṇasya tāpavisphoṭayośca kāryayossāmānādhikaraṇyena hetuhetumadbhāvaśālinostadviparītaṃ bhinnādhikaraṇatvaṃ nibaddham | visphoṭo nāmāgnidāhādijanyo budbudākārastvagvikāraviśeṣaḥ piṭakāparanāmā | ‘visphoṭaḥ piṭakaṃ triṣu' ityamaraḥ | anyatra visphoṭaḥ vidalanaṃ ‘vidalaḥ sphuṭanaṃ bhidā' ityamaraḥ ‘sphuṭir viśaraṇe' iti dhātuḥ | pūrvodāharaṇeṣu kāraṇamekaṃ kāryaṃ caikaṃ, atra tu kāraṇamekaṃ dve kārye te api bhinnādhikaraṇe iti viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā jyāṃ karṣati raghuvīre śarāvalī nyapatadāśarāvalyām | samamūrchadviṣphāraḥ kakubho niṣphālitā vicitramidam || 1152 || samamūrchat amuhyat | ucchrito'bhūditi vastusthitiḥ | 'murchā mohasamucchrāyayoḥ' iti dhātossaṃpūrvakāllaṅ | ‘sammūrchanamabhivyāptau saṃmūrchāmohayorapi' iti viśvaḥ | niṣphālitāḥ viśīrṇāḥ kṛtāḥ ‘phala viśaraṇe' ṇyantādasmātkarmaṇi ktaḥ | yadvā niṣphālo viśaraṇaṃ | niṣpūrvakātphalerghañ | sa āsāṃ saṃjāta iti niṣphālitāḥ | niṣphālavatyaḥ kṛtā iti vā | niṣphālavacchabdāṇṇāviṣṭhavadbhāve ‘vinmatoḥ' iti matupo luk | atra śarāvalīnipatanasya kāraṇasya mūrchāniṣphalanayoḥ kāryayośca vaiyadhikaraṇyam | pūrvodāharaṇavadatrāpi kāraṇamekaṃ kārye dve iti dhyeyam || yathāvā śrutyañcalapariśīlanamāsīnmaurvyā upāsanaṃ tu hareḥ| bāṇānāṃ mokṣastu prāṇānāṃ hanta vairivargasya || 1153 || hareriti āsīditi ca sarvatra saṃbadhyate | hareḥ maurvyāḥ śrutyañcalapariśīlanaṃ vedāntavimarśaḥ karṇāntasparśaśca | āsīt | upāsanaṃ nididhyāsanaṃ, pakṣe prayogaḥ | tattu hareḥ bāṇānāmāsīt | mokṣaḥ saṃsārabandhamuktiḥ śarīratyāgaśca, sa tu vairivargasya prāṇānāṃ āsīt | atra śrutyañcalapariśīlanarūpakāraṇasya upāsanarūpakāryasya ca evaṃ upāsanarūpakāraṇasya mokṣarūpakāryasya ca vaiyadhikaraṇyam| atra kāraṇe dve kārye ca dve | mālārūpatā ekāvalīrūpatā cātra dhvanyata iti viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā karṣaṇamavindata jyā phalaṃ kalambeṣvalaṃ cakāna tava | tadbubhuje ripuvargassauhityaṃ tava babhūva bata bhagavan || 1154 || he bhagavan! tava jyā maurvī | bhūrityapi gamyate | karṣaṇaṃ lāṅgalavilekhanaṃ ākarṣaṇaṃ ca avindata | kalambeṣu bāṇeṣu phalaṃ sasyaṃ dhānyabījaṃ vā | pakṣe āyasamagrimaśalyamityarthaḥ | phalamiṣvagre sasye phalake jātīphale dhane phāle | bhoge bīje lābhe hetūtpanne phalī tu phalinī syāt || iti ratnamālā | cakāna didīpe ‘kana dīptau' liṭ | tat phalaṃ ripuvargaḥ bubhuje abhyavajahre | anyatra tvatprayuktabāṇāgramanubabhūva | tadviddho'bhavaditi yāvat | sauhityaṃ bhojanajanitā tṛptistu | pakṣe śatruhananaprayuktā tuṣṭiḥ tava babhūva | atra karṣaṇaphalayoḥ bhojanatṛptyośca vaiyadhikaraṇyam | iyaṃ śleṣopaskṛtā vakṣyamāṇaikāvalīsaṃkīrṇā mālārūpā ceti draṣṭavyam || asyāṃ ca vibhāvanāyāmiva kāryāṃśe'tiśayoktyanuprāṇanamāvaśyakaṃ, anyathā virodho duṣparihārassyāt ityalaṃkārasarvasvakārādīnāṃ matam | taccodāhṛteṣu padyeṣu vyabhicārādasaṃgatam | na hi 'āpedire'rilalanāstāpāṭopaṃ' ityādāvarilalanātāpāṭopādyavāptyaṃśe atiśayoktirasti, kiṃtu śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasānamātram | tasmāt yenakenāpi prakāreṇa kāryābhedādhyavasānamāvaśyakamiti tu saṃgatam | yadyapi ‘śrutyaścalapariśīlanam' ityādau kāraṇāṃśe'pi śleṣādinā abhedādhyavasānaṃ saṃbhavati | tathā'pi nāsau tadaṃśe niyataḥ | ‘vārāṇasīmadhākṣīt' ityādau dāhādyaṃśe tadabhāvāt | ‘sā bālā vayamapragalbhamanasassā strī vayaṃ kātarāssā pīnonnatimatpayodharabharaṃ dhatte sakhedā vayam' iti prācīnodāharaṇapadye bālātvastrītvādyaṃśe talleśasyāpyasaṃbhavāt || kvacidasaṃgatisamādhānena cārutātiśayo dṛśyata iti kuvalayānandakārāḥ || tatra yathā hārassvorasi nihitaśśrīramayā śaurihṛdayamudalāsīt | tādātmyaudāryamidaṃ modāya na kasya vā bhavedanayoḥ || 1155 || udalāsīt prakāśate sma | hṛṣyati smeti parihāraḥ | anayoḥ śrīśrīśayoḥ tādātmyaudāryaṃ anyonyenāvinābhāvādanyonyena samanvayāt | tādātmyaṃ viddhi saṃbandhaṃ mama nāthasya cobhayoḥ || iti lakṣmītantroktatādātmyamahattvaṃ kasya modāya bhavediti yojanā | atra hāranidhānaṃ lakṣmīvakṣasi, ullāsastu śaurihṛdayasyeti hetukāryayorvaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ nibaddham | tatsamādhānāya bhagavato lakṣmītādātmyaṃ bhagavacchāstrapratipāditamupanyastam | tādātmyaṃ cātra lokaprasiddhamabhedarūpaṃ udāhṛtaśāstrasiddhāvinābhāvarūpaṃ ca śleṣeṇābhinnatayā'dhyavasitamiti dhyeyam | tathācātrāmukhepratītā'pyasaṃgatissamādhānapratipādanenābhāsībhavatīti virodhavadasaṃgatyābhāso'pi vicchittiviśeṣaśālitayā alaṃkāro bhavatīti draṣṭavyam || nanviha kāryakāraṇavaiyadhikaraṇyaprayukto virodhābhāsa iti virodhālaṃkāra evaṃ kiṃ na syāditi cecchrūyatām eṣā hi virodhabodhinī, na tu virodha eva | tathāhi asaṃgatau kāryakāraṇayordvayorbhinnādhikaraṇatvaprayukto virodhapratibhāsaḥ | virodhastu jātyāderjātyādinā saha ekādhikaraṇa eva prathamato virodhapratibhāsaḥ | na caivaṃ sati kimiti virodhalakṣaṇe tathā'nuktamiti śaṅkyam | tatraikādhikaraṇa ityanuktāvapi tathaiva paryavasānāt | tataścāsaṃgatervirodhopajīvyatvena virodhāpavādakatayā apavādabhūtāsaṃgativiṣayaparihāreṇaiva virodhasāmānyaviṣayatayā utsargabhūtasya virodhasya vyavasthitiḥ | tathāca virodhālaṃkāre hyekasminnadhikaraṇe dvayossaṃbandhādvirodhabhānaṃ asaṃgatau tvadhikaraṇadvaya iti tasmādasya vailakṣaṇyamiti prāñcaḥ || navyāstu vyadhikaraṇatvena prasiddhayossamānādhikaraṇatvenopanibandhane virodhālaṃkāraḥ | samānādhikaraṇatvena prasiddhayordvayorvaiyadhikaraṇyenopanibandhane asaṃgatiḥ | prāguktāsaṃgatilakṣaṇe hetukāryayoriti ca samānādhikaraṇamātropalakṣaṇam | tena netraṃ nirañjanaṃ tasyāśśūnyāstu vayamadbhutam | ityatra nirañjanatvaśūnyatvayorutpādyotpādakabhāvalakṣaṇasaṃbandhānantarbhāvena śuddhasamānādhikaraṇatvena prasiddhayorapyasaṃgatissaṃgacchate | yathāśrute tu sā na syāt | tathāca sphuṭa eva virodhālaṃkārādasaṃgaterbheda iti vadanti || dvitīyāsaṃgatiḥ kāryamanyatra yattasya tato'nyatra kriyā'pi sā || ekasminnadhikaraṇe kartavyasya vastunastadbhinnādhikaraṇe karaṇamapyasaṃgatiralaṃkāra ityarthaḥ || yathā grasatā purā hiraṇyaṃ prasabhaṃ nṛhareḥ pratāpahavyabhujā | tatsutabhīrvyadrāvyata tatsudatīnāṃ vyalāpyata ca bṛndam || 1156 || hiraṇyaṃ suvarṇaṃ, nāmaikadeśagrahaṇāddhiraṇyakaśipuṃ ca | vyadrāvyata dravīkṛtā | pakṣe adhāvyata | dravaterṇyantātkarmaṇi yak | ‘drutaṃ śīghravilīnayoḥ' iti hemacandraḥ | vyalāpyata dravīkṛtaṃ | vipūrvakāt ‘lī dravīkaraṇe' iti dhātorṇyantātkarmāṇi yaki laṅ | 'vibhāṣā līyateḥ' ityejviṣaye ātve ‘artihrī' ityādinā pugāgamaḥ | pakṣe paryadevyata | ‘vilāpaḥ paridevanam' ityamaraḥ | vipūrvakāllapaterṇyantātkarmaṇi yaki laṅ | atra hiraṇyarūpe'dhikaraṇe agnikartavyasya vidrāvaṇasya vilāpanasya ca tadbhinne prahlādatrāsarūpe hiraṇyakaśipusudatībṛndarūpe cādhikaraṇe karaṇaṃ varṇitam | śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyottambhiteyam || yathāvā sūte kaṭākṣalakṣmīssā te sādhuṣu samastapuruṣārthān | vyātānastvimariṣṭaṃ viśvavibho taditareṣu suspaṣṭam || 1157 || ariṣṭaṃ sūtikāgṛhaṃ aśubhaṃ ca ‘ariṣṭamaśubhe tāmre laśune sūtikāgṛhe' iti ratnamālā | taditareṣu asādhuṣu | atra kaṭākṣa lakṣmīkartṛkapuruṣārthaprasavādhikaraṇeṣu sādhuṣu kartavyasyāriṣṭakaraṇasyāsādhuṣu karaṇam | śleṣasamāsoktyupabṛṃhiteyam || yathāvā tamasā malīmasā ye bhūyāṃsyāgāṃsi te vitanvanti | sattvavatāṃ damamadhikaṃ sa tvaṃ vidadhāsi tava nayo'nyādṛk || 1158 || caturthapāde saḥ tvaṃ iti cchedaḥ | damaṃ daṇḍaṃ dāntiṃ ca ‘damo daṇḍe cendriyanigrahe' iti ratnamālā | atrāpyaparādhiṣu kartavyasya damasyānaparādhiṣu karaṇaṃ nibaddham | śleṣavyājastutisaṃkīrṇeyam || yathāvā nanu nātha bhavatiniṣṭhāṃ bhagavanniyataṃ cikīrṣuṇā kavinā | kriyate kāmamadādidviṣiniṣṭhāparamapadavidā citram || 1159 || nanu nātha! bhagavan! paramaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yatpadaṃ śabdaśāstraṃ tadvettīti tathoktena | pakṣe paramaṃ padaṃ padanīyaṃ parabrahmasvarūpaṃ tadvidā | anena ‘tasyaivātmā padavit' iti śrutiḥ pratyabhijñāpyate | kavinā viduṣā bhavatiniṣṭhāṃ bhavatiḥ bhūdhātuḥ śtipā nirdeśo'yaṃ, ikśtipau dhātunirdeśe' iti smaraṇāt | tasmāt niṣṭhāṃ ktaṃ ktavatuṃ vā pratyayaṃ "ktaktavatū niṣṭhā" ityanuśāsanāt | anyatra bhavati tvayi niṣṭhāṃ naiṣṭhikatāṃ tvadaikāntyamityarthaḥ | cikīrṣatā satā kāmaṃ paryāptaṃ yathāsyāttathā | adādidviṣiniṣṭheti samastaṃ padam | adādiḥ 'ada bhakṣaṇe' ityukto dhātuḥ ādiḥ yasya tathābhūte ādādike ityarthaḥ | dviṣiḥ ‘dviṣa aprītau' ityukto dhātuḥ | ikā nirdeśo'yaṃ | tasmin niṣṭhā ktaḥ ktavaturvā pratyayaḥ | anyatra kāmamadādidviṣīti samastaṃ padam | kāmo madaśca ādiryasya tasmin dviṣi vairivarge jātyabhiprāyakamekavacanam | niṣṭhā naiṣṭhikatā kriyate iti citram | kāmasya madanasya madaṃ harṣaṃ darpaṃ vā, ādiśabdena kutūhalādirgṛhyate, taṃ dveṣṭīti tathokte paśupatau niṣṭhā kriyata ityapyartha upaskriyate | kāmamadādivairivarge niṣṭhā nāśaḥ kriyata iti parihāraḥ | kāmādivairivargāvadhīraṇamantarā bhagavanniṣṭhā dussādheti bhāvaḥ | 'niṣṭhā niṣpattināśāntāḥ' ityamaraḥ | atrānyatra karaṇīyāyā niṣṭhāyā anyatra kṛtirupavarṇitā |vailakṣaṇyaṃ tu pūrvebhyasspaṣṭamava || yathāvā barhaṃ svīye mūrdhani dāśārha nidhitsureva pūrvaṃ tvam | ripujanamūrdhanibarhaṃ vyadadhāścāturyamadbhutaṃ bhavataḥ || 1160 || he dāśārha bhagayan! svīye mūrdhani śīrṣe barhaṃ piñchaṃ nidhitsuḥ nidhātumicchuḥ ripujanānāṃ mūrdhani barhaṃ piñchaṃ vyadadhā iti virodhaḥ| ripujanamūrdhnāṃ nibarhaṃ nibarhaṇaṃ hiṃsanaṃ vyadadhā iti pariharaḥ | 'barha hiṃsāyām' iti dhātornipūrvakādghañ | 'pramāpaṇaṃ nibarhaṇam' ityamaraḥ | atrānyatra nyasanīyasya barhasyānyatra nyasanaṃ varṇitam | śleṣottambhitavyājastutisaṃkīrṇeyamiti viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā śritajanadhāmani satataṃ dhanamativelaṃ titāṃsatā bhavatā | abhiyātidhāmanidhanaṃ mādhava samatāni satatamativelam || 1161 || śritajanānāṃ dhāmani gṛhe dhanaṃ vittaṃ titāṃsatā tanitumicchatā | tanotessannantācchatā | bhavatā abhiyātīnāṃ ripūṇāṃ dhāmani gṛhe dhanaṃ vittaṃ samatāni vyastārīti virodhaḥ | abhiyātīnāṃ dhāmnāṃ veśmanāṃ tejasāṃ prabhāvānāṃ vā nidhanaṃ nāśa iti parihāraḥ || yathāvā saṃtatamasuravyūhe saṃpadapūrvāṃ sthitiṃ vidhitsustvam | tāmasurāṇāṃ vyūhe tāmarasavilocana vyadhāścitram || 1162 || saṃpadā śriyā apūrvāṃ āścaryāvahāṃ sthitiṃ maryādāṃ | pakṣe samityākārakapadaṃ pūrvaṃ yasyāstāṃ sthitiṃ saṃsthitiṃ nidhanamityarthaḥ | śabdārthayostādātmyavaibhavaṃ na prasmartavyam | anayorapyudāharaṇayoranyatra karaṇīyasyānyatra karaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam || tṛtīyāsaṃgatiḥ kartumanyatpravuttasya tadviruddhakriyā ca sa || anyatkāryaṃ kartuṃ pravṛttasya tadviruddhakāryakaraṇamasaṃgatestṛtīyaḥ prakāraḥ || yathā vinatāmimāṃ vidhitsurjanatāṃ bhuvyuttamāṃ ramānātha | vidadhāsyanuttamāmiti vipulaṃ vitanoti vismayamidaṃ naḥ || 1163 || anuttamāṃ nihīnāṃ pakṣe avidyamānā uttamā yasyāssā iti pañcamībihuvīhiḥ | sarvottamāmityarthaḥ | 'klībe pradhānaṃ pramukha pravekānuttamottamāḥ' ityamaraḥ | yadvā anuttā anirastā mā lakṣmīryasyāstāṃ kenāpi kadā'pyanapanodyasaṃpadamityarthaḥ | nuttetyatra nudeḥ ktaḥ 'nudavida' ityādinā niṣṭhānatvasya vikalpena vidhā nānna ‘radābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ' iti natvaṃ ‘nuttanunnāstaniṣṭhyūtaviddhakṣipteritāssamāḥ' ityamaraḥ | atra vinatajanatāmuttamāṃ cikīrṣatā bhagavatā sā anuttamaiva kṛtetyanyatkartuṃ pravṛttasya tadviruddhakāryakaraṇaṃ nibaddhamiti lakṣaṇasaṃgatiḥ | śleṣadattahasteyam || yathāvā māhākulatāṃ prathayanmāhākulatāṃ dhunoṣi śaure ! tvam | kālindīṃ modayase kālindībhedane'nuṣakto'pi || 1164 || mahākulasyāpatyaṃ pumān māhākulaḥ 'tasyāpatyam' ityarthe 'mahākulādañkhañau' ityañ | ‘māhākulakulīnāryasabhyasajjanasādhavaḥ' ityamaraḥ | tasya bhāvaḥ māhākulatā tāṃ uttamakulaprasūtatāṃ sajjanatāmityarthaḥ | prathayan 'lakṣaṇahetvoḥ' iti śatā | heturiha phalaṃ prathayitumityarthaḥ | māhākulatāṃ kulīnatāṃ dhunoṣīti virodhaḥ māhānāṃ gavāṃ ‘usrā māhā ca śṛṅgiṇī' ityamaraḥ | ākulatā vyagratāṃ dhunoṣīti parihāraḥ | kālindyāḥ yamunāyāḥ bhedane bhidāyāṃ bhiderbhāve lyuṭ, anuṣakto'pi kālindīṃ yamunāṃ modayase iti virodhaḥ | kālindībhedane balabhadre | bhideḥ kartari nandyāditvālyuḥ anuṣakto'pi kālindīṃ tannāmnīṃ divyamahiṣīṃ modayase iti parihāraḥ | atra māhākulatāprakhyāpanakālindībhedanayoḥ pravṛttasya māhākulatādhūnanakālindīmodanalakṣaṇaviruddhakāryakaraṇaṃ śleṣottambhitaṃ nibaddham || yathāvā puṇyajanān saṃtrātuṃ puruṣottama! bhuvi kṛtāvatāro'pi | puṇyajanān dhvaṃsayase purācaritraṃ tavaitadaticitram || 1165 || puṇyajanān dhārmikān saṃtrātuṃ puṇyajanān dhvaṃsayase iti virodhaḥ | yātudhānāniti parihāraḥ | atra 'paritrāṇāya sādhūnām' iti gīto'rtho'nusaṃhitaḥ | atra puṇyajanasaṃtrāṇapravṛttasya taddhvaṃsanarūpaviruddhakāryakaraṇaṃ śleṣato nibaddham || yathāvā dviṣatāṃ viśuśoṣayiṣurjīvanamahirājagirīśikharabhāsvan ! | drutamapsarassu yadimānnidadhāthādbhutamito'pi kiṃ jagati || 1166 || jīvanaṃ prāṇanaṃ salilaṃ ca | apsarassu svarveśyāsu apāṃ sarassu ca | atra dviṣatāṃ jīvanaśoṣaṇe pravṛttasya jalasarassu nidhānarūpaṃ viruddhakāryamupavarṇitam | iyamapi śleṣasaṃkīrṇaiva || yathāvā mādhuryaṃ pracikaṭayiṣurikṣvākukule'khileśvarāvirabhūḥ | prathayan bahumukhakīrtiṃ tāmeva tanīyasīṃ bata vyatanoḥ || 1167 || mādhuryaṃ madhurarasavattvaṃ pracikaṭayiṣussan ikṣvākukule kaṭutumbīnivahe āvirabhūriti virodhaḥ sarvalokapriyatvaṃ prakaṭayitumicchustadanuguṇe ikṣvākumahārājānvavāye āvirāsīriti parihāraḥ | 'svādupriyau tu madhurau' ityamaraḥ | ‘ikṣvākuḥ kaṭutumbyāṃ strī sūryavaṃśyanṛpe pumān' iti medinī | bahumukhakīrtiṃ viśvatomukhaṃ yaśaḥ tāmeva bahumukhakīrtimeveti virodhaḥ | daśānanayaśa eveti parihṛtiḥ || yathāvā rāvaṇanikāraṇānnanu laṅkāmavibhīṣaṇāṃ cikīrṣustvam | savibhīṣaṇāmatānīraho phaṇigirīndra! kosalendratve || 1168 || nikāraṇāt nibarhaṇāt ‘pramāpaṇaṃ nibarhaṇaṃ nikāraṇam' ityamaraḥ || yathāvā viśvāmitrollāsaṃ vidhātumicchanmahāhave pūrvam | viśvāmitranirāsaṃ vyatanoratanuprabhāva dāśarathe! || mahāhave mahatyadhvare saṅgare ca 'āhavau yāgasaṅgarau' iti ratnamālā | viśvasya mitraṃ viśvāmitraḥ kuśikanandanaḥ | ‘mitrecarṣau' iti viśvaśabdasya dīrghaḥ | tasya ullāsaṃ vidhātumicchan viśvāmitranirāsaṃ vyatanoriti virodhaḥ | viśveṣāmamitrāṇāṃ nirasanamiti parihāraḥ || yathāvā bhīṣmadroṇakṣveḍākulaṃ pṛthāsutabalaṃ samādhitsan | kṛṣṇāśugālitodanamatanoratimātramabjanayana! tvam || 1170 || he abjanayana! bhīṣmāḥ bhayānakāḥ ye droṇāḥ vṛścikāḥ teṣāṃ kṣveḍaḥ garalaṃ tena | pakṣe bhīṣmadroṇayoḥ kṣveḍāḥ siṃhanādāḥ tābhiḥ ākulaṃ ‘bhīṣaṇe triṣu bhīṣmassyādrudragāṅgeyayostu nā | droṇaḥ kṛpīpatau kāke bhekavṛścikayostu nā | kṣveḍā vaṃśaśalākāyāṃ siṃhanāde'pica striyām | kṣveḍo nā puṃsi garale' iti ca ratnamālā | pṛthāsutānāṃ balaṃ samādhitsan auṣadhamastrādinā abhayadānādinā ca tatpratīkāraṃ vidhitsan | kṛṣṇāḥ nīlavarṇāḥ āśugāḥ śīghragāminaḥ ye alayo vṛścikaviśeṣāḥ ‘alidroṇau tu vṛścike' ityamaraḥ | pakṣe kṛṣṇasya arjunasya āśugānāṃ bāṇānāṃ āliḥ paṅktiḥ tattodanaṃ tatkaraṇakavyathanaṃ atanoḥ | atra vṛścikakṣveḍākulatāsamādhitsoḥ tadviruddhakṛṣṇavṛścikakaraṇakavyathanamupavarṇitam || yathāvā kaluṣaṃ jagatāṃ hartuṃ jalajekṣaṇa! divyarūpametadadhāḥ | lalanānāṃ vrajajanuṣāṃ kaluṣayasi batāmunaiva hṛdayāni || 1171 || kaluṣaṃ vṛjinam | amunaiva divyarūpeṇaiva kaluṣayasi vṛjinavanti karoṣi | kāmāvilani karoṣīti vastusthitiḥ | ‘kaluṣaṃ klībeṃ'hasyāvile triṣu' iti ratnamālā || yathāvā śakalayituṃ lokānāṃ sakalamariṣṭaṃ tavāvatāro'yam | amunaiva samedhayase rameśa! teṣāmariṣṭamiti citram || 1172 || ariṣṭaṃ aśubhaṃ | śakalayituṃ dhvaṃsayituṃ | amunaiva avatāreṇaiva | teṣāṃ lokānāṃ ariṣṭaṃ śubhaṃ ‘ariṣṭe tu śubhāśubhe' ityamaraḥ | anayorapi padyayoruktadiśaivāsaṃgatissaṃgamayitavyā || idamantimamasaṃgatiprakāradvayaṃ dīkṣītopajñameva anyatra karaṇīyasya tato'nyatra kṛtiśca sā | anyatkartuṃ pravṛttasya tadviruddhakṛtistathā || apārijātāṃ vasudhāṃ cikīrṣan dyāṃ tathā'kṛthāḥ | gotroddhārapravṛtto'pi gotrodbhedaṃ purā'karoḥ || iti taireva lakṣaṇayorlakṣyayośca kuvalayānande saṃdarśitatvāt || atra kecit ‘anyatra karaṇīyasyetyādyasaṃgatiprakāradvayāntarakathanamayuktaṃ, apārijātāmityatra pārijātarāhityacikīrṣayā kāraṇabhūtayā saha pārijātarāhityasya kāryasya viruddhavaiyadhikaraṇyopanindhanāt ‘viruddhaṃ bhinnadeśatvaṃ kāryahetvorasaṃgatiḥ' iti prāthamikāsaṃgatito vailakṣaṇyānupapatteḥ | ālambanākhyaviṣayatāsaṃbandhena cikīrṣāyāssāmānādhikaraṇyena kāryamātraṃ pratihetutvasya prasiddheḥ | evaṃ ‘gotroddhārapravṛtto'pi' ityādyudāharaṇe ‘viruddhātkāryasaṃpattirdṛṣṭā kācidvibhāvanā' ityuktavibhāvanāprakāreṇaiva gatārthatvādasaṃgatibhedāntarakalpanā'nucitā' ityāhuḥ || atra vadanti ‘apārijātām' ityasya na prāthamikāsaṃgatāvantarbhāvaḥ | na hi ‘viṣaṃ jaladharaiḥ pītaṃ mūrchitāḥ pathikāṅganāḥ' ityādāviva kāryakāraṇavaiyadhikaraṇyaprayukto'tra vicchittiviśeṣaḥ, yena prāthamikāsaṃgatāveveyamantarbhāvyeta | kiṃtu anyatra karaṇīyasya samānakartṛkasya kāryasyānyatra karaṇaprayukta eva || evaṃ 'gotroddhārapravṛtto'pi' ityasya viruddhātkāryasaṃpattirūpavibhāvanāyāṃ nāntarbhāvaḥ | na hyatra 'śītāṃśukiraṇāstanvīṃ hanta santāpayanti tām' ityādāviva nivartyanivartakabhāvavirodhaścamatkārī, yenoktavibhāvanāviśeṣe'ntarbhāvaśśakyeta vaktum | apitu anyatkartuṃ pravṛttasya tadviruddhakṛtirūpa iti sahṛdayahṛdayamevātra pramāṇamiti | vistarastvanyatra | tasmādupadarśitamasaṃgatiprakāradvayāntaramavaśyameṣṭavyamityalaṃ bahunā || evaṃ ‘anyatra sthitasyānyatropalambhe'pyasaṃgatirdṛśyate, iti kāvyadarpaṇakāraḥ | tadedamudāharaṇam śrutiśirasi vicinvantaḥ pratikalamapi devadeva! dhīmantaḥ | vyālādhīśelādharamaulāvāścaryamāpnuvanti tvām || 1173 || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre asaṃgatisara ekonatriṃśaḥ <15> atha viṣamālaṃkārasaraḥ anānurūpyabhājoryadghaṭanaṃ viṣamaṃ hi tat || yatrātimātravaidharmyādatyantamananurūpayoḥ dvayoḥ padārthayorghaṭanaṃ saṃbandho varṇyate tatra viṣamālaṃkāraḥ | saṃbandhaśca saṃyogādirutpādyotpādakabhāvaśceti sarvaprakārasādhāraṇametallakṣaṇamiti dhyeyam | ata eva hi 'ananurūpasaṃsargo hi viṣamam' ityalaṃkārasarvasvakāraḥ || yathā kva nu lokanāyakastvaṃ kva jaraddvirado'pi nakrasaṃkrāntaḥ | asya vipattyapanuttyai trasyan dravasi sma tava kṛpā kiyatī || 1174 || atra sarvalokeśvaratvena tiryagjantutvena cānanurūpayorbhagavajjaradgajayorghaṭanaṃ varṇitam | adhikaraṇaśaktipradhānābhyāṃ kvetyavyayābhyāmanucitaghaṭanatvamāviṣkṛtam | atra saṃbandhassaṃyogarūpaḥ || yathāvā jaḍamūrdhanyaḥ kvāhaṃ jagadīśa! tavānubhūtibhāgyaṃ kva | jambukakiśorakaḥ kva nu jambhāripurīvibhūtyanubhavaḥ kva || 1175 || atrājñamūrdhanyatvena duṣprāpatamamahāpuruṣārthatvena cānanurūpayorbhaktabhagavadanubhavayossaṃbandhaḥ | idamāndhrabhāṣāprasiddhalokapravādānukṛtilakṣaṇalokoktyalaṃkārarūpadṛṣṭāntālaṃkārasaṃkīrṇaṃ, pūrvaṃ tu śuddhamiti bhidā || yathāvā kenāpyakampanīyā mahīyasī śrīśa ! tava vibhūtiḥ kva | phūtkṛtimātravineyā laghīyasī paśupateḥ kva ca vibhūtiḥ || 1176 || he śrīśa ! idaṃ saṃbodhanaṃ vivakṣitavibhūtermahīyastvādyabhiprāyagarbham | kenāpi brahmaṇā'pīti bhāvaḥ | akampanīyā, tava ‘mahāvibhūtessaṃpūrṇaṣāḍguṇyavapuṣaḥ prabhoḥ' iti mahāvibhūtitvena prasiddhasyeti bhāvaḥ, mahīyasī vibhūtiḥ aiśvaryaṃ kva, phūtkṛtimātreṇa kevalaphūtkāreṇaiveti lokoktiriyam | alpīyasā yatnenaiveti bhāvaḥ | vineyā uṭṭaṅkanīyā, paśupateḥ idaṃ vivakṣitatadvibhūtilaghīyastvābhiprāyakam, na tu taveva śrīpateriti bhāvaḥ | laghīyasī vibhūtiḥ eśvaryaṃ ca, kva | bhasmeti ca gamyate | tasya phūtkṛtimātroṭṭaṅkanīyatvaprasiddheḥ | na hyanayossādharmyaṃ kalayā'pi ghaṭeteti bhāvaḥ | atra śrīpatipaśupativibhūtyoranānurūpyabhājorghaṭanam | vyatirekaparikarāṅkuropaskṛtamidam || yathāvā natapātana evānyo natapāvana eva nātha! sa bhavāṃstu | nārāyaṇagirināyaka! dūrādindhe tato hi tavabhedaḥ || 1177 || anyaḥ tvaditaro devaḥ natapātana eva svāśritān saṃsāre pātayatyevetyarthaḥ | ‘ābrahmastambaparyantāḥ' ityādinā ‘te hi saṃsāragocarāḥ' ityuktarītyā svayameva saṃsārasāgare nimagnassvāvalambino janān kathamunmajjayediti bhāvaḥ | saḥ ‘teṣāmahaṃ samuddhartā mṛtyusaṃsārasāgarāt' ityuktaprakāreṇa prasiddhaḥ bhavāṃstu natapāvana eva | ‘pāvanassarvabhūtānāṃ tvameva raghunandana' ityādyuktarītyā sarvāghavidhvaṃsanapūrvakamuccairgatipradāteti bhāvaḥ | ata eva nārāyaṇagirināyaka śeṣādrīśvara he nātha! tataḥ natapātanādanyasmāddevāt, tava natapāvanasya tava bhedaḥ bhidā dūrāt indhe atiśayitatayā prakāśate | pakṣe natapātanaḥ natapāvana ityābhyāṃ tau śabdāveva gṛhyete | tata iti ṣaṣṭhyāssārvavibhaktikastasiḥ | tayoḥ natapātananatapāvanaśabdayorityarthaḥ | tavabhedaḥ ta va iti varṇābhyāṃ vailakṣaṇyaṃ dūrādindhe | atrāpi devatāntaraśrīnivāsayorananurūpayorghaṭanam || yathāvā aśanāyātīto'nagha! nissaṅgaḥ kvācyutasvarūpastvam | ādyūno'tyāsaṅgaḥ kvādityassvasvarūpavibhraṣṭaḥ || 1178 || he anagha bhagavan! aśanāyātītaḥ aśanāyopalakṣitormiṣaṭkapratibhaṭaḥ 'aśanāyāpipāse śokaṃ mohaṃ jarāṃ mṛtyumatyeti' iti śruteḥ | nissaṅgaḥ karmasaṃbandhagandhaśūnyaḥ | karmaphalānanuṣakto vā ‘niravadyaṃ nirañjanam' iti śruteḥ ‘na māṃ karmāṇi limpanti na me karmaphale spṛhā' iti gānāśca | acyutaṃ apracyutaṃ svarūpaṃ svabhāvo yasya sa tathoktaḥ | rāmakṛṣṇādyavatāradaśāsvapyajahatsvasvabhāva ityarthaḥ | ajo'pi sannavyayātmā bhūtānāmīśvaro'pi san | prakṛtiṃ svāmadhiṣṭhāya saṃbhavāmyātmamāyayā || iti gānāt | prādurbhāvāstu seneśa madaṃśatvādviśeṣataḥ | ajahatsvasvabhāvā hi divyāprākṛtavigrahāḥ | dīpāddīpā ivotpannā jagato rakṣaṇāya te || iti viṣvaksenasaṃhitāvacanamapyatraivānukūlam | īdṛśaḥ tvaṃ kva | ādyūnaḥ audarikaḥ 'ādyūnassyādaudarikaḥ' ityamaraḥ | udarabharaṇaikaniratatvātsarvāśīti bhāvaḥ | atyāsaṅgaḥ atimātrakarmasaṃbaddhaḥ karmaphalaspṛhāvānvā | ata eva svasvarūpavibhraṣṭaḥ tirohitajñānānandādisvabhāva iti yāvat | ādityaḥ kva yuvayorauemyaṃ davīya iti bhāvaḥ | vastutastu ādityaḥ ādityaśabdaḥ ādyūnaḥ ādi iti varṇābhyāṃ viśliṣṭaḥ atyāsaṅgaḥ avidyamānaḥ tya ityākārakavarṇasamudayasabandho yasya sa tathoktassan svasvarūpavibhraṣṭaḥ ādityetisarvavarṇāpāye niśśeṣitasvaprakṛtiriti yāvat | śabdārthayostādātmyaṃ na vismartavyam | atrāpi bhagavadādityayoranānurūpyabhājorghaṭanaṃ śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyanirvyūḍham || yathāvā ādau dugdhaṃ madhye bhiduramathendustu dūṣitaḥ paścāt | kvanu tāni jagadadhīśvara! kadā'pyadūṣitamaho yaśaḥ kva tava || 1179 || he jagadadhīśvara! dugdhaṃ kṣīraṃ ādau prathamameva dūṣitamiti liṅgavipariṇāmena yojyam | aviśadamiti janaiḥ pratyākhyātamityarthaḥ | bhiduraṃ kuliśaṃ madhye madhyakāle dūṣitam | atha kiṃca industu paścāt ante dūṣitaḥ | tāni dugdhādīni ‘napuṃsakamanapuṃsakenaikavaccāsyānyatarasyām' iti napuṃsakaikaśeṣaḥ, kva | kadā'pi ādimadhyāvasānasamayeṣu jātvapi adūṣitaṃ tava yaśaḥ kva | teṣāmasya ca sādharmyaṃ na kadā'pi ghaṭeteti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe dugdhabhidurenduśabdāḥ ādimadhyāvasāneṣu krameṇa duvarṇaghaṭitā ityarthaḥ | duḥ uṣito yasmin sa iti vigrahaḥ, āhitāgnyāderākṛtigaṇatvānniṣṭhāyāḥ paranipātaḥ | yaśastu yaśaśśabdastu kadā'pyadūṣitameva duvarṇasaṃbandhasyaiva tatrābhāvāt | atra dugdhādīnāṃ bhagavadyaśasaścānanurūpāṇāṃ ghaṭanam | pūrvodāharaṇeṣu vastusadghaṭanam | tatrāpyādyodāharaṇadvayaṃ śuddhaṃ, anyāni śleṣādisaṃkīrṇāni | atra tu dugdhādīnāṃ yaśasaśca tarkitaṃ ghaṭanaṃ, ‘tvaṃ kva tasyā mukhaṃ kva' itivat | śleṣavyatirekasaṃkīrṇatvaṃ ca viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā dyūtasthitimānādau madhyama evāntato'ṇimahitaśca | kva dyumaṇiḥ kvādhūrto'cyutāśrito'tyuttamo mahāmahimā || 1180 || ādau pūrvavayasi dyūtasthitimān dyūtanirataḥ | ata eva madhyama eva uttamatvenāparigaṇita eva san antataḥ caramavayasyapi aṇimahitaḥ aṇimā hito yasya sa tathoktaḥ kevalalāghavaprasaktaḥ| dyumaṇiḥ bhānuḥ kva | pakṣe ādau dyunā dyu iti varṇasamudayena ūtā syūtā yā sthitiḥ tadvān | madhyaḥ maḥ mavarṇo yasya sa tathoktaḥ | antataḥ ante ṇinā ṇivarṇena mahitaḥ dyumaṇiḥ dyumaṇiśabdaḥ | ādimadhyāvasāneṣūktavarṇaghaṭita ityarthaḥ | adhūrtaḥ anakṣadevī atyuttamaḥ mahān mahimā mahattvaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | acyutāśritaḥ bhāgavataḥ kva | anayormahadantaramityarthaḥ | atra bhānubhāgavatayorananurūpayorghaṭanam | śleṣavyatirekasaṃkīrṇatā ghaṭanasya tarkitatā ca tulyā || bhagavati hariṇi hiraṇmayi bhavatī kva purassuvarṇavadbhānā | itarā ca surī kva nu vā paścārdhe rītivarṇamāptavatī || 1181 || hiraṇyasya vikāro hiraṇmayī tasyāssaṃbuddhiḥ | he hariṇi suvarṇapratime ! pracurahiraṇye haritavarṇe iti vastusthitiḥ | ‘varṇādanudāttāttopadhātto naḥ' iti ṅīp | tatsaṃniyogena naḥ | tato ṇatvaṃ ca ‘hariṇī syānmṛgī hemapratimā haritā ca yā' ityamaraḥ | hariṇīrūpadhāriṇīti vā | ‘śrīrdhṛtvā hariṇīrūpamaraṇye vicacāra ha' iti purāṇāditi vidyāraṇyabhāṣyam | atra ‘hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇam, candrāṃ hiraṇmayīm' iti śrutissmartavyā | he bhagavati! bhavatī īdṛśī tvaṃ kva | puraḥ pūrvakāya eva na tu sarvasminvigrahe suvarṇavadbhānā suvarṇavat hematulyaṃ na tu hematvenaiva bhānaṃ prakāśo yasyāssā tathoktā, paścārdhe aparabhāge pṛṣṭhabhāge ityarthaḥ | ‘aparasyārdhe paścabhāvo vaktavyaḥ' ityaparaśabdasya paścabhāvaḥ | rītivarṇaṃ rītiḥ pittalāparaparyāyamārakūṭaṃ 'rītisstriyāmārakūṭam' ityamaraḥ | tasyāḥ varṇaṃ āptavatī | na tu pittalamayī vā | itarā anyā surī devastrī sarasvatī pārvatī śacyādiśca kva vā | tava tasyāśca rūpalāvaṇyavaibhavādau mahadantaramiti bhāvaḥ | vastutastu surī surīśabdaḥ puraḥ ādau suvarṇamasyāstīti suvarṇavat bhānaṃ prakāśo yasyāssā prathamaṃ su ityākārakākṣaraghaṭiteti yāvat | paścārdhe aparasminnardhe | surīśabdasya varṇadvayātmakatvātprathamasya varṇasya pūrvārdhatvaṃ dvitīyasyottarārdhatvamiti dhyeyam| rītivarṇaṃ rī ityākārakamakṣaraṃ āptavatī prāptetyarthaḥ | atra bhagavatyāśśriyaḥ anyadevalalanāyāścānanurūpayorghaṭanaṃ | anyatsarvaṃ pūrvavat || yathāvā eko'pi na mama suguṇo nātha pratyuta guṇatritayabaddhaḥ | īśīya vaśayituṃ kathamanantaguṇavaśitasakalalokaṃ tvām || 1182 || he nātha ! mama eko'pi suguṇaḥ bandhanapūrvakavaśīkaraṇasādhanabhūtā draḍhīyasī rajjuḥ | ‘rajjustriṣu vaṭīguṇe' ityamaraḥ | na nāsti | satyārjavadayādirātmaguṇo nāstīti vastusthitiḥ | naitāvadeva pratyuta uktavaiparītyena ‘pratyutetyuktavaiparītye' iti gaṇavyākhyāne | ahameva guṇatritayena rajjutrayeṇa sattvarajastamorūpeṇa ca prākṛtaguṇatrayeṇa baddhaḥ asmīti śeṣaḥ | anantaiḥ asaṃkhyākaiḥ guṇaiḥ rajjubhiḥ sauśīlyādibhiḥ kalyāṇaguṇaiśca vaśitalokaṃ svāyattīkṛtākhilabhuvanaṃ tvāṃ vaśayituṃ kathamīśīya | atra kavibhagavatorananurūpayorghaṭanaṃ kvaśabdābhyāṃ vinaiva darśitamiti viśeṣaḥ | anyatsarvaṃ prāgvadeva || yathāvā suhṛdacyuta durhṛdvā paramapadajñairudañcyate tulyam | teṣu kathaṃ dvāvapi tau nipātayan gaṇyatāṃ padajñamuniḥ || 1183 || he acyuta! padyate prāpyata iti padaṃ, paramaṃ ca tatpadaṃ ca paramapadaṃ parabrahmasvarūpaṃ, so'dhvanaḥ pāramāpnoti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam | iti, samastaheyarahitaṃ viṣṇvākhyaṃ paramaṃ padam | ityādipramāṇāt | tat jānantīti tathoktāḥ | taiḥ parabrahmavedibhiḥ | pakṣe paramāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ padajñāḥ vaiyākaraṇāḥ taiḥ | suhṛt durhṛdvā anukūlaḥ pratikūlo vā udañcyate saṃsārasāgarāduddhriyate | 'tulyo mitrāripakṣayoḥ' ityuktalakṣaṇānāṃ teṣāṃ mitrāmitravibhāgavaiṣamyagandho'pi na saṃbhavatīti bhāvaḥ | teṣu evaṃprakāreṣu paramapadajñeṣu tau suhṛddurhṛdau dvāvapi nipātayan bhavābdhau nimajjayan| pakṣe suhṛddurhṛcchabdau nipātayan ‘suhṛddurhṛdau mitrāmitrayoḥ' iti sūtreṇa nipātayan | nipātanaṃ nāma lakṣaṇābhāve śabdasādhutvāya svarūpeṇoccāraṇam | padajñaḥ kevalaṃ tattatprākṛtavastuvedī muniḥ| pakṣe kevalapadajñaḥ na tu paramapadajñaḥ śabdaśāstradarśīmuniḥ pāṇinirityarthaḥ | kva parabrahmavettāraḥ kva cāyaṃ kevalaśābdiko muniriti bhāvaḥ | atra brahmavidāṃ pāṇineścānanurūpāṇāṃ ghaṭanaṃ kvaśabdamantareṇaiva darśitaṃ pūrvavadeva | tulyayogitādisaṃkīrṇatvaṃ viśeṣaḥ | atra kenāpītyādyudāharaṇeṣu yathāsaṃbhavaṃ gamyamānaṃ ghaṭanāviśeṣamādāya lakṣaṇānugatirbodhyā || dvitīyaviṣamam vilakṣaṇasya kāryasyotpattiṃ ca viṣamaṃ viduḥ || kāraṇarūpavijātīyarūpaśālikāryotpattirapi viṣamamityarthaḥ || yathā dalitendīvarasundaralalitatamā tāvakāvayavasuṣamā | medhāṃ mayi prasūte vaidhātravadhūsudhāṃśuruciviśadām || 1184 || atra 'kāraṇaguṇā hi kāryaguṇānārabhante' iti nyāyaviruddhā śyāmādviśadotpattirvarṇitā | atrotpattilakṣaṇasaṃsargasyānanurūpatā | abhedādhyavasānalakṣaṇenātiśayena samavāyikāraṇarūpatayā sthite nimittakāraṇe samavetakāryarūpatayā sthite nimittakārye vā viṣayyaṃśamādāya sphurito virodho viṣayāṃśavimarśottaraṃ vinivartata itīhāpyabhedādhyavasānasyānuprāṇayitṛtvaṃ taduttambhitavirodhābhāsasya ca paripoṣakatvam | ayameva cāṃśo'tra kavipratibhonmeṣitatvādalaṃkāratābījam | tena ‘gomayādvṛścikā jāyante' ityādau kāryakāraṇayorvairūpyasaṃbhave'pi nālaṃkāratvaṃ, tasya vāstavatvena kavipratibhānirvartitatvābhāvādityalaṃkāradarśananiṣṇātānāṃ panthāḥ | kāryakāraṇayornivartyanivartakabhāve pañcamī vibhāvanā | vilakṣaṇaguṇaśālitve tvayaṃ viṣamaprabheda iti kuvalayānande sthitam || yathāvā śaśiviśadātkṣīrodātkaṭhinatarādvā madamba dharaṇitalāt | kathamāvirabhūdbhavatī kanakapiśaṅgīśirīṣamṛdulāṅgī || 1185 || atra viśadatarātkaṭhinatarācca kāraṇātpiśaṅgakomalarūpavijātīyakāryotpattiḥ | idaṃ vakṣyamāṇayathāsaṅkhyasaṃkīrṇam || yathāvā jātā jagadīśvara te caraṇājjalajāruṇājjharī hariṇā | svakṣīrapūrapātṝn sūte kṛṣṇākṛtīniyaṃ citram || 1186 || hariṇā pāṇḍuravarṇā ‘hariṇaḥ pāṇḍuraḥ' ityamaraḥ | jharī gaṅgā | kṣīraṃ jalaṃ dugdhaṃ ca | kṛṣṇākṛtīn śyāmalākārān prāptabhagavatsārūpyāniti tu vastusthitiḥ | atrāpi kāraṇaguṇaprakramaviruddhādaruṇāddhavalotpattiḥ dhavalācchyāmalotpattiśca varṇitā | idaṃ mālārūpavakṣyamāṇaikāvalīpariṣkṛtaṃ śleṣottambhitaṃ cetiviśeṣaḥ || kecittu kāraṇakriyāto viruddhakriyasya kāryasyotpattāvapi viṣamaprabhedaṃ manvānāḥ guṇakriyābhyāṃ kāryasya kāraṇasya guṇakriye | krameṇa ca viruddhe yatsa eṣa viṣamo mataḥ || iti lakṣayitvā tvāmāmodayase lokāṃstvattejastāpayatyarīn | iti dvitīyaprabhedamudāhārṣuḥ | tanmate idamudāharaṇam, yathā amṛtaṃ prasaviturabdheramṛtāṃśumapi tvamamba janitā'si | paramādbhutametannaḥ prāsūthāḥ kardamaṃ kathaṃ tvamiti || 1187 || he amba! amṛtaṃ amṛtāṃśumapi prasūtavato'bdheḥ tvaṃ janitā asi | tvaṃ īdṛśīti bhāvaḥ | kardamaṃ paṅkaṃ kathaṃ prāsūthā iti virodhaḥ, kardamākhyaṃ putramiti parihāraḥ | ‘kardamena prajā bhūtāḥ' iti śruteḥ | atrāmṛtāmṛtāṃśujananakriyāvato jaladheḥ kāraṇāt kardamajananakriyāśālilakṣmīirūpakāryotpattirvarṇitā | śleṣopaskṛtamidam || yathāvā narakanirākaraṇacaṇapraguṇaśrīramaṇacaraṇajā dharaṇiḥ | narakaṃ vakraṃ ca sutaṃ prāsoṣṭa na kasya vismayāyedam || 1188 || narakasya nirayasya nirākaraṇena vittau nirākaraṇacaṇau 'tena vittaścuñcupcaṇapau' iti caṇappratyayaḥ | praguṇau avakrau prakṛṣṭamārdavādiguṇaśālinau ca 'ṛjāvarjihapraguṇau' ityamaraḥ | yau śrīramaṇacaraṇau tābhyāṃ jātā ‘padbhyāṃ bhūmiḥ' iti śruteḥ | dharaṇiḥ narakaṃ nirayaṃ vakraṃ kuṭilaṃ ca sutaṃ prāsoṣṭeti virodhaḥ | narakākhyaṃ dānavaṃ aṅgārakaṃ ca prāsoṣṭeti vastusthitiḥ | ‘narakaḥ puṃsi nirayadevārātiprabhedayoḥ, vakro bhaume'nṛjau triṣu' iti medinīratnamāle | atra narakanirākaraṇakriyāvataḥ ārjavaguṇaśālinaśca bhagavaccaraṇātkāraṇājjatāyā dharaṇyā narakarūpasutajananakriyāvaiśiṣṭyaṃ vakratvarūpaguṇaviśiṣṭasutaprasūtiśca varṇite iti pūrvasmādvicchittiviśeṣaḥ || samādhānagarbhamapīdaṃ viṣamaṃ dṛśyata iti viśveśvarādayaḥ | tatrodāharaṇaṃ yathā svāhārasamaṃ sūte sutaṃ prasūriti vaco hare na mṛṣā | śiśirā'pi tvaddṛṣṭiryadasaudbhavatāpakabalanāttapanam || 1189 || he hare! prasūḥ mātā svāhārasamaṃ svābhyavahṛtavastvanurūpaguṇaṃ sutaṃ sūte iti vacaḥ na mṛṣā satyameva | yat yasmāt kāraṇāt tvaddṛṣṭiḥ dṛk svayaṃ śiśirā'pi bhavasya saṃsṛtisaṃmbandhināṃ tāpānāṃ saṃtāpānāṃ ādhyātmikādīnāmiti tu tattvaṃ, kabalanāt grasanāt apanayanāditi tu tattvam | tapanaṃ tāpaśālinaṃ āhārānurūpamiti bhāvaḥ | asaut prāsūta ‘ṣu prasavaiśvaryayoḥ' iti dhātorlaṅ | yadyapi ‘prasavo'bhyanujñānam' ityuktaṃ, tathā'pi ‘mātaḥ kadru yadi prasauti bhavatī bhūyassutānīdṛśān' iti murāryādiprayogadarśanāt garbhavimocanārthakatā'pyasya prasidhyatītyavirodhaḥ || yathāvā tava nayanaṃ nanu bhāsvānudārabṛndārakaṃ sutaṃ sūtām | kathameṣa kapimasāvīdā viditaṃ kapiriti śruto hyeṣaḥ || 1190 || nanu bhagavan ! tava nayanaṃ netrabhūtaḥ bhāsvān bhānuḥ | anena tejasvitvamuktam | udāraścāsau bṛndārakaśca mahārūpavantaṃ uttamaṃ devaṃ vā | pakṣe vadānyamukhyaṃ karṇamityarthaḥ 'udāro dātṛmahatoḥ, bṛndārakau rūpimukhyau' iti cāmaraḥ | sutaṃ sūtāṃ janayatu | mahātejasvino bhānostādṛśasutaprasūtiranurūpaiveti bhāvaḥ | eṣaḥ īdṛśa eva bhāsvān kapiṃ tiryañcaṃ jātivṛttarūpādibhiratinihīnamiti bhāvaḥ | sugrīvamiti vastusthitiḥ | kathaṃ asāvīt prāsūta | sauterluṅ | atimātravisadṛśaprasūtirviruddheti praśnaḥ | samādhatte ā iti | ā iti smaraṇārthakamavyayaṃ, 'ā pragṛhyaḥ smṛtau' ityamaraḥ | viditaṃ idānīṃ smṛtamityarthaḥ | hi yasmāt eṣaḥ bhāsvāneva kapiriti śrutaḥ śrutipratipāditaḥ | tasmātkapimasāvīditi kāryakāraṇasārūpyaparicintanena samādhānaṃ ‘kapirbabhasti tejanam, iti śrutirbhānuṃ kapiśabdavācyaṃ brūte | kaṃ jalaṃ pibatīti kapiritivyutpatteḥ | ata eva ‘kapyāsam' iti padavivaraṇāvasare 'kapistvādityaḥ kaṃ pibati kiraṇaiḥ' iti varadaguravaḥ | ‘kapayo'rkebhavānarāḥ' iti ratnamālā | atrobhayatrāpi samādhānagarbhaṃ viṣamam | prathame guṇavirodhasya prayojakāntarādhīnaṃ samādhānaṃ, dvitīye kriyāvirodhasya kāraṇe kāryadharmakalpamādhīnaṃ samādhānamiti viśeṣaḥ || tṛtīyaviṣamam iṣṭārthodyogato'niṣṭāvāptiśca viṣamaṃ matam || aniṣṭāvāptirityatra na iṣṭāvāptiritīṣṭāvāptiśabdena nañsamāsaḥ | iṣṭānavāptirityarthaḥ | anyaśca na iṣṭamaniṣṭamitīṣṭaśabdena nañsamāsaḥ | aniṣṭasyānarthasyāvāptirityarthaḥ | uktamarthadvayamapyāvṛttilabhyam | tataścābhīṣṭārthamuddiśya kiṃcitkāryamārabdhavata iṣṭānavāptyaniṣṭāvāptī milite eko bhedaḥ, kevaleṣṭānavāptiḥ kevalāniṣṭāvāptiśceti pratyekaṃ bhedadvayamiti trayo bhedāssaṃgṛhītā bhavanti | iṣṭārthaśca svasya kiṃcitsukhasādhanārthāvāptiḥ duḥkhasādhanānarthanivṛttiśca, parasya duḥkhasādhanānarthaprāpaṇaṃ sukhasādhanārthanivṛttiśceti caturvidhaḥ | tena iṣṭānavāptighaṭite bhedadvitaye'pi cāturvidhyam | aniṣṭaśca svasya duḥkhasādhanānarthaprāptiḥ, parasya sukhasādhanārthaprāptiḥ, duḥkhasādhanānarthanāśaśceti trividhaḥ| svasyeṣṭāprāptistu gaṇiteti nāniṣṭe gaṇyate | tenāniṣṭāvāptighaṭite bhedadvitaye'pi traividhyam || udāharaṇāni tatra svasukhasādhanārthāvāptirūpeṣṭārthodyogādiṣṭānavāptau duḥkhasādhanarūpāniṣṭapratilambhe ca yathā rāmaṃ salakṣmaṇaṃ prākprāptā rakṣassvasā vṛṣasyantī | tanmadhye vyagrā'bhūdvigrā navyaṃ mukhe vikāramitā || 1191 || rakṣassvasā śūrpaṇakhā vṛṣasyaṃtī kāmukī satī ‘aśvakṣīravṛṣalavaṇānāmātmaprītau kyaci' aśvavṛṣayormaithunecchāyām' iti vṛṣaśabdātkyacyasuk | ‘vṛṣasyantī tu kāmukī' ityamaraḥ | salakṣmaṇaṃ rāmaṃ prāptā | tayoḥ rāmalakṣmaṇayormadhye vyagrā tatparihāsavacanairākulā | tatassāhasapravṛttyā vigrā vigatā nāsikā yasyāsseti bahuvrīhau 'vergro vaktavyaḥ' iti viśabdottarasya nāsikāśabdasya grādeśaḥ | ‘vigro vigatanāsikaḥ' ityamaraḥ | lakṣmaṇena cchinnanāsiketi bhāvaḥ | ata eva mukhe vadane navyaṃ apūrvaṃ vikāraṃ vikṛtiṃ itā prāptā abhūt | iṇaḥ kartari ktaḥ | atra vyagretiśabdaḥ mukhe ādau navyaṃ navidyamāno vya iti varṇasamudayo yasmin karmaṇi tadyathāsyāttathā | naśabdena samāsaḥ | vikāraṃ tatraiva vi ityākārakaṃ varṇaṃ itā satī vigrā'bhūditi yojanā | vigreti niṣpannetyarthaścamatkārī | atra salakṣmaṇaṃ rāmamupabhogasukhasādhanarūpasveṣṭasiddhyarthamupasarpantyāśśūrpaṇakhāyā na kevalaṃ tadalābhaḥ apitu nāsikācchedarūpaduḥkhasādhanānarthāvāptiśca nibaddheti lakṣaṇaṃsagatiḥ | atreṣṭasādhanatayā niścitātkāraṇādaniṣṭakāryāvāptyā utpattilakṣaṇasaṃsargasyānānurūpyam | evamuttaratrāpi || yathāvā tvadvajrakaṇṭhikāśriyamīpsussaudāmanī mukhe'bhihatā | bhūtvā'sau ramaṇīmaṇi kamale paśukaṇṭhabandhayogyā''sīt || 1192 || he ramaṇīmaṇi kamale! asau tejasvitayā pratyakṣadṛśyā saudāmanī vidyut sudāmnā adriṇā ekadigiti vigrahe ‘tenaikadik' iti prāgdīvyatīye aṇi ‘an' iti nakārasya prakṛtibhāve ‘ṭiḍḍhāṇ' iti ṅīp | tvadvajrakaṇṭhikāyāḥ śriyaṃ tadvaddedīpyamānatayā'jasraṃ tvatkaṇṭhāvasthānasaubhāgyamiti bhāvaḥ | īpsuḥ āptumicchussatī ata eva mukhe vadane abhihatā prahṛtā bhūtveti lokoktiḥ | svasvarūpadurlabhotkarṣalipsutayā tayā tvadvajrakaṇṭhikayā mukhoparikṛtaprahāreti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe saudāmanīśabdavyaktiḥ mukhe prathamabhāge abhihatā | asauramaṇītyatra asauḥ ramaṇīticchedaḥ | ‘ro ri' iti rephalopaḥ | ata eva asauḥ avidyamānaḥ sau ityākārakavarṇo yasyāssā tathoktā bhūtvā | saukārāpanayane dāmanīti niṣpanneti bhāvaḥ | nauritivadayaṃ śabdaḥ | paśukaṇṭhabandhanayogyā''sīt ‘paśurajjustu dāmanī' ityamaraḥ| dāmaiva dāmanī | svārthike aṇi prakṛtibhāvaṅīpau prāgvat | atra saudāmanyāḥ lakṣmīkaṇṭhābharaṇaśrīlābharūpeṣṭasādhanārthamudyuñjānāyā na tadalābhamātraṃ kiṃtvatinihīnapaśukaṇṭhabandhanārharajjutāvāptilakṣaṇotkaṭāniṣṭalābho varṇitaḥ || yathāvā iṣṭārthalābhalobhādupasarpantyā vrajenduvadanāyāḥ | sadyastanalābhepsurnīvīmapi śaurirakṛta bata śithilām || 1193 || śauriḥ iṣṭaḥ arthasya dhanasya lābhaḥ adhikaphalaṃ 'lābho'dhikaṃ phalam' ityamaraḥ | tasmin lobhāt | pakṣe abhīpsitopabhogarūpaprayojanalābhalobhādityarthaḥ | upasarpantyāḥ samīpamāyāntyāḥ vrajenduvadanāyāḥ nīvīmapi paripaṇamapi; pakṣe kaṭivasanabandhamapi ‘strīkaṭīvastrabandhe'pi nīvī paripaṇe'pica' ityamaraḥ | paripaṇaṃ mūladhanaṃ 'nīvī paripaṇaṃ mūladhanam' ityanuśāsanāt | śithilāṃ naśvarīṃ | pakṣe visrastāṃ | akṛta | bateti khede | tatra hetuḥ sadyastanalābhepsuriti | tādātvikasvalābhepsurevāyaṃ na tvanyayogakṣemacintaka iti bhāvaḥ | tatkṣaṇavakṣojaparirambhecchuriti vāstavārthaḥ | atrādhikadhanalābhārthinyā vrajavilāsinyā mā bhūttadavāptiḥ kiṃtu svalābhamātrepsunā śauriṇā tanmūladhanamapi śithilitamityaniṣṭapratilambhaśca varṇitaḥ | upapāditārthadvayaśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyajīvātuko'yaṃ viṣamopanyāsa iti dhyeyam || yathāvā ahamapi vidhuriti madhuripusadharmatāyai nibaddhavispardhaḥ | vidhuto'munā'ntato'bhūt glauralasattāmavāpya gaureva || 1194 || pūrvārdhaṃ spaṣṭārtham | glauḥ mṛgāṅkaḥ amunā madhuripuṇā vidhutaḥ tiraskṛtaḥ ata eva alasattāṃ lasato bhāvaḥ lasattā na lasattā alasattā tāṃ aprakāśamānatāṃ | yadvā alasaḥ mandaḥ sa ivācaratītyalasan tasya bhāvaḥ alasattā tāṃ ālasyamityarthaḥ | avāpya mando bhūtvetyarthaḥ | antataḥ paryavasāne gauḥ paśureva abhūt | na tu bhagavatsadharmeti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe glauśabdaḥ antataḥ madhye 'anto'strī niścaye nāśe svarūpe'gre'ntike'ntare' iti ratnamālā | gakāraukārayorantarāle iti bhāvaḥ | vidhutaḥ utsāritavarṇa iti yāvat | ata eva alasattāṃ lasya lavarṇasya sattā sthitiḥ na lasattā alasattā lavarṇasthityabhāvaṃ prāpya gaureva gauriti śabda evābhūt | uktarītyā lakārotsāraṇe tathā niṣpatteriti bhāvaḥ | atrāpīṣṭānavāptyaniṣṭaprāptī pūrvavat || yathāvā latikāstvattanutulanākutukādabhyetya janani tadvidhutāḥ | mukhavarṇaviparyāsāttilakā bhūtvā vanāntabhuvamagaman || 1195 || he janani! alpāḥ latāḥ latikāḥ, alpārthe vihitena kanā latānāmatisaukumāryaṃ vyañjitam | tvattanulatātulanākutukāt abhyetya abhimukhamāgatya tadvidhutāḥ tvattanvā nyakkṛtāḥ ata eva mukhavarṇasya vadanaśobhāyāḥ viparyāsāt parābhavalakṣaṇavaivarṇyādityarthaḥ | pakṣe mukhavarṇayoḥ ādimākṣarayoḥ la ti ityetayoḥ vaiparītyāt prātilomyāt tilakāḥ vṛkṣaviśeṣāḥ bhūtvā ‘tilakaḥ kṣurakaḥ' ityamaraḥ | anena latāvasthāvasthitasaukumāryasyāpi hānirdyotyate | pakṣe uktarītyā latikāśabdastilakā iti niṣpanna ityabhiprāyaḥ | vanāntabhuvaṃ agaman kasyāpi vadanaṃ darśayitumanīśānāḥ kvāpi gahanāntare nyalīyanteti bhāvaḥ | sarvaṃ pūrvavat || yathāvā harinandakadhutatejāssvarurvidhūnvan śirassvamatha roṣāt | abhavatsaṃmukha etya sthito'pi punarapyadhaḥ kṛtastena || 1196 || svaruḥ dambholiḥ harinandakajigīṣuriti bhāvaḥ | hareḥ bhagavataḥ nandakena tannāmnā khaḍgena dhutatejāḥ ata eva svaṃ śiro vidhūnvanniti krodhānubhāvoktiḥ | atha tatkṣaṇameva roṣāt saṃmukhe agrabhāge etya sthito'pi dvaṃdvayuddhārthamiti bhāvaḥ | tena nandakena punarapi adhaḥkṛtaḥ nyakkṛtaḥ abhavat | sarvathā'pi nājauṣīt kiṃtu parābhūta pavāsīditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe svaruḥ svaruśabdaḥ śiraḥ agrabhāgāvasthitamiti yāvat | svaṃ svetyākārakaṃ varṇasamudayaṃ vidhūnvan | tyajan san abhavatsaṃmukha ityatra abhavat tsaṃmukhe iti cchedaḥ| abhavat saṃmukhe' iticchedapakṣe takārasya 'anaci ca' iti dvitvam | mukhe agrabhāge tsaṃ tsetyākārakavarṇasamudayaṃ etya sthito'pi tsarurbhūtvā sthitopi svaruśabde mukhagatasvavarṇalope tatraiva tsavarṇanyasane tsaruriti niṣpatteriti bhāvaḥ | tena nandakena adhaḥkṛtaḥ muṣṭeḥ khaṅgādhobhāgāvasthānāditi bhāvaḥ | ‘tsaruḥ khaṅgādimuṣṭau syāt' ityamaraḥ | atra svarornandakajayarūpeṣṭālābhaḥ adhaḥkṛtatvarūpotkaṭāniṣṭapratilambhaśca śleṣeṇa nibaddhaḥ | śabdārthayostādātmyavaibhavamīdṛśasthaleṣu na vismartavyam || yathāvā lakṣmyā kucakokatulāprepsusstabako bako babhūvāstaḥ | iṣṭānavāptyaniṣṭaprāptī khalu sūnabhāgino niyate || 1197 || lakṣmyā śriyā kucakokasya svakucacakravākasya tulāṃ pre ‘psuḥ stabakaḥ praśastakusumagucchaḥ astaḥ nirastassan 'nuttanunnāstaniṣṭhyūtaviddhakṣipteritāssamāḥ' ityamaraḥ | bakaḥ babhūva kokasāmyaprepsayā yatamāno nirastaḥ kahvākhyo nihīnaḥ khago'bhūt na tūttamaśrīkucakokasadṛśa iti bhāvaḥ | kiṃca bakaḥ śivamallī babhūva lakṣmyā nirastaḥ pāśupatākhyapuṣpatarūviśeṣo babhūvetyapyartho gamyate | 'śivamallī pāśupata ekāṣṭhīlo bako vasuḥ | ityamaraḥ | ‘bakastu bakapuṣpe syātkahve śrīde ca rakṣasi' iti medinī ca | lakṣmīnirastasya pāśupatamatapraveśo yukta eveti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe stabakaḥ stabakaśabdaḥ astaḥ avidyamānastavarṇaḥ bako babhūva | bhāgo bhāgadheyaṃ ‘bhāgo rūpārthake prokto bhāgadheyaikadeśayoḥ' iti viśvaḥ ‘bhāginaṃ bhajate sukham' iti prayogaśca | sūnaḥ suṣṭhuḥ ūnaḥ bhāgaḥ so'syāstīti sūnabhāgī tasya atimātranihīnabhāgyasyetyarthaḥ | pakṣe bhajatīti bhāgī saṃpṛcānurudha' ityādinā bhajaterghinuṇ ‘cajoḥ ku ghiṇyatoḥ' iti kutvam | sūnānāṃ kusumānāṃ bhāgī tasya puṣpabhāja ityarthaḥ | sugamamanyat | atrāpīṣṭānavāptyaniṣṭapratilambhau pūrvavadeva | arthāntaranyāsaśiraskaśleṣasaṃkīrṇatā tu viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā tava varṇamupajihīrṣurmādhava madhye svavarṇavibhraṣṭaḥ | bakavṛttimeva labdhvā balāhako nāñcyate sma vācā'pi || 1198 || he mādhava ! balāhakaḥ vārivāhakaḥ balāhakaśabdaśca tava varṇaṃ apajihīrṣuḥ ata eva madhye antaraiva svavarṇāt vibhraṣṭaḥ | pakṣe madhye svavarṇābhyāṃ lā ha ityetābhyāṃ vibhraṣṭaḥ | lāhau ityetau varṇau vibhraṣṭau yasyeti vā | bakavṛttimeva adhodṛṣṭirnaikṛtikassvārthasādhanatatparaḥ | śaṭho mithyāvinītaśca sa bakavratiko dvijaḥ || ityuktaprakārāṃ bakavṛttimeva yadvā svābhīpsitālābhādbakavattūṣṇīṃ sthitimityarthaḥ | kahvākhyakhagatvameva vā | pakṣe ba ka iti varṇayoḥ sthitimeva labdhvā balāhakaśabdo lāhavarṇayorapāye bakavarṇayoreva sthitiṃ bhajata iti bhāvaḥ | vācā'pi nāñcyate sma 'haitukān bakavṛttīṃśca vāṅmātreṇāpi nārcayet' ityuktarītyā vāṅmātreṇāpyarcito nāsīdityarthaḥ | yadvā bakasya tiryaktvānmanuṣyārhavāgavāptirnāsīdeveti bhāvaḥ | atra balāhakasya na bhagavadvarṇāpahārarūpeṣṭānavāptimātraṃ apitu svavarṇabhraṃśādyuttarottarotkaṭāniṣṭopalambhaśca varṇitaḥ || yathāvā śrīstanasāmyaṃ prepsuḥ kulācalo niścitaḥ kulālo'bhūt | tatsadṛśā iti kalaśānapi vidadhānaḥ kimīpsitaṃ labdhā || 1199 || kulācalaḥ niścitassan kartariktaḥ kulālaḥ kumbhakāraḥ abhūt | pakṣe kulācalaśabdaḥ nirgataḥ cakāro yasya saḥ niścaḥ niścaḥ kṛto niścitaḥ kulālaḥ abhūt | atrāpi śrīstanasāmyarūpeṣṭānavāptipūrvakaṃ kulācalasya kulālatvarūpāniṣṭapratilambhaḥ || yathāvā kalabhastava gativibhavaṃ sulabhaṃ matvā tvayā pratispardhī | alabhata kaśābhighātācchalabhatvaṃ hanta vṛṣabhaśikharivibho || 1200 || kaśāyāḥ 'aśvādestāḍanī kaśā' ityamaraḥ, ābhighātāt | pakṣe śena śavarṇena abhighātaḥ vilopanaṃ 'sādhanaṃ kṛtā' iti samāsaḥ | kasya kavarṇasya śābhighātaḥ tasmāt kakāramapanīya śakāranyasanāditi yāvat | kalabhaḥ śalabhatvaṃ pataṅgatvaṃ kalabhaśabdaśśalabhaśabdatvaṃ ca || yathāvā phaṇigirināyakabhāmini tāvakatanusaukumāryaharaṇeccham | kaśyāhateśśirīṣaṃ karīṣabhūtaṃ jagajjanani jātam || 1201 || haraṇe icchā yasya tat haraṇecchaṃ, śirīṣasya vikāraḥ puṣpaṃ śirīṣaṃ 'dvihīnaṃ prasave sarvaṃ' iti klībatā | kaśāmarhatīti kaśyā arhārthe 'daṇḍādibhyo yaḥ' iti yaḥ | kaśāprahārānuguṇataikṣṇyeti yāvat | tādṛśyā āhateḥ 'kaśyaḥ kaśārha' ityamaraḥ | pakṣe kakāreṇa śivarṇasyāhateḥ śivarṇasthāne kakāraniveśāditi yāvat | karīṣabhūtaṃ śuṣkagomayavadatiparuṣabhūtam, pakṣe karīṣamitipadaṃ jātaṃ 'taddhi śuṣkaṃ karīṣo'strī' ityamaraḥ | atra śirīṣasya śrītanusaukumāryalābharūpeṣṭapraptirmā bhūt, pratyuta naisargikasvasaukumāryapratīpakārkaśyarūpāniṣṭalābhaśca jāta iti dhyeyam || yathāvā tapanasya śarīraṃ tvattapanīyavimānadīptimāditsu | aśakatayā''dita eva hi karīramāsītsarīsṛpagirīndo || 1202 || he sarīsṛpagirīndo ! tapanasya bhānoḥ śarīraṃ vapuḥ śarīrapadaṃ ca | tvattapanīyavimānadīptiṃ āditsu ādātumicchāmātraṃ kṛtavat sat āditaḥ prathamata eva aśakatayā aśaktatayā | śaknotīti śakaṃ pacādyac | tato nañsamāsaḥ tatastal | pakṣe aśaḥ avidyamānaśavarṇaḥ kaḥ kakāro yasmiṃstat tasya bhāvaḥ tattā tayā | śakāralopena tatraiva kakāraprāptyetyarthaḥ | karīraṃ vaṃśāṅkuraḥ āsīt tadvannīlamāsīt | nissejaskamabhūditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe karīramiti niṣpannamabhūdityarthaḥ | 'vaṃśāṅkure karīro'strī' ityamaraḥ | atra bhānośśarīrasya śrīnivāsakanakavimānadīptyupāditsārūpeṣṭālābhaḥ karīratvarūpāniṣṭopalambhaśca || yathāvā cakrastvatkucatāptyai kamapi bhajannantarāpyavailomyam | krakacassanparamudbhavametyāgre bhavati vakrakaca eva || 1203 || he śrīrityadhyāhṛtya saṃbodhanam | cakraḥ kokaḥ tvatkucatāptyai tāvakastanajanmalabdhaye antaḥ manasi kaṃciddevaṃ svaprītidaṃ bhānuṃ vā | 'mārute vedhasi bradhne puṃsi kaḥ' ityamaraḥ | bhajannapīti yojanā upāsīno'pītyarthaḥ | vailomyaṃ vilomatvaṃ 'vṛttau cālomaśau stanau' ityuktasulakṣaṇastanatvārhamaromaśatvaṃ āpya apītyetadatrāpyanuṣajyate | tāvanmātraṃ prāpyāpi krakacassan karapatraṃ bhūtvā aromaśatvena karapatrajanma labdhavānitibhāvaḥ | agre anantaraṃ anyaṃ udbhavaṃ janma 'janirutpattirudbhavaḥ' ityamaraḥ etya alomaśatayā krakacajanmalabdhvā'pi sveṣṭārthasiddherjanmāntaraṃ prāpyāpītyarthaḥ | vakrakaca eva vakrakeśa eva bhavati na tu stanajanma labdhavāniti bhāvaḥ | vakraścāsau kacaśceti vigrahaḥ | pakṣe cakraśabdaḥ vailomyaṃ pratilomavarṇatvaṃ āpya antaḥ madhye kamapi kavarṇamapi bhajan krakaca iti niṣpannaḥ | atha agre kravarṇādapyādau paraṃ atiśayitaṃ yathā syāttathā | udbhavaṃ udgatā bhā yasya taṃ tathoktaṃ udbhūtatayā bhāsamānamityarthaḥ | vaṃ vakāraṃ etya vakrakaca iti niṣpadyata ityarthaḥ || yathāvā vikalaṅkaḥ ko'pi khagastava vāhatvepsuravirabhūdagre | anukalamatha vikṛtivaśāt khagendravāhana babhūva kalaviṅkaḥ || 1204 || he khagendravāhana! bhagavan! idaṃ prakṛtavivakṣitārthopaskārakam | vikalaṅkaḥ hetugarbhamidaṃ, vikalaṅkatvāddhetoḥ ko'pi khagaḥ kaśabdavācyo bhānurapi | yadvā kaḥ khago vikalaṅko'pīti yojanā | īdṛśasyāpi vivakṣiteṣṭāsiddhirāścaryeti bhāvaḥ | ‘mārute vedhasi vradhne puṃsi kaḥ, ityamaraḥ | ko'pi khagaḥ yaḥkaścidajñātanāmā pakṣītyartho'pyupaskāryaḥ | ‘śarārkavihagāḥ khagāḥ' ityamaraḥ | tava vāhatvaṃ vāhanatvaṃ khagendratvamiti bhāvaḥ | īpsuḥ āptumicchuḥ, icchā svāyattā na tu phalaprāptiriti bhāvaḥ | agre ādau aviḥ meṣaḥ mūṣako vā abhūt | vastutastu aviḥ aviśabdavācyaḥ tejorūpo vā tava bhavanaṃ vā abhūt | tanmaṇḍalāntassthitatvāttaveti bhāvaḥ | 'avirnā parvate sūrye meṣe mūṣakakambale | prākāre bhavane bhāsi strī tu puṣpavatībhuvoḥ' iti ratnamālā | 'mūṣakakambale' ityatra ākhau kambale cetyarthaḥ iti ‘avayaśśailameṣārkāḥ' ityamaraślokavyākhyānāvasare daśaṭīkāsarvasvakārādayaḥ | pakṣe agre ādau aviḥ vikāraśūnyaḥ tyaktavivarṇa ityarthaḥ | abhūt | atha anantaraṃ anukalaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ vikṛtivaśāt uttarottaravilakṣaṇavikārāvāptivaśāt | pakṣe kalau kakāralakārau tayoḥ paścāt anukalaṃ ‘avyayaṃ vibhakti' ityādinā paścādarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ | vikṛtivaśāt veḥ vi ityakārakavarṇasya kṛtiḥ karaṇaṃ nyasanamiti yāvat | tadvaśāt kalaviṅkaḥ khagaḥ caṭakākhyaḥ pakṣī abhūt | vikalaṅkaśabda uktarītyā prāthamikavarṇotsāraṇena kakāralakārānantaraṃ vivarṇanyasanena ca kalaviṅka iti niṣpanna iti | nirgalito'rthaḥ | atra vikalaṅkakhagasya na paramabhīṣṭabhagavadvāhanatānavāptiḥ apitu mūṣakatvādyutkaṭāniṣṭapratilambhaśca śabdārthatādātmyanibandhanaśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyajīvātuka iti vibhāvanīyam || yathāvā tava rucilipsu parāstaṃ dhvastasuvarṇaṃ kusumbhamamba tataḥ | klaibyaṃ vihāya puṃstva bhajatu tathā'pi stanena jīyeta || 1205 || he amba! kusumbhaṃ mahārajanaṃ kanakaṃ vā | pakṣe kusumbhamiti padaṃ ‘kusumbhaṃ hemani mahārajane nā kamaṇḍalau' iti medinī | mahārajanaṃ kuṅkumakusumamityāhuḥ | tava ruciṃ tviṣaṃ lipsu ata eva parāstaṃ tvadrucā nirastaṃ ata eva dhvastaḥ suvarṇaḥ śobhanasvakīyavarṇaḥ su ityākārakavarṇaśca yasya tattathoktaṃ sat | tataḥ īdṛśāvasthāvāptyanantaraṃ klaibyaṃ adhṛṣṭatāṃ napuṃsakaliṅgatāṃ ca vihāya puṃstvaṃ pauruṣaṃ bhajatu kalaśaḥ karikumbho vā jāyatām | pakṣe pulliṅgatvaṃ bhajatu | su iti varṇotsāraṇena kumbha iti pulliṅgo niṣpadyatāmiti bhāvaḥ | kumbhaśabdo hi 'kumbhau ghaṭebhamūrdhānau' iti puṃstvenānuśiṣṭaḥ | tathā'pi tavetyetadanuṣajyate | tava stanena svatassiddhapuṃstveneti bhāvaḥ | ekavacanasya ekenaiva sukare jaye na dvābhyāmapi sannaddhavyamityabhiprāyaḥ | jīyeta abhibhūyeta | jayateratrābhibhavārthakatvātsakarmakatā | taduktaṃ hariṇā jayirjayābhibhavayorādyarthe'sāvakarmakaḥ | utkarṣaprāptirādyārtho dvitīye'rthe sakarmakaḥ || iti | atra kusumbhasya na svepsitālābhamātraṃ apitu rūpāntaragrahaṇe'pyavarjanīyo'niṣṭapratilambhaśca nibaddhaḥ || yathāvā iṣṭatvadvadanatulā'nāptyā''dyantakṣaraḥ kṣapākara eṣaḥ | kṣetraṃ paramapi vindan kṣapākaraḥ pākarasahito'mba prāṇīt || 1206 || he amba! eṣaḥ kṣapākaraḥ candramāḥ kṣapākaraśabdaśca | iṣṭāsvābhilaṣitā yā tvadvadanatulā tasyāḥ anāptyā ādyantāvabhivyāpya ādyantaṃ āpādamastakaṃ ājanmanidhanaṃ vā kṣaraḥ kṣīṇassan ādyantayoḥ śuklapratipadamāvāsyayoḥ kṣaraḥ kṣīṇa iti ca | pakṣe ādyantau kṣarau kṣakārarephau yasya sa tathoktaḥ paraṃ anyat kṣetraṃ śarīraṃ uttamaṃ siddhasthānaṃ vā ‘kṣetraṃ śarīre kedāre siddhasthānakalatrayoḥ' iti medinī | kamapi bhagavadabhivyaktikṣetramityarthaḥ | vindannapi | pakṣe kṣe traṃ iti bhinnaṃ padaṃ kṣe paraṃ tramiti yojanā | kṣe paraṃ kṣakāramātre traṃ vindan kṣakārasthāne tretivarṇasamudāyaṃ prāpnuvannityarthaḥ | trapākaraḥ lajjāśrita eva pākarasena hitaḥ bhoktṛbhyasssauhityarūpahitakārī māhanasikassanniti bhāvaḥ | prāṇīt ajīvat | pakṣe trapākara iti niṣpannaḥ pākara iti varṇa sahitaḥ kṣakāramātre varṇāṃntaraṃ prāpto'pi pākara iti varṇānupūrvyāmavikṛta eva sattāmalabhatetyarthaḥ | atrāpi pūrvavadeva iṣṭhānavāptyaniṣṭaprāptī || yathāvā suramānvitā'pi harimukhabhavasmitātprepsuruttamaṃ varṇam | lopitabhūyovarṇā'suramā bhillyeva surabhimallyāsīt || 1207 || surabhimallī vasantasaṃbandhimallikākusumam | surabhisaṃbandhitvakathanānmallikāyā varṇasaurabhādyatiśayaḥ pratyāyyate | surabhiḥ manojñā mallī mallānāma khuralīkhelanaparā jātiviśeṣāḥ, tajjātistrītyapyartho'nusandheyaḥ | pakṣe surabhimallīśabdaśca | tayostādātmyam | śobhanā ca sā ramā śrīḥ tayā'nvitā'pi | surāṇāṃ mā lakṣamīḥ tadanvitā'pīti vā | apiśabdena tāvatā aparyāptatvaṃ gamyate | hareḥ bhagavataḥ mukhabhavaṃ yat smitaṃ tasmādapi smitavarṇādapīti yāvat | smitasya mukhabhaveti viśeṣaṇena brāhmaṇavarṇatvaṃ gamyate | uttamaṃ varṇaṃ prepsuḥ | teneti śeṣaḥ smitenetyarthaḥ | lopitaḥ bhūyān varṇo naisargiko yasyāssā tathoktā | ata eva asuramā suṣṭhu ramata iti suramā pacādyac | tato nañtatpuruṣaḥ harṣavirahiteti yāvat | bhillī kirātī āsīt mallajāterapi nihinajātirabhūditi bhāvaḥ | malī bhillītyubhayatrāpi jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ | pakṣe lopitāḥ bhūyāṃso varṇāḥ akṣarāṇi yasyāssā ‘chinnabhūyiṣṭhadhūmā' ityādāvalpāvaśiṣṭadhūmetyādivat alpāvaśeṣitākṣareti bhāvaḥ | luptānvarṇāneva darśayaty asurameti | su ra meti varṇatritayavidhurā ataeva bhillīti āsīt | surabhimallīśabde surameti varṇāvalīlope bhillīti varṇadvayasyaiva pāriśeṣyāditi bhāvaḥ | atra surabhimallyāḥ bhagavadvadanasmitādapyadhikavarṇalipsārūpeṣṭālābhaḥ svavarṇabhraṃśādyaniṣṭapratilambhaśca śabdārthatādātmyāvalambiśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyasāmrājyena nirvyūḍhaḥ || yathāvā tvadgatimīpsuścauryādaṇako'cyuta vāraṇo'ntarāsannaḥ | vānaratāmāpāpararūpāptyā tadanu vāna evābhūt || 1208 || he acyuta! vāraṇaḥ gajaḥ vāraṇaśabdaśca cauryāt tvadgatiṃ īpsuḥ ata eva aṇakaḥ garhyaḥ ‘kheṭagarhyāṇakāssamāḥ' ityamaraḥ | pakṣe avidyamānaṇakārassan antarā icchācauryayormadhya eva sannaḥ viśīrṇaḥ saderviśaraṇārthakātkartari ktaḥ | ‘radābhyāṃ' iti niṣṭhātasya pūrvadakārasya ca natvam | pakṣe antarā ṇakārāpagamānantaramavaśiṣṭavāra iti varṇadvitaya madhye san vidyamānaḥ naḥ nakāro yasya sa tathoktassan vānaratāṃ plavagatāṃ vānaraśabdatāṃ ca āpa prāptavān | tadanu apararūpasya tato'pi nihīnarūpasya āptyā | pakṣe aparaṃ apagatarephaṃ yadrūpaṃ tasya āptyā | rephotsāraṇeneti yāvat | vāna eva śuṣka eva abhūt | ‘vānaśśuṣkaphale śuṣke sīvane gamane kaṭe' iti hemacandraḥ | pakṣe vānaśabdaḥ abhūt | atra vāraṇasya bhagavadgatisteyarūpeṣṭānavāptiḥ aṇakatvādyaniṣṭapratilambhaśca nibaddhaḥ || yathāvā nīlāmbara bhagavaṃstava celākāraṃ paraṃ pariprepsuḥ | vinayannapyātmānaṃ vanarāśiḥ prāntato varāśirabhūt || 1209 || he nīlāmbara balabhadra bhagavan! ‘nīlāmbaro rohiṇeyaḥ ityamaraḥ | vanarāśiḥ jaladhiḥ vanarāśiśabdaśca | paraṃ utkṛṣṭaṃ tava celākāraṃ vasanasya nīlarūpaṃ tattulyatāmityarthaḥ | pariprepsuḥ ata eva ātmānaṃ svaṃ vinayannapi tadrūpagrahaṇayogyatārthaṃ śikṣayannapi | pakṣe vinaṃ kurvanvinayan vigatanakāraṃ kurvan san prāntataḥ paryavasāne varāśiḥ sthūlapaṭaḥ 'varāśiḥ sthūlaśāṭakaḥ' ityamaraḥ | abhūt anyatra varāśiriti niṣpanna ityarthaḥ | atra bhagavadbalabhadradivyāṃśukarūpalakṣaṇeṣṭālābhaḥ sthūlapaṭatvarūpāniṣṭapratilambhaśca vanarāśervarṇitaḥ || yathāvā bhuva iva tavāpyananta prāptuṃ yadyaṃśukatvamudyuṅkte | ādyākārahrāsādvārāśissyādvarāśireva tadā || he ananta ! ullaṅghitatrividhapariccheda bhagavan ! vārāśiḥ jaladhiḥ bhuva iva paricchinnāyā bhūmeriva tavāpi aparicchinnasya bhavato'pi aṃśukatvaṃ sūkṣmāmbaratvaṃ 'aṃśukaṃ ślakṣṇavastre syādvastramātrottarīyayoḥ' iti medinī | prāptuṃ yadi udyuṅkte tadā ādyākārasya prāthamikasvasvarūpasyāpi hrāsāt saṃkocāt varāśiḥ sthūlapaṭa eva syāt na tu sūkṣmaślāghyatamabhavaddivyāṃśukamiti bhāvaḥ | vārāśiśabdaḥ prāthamikasya āvarṇasya hrasvatvādvarāśiriti niṣpanna iti vastusthitiḥ | atrāpi pūrvavadevaṃ viṣamam saṃbhāvanasaṃkīrṇatvaṃ viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā dvijajanibhuvamacyuta tava vadanaṃ dvijarājatāmadātpūrṇenduḥ | vaśayitumicchuḥ kramaśo malinātmā'viprabhāmupājīvadaho || 1211 || he acyuta! pūrṇenduḥ dvijarājatāmadāt ahaṃ brahmaṇānāṃ rājeti garvāt ‘soma eva no rājetyāhurbrāhmaṇīḥ prajāḥ' iti śruteḥ | dvijajanibhuvaṃ brāhmaṇotpattisthānaṃ ‘brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamā sīt' iti śruteḥ | tava vadanamapi vaśayituṃ svavaśe vidhātuṃ icchan san kramaśaḥ krameṇa malinātmā īdṛśasaṃkalpena pāpiṣṭhassan, asitapakṣe kalāpacayena niṣprabhaśarīra iti vastusthitiḥ | aviprasya abrāhmaṇasya śūdrasya bhāṃ varcaḥ, svasya brāhmaṇarājatāprakhyāpanāya tajjanisthānabhūtabhagavanmukhavaśīkaraṇapravṛttassvayamevābrāhmaṇatāmavāpetyarthaḥ | pakṣe aveḥ bhānoḥ tejaḥ upājīvat upajīvyatvenābhyupaidityarthaḥ | darśe candramasaḥ ravisaṃbandhasya taddattatejastvasyaca śrutyādiprasiddhatvāt | āhuśca jyotirvidaḥ 'salilamaye śaśini raverdīdhitayo mūrchitāstamo naiśam | kṣapayanti' iti | atrāpīṣṭānavāptyaniṣṭaprāptī spaṣṭe || yathāvā yaśasā marālikā tava vijitā'mālirbhavantyatha kathaṃcit | rākā satī smitarucā'ntato'mba kārāsthitā hyavāṅmūrdhā || 1212 || he amba! marālikā haṃsī tvadyaśassāmyamabhilaṣantīti bhāvaḥ | taba yaśasā vijitā satī ata eva amāliḥ amāvāsyāyāssakhī bhavantī satī ‘ālissakhī' ityamaraḥ | malinā bhavantīti yāvat | pakṣe amā āliḥ iti cchedaḥ | makāralikārābhyāṃ śūnyā satītyarthaḥ | atha kathaṃcit mahatā prayatnena | pakṣe makāralikāratyāgakleśenetyarthaḥ | rākā pūrṇaniśākarapūrṇimā satī vaiśadyaṃ saṃpāditavatīti yāvat | marāliketi śabdavyaktiḥ tyaktamakāralikāratvena rāketi niṣpannetyarthaḥ | tava vijitetyetatpadadvayamapyanuṣajyate | tava smitarucā tadavasthālokanajanitamandahāsatviṣā vijitā satī antataḥ paryavasānadaśāyāṃ avāṅmūrdhā adhaḥkṛtaśirāssatyapi kārāsthitā bandhanālayasthā | hītyavadhāraṇe | abhūt uktaduravasthāmevāpnot na tu svābhīṣṭamiti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe avaśiṣṭā rāketi śabdavyaktirvilomatve kāreti niṣpannā'bhūdityarthaḥ | atra marālikāyāssarvadhā'pi śrīyaśassmitarucisāmyarūpeṣṭālābhaḥ mālinyādyaniṣṭāvāptiśca śabdārthatādātmyamūlakaśleṣāvalambinī || yathāvā tvatkacakalāpalakṣmyā svakalāpacyutimupetya vacanīyaḥ | kanakagirīśavilāsini kapīśatāmaśnute kalāpīśaḥ || 1213 || he kanakagirīśavilāsini! kanakagiriḥ veṅkaṭādriḥ | kalāpīśaḥ mayūravareṇyaḥ tvatkacakalāpalakṣmīprepsuritibhāvaḥ | ata eva tvatkacakalāpalakṣmyā hetubhūtayā svakalāpasya svabarhasya cyutiṃ hāniṃ etya vacanīyaḥ svakanīyastvamavigaṇayya mahanīyaḥ ramākacakalāpataulyalipsussvakalāpasyaiva hānimavāpya lokairgarhaṇīyassanniti bhāvaḥ | kapīśatāṃ kīśottamatāṃ aśnute svābhīṣṭālābhāniṣṭābhyāgamābhyāṃ ākulamanāḥ kapivadatimātracapalo bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | anyatra kalāpīśaśabdaḥ svakasya svakīyasya lāvarṇasya apacyutiṃ pracyavanaṃ etya vacanīyaḥ vaktumarhaścet kapīśa iti niṣpadyata ityarthaḥ || yathāvā tvatphālarucā dhvastā vikalā'cyuta vidhukalākamapi varṇam | aprāptāgatapūrvākārā tata āvilā samajaniṣṭa || 1214 || he acyuta ! vidhukalā candrakalā tvatphālaviḍambanecchuriti bhāvaḥ | tvatphālarucā tvadīyalalāṭasuṣamayā dhvastā parābhūtā ata eva vikalā avayavavaikalyaṃ prāptā kamapi yaṃ kaṃcidapi varṇaṃ rūpaṃ aprāptā naitāvadeva gatapūrvākārā dhvastaprācīnasvavarṇā satī tataḥ āvilā anacchā samajaniṣṭa ‘kaluṣo'naccha āvilaḥ' ityamaraḥ | pakṣe vidhukaleti śabdavyaktiḥ arthagatasya strītvasya śabda āropa ityasakṛdavocāma | dhvastā dhuḥ astaḥ nirastaḥ yasyāssā tathoktā nirastadhuvarṇā satītyarthaḥ | vikalā vikaleti niṣpannā satī kamapi ka ityākārakavarṇamapi aprāptā vigatakakāreti yāvat | āgatapūrvākārā āgataḥ adhigataḥ pūrvaḥ sarvavarṇebhyaḥ prathamaḥ ākāraḥ ā iti varṇaḥ yasyāssā tathoktā satī āvilā samajaniṣṭa | vidhukalāśabdo dhuvarṇalope vikaleti niṣpannaḥ tataḥ kakāralope ādāvākāraprāptau cāvileti niṣpanna iti nirgalito'rthaḥ | atrāpīṣṭāvāptyaniṣṭaprāptī spaṣṭe || yathāvā ikṣuraso'mba tvadvāgrasadūradhutassadāsatāṃ bibhrat | kamapi bhajannante'bhūdikṣurako nāsa madhupabhogyo'pi || 1215 || he amba ! saḥ svādutvena jagadviditaḥ ikṣurasaḥ rasālāsava iti yāvat | tvadvāgrasādapyutkarṣepsuriti bhāvaḥ | tvadvāgrasena dūradhutaḥ ata eva dāsatāṃ kiṃkaratāṃ bibhradapi ante anantaraṃ kamapi bhajan brahmāṇamupāsīno'pi ikṣurakaḥ kṣudrakaṇṭakivṛkṣaviśeṣa evābhūt na tu tvadvāgrasādutkṛṣṭaḥ | ata eva madhupānāṃ śīdhupātṝṇāṃ madhukarāṇāmiti ca | bhogyo'pi nāsa nāsīt | āseti tiṅantapratirūpakamavyayam | ‘madhuvrato nekṣurakaṃ hi vīkṣate' ityukteriti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe ikṣurasaśabdaḥ sadā asatāṃ avidyamānasakāratāṃ bibhrat dhvastasakāra ityarthaḥ | ante avasāne kaṃ kavarṇamapi bhajan prāpnuvan san ikṣuraka iti niṣpanna ityarthaḥ | atrekṣurasasya iṣṭānavāptiraniṣṭapratilambhaśca spaṣṭa eva || yathāvā svarato'mba vallakī tava dhutā tulayituṃ vacāṃsi kīrībhāvam | yāntyeva vallarītvaṃ yātā sukumāratāparābhūtā'bhūt || 1216 || he amba! vallakī vīṇā tvatsvaratulanecchuriti bhāvaḥ | tava svarataḥ kaṇṭhasvareṇa dhutā satī tava vacāṃsi tulayituṃ kīrībhāvaṃ śukībhāvaṃ yāntyeva gacchantyeva vallarītvaṃ kusumamañjarītvaṃ yātā | kīrībhāvāvāptyavasara eva vallarī babhūvetyarthaḥ | atha sukumāratayā saukumāryeṇa parābhūtā abhūt | pakṣe vallakīśabdaḥ kīrībhāvaṃ kīvarṇasya rīvarṇatvaṃ kīvarṇāpanayanena rīvarṇanyasanamityarthaḥ | yānyeva satī vallarīti niṣpannetyarthaḥ | atra vallakyā īpsitālābhaḥ aniṣṭaparaṃparāvāptiśca draṣṭavyā || yathāvā nārāyaṇa tava kīrtibhirairāvata eva bhagnamukhavarṇaḥ | valatetrapāvalīḍhaḥ pārāvatatāmavāpya vanasīmni || 1217 || bhagnaḥ mukhavarṇaḥ vadanatejaḥ ādivarṇaśca yasya sa tathoktaḥ | ata eva trapayā lajjayā avalīḍhaḥ | pakṣe atra pāvalīḍhaḥ iti cchedaḥ atra nirastamukhavarṇasthāne pāvalīḍhaḥ pāvarṇena yuktaḥ pārāvatatāṃ kapotatāṃ tadvaddhūmravarṇatāmiti yāvat | pakṣe pārāvataśabdatāmityarthaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat | atrāpi bhagavatkīrtitaulyepsorairāvatasya iṣṭālābhāniṣṭaprāptī varṇite || yathāvā bhraṣṭasvādyākārastvadgāmbhīryepsuratha dhuto'kūpāraḥ | āpadyāsāratvaṃ śrīparibṛḍha kūpamātrarūpamavāpa || 1218 || he śrīparibṛḍha! akūpāraḥ sindhuḥ tvadgāmbhīryepsuḥ ata eva dhutaḥ tvayeti śeṣaḥ | ata eva bhraṣṭaḥ svasya ādyaḥ prāthamikaḥ ākāro rūpaṃ gāmbhīryādikaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | bhraṣṭaḥ svādyaḥ rucyaḥ ākāro yasyeti ca | ata eva asāratvaṃ vibalatvaṃ nīrasatvaṃ ca āpadya prāpya kūpaḥ pramāṇamasya kūpamātraṃ tattulyapramāṇamityarthaḥ | tādṛśaṃ ca tat rūpaṃ avāpa | agabhīra āsīditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe akūpāraśabdaḥ bhraṣṭaḥ svasya ādyaḥ prāthamikaḥ akāraḥ a iti varṇo yasya sa tathoktaḥ | dvitīyākāravyāvṛttyarthamādyākāra ityuktam | asāratāṃ āśca raśca ārau tābhyāṃ saha vartata iti sāraḥ na sāraḥ asāraḥ tasya bhāvaḥ tattā tāṃ ākārarepharūpavyañjanavihīnatāmityarthaḥ | āpadya kūpāveva kūpamātraṃ tathoktaṃ rūpaṃ avāpa | ādyākārasya pakārottarākārarephavyañjanayoścāpāyena kūpa iti varṇadvayamātrāvaśeṣitaṃ | rūpamalabhatetyarthaḥ | atrāpi pūrvavadeva viṣamamanusandheyam || yathāvā kalabhādhīśassvakare tvadūrubhepsustvayā kṛto vikalaḥ | bhādhīśo'pyastu tataścaraṇena vā samaḥ kiṃ syāt || 1219 || he bhagavan! kalabhādhīśaḥ gajarājaḥ svakare tvadūrvoḥ bhāṃ īpsuḥ ata eva tvayā vikalaḥ nistejāḥ ralayorabhedāt vikaraḥ śuṇḍāvidhura iti vā kṛtaḥ | tataḥ bhādhīśaḥ bhānāṃ ādanto'yaṃ bhāśabdaḥ bhāsāmityarthaḥ, adhīśaḥ sahasrāṃśuḥ bhānāṃ tārāṇāṃ adhīśaḥ candramāḥ apivā astu | tata ityāvartyate | tataḥ evaṃ bhaṇanādapi caraṇena tavāṅghriṇā nakhena vā samaḥ syāt kim | bhānutve'pyāruṇyāccaraṇatulyaḥ indutve'pi viśadimādinā nakhatulyo vā na syāditi bhāvaḥ | anyatra kalabhādhīśaśabdaḥ kakāralakāravidhuritaḥ bhādhīśa iti niṣpadyata ityarthaḥ | pūrvavadviṣamam || yathāvā tvadvacanarasadhutatvādvyapayātāyā'vasattimatsvāntā | sā mṛdvīkā svāmini kāmaṃ syānmṛttikaiva ko viśayaḥ || 1220 || he svāmini! yā mṛdvīkā drākṣā ‘mṛdvīkā gostanī drākṣā' ityamaraḥ | tvadvacanarasalipsuriti bhāvaḥ | tvadvacanarasena dhutatvāt vyapayātā dūraṃ kvāpi gatā satī avasattiḥ avasādaḥ so'syāstīti avasattimat svāntaṃ hṛdayaṃ yasyāstathābhūtā ābhūditi śeṣaḥ dīnamānasā'bhūdityarthaḥ | sā mṛdvīkā kāmaṃ mṛttikaiva syāt mṛdākāratāmevāpadyeta | tadvannīrasā saṃpadyeteti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe dhutatvādvyapayātetyatra dhutatvāt dvyapayāteti cchedaḥ | dhutatvāt vyapayāteti prāthamikacchedapakṣe dakārasya ‘anaci ca' iti dvitvaṃ, yā'vasattimatsvāntetyatra yā avasat ttimatsvānteti cchedaḥ | yā mṛdvīketi śabdavyaktiḥ dvyapayātā dvī ityākārakavarṇādapagatā | dvī ityākārakavarṇaḥ apayāto yasyā iti vā | utsāritadvīvarṇetyarthaḥ | ttiḥ dvitvaghaṭitastikāraḥ so'syāstīti ttimān svāntaḥ svāntaraṃ yasyāssā tathoktā satī avasat avātsīt | asmin pakṣe avasattimadityatra takāratraye 'jharo jhari savarṇe' iti dvitīyatakārasya lope arthadvaye'pi dvitakāratvaṃ draṣṭavyam | 'anto'strī niścaye nāśe svarūpe'gre'ntike'ntare' iti ratnamālā | mṛttikaiva syāt uktarītyā mṛttiketi niṣpadyetetyarthaḥ | atra mṛdvīkāyā na paraṃ śrīvacanarasālābhaḥ apitu mṛttikātvarūpotkaṭāniṣṭaprāptiḥ | yathāvā divametya śacīpatiriti nahuṣo'bhikhyātilipsa evātha | śapto'bhikhyāhīnaḥ parāṅmukhyācchriyastilipso'bhūt || 1221 || nahuṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ divaṃ svargaṃ etya aindraṃ padamāsādyeti yāvat | śacīpatiriti abhikhyātau lipsā yasya sa tathābhūtassanneva | atha īdṛśasaṃkalpānupadameva śriyaḥ lakṣmyāḥ pārāṅmukhyāt śaptaḥ munineti śeṣaḥ | abhikhyāhīnaḥ tejovidhuraḥ tilipsaḥ ajagaraḥ abhūt | yadyapi ‘atha gonase | tilipsassyāt' ityanuśāsanāt gonasākhyamahāhiviśeṣavācyeva tilipsaśabdaḥ, na tvajagaravācī 'ajagare śayurvāhasa ityubhau' ityanuśāsanāt | tathā'pi tayorgonasājagarayorgrāhanakrayoriva yatkiṃcidvailakṣaṇyānādareṇābhedaḥ kavisamayasiddha iti dhyeyam | tilipsaśabdaṃ tilatsa iti kecitpaṭhanti | asmābhistu tilipsa iti pracurapāṭhamanusṛtyāyaṃ vicchittiviśeṣaḥ pradarśitaḥ | 'tila gatau' telatīti tiliḥ 'ikkṛṣyādibhyaḥ' iti ik jaṅgamaṃ vastu | taṃ psāti bhakṣayatīti tilipsaḥ | ‘psā bhakṣaṇe' ādādikādasmāt ‘āto'nupasarge' iti kaḥ | yadvā ‘tila snehane' tudādiḥ tilanaṃ tiliḥ, tena psātīti tathoktaḥ | yathākathaṃcidarthapradarśanamidam | nātrāvayavārthe viśeṣato'bhiniveṣṭavyaṃ rūḍhaśabdatvādasya | atra nahuṣasya śacīpatitvakhyātilābhalakṣaṇeṣṭānavāptipūrvakājagaratvarūpādyaniṣṭalābhonibaddhaḥ | pakṣe abhikhyātilipsaśabdaḥ abhikhyeti varṇapaṅktervirahe tilipsa ityavaśiṣyata ityarthaḥ || yathāvā nanu mecakībubhūṣustava bahudhāmāpaharaṇataḥ ko'pi khagaḥ | pāpassanpecakatāmāpa gataḥ kṛṣṇa hanta viśadāṃśukatām || 1222 || nanu he kṛṣṇa! idaṃ vakṣyamāṇārthopaskārakam | viśadāṃ sphuṭāṃ śukatāṃ kīratvaṃ gataḥ prāptaḥ ko'pi khagaḥ śuka ityarthaḥ | bahu yathāsyāttathā mecakībubhūṣuḥ svakīyaharitavarṇasya nātīvamecakatvādatiśyāmalībhavitumicchurityabhiprāyaḥ | yadvā viśadāḥ aṃśavo yasya sa tathoktaḥ, kap, pāṇḍuravarṇa ityarthaḥ | tattāṃ gataḥ prāptaḥ kopi khagaḥ haṃsa iti bhāvaḥ | mecakībubhūṣuḥ asitībhavitumicchuḥ | abhūtatadbhāve cviḥ | pakṣe mecakāḥ candrakāḥ asya santīti mecakī mayūraḥ bubhūṣuḥ 'mecakastu mayūrasya candrake śyāmale pumān | tadyukte vācyavat klībaṃ sroto'ñjanāndhakārayoḥ' iti medinī | ‘mecakaścandrake dhvānte nīle nā tadvati triṣu' iti ratnamālā ca | tava dhāmnaḥ tviṣaḥ nīlimna ityarthaḥ | apaharaṇataḥ apahārāddhetoḥ pāpaḥ pātakī san ‘atha triṣu dravye pāpapuṇyasukhādi ca, ityamaraḥ | pecakatāṃ ulūkatāṃ āpa hanteti viṣāde | vastutastu kopi khagaśabdaḥ bahudhā mecakībubhūṣuḥ mecakaśabdo bhavitumicchuḥ, maḥ m iti halmātrasya āpaharaṇataḥ īṣadapahārāt paṃ p iti vyañjanaṃ āpnotīti pāpaḥ tathābhūtassan pecakatāṃ pecakaśabdatāmapi mecakaśabdo bubhūṣuruktarītyā pecakaśabdo'bhūdityarthaḥ | atra śukasya haṃsasya vā mayūratāṃ prāpsorna kevalaṃ tadalābhaḥ apitu pecakatvarūpotkaṭāniṣṭapratilambhaḥ | ayaṃ ca śabdārthatādātmyavaibhavāsāditamahimaśleṣabhittikābhedātiśayanirvyūḍhaḥ || eṣūdāharaṇeṣu prāyeṇopamāmūlakatvaṃ aprastutapraśaṃsāgarbhatvaṃ śleṣottambhitatvaṃ ca draṣṭavyam | evamiṣṭānavāptyaniṣṭaprāptyubhayakṛtā utpattilakṣaṇasaṃsargasyānanurūpatā sāmānyato darśitā | pūrvoktacaturvidhabhedāyā iṣṭānavāpteḥ pūrvoktatrividhabhedenāniṣṭena saṃsṛṣṭau iyameva dvādaśavidhā bhavati | tatra svasya sukhasādhanavastvanavāptiduḥkhasādhanavastuprāptirūpa ubhayabhedastāvadudāhṛtaḥ || svasya duḥkhasādhanavastvanivṛttiduḥkhāntarasādhanāvāptirūpadvayaṃ yathā taralatvaṃ vijihāsurdyumaṇistava hāramadhyaratnatvam | prāpyāpi na tadahāsītparaṃtu tatrāsa bata vṛṣādrimaṇe || 1223 || dyumaṇiḥ taraṇiḥ svarlokaratnamityapi gamyate | taralatvaṃ svasya cāpalyaṃ ṣidgatvaṃ vā bhāsvaratvamiti tu vastusthitiḥ | 'taralaṃ cañcale ṣidge bhāsvare'pi triliṅgakam' iti medinī | vijihāsuḥ tava hāramadhyaratnatvaṃ prāpyāpi tat taralatvaṃ nāhāsīt nātyākṣīt | punarapi taralatvamevāpadyatetyarthaḥ | hāramadhyagatvāttaralasaṃjño babhūveti vastusthitiḥ | paraṃtu tatrāsa trāsākhyaṃ maṇidoṣamavāpsīt bibhāyeti vā arthaḥ| 'trāso bhīmaṇidoṣayoḥ ' iti viśvaḥ| pakṣe tatra āsa iti cchedaḥ | tatra hāramadhye | āsa didīpe ityarthaḥ | ‘asa dīptau' liṭ | atra dyumaṇestaralatvarūpaduḥkhasādhanavastunivṛttyudyamāttadanivṛttiḥ trāsarūpaduḥkhāntarasādhanāvāptiśca nibaddhā | idamevānarthaparihārārtharūpeṣṭārthasamudyamāttadanavāptiraniṣṭāntaraprāptiśceti vyavahriyate'nyatra || śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyottambhitamidam || parasya duḥkhasādhanaprāpaṇarūpeṣṭārthasamudyogāttadanavāptiḥ svasya duḥkhasādhanaprāptirityubhayaṃ yathā hiṃsitumanā bhavantaṃ kaṃsaripo stanyadānataḥ kācit | hiṃsāmāpa nṛśaṃsā puṃsāmavataṃsa bahutarāṃ saiva || 1224 || atra saivetyanena bhagavadaniṣṭaprāpaṇābhāvo darśitaḥ || yathāvā rāghava tava pratāpapradīpanirvāpaṇāya kṛtayatanāḥ | niśicarabalapatiśalabhāssulabhaṃ nirvāpaṇaṃ svayamavindan || 1225 || nirvāpaṇāya śamanāya | nirvāpaṇaṃ śamanaṃ nidhanaṃ ca | ‘nirvāpaṇaṃ saṃjñapanam' ityamaraḥ | atra niśicarabalapatiśalabhānāṃ raghuvarapratāpapradīpanirvāpaṇarūpeṣṭārthasamudyogāttadanavāptiḥ pratyuta sveṣāmeva tadaniṣṭaprāptiḥ | rūpakasaṃkīrṇamidam || yathāvā banddhuṃ jagatāṃ bandhuṃ nanvadhūstvāṃ guṇaiḥ prayasyantī | sandānitā guṇaiste nandātmaja saiva mandavispandā || 1226 || tvāṃ guṇaiḥ rajjubhiḥ banddhuṃ naddhuṃ ‘bandha bandhane' asmāttumun | nakāradakāradhakārasaṃyogaḥ | te tava guṇaiḥ rajjubhiḥ sauśīlyādikalyāṇaguṇaiśca | atra yaśodāyā na kevalaṃ svanandanabandhanaprāpaṇarūpeṣṭānavāptiḥ | apitu tadguṇairātmana eva bandhanarūpāniṣṭapratilambhaḥ | asya bandhasyāniṣṭatvaṃ ca guṇaśabdopāttārthadvayaśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyanirvyūḍham || yathāvā tvadrūpamabhibubhūṣaṃ vibhagnavadanaṃ vidhāya jīmūtam | vedhāḥ krodhānmumuve bhagnamukho'yaṃ bhavatyato mūtaḥ || 1227 || vedhāḥ brahmā tava rūpaṃ snigdhaśyāmalimānaṃ abhibhūṣuṃ abhibhavitumicchuṃ | abhibhavaḥ duḥkhasādhanānukūlavyāpāraḥ | jīmūtaṃ krodhāt vibhagnavadanaṃ vidhāya mukhe gāḍhaṃ prahṛtyeti bhāvaḥ | lokoktiriyam | mumuve babandha | 'mūṅ bandhane' liṭ | ata eva ayaṃ jīmūtaḥ bhagnamukhaḥ parāhatatayā pareṣāṃ vadanaṃ darśayitumanīśa iti yāvat | mūtaḥ baddha eva bhavati | mṛṅdhātoreva karmaṇi ktaḥ | ‘baddhe saṃdānitaṃ mūtam' ityamaraḥ | jīmūtaśabdo luptamukhyajīvarṇaḥ mūta iti bhavatīti vastusthitiḥ | atra bhagavadrūpābhibhavarūpatadduḥkhasādhanalakṣaṇasveṣṭārthodyogena na kevalaṃ jīmūtasya tadalābhaḥ, kiṃtu mukhabhaṅgādirūpaduḥkhasādhanāvāptiśca nibaddheti lakṣaṇasaṃgatiḥ || yathāvā śrīkucajayasannaddhastadabhivilūnāgryaguṇaka eva tataḥ | kamapi bhajannākāraṃ kokaḥ kāko bhavannariṣṭo'bhūt || 1228 || kokaḥ cakravākaḥ 'kuka ādāne' ityasmādaci laghūpadhalakṣaṇo guṇaḥ | śrīkucayoḥ jaye abhibhave | abhibhavo nyūnīkaraṇaṃ parasamavetaduḥkhānukūlavyāpāraḥ | tasmin sannaddhaḥ sajjaḥ | ata eva tābhyāṃ abhivilūnaḥ sarvātmanā chinnaḥ agryaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ guṇaḥ ramyatvādiḥ parākramādriśca yasya sa tathoktaḥ | ‘śeṣādvibhāṣā' iti kap | kṛttaparārthyamaurvīka ityapi gamyate | evakāreṇa nirastasya guṇasya punardaurlabhyaṃ dyotitam | ata eva tataḥ kamapi atiśocanīyaṃ ākāraṃ ākṛtiṃ bhajan kāko bhavan vāyaso bhavan ariṣṭaḥ ariṣṭaṃ aśubhaṃ mṛtyucihnaṃ vā asyāstītyariṣṭaḥ arśa āditvādac | ariṣṭaśabdavācyo'bhūditi tu tattvam | ‘ariṣṭamaśubhe tāmre laśune sūtikāgṛhe | mṛtyucihne ca nā tveṣa kāke phenilanimbayoḥ' iti ratnamālā | pakṣe kokaḥ kokaśabdaḥ agryaḥ agre svāntaraṃ bhavaḥ guṇaḥ guṇasaṃjñika okāraḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ agryaguṇaḥ kaḥ kavarṇaḥ saḥ vilūno yasyeti bahuvrīhigarbho bahuvrīhiḥ | nirastakovarṇa eveti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kaṃ kavarṇaṃ | ākāramapīti yojanā āvarṇaṃ ca bhajan kokārasthāne kāvarṇaṃ pratipadyamāna ityarthaḥ | ata eva kākobhavan kāka iti niṣpadyamānassan ariṣṭaḥ vāyasavācaka iti yāvat | abhūt | vācyāvacakayostādātmyaṃ na vismartavyam | atra śrīkucābhibhavarūpatadduḥkhasādhanalakṣaṇasveṣṭārthalābhodyogātkokasya na tadalābhamātraṃ pratyuta kākatāvāptiparyantāniṣṭaprāptirityubhayaṃ darśitam || yathāvā tvanmukhatilakaṃ jetuṃ cāndramaso madabalādyadi kalaṅkaḥ| udvalgettadvijitaḥ kaṅko bhavitā madambalaṃ cojjhan || 1229 || he śrīriti sāmarthyāllabhyate | cāndramasaḥ kalaṅkaḥ madaśca balaṃ ca madabalaṃ samāhāradvaṃdvaikavacanam | śyāmalimātiśayagarvāt āśrayabalācca tvanmukhatilakaṃ jetuṃ abhibhavituṃ udvalget utpatedyadi tena tilakena vijitaḥ madaṃ garvaṃ balaṃ śaktiṃ ca ujjhan kaṅko bhavitā gṛdhraviśeṣatulyo bhavitā | gṛdhro hyāmiṣagṛdhnustaddaurlabhyasaulabhye avimṛśya sahasā'bhipatya yathā balīyobhirvihāyobhirabhihato dūraṃ dhāvettathā'yamapi kalaṅka iti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe madamba laṃ ca iti cchedaḥ| he madamba manmātaḥ! kalaṅkaḥ kalaṅkaśabdaḥ laṃ lakāraṃ, cakāro bhinnakramaḥ kaṅka ityanena saṃbadhyate | ujjhan kaṅkaśca bhavitā kaṅka iti ca niṣpatsyata ityarthaḥ | yadvā castvarthaḥ ujjhaṃśceti saṃbadhyate | laṃ tyajaṃstu kaṅkaiti bhavitetyarthaḥ | atrāpi kalaṅkasya śrīvadanatilakābhibhavarūpeṣṭārthodyogāttadanavāptiḥ kaṅkatvarūpotkaṭāniṣṭaprāptiśca śleṣamūlātiśayopajīvitā vakṣyamāṇasaṃbhāvanarūpeṇa nibaddhā || yathāvā nātha masārastava rucijayamīpsurupetya saprathamabhaṅgam | labdhvā'pi vibhavamagre visāratāṃ prāptavān jito'kṣibhyām || 1230 || he nātha saḥ prasiddhaḥ masāraḥ indranīlaḥ ‘masāra indranīle syāt' iti ‘masāragalvarkamukhaḥ' ityatra bhūṣaṇe kośa udāhṛtaḥ | tava ruceḥ jayaṃ abhibhavaṃ īpsussan prathamabhaṅgaṃ ādāveva parābhavam | pakṣe masāraśabdaḥ, saprathamabhaṅgamityatra sapratha mabhaṅgamiti cchedaḥ | he sapratheti saṃbuddhyantaṃ nāthetyasya viśeṣaṇam | prathayā prakhyātyā saha vartata iti saprathaḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | mabhaṅgaṃ makāralopaṃ upetya agre anantaraṃ ādibhāge ca vibhavaṃ prābhavaṃ jayasādhanabhūtamiti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe vi iti varṇasya bhavaṃ sattāṃ labdhvā'pi | apinā tadvibhavasyākiṃcitkaratā dyotyate | pakṣe apissamuccaye | na kevalaṃ makāralopaṃ kiṃtu tatraiva vikārasthitiṃ ca prāpyetyarthaḥ | visāratāṃ mīnatāṃ ‘visāraśśakulī ca' ityamaraḥ | nissāratāṃ daurbalyamiti ca gamyate | pakṣe visāra iti niṣpanna ityarthaḥ | akṣibhyāṃ tava nayanābhyāṃ jitaḥ | atrāpi pūrvavadevobhayam || yathāvā dānena tvadvijaye dhuri śabalāśojjhitā kathaṃcidatha | prāptā'pi kāntimatvaṃ nātha balākaiva bhavati na tu jetrī || 1231 || he nātha! śabalā kāmagavī dānena audāryeṇa karaṇena tvadvijaye tvatkarmakābhibhave viṣaye dhuri ādāveva āśojjhitā tyaktapratyāśetyarthaḥ | atha kathaṃcit kāntimatvaṃ kāntiricchā tadvattāṃ jayaviṣayakaspṛhāmityarthaḥ | ‘kāntiśśobhecchayoḥ striyām' iti medinī | dyutimattāmityapi gamyate | prāptā'pi balākaiva bisakaṇṭhikaiva bhavati | na tu tava jetrī tadvatkvāpyuḍḍīyate na tu tvāmabhibhavitumīṣṭa ityarthaḥ| pakṣe śabalā śabaleti śabdavyaktiḥ dhuri prathamabhāge śojjhitā śakāreṇa tyaktā atha kāntimattvaṃ kā iti varṇaḥ antimo yasya tat kāntimaṃ tasya bhāvaṃ takārasya 'anaci ca' iti dvitvam | ‘śaradaḥ kṛtārthatā' ityādāviva sāmānye napuṃsakam | prāptā'pi ante kāvarṇaghaṭitā satī balākaiva bhavati | na tu jetrīśabda ityarthaḥ | atrāpi pūrvavadeva sarvam || yathāvā bhagavanbalabhadra tvadvasanaśrīvijayalivsuratha madhye vyatyastahalākarṣaṇarabhasena balāhako bakovṛttaḥ || 1232 || he bhagavan balabhadra! nīlāṃmbaratvadyotanāyedam | balāhakaḥ vārivāhakaḥ nailyātiśayadyotanāyedam | tvadvasanaśriyaḥ vijayaṃ abhibhavaṃ lipsuḥ atha madhye asminnavasara eva paryastaṃ paritaḥ kṣiptaṃ yat halaṃ lāṅgalaṃ tadākarṣaṇarabhasena tvatkartṛkeṇeti bhāvaḥ | bakaḥ vṛttaḥ parāniṣṭaprāpaṇālābhasvāniṣṭaprāptimūlakamanaḥkhedavaśātsvakīyanaisargikaśyāmalimavidhuro bakavatpāṇḍura evābhūt na tu tvadvasanaśrīvijayena kamanīyaśyāmalimotkarṣamiti bhāvaḥ | bakavaddhyānaparo'bhavaditi vā | pakṣe balāhakaśabdaḥ madhye svāntarāle paryastau vyatyastau yau ha lā iti varṇau tayoḥ karṣaṇarabhasena utsāraṇena, paryastaṃ yathāsyāttathā halā iti varṇayorākarṣaṇarabhaseneti vā | ādau caramahavarṇasya anantaraṃ prāthamikalāvarṇasyotsāraṇenetyarthaḥ | bako vṛttaḥ baka iti niṣpanna ityarthaḥ || yathāvā tvannayanayugajigīṣākutukādabhyetya janani tadapāstaḥ | hariṇa ihakṣatimupayannagādiriṇatāṃ khagādripatimahile || 1233 || hariṇaḥ kuraṅgaḥ hariṇaśabdaśca | iha loke kṣatiṃ hānim | pakṣe inā ikāreṇa hakṣatiṃ hakārasya bhraṃśaṃ saṃbandhasāmānyaṣaṣṭhyāssamāsaḥ | upayan hakārasthāne ikāraṃ prāptavān san iriṇatāṃ śūnyatāṃ svarūpahānimityarthaḥ | pakṣe iriṇaśabdatāṃ agāt | 'atha triṣu viṣāṇaṃ syāt' ityupakramya ‘iriṇaṃ śūnyamūṣaram' iti ṇāntanānārtheṣvamaraḥ | ‘iriṇaṃ tūṣare śūnye' iti medinī ca || atra hariṇasya parāniṣṭaprāpaṇarūpeṣṭānavāptyaniṣṭaprāptī || yathāvā tvāṃ sarvagandhamacyuta saurabhataścandano yadi jigīṣuḥ | cakrabhidāṃ gantaiva krandana evātha bhavati manye'ham || 1234 || sarvagandhaṃ 'sarvakarmā sarvakāmassarvagandhaḥ' iti śrutaṃ 'aśabdamasparśam' ityādinā prākṛtagandhādiniṣedhāt aprākṛtāssvāsādhāraṇāḥ nityaniravadyāḥ niratiśayāssvabhogyabhūtāḥ kalyāṇāssarve guṇā asya santītyarthaḥ | īdṛśaṃ tvāṃ candanaḥ prākṛtaparimitagandhāśraya iti bhāvaḥ | saurabhataḥ jigīṣuryadi cakreṇa sudarśanena bhidāṃ bhedanaṃ ‘sādhanaṃ kṛtā' iti samāsaḥ | cakārasya kretivarṇena bhidāṃ nirasanaṃ ca gantaiva | atha īdṛgavasthāvāptyanantaraṃ krandana eva roditaiva, pakṣe krandanaśabda eva bhavatīti manye | atra candanasyeṣṭālābhāniṣṭalābhau saṃbhāvanayā nibaddhau || yathāvā tvatkararucivijayādbhuvi satkṛtimīpsvabhisamāhataṃ tābhyām | agre bahuhānyuditāvarṇamathābjaṃ jananyabhūnnyubjam || 1235 || he janani! abjaṃ agre ādau bahvī hāniryasya tadbahuhāni | uditaḥ avarṇaḥ parābhūtamityapavādo yasya tat uditāvarṇaṃ 'avarṇākṣepanirvādaparivādāpavādavat' ityamaraḥ | bahuhānyā uditāvarṇamiti vā | pakṣe bahu hā iti cchedaḥ | agre mukhabhāge bahu yathā tathā nyuditaṃ nyunā nyu iti varṇasamudāyena ditaṃ chinnaṃ nirastamiti yāvat | tādṛśaṃ avarṇaṃ akāro yasya tat nyuditāvarṇaṃ ‘ditaṃ chitaṃ vṛkṇam' ityamaraḥ | nyubjaṃ rujābhagnaṃ abhūt | ‘bhujanyubjau pāṇyupatāpayoḥ' iti nipātanātsādhuḥ | ‘nyubjo rujābhugne' ityamaraḥ | abjapadaṃ nyubjamiti niṣpannamiti vastusthitiḥ | hā iti khede | śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭam || yathāvā tvaccakramaṃśumālī cicchādayiṣussvarociṣā'bhyetya | kalito niraṃśukastanmahasā mālī bhavan hatastena || 1236 || tanmahasā cakratejasā | niraṃśukaḥ apahṛtavasanaḥ nirgalitakiraṇa iti ca | pakṣe aṃśuśabdavighaṭitaśca kalitaḥ mālī tannāmā mahādaityaḥ bhavan, aṃśumāliśabdaḥ aṃśuśabdavighaṭitatayā mālītyavaśiṣṭa ityarthaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || yathāvā mālūraphalaṃ śrīkucajayaphalamabhilaṣya tadanulūnamaram | māphalamityabhidhāvadvācyaṃ lipitastathā'nuśiṣṭamabhūt || 1237 || mālūrasya bilvasya phalaṃ śrīkucajayarūpaṃ phalaṃ prayojanaṃ abhilaṣya apekṣya araṃ drutaṃ tadanulūnaṃ tābhyāṃ kucābhyāṃ anulūnaṃ anantarameva cchinnaṃ na tu vilambena, parājitamiti yāvat | māphalamiti mā bhūtsvoddiṣṭaprayojanaṃ 'jīvanbhadrāṇipaśyati' ityuktanayena kathamapi jīveyamiti svābhilaṣitasādhanānīśvaratayā nairāśyaṃ dadhānamiti bhāvaḥ | abhidhāvat pratipakṣabhiyā abhitaḥ palāyamānam | aṃbhipūrvakāddhāvaterlaṭaśśatā | tathā lipitaḥ tādṛśakarmaphalasūcakavaidhasalalāṭarekhāvaśāt anuśiṣṭaṃ prāṇamātrāvaśeṣaṃ sat vācyaṃ nirvīryāmidamiti kutsanīyaṃ 'vācyaṃ tu kutsite hīne vacanīye ca vācyavat' iti medinī, abhūt | pakṣe mālūraphalamitipadaṃ, śabdārthayostādātmyam, tadanu lakṣmīkucajayaphalābhilāṣānantaraṃ lūnaṃ lūvarṇena nyūnaṃ araṃ avidyamānarephaṃ ca sat lipitaḥ svaghaṭakākṣaraiḥ māphalamiti suśiṣṭaṃ samyagavaśiṣṭaṃ abhidhāvat abhidhā sākṣātsaṃketaviṣayajñānahetubhūtaśśabdaniṣṭho mukhyo vyāpāraḥ 'vyāpāraśśakyadhīheturmukhyaśśabdagatoSbhidhā' iti lakṣaṇāt, sā'syāstīti tathoktaṃ sat, matup | vācyaṃ vaktavyaṃ abhūt | śrīphalarūpārthaviṣayakaśaktimattayā vyavahāryamāsīditi bhāvaḥ | yadvā mālūraphalarūpārtha eva lipitaḥ svavācakaśabdasthavarṇaiḥ tathā
