uktarītyā lūravarṇatyāgena suśiṣṭaṃ samyagavaśiṣṭaṃ sat, māphalamiti abhidhā nāmadheyaṃ sā'syāstītyabhidhāvat, svavācakamāphalarūpaśabdavatsat vācyaṃ vaktuṃ yogyaṃ abhūt, svābhidheyārthamajahadeva vyavahārārhamāsīdityarthaḥ | māphalaṃ śrīphalam | bilvasya māphalavaṃ ca ‘vanaspatistava vṛkṣo'tha bilvaḥ' iti śruteḥ | ‘bilvo lakṣmyāḥ kare'bhavat' iti vidyāraṇyabhāṣyadhṛtavāmanapurāṇāt ‘tanumadhyā svahastotthaṃ bilvaṃ tarumupāśritā' iti pṛthvīdharabhāṣyadhṛtabhārgavatantravacanācceti dhyeyam | phalati niṣpadyata iti phalaḥ pacādyac | māyāḥ phalaḥ māphalaḥ lakṣmīkaraniṣpannatvānmāphalaśabdo bilvavācī | tasya vikāraḥ phalaṃ māphalam | yadvā māpradāni śrīpradāni phalāni yasya sa iti māphalaḥ śākapārthiva itivanmadhyamapadalopi samāsaḥ | ‘tasya phalāni tapasā nudantu māyāntarāyāśca bāhyā alakṣmīḥ' ityalakṣmyapanodakatvaśravaṇācchrīpradaphala ityarthaḥ | tataḥ phalārthe vaikārikāṇo luk | māphalaśabdasya ‘bilve śāṇḍilyaśailṛṣau mālūraśrīphalavapi, iti kośaghaṭakaśrīphalaśabdavadbilvābhidhāyitvaṃ lakṣmīpatyādiśabdānāṃ ‘śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ' ityādikośaghaṭakaśrīpatyādiśabdānāṃ puruṣottamābhidhāyakatvamiveti dhyeyam | atra mālūraphalasya parānarthaprāpaṇarūpeṣṭānavāptyaniṣṭaprāptī nibaddhe || yathāvā mālūraṃ harimahile saṃnaddhaṃ tava kucābhibhavane tābhyām | ekādimābhighātācchātaṃ śritanīrakaṃ ca śālūkamabhūt || 1238 || he harimahile! mālūrasya vikāraḥ phalaṃ mālūram | vaikārikāṇo luk, klībamiti bhāvaḥ | tava kucayoḥ abhibhavane nyūnīkaraṇe sannaddhaṃ ata eva tābhyāṃ tava kucābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ pumbhyāmiti bhāvaḥ | ekasmāt ādimāt ādyāt abhighātāt prahārādeva chātaṃ chinnaṃ ‘cho chedane' asmātkarmaṇi ktaḥ | 'ādecaḥ' ityātvam | ‘chinnaṃ chātam' ityamaraḥ| śātamiti vā cchedaḥ | śātaṃ tanūkṛtaṃ karśitamityarthaḥ | ‘śo tanūkaraṇe' asmāt ktaḥ, ātvaṃ ca prāgvat | ata eva śritanīrakaṃ śritaṃ nīraṃ yena tattathoktaṃ ca sat | bahuvrīhau śeṣādvibhāṣā' iti kap | punaḥ prahārabhiyā jale nimagnamita bhāvaḥ | śalūkaṃ ‘saugandhikaṃ tu kahlāram' ityupakramya ‘śālūkameṣāṃ kandassyāt' ityamaraḥ | śalyate śalati vā ‘śala calanasaṃvaraṇayoḥ' ‘śalimaṇḍibhyāmūkaṇ' iti ūkaṇpratyayaḥ | idaṃ ca sudhāyāṃ spaṣṭam | pakṣe mālūramiti padaṃ ekasya ādeḥ prāthamikasya mākārasya abhighātāt dhvaṃsanaṃ prāpya śātaṃ śāṃ śākāraṃ atati satataṃ gacchatīti tathoktaṃ ‘ata sātatyagamane' karmaṇyaṇ | śritanīrakaṃ nirgamito raḥ rephaḥ yena saḥ nīraḥ, nīraḥ kaḥ kakāraḥ śrito yena tattathoktaṃ ca lat , mākārasthāne śākāraṃ rephasthāne kakāraṃ ca prāptaṃ śālūkamiti niṣpannamityarthaḥ | atra mālūrasya śrīkucābhibhavanarūpeṣṭānavāptiḥ abhighātādinā śālūkatvarūpāniṣṭāvāptiśca || yathāvā gatigarvādabhiyaṃstvāṃ mukhavātyādhūta uparigata evāgre | vāraṇa uraṇassamajani na puraskurute raṇaṃ tadadyāpyeṣaḥ || 1239 || he bhagavan! vāraṇaḥ gatigarvāt gamanagambhīryaprayuktādahaṃkārāt abhiyan abhiyogārthamabhimukhaṃ gacchan san mukhavātyādhūtaḥ | asya tavetyādiḥ | tava mukhavātyayā mukhaniśvāsaphūtkārabhūmnaiva dhūtaḥ | vātānāṃ samūho vātyā 'pāśādibhyo yaḥ' iti sāmūhiko yapratyayaḥ | 'tal bṛnde yenikaḍyactrāḥ' ityanuśāsanāt strītvam | anena strīparājitatvaṃ dyotyate | ata eva agre anantaraṃ uparigata eva kvāpi gagane uṭṭaṅkitassannityarthaḥ| uraṇaḥ meṣaḥ ajani | meṣajanmābhajadityarthaḥ | tadvannirvīryo'bhavaditi vā | gagane meṣarāśitāṃ gata ityapi gamyate | ata eva eṣaḥ vāraṇaḥ uraṇo vā adyāpi raṇaṃ yuddhaṃ na puraskurute nādriyate parābhavabhayāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe vāraṇa iti śabdaḥ mukhabhūto yo vākaraḥ tasmin atyādhūtaḥ nirastavākāra ityarthaḥ | agre ādau anantaraṃ vā uparigataḥ uvarṇayuktaḥ uraṇa iti niṣpannaḥ raṇaṃ rephaṇakārarūpavarṇasamudayaṃ adyāpi na puraskurute paścādeva bibharti | vāraṇoraṇaśabdayorādau raṇavarṇādarśanātpāścādeva taddarśanācceti bhāvaḥ | atra vāraṇasya bhagavadgatinyūnīkaraṇarūpaparāniṣṭaprāpaṇalakṣaṇeṣṭānavāptiruraṇatvarūpāniṣṭāvāptiśca || yathāvā abhibhavituṃ tava vadanaṃ kutukādetyāntarālakanirastaḥ | sa niśākaro niśāro bhavanhimānilanivāraṇaṃ vidadhe || 1240 || he amba! saḥ jagadāhlādadāyitayā prasiddhaḥ niśākaraḥ tava vadanaṃ abhibhavituṃ kutukādetya antarā madhye alakaiḥ cūrṇakuntalaireva nirastaḥ | īdṛśasya sākṣātpratipakṣatvadvadanābhibhavodavīyāniti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe niśākaraśabdaḥ antarāle svaghaṭakavarṇamadhye kanirastaḥ nirastakakārassannityarthaḥ | niśāro bhavan himānilanivāraṇaprāvaraṇarūpo bhavan ‘niśārassyātprāvaraṇe himanilanivāraṇe' ityamaraḥ | pakṣe niśāraśabdo bhavannityarthaḥ | himānilanivāraṇaṃ tava vā anyasya vā kiṃkarībhūyeti bhāvaḥ | vidadhe | atra niśākarasya śrīvadanābhibhavānavāptiniśāratvarūpāniṣṭāvāptiśca | yathāvā tāvakakīrtivijityai saṃmukhamupayannathāntarā bhagavan | śāsanataścyutavarṇassaśaṅka evābhavatkhalu śaśāṅkaḥ || 1241 || he bhagavan ! śaśāṅkaḥ tāvakakīrteḥ vijityai vijayaṃ kartuṃ kutukāt saṃmukhaṃ abhimukhaṃ upayan | pakṣe mukhaṃ sarvavarṇebhyopyādimaṃ saṃ sakāraṃ prāpnuvan san, atha avilambenaiva antarā asminnevāvasara ityarthaḥ | pakṣe madhyabhāge | śāsanataḥ tadatikramānurūpāttvatkṛtācchikṣaṇāt | pakṣe śā iti varṇasya asanataḥ nirasanāt | cyutavarṇaḥ galitatejāḥ nirastākṣaraśca san saśaṅka eva savyadha eva abhavat | pakṣe śaśāṅkaśabdaḥ ādau sakāranyasanena madhye śāvarṇabhraṃśanena ca saśaṅka iti niṣpanna ityarthaḥ || yathāvā tvannakhajigīṣuretaistalātalihato'ntato visargamayan | dūno bhūtvā bhagavanninduḥ kevalamināśritaḥ prāṇīt || 1242 || he bhagavan! induḥ tvannakhajigīṣuḥ ata eva taiḥ nakhaiḥ talātali talaistalaiḥ prahṛtyedaṃ pravṛttaṃ yuddhaṃ talātali | tasmin hataḥ prahṛtaḥ antataḥ visargaṃ ayan prāpnuvan dayayā jīveti dūramutsṛṣṭa iti bhāvaḥ | ata eva atitarāṃ dūnaḥ paritaptaḥ bhūtvā kevalaṃ ināśritaḥ aprasiddhaprabhusamāśritaḥ prāṇīt | yadvā ināśritaḥ kaṃcitprabhumāśritaḥ kevalaṃ prāṇīditi yojanā | prāṇadhāraṇamātramakārṣīt na tu tānabhibhavituṃ prābhavaditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe induśabdaḥ antato visargaṃ visarjanīyaṃ ayan anujjhitavisargaḥ kevalaṃ dūnaḥ duvarṇanyūno bhūtvā inā in iti varṇasamudayena śritaḥ prāṇīt svarūpasattāmalabhatetyarthaḥ | anyatsarvaṃ prāgvat || yathāvā navyena tvanmahasā parākṛto dyocyutassvayaṃ pratanaḥ | pradyotanaḥ praharaṇādavākśirāssannato'bha vadbhagavan || 1243 || he bhagavan! pradyotanaḥ bhānuḥ tvanmahovijigīṣuriti bhāvaḥ | navyena nūtanena yūneti yāvat | stavyeneti vastusthitiḥ | ‘ṇu stutau' aco yat' iti yat | tava mahasā tejasā parākṛtaḥ tiraskṛtaḥ ata eva dyocyutaḥ antarikṣāt svargādvā bhraṣṭaḥ | tatra hetuḥ svayaṃpratana iti | pratanaḥ purāṇaḥ jīrṇa iti yāvat | 'naśca purāṇe prāt' iti ṭyul | ‘purāṇapratanapratnapurātanacirantanāḥ' ityamaraḥ | svayaṃ sthavirastaruṇena tvanmahasā spardhamānaḥ kathaṃ tena nābhibhūyeteti bhāvaḥ | praharaṇāt tvattejaḥkṛtātprahārāt avākchirāḥ avākkṛtaśirāssan nataḥ praṇataḥ abhavat, tatprahārabhagno namitaśirāśśaraṇaṃ gata iti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe pradyotanaśabdaḥ dyocyutaḥ dyo iti varṇaścyuto yasmātsa tathoktassan pratanaḥ pratama iti niṣanno'bhavat | atha praharaṇāt pra itivarṇasamudayalopāt taṃ prāpyetyarthaḥ | lyablope pañcamī | avākśirāssan vilomo bhavanniti yāvat | nataḥ abhūt nata iti niṣpanno'bhūt | pratanaśabdaḥ pravarṇalopānantaraṃ avaśiṣṭasya ta na iti varṇadvayasya vaiparītyena nata iti niṣpanna iti nirgalito'rthaḥ | atra pradyotanasya bhagavanmahobhibhavecchā samabhivyāhāravaśādgamyā, aniṣṭaprāptistu sphuṭaiva | gatamanyat || yathāvā tvadvacanarasaparāstaṃ rasālakhaṇḍaṃ rasonakādyamabhūt | bhūtvā'tha kālakhaṇḍaṃ kravyādāsvādyamajani janani tataḥ || 1244 || he janani! rasālakhaṇḍaṃ ikṣukhaṇḍaṃ sahakāraphalakhaṇḍaṃ vā | tvadvacanarasaspardhīti bhāvaḥ | tvadvacanarasena parāstaṃ sat rasonakādyaṃ rasonakānāṃ laśunānāṃ ādyaṃ agryaṃ | rasonakaṃ ca tat ādyaṃ ceti vā | rasonakarūpabhakṣyavastu abhūt | 'laśunaṃ gṛñjanāriṣṭamahākandarasonakāḥ' ityamaraḥ | prathamatassāmānyena madhuratayā pratītamapi svasvarūpāparicintanena madhuratamaśrīvacanarasābhibhavapravṛttatayā tattiraskṛtaṃ durgandhi samajaniṣṭeti bhāvaḥ | naitāvadeva, atha anantaraṃ kālakhaṇḍaṃ yakṛdākhyamāṃsakhaṇḍaṃ bhūtvā 'kālakhaṇḍayakṛtī tu same ime' ityamaraḥ | kravyamadantīti kravyādaḥ āmamāṃsāśinaḥ pakṣyādayo rākṣasā vā | ‘kravyānmāṃsāśirakṣasoḥ' iti ratnamālā | teṣāṃ āsvādyaṃ ajani, na tu rasasāravidāmiti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe rasālakhaṇḍamiti padaṃ rasonaṃ rephasākārābhyāṃ hīnaṃ tadrahitamityarthaḥ | kādyaṃ kākāra evādyo yasya tat prathamataḥ kākāraghaṭitamityarthaḥ | rasonaṃ ca tat kādyaṃ ceti viśeṣaṇobhayapadasamāsaḥ | evaṃ bhūtvā kālakhaṇḍamiti niṣpannamityarthaḥ | atra rasālakhaṇḍasya śrīvacanarasaparibubhūṣostadanavāptiḥ rasonakatvādyaniṣṭapratilambhaśca || yathāvā vaiśvānarastvadojasspardhī tenāhato'tha vaibhraṣṭaḥ | vyūṣmāhāraṃ muñcanvānaratāmetya vāna evānīt || 1245 || he bhagavan! vaiśvānaraḥ vahniḥ vaiśvānaraśabdaśca | tayostādātmyam | tava ojasā pratāpena spardhata iti tathoktaḥ | ata eva tena āhataḥ abhihataḥ atha anantarameva bhraṣṭaḥ | vaiśabdosvadhāraṇe | 'syurevaṃ tu punarvaiva' ityamaravacanasya ‘punarvai ca' iti subhūtinā paṭhitatvāt | etacca sudhāyāṃ spaṣṭam | adhaḥ patita evetyarthaḥ | śabdapakṣe vaibhraṣṭa iti samastaṃ padam | vaiityākārakavarṇabhraṃśaṃ prāpta ityarthaḥ | vyūṣmā vigatauṣṇyaḥ śāntapratāpa iti yāvat| pakṣe vigaśakāra ityarthaḥ | 'śaṣasahā ūṣmāṇaḥ' iti śakārasyoṣmasaṃjñāvidhānāt | vānaratāmetya apratipattimūḍhahṛdayatayā kapivadaticapalo bhūtveti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe vai iti sasvaravyañjanasya ś iti kevalavyañjanasya cāpagame vānara ityavaśiṣṭa ityarthaḥ | āhāraṃ abhyavahāraṃ muñcan parābhavamūlakakhedena prāyopaveśaṃ kurvanniti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe hā iti cchedaḥ | raṃ rephaṃ muñcan vānaḥ śuṣka eva san ānīt kathaṃcitprāṇānadhārṣīt | ‘vānaśśuṣke śuṣkaphale' iti ratnamālā | ‘vānaśśuṣkaphale śuṣke sīvane gamane kaṭe' iti hemaśca | 'pai o vai śoṣaṇe' ‘gatyārthakarmaka' ityādinā ktaḥ | 'oditaśca' iti tasya natvam | ‘ādeca upadeśe'śiti' ityātvam | pakṣe rephasyāpi lope va na ityavaśiṣṭassan ānīt | tāvanmātreṇa sattāmalabhateti bhāvaḥ | atra vaiśvānarasya iṣṭānavaptyaniṣṭaprāptī || yathāvā ādyantayorvikalitastava kucayugalena kamalamukulo'mba | ādyantasāratāptyā'malamukuro'pyatha dhutaḥ kapolābhyām || 1246 || he amba! kamalamukulaḥ padmakośaḥ mṛdurekākī ceti bhāvaḥ | tava kucayugalena kaṭhinatareṇa itaretaradattasāhyena dvaṃdvabhūteneti bhāvaḥ | ādyantayoḥ adāvante ca sarvatheti bhāvaḥ | vikalitaḥ vikalaḥ kṛtaḥ śaktyādisākalyavidhuraḥ kṛtaḥ svena spardhamānaḥ parāsta iti bhāvaḥ | atha anantaraṃ ādyantayoḥ sāraḥ balaṃ yasya tattathoktaṃ, tasya bhāvaḥ ādyantasāratā, tasyāḥ āptyā prāptyā sarvathā śaktyādimattālābhena tvatpraticikīrṣuriti bhāvaḥ | amalamukurassannapi nirmalādarśajanma labdhavānapīti bhāvaḥ | tava kapolābhyāṃ dhutaḥ dūraṃ parāstaḥ sāravato'pyekasya sāravattarābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ spardhamānasya sarvadhā paribhava eva bhaviteti bhāvaḥ | anyatra kamalamukulaśabdaḥ ādyantayoḥ vikalitaḥ vibhraṃśitau kalau yasya sa tathoktaḥ kṛtaḥ | krameṇādau kakārasya ante lakārasya ca bhraṃśaṃ prāpita iti bhāvaḥ | atha ādyantayoḥ sāratāptyā aśca raśca arau arābhyāṃ saha vartata iti sāraḥ, tasya bhāvaḥ sāratā tadāptyā | adau akārasya ante rephasya ca sambandheneti bhāvaḥ | amalamukuraḥ amalamukuraśabdo bhavannityarthaḥ | atra kamalamukulasya na kevalaṃ śrīkucayugalānarthaprāpaṇarūpeṣṭānavāptiḥ kiṃtu vikalitatvādyaniṣṭaprāptiśca | evaṃ tasyaivāmalamukugrūpajanmāntare'pi na kevalaṃ śrīkapolaparibhavarūpeṣṭālābhaḥ kiṃtu tābhyāṃ svasya dhūnanarūpāniṣṭapratilambhaśca | evaṃ sarvatrāpi bodhyam || yathāvā nijavijayepsu tavādhararucā parāstaṃ svavarṇatassrastam | ghuṇatāṃ prapadya ghusṛṇaṃ līnaṃ kāṣṭhāntare kvacitsuṣire || 1247 || he amba! ghusṛṇaṃ kāśmīrajaṃ kuṃkumamityarthaḥ | nijavijayepsu svakartṛkatvadadharakarmakābhibhavaprepsu | ata eva tava adhararucā | parāstaṃ avadhīritaṃ ata eva svavarṇataḥ svakīyasuṣamāyā apīti yāvat | srastaṃ dhvastaṃ nistejaskamiti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe ghusṛṇamiti padaṃ svavarṇataḥ ādyāditvātsaptamyāstasiḥ | svaghaṭakavarṇeṣvityarthaḥ | srastaḥ sṛ iti varṇaḥ astaḥ nirastaḥ yasya tattathoktam | sṛ asta iti sthite yaṇādeśaḥ | nissāritasṛkāraṃ sadityarthaḥ | ghuṇatāṃ kīṭatāṃ pakṣe ghuṇaśabdatāṃ prapadya kāṣṭhāntare svanivāsādbhraṣṭaṃ kvāpi digantare, tatrāpi kvacitsuṣire kvāpi koṇe | kāṣṭhāntare dārvantare tatrāpi kvacicchidre iti copaskāryam| ghuṇānāṃ dārucchidrāntarāvasthānasya prasiddhatvāt | līnaṃ layaṃ prāptam || yathāvā tvatparimalaviddho'gururagamadhyastho'pyarusphuranmūrtiḥ | madhyasthaguragurussannaguragurāsīttato jagajjanani || 1248 || he jagajjanani! agaruḥ rājārhākhyagandhadravyaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | 'vaṃśakāgarurājārhalohakrimijajo'ṅgakam' ityamaraḥ | pulliṃṅgo'pyayaṃ, tathāca dvirūpakośe śrīharṣaḥ ‘agaruścāguruśca' iti | hemacandro'pyabhidhānacintāmaṇau ‘agurustvagarau laghau | śiṃśupāyām' iti | vopālitādayo'pyevam | prayogaśca ‘śītakṛtte'gurormadaḥ' iti | śrīparimalābhibubhūṣuriti gamyate | agamadhyastho'pi tarūṇāṃ girīṇāṃ vā madhye sthito'pi | anena dhanvadurgaṃ mahīdurgamabdurgaṃ vārkṣameva vā | nṛdurgaṃ giridurgaṃ vā samāśritya vasetpuram || sarveṇāpi prayatnena giridurgaṃ samāśrayet | eṣāṃ hi bāhuguṇyena giridurgaṃ viśiṣyate || ityuktaprakāreṇa agadurgasthitatvaṃ vyajyate | tvatparimalena tvadaṅgasaurabheṇa | asya vīrapuruṣatvaṃ gamyate vakṣyamāṇārthānuguṇyāt | viddhaḥ śastrādinā kṣataḥ parāsta iti tatvam | ata eva arurbhiḥ vraṇaiḥ sphurantī mūrtiryasya sa tathoktaḥ | ‘vraṇo'striyāmīrmamaruḥ' ityamaraḥ | pakṣe agaruḥ agaruśabdaḥ gaḥ gakāraḥ madhyastho yasya sa na bhavatītyagamadhyasthaḥ | tathā'pi arusphuranmūrtiḥ akāraruvarṇābhyāṃ prakāśamānasvarūpaḥ gakāracyutāvapi aru iti varṇadvayamātrāvaśiṣṭa ityarthaḥ | tataḥ madhyasthaguḥ madhye śarīramadhye sthagu uronissṛtonnatavikṛtāvayavaviśeṣo yasya sa tathoktaḥ ‘tavedaṃ sthagu yaddīrgham' ityatra śrīrāmāyaṇabhūṣaṇe evameva vivṛtam | atimātraviddhatayā'ntarbhagnonnaddhāsthiviśeṣavikṛta iti bhāvaḥ | ata eva aguruḥ gauravahīna ityarthaḥ | pakṣe madhyasthaḥ guḥ guvarṇo yasya tathoktassan | avaśiṣṭaḥ aruśabdaḥ madhye guvarṇanyasanena agururiti niṣpannassannityarthaḥ | aruraguriti samastaṃ padam | arurbhiḥ vraṇaiḥ avidyamānā gauryasya tathoktaḥ āsīt ‘gostriyoḥ' iti hrasve eca igādeśaḥ | vraṇavedanāsaṃbhrāntatayā 'diśo me vipraṇaśyanti' ityuktarītyā vinaṣṭadigvivekaḥ praṇaṣṭavāgvyavahāro vā pratihatadṛṣṭiprasaro vā'bhavadityarthaḥ | 'svargeṣupaśuvāgvajridiṅnetraghṛṇibhūjale | lakṣyadṛṣṭyā striyāṃ puṃsi gauḥ' ityamaraḥ | nityapulliṅgaṃ parimalaśabdaṃ vibhāṣitapuṃstvaṃ agaruśabdaṃ ca prayuñcānasya kaverayamāśayaḥ nityapauruṣeṇa puṃsā kādācitkapauruṣaśālī kaścitpumān spardhamānastenāvadhīrita īdṛśīṃ duravasthāṃ prāpnuyādeveti | pakṣe aruḥ ruvarṇavidhuraḥ aguḥ aguriti niṣpanno'bhūdityarthaḥ | prathamaṃ aguriti sthitaḥ tato gakāralope arurbhūtvā tataḥ aruvarṇayorantare guvarṇanyāse agururiti tataśca ruvarṇalope aguriti niṣpanno'bhūdayaṃ śabda iti nirgalito'rthaḥ || yathāvā kīrastava tanurucijayamīpsurvidhutastayā śriyaḥ kānta | vyatyāsitasvaravyañjanaḥ karī bhavatu tadgatimiyātkim || 1249 || he śriyaḥ kānta! kīraḥ śukaḥ ‘kīraśukau samau' ityamaraḥ | tvattanurucijayaṃ īpsuḥ haritaśyāmalavarṇayoraikyasya kavisamayasiddhatvācchukasya bhagavattanurucijayepsutoktiḥ | tathā coktamalaṃkāraśekhare kamalasaṃpadoḥ kṛṣṇaharitornāgasarpayoḥ | pītalohitayossvarṇaparāgāgniśikhādiṣu || candre śaśaiṇayoḥ kāmadhvaje makaramatsyayoḥ | dānavāsuradaityānāmaikyamevābhisaṃhitam || iti | ata eva ‘śukāṅganīlopalanirmitānām' ityādyupapattiḥ | ata eva tayā tvattanvā tadrucā vā vidhutassan, strīparābhūtatvaṃ dyotyate | vyatyāsite svaravyañjane svaraḥ kaṇṭhajanyadhvaniḥ vyañjanaṃ haritavarṇatvādicihnaṃ cañcupakṣādyavayavo vā yena sa tathoktassan, svapratipakṣabhagavattanurucijayo'nena rūpeṇa duṣkara iti rūpāntaraprepsayā prāktanarūpa tyajanniti bhāvaḥ | karī bhavatu gaja eva bhavatu | alpasvarūpakīratvaṃ vihāya mahāvayavo gaja eva bhavatu | tāvatā'pi tadgatiṃ tvattanusthitiṃ svadrucisthitiṃ vā | sā gatistadgatiḥ tāṃ tathā | gabhīrodāraṃ tvadgamanaṃ ca iyātkiṃ vindetkiṃ, na vindedeva | na hi lāvaṇyavidhuranailyaśarīrasthaulyādiparigrahamātreṇa mayūrakakaṇṭhamecakalokottarabhagavaddivyavigraharucigatyādikaṃ sulabhamiti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe kīra iti śabdaḥ vyatyāsitasvaravyañjanaḥ svarau īkāraḥ akāraścetyajvarṇau vyatyāsitau yayoste | tādṛśe vyañjane k r iti kakārarepharūpe halvarṇe yasya sa tathoktaḥ, bahuvrīhi garbhabahuvrīhiḥ | īkārākārarūpājvarṇayoreva vyatyayaḥ na tu kakārarepharūpahalvarṇayoriti bhāvaḥ | tathā sati kīraśabdaḥ karīti niṣpadyatāmityabhiprāyaḥ | atra kīreti prakṛtimātrasyaiva vivakṣā na tu supratyayaviśiṣṭasya | 'svaro'kārādimātrāsu madhyamādiṣu ca dhvanau' iti, ‘vyañjanaṃ śmaśrucihnayoḥ | temane'vayave kādau' iti ca viśvahemacandrau | atra kīrasya na kevalaṃ bhagavattanurucivijayālābhaḥ, kiṃtu pūrvasiddharucihānirūpāniṣṭalābhaśca || yathāvā kṛtamukhatāṃ rāghava tava kṛtahastatvaṃ ca śithi layitumicchan | bhagnamukhaḥ prathamaraṇe tvayā daśāsyassvayaṃ vihasto'bhūt || 1250 || kṛtamukhatāṃ praśastavadanatvamiti yāvat | kuśalatvamiti vastusthitiḥ | ‘vaijñānikaḥ kṛtamukhā kṛtī kuśala ityapi' ityamaraḥ | kṛtahastatāṃ praśastapāṇimattāmiti yāvat | śarābhyāsaśikṣitahastatvamiti tattvam | ‘kṛtahastassuprayogaḥ' ityamaraḥ | bhagnamukhaḥ mukhabhaṅgaṃ prāpitaḥ | parābhūta iti tu tatvam | vihastaḥ hastavidhuritaḥ vyākulaśca ‘vihastavyākulau samau' ityamaraḥ | spaṣṭamanyat | atra daśāsyasya rāghavakṛtamukhatvakṛtahastatvaśithilīkaraṇalakṣaṇaparāniṣṭaprāpaṇarūpeṣṭānavāptiḥ svasya tādṛśāniṣṭaprāptiśca || yathāvā mithilādhināthatanayāṃ virāmayituyudyato bhavantamapi | rajanīcarapatirajani svayaṃ virāmo dineśavaṃśamaṇe || 1251 || mithilādhināthatanayāṃ virāmayituṃ rāmavidhurāṃ kartuṃ bhavantaṃ rāmāvirahitaṃ kartuṃ viyuktapatnīkaṃ vidhātum | svayameva virāmaḥ rāmavidhurito rāmāvidhuritaśca | vastutastu svayaṃ virāmo'vasānaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ ajani | spaṣṭamitarat | atrāpi pūrvavadeva sarvaṃ draṣṭavyam || yathāvā tvatkucaparibhūtaṃ tāvabhibhavituṃ śrīśśamantato dhūnvat | kalaśamatha vaiśasaṃgatamagre bhūtvā'pi śakalamevāsīt || 1252 || he śrīḥ! kalaśaṃ kumbhaḥ 'kalaśastu triṣu' ityamaraḥ | klībamekamiti bhāvaḥ | tvatkucābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ pumbhyāmiti bhāvaḥ | paribhūtaṃ ata eva śamaṃ śāntiṃ dhūnvat, kruddhaṃ saditi yāvat | anyatra kalaśaṃ kalaśapadaṃ antataḥ ante vidyamānaṃ śaṃ śakāraṃ dhūnvat visṛjat sat agre bhūtvā tvatkucayoḥ puraḥ sthitvā'pi dvaṃdvayuddhārthamiti bhāvaḥ | vaiśasaṃ viśasanaṃ kucakartṛkaṃ hiṃsanaṃ gataṃ prāptaṃ sat | itaratra agre mukhabhāge vai iti bhinnaṃ padaṃ, śasaṃgataṃ śakāreṇa saṃbaddhaṃ bhūtvā śakalameva khaṇḍitameva | pakṣe śakalamityeva niṣpannamāsīdityarthaḥ || yathāvā avagaṇitastava vacasā śucirdvijo hanta cāruvāko'pi | bhavati rame'lasadūnaścārvākassādhu viprakṛṣṭo'nte || 1253 || he rame! śuciḥ viśadaḥ dvijaḥ khagaḥ haṃsa ityarthaḥ | śuddho vipra iti ca gamyate | cāruḥ vāko vacanaṃ yasya saḥ cāruvākaḥ | śravaṇasubhagavacanaḥ śāstrīyatayā manohārivacanaśca | vāka ityatra vacerbhāve ghaṅi ‘cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ' iti kutvam | tathāvidho'pi tava vacasā vacanena lakṣmītantrādirūpaśāstreṇetyapi gamyate | avagaṇitaḥ tena spardhamāno'vamata ityarthaḥ | mahilālāpānāṃ marālālāpasādharmyaṃ ca ālāpaistulitaravāṇi mādhavīnāṃ mādhuryādamalapatatriṇāṃ kulāni || ityādau prasiddhyati | ata eva alasaḥ pratikartumapaṭuḥ dūnaḥ paritaptaśca alasadūnaḥ viśeṣaṇobhayapadakarmadhārayaḥ | ata eva ante dūratarapradeśe sādhavo ye viprāḥ taiḥ kṛṣṭaḥ niṣkāsitaḥ sādhūnāṃ satāṃ viprakṛṣṭaḥ dūrastha iti vā | 'syāddūraṃ viprakṛṣṭakam' ityamaraḥ | bahiṣkṛta iti bhāvaḥ | sādhu yathāsyāttathā vīnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ prakṛṣṭaḥ śreṣṭha iti vastusthitiḥ | cārvākaḥ cārvākamatāvalambī bhavati | anupādeyavacano bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | yathocyate caturviṃśatimate arhaccārvākavākyāni buddhādipaṭhitāni ca | vipralambhakavākyāni tāni sarvāṇi varjayet || iti | pakṣe bhavatīti saṃbuddhyantam | he bhavati! pūjye ityarthaḥ | alasadūna ityatra alasat ūnaḥ iti cchedaḥ | cāruvākaśabdaḥ ūnaḥ ukāreṇa nyūnaḥ cārvāka iti niṣpannassan alasaditi yojanā | lasaterlaṅ | yadvā alasat ralayorabhedāt arasat jaladavannirarthakaṃ śabdamakarot akrandaditi yāvat | ‘rasa śabde' asmādbhauvādikāllaṅ | atra śrīvacanābhibhavecchoramaladvijasya na tadalābha eva, paraṃ tu tadavagaṇitatayā alasadūnatvādyaniṣṭapratilambhaśca śabdārthatādatmyāvalambiśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyātiśayasaubhāgyasamāsāditotkarṣa iti dhyeyam || yathāvā amba tavoruspardhinyāsīdbata kadalikāpadā'bhihatā | kalikā satyatha nakharairvṛddhā bhūtvā'tha kālikā cikuraiḥ || 1254 || he amba! kadalikā rambhā | strī ekākinīti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe kadaliketi śabdavyaktiḥ tava ūrubhyāṃ 'sakthi klībe pumānūruḥ' ityamaraḥ, dvābhyāṃ pumbhyāmiti bhāvaḥ, spardhata ityūruspardhinī satī, spardhā saṃgharṣaḥ sa ca parābhibhavecchā | ata eva padā pādena tvayeti śeṣaḥ | abhihatā āsīt | pakṣe apadeti cchedaḥ | abhihatā satī apadā apahṛtadakārā āsīdityarthaḥ | atha kalikā satī korakurūpā satī rūpāntaraparigraheṇa yatkiṃcittvadvastunirāsato vairaśuddhiṃ cikīrṣantīti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe kadalikāśabdavyaktiḥ dakārotsāraṇena kaliketi niṣpannetyarthaḥ | 'kalikā korakaḥ pumān' ityamaraḥ | tava nakharaiḥ nakhaiḥ abhihatā parājitā āsīt | atha vṛddhā abhivṛddhā prauḍhā satī kālikā meghasaṃhatiḥ bhūtvā tajjanmalabdhveti bhāvaḥ | tava cikuraiḥ abhihatā abhibhūtā āsīt | kālikā durgādevī bhūtvā'pīti gamyate | 'kālikā yoginībhidi | svarṇādidoṣe meghālyāṃ surāgauryornavāmbude' iti hemaḥ | pakṣe vṛddhā kaliketi śabdavyaktiḥ āderaco vṛddhiṃ prāpya vṛddhasaṃjñā satī 'vṛddhiryasyācāmādistadvṛddham' ityanuśāsanāt kāliketi niniṣpadyamānetyarthaḥ | atra kadalikāyāssarvadhā'pi lakṣmyā ūrvādyabhibhavaṃrūpānarthaprāpaṇarūpeṣṭānavāptiḥ pādāhananādyaniṣṭaparaṃparāvāptiśca nibaddhā || yathāvā tvattanujayāya jahatī pratikūlādyantakākarūpatvam | kramatassavitā bhavatāttadapi rame kadalikā vidalitā syāt || 1255 || he rame! kadalikā rambhā | tava 'hiraṇyavarṇo' ‘ādityavarṇe' iti śrutiprathitavarṇāyā iti bhāvaḥ | tanoḥ jayāya abhibhavāya pratikūlaṃ svābhīpsitādityavarṇaśrītanujayavirodhi yat ādyantaṃ ādyantāvabhivyāpya āpādamastakamiti yāvat, kākarūpatvaṃ vāyasatulyavarṇatvaṃ iṅgālavadasnigdhanīlavarṇatvamiti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe pratikūlayoḥ viparyastayoḥ adyantayoḥ ādyantavarṇayoḥ kākarūpatvaṃ antyavarṇe kārūpatvaṃ ādyavarṇe karūpatvaṃ cetyarthaḥ | śabdārthatādātmyavaibhavena kadalikāyāḥ kākarūpatānirvāhaḥ | jahatī satī kramataḥ kālakrameṇa savitā bhāskara eva bhavatāt bhūyādityāśīḥ upahāsārthā | pakṣe kramataḥ ādyantavarṇayoḥ na tu pūrvavadviparyayeṇāntyādyayoḥ savitā vi tā iti varṇābhyāṃ saha vartata iti tathoktā | krameṇādau vivarṇena ante tāvarṇena ca sahitetyarthaḥ | syāt tadapi tathā'pi vidalitaiva viśīrṇaiva syāt | svepsitāsiddheriti bhāvaḥ | kadaliketi śabdavyaktiruktarītyā varṇaviparyāsena vidaliteti niṣpadyetetyarthaḥ | atrāpyubhayaṃ spaṣṭam || yathāvā avadhīraṇaṃ vidhātuṃ bhavato naktaṃcarendra udyuktaḥ | avadhīraṇamupayātaṃ yatanādatanostameva bata bhagavan || he bhagavan! naktaṃcarendraḥ bhavataḥ avadhīraṇaṃ abhibhavaṃ vidhātuṃ udyuktaḥ | yatanāt yatnāt tameva naktaṃcarendrameva avadhīraṇaṃ upayātaṃ prāptavantaṃ atanoḥ akaroḥ | batetyāścarye | anyatra avadhīḥ raṇaṃ iti cchedaḥ | atanoḥ analpāt | 'tṛtīyādiṣu bhāṣitapuṃskaṃ puṃvadgāvalasya' iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ | yatanāt yatnāt yataterbhāve lyuṭ, raṇaṃ yuddhaṃ upayātaṃ tameva avadhīḥ hatavāniti yojanā | atra yadyapi yathāśrutaprāthamikārthapakṣe'pi vivakṣiteṣṭānavāptyaniṣṭaprāptī bhavata eva | tathā'pi daitīyīkārthapradarśanaṃ utkaṭāniṣṭaprāptirūpacamatkārātiśayāyeti dhyeyam || yathāvā vijigīṣu harernayanaṃ bhujagagirīndoḥ padāhataṃ nalinam | khañjamabhūduccāraṇapāṭavavidhurā vadanti tatkañjam || 1257 || padāhataṃ caraṇena tāḍitaṃ jitaṃ ca | khañjaṃ pratihatagātikam | 'khaji gativaiklabye' iti hi dhātuḥ | 'khoḍe khañjaḥ' ityamaraḥ | idamapahnutiśiraskamiti vailakṣaṇyam | vastutastvidamapahnuterevodāharaṇamiti yuktaṃ, tasyā evātra prādhānyena camatkṛtijanakatvāt | prādhānyena hi vyapadeśā bhavantītyasakṛdavocāma | evamudāharaṇāntare'pi yathāyathamūhyam || yathāvā tvaddhāmākramituṃ ye baddhāsthāḥ pauruṣādvṛṣādrimaṇe | tvaccheṣaiste'pāstāḥ pāṣaṇḍāśśrīpate'bhavan ṣaṇḍāḥ || 1258 || he vṛṣādrimaṇe! śrīpate! ye pāṣaṇḍāḥ ye'nyaṃ devaṃ paratvena vadantyajñānamohitāḥ | nārāyaṇājjagannāthātte vai pāṣaḍinassmṛtāḥ || ityādyuktalakṣaṇāḥ | 'pāṣaṇḍāssarvaliṅginaḥ' ityamaraḥ | pauruṣāt parākramāt abhiniveśāditi yāvat | ‘pauruṣaṃ puruṣasya syādbhāve karmaṇi tejasi' iti medinī | tava dhāma vṛṣādristhaṃ divyālayaṃ tatra sthitaṃ tvadarcādivyavigrahaṃ ca ‘gṛhadehatviṭprabhāvā dhāmāni' ityamaraḥ | ākramituṃ svavaśe vidhātuṃ baddhāsthāḥ kṛtapaṇabandhā iti yāvat | abhūvan | te pāṣaṇḍāḥ tvaccheṣaiḥ tvaddāsaiḥ bhāgavataiḥ śeṣāvatārairbhagavadrāmānujamunibhiriti hṛdayam | pūjāyāṃ bahuvacanam | apāstāḥ nirastāssantaḥ ṣaṇḍāḥ klībakalpāḥ niṣpauruṣā abhavan | pakṣe pāṣaṇḍāḥ pāstāḥ nirastapāvarṇāḥ ṣaṇḍā iti niṣpannā ityartho'pi camatkārī || atra vipakṣopaplavaviklabatayā prārthayamānāya bhaktidhanāya kasmaicinmahīkṣite rakṣaṇārthaṃ vitīrṇaśaṅkhacakratayā śanyapāṇiṃ divyārcārūpaṃ bhagavantaṃ ayaṃ subrahmaṇya eveti svavaśe vidhātuṃ taṃ vivadamānāḥ katicana pāṣaṇḍāḥ svamahimnā śeṣarūpato bhagavadālaya somasutrāntarālātpraviśya tamarcārūpaṃ bhagavantaṃ grāhitaśaṅkhacakraṃ vidadhānaiśśrībhāṣyakārairnirastā ityaitihyamanusaṃhitam | atra pāṣaṇḍānāṃ tvaddhāmākramaṇarūpaparāniṣṭaprāpaṇalakṣaṇeṣṭānavāptiḥ ṣaṇḍatā rūpāniṣṭaprāptiśca || nivivedayiṣuśśaurestaddattāṃ viśvatomukham | kavitāṃ hanta nāsmārṣaṃ bahūdāhṛtisādhvasam || evaṃ parasya duḥkhasādhanaprāpaṇarūpeṣṭāprāptiḥ svasya duḥkhasādhanarūpāniṣṭaprāptiścetyubhayaṃ darśitam | parasya sukhasādhananivṛttirūpeṣṭārthodyogāttadanivṛttiḥ, svasya duḥkhasādhanaprāptiścetyubhayaṃ yathā daśavadanaḥ kila patisukhavikalāṃ vipulātmajāṃ vidhātumanāḥ | nijadayitāmeva tathā vyadhita raghūttamaśarāhativyathitaḥ || 1259 || vyadhita vipūrvakādvadhāterātmanepadinaḥ kartari luṅ, akārṣīdityarthaḥ | atra rāvaṇena cikīrṣitaṃ bhagavatyā vaidehyāḥ patisukhavaikalyaṃ na kṛtaṃ, kiṃtu svadayitāyā eva tatsaṃpāditam | yadyapisukhasādhananivṛtterduḥkhasādhanarūpatvānna pṛthaggaṇanā yuktā, tathā'pi duḥkhasādhananivṛtau sukhasyeva sukhasādhananivṛttau duḥkhasyāpi pratiniyatakāraṇajanyatvenānaiyatyātpṛthagupādānamiti dhyeyam || yathāvā vaidehīkabalanato vidārayitumudyatā raghūttaṃsam | svayameva yātubhaginī nāsākarṇe vidāritā vikṛtā || 1260 || vidāraṃ kartuṃ vidārayituṃ vikalatraṃ kartumityarthaḥ | vidārayituṃ vidalayitumiti ca | nāsākarṇe ityatra prāṇyaṅgatvādekavadbhāvaḥ | atra bhagavato dāśarathessukhasādhanībhūtavaidehīkabalanena duḥkhasādhanaprāpaṇodyatāyāśśūrpaṇakhāyā na paraṃ tadalābhaḥ, paraṃtu ātmana eva karṇanāsavidāraṇarūpāniṣṭaprāptiḥ | iyaṃ śleṣottambhitā | pūrvodāharaṇaṃ śuddham || yathāvā prahlādena kṛtāyāstvadbhakternirasanāya yatamānaḥ | nṛhare hiraṇyakaśipustvattassvayameva nirasanamayāsīt || 1261 || nirasanāya pratipakṣepāya | nirasanaṃ pratikṣepaṃ vadhaṃ ca | 'nirasanaṃ vadhe pratikṣepe' iti medinī | atra hiraṇyakaśipunā vidhitsitaṃ prahlādasaṃbandhiniratiśayasukhasādhanabhūtabhagavadbhaktikarmakanirasanaṃ na vihitaṃ, kiṃtu svayameva nirasanamāsāditam | idamapi śleṣagarbhameva | parisaṃkhyālaṃkārasaṃkīrṇatvaṃ tu sarvatra tulyameva || yathāvā tava sadgatiṃ caraṇayorasahiṣṇustaccucorayiṣuretya | svagatibhraṃśodgajapatiralabhata japatopi nātmanassattām || 1262 || he bhagavan! gajapatiḥ tava caraṇayoḥ pādayoḥ tvadīyayoḥ, śākhādhyetrorviprayorityapi gamyate | ‘caraṇo'strī bahvṛcādau mūlegotre pade'pica' iti medinī | sadgatiṃ praśastaṃ jñānaṃ uttamalokāvāptisādhanabhūtāṃ vidyāmiti yāvat | 'gatisstrī mārgadaśayorjñāne yātrābhyupāyayoḥ' iti medinī | praśastaṃ gamanamiti tu tatvam | asahiṣṇuḥ | "na loka" ityādinā ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhātkarmaṇi dvitīyā | ataeva taccucorayiṣuḥ tvaccaraṇagatijihīrṣuḥ | etya tadabhimukho bhūtvā svagataiḥ svajñānasya svagamanasya ca bhraṃśāt bhraṃśaṃ cyutiṃ etya | lyablope paścamī | japato'pi steyadoṣanirāsivedādhyayanenāpi ‘svādhyāyassyājjapaḥ' ityamaraḥ | ātmanassattāṃ svasvarūpasthitiṃ sattāṃ abhyarhitatāṃ praśastatāṃ vā | ‘satye sādhau vidyamāne praśaste'bhyarhite ca sat' ityamaraḥ | nālabhata | pakṣe gajapatiśabdaḥ svagatibhraṃśāt svaniṣṭhayoḥ ga ti iti ādyantavarṇayoḥ bhraṃśaṃ prāpya japataḥ madhye'vaśiṣṭenāpi varṇadvayena ātmanassattāṃ gajapatirityākārakaśabdasvarūpasthituiṃ nālabhatetyarthaḥ | atra gajapatinā bhagavaccaraṇayoruttamasukhasādhanabhūtasadgatinivṛttirūpeṣṭārtho nāsāditaḥ, apitu svagatibhraṃśarūpāniṣṭārtha eva samadhigataḥ | ayaṃ ca caraṇādiśabdapratipādyārthadvayaśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyajīvātuka ityavadheyam || kevaleṣṭānavāptiryathā kaikeyīvarayugavaśadaśarathavacanādbhavantamāptavanam | vinivartayitumanīśo nyavṛtadraghuvaṃśadinamaṇe bharataḥ || 1263 || atra bharatasya svāgrajarāmabhadravanavāsanivartanarūpeṣṭānavāptimātraṃ nibaddham || yathāvā mūḍhaguṇaṃ vpapavoḍhuṃ gāḍhaṃ śrīparibhṛḍhaṃ vrajan śaraṇam | cetanavargo bāḍhaṃ samūḍhaguṇa eva bhavati citramidam || 1264 || mūḍhaguṇaṃ mauḍhyamityarthaḥ | saḥ mūḍhaguṇa iti cchedaḥ | saḥ śaraṇaṃ vrajan pumān mūḍhaguṇa eveti virodhaḥ | samūḍhāḥ sapuñjitāḥ guṇāḥ 'aṣṭā guṇā puruṣaṃ bhūṣayanti' ityuktāḥ mahāguṇāḥ yasya sa tathokta iti parihāraḥ | mahārhaguṇasaṃpanno bhavatītyarthaḥ | 'samūḍhaḥ puñjite bhugne' iti viśvaḥ | atra mūḍhaguṇavyapohanaprepsoścetanavargasya tadalābhamātrameva | na tvaniṣṭāntaropalambhaḥ | pūrvaṃ śuddhaṃ, idaṃ śleṣasaṅkīrṇamiti viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā avalambya tvatpadamapyaprāpya tvattanūpamāmabhram | amukhamabhūtkila viṣṇo bhrāntasyeṣṭaṃ kathaṃ bhavetsaphalam || 1265 || he viṣṇo! tvatpadaṃ tvaccaraṇaṃ tattadīpsitānuguṇasakalaphalapradamiti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe viṣṇupadaṃ antarikṣamityarthaḥ | īdṛśārthavivakṣayaiva viṣṇo iti saṃbodhanam | abhraṃ vārivāhaḥ tvattanūpamāṃ tvaddivyavigrahatulāṃ tava tanuṃ alpāmapyupamāmiti ca gamyate | alabdhvā amukhamabhūt | iyaṃ lokoktiḥ | īpsitānavāptestrapathā kasyacidapi vadanamunnamayya darśayituṃ na prābhavaditi bhāvaḥ | amukhaṃ akāramukhavarṇamiti vastusthitiḥ, abhraśabdasya tathātvāt | tathāhi, bhrāntasya anavasthitacetasaḥ tīvratamapavamānavikṣepakṣubhitasya ca viṣṇupadāśrayaṇe'pi iṣṭaṃ īpsitaṃ kathaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet | kṣiptavikṣiptabhūmigatasya cittasyaikāgryāsiddherna yogasyaiva niṣpattiḥ kathaṃ tatsādhyaṃ phalaṃ sidhyediti bhāvaḥ | abhramapi bhrāntameva śabdārthayostādātmyāt | atrābhrasya bhagavaddivyavigrahasāmyarūpeṣṭānavāptimātraṃ śleṣasaṅkīrṇatvaṃ pūrvavadeva | evamuttaratrāpi | yadyamukhatvamaniṣṭamityabhimataṃ tarhīṣṭānavāptyaniṣṭaprāptirūpasya etadviṣamaprabhedasyaivedamudāharaṇaṃ bhavitumarhatītyavadheyam || yathāvā ādau śatakratumaṇistvadrucilābhāya tantusaṃnāham | prāpto'pyaśakanato'muṃ muktvā''sīnnātha śakramaṇireva || 1266 || he nātha! śatakratumaṇiḥ indranīlaratnaṃ ādau tvadrucilābhāyatāṃ labdhuṃ tantoḥ pratisarasūtrasya saṃnnāhaṃ bandhaṃ prāpto'pi tadarthaṃ baddhakaṅkaṇo'pītyarthaḥ | suvarṇādisūtragrathanaṃ prāpta iti tattvam | taṃ tavarṇaṃ tusaṃnāhaṃ tuvarṇasaṃbaddhatvaṃ ca prāpta iti vastusthitiḥ | aśakanataḥ vivakṣitepsitasādhanāśaktatvāt amuṃ tantusaṃnnāhaṃ prītasarabandhaṃ muktvā visṛjya taṃ tu saṃnāhamiti cchedaḥ| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe | taṃ tu tathāvidhameva saṃnāhaṃ prāpto'pi aśaktatayā amuṃ evaṃvidhaṃ taṃ sannāhaṃ prayatnameva muktvetyapi gamyate | pakṣe taṃ takāraṃ tusaṃnāhaṃ tuvarṇasaṃbandhaṃ ca tyaktvā śakramaṇireva yathāpūrvamindranīlaratnameva āsīt | na tu tvadrucimalabhateti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe śatakratumaṇiśabdaḥ upapāditarītyā takāratuvarṇayostyāge śakramaṇiriti nirapadyatetyarthaḥ | atra śatakratumaṇeriṣṭālābhamātram | vakṣyamāṇapūrvarūpasaṅkīrṇam || yathāvā harisakhi rasālasārastvadvacanasudhātmanā'vataraṇāya | adharitaśīrṣopi na tadvindeta rasālasāra eva syāt || 1267 || rasālasāraḥ ikṣurasaḥ sahakāraphalaraso vā rāsalasāra eva syāt na tu tvadvacanasudhātmanā'vataredityarthaḥ | rasālasāraśabdo vilomatayā paṭhito'pi tulyarūpa eveti tattvam | anyatsugamam | atra rasālasārasya kevalamiṣṭānavāptiḥ | idamapi vakṣyamāṇapūrvarūpopaskṛtameva || yathāvā vijigīṣu nārikelaṃ dvaṃdvaprathitau tava stanau tarūṇau | madhye'kṣaradvayadhaścyunnalinekṣaṇataruṇi nālamevāsīt || 1268 || he nalinekṣaṇataruṇi! idaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇastanatāruṇyopaskārakama, | nārikelaṃ nārikalaphalaṃ kartu klībamekameveti bhāvaḥ | dvaṃdvaprathitau yuddhaprakhyātau | yugmatayā prasiddhāviti vastusthitiḥ | dvaṃdvamiti prathitāvitivigrahaḥ | 'dvaṃdvaṃ kalahayugmayoḥ' ityamaraḥ | taruṇau vayasthau tava stanau pumāṃsau dvāviti bhāvaḥ | vijigīṣu svaparabalābalānālocanena jayecchāmātraṃ kṛtavaditi bhāvaḥ | madhye iṣṭalābhecchayorantarālaṃ kṣarat kṣayaṃ prāpnuvat | tatra hetuḥ vayaścyuditi | vayasaḥ yauvanarūpādvayasaḥ cyavata iti vayaścyut ‘cyu cyavane' asmādbhauvāditkvip tuk | sthaviramityarthaḥ | nālameva asamarthameva āsīt alaṃ samarthaṃnāsīditi vā yojanā | nālamātrāvaśiṣṭamityapi gamyate svayaṃ ṣaṇḍo vṛddhaḥ kṣīṇa ekaśca dvau yuddhoddhatau vayasthau vayassthāśritau ca vijetuṃ kathaṃ śaknuyāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe nārikelaṃ nārikelamiti padaṃ madhye antarāle akṣaradvayaścyuditi samastaṃ padam | akṣaradvayaṃ varṇayugmaṃ ścyotatīti tathoktam | ‘ścyutir kṣaraṇe' asmādbhauvādikātkvip | dravadravyakartṛka evāyamakarmakaḥ sravativat | atrādravadravyakartṛkatvena sakarmatvam | akṣaradvayāt ścyotatīti vā vigrahaḥ | varṇadvayacyutamityarthaḥ | nālamityevāsīt | nārikelamiti padaṃ ri ke iti varṇadvayavidhuraṃ nālamityevāvaśiṣṭamabhūdityarthaḥ | atra nārikelasyeṣṭālābhamātram | iṣṭasya parānarthaprāpaṇarūpatvavivakṣāyāmidaṃ vakṣamāṇaprabhedasyaivodāharaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti dhyeyam || yathāvā ye vaitaraṇyatītestava janani janā hariṃ didṛkṣante | tānvaitaraṇyatīterdarśayasi hariṃ na jātviti vicitram || 1269 || he janani! ye tava janāḥ tvadbhaktāḥ | vai iti prasiddhau | taraṇyatīteḥ sūryātikramaṃ prāpya bhānumaṇḍalabhedanapūrvakamiti bhāvaḥ | hariṃ vāsudevaṃ didṛkṣante draṣṭumicchanti ‘jñāśrusmṛśāṃ sanaḥ' iti taṅ | tān janān jātvapi taraṇyatīteḥ hariṃ na darśayasi vai | idaṃ vicitram | vaitaraṇyatīteriti samastaṃ padam | vaitaraṇyāḥ yamapuradvārataraṅgiṇyāḥ atīteḥ hariṃ yamaṃ na darśayasīti parihāraḥ | ‘dṛśeśca' iti dvikarmakatvam | atra śrībhaktānāmiṣṭālābhamātraṃ śleṣeṇa darśitam || yathāvā āśrityānantapadaṃ tapatvadhaśśīrṣameva tadapi rame | bhavitā yathāpuraṃ na tu tava padaruci janma bhānubhā bhajate || 1270 || bhānubhā raviprabhā | anantapadaṃ bhagavaccaraṇaṃ antarikṣasthānaṃ ca āśritya tapatu tapaścaratu tāpaṃ bhajatu ca | yathāpurameva bhavitā bhānubhaiva bhavet | na tu tvaccaraṇaprabhātmanā janma bhajate | bhānubhāśabdo vilomatve'pi bhānubhetyeva saṃpadyate na tvanyāmānupūrvīṃ labhate | atra bhānubhāyā lakṣmīcaraṇaprabhātmanā janma prepsoradhaśśīrṣaṃ bhagavaccaraṇe tapaścaryayā'pi tadalābhamātraṃ nibaddham | śleṣapūrvarūpasaṃkīrṇam || yathāvā nanu kālikā'khilāmba tvatkabarījanma labdhumicchantī | atha yadyadhaśśirāssyāttadā'pi sā kālikaiva na tu kabarī || 1271 || kālikā kādambinī | ‘meghajāle'pi kālika' ityamaraḥ | atrāpi kālikāyā iṣṭānavāptimātraṃ pūrvarūpasaṃbhāvanāsaṃkīrṇam || kevalāniṣṭapratilambho yathā padmākarapadmasthitiyogyaṃ syāmiti vivalgasi na vetsi | tena paribhūtimambuja jaḍajātatvaṃ | tavaitadeva khalu || 1272 || he ambuja! padmāyāḥ lakṣmyāḥ karapadme pāṇipaṅkaje yā sthitiḥ avasthānaṃ tasyāḥ yogyaṃ syāmiti vivalgasi utplavase | tena śrīpāṇipadmena | tavetyetaduttaravākyādapakṛṣyate | tava paribhūtiṃ na vetsi | ‘ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' iti karmaṇyave ṣaṣṭhī na tu kartari| spaṣṭamanyat || yathāvā adhirohasi vṛṣabhūmibhṛdadhityakāṃ ghana rameśasevecchuḥ | sa hi harate tava lakṣmīṃ na hi jaḍahṛdveda bhāvinamanartham || 1273 || he ghana! he jīmūta! vṛṣabhūmibhṛtaḥ ādhatyakāṃ ūrdhvabhūmiṃ ‘bhūmirūrdhvamadhityakā' ityamaraḥ | jaḍahṛt stabdhamanāḥ laḍayorabhedāt jalaṃ hṛdi antaḥpradeśe yasya sa tathoktaḥ | samudrājjalaṃ haratīti vā tathoktaḥ | sphuṭārthamanyat | atra udāharaṇadvaye krameṇa ambujāmbudayorlakṣmīkarapadmasthitiyogyatvabhāgyaśrīnivāsasevābhāgadheyarūpeṣṭārthalābhau sta eva | kiṃtu tatkartṛkaparibhūtilakṣmīharaṇarūpotkaṭāniṣṭapratilambhāvapīti kevalāniṣṭapratilambharūpaviṣamāmadam || yathāvā kamalaṃ tvannayanarucā pramathitarociḥ prapadya puṃstvamatha | vañcayitumupetya tvāṃ tvayā parāhaṇyate parā rāma || 1274 || he rāma ! idaṃ vakṣyamāṇārthasya tadavatārakṛtatvadyotanāya | kamalaṃ nalinaṃ klībamiti bhāvaḥ | tvannayanarucā striyeti bhāvaḥ | pramathitarocissat atha puṃstvaṃ puruṣatvaṃ pulliṅgatāṃ ca prapadya tatpratīkārārthaṃ kamalo māyāmṛgo bhūtveti bhāvaḥ | ‘syātkuraṅge'pi kamalaḥ' ityamaraḥ | purā parāhaṇyate parāhaṇyatetyarthaḥ | ‘puri luṅacāsme' iti purāśabdayoge bhūte'rthe laṭ | ‘hanteratpūrvasya' iti ṇatvam | spaṣṭamitarat | atra kamalasya śrīrāmavañcanarūpeṣṭasiddhirastyeva | paraṃtu parāhatirūpotkaṭāniṣṭapratilambhaścetīdamapi kevalāniṣṭapratilambharūpameva || yathāvā nanu capale'śanisahabhūrnityaśrīpsuśśritā śriyo madhyam | bhavasi ca yathepsitaśrariśanābhāvaḥ paraṃtu te'tra syāt || 1275 || aśanināṃ aśanavatāṃ, bhūmni nityayoge vā matvarthīya iniḥ | sahabhūḥ sahajanmā taissaha jātetyarthaḥ | tasyāssaṃbuddhiḥ he aśanisahabhūḥ! pakṣe aśaneḥ vajrasya sahabhūḥ vidyudaśanyorekatrāvasthānāttathoktiḥ | nanviti sukumārāmantraṇe | nanu capale he saudāmani! cāpalyaṃ sūcayitumidam | tvaṃ nityaśriyaṃ acañcalāṃ lakṣmīṃ ipsussatī śriyaḥ saṃpadaḥ bhagavatyā lakṣmyāśca madhyaṃ antaraṃ avalagnaṃ ca śritā satī yathepsitaśrīśca bhavasi paraṃtu te tava atra śrīmadhye aśanābhāvaḥ syāt āhāradaurlabhyaṃ bhavet aśanaśālisahabhūstvaṃ tāvanmātreṇāparituṣyantī tato'tiśayitāṃ śriyamapekṣamāṇā tāṃ labhasa eva paraṃtvaśanābhāvarūpamahāniṣṭaṃ ca lapsyase iti bhāvaḥ | yathocyate yāvadbhriyeta jaṭharaṃ tāvatkuryādupārjanam | adhikaṃ yo'bhimanyeta sa steno daṇḍamarhati || iti | śanisahabhūriti ca labhyate | tadā śaninā saha sthitā śanipīḍiteti yāvat | evaṃ śanipīḍitāyāḥ kathaṃcidiṣṭalābhe'pyaniṣṭalābho duṣparihāra iti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe yathepsitaśrīḥ raśanābhāva iti cchedaḥ| ‘ro ri' iti rephalopaḥ | te tava raśanābhāvaḥ mekhalātvaṃ syāt | nityaśrīmattayā śriyo madhyabhāge'vasthānāttava raśanātvaṃ bhavedeveti bhāvaḥ | 'saptakī raśanā tathā' ityamaraḥ | atrāpi pūrvavadeva kevalāniṣṭalābhaḥ || yathāvā karikarapīḍāṃ vyudasitumaravindaṃ tvatkarātmanā''virabhūt | harikarapīḍanamalabhata sarasijanayanapriye tadatrāpi || 1276 || hareḥ siṃhasya bhagavataśca karapīḍanaṃ hastopamardaṃ, pakṣe karapīḍanaṃ pāṇigrahaṇamityarthaḥ | tat aravindam | atrāpi aravindajanmanyapi | atrāravindasya karikarapīḍāvyudasanarūpeṣṭāvāptisadbhāve'pi harikarapīḍanarūpāniṣṭapratilambhaśca bhavatītīdamapi kevalāniṣṭapratilambha eva | śleṣamahimnā iṣṭatamasyāpyaniṣṭatāsaṃpādanamiti dhyeyam || yathāvā inasuhṛdā rājñā tvaṃ mayā sadṛksyā itīcchurakhilavibho | tava dṛggata evābhūdinānvito hanta dūta evenduḥ || 1277 || he akhilavibho ! induḥ inasuhṛdā anekaprabhumitreṇa, pakṣe bhānusahitena rājñā nṛpeṇa candraṇa ca | mayā tvaṃ sadṛk tulyaḥ dṛgbhyāṃ sahitaśca mayetyatra tṛtīyāyā abhedo'rthaḥ | tathāca sūryasahitamadabhinnanayanadvayavāniti bhāvaḥ | syāḥ | iti icchuḥ kāṅkṣan san ‘vinduricchuḥ' iti nipātanātsādhuḥ | tava akhilajagadrājādhirājasyeti bhāvaḥ | dṛggataḥ dṛṣṭipathagatamātra eveti bhāvaḥ | inānvitaḥ svasuhṛdanekaprabhusahitassan tava dūta eva saṃdeśahara eva abhūt | tvadadarśanāvasare ātmānameva mahārājaṃ manyamano'khilalokanāthamapi tvāṃ svasadṛśaṃ cikārṣurabhyetya tvaddarśanamātreṇaiva tyaktābhimānassvapakṣīyaprabhubhissaha tava dūtyamalabhateti bhāvaḥ | inānvitaḥ sūryasahitaḥ tava dṛggataḥ dṛṣṭisthānaṃ prapanna evābhūt | candrasūryayorubhayorapi tannayatatvaśravaṇāditi bhāvaḥ | naitāvadeva | dūta evābhūt | 'etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane gārgi sūryācandramasau vidhṛtau tiṣṭhataḥ' ityuktarītyā tacchāsanānativartyabhūditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe induśabdaḥ inā iṃnniti varṇasamudāyena anvitaḥ dūtaḥ dunā duvarṇena ūtaḥ syūtaḥ yukta evetyarthaḥ | abhūt | inśabdasya tādvidhyāditi bhāvaḥ | atra sadṛktvaprepsorindossadṛkchabdapratipādyasadṛśasadṛṣṭirūpārthadvayaśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyavaibhavena tādṛśepsitalābho'styeva | tathā'pi dūtatvarūpāniṣṭopalambho'pi bhavatītyayamapi kevalāniṣṭapratilambha eva || yathāvā kvāpyapratikūlāstvatkabarīsakhyāya kālikā yatamānāḥ | prāpyāntarālitāmapi kākā āsanviparyaye'pi tathaiva || 1278 || he śrīḥ! iti sāmarthyāllabhyate | kālikāḥ kādambinyaḥ 'meghajāle'pi kālikā' ityamaraḥ | pakṣe kālikāśabdo'pi | arthagate strītvabahutve śabde āropyete | kvāpi kvacidapi apratikūlāḥ prātikūlyarāhitāssatyaḥ | na hi prātikūlye sakhyaṃ sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe pratilomatve'pyavairūpyaṃ bhajamānā ityarthaḥ | tvatkabaryāḥ sakhyāya maitryāya tulanāyeti vastusthitiḥ | yatamānāssatyaḥ āntarālitāṃ antare bhavāḥ āntaryaḥ tāśca tāḥ ālayaśca āntarālayaḥ | ‘puṃvatkarmadhāraya' iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ | tāsāṃ bhāvaḥ tattā tāṃ antaraṅgasakhītvamityarthaḥ | 'ālissakhī vayasyā ca' ityamaraḥ | prāpyāpi kākāḥ vāyasāḥ āsan | viparyaye pralaye'pīti yāvat | tathaiva kākā eva āsan | na tu yuktarūpāḥ | pakṣe antarā madhye alitāṃ livarṇaśūnyatāṃ prāpya kākā apīti yojanā | kākā ityapyāsan | atha viparyaye vilomatve'pi kākā ityevāsan na tvanyānupūrvīkāḥ | atra kālikānāṃ prāpyāntarālitāśabdapratipādyārthadvayaśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyamahimnā śrīkabarīsakhyarūpeṣṭalābhākṣatāvapi kākatārūpāniṣṭāntarāvāptiśca śleṣamahimnā bhavatītīdamapi kevalāniṣṭaprāptirūpaviṣamam || aniṣṭaparihārarūpeṣṭānavāptiryathā atrāsā nivasāmetyatrāsye tava radātmanā jātāḥ | muktā bhagavannabhavannatrāpyetā mahābhayākalitāḥ || 1279 || muktāḥ mauktikāni atrāsāḥ nirbhayāssatyaḥ anyatra maṇidoṣavidhurāssatyaḥ 'trāso bhīmaṇidoṣayoḥ' iti viśvaḥ | atra nivasāmeti tava āsye radātmanā dantarūpeṇa jātāssatyaḥ atrāpi tvadāsye'pi etāḥ muktāḥ mahābhayena mahatā trāsena ākalitāḥ | mahatyā abhayā kalitā iti vastusthitiḥ || yathāvā vipadānvitaṃ bhavaṃ tvaṃ vineṣyasīti śrayemahi bhavantam | vipulayasi tadeva tvaṃ vicitrametadvṛṣācaladyumaṇe || 1280 || atrādyodāharaṇe kevalaṃ muktānāṃ trāsaśabdapratipādyārthadvayaśleṣagṛhītabhayarūpāniṣṭaparihāralakṣaṇeṣṭāttavāptirdarśitā | dvitīyodāharaṇe vipadā āpadā anvitaṃ bhavaṃ saṃsāraṃ , pakṣe vi ityākārakapadenānvitaṃ bhavaṃ vibhavamiti śabdārthatādātmyamūlakaśleṣamahimnā aniṣṭaparihārarūpeṣṭānavāptiḥ prakāśitā || yathāvā aridaragadākaratvaṃ parihartuṃ tvāṃ bhajanti ye manujāḥ | aridaragadākaratvaṃ | santatameṣāṃ tvamantatastanuṣe || 1281 || arayaḥ kāmādayaḥ daraḥ bhayaṃ tatprayuktam | gadaḥ tatprayukto vyādhiḥ | teṣāmākaratvaṃ āśrayatvaṃ parihartuṃ | uttarārdhe'pyevam | vastutastu aridaragadākaratvaṃ cakraśaṅkhagadāpāṇitvāmityarthaḥ | bhagavatsārūpyamiti bhāvaḥ | atrāpi aridaragadākaratvalakṣaṇānarthaparihārarūpeṣṭānavāptiśśleṣamahimnā nibaddhā || yathāvā tvadvadanarucidveṣācchvādyatvaṃ prāpya tadvyapanunutsuḥ | adharitaśirā bhavannapi sa puṣkare tajjahau na śubhrāṃśuḥ || 1282 || he bhagavan ! śubhrāṃśuḥ candramāḥ tvadvadanarucau dveṣāt śvādyatvaṃ śunāmāditvaṃ śunakāgresaratvamityarthaḥ | śvā ādyaḥ bhakṣyo yasyeti vā śvapākatvamityarthaḥ | prāpya, devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ yo dveṣṭi jagatāṃ prabhum | śvānayonisahasrānte śvapākeṣu sa jāyate || iti smaraṇāt | bhagavadvadanāravindavidveṣasyedamalpaṃ phalamiti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe śuvarṇaḥ ādyaḥ prāthamiko yasya saḥ śvādyaḥ tattvam | vācyavācakayostādātmyāt | prāpya tat śvādyatvaṃ vyapanunutsuḥ vyapanoditumicchuḥ puṣkare tannāmni tīrthaviśeṣe antarikṣe ca | adharitaśirāḥ avākchīrṣo bhavannapi tathā tapasyannapīti bhāvaḥ | astābhimukhyadaśāyāmantarikṣe candrabimbasya avākchirastvena darśanāttathoktiḥ | pakṣe vilomatayā sthito'pītyarthaḥ | tat śvādya vaṃ na jahau | yathāpuraṃ śunāmagraṇīḥ śvabhakṣakī vā'bhūt | na tu svābhīpsitaṃ labdhavān | bhagavadvidveṣiṇāṃ puṇyatīrthaniṣevaṇamapi na śodhakamiti bhāvaḥ | ye dviṣanti mahātmānaṃ na smaranti ca keśavam | na teṣāṃ puṇyatīrtheṣu gatissaṃsargiṇāmapi || iti mahābhāratāt | pakṣe śubhrāṃśuśabdo vilomatayā paṭhito'pi śubhrāṃśurityeva bhavan śuvarṇādyatvaṃ na jahāvityarthaḥ | atra śubhrāṃśoraniṣṭaparihārarūpeṣṭānavāptiḥ || yathāvā abhitaśśunā'bhimṛṣṭo'smyahamiti śubhrāṃśuratitarāṃ bhrāntaḥ | tadapanayāyānante patannadhaśśīrṣamapi tathaivābhūt || 1283 || śubhrāṃśuḥ abhitaḥ sarvataḥ ubhayataśca śunā śunakena śuvarṇena ca abhimṛṣṭaḥ spṛṣṭaḥ asmīti atitarāṃ bhrāntaḥ bhrāntimān | pakṣe bhraḥ bhra iti varṇasamudayaḥ ante madhye yasya sa tathoktaḥ | tadapanayāya tasya abhitaśśunā spṛṣṭatvabhramasyāpanodanāya anante bhagavati antarikṣe ca adhaśśīrṣaṃ patannapi vilomatayā sthito'pīti ca tathaivābhūt bhrānta evābhūt pakṣe śubhrāṃśurityevābhūt | na tvanyadhā | atra śubhrāṃśoḥ pūrvavadeveṣṭānavāptiḥ || yathāvā sutarāṃśumayo'pyādāvante ca tavānanaśriyamalabdhvā | klāntasthitimainna jahau śuklāṃśuradhaśśiraḥ patannapi tām || 1284 || he bhagavan! śuklāṃśuḥ sitakaraḥ ādau māsādau ante māsānte ca | idaṃ pūrṇimādyantamāsābhiprāyoṇoktam | sutarāśca te aṃśavaśca tanmayo'pi prācurye mayaṭ | tava ānanaśriyaṃ alabdhvā klāntasthitiṃ glānasthitiṃ glānimityarthaḥ | ait agāt | atha adhaśśiraḥ patannapi tāṃ na jahau glānisthitiṃ nātyākṣīt | pakṣe śuklāṃśuśabdaḥ sutarāṃ atitarāṃ ādāvante ca śumayaḥ śuvarṇapracuraḥ ādyantayoḥ śuvarṇasyaiva jāgarūkatvāditi bhāvaḥ | adhaśśiraḥ nipatito'pi vyatyastatayā sthito'pīti yāvat | klā iti varṇasamudāyasya antasthitiṃ madhye sattāṃ na jahau | tasya vaiparītye'pi tādavasthyāditi bhāvaḥ | atrāpi pūrvavadeva sarvam || yathāvā tvāṃ stotā sakalakaviḥ stotā tu parasya vikalakavireva | adharitaśīrṣo'pi bhavanvikalakavissyādayaṃ na sakalakaviḥ || 1285 || sakalakaviḥ saṃpūrṇakaviḥ mahākavirityarthaḥ | vikalakaviḥ kṣudrakaviḥ | atra vikalakavessvānarthaparihārarūpeṣṭālābhaḥ || yathāvā tvattejo'bhihataujānubhaṅgabhāgbhānubhāssatī bhābhāḥ | syādyadi punaḥ prasavyā yathāpuraṃ syānna tu tvadojobhāḥ || 1286 || he bhagavan ! bhānubhāḥ bhāsvatprabhā | tvattejastaulyalipsuriti sāmarthyādavagamyate | tvattejo'bhihatau satyāṃ tvatpratāpakartṛkābhihanane sati jānubhaṅgabhāk jānunīḥ ūruparvaṇoḥ bhaṅgaṃ avamardaṃ bhajatīti tathoktā bhagnajānussatītyarthaḥ| ata eva bhābhāḥ nabhāsata ityabhāḥ | bhāsateḥ kvip | bhayā prabhayā abhāḥ bhābhāḥ| nabhātīti vigrahe bhāteḥ kvip | viśvapāśabdavadādantaḥ | ubhayathā'pi prabhayā aprakāśamānetyarthaḥ | yadvā bhaṃ nakṣatramiva ā īṣat bhāsata iti bhātīti vā bhābhāḥ ādau mahāprakāśā jānubhaṅgānantaramalpataraprakāśetyarthaḥ | pakṣe bhānubhā iti śabdavyaktiḥ tvattejo'bhihataujāḥ nubhaṅgamiti chedaḥ | tava tejasā abhihataṃ ojaḥ balaṃ avaṣṭambhaḥ prabhāvo vā yasyāssā tathoktā 'ojo dīptāvavaṣṭambhe prabhāvabalayorapi' iti medinī | nubhaṅgabhāk nuvarṇabhraṃśaṃ prāptā ata eva bhābhāssatī bhābhā iti niṣpannā satī punaḥ ādau uktarītyā paribhave satyapīti bhāvaḥ | prasavyā prāptāniṣṭaparihārapūrvakaṃ tvattejastaulyalābhāya tasya pratikūlā anukūlā vā yadi syāt ‘prasavyaṃ vācyaliṅgaṃ syāt pratikūlānukūlayoḥ' iti medinī | tadā'pi yathāpurameva syāt bhābhā eva syāt aprakāśaprabhāvā atyalpaprakāśā vā bhavet | na tu tvadoja iva bhātīti tvadojobhāḥ syāt pakṣe bhābhā iti niṣpannā bhānubhāśabdavyaktiḥ prasavyā anulomā pratilomā vā bhābhā ityeva syāt na tu tvadojobhā ityānupūrvīyutetyarthaḥ | yadi punaḥ prasavyā syādityanena bhānubhāsaḥ parāhateḥ pūrvamapi prasavyatve'pi yathāpūrvāvasthāvasthitatvameveti gamyate | evaṃ śabdarūpārthapakṣe'pi, bhānubhāśabdasyāpi bhābhāśabdasyevānulomapratilomāvasthayostulyarūpatvāt | atra bhānubhāsaḥ prāptabhābhārūpānarthanivāraṇalakṣaṇeṣṭānavāptimātram | tacca tasyāḥ bhagavattejastaulyarūpeṣṭālābhapūrvakajānubhaṅgādyaniṣṭalābhalakṣaṇaprāguktaitadviṣamaprabhedena dattahastamiti pūrvāpekṣayā viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā yattvadgamanaṃ praipsattadagatvā devadeva gajarājaḥ | prāpya jarājatvamadhaśśīrṣo'pi tato jarājatāṃ na jahau || 1287 || he devadeva! gajarājaḥ yat tvadgamanaṃ tvadgamanatulyagamanamityarthaḥ | praipsat prāptumaicchat yat tvadgamanaṃ agatvā aprāpya | yadvā tadagatvāt eva deveti cchedaḥ | he deva na gacchatītyagaḥ | tasya agaḥ tadagaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ tadagatvaṃ tasmādeva tvadgamanāprāpterevetyartha | jarājatvaṃ jarānvitacchāgatvaṃ, yadvā jīryatīti jaraḥ pacādyac | sa cāsāvajaḥ jīrṇacchāgaḥ tatvaṃ gamanasaundaryaśaktivaikalyena tattaulyamiti yāvat | prāpya, pakṣe gajarājaśabdaḥ agatvāt gakārarahitatvāt jarājatvaṃ jarājaśabdatvaṃ prāpyetyarthaḥ | tataḥ adhaśśīrṣo'pīti lokoktiḥ | pakṣe vaiparītyaṃ prāpto'pi jarājatāṃ ubhayathā'pi jarājatvaṃ na jahau | jarāja ityevāsīt | na tu tāṃ paryahārṣīditi bhāvaḥ | atra gajarājasya prāptajarājatvarūpāniṣṭaparihāralakṣaṇeṣṭānavāptimātraṃ prādhānyena pratipādyate | bhagavadgamanataulyarūpeṣṭānavāptipūrvakajarājatvarūpāniṣṭaprāptilakṣaṇaitadviṣamaviśeṣastvaṅgatayeti pūrvodāharaṇavadeva sarvam || yathāvā tvadyaśasā dhuta indussvasuhṛdaminamāpa so'pi tava mahasā | vidhutastamenamaujjhīdinojjhito'bhavadayaṃ ca dusthitimān || 1288 || he bhagavan! induḥ tvadyaśasā dhutassan svasuhṛdaṃ svamitraṃ inaṃ kaṃcana rājānaṃ āpa | svānarthaparihārāyeti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe inaṃ bhānuṃ tasya tatsuhrattvaṃ jyotiśśāstraprasiddham | āpa | apacitakalastadupacayāya darśe ravimaṇḍalamāsāditavānityarthaḥ | so'pi sa rājā'pi sa bhānurapi tava mahasā ‘divi sūryasahasrasya' ityuktaprakāreṇa tejasā vidhutaḥ viśeṣeṇa kampitaḥ tamenaṃ svasyāpyaniṣṭahetubhūtaminduṃ aujjhīt vyasrākṣīt | śuklapakṣādau ravimaṇḍalādasya viśleṣaḥ prasiddha eveti bhāvaḥ | inojjhitaḥ inena tena rājñā bhānunā ca ujjhitaḥ svāniṣṭaheturayamiti visṛṣṭaḥ ayaṃ induśca dusthitimān duravasthāvān abhūt | vastutastu induśabdaḥ inā in iti varṇasamudayena ujjhitaḥ dusthitimān duriti varṇasamudayasthitimān abhūdityarthaḥ | atra na kevalamindossvānarthaparihārarūpeṣṭānavāptiḥ, kintu svāśrayasyāpyanarthaprāptiriti viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā atighoraṃ nissāraṃ saṃsāraṃ dūramujjhitumapāram | udyuñje puruṣottama kuruṣe karuṇāṃ kuto na sādaraṇām || 1289 || udyuñje udyukto'smi | utpūrvakādyujeḥ raudhādikātkartari laḍuttamapuruṣaikavacanam | atrārtasya bhagavatprapannasya saṃsārarūpānarthaparihāralakṣaṇeṣṭānavāptimātram | idaṃ śuddhamudāharaṇam | prācīnāni tu śleṣādisaṃkīrṇānīti viśeṣaḥ || parāniṣṭaprāpaṇarūpeṣṭānavāptiryathā bhīṣmaṃ tvāṃ dhṛtacakraṃ bhīṣmaṃ hantuṃ dravantamatyantam | pārthassarabhasamaruṇatsārthāṃ saṃdhāṃ ca vīkṣya sa nananda || 1290 || bhīṣmaṃ dāruṇaṃ yathāsyāttathā bhīṣmaṃ śāntanavaṃ hantuṃ dhṛtacakraṃ atyantaṃ dravantam | sa ca bhīṣmaśca saṃdhāṃ ‘aśastragrahaṇaṃ pratiśrutavantaṃ bhagavantaṃ śastraṃ grāhayiṣyāmyeva' iti svakṛtāṃ pratijñāṃ sārthāṃ bhagavatkṛtacakragrahaṇena saphalāṃ vīkṣya nananda | atra bhagavato bhīṣmahananarūpaparāniṣṭaprāpaṇalakṣaṇeṣṭānavāptirnibaddhā | atraiva bhīṣmasya svapratijñānirvahaṇarūpasukhasādhanārthaprāptiḥ vadharūpaduḥkhasādhanānarthanāśaḥ, bhagavataśca svapratijñābhaṅgarūpaduḥkhasādhanānarthaprāptiśca nibaddheti sūkṣmayā dṛśā'vadhātavyam || yathāvā niśicaravadhūkadambaṃ madamba hantumapi yatanavān hanumān | karuṇatamatāvakavacassaraṇigatipratihatābhilaṣito'bhūt || 1291 || niśicaravadhvaḥ ekākṣyekakarṇyādikāḥ tāsāṃ kadambaṃ hantuṃ rāvaṇavadhānantaraṃ tvatsamāśvāsanāvasara iti bhāvaḥ | yathocyate śrīmati rāmāyaṇe hanūmatā imāstu khalu rākṣasyo yadi tvamanumanyase | hantumicchāmyahaṃ sarvā yābhistvaṃ tarjitā purā || ityādi | karuṇatamatāvakavacasāṃ pāpānāṃ vā śubhānāṃ vā vadhārhāṇāṃ plavaṅgama | kāryaṃ karuṇamāryeṇa na kaścinnāparādhyati || ityādivacananām | spaṣṭamanyat | atrāpi hanūmato rakṣasstrīhananalakṣaṇaparāniṣṭaprāpaṇarūpeṣṭānavāptiḥ || yathāvā yatpadamiyāttvadīyaśśrīdaśrīrdhīradhīḥ pradīpraśca | tatpadaviparyayāya prabhavetko vā kṛtaprayatno'pi || he bhagavanniti prakaraṇāllabhyate | tvadīyaḥ tvadbhaktaḥ śrīdaśrīḥ dhanadatulyavibhavaḥ dhīradhīḥ mahāmatiḥ, ābhyāṃ saṃpatsārasvatobhayasamṛddhiruktā | ata eva pradīpraḥ atimātradyutiśālī ca san yatpadaṃ aihikamāmuṣmikamāpavargikaṃ vā sthānaṃ iyāt prāpnuyāt tatpadasya tadārjitasya sthānasya viparyayāya pralayāya kṛtaprayatno'pi ko vā prabhavet na ko'pīti bhāvaḥ | yadvā kaḥ brahmā'pi prabhavedvā iti yojanā | so'pi na prabhavedeveti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe tvadīyaḥ yatpadaṃ śrīdaśrīrityādikaṃ yatpadaṃ iyāt tatpadasya viparyayāya vailomyāya kṛtaprayatna'pi ko vā prabhavet | mahatā yatnena prātilomyena pāṭhe'pi pūrvānupūrvyā eva vidyamānatvāt | atra bhagavadbhaktasādhitapadaviparyāsalakṣaṇaparāniṣṭaprāpaṇarūpeṣṭārthālābhaḥ pṛthagjanasya varṇitaḥ | idaṃ śleṣasaṃkīrṇam | pūrvodāharaṇe tu śuddhe || yathāvā yadyacikīrṣiṣyata te pratāpamatibhīṣmamapagatoṣmāṇam | niśicarakulamabhaviṣyatsa tadā'pyatibhīma eva dāśarathe || 1293 || he dāśarathe! niśicarakulaṃ kartṛ atibhīṣmaṃ atidāruṇaṃ te tava pratāpaṃ apagataḥ ūṣmā uṣṇatā dāruṇatvaṃ yasya taṃ tathoktaṃ acikīrṣiṣyata yadi kartumaiṣiṣyaccet | karotessannantātkriyātipattau lṛṅ | tadā'pi saḥ tava pratāpaḥ atibhīma eva abhaviṣyat anapanodyoṣmatayā atibhīṣma eva samapatsyateti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe atibhīṣmaśabdaṃ ṣakārarūpoṣmavarṇavidhuraṃ samapādayiṣyata cet atibhīma ityeva sa nirapatsyatetyartho'pi camatkārī | atra niśicarakulasya bhagavatpratāpanirūṣmatākaraṇalakṣaṇeṣṭānavāptissaṃbhāvanārūpeṇa darśitā | evaṃ tṛtīyaviṣamaprabhede aṣṭāvavāntaraprabhedā upadarśitāḥ | bhedāntarāṇyapyevamevodāhāryāṇīti vistarātibhūmibhayādviramyate || yatra kenacitsveṣṭasiddhyarthaṃ niyuktenānyena niyokturiṣṭamanādṛtya svasyaiveṣṭaṃ sādhyate tatrāpīṣṭānavāptirūpameva viṣamamiti kuvalayānandakārāḥ | tadyathā mama dhīriyamiti dayitaṃ samayā prahitā mayā sasaṃbhramayā | sā nāma tatra līnā kiṃ tanavānītyacintayadrādhā || 1294 || iyaṃ madīyeti visrambheṇa mama dhīḥ dayitaṃ nandanandanaṃ samayātaṃ pratīti yāvat | 'abhitaḥ paritassamayā' ityādinā dvitīyā | sasaṃbhramayā adūradarśinyeti yāvat | mayā prahitā preṣitā | dhīśabdasya strīliṅgatayā tasyāṃ dūtītvasamādhirgamyate | sā dhīḥ tatra dayita eva ‘sarvaṃ vākyaṃ sāvadhāraṇam' iti nyāyāt, līnā nāma | itaraiḥ pṛthagdurgrahatayā tatraiva tadāśleṣeṇaikyaṃ prāpteti bhāvaḥ | ‘lī śleṣaṇe' kartari ktaḥ | pakṣe tadākārākāriteti bhāvaḥ | nāmeti saṃbhāvanāyām | nilīneti manya ityarthaḥ | kutsane vā | dhiktāṃ dayitaṃ prati adrohiṇīti pratyayena mayā prahitāṃ tatraiva ramamāṇāmiti bhāvaḥ | 'nāma prakāśyasaṃbhāvyakrodhopagamakutsane' ityamaraḥ | kiṃ tanavāni kiṃ karavāṇīti rādhā acintayat | atra niyoktryā rādhāyā abhīṣṭamanādṛtya dhiyā sveṣṭameva sādhitam | samāsoktisaṃkīrṇamidaṃ viṣamam || kadācidiṣṭāvāptipūrvakatadanavāptiryathā tvadgiriparisaragamane kṣaṇamātraṃ tattaṭasphaṭikabhābhiḥ | muṣitakalaṅkastvanmukhasadṛśo vidhuratha yathāpuraṃ bhavati || 1295 || atha tvadgiriparisarātivartanānantaraṃ yathāpuraṃ bhavati sphaṭikarucīnāṃ davīyastvādyathāpūrvaṃ prakaṭakalaṅka eva bhavati | atra candramaso vikalaṅkaveṃkaṭanāthavadanasādṛśyamabhīpsato veṅkaṭagiriparisaragamanāvasare kṣaṇamātrameva tallābho na sārvakālika iti kadācidiṣṭaprāptipūrvakatadanavāptiḥ || kvacidiṣṭānavāptāvapi tadavāptibhramanibandhanavicchittiviśeṣaḥ | yathā navanītahṛdāgata iti navanīradaśiśumavekṣya nikaṭagatam| taṃ bhramavatī nibaddhuṃ saṃbhramato'yatata kā'pi gopavadhūḥ || 1216 || atra navanītacoranandakiśorabandhanajātakautukāyāssamayaṃ pratīkṣamāṇāyāḥ gopavāmekṣaṇāyāḥ kasyāścittadīpsitālābhe'pi tallābhabhramo darśitaḥ || yatra samagreṣṭālābhena tadekadeśamātrāvāptistatrāpi tadanavāptireva | yathā tvaddhāmatāmabhīpsustyajanmilindassvakaṃ mitasphuraṇam | amitaśriyā sphurannapyalinda evāravindanayanābhūt || 1297 || he aravindanayana! milindaḥ bhramaraḥ tvaddhāmatāṃ tvadālayatāṃ tvattulyacchavitāmiti tattvam | abhīpsuḥ ata eva svakaṃ nijaṃ mitasphuraṇaṃ alpaprakārāṃ tyajan | pakṣe milindaśabdaḥ mitaḥ mivarṇena mivarṇasya vā sphuraṇam | mita ityatra sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ | visargasya ‘kharpare śari vā visargalopo vaktavyaḥ' iti pākṣiko lopaḥ | tyajannapi mivarṇasaṃbandhaṃ visṛjannityarthaḥ | amitaśriyā pracuratviṣā saṃpadā vā, śakārasya ‘anaci ca' iti dvitvam | pakṣe aṃ itaḥ śriyā iti chedaḥ | aṃ avarṇaṃ itaḥ prāptaḥ śriyā sphurannapi arthavattārūpasaṃpadā prakāśamāno'pi alinda eva bahirdvāraprakoṣṭhaka eva abhūt | na tu samagraṃ tvaddhāmeti bhāvaḥ | 'praghāṇapraghaṇālindā | bahirdvāraprakoṣṭhake' ityamaraḥ | pakṣe mikārasthāne akāraṃ prāptaḥ alindaśabda evābhūdityarthaḥ | atra ‘na girā gireti brūyādirāṃ kṛtvodgāyet' ityatra girāpadaṃ pratiṣidhya vidhīyamānamirāpadaṃ yathā girāpadasthāna eva bhavati tathā'trāpi mivarṇaṃ pratiṣidhya vidhīyamānamavarṇaṃ mikārasthāna eva bhavati | ata eva ‘kuṣirañjyoḥ prācāṃ śyanparasmaipadaṃ ca' ityatra yakaṃ pratiṣidhya vidhīyamānaśśyan tadīya eva sthāne bhavatīti tattvabodhinyādāvuktaṃ saṃgacchate | atra milindasya svābhīpsitabhagavatparipūrṇadivyālayatvānavāptyā tadekadeśabhūtālindatvaprāptirapīṣṭānavāptireveti dhyeyam || yatreṣṭānavāptipūrvakamanabhīpsitasya yasyakasyacidudāsīnasya vā'rthasyāvāptirnibadhyate tatrāpi kevaleṣṭānavāptireva | yathā tvatpādasaridabhikhyālābhāyādhaśśirāssa ghanasāraḥ | bhūtvā rasānagho'pi śrīśa śrīpādareṇunāmā'bhūt || 1298 || he śrīśa! saḥ śaityasaurabhādibhiḥ prasiddhaḥ ghanasāraḥ karpūraḥ 'atha karpūramastriyām | ghanasāraḥ' ityamaraḥ | tava pādasya yā sarit gaṅgā tasyāḥ abhikhyā nāma śobhā ca | ‘abhikhyā nāma śobhayoḥ' ityamaraḥ | tasyāḥ lābhāya adhaśśirāḥ tava pāde namraśirā ityarthaḥ | rasena jalena anaghaḥ bhūtvā'pi | anena bhagavatpādasaridabhikhyālābhaupayikatā darśitā | ghanasāraśabdo vilomatayā paṭhito rasānagha iti niṣpanna iti vastusthitiḥ | śabdārthayostādātmyaṃ na vismartavyam | śrīpādasya lakṣmīcaraṇasya reṇuḥ pāṃsuriti nāma yasya sa tathoktaḥ abhūt | bhagavaccaraṇasaridabhikhyālābhāya pāvanatīrtharūpatāyāḥ kathaṃcitsaṃpādane'pi tallābho nābhūccenmābhūt, śrīpādasaridabhikhyā'pi vā nāsīt, pratyuta śrīpādareṇunāmāsīditi nirgalito'rthaḥ | śrīveṅkaṭādrau bhagavaddivyavigrahārpito ghanasāraśrīpādareṇuriti vyavahṛto bhavatīti tattvam | atra ghanasārasya bhagavatpādasaridabhikhyārūpeṣṭālābhamātraṃ, śrīpādareṇutvaṃ tu notkaṭāniṣṭaṃ, yenaitatpadyaṃ etattṛtīyaviṣamaprāthamikabhedasyodāharaṇaṃ syāt, kintvanabhīpsitamiti dhyeyam || yathāvā tvallakṣmyā apyatasī śraiṣṭhyepsātaccyutā tulāptyaiva | dhanyā tulasībhūyaṃ gataiva te'mbudhisuteśa hṛdyā''sīt || 1299 || he ambudhisuteśa ! atasī kṣumākusumaṃ 'atasī syādumā kṣumā' tyamaraḥ | ‘puṣpamūleṣu bahulam' iti vaikārikāṇo lup | tvallakṣmyā api tvatprabhāyā api | tvadīyāyāḥ śrīdevyā apītyartho'pyupaskāryaḥ | śreṣṭhye praśasyatamatve īpsā yasyāssā tathoktā satī tacyutā tasmādabhīpsitāt bhraṃśaṃ prāptā satī tulāptyaiva tvallakṣmīsāmyalābhenaiva dhanyā paramābhīpsitālābhe'pi tāvataiva kṛtakṛtyeti bhāvaḥ | tulasībhūyaṃ tulasītvaṃ ‘bhuvo bhāve' iti bhāve kyap | gataiva te tava hṛdyā hṛdayasthā hṛdayapriyā ca āsīt | pakṣe atasīti śabdavyaktiḥ ataccyutā atābhyāṃ akāratakārābhyāṃ cyutā tadrahitetyarthaḥ | taccyutetyatra ‘anaci ca' iti pākṣikaṃ cakārasya dvitvamarthāntarānuguṇyāyaiṣṭavyamityasakṛdavocāma | tulāptyā akāralakārasthāne krameṇa tuvarṇalavarṇaghaṭanayā tulasībhūyaṃ gatā tulasīśabdatvaṃ prāptā satī hṛdyā āsīt | atra atasyāḥ bhagavallakṣmyā api śreṣṭhyamīpsoḥ tulasītvamanabhīpsitamātraṃ na tūtkaṭāniṣṭamiti tadaprāptyā kevaleṣṭānavāptireva || yathāvā bhāvatkacaraṇataṭinībhāsarvadhurīṇatāmabhīpsantī | bhāratyavākchirāssyādapi tasyāstīrabhaivadeva syāt || 1300 || he deva ! bhāratī sarasvatī bhāvatkacaraṇataṭinyāḥ gaṅgāyāḥ bhā prabhā tasyāḥ sarvadhurāvoḍhṛtāṃ, sarvadhurāṃ vahati sarvadhurīṇaṃ tasya bhāvaḥ tattā 'vahati' ityarthe ‘khassarvadhurāt' iti khaḥ | abhīpsantī satī avākchirāssyādapi tasyāḥ tvaccaraṇataṭinyāḥ tīrabhaiva syāt | mahatā'pi prayāsena tattīrasadṛśaprabhaiva syānna tu tattulyaprabheti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe bhāratīti śabdavyaktiḥ vilomā cettadā tīrabhetyeva niṣpadyetetyarthaḥ | atrāpi bhagavaccaraṇataṭinīśobhābhīpsorbhāratyāḥ tattīradīptilābho'nabhīpsitaḥ, na tūtkaṭāniṣṭarūpa iti kevaleṣṭānavāptireva || yathāvā tava ketakī kapolaśriyamicchantī svamamba taṃ varṇam | jahatī kekī bhūtvā cikurakalāpaśriyaṃ paramavāpnot || 1301 || svaṃ svakīyaṃ taṃ lokottaratayā prasiddhaṃ varṇaṃ gauravarṇam | pakṣe svaṃ svavācakapadaghaṭakaṃ taṃ tamityākārakaṃ varṇaṃ akṣaraṃ jahatī satī kekī mayūro bhūtvā | pakṣe svavācakaketakīśabdaḥ takārāpasāraṇāt kekīti niṣpanna ityarthaḥ, vācyavācakatādātmyavaibhavāt | cikurakalāpaśriyaṃ kacakalāpalakṣmīṃ, spaṣṭamanyat | atra ketakyāḥ anabhīpsitaśrīkacakalāpaśobhālābhe'pi tasyāniṣṭatvābhāvātsvābhīṣṭalakṣmīkapoladyutyalābhamātramiti kevaleṣṭānavāptiriva | lakṣaṇe aniṣṭāvāptirityatra iṣṭapadena samasyamānasya nañaḥ 'asuraḥ adharmaḥ aśubhaṃ' ityādāviva virodho'rthaḥ, na tu ‘amānuṣaḥ anaśvaḥ' ityādāviva tadbhinnatvam | tena aniṣṭamanartharūpamiti siddhyati | tathā ca tādṛśāniṣṭapratilambha eva viṣamaṃ, na tviṣṭabhinnasya yasyakasyacidudāsīnasyeti rahasyam | tathaiva prāktanabahūdāharaṇadarśanāt || yatrāniṣṭaprāptiriṣṭānavāptirvā śleṣamahimnaiva pratīyate na vastutaḥ tatrāpi viṣamālaṃkāro bhavatyeva | yathā mā bhūtkvāpi parābhava iti ye jagataḥ prabhuṃ bhajanti tvām | bata puṣkarākṣa teṣāṃ bhavatā kriyate parābhavaprāptiḥ || 1302 || he puṣkarākṣa ! kvāpi parābhavaḥ mā bhūditi ye tvāṃ bhajanti teṣāṃ parābhavaprāptiḥ bhavatā kriyata iti virodhaḥ | parā śreṣṭhā, bhavasyābhāvo'bhavaṃ arthābhāve'vyayībhāvaḥ, na bhavaḥ abhava iti tatpuruṣo vā, tasya prāptiḥ niśśreyasaprāptirityarthaḥ | yadvā he pareti bhagavatassaṃbodhanam | abhavaprāptiḥ ukta evārthaḥ, iti parihāraḥ | atra viśveśvaramajaṃ devaṃ jagataḥ prabhumavyayam | bhajanti ye puṣkarākṣaṃ na te yānti parābhavam || iti ślokārtho'nusaṃhitaḥ | atra parābhavaprāptiriti śleṣeṇaiva aniṣṭaprāptiriṣṭāprāptirvā nibaddhā, na tu vastusiddhā || yathāvā cakratulepsuravāgrā bhavataḥ kaumudakī tadaprāptyā | nātha vimodā kaukī bhūtvā tadabhidhakhagānubandhamagāt || 1303 || he nātha bhagavan! bhavataḥ kaumodakī gadā cakrasya sudarśanasya tulāṃ īpsuḥ ata eva avāgrā avanatā | ‘avāgre'vanatānatam' ityamaraḥ | tatsāmyalābhārthaṃ namratayā kṛtatadupasarpaṇeti bhāvaḥ | tadaprāptyā vimodā vigalitamodā satī | yadvā tadaprāptyā avāgreti yojanā | tadalābhaprayuktasaṃkocena namraśirā ityarthaḥ | vastustaḥ kaumodakyāḥ bhagavadvāmapāṇinā avākchikharatayaiva dhṛtatvasya darśanāttathoktiḥ | kokasyeyaṃ kaukī ‘tasyedam' ityaṇi 'ṭiḍhḍha, iti ṅīp, bhūtvā | pakṣe kaumodakīti śabdavyaktiḥ modeti varṇadvayavigame kaukīti siddhetyarthaḥ | tasya cakrasya abhidhā nāma yasya saḥ tathoktaḥ khagaḥ pakṣī cakravāka ityarthaḥ | yathā'nuśiṣyate 'kokaścakraścakravāko rathāṅgāhvayanāmakaḥ' iti | tasya anubandhitāṃ saṃbandhaṃ agāt, kaukītvaprāpteriti bhāvaḥ | atra kaumodakyāḥ kaukītvalakṣaṇāniṣṭaprāptiḥ śleṣeṇaiva, na tu vastutaḥ || yathāvā prāktanapaṅkamaśeṣaṃ tvaṃ śoṣayituṃ harerbhajasi pādam | tasmātkīrtirudeṣyati navyeti sakhe punarna jānīṣe || 2304 || he sakhe! iti yaṃkaṃcitsuhṛdaṃ prati saṃbodhanam | aśeṣaṃ niśśeṣaṃ yathāsyāttathā prāktanapaṅkaṃ pūrvāghaṃ prācīnakardamaṃ ca śoṣayituṃ nirākartuṃ śuṣkaṃ kartuṃ ca, hareḥ bhagavataḥ bhānośca, pādaṃ caraṇaṃ kiraṇaṃ ca bhajasi prītipūrvakamanudhyāsi sevase ca | tasmāt tadbhajanāt kīrtiḥ ‘yaśo'haṃ bhavāmi brāhmaṇānām' ityādiśrutyuktaprakāreṇa yaśassādhanabhūtaṃ paraṃ brahma udeṣyati darśanasamānākāradhyānagoḥ caratāṃ prapatsyate | punaḥ na vyeti vyayaṃ na prāpnoti na kṣaratītyarthaḥ | yadvā kīrtiḥ brahmavittvaprathā udeṣyati janiṣyate | punana vyeti nāpacīyata ityarthaḥ| pakṣe navyā abhinavā kīrtiḥ kardamaḥ punaḥ udeṣyati iti na jānīṣe | atra prāktanāśeṣapaṅkaśoṣaṇāya haripādaṃ bhajamānasya tallābhasadbhāve'pi apūrvakardamarūpāniṣṭaprāptiśca śleṣeṇaiva nibaddhā || yathāvā nityabhavabhramikhanno'smyabhrāntaḥ kvacana haripade satataṃ syām | iti kṛtayatano'pi hare prāvṛṣi kevalamavindatepsitaminduḥ || 1305 || he hare! nityaṃ bhave saṃsāre bhrameṇa caṅkramaṇena dehātmabhrameṇa vā khinno'smīti nirvedoktiḥ | ataḥ abhrāntaḥ nityasaṃcāravidhuro dehātmabhramavidhuro vā san haripade bhagavanmandire kvacana tatrāpi yatrakvacit satataṃ sadā syāṃ nivaseyam | yatkiṃcidapi kurvāṇo viṣṇorāyatane vaset | na kiṃcidapi kurvāṇo viṣṇorāyatane vaset || iti bhagavacchāstrāditi bhāvaḥ | iti kṛtayatano'pi induḥ prāvṛṣi kevalaṃ varṣāsamayamātre īpsitaṃ pūrvoktamabhīṣṭaṃ avindata na tvanyadā | prāvṛṣyeva candramā viṣṇupade kvacana abhrāntasthitimānabhūt na tu śaradādāvityarthaḥ | vastusthitistu nityabhavaḥ satataṃ jātaḥ yo bhramaḥ merupradakṣiṇasaṃcāraḥ tena khinnaḥ haripade antarikṣe kvacana abhrāntaḥ jalabhṛdantare sthitimāniti | atrendoryatkiṃcitkālikeṣṭāvaptireva, na sārvakālikeṣṭāvāptiḥ śleṣamahimnaiva || evaṃ prāgupadarśiteṣūdāharaṇeṣu prāyeṇa śleṣamūlābhedādhyavasāyavaibhavenāniṣṭaprāptīṣṭānavāptī pradarśite api vyutpitsubālabuddhivaiśadyāya punarvivicya pradarśite || evameteṣu sarveṣūtpādyotpādakabhāvarūpasaṃsargagarbheṣu prabhedeṣu kāryakāraṇayoḥ kvacidvilakṣaṇaguṇaśālitvenānurūpyābhāvāt kvacicceṣṭāpādakatvenābhimatasya kāraṇasyeṣṭānavāptyaniṣṭāvāptirūpakāryeṇānurūpyābhāvātsāmānyalakṣaṇānugatiriti dhyeyam || ityalaṅkāramaṇihāre viṣamālaṃkārasaraścatvāriṃśaḥ || <16> atha samālaṃkārasaraḥ yatrānurūpaghaṭanaṃ varṇyate tatsamaṃ viduḥ || parasparamanurūpayossaṃsargasya varṇanaṃ samālaṃkāraḥ | atrāpi saṃsargo viṣama iva saṃyogalakṣaṇa utpattyādilakṣaṇaścetīdaṃ sarvaprakārasādhāraṇaṃ lakṣaṇam | tatra saṃyogādilakṣaṇasya saṃsargasyānurūpatā ca dvedhā stutiparyavasāyinī nindāparyavasāyinī ceti | idaṃ prathamaviṣamapratidvandvi samam || tatrādyā yathā sthānaṃ śrīśailastava nūnaṃ tvaṃ śrīnivāsa evāsi | dānaṃ śriyaśśritebhyassānandaṃ vitarasīti yuktamidam || 1306 || yathāvā svālokairvardhayase vibudhāgrasarasvato hare bhuvanam | kairavamatā tava śrīrmanye tvaṃ vidhurasītyucitameva || 1307 || he vibudhāgrasara tridaśaśreṣṭha! agre saratītyagrasara iti vigrahaḥ | ‘puro'grato'greṣu sarteḥ' iti ṭaḥ | ‘yūdhaṃ tadagrasaragarvitakṛṣṇasāram' ityādāviva bāhulakādagraśabdasya edantatvanipātanābhāvaḥ| he hare ! ālokaiḥ kaṭākṣaiḥ ‘tadaikṣata bahu syām' ityuktasaṃkalpaviśeṣairvā svataḥ svabhāvata eva bhuvanaṃ lokaṃ, jātyabhiprāyakamekavacanaṃ, vardhayase sṛṣṭipūrvakaṃ samedhayase | tava īdṛśasya bhavataḥ śrīḥ saṃpattiḥ sarvalokeśvaratvarūpā kaiḥ janaiḥ avamatā avahelitā, na kairapīti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe vibudhāgra sarasvataḥ iti cchedaḥ | he vibudhāgra devaśreṣṭha! 'parārthyāgraprāgrasaraprāgryā gryāgrīyamagriyam' ityamaraḥ | ālokaiḥ prakāśaiḥ svakiraṇairityarthaḥ| sarasvataḥ sāgarasya bhuvanaṃ jalaṃ abhivardhayase utsecayase | tava śrīḥ śobhā kairavamatā kairavāṇāṃ kumudānāṃ matā abhimatā | ataḥ tvaṃ vidhuḥ candraḥ asīti ucitameva manye | vidhuḥ bhagavāniti tu tattvam || yathāvā bhūyassu bhūṣaṇeṣvapi kalayasi kamaleśa kāñcikāṃ madhye | madhyasthatocitā'syāḥ pratīpavacane'pi na vikṛtā yadiyam || 1308 || yat yasmāt kāraṇāt iyaṃ kāñcikā pratīpavacane'pi svapratikūlabhāṣaṇe'pi na vikṛtā avikṛtasvabhāvā nyāyaikadṛṣṭitayā svābhīpsitaviruddhabhāṣaṇe'pi cittavikāraṃ naitīti bhāvaḥ | asyāḥ evaṃvidhāyā madhyasthatā madhye nyāyye'rthe tiṣṭhatīti madhyasthaṃ tasya bhāvaḥ madhyasthatā ‘śaradaḥ kṛtārthatā' ityādāviva sāmānye napuṃsakamityasakṛdavocāma | nyāyyamārgavartitvamityarthaḥ | 'nyāyye'pi madhyam' ityamaraḥ | 'astrī madhyaṃ same nyāyye'pyavakāśāvalagnayoḥ' iti ratnamālā ca | pakṣe kāñcikāśabdaḥ pratikūlatayā pāṭhe'pyavikṛtānupūrvīko bhavatītyarthaḥ | asyāḥ kāñcikāyāḥ madhyasthatā avalagnalagnatā uciteti vastusthitiḥ | tasyāḥ madhyaikabhūṣaṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ || yathāvā ādyantatulyarūpaṃ vibhinnavarṇamapi madhyatastava bhagavan | nayanaṃ nalinaṃ ca kadā'pyapratikūlaṃ taducitamanayossakhyam || 1309 || he bhagavan! tava nayanaṃ nalinaṃ ca ādyantayoḥ mūlāpāṅgayoḥ prathamacaramabhāgayośca tulyarūpaṃ ubhayorapyaruṇavarṇatvāt, tulyākṣaraṃ ca anayośabdayorādyantayornakāraghaṭitatvāt | madhye madhyabhāge vibhinnavarṇaṃ parasparavilakṣaṇavarṇamapi nayanasya madhye kanīnikayā nailyāt nalinasya tu karṇikayā piśaṅgatvāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe ya li ityanyonyavilakṣaṇamadhyamākṣaramātramityarthaḥ | sadā'pi apratikūlaṃ anyonyaprātikūlyarahitaṃ aviruddhabhūyodharmavattayā yatkiṃcidviruddhadharmavattāyā akiṃcitkaratvāditi bhāvaḥ | śabdapakṣe sadā'pi ānulomya iva prātilomye'pīti bhāvaḥ | apratikūlaṃ avikṛtānupūrvīkameva | tat tasmāt anayoḥ nayananalinayoḥ sakhyaṃ ucitameva yatkiṃciddharmavailakṣaṇye'pi tayorbhūyodharmavattāyāssadbhāvātsāmyaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | kiṃca atra tava nayanamityanena bhagavato bhānurūpaṃ nayanameva cedvivakṣyeta tadā'pyamūni viśeṣaṇānyubhayasādhāraṇānyeva | yathā ādyantatulyarūpatvamanayorubhayorapyaruṇavarṇatvāt | madhye vibhinnavarṇatvaṃ ca bhānormadhye'pyaruṇavarṇatvāt, nalinasya uktarītyā madhye piśaṅgavarṇatvācca | sadā'pyapratikūlatvaṃ tūbhayorānukūlyasya lokavedaviśrutatvāt | tasmādbhānunalinayossakhyamucitameveti | anyattulyam || yathāvā api yatprasavyabhāve nanu ghanasāro rasānaghastadayam | ghanasārasyācyuta tava rasānaghasyocitaṃ lalāmamiti || 1310 || nanu acyuta ! yat yasmāt ghanasāraḥ karpūraḥ prasavyaḥ pratikūlaḥ bhāvaḥ svabhāvo yasya tasminnapi jane rasānaghaḥ rasena prītyā anaghaḥ nirdoṣaprītiriti bhāvaḥ | rasaḥ anaghaḥ yasyeti vā vigrahaḥ | apiśabdena anukūlasvabhāve rasānaghatvaṃ kaimutikanyāyasiddhamiti dyotitam | vastutastu ghanasāraśabdaḥ pratikūlatve rasānagha iti niṣpadyata ityarthaḥ | ‘prasavyaṃ savya āyatte pratikūlāṃnukūlayoḥ' iti ratnamālā | tat tasmāt ayaṃ īdṛśo ghanasāraḥ ghanassāraḥ balaṃ yasya tasya ghanasārasya, prasavyabhāve'pītyetadatrāṇyanuṣajyate | anukūlasvabhāve puṃsīva pratikūlasvabhāve'pi viṣaye iti tadarthaḥ | rasānaghaḥ nirdoṣaprītiśālī, na hi mahodārasyāsya prītiviṣaye pratikūlānukūlakakṣyāvibhāgo'stīti bhāvaḥ | yadrā rasaḥ ānandopalakṣitānantakalyāṇaguṇākaraḥ anaghaḥ akhilaheyapratyanīka ityarthaḥ | cetanaḥ anukūlaḥ pratikūlovā'stu tadānukūlyaprātikūlyābhyāṃ svābhāvikasyaitadubhayaliṅgatvasya na kaścidviśeṣassaṃbhavatīti bhāvaḥ | īdṛśasya tava lalāmaṃ divyavadane puṇḍraṃ bhavatītyucitaṃ, ubhayorapi ghanasāratvarasānaghatvābhyāmānurūpyāditi bhāvaḥ | 'lalāmaṃ pucchapuṇḍrāśvabhūṣāprādhānyaketuṣu' ityamaraḥ | prasiddhaṃ hi śrīnivāsasya bhagavataḥ karpūrordhvapuṇḍraśobhamānaphālaphalakatvam || yathāvā karpūraṃ tava mukhamapi candrābhikhyojjvalaṃ tathā surabhi | uragācalaśikharaśaśinnucitaṃ khalu tasya tallalāmatvam || 1311 || candrābhikhyayā candranāmnā ujjvalaṃ ‘ghanasāraścandrasaṃjñaḥ' ityanuśāsanāt | pakṣe candranibhaśobhāvibhāsuraṃ | tathā tadvat surabhi sugandhi, pakṣe manojñaṃ 'sugandhau ca manojñe ca vācyavatsurabhissmṛtaḥ' iti viśvaḥ | tathāsurabhīti samastaṃ vā padam | lokottarasaurabhaśālītyarthaḥ | tasya karpūrasya tallalāmatvaṃ tvadvadanasya puṇḍratvaṃ bhūṣaṇatvaṃ vā, kośastūktaḥ | atrādya udāharaṇe parasparamanurūpayoḥ śrīnivāsaśrīpradānayoḥ, dvitīye svālokakaraṇakabhuvanābhivardhanādividhutvayoḥ, tṛtīye kāñcikāmadhyasthatvayoḥ turīye nayananalinasakhyayoḥ, pañcamaṣaṣṭhayorudāharaṇayorghanasāraśrīnivāsamukhalalāmatvayossaṃsargasya varṇanam || yathāvā phaṇivṛṣabhācalabhāsvan śubhāśrayaṃ tava vibhāvayannantaḥ | tatkratunayādihaiva hi śubhāśrayo'bhavamarephasaṃsargaḥ || 1312 || he phaṇivṛṣabhācalabhāsvan! tava śubhaścāsāvāśrayaśca dhyānālambanabhūto divyamaṅgalavigrahaḥ taṃ antaḥ vibhāvayan dhyāyan ahaṃ tatkratunayāt ‘yathākraturasmin loke puruṣo bhavati tathetaḥ pretya bhavati' iti śrutipratipāditayathākratunyāyāt | kraturupāsanam | ihaiva na tvitaḥ pretya | idamāścaryamiti bhāvaḥ | rephasya garhitasya aghasyetyarthaḥ | ‘ninditasya ca sevanāt' ityādau aghasya ninditatvokteḥ| saṃsargassaṃbandhaḥ sa nāsti yasya saḥ arephasaṃsargassan śubhāśrayaḥ maṅgalavigrahaḥ abhavam | pakṣe śubhāśrayaśabdaḥ arephasaṃsargaḥ ravarṇasaṃbandharahitaḥ śubhāśaya iti niṣpanna ityarthaḥ | śabdārthayostādātmyam | ‘ravarṇe puṃsi rephassyāt kutsite vācyaliṅgakaḥ' ityamaraḥ | tvaddivyamaṅgalavigrahānudhyānena nirastanikhilāghaḥ kalyāṇāśayo'bhavamiti nirgalito'rthaḥ | ‘āśayassyādabhiprāye mānasādhārayorapi' iti viśvaḥ | atra śubhāśrayānudhyānaśubhāśrayatvaprāptyoranurūpayorvarṇanam || yathāvā vinatānandananipuṇau dvāvapi viśvaṃbharābhivahanacaṇau | tannabhidā kā'pyanayormaitryucitā patagapannagādhipayoḥ || 1313 || dvāvapi patagapannagādhipāvubhāvapi vinatānandananipuṇau vinatāyāḥ vinatānāṃ ca ānandane nipuṇau | viśvaṃbharasya viśvaṃbharāyāśca abhivahanena vittau abhivahanacaṇau | ‘tena vittaḥ' iti caṇappratyayaḥ | prathita ityarthaḥ | tat tasmāt anayoḥ patagapannagādhipayoḥ garutmadanantayoḥ kā'pi bhidā vailakṣaṇyaṃ nāsti | ato'nayoḥ maitrī ucitā, ubhayorapi tulyadharmakatvāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe patagādhipapannagādhipaśabdayoḥ, tannabhideti samastaṃ padam | takāradvitvaghaṭitanakārābhyāmeva bhedaḥ, pakāragakārādivarṇānāmubhayatra taulyāditi bhāvaḥ | atra patagapannagādhipayoranyonyamaitryā ānurūpyam || yathāvā vyatyayasamaye'pyavikṛtabhāvairyairvaiṣṇavaissthitaṃ bhagavan | tādṛkṣā eva hi taissevyante tvatpadaśritā yatayaḥ || 1314 || he bhagavan ! vyatyayasamaye viparyayakāle'pi atikṛchradaśāvasare'pīti yāvat | yaiḥ vaiṣṇavaiḥ avikṛtabhāvaiḥ yathā'vasthitabhagavaccheṣatvādisvabhāvaireva sthitaṃ, bhāve ktaḥ | taiḥ vaiṣṇavaiḥ tādṛkṣāḥ vyatyayasamaye'pyavikṛtasvabhāvā eva tvatpadaśritāḥ tvaccaraṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | yadvā tvatpadaṃ tvaccihnaṃ tridaṇḍamityarthaḥ | ‘tridaṇḍaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ liṅgam' iti smaraṇāt | śritāḥ tridaṇḍina ityarthaḥ | yatayaḥ saṃyaminaḥ sevyante, na tvatādṛśā iti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe varṇaviparyāsasamaye'pyavikṛtasvabhāvaiḥ vaiṣṇavaiḥ, asya vaiṣṇavairityānupūrvīviśiṣṭasya padasya viparyayeṇa paṭhane'pi tathaivāvasthānāditi bhāvaḥ | tādṛkṣāḥ uktavidhāḥ yatayaḥ asyāpi padasya vaiparītye yathāpūrvamevāvasthiteriti bhāvaḥ | arthagatasya bahutvasya pade āropaḥ | atra vaiṣṇavānāṃ tridaṇḍināṃ prapannānāṃ vā yatīnāṃ cānurūpassaṃsargaḥ || yathāvā jagatāmadhibhūrbhagavān śrīradhibhūstvamapi tadidamanurūpam | prāyeṇa vibhaktāvapi pauṃsne straiṇe yadaikarūpyajuṣau || 1315 || he śrīḥ ! bhagavān jagatāṃ adhibhūḥ adhīśvaraḥ 'eṣa sarveśvaraḥ' 'patiṃ viśvasya' ityādiśravaṇāt | ‘adhibhūrnāyako netā' ityamaraḥ | tvamapi jagatāṃ adhibhūḥ adhīśvarī ‘īśānā devī bhuvanasyādhipatnī, asyeśānā jagato viṣṇupatnī' ityādiśruteḥ | tadidaṃ yuvayoradhīśvaratvaṃ anurūpam | ubhayoradhibhūtve hetumāha prāyeṇetyādinā | yat yasmāt pauṃsne puṃsamūhe straiṇe strīsamūhe ca vibhaktāvapi devatiryaṅmanuṣyeṣu punnāmā bhagavān hariḥ | strīnāmnī lakṣmīrmaitreya nāvayorvidyate param || yo yo bhavati puṃbhācassa viṣṇoriti niścayaḥ | ya yastu nārībhāvassyāttatra lakṣmīrvyavasthitā || iti vaiṣṇavabrāhmapurāṇādyuktarītyā parasparecchāviśeṣeṇa kṛtavibhāgāvapi aikarūpyajuṣau jagadvyāptyādilakṣaṇasvabhāvaikyabhājau, mayā yathā jagadvyāptaṃ svarūpeṇa svabhāvataḥ | tayā vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ niyantrī ca tatheśvarī || mayā vyāptā tathā sā'pi tayā vyāpto'hamīśvaraḥ | iti viṣvaksenasaṃhitādyukteḥ | prāyeṇetyuktyā mama tasyāśca seneśa vailakṣaṇyamidaṃ śruṇu | maccheṣabhūtā sarveṣāmīśvarī vallabhā mama || tasyāśca jagataścāhamīśvaro vedaviśrutaḥ | ityādyuktaṃ kiṃcidvailakṣaṇyamastīti sūcitam | ato yuvayoradhibhūtvamanurūpameveti | pakṣe adhibhūśabdāvubhāvapi pauṃsne puṃstve straiṇe strītve ca 'strīpuṃsābhyāṃ nañsnañau bhavanāt' ityapatyādibhavanādhikāraparyantamukteṣvartheṣu nañasnañorvidhānātsamūhārthe bhāvārthe ca puṃśabdāt snañ, strīśabdānnañ ca pratyayaḥ | vibhaktau svādivibhaktau parata iti śabdaśāstramaryādālabhyaṃ, prāyeṇa bhūmnā aikarūpyajuṣau tayośśabdayoḥ pulliṅgastrīliṅgayoraikarūpyasya darśanāditi bhāvaḥ | strīliṅge ṅiti āmi ca vibhaktau rūpāntarasyāpi vidhānātprāyeṇetyuktam | tasmātpuṃstrīvācakayorubhayorapyadhibhūśabdayorānurūpyamiti || yathāvā yadyādideva satvaṃ hṛdyāvirbhāvabhākparaṃ sukṛtāt | vidyāma tadā sattvaṃ hṛdyāvirbhāvabhāgiti sthāne || he ādideva ! akhilajagatkāraṇabhūta bhagavan ! anena ‘ādidevo mahābāhurharirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ' ityetat smāritam | sukṛtāt yādṛcchikaprāsaṅgikānuṣaṅgikabhedabhidurātsukṛtaviśeṣāt paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ satvaṃ satvaguṇaḥ hṛdi manasi avirbhāvabhāgyadi āvirbhūtaṃ cet āhāraśuddhimūlakasattvaguṇalābhena cittaśuddhirbhaveccediti bhāvaḥ | tadā saḥ sakalajagatkāraṇatvaniyantṛtvādinā prasiddhaḥ tvaṃ hṛdi citte avirbhāvabhāk | yadvā hṛdyaḥ hṛdayasya priyaḥ yaḥ avirbhāvaḥ taṃ bhajatīti tathoktaḥ | darśanasamānākāradhruvānusmṛtirūpadhyānagocaro bhavasīti sthāne yuktaṃ vidyāma jānīyāma | viderliṅuttamabahuvacanam | atra ‘āhāraśuddhau sattvaśruddhissattvaśuddhau dhruvā smṛtiḥ' iti śrutyarthacchāyā'nusmṛtā | atra sattvaśuddhibhagavadāvirbhāvayoranurūpayorvarṇanam || yathāvā vṛṣagotraśekharaṃ tvāmuṣasi smaratāṃ hare'cyutātmavatām | bhadratvaṃ cokṣatvaṃ prāpyaṃ yadbhavati tadidamanurūpam || 1317 || he hare ! idaṃ ca saṃbodhanaṃ vakṣyamāṇapratyūṣasmaraṇānuguṇyāya | ‘uttiṣṭhaṃścintaya harim' iti smaraṇām | anenaivāsya vakṣyamāṇabhadratvaprāpaṇānukūlaṃ maṅgalatvamapi dyotitam | nityotsavo bhavetteṣāṃ nityaśrīrnityamaṅgalam | yeṣāṃ hṛdistho bhagavān maṅgalāyatanaṃ hariḥ || iti smaraṇāt | he acyuta! anena vakṣyamāṇacokṣatvasaṃpādanānuguṇaṃ pāvanatvaṃ vyañjitam | yathācocyate atipāpaprasakto'pi dhyāyannimiṣamacyutam | bhūyastapasvī bhavati paṅktipāvanapāvanaḥ || iti | uṣasi pratyūṣe vṛṣagotraśekharaṃ śeṣādriśekharaṃ tvāṃ smaratāṃ ātmavatāṃ jñānināṃ yat bhadratvaṃ maṅgalāyatanatvenoktasya harestavasmaraṇena yatkalyāṇatvamiti bhāvaḥ, prāpyaṃ bhavati tat anurūpam | yat cokṣatvaṃ śuddhatvaṃ ca prāpyaṃ pāvanatamatvenoktasyācyutasya tava smaraṇena yatpavitratvaṃ labhyamiti bhāvaḥ, tadidamapyanurūpam | ‘cukṣa saṃśuddhau' asmātpacādyac | ‘bhadraśśive khañjarīṭe vṛṣabhe ca kadambake' ityupakramya 'klībaṃ maṅgalamustayoḥ' iti 'cokṣo gīte śucau dakṣe tathā'bhīkṣṇamanojñayoḥ' iti medinī | pakṣe vṛṣagotraśekharaṃ vṛṣabhakulāvataṃsaṃ tvāṃ smaratāṃ bhadratvaṃ vṛṣabhatvaṃ yat prāpyaṃ tadanurūpam | ca ukṣatvamiti chedaḥ | ukṣatvaṃ ca prāpyamiti yat tadidamapyanurūpamityarthaḥ | vṛṣabhakulāvataṃsasmartṝṇāmidaṃ phalamucitameveti bhāvaḥ | atra vṛṣagotraśekharasmaraṇasya bhadratvāvāptyādeścānurūpyam || yathāvā acyutaśobhanabhogasparśanatasphātimān ghanāghanarāṭ | atimātramunnataśśrīstanatītyucitaṃ payodharo hyeṣaḥ || 1318 || acyutā apracyutā śobhā yasya saḥ nabhaḥ gacchatīti nabhogaśca | viśeṣaṇobhayapadakarmadhārayaḥ | acyutaśobhaṃ yannabhaḥ tadgacchatīti tathokta iti vā | sparśanataḥ mārutāt sphātimān vṛddhimān | sparśanata ityatra sakārasya kharparakatvānnabhogaśabdāntimavisargalopa eṣṭavyaḥ, arthāntare'pi śabdasārūpyāya | evaṃ śrīstanatītyatrāpi | pakṣe acyutasya bhagavataḥ śobhano bhogo yasya tattathoktaṃ yat sparśanaṃ avamarśaḥ tena tataḥ, sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ| yadvā śobhano yo bhogasaṃmbhogaḥ tasmin tadavasare sparśanataḥ saṃsparśāt sphātimān ucchūnaityarthaḥ | ‘sphātirvṛddhau' ityamaraḥ | atimātraṃ unnatā śrīḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | ghanāghanarāṭ prāvṛṣeṇyavārivāhaḥ stanati garjatītyucitam | hi yasmāt eṣaḥ payodharaḥ pūrṇasalilaḥ | pakṣe atimātraṃ unnataḥ śrīstanati śrīstana ivācaratītyucitam | hi yasmāt eṣaḥ payodharaḥ pūrṇakṣīraḥ | atra ghanāghanarājasya stanatītiśabdapratipādyagarjanābhedādhyavasitastanavadācaraṇasya cānurūpyam | upamāsaṃkīrṇamidam || yathāvā sevanakṛcchramalabdhā pāvana tava pādapadmayormanujaḥ | sevanakṛcchramalabdhā devanakṛcchreṇiṣūcitaṃ hyetat || 1319 || he pāvana! 'pāvanassarvabhūtānāṃ tvameva raghunandana' ityuktarītyā pavitrarūpa he bhagavan! tava pādapadmayoḥ sevanakṛt sevāvidhātā | śramasya labdhā ‘tribhuvanavidhātuḥ' ityatreva śaiṣikaṣaṣṭhyāstṛjantena samāsaḥ | bhagavaccaraṇāravindaparicaraṇapariśramaśālītyarthaḥ | manujaḥ devanakṛtāṃ dhūrtānāṃ śreṇiṣu viṣaye sevanakṛt śramalabdhā bhavati etaducitamiti kākvā nocitamiti virodhaḥ | parihārastu sevanakṛcchraṃ alabdhā iti chedaḥ| devanakṛtāṃ akṣadevināṃ dhūrtānāṃ śreṇiṣu paṅktiṣu sevanasya syūteḥ ‘ṣivu tantusantāne, lyuṭ | kṛcchraṃ kleśaṃ alabdhā aprāptā | labhestṛn | dhūrtaśreṇimadhyaghaṭanaprayuktakleśamananubhavitā bhavati | bhagavaccaraṇāravindaparicaraṇacaṇasya tādṛśadoṣānunmeṣāditi bhāvaḥ | atra bhagavaccaraṇaparicaraṇakṛto dhūrtajanāsaṃsargo'nurūpaḥ | virodhālaṅkārayamakasaṃkīrṇatvaṃ viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā adhyakṣitamāsīdyairadhyahigiri deva tāvakaṃ rūpam | dadhati sadādhyakṣitamiha paratra cāmī tadetadanurūpam || 1320 || he deva ! yaiḥ janaiḥ adhyahigiri ahigirau tāvakaṃ rūpaṃ adhyakṣitaṃ sākṣātkṛtaṃ āsīt amī te janāḥ iha paratra ca adhyakṣitaṃ tat tvadrūpaṃ sadā dadhati | etat anurūpaṃ upāyaphalayoravisaṃvādāditi bhāvaḥ | vastutastu iha asmin loke sadā adhyakṣitaṃ adhyakṣaṃ kṛtaṃ adhirājatvena niṣpāditaṃ rūpaṃ dadhati rājāno bhavantītyarthaḥ | ‘adhyakṣo'dhikṛte puṃsi syātpratyakṣe'bhidheyavat' iti medinī | paratra ca paramapade'pi sadādhyakṣitaṃ rūpaṃ sat ādhyakṣitaṃ iti cchedaḥ | sat praśastaṃ satyakāmatvādiśubhaguṇavat | ādhinā manovyathayā aśanāyādihetukayā akṣitaṃ akṣīṇaṃ 'kṣi kṣaye' karmaṇi ktaḥ | rūpaṃ ‘apahatapāpmā' ityādyuktaṃ svābhāvikaṃ rūpaṃ dadhati || yathāvā raktaṃ tvayi sarvasame samatāṃ ceto bibharti sarvatra | bhagavan pratikūlaṃ tu prapadyate tatpratīpatāmeva || 1321 || he bhagavan ! sarvasame ‘sarvasya śaraṇaṃ suhṛt | samo'haṃ sarvabhūteṣu' ityuktarītyā sarvasuhṛdi tvayi raktaṃ anurāgaśāli cetaḥ cetanasya hṛdayaṃ sarvatra samatāṃ tulyadṛṣṭitāṃ bibharti | ‘tulyo mitrāripakṣayoḥ' ‘sarvabhūtaśśamaśśāntaḥ' ityādyuktacetanadharmasya cetasyāropaḥ | pratikūlaṃ sarvasuhṛdi tvayi prātikūlyabhāk cetastu tatpratīpatāṃ sarvasamatāprātikūlyameva vaiṣamyameva prapadyate | pakṣe tatpratikūlatāṃ tasya samatāmiti śabdasya pratilomaṃ tāmasamiti śabdaḥ tasya bhāvaṃ tāmasatāṃ prapadyata ityartho'pi camatkārātiśayaṃ puṣṇāti | atra sarvasamabhagavadviṣayakānurāgasarvasamatāvāptyoḥ tatpratikūlatvatāmasatāvāptyoścānurūpayorghaṭanam | mālārūpatvaṃ paryāyoktigarbhatvaṃ ca viśeṣaḥ || imāni sarvāṇyudāharaṇāni śleṣādisaṃkīrṇāni | idaṃ tu śuddhamudāharaṇam | yathā ajñaṃ sarvajñastvaṃ dayanīyaṃ māṃ dayāsudhāmbhodhe | dīnaṃ ca dīnabāndhava rakṣasi ceducitamambujākṣa tava || 1322 || sarvamidaṃ stutiparyavasāyi samam || nindāparyavasāyi yathā durjanaśikhāmaṇerme durjaraviṣayānudhāvanaṃ yuktam | śunakakharajambukādirnanu kalayati naiva heyavaimukhyam || 1323 || yathāvā nanu nātha śītalamahā jahāra bhavatassmitaśriyaṃ viśadām | hāśīlavarjito'sau tamassvabhāvaṃ babhāra tadyuktam || 1324 || nanu nātha! he bhagavan! śītalamahāḥ candramāḥ bhavataḥ viśadāṃ smitaśriyaṃ unnidrāṃ saṃpadamiti ca gamyate, jahāra | hā iti khede | śīlena sadvṛttena varjitaḥ asau
