śītalamahāḥ tamassvabhāvaṃ tamoguṇasvabhāvaṃ babhāra | tadyuktam, bhavadīyasmitaśrīhartussaccaritavarjitasya tamaḥprakṛtikatvaṃ yuktameveti bhāvaḥ | tamasaḥ timirasya suṣṭhu abhāvaḥ svabhāvaḥ taṃ babhāreti vastusthitiḥ | pakṣe hāśīla itivarṇatrayavarjitaśśītalamahā iti śabdaḥ tama iti varṇasamudayena svabhāvaṃ svasattāṃ babhāra | hāśīla iti varṇasamudayāpasaraṇe tāvanmātrameva pariśiṣṭa iti bhāvaḥ| | atra parasvāpaharaṇādestamassvarūpabharaṇasya cānurūpyaṃ nindāparyavasāyi || yathāvā kacajātarūpacauryāttavādyavarṇacyuto bata milindaḥ| agrajapumāśrito'pi prāpa pulindatvameṣa madhupo hi || 1325 || he śrīriti sāmarthyāllabhyate | milindaḥ bhramaraḥ milindaśabdaśca, tayostādātmyam | tava kacānāṃ śiroruhāṇāṃ yat jātarūpaṃ suvarṇaṃ tadābharaṇabhūtamiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā kacati dīpyata iti kacaṃ 'kaca dīptau' pacādyac | yat jātarūpaṃ daśavarṇasuvarṇamityarthaḥ | kacajātaṃ śiroruhajaṃ yat rūpaṃ nīlarūpamiti tu vastusthitiḥ, tasya cauryāt | ādyavarṇāt, brāhmaṇavarṇāt mi ityākārakaprathamavarṇācca cyutassan agrajāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ ye pumāṃsaḥ teṣāṃ āśrito'pi, śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāssamāsaḥ, tānāśrito'pītyarthaḥ | vastutastu agrajaṃ ādyaṃ mikārasthānikamiti bhāvaḥ | puṃ pumityākārakavarṇasamudayaṃ āśritaḥ | apissamuccaye | na kevalamādau mivarṇacyutaḥ apitu puvarṇamapyāśrita ityarthaḥ | pulindatvaṃ mlecchajātiviśeṣatvaṃ ‘bhedāḥ kirātaśabarapulindā mlecchajātayaḥ' ityamaraḥ | pakṣe pulindaśabdatvaṃ ca prāpa | asya pulindatāvāptau hetvantaraṃ samuccinoty eṣa iti | hi yasmāt eṣaḥ milindaḥ madhupaḥ madyapaḥ, iṃdṛśasya pulindatvaprāptirucitaiveti bhāvaḥ | makarandaliḍiti tatvam | atra kacajātarūpacauryaprabhṛteḥ pulindatvaprāptyādeścānurūpyaṃ nindāparyavasāyi || yathāvā mukhajamapi nātha jalajaṃ tvatpadavidveṣato'ntarāvilatām | etya jaghanyajamāsīdīdṛkṣasyāntyajatvamapyucitam || 1326 || he nātha jalajaṃ mukhajamapi svayaṃ brahmavarṇamapi 'mukhabhāge jakārasahitamiti vastusthitiḥ, śabdārthayostādātmyāt | jalajaṃ laḍayorabhedājjaḍajamityapi pratīyate | tvatpadavidveṣataḥ antaḥ manasi āvilatāṃ kaluṣatāṃ, pakṣe antarā avilatāṃ iti chedaḥ | vigato lakāro yasya tat vilaṃ na vilaṃ avilaṃ tasya bhāvaḥ avilatā tāṃ avilatāṃ, antarā madhye avilatāṃ lakārasā hityamityarthaḥ | etya jaghanyajaṃ śūdravarṇajaṃ ‘vṛṣalāśca jaghanyajāḥ' ityamaraḥ | pakṣe jaghanyaḥ antyaḥ jaḥ jakāro yasya tattathoktaṃ āsīt | naitāvadevāsya phalamityāhaīdṛkṣasyeti | tvatpadavidveṣiṇa ityarthaḥ | antyajatvaṃ caṇḍālatvamapi ucitameva | 'yo viṣṇuṃ satataṃ dveṣṭi taṃ vidyādantyaretasam' ityukteriti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe asya jalajapadasya antyaḥ antimaḥ jaḥ jakāro yasya tattathoktaṃ tasya bhāvaḥ antyajatvamapītyarthaḥ | jaghanyajāntyajaśabdayorasmin pakṣe tulyārthakatvāditi bhāvaḥ | atra bhagavatpadavidveṣasya jaghanyajatvādeścānurūpassaṃsargo nindāparyavasāyī || yathāvā airāvaṇastavāgrairahitatvamupetya raghuvara yaśobhiḥ | alabhata bata rāvaṇatāṃ tāvakavidveṣiṇo'sya yuktamidam || 1327 || he raghuvara! airāvaṇaḥ airāvataḥ agraiḥ parārthyaiḥ tava yaśobhissaha ahitatvaṃ dhāvalyena virodhaṃ upetya prāpya rāvaṇatāṃ alabhata | pakṣe airāvaṇaśabdaḥ agrairahitatvaṃ iti samastaṃ padam | agraḥ prathamaḥ ai itivarṇaḥ tadrahitatvaṃ upetya rāvaṇatāmalabhata tathā niṣpanna ityarthaḥ | tāvakavidveṣiṇaḥ tvadīyavastuviṣayakadveṣaśālinaḥ asya airāvatasya idaṃ yuktam | atra raghuvarayaśovidveṣarāvaṇatāvāptyorānurūpyam || yathāvā nirayastvadviṣaye yo nirayastenāpyate'hiśailamaṇe | narako yo dveṣṭi tvāṃ narako niyato'sya tadidamanurūpam || 1328 || yaḥ tvadviṣaye nirayaḥ ayāt niṣkrānto nirayaḥ ‘ayaśśubhāvaho vidhiḥ' ityamaraḥ | ‘nirādayaḥ krāntādyarthe pañcamyā' iti samāsaḥ | ‘na viṣṇvārādhanātpuṇyaṃ vidyate karma vaidikam' ityavaśyakartavyatayā vihitatvadārādhanarūpaśubhāvahavidhividhura ityarthaḥ | tena nirayaḥ narakaḥ āpyate | yaḥ narakaḥ kutsito naraḥ ‘kutsāyām' iti kan | tvāṃ dveṣṭā tācchīlye tṛn ‘na loka' iti ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhaḥ | asya puṃsaḥ narakaḥ nirayaḥ niyataḥ niyamena bhavitā | atra bhagavatparicaryāvaidhuryanirayaprāptyostadvidveṣanarakāvāptyoścānurūpyam | mālārūpamidamiti viśeṣaḥ | nindāparyavasāyitvaṃ tu pūrvavadeva | eṣūdāharaṇeṣvādimamudāharaṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntasaṃkīrṇaṃ, anyānyudāharaṇāni tu śleṣādisaṃkīrṇānīti viśeṣaḥ || dvitīyasamam samaṃ tadapi kāryasya sārūpyaṃ kāraṇena yat || kāryasya kāraṇena sārūpyamapi samālaṃkāraḥ | atrotpattilakṣaṇasaṃsargasyānurūpyam | tacca kāraṇātsvasamānaguṇakāryotpattyā, yādṛśaguṇakavastusaṃsargastādṛśaguṇotpattyā ceti dvividham | idaṃ dvitīyaviṣamapratidvandvi || tatrādyaṃ yathā kṛtasūryabhavāśleṣā gaṅgā cakrābjamatsyarekhāḍhyā | idamanurūpaṃ tasyā uditāyāḥ phaṇigirīśa tava padataḥ || 1329 || kṛtaḥ sūryabhavāyāḥ kālindyāḥ śleṣaḥ saṃsargo yayā sā tathokteti gaṅgāpakṣe, bhagavaccaraṇapakṣe tu kṛtaḥ sūrīṇāṃ viduṣāṃ abhavāśleṣaḥ saṃsārasaṃbandhavaidhuryaṃ yeneti yojyam | cakrāḥ cakravākāḥ abjāni padmāni matsyāśca teṣāṃ rekhayā paṅktyā āḍhyā | anyatra cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ abjaḥ śaṅkhaḥ abjaṃ padmaṃ vā matsyaśca teṣāṃ rekhābhiḥ tadākārarekhābhirāḍhyamiti || yathāvā ambhodhirājaduhitā gambhīrā śrīnivāsa tava dayitā | karituragadhenumaṇimukhavibhavaṃ sumanassu vitarati sthāne || 1330 || karituragadhenumaṇayaḥ airāvatoccaiśravaḥkāmagavīcintāmaṇayaḥ | anyatra gajādaya eva | sumanassu deveṣu vidratsu ca | atra udāharaṇadvaye kāraṇābhyāṃ bhagavaccaraṇāmbhonidhibhyāṃ kāryayorgaṅgālakṣmyossārūpyaṃ śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyena nirvyūḍham | ubhayatrāpi kāraṇātsvasamānaguṇakāryotpattyā utpattilakṣaṇasaṃsargasyānurūpyamuktam || yathāvā śrīstvāṃ jaladhissuṣuve viṣamapi saṃmūrchitaṃ jagadyābhyām | sāṃpratamidaṃ viṣamayo yadayaṃ kila sagarajātasaṃvṛddhaḥ || 1331 || he śrīḥ ‘śrīrveṣaracanāśobhāsaṃpatsaralaśākhiṣu | vāṇīlakṣmīlavaṅgeṣu viṣe bilve'pi' iti ratnamālā | jaladhiḥ tvāṃ viṣāparaparyāyaśrīśabdavācyāmiti bhāvaḥ | viṣamapi garalaṃ ca suṣuve | yābhyāṃ tvayā viṣeṇa ca jagat saṃmūrchitaṃ mohitaṃ niścetanīkṛtamityarthaḥ | śrīpakṣe 'tvayā ca viṣṇunā cāmba' ityuktarītyā abhivyāptamiti vāstavārthaḥ | ‘saṃmūrchanamabhivyāptāvucchrāyamohayorapi' iti medinī | idaṃ ambudherīdṛśavastujananaṃ sāṃprataṃ yuktam | yat yasmāt saḥ garajātasaṃvṛddha iti cchedaḥ | so'yamiti yojanā | pūrvokto'sau jaladhiḥ garajātena garalasamūhena saṃvardhitaḥ viṣamayaḥ pracuragaralaḥ | tasmādasya jaladheḥ viṣāparanāmaśrīśabdavācyavastvādiprasūtiruciteti bhāvaḥ | vastutastu sagaretyabhinnaṃ padam | sagarajātaiḥ sagarasutaiḥ abhivardhitaḥ viṣamayaḥ jalamaya ityarthaḥ | atrāpi kāraṇena jaladhinā kāryayośśrīviṣayossārūpyaṃ śleṣāsāditavaibhavam | pūrvodāharaṇadvayaṃ praśaṃsāparyavasāyi | idaṃ tu nindāparyavasāyīti bhedaḥ | evaṃca prathamasamaprabheda iva dvitīyamasminnapi stutinindāparyavasāyitvalakṣaṇadvaidhī saṃbhavatīti dhyeyam || dvitīyasamaprabhede dvitīyaṃ yathā ghanasāracūrṇakalpitalalāma kamalāmanohara mukhaṃ te | vidhunīte mama tāpaṃ vidadhātyāmodamiti yaducitaṃ tat || 1332 || kamalāmanohareti saṃbuddhiḥ | lalāmaśabdo nānto napuṃsakaliṅgaḥ | ‘lalāmaṃ ca lalāma ca' ityanuśāsanāt || yathāvā visṛmarakaustubhamahasā masṛṇaṃ kamalāṅghrijaturasātyaruṇam | añjanagiripatihṛdayaṃ rañjayati mano mametyucitametat || 1333 || rañjayati aruṇayati ānandayati ca | atrādye udāharaṇe bhagavanmukhagataśiśirasurabhilaghanasāratilakasaṃsargānurūpyaṃ tāpavidhūnanāmodanarūpakāryayoḥ | anantarodāharaṇe manorañjanarūpakāryasya bhagavadurassthalagatakaustubhaprabhādisaṃsargānurūpyam || yathāvā hālāhalasahajanmā vyālāvanibhṛdvibhośca hṛdayamagāḥ | yassevate sadā tvāṃ sudhābdhitanaye samuhyatītyucitam || 1334 || vyālāvanibhṛdvibhoḥ bhujagarājādhirājasya hṛdayaṃ antaraṃ śeṣācalanāthasya vakṣa iti vastusthitiḥ | sevate pibati bhajate ca | muhyati mūrchati aiśvaryamūlakacittavikāraṃ prāpnoti ca | spaṣṭamanyat | pūrvodāharaṇadvayaṃ praśaṃsāparyavasāyi, idaṃ tu nindāparyavasāyīti pūrvavadeva bhedaḥ | evaṃca dvitīyasamaviśeṣe prāthamikaprabhedodāharaṇatraye kṛtasūryabhavāśleṣetyādau kāraṇasvabhāvānurūpyaṃ kāryasya dvitīyaprabhedodāharaṇatraye ghanasāracūrṇetyādau agantukaghanasārādisaṃsargānurūpyamiti niṣkarṣaḥ || tṛtīyasamam yatkiñcidiṣṭasiddhyarthaṃ ya udyogo vitanyate | aniṣṭena vinā tasya siddhiśca samamucyate || yatkiñcidiṣṭaprāptyarthanaprayuktātkāraṇādaniṣṭaṃ vinā tatprāptyā utpattilakṣaṇasaṃsargasyānurūpyaṃ ca samālaṃkāra ityarthaḥ | utkaṭeṣṭāntaraprāptau tu praharṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate | idaṃ tṛtīyaṃ samaṃ ‘iṣṭārthodyogato'niṣṭāvāptiśca viṣamaṃ matam' iti saṃgṛhītasaprakāratrividhaviṣamasyāpi pratidvandvi, iṣṭāvāpteraniṣṭasyāprasaṅgācca || yathā aniśamapi taṃ niṣevitumasitaṃ niśyutpalaṃ niṣevya vidhum | tvaddivyadṛgātmatvaṃ prāpya rame svepsitārthamanubhavati || 1335 || he rame ! aniśaṃ niśāyā abhāve'pi | arthābhāve'vyayībhāvaḥ | taṃ vidhuṃ śrīnivāsaṃ candramasamiti tu tattvam | niṣevituṃ asitamutpalaṃ indīvaraṃ niśi vidhuṃ niṣevya niśāyā yogābhyāsasamayatvāttadā vidhumupāsyetyarthaḥ | tvaddivyadṛgātmatvaṃ tava kamanīyanayanarūpatvaṃ tvadviṣayakāsaṃkucitajñānātmatvaṃ pariśuddhaṃ svarūpamityapi gamyate | prāpya svepsitārthaṃ aniśavidhuniṣevaṇarūpamabhīṣṭārthaṃ anubhavati | atra niśābhāvadaśāyāmapi vidhuniṣevaṇalakṣaṇābhīṣṭāvāptyarthaṃ prayuktānniśādhikaraṇakopāsanalakṣaṇātkāraṇādindīvarasyāniṣṭaṃ vinā tatsiddherutpattilakṣaṇasasaṃrgasyānurūpyam || yathāvā satatamapi harikaragrahavaibhavamākāṅkṣadamba sarasiruham | abhihari salile tapvā'labhata tvatpāṇijanmani tadeva || 1336 || harikaragrahavaibhavaṃ bhagavatpāṇigrahaṇasaṃpadaṃ bhānukarasaṃparkātiśayaṃ ca | abhihari bhagavadabhimukhaṃ bhānumadabhimukhaṃ ca | tadeva satataharikaragrahavaibhavameva | atrāpi sārvakālikaharikaragrahaṇalakṣaṇābhīṣṭalābhāya haryabhimukhaṃ tapasyato'mbujasya janmāntare'niṣṭaṃ vinā tatsiddhirdarśitā || yathāvā dātuṃ vibhave bhogānbhoktuṃ svayamapi bhavan bahuvidhāśaḥ | janani sudhākalaśastvatkucajanmani bhavati sukala iti yuktam || 1337 || he janani ! sudhākalaśaḥ amṛtakumbhaḥ sudhākalaśaśabdaśca vibhave sati aiśvaryāvasara ityarthaḥ | vibhave lokanāthāya bhagavate iti vastusthitiḥ | bhogān dātuṃ svayaṃ bhoktumapi bahuvidhā āśā āyatatṛṣṇā yasya sa tathoktaḥ bhavan | pakṣe bahu yathāsyāttathā vidhāśaḥ vigatadhākāraśakāraityarthaḥ | tvatkucajanmani sukalaḥ manorathānuguṇaṃ tyāgabhogabhāgbhavan san 'sukalo dātṛbhoktari' ityamaraḥ | dhākāraśakarāpanayanena sukala iti niṣpanna iti vastusthitiḥ | atra sudhākalaśasyānīṣṭaṃ vinā svepsitāvāptiḥ || yathāvā kucajanma prepsustava tapasthitassoḍhaśītavātoṣṇaḥ | kucatāṃ kulācalo'gāttava kamalelālayan svamātmānam || 1338 || he kamale ! kulācalaḥ tava kucajanma prepsuḥ ataeva tapasthitaḥ tapaścaran | pakṣe tapasi māghamāse śiśiraṛtāviti bhāvaḥ | tape grīṣme ca sthitaḥ niścalatayā vartamānaḥ ātape sthita iti vā | na hi kulācalaḥ kālabhedena calācalo bhavati | ataeva soḍhaśītavātoṣṇaḥ ‘grīṣme pañcatapā bhūtvā varṣāsvāsāraṣāṇmuniḥ' ityādyuktaprakriyayā dvaṃdvasahiṣṇussan | pakṣe nisargata eva śītādessoḍhā | na hyacalaśśītena vātena vā vepate uṣṇena vitapate | tapasaḥ phalamāha kucatāmiti | svaṃ svakīyaṃ ātmānaṃ antarātmānaṃ bhagavantaṃ lālayan vilāsayan ‘laḍa vilāse' ṇijantādasmāt lakṣaṇahetvoḥ' iti śatā | heturiha phalam | svāntarātmaprīṇanāyetyarthaḥ | tatra kucatāṃ agāt stanatayā'vātārītyarthaḥ | pakṣe kulācalaśabdaḥ kamale alālayanniti chedaḥ | svaṃ ātmānaṃ svasvarūpaṃ alālayan lāśca laśca lālau avidyamānau lālau yasya saḥ alālaḥ tathoktaṃ kurvan alālayan lāletivarṇadvayavidhuritaṃ kurvan kucatāṃ kucaśabdatāṃ agāt | uktarītyā lākāralakārarāhitye kuca iyevāvaśeṣāditi bhāvaḥ | atra kulācalasya vinā'niṣṭamabhīpsitārthasaṃsiddhiḥ || yathāvā śrīkucaphalaśeṣatvaprepsāvallūrabhogasaṃtyāgi | mālūraphalaṃ śuddhaṃ māphalaśeṣaṃ na muñcati svārtham || mālūrasya bilvasya phalaṃ 'bilvaśāṇḍilyaśailūṣamālūraśrīphalā api' ityamaraḥ| śriyaḥ kucāveva phale tayośśeṣatvaṃ tadatiśayādhitsayopādeyasvarūpatvaṃ tasya prepsayā vallūrasya śuṣkamāṃsasya ‘uttaptaṃ śuṣkamāṃsaṃ syāttadvallūraṃ triliṅgakam' ityamaraḥ bhogaḥ abhyavahāraḥ bhujerbhāve ghañi ‘cajoḥ' iti kutvam | ‘bhogastu rājye veśyābhṛtau sukhe | dhane'hikāyaphaṇayoḥ pālanābhyavahārayoḥ' iti hemacandraḥ | tasya saṃtyāgi vallūropalakṣitanikhilaniṣiddhāhāratyajanaśāli | āhāraśuddhyabhāve sattvaśuddhyanudayāditi bhāvaḥ | ata eva śuddhaṃ nirdoṣaṃ pavitraṃ vā | ataeva māphalaśeṣaṃ māyāḥ śriyaḥ phale phalatvenādhyavasitau stanau tayoḥ śeṣaṃ śeṣabhūtaṃ atiśayādhāyakaṃ ca sat svābhīpsitaśeṣatāṃ labdhavaditi bhāvaḥ | svarthaṃ svakīyaṃ puruṣārthaṃ na muñcati kadā'pi na tyajati | nityaśeṣameva sat tatkaiṃkaryaṃ samanubhavatīti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe mālūraphalamiti padaṃ, śabdārthayostādātmyam | śrīkucaphalaśeṣatvaprepsāvat lūrabhogasaṃtyāgi iti chedaḥ | uktecchāviśiṣṭaṃ sat | lūrayoḥ lūkārarephayoḥ bhogaḥ anubhavaḥ tasya saṃtyāgi | utsāritalūkārarephamityarthaḥ | ataeva śuddhaṃ kevalaṃ yathātathā ‘śuddhaṃ syāttriṣu kevale | nirdoṣe ca pavitre ca' iti medinī | māphalaśeṣaṃ mā pha lā iti trayo varṇāḥ śeṣāḥ śiṣṭāḥ yasya tathoktaṃ avaśiṣṭamāphalarūpavarṇatrayamityarthaḥ | īdṛśamapītyupaskāryam | svārthaṃ śrīphalarūpaṃ svābhidheyaṃ na muñcati | mālūraphalamiti padamavikalavarṇaṃ yāvantamarthaṃ bodhayati uktarītyā varṇavaikalye'pi tāvantamevārthaṃ bodhayati | mālūraphalamāphalaśabdayorekārthakatvāditi bhāvaḥ | māphalaṃ śrīphalam | bilvasya śrīphalatvaṃ ca 'vanaspatistava vṛkṣo'tha bilvaḥ' iti śrutisiddhaṃ udāhṛtakośasiddhaṃ ca | śeṣamityatra śiṣyata iti śeṣamiti karmaṇi ghañ ataeva bhedyaliṅgatā | bhāve ghaña eva pulliṅgatvaniyamaḥ | ataeva saṃbandhamanuvartate' iti bhāṣyam śeṣaṃ rāmavat' ityādiprayogāḥ ‘śeṣassaṃkarṣaṇe vadhe' ityupakramya 'upayuktetare na strī' iti medinyādikośāśca saṃgacchante | atra mālūraphalasyāniṣṭaṃ vinā abhīṣṭasiddhiḥ || imāni sarvāṇyapi aniṣṭaṃ vinā kevaleṣṭaprāptāvudāharaṇāni || aniṣṭaparihārarūpeṣṭaprāptiryathā tvacchrīvidveṣakṛtāṃ ghanāghavattāṃ ghanāghanodhūnvan | viṣṇo pade tava patannadhaśśirāḥ kalpate sma naghanāghaḥ || 1340 || he viṣṇo! ghanāghanaḥ prāvṛṣeṇyāmbuvāhaḥ tava śriyaḥ saṃpadaḥ ruceśca vidveṣaḥ tena kṛtāṃ tāvakaśrīviṣayakavairahetukāṃ ghanāghavattāṃ aviraladuritaśālitāṃ dhūnvan ‘lakṣaṇahetvoḥ' iti śatā | heturiha phalam | ghanāghavattāvidhūnanena prayojanenetyarthaḥ | tava pade caraṇe viṣṇoḥ pade antarikṣe iti tattvam | adhaśśirāḥ patan praṇipatannityarthaḥ | ghanaṃ ca tat aghaṃ ca ghanāghaṃ, na ghanāghaṃ yasya sa naghanāghaḥ naśabdena bahuvrīhiḥ | kalpate sma | nirastanikhilakaluṣo'bhūdityarthaḥ | praṇamya kṛṣṇaṃ sahasā pāṃsukliṣṭe mahītale | niṣkalmaṣo bhavetsadyo lalāṭe pāṃsumaṇḍanāt || harimamaragaṇārcitāṅghipadmaṃ praṇamati yaḥ paramārthato manuṣyaḥ | tamapagatasamastapāpabandhaṃ vraja parihṛtya yathāgnimājyasiktam || ityādi pramāṇasahasraṃ smartavyam | pakṣe ghanāghanaśandaḥ ghanāghavattāṃ ghanāgheti varṇapaṅktirmattāṃ adhūnvan iti chedaḥ avisṛjannevetyarthaḥ| adhaśśirāḥ patan vilomatayā sthita iti yāvat | naghanāgha iti niṣpanna iti | atra ghanāghanasyāniṣṭaṃ vinā svābhīpsitaghanāgharūpāniṣṭanivṛttirūpeṣṭasiddhiḥ || yathāvā svajuṣāṃ sadā sumanasāṃ hartumadhaḥ prasavabandhanātpatanam| tvadbhujatāmetya hare kalpatarurharati tadyaducitaṃ tat || 1341 || he hare! kalpataruḥ sadā svajuṣāṃ ātmānaṃ sevamānānāṃ sumanasāṃ viduṣāṃ kusumānāṃ ca | prasavabandhanāt nānāyoniprasūtisaṃbandhāt vṛntācca ‘vṛntaṃ prasavabandhanam' ityamaraḥ | adhaḥpatanaṃ adholoke bhraṃśaṃ adhaḥpradeśe galanaṃ ca | hartuṃ nirasituṃ tvadbhujatāṃ tvadbahurūpatāṃ etya tat sumanasāṃ prasavabandhānadadhaḥpatanaṃ haratīti yat taducitam | atra sumanasāṃ prasavabandhanādadhaḥpatanarūpāniṣṭaparihāralakṣaṇeṣṭārthodyogātkalpataroraniṣṭaṃ vinā tatsiddhiḥ | sarvāṇyapyetānyudāharaṇāni śleṣābhedādhyavasāyasaṃkīrṇānyeva || kiṃca yatrātarkitotkaṭāniṣṭasadbhāve'pi śleṣavaibhaveneṣṭārthatvapratipattistatrāpi samālaṃkāro na pratihanyate | yathā śrīvaśagavyāmohe bhagavanmā muktamātanu tvamiti | tvāmāseve tvamapi ca tathaiva māmuktamācaraṃstanuṣe || 1342 || he bhagavan ! śrīvaśagaḥ lakṣmīvaśaṃvadaḥ vyāmaḥ yasya 'vyāmo bāhvossakarayostatayostiryagantaram' ityamaraḥ | yathāsaṃbhavamāśleṣārthaṃ svesve pārśve prasāritayorbāhvorantaraṃ lakṣmīvaśaṃvadaṃ yasya sa tathokta ityarthaḥ | tvaṃ anena puruṣākārasānnidhyabalādavadhīritavinatajanatāparādhatayā rakṣaṇaunmukhyaṃ dyotitam | mā māṃ ananvādeśe vaikalpikatvādatra mādeśaḥ | muktaṃ śithilitabhavabandhaṃ ātanu kuru | yadvā śrīvaśagaḥ saṃpanmūlakaḥ yo vyāmohaḥ atimātravaicittyaṃ tasmin | athavā śrīvaśageti bhagavata eva saṃbodhanam | vyāmohe putrakalatrasaṃpadādiprayuktasaṃmohe āmuktaṃ baddhaṃ ‘āmuktaḥ pratimuktaśca' ityamaraḥ | mā tanu mā kuru | māśabdo'yaṃ na tu māṅ, yena luṅeva syāt | iti tvāṃ āseve tvamapi māmuktaṃ ācaran san tathaiva tanuṣe yathāprārthanameva kuruṣe iti stutiḥ | śrīvaśagavyāmohe mā māṃ āmuktaṃ baddhameva tanuṣe ityupālambhaḥ | idaṃ muktaiśvaryaprepsayā śrīnivāsaṃ sevamānasya ānuṣaṅgikīṃ tadviśrāṇitāmaihikīmāmuṣmikīṃ ca saṃpadamapi tatparipanthinīṃ jānataḥ kasyacitprapannasya te pratyupālambhavacanam | atra yadyapi vyājastutau stutyā nindābhivyaktivivakṣāyāṃ viṣamālaṅkāraḥ | na caihikāmuṣmikavibhavasyāniṣṭatvāyogānna viṣamālaṃkāra iti vācyaṃ, mumukṣudṛṣṭyā tasyāniṣṭatāyāḥ ‘ete vai nirayāstāta sthānasya paramātmanaḥ' ityukteḥ anena vacanenāmuṣmikasaṃpada eva nirayaprāyatvasya varṇanādaihikasaṃpadastathātvaṃ kaimutyanyāyasiddham | tathā'pi prāthamikastutirūpavācyavivakṣāyāṃ samālaṃkāro na nivāryate || yathāvā sutarāmuktividūrā saṃpatsyāditi samāśrito'haṃ tvām | sutarāmuktividūrā tathaiva saṃpattvayā'cyuta vitīrṇā || 1343 || sutarāṃ uktividūrā ‘yato vāco nivartante' ityuktarītyā vācāmaviṣayabhūtā | saṃpat muktaiśvaryaṃ syāditi bhavediti pratyāśayetyarthaḥ | tvāṃ ahaṃ samāśritaḥ tathaiva sutarāmuktividūrā saṃpadeva tvayā'pi vitīrṇeti stutiḥ | sutarā śobhanataratvenābhāsamānā muktividūrā mokṣadavīyasī saṃpadityupālambhaḥ | ‘arthaśreyasi cāsakto na śreyo vindate param' iti mahābhāratokteraihikasaṃpado muktividūratvam | atrāpi pūrvodāharaṇavadeva sarvaṃ draṣṭavyam || yathāvā ahamannāda iti sadā gātuṃ tvāṃ śaraṇamagamamabjākṣa | bhavatā'pi tathā'kāriṣi sāṃpratamannāda eva kila kṛpayā || 1344 || idaṃ niśreyasāvāptitvarayā prārabdhakarmaphalabhogānubhavādapi jugupsamānasya kasyacitprapannasya prapattyuttaramapi sāṃsārikabhogāneva yathāpuramanubhāvayantaṃ bhagavantaṃ prati vyājastutyā upālambhavacanam | tathāhi he abjākṣa ! ahamannāda iti sadā gātuṃ ‘etatsāmagāyannāste' ityupakramya ‘ahamannādo'hamannādaḥ' iti śrutyuktakrameṇa sāmagānaṃ vidhātuṃ paripūrṇaparabrahmānubhavānandarūpaṃ muktyaiśvaryaṃ labdhumiti bhāvaḥ | ‘ahamannādaḥ' iti śrutigatayośśabdayoḥ ahaṃ asmaccharīrakaḥ paramātmaiva annādaḥ sakalabhoktṛśarīraka ityarthaḥ | ‘ahaṃśabdaḥ paramātmaparyantaḥ bhogyabhoktṛvācyānnānnādiśabdau ca tatparyantau' iti tadbhāṣyam | tvāṃ śaraṇamagamaṃ prapanno'smi | bhavatā'pi kṛpayā sāṃprataṃ idānīṃ tathā akāriṣi yathābhyarthanaṃ annāda eva kṛto'smi | kṛñaḥ karmaṇi bhūte luṅuttamaikavacanam | akāriṣi sāṃpratamiti vā yojanā | tadā sāṃprataṃ yuktamityarthaḥ | ‘sāṃprataṃ cādhunārthe syādyuktārthe'pica sāṃpratam' iti viśvaḥ | kileti saṃbhāvanāyāmanunaye vā | 'kilaśabdastu vārtāyāṃ saṃbhāvyānunayārthayoḥ' iti viśvaḥ | upapādito'rthassarvo'pi stutiparaḥ | annādaḥ kevalaṃ prakṛtaudanabhoktaiva akāriṣi na tu ‘vijighatsaḥ' iti śrutyuktajighatsādiheyaguṇavidhura ityupālambhaḥ | atra mumukṣoḥ prapannasva prākṛtabhogarūpotkaṭāniṣṭasadbhāve'pi śleṣamahimnā muktaiśvaryānubhavarūpeṣṭapratipattiḥ || yathāvā rajanicarā raghunandana niśāraṇaṃ tava jayāya ye'kāṅkṣan | tvamapi tathaiva niśāraṇamadadāsteṣāmudāradākṣiṇyaḥ || 1345 || tava jayāya tvatkarmakābhibhavāya niśāraṇaṃ rātryadhikaraṇakaṃ yuddham | tathaiva yathepsitameva niśāraṇaṃ rātriyuddham | vastutastu tava jayāya tvatkartṛkāvijayāya teṣāṃ rajanicarāṇāṃ niśāraṇaṃ niṣūdanaṃ adadā ityarthaḥ | ‘pramāpaṇaṃ nivarhaṇaṃ nikāraṇaṃ niśāraṇam' ityamaraḥ | atra rajanicarāṇāṃ nibarhaṇarūpāniṣṭasyotkaṭasya sattve'pi śleṣaprabhāveṇa niśāyuddharūpepsitalābhaḥ || yathāvā amitāṃ kamanīyasthitimāptuṃ ye tvatparābhavādaicchan | kamanīyasthitireva hyamitā taistvatparābhavāllabhe || 1346 || he bhagavan ! tvatparābhavāt tvatkarmakaparibhavāt | amitāṃ aparicchinnāṃ kamanīyasthitiṃ vaibhavavattayā ramaṇīyamavasthānam | uttarārdhe'pyevameva | tatra paramārthatastu tvaditi bhinnaṃ padam | tvat tvattaḥ parābhavāt svakarmakaparibhavāt | amitā avidyamānamakārā kṛtā kamanīyasthitiḥ kanīyasthitiḥ śabdārthayostādātmyāt | atimātranikṛṣṭā sthitirevetyarthaḥ | kanīyasī cāsau sthitiśceti vigrahaḥ | alpaśabdādīyasuni ‘yuvālpayoḥ kananyatarasyām' iti kanādeśaḥ | atra kanīyassthitirūpotkaṭāniṣṭasadbhāve'pi śleṣavaibhavena kamanīyasthitirūpeṣṭalābhaḥ || yathāvā prāptā surapatipadamapi pātālamanantabhogilokamapi | vindeyamiti yajan balirakāri bhavatā trivikrama tathaiva || 1347 || he trivikrama ! idaṃ etatpadyaprastutārthasya tadavatārāsādhāraṇatāṃ vyañjayitum | surapatipadaṃ mahendrasthānaṃ prāptā | prapūrvakādāpnotestṛn | apiścārthakaḥ | alaṃ pātā'pi rakṣitā ca | pātestṛn | baliḥ daityendraḥ | anantaḥ yaḥ bhogināṃ uttamatattatkarmaphalabhoktṝṇāṃ lokaḥ brahmalokaparyantaṃ viṣṭapam | yadvā ananteti bhagavataeva saṃbodhanam | bhogilokamapi ukta evārthaḥ | athavā anantabhogaḥ bhagavadanubhavaḥ so'sminnastītyanantabhogī sa cāsau lokaśca | anantabhogināṃ bhagavadanubhavaśālināṃ loka iti vā | tamapi śrīvaikuṇṭhamapītyarthaḥ | vindeyaṃ prāpnuyāmiti yajan yajñaṃ kurvan san bhavatā yajñārādhyena tatphalapradena ceti bhāvaḥ | yathāmanorathameva phalaṃ lambhita ityarthaḥ | vastutastu surapatipadaṃ prāptā'pi baliḥ anantaḥ bhogilokaḥ bhujagasamudayaḥ yasmin saḥ taṃ tathoktaṃ pātālaṃ prāpita iti | ananteti bhagavatassaṃbodhanavivakṣāyāṃ pātālaṃ tatsaṃjñakaṃ bhogilokaṃ nāgalokaṃ prāpita iti vā arthaḥ | atrotkaṭāniṣṭasya pātālaprāpaṇasya sadbhāve'pi anantapuṇyakṛllokādiprāptirūpeṣṭasiddhiḥ pratyāyitā | atrotkaṭāniṣṭasyātarkitatvaṃ sphuṭataramiti dhyeyam || yatreṣṭārthaprāptisadbhāve'pi śleṣavaśādasato'niṣṭārthasya pratītistatrāpi samālaṃkārasya na kṣatiḥ, aniṣṭapratīterābhāsarūpatvenāparyavasānāt || yathā guruṇātyādaraguruṇā kāryā devenabhaktirityuditaḥ | kurvaṃstathaiva bhaktiṃḥ gurvājñāṃ sarvathā'pi nātyaiṣīt || atra gurvājñāṃ sarvathā'pi nātyaiṣīdityanena virodhālaṃkārābhivyañjanāya devenabhaktirityatra padatrayavibhāgātmakarūpāntarasyāpi vivakṣāyāssattve'pi devānāṃ ine svāmini bhagavati bhaktiḥ devenabhaktirityekapadena vastusadarthāntaraparaṃ rūpāntaramupādāya samālaṃkāro'pyastyeva || yathāvā vratametarhi jayantyāḥ kāryaṃ nāśanamitīritaḥ pitrā | bālastathaiva vidadhe vitathāṃ vidadhīta ko nu piturājñām || 1349 || atrāpi vitathāṃ vidadhīta ko nu piturājñāmityanena virodhālaṃkṛtimabhivyañjayituṃ nāśanamityatra ekapadarūpāntarasyāpi vivakṣāyāssadbhāve'pi na aśanamiti padadvayavibhāgena aśanaṃ abhya vaharaṇaṃ na kāryaṃ kiṃtūpavasanameveti vastusadarthāntaramabhidadhānaṃ rūpāntaramālambya samālaṃkāro'pyakṣata eva | pūrvasminnudāharaṇe padatrayavibhāgenāsato'niṣṭārthasya pratītiḥ, aikapadyena vastusata iṣṭārthasya | iha tu aikapadyenāsadaniṣṭārthapratītiḥ padadvayavibhāgena vastusadiṣṭārthasyeti bhedaḥ || śleṣalabdhāsadiṣṭāvāptipratītimātreṇāpi samālaṃkāratvaṃ ‘aniśamapi taṃ niṣevitum' iti prāgupadarśiteṣūdāharaṇeṣu draṣṭavyam | mātrapadenāniṣṭārthapratītirvyavacchidyate | tatra hi asitotpalādīnāṃ śleṣabalādaniśavidhuniṣevaṇādīṣṭāvāptimātram, na tvaniṣṭapratibhāso'pīti dhyeyam || yattu virūpakāryānarthayorutpattirvirūpasaṃghaṭanā ca viṣamamiti viṣamālaṃkāraṃ lakṣayitvā tadviparyayassamamiti samālaṃkāraṃ lakṣayatā tatpadenātra viṣamālaṃkārasabandhī virūpaghaṭanārūpaścarama eva bhedo gṛhyate tadviparyayasyaiva carutvāt | na tvādyabhedadvayaṃ, tadviparyayasya kāraṇādanurūpakāryotpattirūpasya vāñchitārthaprāptirūpasya ca vastusiddhatayā cārutāvirahāt | evaṃ cānurūpasaṃghaṭanātmaka eva samālaṃkāraḥ | na tu viṣamālaṃkāra iva bhedatritayātmaka ityalaṃkārasarvasvakṛtoktam | tanna, vastuto'nanurūpayorapi kāryakāraṇayoḥ śleṣādinā dharmaikyasaṃpādanadvārā anurūpatvavarṇane vastuto'niṣṭasyāpi tenaivopāyena iṣṭaikyasaṃpattāviṣṭaprāptivarṇanaṃ ca cārutayā atraiva darśitatvāt | tasmātsamamapi viṣamamiva trividhameveti || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre samālaṃkārasara ekacatvāriṃśaḥ <17> atha vicitrālaṃkārasaraḥ iṣṭaiṣiṇeṣṭasiddhyai tadviparītaṃ kriyeta cet | prayatnastāmimāṃ prāhurvicitrālaṃkṛtiṃ budhāḥ || kasyacitphalasyecchayā tadviparītaḥ prayatnaḥ kriyeta cet vicitrālaṃkāraḥ | iṣṭaviparītācaraṇamiti yāvat | viparītatvaṃ ca pratikūlatvam || yathāvā bhavajaladhitalanimagnānuddhartuṃ tān sugaṃ supanthānam | prāpayitumapi hare bata phaṇidharaśikharāgradurgamāvasasi || 1350 || sukhena gacchantyatreti sugaḥ taṃ ‘suduroradhikaraṇe' iti gamerḍaḥ | śobhanaḥ panthāḥ supanthāḥ taṃ supanthānaṃ ‘na pūjanāt' iti samāsāntaniṣedhaḥ | duḥkhena gacchantyatreti durgam | atrātimātranimnabhavajalanidhitalanimagnajanoddharaṇaṃ teṣāṃ sumārgaprāpaṇaṃ ca phalamuddiśya tadviparītamahonnataphaṇipracuragiriśikharāgradurgasthānāvasthānarūpaviparītaprayatnavarṇanam | śeṣācalaśikharāgrāvasthitimācarasīti tattvam || yathāvā niravadhimavadhīrayituṃ durabhibhavaṃ heyabhogasaṃsargam | santaḥ kṛṣṇa bhajante hanta tvāheyabhogakṛtanṛttam || 1351 || he kṛṣṇa ! santaḥ heyabhogasaṃsargaṃ avadhīrayituṃ heyabhogeṣveva kṛtanṛttaṃ tatraivābhiṣaktamiti yāvat | tvā tvāṃ bhajante | hantetyāścarye | vastutastu āheyeti chedaḥ āheyaḥ ahibhavaḥ yo bhogaḥ phaṇaḥ tatra kṛtanṛttaṃ kāliyaphaṇiphaṇakṛtanaṭanamityarthaḥ | āheyetyatra ahiśabdāt bhavārthe ‘dṛtikukṣikalaśivastyastyaherḍhañ' iti ḍhaña | atra heyabhogasaṃsargāvadhīraṇamuddiśya tadviparītaheyabhogakṛtanaṭanabhajanalakṣaṇaprayatno nibaddhaḥ | prāyeṇa śleṣamūlabhedādhyavasāyo'tra jīvātuḥ || yathāvā vṛjinadharādharaśikharādavaroḍhuṃ śrīnivāsa nanu manujāḥ | jihmagadharaṇidharāñcalamārohantīti nādbhutaṃ kasya || 1352 || vṛjinaṃ kuṭilaṃ yat dharādharaśikharaṃ tasmāt avaroḍhuṃ | pakṣe vṛjinaṃ duritameva dharādharaśikharaṃ tasmādityarthaḥ | `vṛjinaṃ kalamaṣe klībaṃ keśe na kuṭile triṣu' iti medinī | jihmagasya kuṭilagamanasya dharādharasya gireḥ añcalaṃ agraṃ śeṣācalaśṛṅgamiti vastusthitiḥ | ‘arālaṃ vṛjinaṃ jihmam' ityamaraḥ | atra vṛjinadharādharaśikharāvarohaṇalakṣaṇaphaloddeśena tadviparītaḥ jihmagadharaṇīdharāgrārohaṇarūpaprayatnaḥ || yathāvā atipatituṃ durgāṇi pratipadamahiśikhariśikharadurgagatam | śaraṇaṃ vrajanti daivaṃ karaṇaṃ viniyamya sakalamapi munayaḥ || 1353 || durgāṇi śailādidurgamasthānāni | kṛcchrāṇi narakāṃśca ‘durgā tu gauryāṃ kālyāṃ ca durgaṃ tu narake pure | śailādidurgamasthāne triṣu tveṣa durāsade' iti ratnamālā | ‘durgaṃ tu narake kṛcchre' iti kośāntaram | ‘sarvastaratu durgāṇi, durgāṇyatitarasyāśu' ityādayaḥ prayogāśca | atra durgātipatanarūpaphalamuddiśya tadvipratīpadurgagatapuruṣaśaraṇāgatilakṣaṇaprayatnavarṇanam || yathāvā pāpaśamanāvalokanalopakṛte tvatkṛpāvyapāśrayavān | śrīparibṛḍha sādhujanaḥ pāpaśamanameva kalayati vicitram || 1354 || he śrīparibṛḍha ! tvatkṛpāvyapāśrayavān sādhujanaḥ, pāpaḥ krūra iti yāvat yaḥ śamanaḥ yamaḥ 'śamanaṃ śāntivadhayoḥ klībe vaivasvate pumān' iti ratnamālā | tasya avalokanaṃ tasya lopakṛte kadācidapi yamadarśanaṃ mā bhūnmametyetadarthamiti bhāvaḥ | pāpaśamanameva krūraṃ yamameva kalayati sevate idaṃ vicitram | duritaśāntimātanute iti tu tattvam | atrāpi sarvaṃ pūrvavadeva | vicitramiti padena prakṛtālaṃkāranāmno'pi sūcanamiti vakṣyamāṇamudrālaṃkāraśiraskatvaṃ viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā aśiśirakarakulanāyaka niśicararājyaśriyaṃ svayaṃ hartum | tāmeva yāminīcarakanīyase nītimānaho tvamadāḥ || 1355 || he aśiśirakarakulanāyaka ! niśicararājyasya śriyaṃ saṃpadam | pakṣe niśicarāṇāṃ rājeḥ paṅkteḥ aśriyaṃ daśānanabhujābhiguptatvaprayuktāślīlatāṃ ‘hartuṃ tāmeva niśicararājyaśriyameva yāminīcarakanīyase vibhīṣaṇāya | śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭam | atra niśicararājyaśrīharaṇalakṣaṇaphalamuddiśya tadviparītastaddānarūpaprayatnaḥ || yathāvā tvadanaghapunarbhavaruciṃ punarbhavaruciṃ vihātumativelam | manasi sadātanavaibhava kanakagirīndo sadā tanavai || 1356 || sadātanaṃ vaibhavaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ nityavaibhavetyarthaḥ | he kanakagirīndo ! punarbhavaruciḥ bhūyo'pi janmaspṛhāṃ vihātuṃ tvaditi chedaḥ| he anagheti bhagavata eva saṃbuddhyantaṃ viśeṣaṇam | tvat tvattaḥ punarbhavaruciṃ ukta evārthaḥ | sadā manasi tanavai karavai, iti virodhaḥ | tvadanaghapunarbhavarucimiti samastaṃ padam | tava anaghāḥ ye punarbhavāḥ nakhāḥ ‘punarbhavaḥ kararuhaḥ' ityamaraḥ | teṣāṃ ruciṃ prabhāṃ manasi tanavai dhyāyaniti parihāraḥ | atra punarbhavaruciprahāṇaphalamuddiśya punarbhavarucimanaskārarūpaviparītaprayatnaḥ | yamakasaṃkīrṇatvaṃ pūrvebhyo viśeṣaḥ | śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyastu sarvatra tulyaḥ || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre vicitrasaro dvicatvāriṃśaḥ athādhikālaṃkārasaraḥ ādheyādhikyakathanamādhārānmahato'dhikam || yatra mahata ādhārādādheyasyādhikyavarṇanaṃ tatra adhikaṃ nāmālaṃkāraḥ || <18> athādhikālaṃkārasaraḥ ādheyādhikyakathanamādhārānmahato'dhikam || yatra mahata ādhārādādheyasyādhikyavarṇanaṃ tatra adhikaṃ nāmālaṃkāraḥ || yathā adhikurusamiti samasto loko yatra vyaloki lokena | kṛṣṇāvipadapaharaṇapravaṇā karūṇā'tra vapuṣi tava na mamau || 1357 || kurūṇāṃ samitiḥ sabhā saṃgaro vā tasyāṃ adhikurusamiti, vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ | kurūṇāṃ sabhāyāṃ saṃgare ca bhagavatā viśvarūpasya prakāśanāttadubhayasaṃgrahāya samitiśabdopādānam | 'samitissāṃparāye syātsabhāyāṃ saṃgare'pica' iti medinī | atra yatra bhagavaddivyavigrahe samasto loko vyalokītyādhārasyātimahattvamupadarśya atra tava divyavigrahe karuṇā na mamāvityādheyasyādhikyaṃ varṇitam || yathāvā viśvātmanyapi ca tvayi viśvaṃbhara naiva māntisuguṇagaṇāḥ| bhavati kila mahadamīṣāṃ bhavatsvarūpādapīdamānantyam || 1358 || viśvātmani akhilaprapañcaśarīrake | atrāpi viśvātmanītyādhārasyātimahimānaṃ pradarśya tatra kalyāṇaguṇā na māntītyādheyādhikyaṃ darśitam || yathāvā raghuvīra tāvakayaśorākācandramasi sāndrataramahasi | abhito vijṛmbhamāṇe labhate dyaurlāñchanasya saṃrambham || 1359 || yathāvā prasṛmarabhavadīyayaśaḥprakāśakalaśāmburāśijaṭharāntaḥ | gaganābhogo harisakhi garuḍadhvajamūrtivibhramaṃ dhatte || 1360 || yathāvā bhavadīyakaṃṭākṣaśrībhājāṃ bhagavati yaśastripathagāyām | suravartmanā'khilāmba sphuṭataranīlāmbujāyitaṃ kvāpi || 1361 || yathāvā brahmāṇḍasyāntarbahirapi bhāti bhavajjuṣāṃ yaśaḥprasaraḥ | sphāṭikasamudgakāntassphuṭaśikhadīpaprakāśa iva bhagavan || 1362 || eṣūdāharaṇeṣu caturṣu ādye dve udāharaṇe rūpakopaskṛtanidarśanāsaṅkīrṇe | antime dve upamāsaṃvalite | savetra ādhārāpekṣayā ādheyādhikyavarṇanaṃ tulyameva | tatrāpi triṣūdāharaṇeṣu adhārādheyayorgaganayaśasoreva prakārāntareṇopamāpradarśanena varṇanaṃ, antime tu ādheyaṃ yaśa eva, ādhāro brahmāṇḍamityapi vailakṣaṇyaṃ draṣṭavyam || yathāvā bhagavannagaṇitavaibhava bhavadīyayaśaśchale sudhājaladhau | brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalanibhādvibhānti muktāphalāni pṛthulāni || 1363 || agaṇitavaibhaveti bhagavato viśeṣaṇam | bhavadīyaṃ yaśa iti karmadhārayaḥ | bhavadīyānāṃ bhāgavatānāṃ yaśa iti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo vā | athavā agaṇitavaibhaveti bhavadīyānāṃ bhavadīyayaśaso vā viśeṣaṇam | brahmāṇḍānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ bṛndaṃ tannibhāt tadvyājāt | sphuṭamanyat || atrādhārebhyo brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalebhyo'pyādheyasya bhāgavatayaśasa ādhikyam | atrāpyādheyaṃ yaśa eva | ādhāro'pi brahmaṇḍamaṇḍalameva | kaitavāpahnutigarbhitatvaṃ viśeṣaḥ || dvitīyādhikam ādhārādhikyakathanamādheyādvipulācca tat || vipulādādheyādapyādhārasyādhikyavarṇanaṃ ca tat adhikamevetyarthaḥ || yathā kiyadetanmama cetaḥ sphītaṃ vātaṃdhayācalaniketam | śrīvāsaṃ savikāsaṃ jagadāvāsaṃ nivāsayatyantaḥ || 1364 || sphītaṃ vipulamiti yāvat | savikāsaṃ asaṃbādhaṃ yathātathā | atrākhilajagadāvāsabhūtaśrīnivāsarūpādheyādanyādhārabhūtasya cetasa ādhikyaṃ nibaddham || yadvā manye mādhava saṃprati mano mamālaṃ mahādbhutaviśālam | sarvebhyo jyāyānapi lokebhyo yatra māti paramātmā || 1365 || mama manaḥ mahādbhutaviśālamiti manye | tatra hetumabhiprayannāhasarvebhya iti | yatra yasminmanasi aṇurūpe iti bhāvaḥ | sarvebhyo lokebhyo jyāyānapi 'eṣa ma ātmā'ntarhṛdaye jyāyān pṛthivyāḥ' ityārabhya ‘jyāyānebhyo lokebhyaḥ' iti śāṇḍilyavidyoktaprakāreṇa sakalalokādhikavaipulyamānapīti bhāvaḥ | paramātmā māti | idaṃ pūrvodāharaṇādavilakṣaṇārtham | udāhṛtaśrutipratyabhijñāpanaṃ viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā aṇurātmeti kathaṃ vā bhaṇati śrutiratra saṃśayo'smākam | agaṇitamahimāsya yato nigadati saivāntaraṃ paraṃ brahma || 1366 || ātmā pratyagātmā aṇuḥ iti śrutiḥ 'eṣo'ṇurātmā' ityādiśrutiḥ kathaṃ vā bhaṇati, yataḥ agaṇitaḥ gaṇanāyā agocaraḥ mahimā mahattvaṃ yasya tat paraṃ brahma svarūpato guṇaiśca niratiśayabṛhaditi bhāvaḥ | asya pratyagātmanaḥ antaraṃ antaḥsthitam | saiva śrutireva ‘ya atmānamantaraḥ' ityādiriti bhāvaḥ nigadati | yadyapyatrodāharaṇeṣu cetaḥpratyagātmanorevādhārabhūtayoḥ praśaṃsā kriyate, tathā'pi tanutvena siddhayoścetaḥpratyagātmanoḥ sakalajagannivāsabhūtātsarvalokajyāyaso mahāmahimnaḥ parabrahmaṇo'pyadhikatvenādhikaraṇatāṃ kalpayitvaiva praśaṃsā kriyata iti tatpraśaṃsāprastutaparabrahmapraśaṃsāyāmeva paryavasyatīti dhyeyam || ityalaṅkāramaṇihāre adhikālaṅkārasarastrayaścatvāriṃśaḥ <19> athālpālaṅkārasaraḥ ādhārasaukṣmyamādheyātsūkṣmādalpaṃ taducyate || svāpekṣayā sūkṣmādādheyādādhārasya sūkṣmatvaṃ yat tadalpaṃ nāmālaṅkāraḥ | sūkṣmāt stokāt saukṣmyaṃ kārśyaṃ || yathā adhilaṅkaṃ nivasantyā mithileśabhuvo'tivirahatanvaṅgyāḥ | mauktikavalayitanāsāmaṇḍanamadhikaṇṭhamāpa hāratvam || 1367 || mauktikavalayitanāsāmaṇḍanaṃ mauktikaśroṇigrathitavalayākārasauvarṇanāsābharaṇaviśeṣaḥ | atra uktavidhaṃ nāsābharaṇaṃ sūkṣmam | tadapi vallabhaviśleṣajanitavaicittyena grīvāyāmarpitaṃ virahakṛśayā bhagavatyā janakanandinyā tatra hāratāṃ prāpetyuktyā tato'pi grīvāyāssaukṣmyaṃ darśitamityādheyādādhārasya saukṣmyamanusandheyam || yathāvā tvaddarśanasaṃbhramatastvaddayitākarṇaveṣṭanaṃ madhye | pratimuñcati sma tatra vyatiṣaktaṃ nātha tadbhavati kāñcī || 1368 || atrāpi karṇaveṣṭanaṃ tāvadatisūkṣmaṃ, tadapi tvaddarśanasaṃbhramavaśāttvaddayitayā śriyā'valagne nibaddhaṃ sattatra kāñcītulyamabhūdityuktyā avalagnasyātitanutvaṃ darśitam | atra vibhramākhyaśśṛṅgāraceṣṭāviśeṣaḥ | 'vibhramastvarayā kāle bhūṣāsthānaviparyayaḥ' itilakṣaṇāt | ayamalaṃkāro dīkṣitopajñaṃ, prācīnairalakṣitatvāt || sūkṣmādādhāratassaukṣmyamādheyasya ca tadbhavet || ādhārasaukṣmyādādheyasaukṣmyamapyalpālaṃkāra eva bhavet idaṃ ca prathamasyādhikasya pratidvandvi, pūrvaṃ tu dvitīyasyeti dhyeyam || yadyapyayaṃ prabhedaḥ kuvalayānandakārairalakṣitaḥ, tathā'pyadhikapratidvandvitayā'vaśyameṣṭavya ityasmābhirlakṣitaḥ, dvaṃdvibhūtasyādhikasyāpi dviprakāratvāt || yathā tanutaramudaraṃ devakatanujāyāḥ paramamāvasadbrahma | sūkṣmācca sūkṣmataramiti sākṣācchrutimatanutānvarthām || 1369 || 'sūkṣmācca tatsukṣmataraṃ vibhāti' iti muṇḍakaśrutimityarthaḥ | anvarthāṃ anuguṇābhidheyām | atrādhārabhūtasya devakījaṭharasyāṇīyastayā ādheyasya tadbharbhasthasya parabrahmaṇassaukṣmyaṃ nibaddham || yathāvā aṇumātre mama hṛdaye praṇatasya vilīna eṣa paramātmā | sthāne'yamaṇīyāniti jāne jyāyastvamarthavādo'sya || 1370 || ayaṃ paramātmā aṇīyāniti sthāne jāne ‘eṣa ma ātmā'ntarhṛdaye'ṇīyānvrīhervā yavādvā sarvapādvā śyāmākādvā śyāmākataṇḍulādvā, iti śruteraṇutara iti yuktaṃ manye | tarhi ‘jyāyān pṛthivyā jyāyānantarikṣājjyāyāndivaḥ' iti śruteḥ kā gatiriti cet atrāha jyāyastvamarthavādo'syeti | asya paramātmano jyāyastvamarthavādaḥ praśaṃsāmātraṃ na tu vāstavamiti bhāvaḥ | atra sūkṣmāt hṛdayarūpādādhārādādheyasya paramātmanassūkṣmataratvam | idaṃ paramātmanassarvajyāyastvayoge'pi tadayogakathanarūpātiśayoktisaṃkīrṇamiti viśeṣaḥ || ityalaṅkāramaṇihāre alpālaṅkārasaraścatuścatvāriṃśaḥ <20> athānyonyālaṃkārasaraḥ viśeṣādhānamanyonyamanyonyālaṃkṛtiṃ viduḥ || dvayoranyonyenānyonyasya viśeṣādhānamanyonyaṃ nāmālaṅkāraḥ || viśeṣaśca guṇakriyādirūpaḥ || yathā karapadmarāgabhūmnā'tyaruṇatarā kaṭakapadmarāgaśrīḥ | tatpadmarāgadhāmnā'tyaruṇaṃ karapadmamakhilajananitava || karapadmayoḥ rāgabhūmnā āruṇyātiśayena | tatpadmarāgāṇāṃ karakaṅkaṇakuruvindānāṃ dhāmnā mahasā | atra karapadmāruṇyātiśayakaṅkaṇakuruvindāruṇyayorguṇayoranyonyaviśeṣādhānam || yathāvā uraso'ntarikṣamahaso maṇeśca phaṇiśayana tulitadivasamaṇeḥ | anyonyaśrījananātsāmānyaṃ bhūṣyabhūṣaṇatvamabhūt || 1372 || bhūṣyabhūṣaṇatvaṃ alaṃkāryālaṃkāratvaṃ sāmānyaṃ ubhayasādhāraṇaṃ abhūt | atra bhagavadurasaḥ kaustubhasya ca śrījananarūpakriyayoranyonyaṃ viśeṣādhānam | upamopaskṛtatvaṃ viśeṣaḥ || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre anyonyasaraḥ pañcacatvāriṃśaḥ <21> atha viśeṣālaṃkārasaraḥ viśeṣassyādvinā''dhārādādheyaṃ varṇyate yadi | prakhyātādhāramantareṇādheyasya viśiṣṭāvasthitivarṇanaṃ viśeṣālaṃkāraḥ | ayaṃ ca dvividhaḥ ādhārāntaragatatvenādheyasya varṇanaṃ nirādhāratvena ca || tatrādyā yathā kṣīṇe'stage'pi candre sāndrā śaure tanoti tajjyotsnā | tava vadane dīvyantīvarahitamindīvarāmodam || 1373 || varaṃ hitaṃ ca indīvarāṇāṃ āmodaṃ saurabham, pakṣe dīvyantīvarahitamityatra dīvyantī ivarahitamiti cchedaḥ | ivarahitaṃ indīvarāmodaṃ indirāmodamityarthaḥ | indīvarāmodamityatra dakārottaravartina īkārasya hrasve varṇādvitayātmakatvena uttarasya ikārasya lope'pi pūrvasya ikārasya sadbhāvena tathā niṣpatteḥ || yadvā īvarahitamityeva cchedaḥ, tathāca īvarahitaṃ indīvarāmodaṃ indrāmodamityarthaḥ | indīvarāmodaśabde dakārottaravartinā īkāreṇa saha vakārasya lope avaśiṣṭadakārarephasaṃyogena tathā niṣpatteriti bhāvaḥ | bhagavaddivyavadanajyotsnāyāstrailokyaiśvaryavitaraṇenendrāmodavidhānaṃ purāṇādiṣu prasiddham | bhagavadvadanaśriyaḥ tadīyasmitaśriyo vā jyotsnātvenādhyavasānam | atra candrarūpaprasiddhādhārasyābhāve'pi tajjyotsnārūpādheyasya bhagavadvadanalakṣaṇādhārāntaragatatvena viśiṣṭāvasthitiḥ || yathāvā līne'pi jaladhimadhye bhānau nikhilaṃ tadīyarucijālam | kamalollāsaṃ kalayati kamalākṣorassthamaṇigataṃ satatam || 1374 || kamalollāsaṃ kamalānāṃ vikāsaṃ kamalāyā harṣaṃ ca | atrāpi bhānurucijālasya prasiddhādhārābhāve'pi varṇanīye kaustubhe viśiṣṭāvasthānamuktam || yadyapyatrodāharaṇadvaye'pi jyotsnāravirucijālajātīye eva varṇanīyayorjyotsnārucijāle varṇyete na tu te eva | tathā'pi bhede'pyabheda ityatiśayoktibalādekatvādhyavasāyādadoṣaḥ | indīvarāmodakamalollāsayostu śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyamūlakātiśayoktibalādekatvādhyavasāyaḥ | na caivamatiśayoktireva syāditi vācyam | tasyāssarvālaṅkāraprāṇapradatayā alaṅkārāntarabādhanāyogāt, anyathā śliṣṭaparaṃparitādyanekālaṅkāralopaprasaṅgāt | yathoktaṃ bhāmahena saiṣā sarvatra vakroktiranayā'rtho vibhāvyate | yatno'syāṃ kavibhiḥ kāryaḥ ko'laṅkārastayā vinā || iti | vakroktiḥ atiśayoktirityarthaḥ || dvitīyaḥ prakāro yathā nayanarucā'vayavarucā'pyagaganajaladānanabhrataṭitaśca | diśidiśi parivikirantī diśati phaṇīśādrimaṇivadhūramṛtam || 1375 || amṛtaṃ salilaṃ niśśreyasaṃ ca | atra gaganaṃ vinā abhrāṇāṃ abhrāṇi vinā taṭitāṃ ca nirādhāratayaivāvasthānam || yathāvā saha raghuvīreṇa gataṃ tadāśritaṃ yaccarācaraṃ nikhilam | tatkīrterdhāṣṭyaṃ kiyadekā lokānnirāśrayā carati || 1376 || pūrvaṃ rūpakasaṅkīrṇam | idaṃ śuddhaṃ samāsoktisaṅkīrṇaṃ vā || dvitīyaviśeṣaḥ yatraikameva yugapadanekādhārasaṃśrayam | ādheyaṃ varṇyate so'pi viśeṣaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || yatraikamādheyaṃ paricchinnayatkiñcidādhārasthitamapi yugapadanekādhāragatatvena varṇyate sa dvitīyo viśeṣaprakāraḥ | vakṣyamāṇaparyāyavyāvṛttaye yugapaditi || yathā śirasi diśāṃ tattvadṛśāṃ manasi munīnāṃ ca vacasi sukavīnām | tvayi santa eva suguṇāḥ payasijalocana sadā'pi viharante || 1377 || yathāvā śrutimaulau natamaulau pratibhāti ca yadvṛṣādrivaramaulau | tatpādapadmayugalaṃ matpāpatatiṃ jagatpaterharatām || 1378 || atrādime padye bhagavataḥ kalyāṇaguṇānāṃ dvitīye pādapadmayugalasya ca yugapadanekādhārasthitiḥ || yathāvā śritakanakavimānaṃ yaṃ vīkṣe'higiro pumāṃsamamumeva | vedmi vidhābhedādravibimbe śritakanakadhāmānam || 1379 || yaṃ ahigirau śritakanakavimānaṃ vīkṣe paśyāmi amumeva pumāṃsaṃ paramapuruṣaṃ ravibimbe vidhābhedāt prakārabhedāt śritakanakadhāmānaṃ 'ya eṣo'ntarāditye hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣa' iti śrutahiraṇyavarṇaṃ vedmi ayameka eva paramapuruṣa ubhayatra sthita iti jānāmi | śeṣādrau jaladanīlavarṇatvaṃ ravibimbe tu suvarṇavarṇatvamityayameva vidhābhedaḥ |pakṣeśritakanakavimānaśabdameva vidhābhedāt vi dhā iti varṇamātravailakṣaṇyāt śritakanakadhāmānaṃ śritakanakadhāmaśabdaṃ vedmīti camatkāra eva pūrvato viśeṣaḥ || tṛtīyaviśeṣaḥ kiṃcitkāryārambhamātrādanyatkāryaṃ suduṣkaram | kṛtaṃ nibadhyate yatra viśeṣasso'pi sammataḥ|| kiṃcitkāryamārabhamāṇasyāsaṃbhāvitāśakyakāryāntaranirvartanaṃ tṛtīyo viśeṣaprakāraḥ | evaṃca etadanyatamatvaṃ viśeṣālaṃkārasāmānyalakṣaṇamiti dhyeyam || yathā sopānapathe dadatā gopālenāpi pādamahiśaile | udalaṅghi sā'rcirādikapadavī sahasā'tra konu saṃdigdhām || 1380 || atra śeṣādrisopānaprathamaparvaṇi padanyasanarūpakiṃcitkāryārambheṇāsaṃbhāvitāśakyatamārcirādimārgollaṅganarūpakāryāntaranirvartanaṃ nibaddham || yathāvā marudaśanavaradharādharaśiro hare tvaṃ vataṃsayasi satatam | jagadakhilaṃ śekharitaṃ bhagavan bhavateti bhavati citramidam || 1381 || atra śeṣagirimātrāvataṃsanalakṣaṇakiṃcitkāryārambheṇa duṣkaratamākhilajagacchekharavattāniṣpādanam || yathāvā tvāmekaṃ viśvambhara bibhrāṇo hṛdi bibharmi viśvamidam | nanu viśvabharaṇanipuṇastvaṃ vā'haṃ vā vimṛśya vada tāvat || 1382 || atraikabhagavadbharaṇakāryārambheṇa duṣkaratamaviśvabharaṇakāryāntarakaraṇam | viśvaṃbhareti sābhiprāyaviśeṣyavinyāsarūpaparikarāṅkurodañcitavaibhavamiti viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā atisurabhigandhamādanamativelaṃ ratnasānumahiśailam | sṛjateha citrakūṭaṃ bahavaśailāḥ kṛtāḥ kṣitau vidhinā || 1383 || atyantaṃ surabhiṇāṃ campakakusumānāṃ gandhena mādanaṃ janamānasavikārotpādakam | pakṣe atisurabhi atimātramanojñaṃ gandhamādanaṃ tannāmānaṃ girim | ratnāni sānuṣu yasyeti taṃ ratnasānum | pakṣe sumerum | citrāṇi vismayāvahāni kūṭāni śikharāṇi yasya tat, citrakūṭanāmagiriṃ ca | īdṛśamahiśailaṃ sṛjatā vidhinā kṣitau bahavaśśailāḥ kṛtāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ || yathāvā sukhapavanasarvatomukhaśucivipulaṃ phaṇadharācalaṃ sṛjatā | anyāni padmajanuṣā yugapadbhūtāni sasṛjire pañca || 1384 || khaṃ nabhaḥ, pavanaḥ, sarvatomukhaṃ salilaṃ, śuciḥ agniḥ, vipulā bhūśca eteṣāṃ samāhāraḥ, tat śobhanaṃ yasya tat sukhapavanasarvatomukhaśucivipulam | pakṣe sukhaṃ pānti rakṣantīti sukhapāni sukhāvahāni vanāni kānanāni yasmin saḥ, sarvatomukhaḥ viśvataśśikharavān, śuciḥ śuddhaḥ, vipulaḥ viśālaśceti viśeṣaṇānāṃ karmadhārayaḥ | īdṛśaṃ phaṇadharācalaṃ sṛjatā | anyatsugamam || atra vilakṣaṇānāṃ bhūtānāṃ yugapatsṛṣṭeśśrautaḥ kramo na vivakṣitaḥ || yathāvā mahitamahārambhāḍhyāṃ bahuśobhābhṛtkṛtasthalāṃ sṛjatā | ahiśailadharāṃ dhātrā vihitā'nekāpsarassṛṣṭiḥ || 1685 || mahitāḥ mahānāṃ ārambhāḥ taiḥ āḍhyāṃ saṃpannām | pakṣe mahitā pūjitā mahatī rambhā tannāmā apsarāḥ tayā āḍhyām | bahuśaḥ bhābhṛnti kṛtāni sthalāni yasyāstām | pakṣe bahuśobhāṃ bibhartīti bahuśobhābhṛt kṛtasthalā nāmāpsarāḥ yasyāṃ seti | ahiśailadharāṃ sṛjatā dhātrā anekāsāṃ apsarasāṃ svarveśyānāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ, pakṣe anekeṣāṃ apsarasāṃ jalāśayānāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ vihiteti || atra 'atisurabhigandhamādanam' ityādyudāharaṇatraye śeṣādrisṛṣṭirūpakiṃcitkāryārambheṇa nānāvidhaśailādisarjanarūpaduṣkaratarakāryāntaraniṣpādanaṃ śleṣottambhitaṃ nibaddham | madhyapadye ratnāvalī ceti viśeṣaḥ || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre viśeṣālaṃkārasaraḥ ṣaṭcatvāriṃśaḥ <22> gadetat | tenaiva vṛṣagirīndo tasmai pradadāsyamandamānandam || 1386 || mahatā yena āpadāṃ prabhavaḥ janmasthānaṃ yo rajovibhavaḥ rajoguṇabhūmā tena etat jagat akṣobhi, tenaiva uktarajoguṇavibhavenaivetyarthaḥ | pakṣe patprabhaveti chedaḥ prabhavatīti prabhavaṃ, padaḥ caraṇāt prabhavaṃ yadrajaḥ tadvibhavena svakīyacaraṇaparāgamahimnetyarthaḥ | amandamānandaṃ pradadāsi || atra duḥkhasādhanatvena prasiddhasyāpatprabhavarajovibhavasya śleṣamahimnā caraṇarajovibhavābhedādhyavasitasya bhagavatā ānandasādhanatāvidhānāllakṣaṇasaṅgatiḥ || yathāvā tvadanabhimukhatāyāṃ prāgamṛtāyyante sma deva ye bhogāḥ | tvadabhimukhatādaśāyāṃ garalāyyante ta eva nanu manujaiḥ || 1387 || atra sukhasādhanatvena prasiddhānāṃ viṣayopabhogānāṃ duḥkhasādhanatānibandhanaṃ pūrvoktaviparītamaśliṣṭamupamāsaṃkīrṇaṃ ceti viśeṣaḥ || dvitīyaḥ prakāro yathā bhogikṣmābhṛdadhīśvaraniṣevaṇairyairbudhā mumukṣante | taireva sadā'bhyastairabudhāssarve'niśaṃ bubhukṣante || 88 || budhāḥ tatvavidaḥ yaiḥ bhogikṣmābhṛdadhīśvarasya śrīśeṣādrinetuḥ bhagavataḥ niṣevaṇaiḥ mumukṣante saṃsārabandhānmoktumicchanti, abudhāḥ atatvavidaḥ taireva bhogikṣmābhṛdadhīśvaraniṣevaṇaireva bhogaikapravaṇā ye kṣmābhṛdadhīśvarāḥ bhūpālaśreṣṭhāḥ teṣāṃ niṣevaṇaireveti vastusthitiḥ | bubhukṣante sāṃsārikabhogānanubhavitumicchanti || atra mokṣasādhanatvena budhairupāttānāṃ bhogikṣmābhṛdadhīśvaraniṣevaṇānāṃ tatpratispardhibhirabudhaistadviruddhabhogasādhanīkaraṇaṃ bhogikṣmābhṛdityādiśabdopāttārthadvayaśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyamūlātiśayajīvātukamityavadheyam || yathāvā padmākṣa puramarīṇāṃ yenādhākṣīssudarśanena tvam | tenaiva puro'rīṇāṃ saṃpadamāvahati tava sarojākṣī || 1389 || he padmākṣa ! arīṇāṃ pauṇḍrakādīnāṃ vairiṇāṃ puraṃ vāraṇāsyādikaṃ nagaraṃ yena sudarśanena cakreṇa tvaṃ adhākṣīḥ dahasi sma, tenaiva sudarśanenaiva tava sarojākṣī lakṣmīḥ arīṇāṃ vairiṇāṃ puraḥ purasya saṃpadaṃ āvahatīti virodhaḥ | parihārastu tena sudarśanenaiva śobhanenālokanenaiva puraḥ svadarśanātpūrvamevetyatiśayoktiḥ| aśritānamiti śeṣaḥ | arīṇāṃ aprasrutāṃ akṣīṇāmiti yāvat | 'riṅ prasravaṇe' daivādikādasmātkartari ktaḥ | asya svāditvena 'svādaya oditaḥ' ityodittve ‘oditaśca' iti niṣṭhātasya natvam | syannaṃ rīṇaṃ srutaṃ srutam' ityamaraḥ | saṃpadaṃ śriyaṃ āvahatīti || atra bhagavatā aripuradahane sādhanatayā svīkṛtasya sudarśanasya etatpratidvandvinyā śriyā tadviruddhasaṃpattidānasādhanīkaraṇaṃ śleṣamūlātiśayena nibaddham || yathāvā asamavilokanadhāmnā pradyumnaṃ pluṣyati sma puravairī | tenaiva vṛṣādripatiḥ pradyumnaṃ puṣyatīha muravairī || 1390 || puravairī rudraḥ asamasya viṣamasya tṛtīyasyetyarthaḥ, vilokanasya vilocanasya dhāmnā tejasā agnineti yāvat | pradyumnaṃ smaraṃ pluṣyati sma adhākṣīt | ‘pluṣa dāhe' daivādikaḥ | vṛṣādripatiḥ tenaiva asamavilocanadhāmnaiva asamena asadṛśena vilocanadhāmnā nayanatviṣā kaṭākṣeṇeti yāvat, iti vastusthitiḥ | pradyumnaṃ smaraṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ hiraṇyaṃ vibhavamityarthaḥ | 'hiraṇyaṃ draviṇaṃ dyumnam' ityamaraḥ | puṣyati puṣṇāti | ‘puṣa puṣṭau' daivādikaḥ | āśritānāmiti śeṣaḥ || atra pradyumnaploṣaṇe puravairiṇā sādhanīkṛtasyāsamāvalokanadhāmna eva tatpratidvandvinā muravairiṇā tatpoṣaṇasādhanīkaraṇam | anyatprāgvat || dvitīyavyāghātaḥ parābhimatakāryasya viruddhā kena citkriyā | saukaryato nibaddhā cedvyāghātasso'pi kathyate || kāryaviśeṣaniṣpādakatayā kenacitsaṃbhāvyamānādarthādanyena sukaratayā kāryavirodhinī kriyā samarthyate cetso'pi vyāghātaḥ | kāryavirodhikriyāyāṃ saukaryaṃ kāraṇasya sutarāṃ tadānuguṇyam || yathā mūḍha iti yadyupekṣā tata eva hare'stu mayyanujighṛkṣā | hanta striyo'nukampyā dīnā mūḍhāśca jantavo hi satām || 1391 || he hare! atra bhagavatā upekṣāyāṃ yanmūḍhatvaṃ kāraṇatvena saṃbhāvitaṃ tat pratyuta tadviruddhānujighṛkṣāyā eva kāraṇatayā ‘striyo'nukampyāssādhūnāṃ dānā mūḍhāśca jantavaḥ' iti pramāṇārthamupanyasya tadyuktatāṃ sthāpayatā kavinā samarthyata ityayaṃ dvitīyo vyāghātaḥ || yathāvā mūrkha iti yadi jahāsi tvaṃ māmanuruntsva nātha tata eva | rakṣanti hi vaśayanto mūrkhaṃ chandānurodhataḥ prājñāḥ || 1392 || atrāpi pūrvavadeva bhagavatā bhaktasya parityāgaṃ yanmūrkhatvaṃ kāraṇatayā saṃbhāvitaṃ tat pratyuta tadviruddhānuvartanasyaiva kāraṇatayā ‘mūrkhaṃ chandānurodhena' iti nītipradarśanena tadaucityaṃ sthāpayatā kavinā samarthyate || ityalaṅkāramaṇihāre vyāghātālaṅkārasarassaptacatvāriṃśaḥ evaṃ śleṣātiśayoktyādyupāyonmiṣitena kiñcidaṃśābhedādhyavasānenāmukha eva prādurbhāvito yo virodho vicchittimātrātmā kṣaṇaprabhāvadanuvartamānastanmūlakā virodhābhāsādayo vyāghātāntā nirūpitā alaṅkārāḥ | te ca nānārūpaṃ vaicitryaṃ bhajanto virodhābhāsasyaiva prabhedāḥ, na tu tato'tiriktāḥ kāñcanasyeva kaṅkaṇādaya ityeke | rūpakadīpakādīnāmaupamyagarbhāṇāmupamābhedatvāpatterbhūyasī syādvaiyagrīti parasparacchāyāmātrānusāriṇo bhinnavicchittayo bhinnā evetyapare || <23> rbhūyasī syādvaiyagrīti parasparacchāyāmātrānusāriṇo bhinnavicchittayo bhinnā evetyapare || atha śṛṅkhalālaṃkārāḥ yadyuttarottarasya syātpūrvapūrvānubandhitā artheṣu paṅktibaddheṣu vyatyayo vā'pi śṛṅkhalā || paṅktirūpeṇa nibaddheṣvartheṣu uttarottarasya pūrvapūrvasmin vā pūrvapūrvasyottarottarasmin vā saṃsṛṣṭatvaṃ śṛṅkhalā | tacca kāryakāraṇatvaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvādinānārūpam | iyaṃ ca na svatantro'laṃkāraḥ, vakṣyamāṇaprabhedairgatārthatvāt | na hyanayā vinā teṣāṃ vivikto'sti viṣayaḥ | yathāhi rūpakādiṣvanuprāṇayitṛtayā vartamāno'pyabhedāṃśassamānadharmāṃśo vā na pṛthagalaṃkāraḥ, evaṃ prakṛte'pītyāhuḥ | tadapare na kṣamante sāvayavādibhedaiḥ rūpakasya, pūrṇāluptādibhedairupamāyāśca gatārthatvātsvatantrālaṃkāratā na syāt | tasmācchṛṅkhalāyā eva kāraṇamālādayo bhedā iti | matayoranayostattvamupariṣṭādvivecayiṣyāmaḥ || atha kāraṇamālāsaraḥ pūrvapūrvairvastubhissyāduttarottarakāraṇaiḥ | gumbhaḥ kāraṇamālaiṣā vaiparītye'pi ceṣyate || uttarottarakāraṇabhūtaiḥ pūrvapūrvaiḥ pūrvapūrvakāraṇabhūtairuttarottarairvā vastubhirgumbhane saiva śṛṅkhalākāraṇamālālaṃkāro bhavati | tatra pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ kāraṇaṃ paraṃ paraṃ kāryamiti prāthamikī | pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ kāryaṃ paraṃ paraṃ kāraṇamiti dvaitīyīkī || tatra prāthamikī yathā bhaktyā tvadgirigamanaṃ tvadgirigamanena tava tu nidhyānam | tvannidhyānena vibho pūrṇānandārṇavāntarāplavanam || 1393 || nidhyānaṃ darśanam | ‘nirvarṇanaṃ tu nidhyānaṃ darśanālokanekṣaṇam' ityamaraḥ || atra bhaktyādīnāṃ pūrvapūrveṣāṃ śeṣādrigamanādyuttarottaraṃ prati kāraṇatvaṃ nibaddham || yathāvā annātkhalu bhūtānāṃ prāṇāḥ prāṇairmano'tha manasaśca | vijñānaṃ vijñānādānando brahma bhāsanaṃ dadhate || annāt bhūtānāṃ prāṇāḥ bhāsanaṃ prakāśaṃ dadhate bibhrati | jauhotyādikasya dhāño laṭprathamapuruṣabahuvacanam | prāṇaiḥ manaḥ bhāsanaṃ dadhate dhatte | bhauvādikasya dadhaterlaṭprathamapuruṣaikavacanam | evamagre'pi | atrāpyannādīnāṃ pūrvapūrveṣāṃ prāṇādyuttarottaraṃ prati kāraṇatā gumbhitā | iyaṃ ca ‘annātprāṇā bhavanti bhūtānāṃ prāṇairmano manasaśca vijñānaṃ vijñānādānando brahmayoniḥ' iti taittirīyakaśrutyarthānusāriṇīti viśeṣaḥ | alaṃkārāṇāṃ śrutimūlatākhyāpanāyedamudāharaṇam | ‘annāt prāṇāḥ indriyāṇi prāṇā vā bhavanti | śravaṇānukūlendriyaprāṇasauṣṭhavaṃ jāyata ityarthaḥ | manaḥ mananaṃ, vijñānaṃ darśanasamānākāraṃ jñānaṃ, ānandaḥ ānandamayaṃ brahma parabrahma bhavati bhāsate | prāṇasauṣṭhavamūlakaśravaṇādiparaṃparayotpannānnididhyasanādānandarūpaṃ paraṃ brahma prāpyata iti śruterarthaḥ|| yathāvā āhārasya viśuddhyā śuddhissattvasya sattvaśuddhau te | bhavati dhruvā'cyuta smṛtirakhilagranthipramokṣaṇaṃ tasyāḥ || 1395 || atra ‘āhāraśuddhau sattvaśuddhissattvaśuddhau dhruvā smṛtiḥ smṛtilambhe sarvagranthīnāṃ vipramokṣaḥ' iti śrutyanuvidhānena pūrvapūrvasyāhāraśuddhyāderuttarottarasattvaśuddhyādikaṃ prati kāraṇatā nibaddhā pūrvavadeva || āhāraśuddhau sāttvikāhārasevāyāṃ satyāṃ sattvasya antaḥkaraṇasya śuddhiḥ | tasyāṃ ca satyāṃ dhruvā smṛtiḥ darśanasamānākārā smṛtirbhavati | tasyāṃ satyāṃ sarvagranthīnāṃ durmocatayā granthiśabdavācyānāmavidyārāgādīnāṃ vipramokṣo bhavati iti śruterarthaḥ || yathāvā indriyavijayo manasassthemnā tasmācca karmayogagatiḥ | jñānaṃ tasmāttasmādbhaktirbhavati tato bhavenmuktiḥ || 1396 || iyaṃ kāryopakramā | pūrvāstu kāraṇopakramā iti viśeṣaḥ || dvitīyā yathā bhavavipadastava padayuganavapaṅkajaśaraṇavaraṇavaidhuryāt | tadanekādavivekātso'pyacyuta satsamāgamālābhāt || 1397 || atra bhavavipadādipūrvapūrvaṃ prati uttarottaraśaraṇavaraṇavaidhuryādīnāṃ kāraṇatvaṃ prathitam || yathāvā śreyoheturvibhavo vibhavasya nibandhanaṃ ramāpāpāṅgaḥ | tatkāraṇaṃ ca bhajanaṃ bhajananidānaṃ ca pūrvapuṇyaśrīḥ || 1398 || pūrvodāharaṇe vibhaktyā kāraṇatvabodhanaṃ, iha tu hetvādiśabdaireveti viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā gurukṛpayā haricaraṇaprapadanameṣā ca sattvaguṇapūrtyā | sā ca bhagavatkaṭākṣātsa bhavati yādṛcchikādisukṛtavaśāt || 1399 || eṣā gurukṛpā || ihādau kāraṇopakramaḥ pūrvatra kāryopakrama iti vailakṣaṇyam | iha ca yadyādau kāraṇoktireva prastūyate tadā punaḥ tatkasyacitkāraṇaṃ tadapi kasyaciditi, tasya kāraṇaṃ tasyāpi kāraṇamiti vā kāraṇamālā yuktā | yadā tu kāryoktirādāvupakramyate tadā tatkasyacitkāryaṃ tadapi kasyaciditi, tasya kāryaṃ tasyāpi kāryamiti vā yuktā | sarvathaiva yaḥ kāryakāraṇatvopasthāpaṃkadeśśabda ādau prayuktassa eva nirvāhyaḥ | evaṃkrameṇa nibandhanamākāṅkṣānurūpatvādramaṇīyam | anyathā tu bhagnakramaṃ syāditi dhyeyam | yathā prācīnānāṃ padyaṃ jitendriyatvaṃ vinayasya kāraṇaṃ guṇaprakarṣo vinayādavāpyate | guṇādhike puṃsi jano'nurajyate janānurāgaprabhavā hi saṃpadaḥ || atra jitendriyatvaṃ vinayasya kāraṇaṃ śrutvā jitendriyatvasyāpi kiṃ kāraṇamiti vinayaḥ kasya kāraṇamiti vā ākāṅkṣediti, kāraṇasyaiva smṛtivaśātpūrvamupasthiteḥ | kāraṇaṃ tu jñātaṃ kāryaṃ punarasya kimiti kvacidākāṅkṣā tu kāryatvakāraṇatvayossaṃbandhipadārthatvātkāraṇaśravaṇottaramekasaṃbandhijñānādhīnakāryatvopasthityā saṃgamanīyā, na tvasau sārvatrikī, evaṃca vinayaḥ kasya kāraṇamityākāṅkṣāyāḥ guṇaprakarṣo vinayādavāpyata iti vākyaṃ yadyapi phalataḥ paripūrakaṃ bhavati | tathā'pi na sākṣādityahṛdayaṅgamameva | tathā guṇaprakarṣātkimavāpyata ityākāṅkṣāyāṃ guṇādhike puṃsīti ca | atra ca kathitapadatvaṃ na doṣaḥ, pratyuta padāntareṇa tasyārthasyoktau rūpāntareṇa sthitasya naṭasyeva pratyabhijñāpratirodhakatvādvivakṣitārthasiddherakuṇṭhitatvavirahāddoṣassyāt | śabdādupasthite'rthe pravṛttinimittamiva śabdo'pi viśeṣaṇatayā bhāsate | tathācoktam na so'sti pratyayo loke yaśśabdānugamādṛte | iti | tattacchabdasya viśiṣṭasyārthassvarūpeṇābhinno'pi vilakṣaṇaḥ pratīyata iti na kathitapadatvadoṣa iti vadanti | vistarastvanyatra draṣṭavyaḥ || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre kāraṇamālāsaro'ṣṭacatvāriṃśaḥ <24> athaikāvalīsaraḥ uttarasyottarasya syātpūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ viśeṣaṇam | viśeṣyaṃ vā yadā prāhurimāmekāvalīṃ tadā || uttarottarasya pūrvapūrvaṃ prati viśeṣaṇatayā viśeṣyatayā vā gumbhane saiva śṛṅkhalaikāvalītyucyate | iyameva gṛhītamuktarītyā'rthaśreṇirityucyate | gṛhītaṃ ca tanmuktaṃ ca gṛhītamuktaṃ tasya rītiḥ paṅktiḥ tayā gṛhītamuktarītyā | abhede tṛtīyā | tataśca gṛhītamuktapaṅktirekāvalīti tadarthaḥ || tatrādyā yathā bhujagagirirharivasatirharirambudhijāvihāramaṇiśikharī | ambudhijā''śritavibhavānudañcayati te vataṃsayanti bhuvam || 1400 || atrottarottarasya haryādeḥ pūrvapūrvabhujagagiryādiviśeṣaṇabhāvaḥ | iyaṃ cottarottaraviśeṣaṇasya sthāpakatvāpohakatvābhyāṃ dvividhā | yadāhuḥ sthāpyate'pohyate vā'pi yathāpūrvaṃ paraṃparam | viśeṣaṇatayā yatra vastu saikāvalī dvidhā || iti | yatra yathāpūrvaṃ pūrvapūrvasya paraṃ paraṃ uttarottaraṃ viśeṣaṇatayā sthāpyate vidhīyate apohyate niṣidhyate vā tatraikāvalīti tadarthaḥ || yathā sa budho yastu vivekī sa viveko yastu tattvasaṃmarśaḥ | tattattvaṃ yatparamaṃ tatparamaṃ brahma bhāti yatsaramam || 1401 || atrottarottaravivekādiviśeṣaṇānāṃ pūrvapūrvabudhādiviśeṣyasthāpakatvam || na sa manujo yo'vidvānna sa vidvānyo na veda tadbrahma | na brahma tadvṛṣādrau yanna pariramedramāvaśoraskam || 1402 || atra pūrvapūrvasya manujāderviśeṣyasya uttarottaramavidvadādiviśeṣaṇamapohakam | yadyapi sthāpake'pyapohakatvaṃ gamyate yo na vivekī na sa budha ityādi, tathā'pohake'pi sthāpakatvaṃ yo vidvān sa manuja ityādi, tathā'pi nopāttaṃ tadityadoṣaḥ || pūrvapūrvasya uttarottaraṃ prati viśeṣaṇatayā gumbhanaṃ dvitīya prakāraḥ | sa yathā tvadvibhavajño bhīṣmastajjananī jagadidaṃ pavitrayati | taddayite tvaṃ śayito guṇāstavācyuta nṛṇāṃ priyaṃkaraṇāḥ || 1403 || yathāvā lakṣmyā vibhāti bhagavāṃstenāhigiriśca bhavati śekharitaḥ | tena dramiḍā ramyāstairetadbhūṣitaṃ bharatakhaṇḍam || 1404 || dramiḍānāṃ nivāso janapadaḥ dramiḍāḥ | ‘so'sya nivāsaḥ' ityaṇo ‘janapade lup' iti lupi yuktavalliṅgavacane || atrādye pūrvapūrvasya bhīṣmāderuttarottaragaṅgādikaṃ prati viśeṣaṇabhāvaḥ | dvitīye lakṣmyāderbhagavadādikaṃ pratīti dhyeyam || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre ekāvalīsara ekonapañcāśaḥ atredamavadheyam asmiṃścaikāvalyā dvitīyabhede pūrvapūrvaiḥ parasya parasyopakāraḥ kriyamāṇo yadyekarūparasyāt tadā ayameva mālādīpakatayā vyayahriyate prācīnaiḥ | yathāca lakṣitaṃ taiḥ mālādīpakamādyaṃ cedyathottaraguṇāvaham | iti | ādyaṃ dīpakamityarthaḥ | tatra mālāśabdena śṛṅkhalocyate | dīpakaśabdena dīpa iveti vyutpattyā ekadeśasthaṃ sarvopakārakamucyate | tenaikadeśasthasarvopakārakakriyādiśālinī śṛṅkhaleti padadvayārthaḥ | evaṃ ca dīpakālaṃkāraprakaraṇe prācīnairasya lakṣaṇāddīpakaviśeṣo'yamiti na bhramitavyaṃ, tasya sādṛśyagarbhatāyāssakalālakārikasaṃpratipannatvāt | iha ca śṛṅkhalāvayavānāṃ padānāṃ sādṛśyameva nāstīti kathaṃkāraṃ dīpakatāvācoyuktiṃ śraddhadhemahi, teṣāṃ prakṛtāprakṛtātmakatvavirahāccetyāhuḥ || vastutastu ekasyaiva dharmasya vākyāntareṣvapyanvayamātreṇa dīpakasādṛśyāddīpakamityanupadameva vakṣyamāṇarītyā vicchittiviśeṣasadbhāvātmālādīpakasya pṛthagalaṃkārataiva yuktā | anyathā śṛṅkhalārūpālaṃkārabhedānāṃ kāraṇamālādīnāmapi yatkiṃcidvicchittiviśeṣaśālitayā pṛthagalaṃkāratābhyupagamo'pyayukta eva syāditi pare | ata eva sarvasvakṛtā'pyasminneva prakaraṇe ayamalaṃkāraḥ pṛthaglakṣitaḥ 'pūrvapūrvasyottarottaraguṇāvahatve mālādīpakam' iti | yadyapi prācīnairetaddīpanamātrānuguṇyāddīpakānantaraṃ lakṣitam | śṛṅkhalāmūlatvena viśiṣṭamasya cārutvamityasminneva prakaraṇe lakṣitaṃ sarvasvakuvalayānandakārādibhiriti || atha mālādīpakasaraḥ mālādīpakametatsyāddīpakaikāvalīyuteḥ || yuteḥ yogāt | ekadharmānvayasya gṛhītamuktarīteśca melanāt mālādīpakaṃ nāmālaṃkāraḥ | ekasyaiva dharmasya vākyāntareṣvapyanvayamātreṇa dīpakasādṛśyāddīpakaṃ, na tu prāguktadīpakālaṃkāraḥ, prakṛtāprakṛtānāmaupamyasya gamyatāyāmeva tadavatārāt || yathā hāraḥ kaustubhamaṇinā so'pi bhavadvakṣasā tadapi lakṣmyā | sā'pi bhavatā bhavānapi sauśīlyādyairguṇairupaskriyate || 1405 || upaskriyate alaṃkriyate | upapūrvakātkṛñaḥ karmaṇi laṭ | 'upātpratiyatna' ityādinā pratiyatnārthe kṛñassuṭ | pratiyatno guṇādhānam | atra upaskriyata ityekameva padaṃ hāraḥ kaustubhamaṇinā upaskriyate so'pi bhavadvakṣasā upaskriyata ityevaṃ sarvavākyānvayīti dīpakasādṛśyāddīpakam | gṛhītasuktarītisadbhāvādekāvalīti dīpakaikāvalīyogaḥ || <25> yadyapi prācīnairetaddīpanamātrānuguṇyāddīpakānantaraṃ lakṣitam | śṛṅkhalāmūlatvena viśiṣṭamasya cārutvamityasminneva prakaraṇe lakṣitaṃ sarvasvakuvalayānandakārādibhiriti || atha mālādīpakasaraḥ mālādīpakametatsyāddīpakaikāvalīyuteḥ || yuteḥ yogāt | ekadharmānvayasya gṛhītamuktarīteśca melanāt mālādīpakaṃ nāmālaṃkāraḥ | ekasyaiva dharmasya vākyāntareṣvapyanvayamātreṇa dīpakasādṛśyāddīpakaṃ, na tu prāguktadīpakālaṃkāraḥ, prakṛtāprakṛtānāmaupamyasya gamyatāyāmeva tadavatārāt || yathā hāraḥ kaustubhamaṇinā so'pi bhavadvakṣasā tadapi lakṣmyā | sā'pi bhavatā bhavānapi sauśīlyādyairguṇairupaskriyate || 1405 || upaskriyate alaṃkriyate | upapūrvakātkṛñaḥ karmaṇi laṭ | 'upātpratiyatna' ityādinā pratiyatnārthe kṛñassuṭ | pratiyatno guṇādhānam | atra upaskriyata ityekameva padaṃ hāraḥ kaustubhamaṇinā upaskriyate so'pi bhavadvakṣasā upaskriyata ityevaṃ sarvavākyānvayīti dīpakasādṛśyāddīpakam | gṛhītasuktarītisadbhāvādekāvalīti dīpakaikāvalīyogaḥ || yathāvā rudrāśritā diviṣado rudro brahmāṇamāśrito bhagavan | brahmā tvāmāśrita iha na tvaṃ śrayase kadācidapi kamapi || 1406 || idamāvṛttidīpakaikāvalīyogalakṣaṇaṃ mālādīpakamiti pūrvodāharaṇādviśeṣaḥ | atra rudraṃ samāśritā devā rudro brahmāṇamāśritaḥ | brahmā māmāśrito rājannāhaṃ kaṃcidupāśritaḥ || iti mahābhāratīyabhagavadvacanārtho'nusaṃhitaḥ || ityalaṃkāramāṇihāre mālādīpakasaraḥ pañcāśaḥ
